tei:div.tei:p: kyi ga rjo(/nya nga
(81)krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gis dpe bsdur zhus/krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang /
rme

rgyud 'bum/ (mi (81)0454 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i rtog pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 3dang po/ sprul pa rnam par dag pa'i le'u/ 3gnyis pa/ lha 'byung ba'i le'u/ 7gsum pa/ bris sku'i le'u/ 11bzhi pa/ gsang sngags rnams 'byung ba'i le'u/ 13lnga pa/ sbyor ka phra mo'i le'u/ 16drug pa/ 'khrul 'khor gyi le'u/ 18bdun pa/ sbyin sreg gi le'u/ 24paṇ+ḍi ta a tu la dā sa badz+ra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba mar pa brje chos kyi dbang phyug grags pas bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(29) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(39)0455 khro bo'i rgyal po thams cad gsang sngags gsang ba'i rgyud ces

bya ba 40dang po/ mos pa rnam par dag pa'i le'u/ 40gnyis pa/ lus kyi rnam par dag pa'i le'u/ 41gsum pa/ 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i sngags rnam par dag pa'i le'u/ 41bzhi pa/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor bkod pa'i rim pa'i le'u/ 42lnga pa/ byung ba'i dkyil 'khor bkod pa'i le'u/ 44bsdur mchan/(46) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(47)0456 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i gsang rgyud chen po/ 48dang po/ gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 48gnyis pa/ mngon par rtogs pa'i le'u/ 49gsum pa/ dngos grub kyi le'u/ 50bzhi pa/ gsang sngags kyi le'u/ 52bsdur mchan/(54) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(55)0457 rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud/ 56dang po/ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor byed pa'i mngon tshul bstan pa'i le'u/ 56gnyis pa/ de bzhin nyid sbyor ba ye shes bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 59gsum pa/ sngags phyung ba'i rim pa bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 63bzhi pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 65lnga pa/ las chen po bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 68drug pa/ rdo rje rtsu mdzad kyi bsgrub pa bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 70bdun pa/ dbyangs dang / gar dang / dbang bskur ba dang / de 2

bzhin nyid cher dmigs pa dag bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 72brgyad pa/ dpal ldan khrag 'thung bskyed pa bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 75dgu pa/ dpal bdud rtsi 'khyil pa 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 76bcu pa/ ro langs bsgrub pa bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 78bcu gcig pa/ bdud rtsi lnga sgrub pa'i thabs bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80lo tsā ba gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(82) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(87)0458 rigs kyi 'jig rten mgon po lnga bcu pa zhes bya ba/ 88dang po/ sngags kyi de kho na nyid kyi le'u/ 88gnyis pa/ bdag gi de kho na nyid kyi le'u/ 89gsum pa/ lha'i de kho na nyid kyi le'u/ 90paṇ+ḍi ta chen po bi ma la shrī bha dra'i zhal snga nas/ byang chub rin chen gyis bskul nas / shud ke grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(94) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(95)0459 'phags ma sgrol ma ku ru ku l+le'i rtog pa/ 96rtog pa dang po/ 96rtog pa gnyis pa/ 102rtog pa gsum pa/ 109rtog pa bzhi pa/ 114rtog pa lnga pa/ 119rgya gar gyi mkhan po tha'i paṇ+ḍi ta dang / tsā 3

ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(128) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(138)0460 sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig gis bstod pa phan yon dang bcas pa 139bsdur mchan/(142) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(144)0461 rdo rje phur pa rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi dum bu/ 145slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dngos kyi rgya dpe dang mthun par/ dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas g.yas ru'i sa'i cha/ shangs kyi sreg zhing du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(150) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(153)0462 nag po chen po zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 154dang po/ de kho na shes par byed pa'i le'u/ 154gnyis pa/ thab khung gi rnam pa bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 158gsum pa/ sngags kyi le'u/ 159bzhi pa/ dbang gi rim par phye ba'i le'u/ 163lnga pa/ lha dbang bskur ba'i le'u/ 164drug pa/ spyod pa'i le'u/ 164bdun pa/ lha rnams bzhengs pa'i le'u/ 167brgyad pa/ sa 'og gi bug pa brtag pa'i le'u/ 177

dgu pa/ lha mos zhus pa dang lan las ril bu'i le'u/ 183bcu pa/ rkang byug gi le'u/ 188bcu gcig pa/ lha mo mthu yis brgyan pa'i le'u/ 192bcu gnyis pa/ mig sman gyi le'u/ 194bcu gsum pa/ dngul chu'i le'u/ 195bcu bzhi pa/ dngul chu'i sgrub thabs kyi le'u/ 200bco lnga pa/ rgyal po'i gtam rgyud bstan pa'i le'u/ 203bcu drug pa/ g.yog mo bsgrub pa'i le'u/ 212bcu bdun pa/ dbang du bya ba'i le'u/ 216bco brgyad pa/ pha rol gyi bya ba chud gson pa'i le'u/ 219bcu dgu pa/ rengs pa'i le'u/ 219nyi shu pa/ bsad pa'i le'u/ 220nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ dngos grub nges pa'i le'u/ 225nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ char dbab pa dang gcad par bya ba dag gi le'u/ 226nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ gtso bor rnyed par dka' ba'i sems can thams cad la bde ba ster bar byed pa'i le'u/ 228nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ rgyal po 'grub bam mi 'grub brtag pa'i le'u/ 230nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ bya ba'i le'u/ 231nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor gyi le'u/ 233nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ bslab pa'i sdom pa'i le'u/ 233nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ de kho na'i le'u/ 234nyi shu rtsa dgu pa/ zhing skyes kyi le'u/ 234sum cu pa/ zhing skyong bzhengs pa'i le'u/ 235sum cu so gcig pa/ rtsa'i 'khor lo'i le'u/ 2365

sum cu so gnyis pa/ dge ba dang mi dge ba brjod pa'i le'u/ 236ma cu so gsum pa/ dbyangs can ma'i cho ga bsam gtan gyi bsgrub pa'i le'u/ 237sum cu so bzhi pa/ gzhon nu mas rtsi ba'i le'u/ 243sum cu so lnga pa/ mnyam par sbyor ba'i le'u/ 243sum cu so drug pa/ kha dog 'byung ba'i le'u/ 243sum cu so bdun pa/ rengs par bya ba'i sngags kyi le'u/ 244sum cu so brgyad pa/ sbyin sreg gi le'u/ 246sum cu so dgu pa/ ston mo dang shes rab mas rnam par dag par byed pa'i le'u/ 246bzhi bcu pa/ rol mo'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 247bzhi bcu rtsa gcig pa/ rab tu sbyor ba'i le'u/ 247bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis pa/ byol song bskrad pa'i le'u/ 248bzhi bcu rtsa gsum pa/ mnyam par sbyor ba'i le'u/ 248bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi pa/ rnal 'byor gyi le'u/ nagabazhi bcu rtsa lnga pa/ pas kyi dpung 'joms pa'i le'u/ nagabazhi bcu rtsa drug pa/ gzung ba dang dor ba'i le'u/ nagabazhi bcu rtsa bdun pa/ skar ma'i le'u/ 250bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa/ dge ba bsam pa'i le'u/ 250bzhi bcu rtsa dgu pa/ lam gyi cho ga'i rim pa'i le'u/ 251lnga bcu pa/ a tharba sha ba rī'i sngags kyi le'u/ 251ldang 'phrul gyi gtsug lag khang chen por sa ra mo cher pha rgyal khams pas zhus pa'i don du paṇ+ḍi ta chen po sa man+ta shrī dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ra dge slong chos rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/

bsdur mchan/(252) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(277)0462 ji bzhin brnyes pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud/ 278dang po/ lha yi dam tshig gi le'u/ 278gnyis pa/ thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u/ 280gsum pa/ gsung gi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u/ 282bzhi pa/ sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi le'u/ 283lnga pa/ rgyud gzhan dang thun mong ba'i le'u/ 284rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po tāk+ṣa ka ga ṇa dang /lo tsā ba mang 'or dge slong byang chub shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(287) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(288)0464 de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang chen gsang ba 'dus pa zhes bya ba brtag pa'i rgyal po chen po/ 289dang po/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor byin gyis rlob pa'i le'u/ 289gnyis pa/ byang chub kyi sems kyi le'u/ 298gsum pa/ rdo rje bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 301bzhi pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u/304lnga pa/ kun du spyod pa'i mchog gi le'u/ 306drug pa/ sku dang gsung dang thugs byin gyis rlob pa'i le'u/ 308bdun pa/ sngags kyi spyod pa mchog gi le'u/ 3127

brgyad pa/ bshang gci'i dam tshig gi le'u/ 316dgu pa/ don dam pa'i dag pa de kho na nyid kyi don gyi dam tshig gi le'u/ 319bcu pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs bskul ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 322bcu gcig pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sngags kyi dam tshig de kho na nyid rig pa'i skyes bu mchog gi le'u/ 326bcu gnyis pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i sbyor ba dam tshig sgrub pa mchog nges par bstan pa'i le'u/ 332bcu gsum pa/ rdo rje'i dam tshig bkod pa de kho na nyid kyi don sgom pa mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 340bcu bzhi pa/ sku dang gsung dang thugs rmad du byung ba sngags kyis 'gugs pa rnam par sprul pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 358bco lnga pa/ sems can thams cad kyi dam tshig gi snying po rdo rje 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 371bcu drug pa/ dngos grub thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor rdo rje mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 389bcu bdun pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig dang sdom pa rdo rje'i byin gyi rlabs kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 402rgya gar gyi mkhan po thad dhā ka ra warma dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/slad kyis pa'i ta bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rje btsun nyi ma'i dbang po'i zhal snga nas chag lots+tsha ba dge slong chos rje dpal gyis gus pas zhus shing dag par bcos te gtan la phab/8

bsdur mchan/(426) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(441)0465 dpal gsang ba 'dus pa zhes bya ba rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po/ 442dang po/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor byin gyis rlob pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 442gnyis pa/ byang chub sems kyi le'u/ 452gsum pa/ rdo rje bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u/ 455bzhi pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u/457lnga pa/ kun tu spyod pa mchog gi le'u/ 459drug pa/ sku dang / gsung dang / thugs byin gyis rlob pa'i le'u/ 462bdun pa/ sngags kyi spyod pa mchog gi le'u/ 465brgyad pa/ bshang gci'i dam tshig gi le'u/ 469dgu pa/ don dam pa'i dag pa de kho na nyid kyi don gyi dam tshig gi le'u/ 472bcu pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po bskul ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 476bcu gcig pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sngags kyi dam tshig de kho na nyid rdo rje'i rig pa'i skyes bu mchog gi le'u/ 479bcu gnyis pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i sbyor ba'i dam tshig sgrub pa'i mchog bstan pa'i le'u/ 486bcu gsum pa/ rdo rje dam tshig bkod pa de kho na nyid kyi don bsgom pa mngon par byang chub pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ go4bcu bzhi pa/ sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rmad du byung ba'i sngags kyis 'gugs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 511bco lnga pa/ sems can thams cad kyi dam tshig gi snying po'i rdo rje 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 5259

bcu drug pa/ dngos grub thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor rdo rje mngon par byang chub pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 542bcu bdun pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig dang / sdom pa rdo rje'i byin gyis brlabs kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 555rgya gar gyi mkhan po shra ka ra wa dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing skus te gtan la phab/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī tsā na ka ra bas bshad nas/zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba 'gos lhas btsas kyis zhus/bsdur mchan/(579) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(583)0466 rgyud phyi ma/ 584rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsār+ya thad dhā ka ra wa dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing bcos te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(604) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(611)0467 dgongs pa lung bstan pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud/ 612dang po/ gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 612gnyis pa/ byang chub sems bshad pa'i le'u/ 631gsum pa/ rdo rje bkod pa'i mchog gi le'u/ 641bzhi pa/ thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u/ 646lnga pa/ sngags rnams kun gyi spyod pa'i le'u/ 650drug pa/ rdo rje gsum gyis byin gyis brlab pa'i le'u/ 655bdun pa/ sngags kyi spyod pa mchog gi le'u/ 661brgyad pa/ bshang gci'i dam tshig ces bya ba'i le'u/ 66710

dgu pa/ dam tshig gi tshul bshad pa'i le'u/ 673bcu pa/ de nyid bskul ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 680bcu gcig pa/ rig pa skyes bu mchog gi le'u/ 688bcu gnyis pa/ rdo rje sbyor ba'i dam tshig sgrub pa'i mchog bstan pa'i le'u/ 701rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī lha dra dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(731) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(751)0468 rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba mngon par brjod pa rgyud thams cad kyi snying po gsang ba rnam par phye ba zhes bya ba/ 752dang po/ gsol ba gdab pa dang / dri ba dang / slob ma'i las nyid la sogs pa rgyud kyi gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 752gnyis pa/ slob dpon dang slob ma brtag pa dang dbang bskur ba'i le'u/ 761gsum pa/ rdo rje phreng ba'i tshig dbye ba'i le'u/ 765bzhi pa/ 'dus pa'i tshig lhag par bshad pa'i le'u/ 768lnga pa/ stong pa nyid kyi don bstan pa'i le'u/ 769drug pa/ thig le'i dbye ba dang rnal 'byor mchog thob par byed pa'i le'u/ 772bdun pa/ nā da'i tshig rnam par bshad pa'i le'u/ 777brgyad pa/ gsang ba chen po'i tshogs ma lus par bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 778dgu pa/ sdom pa'i tshig gtan la dbab pa'i le'u/ 779bcu pa/ dam tshig gi don gtan la dbab pa'i le'u/ 781bcu gcig pa/ sgra tsam gyi don gtan la dbab pa'i le'u/ 78311

bcu gnyis pa/ rlung gi de kho na nyid bshad pa'i le'u/ 785bcu gsum pa/ bde ba chen po'i tshig rnam par bshad pa'i le'u/ 788bcu bzhi pa/ rdo rje pad+ma yang dag par sbyor ba bshad pa'i le'u/ 791bco lnga pa/ sngags kyi de kho na nyid gsungs pa'i le'u/ 793bcu drug pa/ rlung gi grangs kyi rim pa'i gnas bstan pa'i le'u/ 797bcu bdun pa/ rtsa'i 'khor lo'i gnas kyi rim pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 801bco brgyad pa/ rnal 'byor pa'i lus kyi rtsa bsdus pa'i le'u/ 805bcu dgu pa/ skad cig ma'i mtshan nyid rgyas par bshad pa'i le'u/ 808nyi shu pa/ dga' ba'i mtshan nyid rnam par dbye ba'i le'u/ 808nyi shu gcig pa/ thig le gsum rnam par dbye ba'i le'u/ 810nyi shu gnyis pa/ sku gsum gyi snying po bshad pa'i le'u/ 812nyi shu gsum pa/ de kho na nyid gsum gyi dam tshig gtan la dbab pa'i le'u/ 816nyi shu bzhi pa/ sna'i rtse mo gsum gtan la phab pa'i le'u/ 821nyi shu lnga pa/ stong pa nyid kyi tshig bshad pa'i le'u/ 824nyi shu drug pa/ lus kyi lha ye shes kyi mtshan nyid kyi le'u/ 826nyi shu bdun pa/ 'khor lo bzhi'i lha mo bzhi rim pa rnam par phye ba'i le'u/ 827nyi shu brgyad pa/ 'char ba dang nub pa'i le'u/ 831nyi shu dgu pa/ dga' ba bskyed pa'i mtshan nyid kyi le'u/ 832sum cu pa/ rtsa 'bab pa'i mtshan nyid kyi go cha zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 833sum cu gcig pa/ mtshams kyi rtsa gsum gyi nges pa'i le'u/ 834sum cu gnyis pa/ rlung gis bskyed pa skyes bu skye ba 'jug pa'i le'u/ 836sum cu gsum pa/ rlung gi rim pas srog zad pa rgyas par bshad pa'i le'u/ 838sum cu bzhi pa/ mkha' 'gro ma sdud pa'i le'u/ 840sum cu lnga pa/ rnam par rtog pa'i rlung gcod pa'i mtshan nyid kyi le'u/ 84012

sum cu drug pa/ rnam rtog med pa'i mtshan nyid kyi le'u/ 841sum cu bdun pa/ rtsa rnams nub pa'i sbyong ba'i le'u/ 842sum cu brgyad pa/ 'khor lo drug sgom pa'i le'u/ 843sum cu dgu pa/ dus dang dus tshad rnam par bshad pa'i le'u/ 844bzhi bcu pa/ gsang ba'i 'bras bu zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 846bzhi bcu gcig pa/ chos kyi dbyings kyi don bshad pa'i le'u/ 846bzhi bcu gnyis pa/ rdo rje bshad pa'i le'u/ 848bzhi bcu gsum pa/ rigs kyi dbye ba'i don bsdus pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 848bzhi bcu bzhi pa/ phyag rgya'i dbye ba rgyas par bshad pa'i le'u/ 850bzhi bcu lnga pa/ phung po la sogs pa dang skye mched kyi mtshan nyid kyi le'u/ 852bzhi bcu drug pa/ phyag rgya chen po'i don rnam par nges pa'i le'u/ 853bzhi bcu bdun pa/ nyams kyi dbye ba bshad pa'i le'u/ 854bzhi bcu brgyad pa/ a haṃ gi sgra'i don bshad pa'i le'u/ 855bzhi bcu dgu pa/ stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid kyi le'u/ 856lnga bcu pa/ stong pa nyid kyi rdo rje'i phreng ba bskyed pa'i mtshan nyid kyi le'u/ 858lnga bcu gcig pa/ mtshan mo nyin mo rgyas par bshad pa'i le'u/ 859lnga bcu gnyis pa/ ā li kā li rgyas par bshad pa'i le'u/ 860lnga bcu gsum pa/ mtshams kyi 'char ba'i mtshan nyid kyi le'u/ 860lnga bcu bzhi pa/ cho ga nyi shu'i las rgyas pa'i le'u/ 861lnga bcu lnga pa/ cho ga nyi shu pa'i rgyu mtshan dang 'bras bu bstan pa'i le'u/ 880lnga bcu drug pa/ nang gi bdag nyid mchod pa'i cho ga'i rnam par dbye ba'i le'u/ 881lnga bcu bdun pa/ lha mo'i mtshan nyid kyi le'u/ 884lnga bcu brgyad pa/ e bo zhes bya ba dang po'i ngag bshad pa dang rgyu mtshan

bstan pa'i le'u/ 884lnga bcu dgu pa/ e baṃ ma yā zhes bya ba dang po'i ngag bshad pa'i le'u/ 885drug cu pa/ nang gi bdag nyid kyi sbyin sreg gi le'u/ 889drug cu gcig pa/ bdud rtsi lnga bza' ba'i cho ga'i le'u/ 891drug cu gnyis pa/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mchod pa dang / rnal 'byor ma dang 'dres pa'i le'u/ 893drug cu gsum pa/ gsang ba'i tshig bshad pa'i le'u/ 897drug cu bzhi pa/ sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor bshad pa'i le'u/ 899drug cu lnga pa/ sangs rgyas dang dam pa'i chos dang dge 'dun la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid kyi tshig rgyas pa'i le'u/ 902drug cu drug pa/ slob ma'i spyod pa rnam par dag pa dang / zhi ba la sogs pa'i las kyi 'bras bu bstan pa'i le'u/ 905drug cu bdun pa/ khro bo'i bzlas pa dang / zhi ba la sogs pa'i dngos grub brgyad kyi le'u/ 906drug cu brgyad pa/ dngos grub thams cad bsdus pa'i le'u/ 909rgya gar gyi mkhan po su dza na shrī tsā na dang / sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba chen po bod kyi lha btsan po bla ma dge slong zhi ba'i 'od kyi zhal snga nas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(917) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(947)0469 lha mo bzhis yongs su zhus pa/ 948dang po/ lha mo spyan mas yongs su zhus pa'i le'u/ 948gnyis pa/ lha mo mā ma khris zhus pa'i le'u/ 951gsum pa/ lha mo na bza' dkar mos zhus pa'i le'u/ 95214

bzhi pa/ lha mo sgrol mas zhus pa'i le'u/ 954rgya gar gyi mkhan po z-i ti tsā na bīrti nyid kyis bsgyur cing zhus te bshad nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(958) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(961)0470 ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud/ 962rgya gar gyi mkhan po tshwa na ka ra'i zhal snga nas dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba khu ston dngos grub kyis bsgyur/ slad nas bla ma de nyid dang / dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas zhus shing gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(972) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(974)047) phrin las thams cad 'byung ba'i sgrol ma 'dus pa don dam pa zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 975dang po/ sngags kyi le'u/ 975gnyis pa/ rnal 'byor chen po'i le'u/ 978gsum pa/ las rab 'byams kyi le'u/ 986rgya gar gyi mkhan po nir+bha ṇa shrī'i zhal snga nas dang / rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas phyis byung ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta mi'i nyi ma'i bka' 'grel dang bstun te g.yar khral du bsgyur/yang slad kyis paṇ+ḍi ta pur+ṇa badz+ra'i drung du/mar me mdzad dpal ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i rgyas 'grel chen po dang bstun nas cung zad bcos shing / thams cad du grub chen zhi ba'i zhabs kyi zhal lung gi rig zig so so rnams dang khyad par gu ru lho phyogs 15

pa chen po'i man ngag dang bsnan nas legs par bcos te dag par bgyis/bsdur mchan/(995) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(997)0472 phrin las thams cad 'byung ba 'dus pa don dam pa las phyi ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 998bzhi pa/ gsang ba thams cad pa'i le'u/ 998lnga pa/ rdo rje byin gyis rlob pa'i ye shes kyi le'u/ 1025rje btsun bu gusta la rgyud 'di zhib mor nyan cing sgyur bar bla ba rnams tho re long nge ba bsgyur zhing / dka' gnas rnams la reg zig gi rim pa mang du byas nas brtag dpyad mang du bgyis pa las/ slad nas rgya gar gyi mkhan po giblo ṇa shrī'i zhabs dang /yang slad kyis paṇ+ḍi ta puṇi badz+ra'i spyan sngar 'grel pa so so dang zhib tu sbyar te rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(1029) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1029)

(7 ()ri (75)ji/———3 4 ༷ ci yā //bye waX ——— hūṃ ṭ+wāṃ/ rdordo/khroX ji 'i da 4tsho ci / ci 5)0 bhe ri mi/ lkeri ga te/—— —5 rī 〉tsa 49〈sna 4 4 di rngopa ) ( ri 4rngo༄ 4 ༷ /—— — 7 — — sna dzā pa ༷ laji 2774) ri dzhaḥsi sna tre co nga(zlos / ri sha ༷'a pa garmermer+sār+sā /༄/tsā'i zhe gyi 7 4ri nang zhes palaXshā gyi sa ci shurngo ca ngaX 34cas pas ci rdo4༷ 3 ri ci ci zhe k+ṣa ཿ byu 1 ri sta pe skeme ci paṃ cusna rdo ri ma — — patre —4 6 rdo 744 then rno ri) 5༄ ci(5༷927 ཿ 4 ye ༷ la sa ri pa'i ༷ tsho ༄/ /bde ba chen po'i rol rgyas pa/ /bcom ldan rdo rje bdud rtsi che//

༄khya/ /'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i rtog pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/1༄tshog /rgya gar skad du/ ār+sā 90tsa la kulpa ri ratan+t+ra rā dzangs/ bod skad du/'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i rtog pa'i (5 rgyud kyi rgyal 56)po/ dpal ngag gi dbang phyug 97la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/84ri de nas yang de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen pos/ bdud thams cad zil gyis gnon pa/ rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin (94skul snyoms par zhugs nas nyid kyi sku dang / gsung pyadang / thugs rdo rje las sngags kyi rgyal po 'di phyung ngo / /oṃ āḥrgyu/ de gsung hu)ma thag tu tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / brgya byin dang / gzhon nu dang / sgring mi gi ri ti 12dang /tshogs kyi bdag po dang / hai ba sa ta dang / dga' byed dbang phyug dang /nag po chen po dang / srin tsomo chen mo 'phrog byed ma dang / nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / mig dmar dang / lag skopa dang / phur bu dang / spen pa dang /81—3

pa ba sangs dang / sgra gcan dang / rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / chu lha dang / gshin rje dang / me lha dang /rlung gi lha dang / sa'i lha mo 1dang / dga' bo dang / nye dga' bo dang /'jog po dang / mtha' yas dang / dung skyong dang / rigs ldan dang /pad+ma dang / pad+ma chen po dang / srin po'i bdag po lang ka rimagrin bcu dang /lha'i bu drug khri la sogs pa sa steng dang / sa bla dang / sa 'og pa thams cad skad cig de nyid la dpal 'byung ba'i mchod rten gyi spo de la 'khod do/ /de'i tshe 'jig rten gsum gyi bdud thams cad der lhags nas byang chub chen po'i bar du gcod 4par rtsom mo/ /de rnams kyis 5thal mo sbyar te mgrin gcig tu 'di skad ces gsol to/ /kye 6bcom ldan 'das ston pa bde bar gshegs pa byang chub kyi bar du gcod pa'i bdud kyi rigs 'di rnams zhi ba dang med par mdzad du gsol zhes pa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das bdud thams cad las mchog tu rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas gsang sngags 'di nyid sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /hūṃ hūm̐ rtsu zhes brjod ma thag tu nyid kyi mdun du khro bo chen po mi g.yo ba sku mdog mthing tsho nag tu 'dug pa/ zhal stong phrag stong ha har bzhad pa/ zhabs stong phrag stong brkyang bskum gyi tshul du bzhugs pa/ phyag stong phrag stong du gdug pa'i mtshon cha ral gri dang / ral gri /kyog po dang / chu gri dang gri gug dang / spu gri dang /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang / rtse gsum 9dang / rtse dgu pa dang / mdung dang / 'phen mdung dang 7/ ldong mdung dang / mda' dang / mda' ste'u kha dang /mda' rtse lnga pa dang / mda' kha brag pa dang / rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang / rtse 81—4

gsum pa dang / rtse dgu pa dang / rtse mo bcu gsum pa dang / sta re dang /dgra sta dang / sta leb dang / so sta dang / 'phen sta dang / bzhar tsho1sta dang ske/ dbyug (na pa dang / tho ba dang / gtun shing dang / 'khor lo dang /phub dang / mgo bo dang / bing ti pa la dang / gzhu dang / gzhu mnyen dang ske/ thod pa dang / thod tshal dang / gri zlum dang / gri rings dang / gri lcags kyo rtso)dang / zhags pa dang / rnga yab dang / ba dan dang / me'i phung po dang / chu'i skyogs dang / brag dang / thod pa khrag gis gang ba dang /phur pa dang / thod pa'i phreng ba dang / zhing dbyug dang / me ri dang /so'i phreng ba dang / dril bu dang / jing dang / pi wang dang / gling bu dang /rdza rnga dang / pa ṭa (de/ha dang / rnga rlum dang / rked nyag dang / dung dang /bsil phreng dang / lag pa dang / rkang pa dang / khab dang / gsil byed dang ske/ nam mkha' lding dang / sbrul zhags la sogs pa'i mtshon cha du ma bzung (6)nas phyag lhag ma rnams g.yas na ral gri phyar tsho7nas g.yon pa sdigs mdzub 9 phyar bar mdzad do/ /zhal stong phrag stong la 'dzum pa dang / bzhad pa dang ske/ ha ha zhes sgrogs pa dang / mche ba gtsigs 9pa dang / so 'dar ba dang ske/ gyen du gdangs pa dang / khrag bldag 7pa dang / rngam pa dang / zhi bar yang mdzad de11/ zhal gyi kha dog kyang tha dad do/ /dbu spa yang 12nag po dang ske/ ser po dang / dmar po la sogs pa tha dad do/ /sku stod la glang po che'i ko ba gyon 1snyenas/ sku smad kyang stag gi pags 1 pas dkris shing / phyag dang —/ zhal dang / zhabs kyi bye brag gis skargyan yang tha dad des/ rin po che du ma dang / rus pa'i phreng ba dang / sbrul gyi chun po dang / mi mgo'i 81—5

phreng ba dang / mi'i pags pa dang / seng ge'i pags pa dang / ma he'i pags pa la sogs pa tha dad do/ /zhal re re la yang ①sbyan gsum gsum dang /gnyis gnyis dang / re re'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khro bo chen po mi g.yo ba de la 'di skad du bka' bsgo'o/ /oṃ kye mi g.yo ba/ khro bo drag po/'jigs byed chen po/ gtum po chen po/ dpa' bo chen po/ bdud kyi tshogs thams cad sod cig /chings shig /btogs (kyeshig /rgyob cigadu /phrol cig /gtubs rigashig /dril cig /phul cig /non cig /gzir cig /phug cig ge /tshos shig / sregs shig /phye (6)mar gyis shig /med par gyis shig /khos shig /sdoms shig /zo shig /'thung shigatso /sdigs rinashig /hūm̐ rtsu hūm̐ dza dza dza haṃ lo traṃ phaṭa/ ces gsungs pa dang / khro bo'i rgyal po de khros nas rtsu zhes brjod pas zhal gsum phyag drug par byas te/klu'i tshogs thams cad ma lus par zos te⑨/ phaṭa ces brjod nas zhal bzhi phyag bzhi zhabs kyang bzhir byas nas lha ma yin thams cad med par byas so/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa drang srong khros pa'i dbyibs ltar byas nas lha'i gdon thams cad pham par byas te/ tshogs kyi bdag po gdan du byas so/ /gzhon nu'i cha byad du byas nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas lha'i bu'i nyu byebadud pham par byas so/ /g.yon pa sa la btsugs nas bi nā 37ya ka med par byas so/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /lha la sogs pa rnams snang zhing / /khros nas gdug pa rnams 12'jigs byed/ /sna tshogs rab mang sbyor mdzad pa'o//chos rnams gang gis cir ma 1lhamathong / /lus dang sems dang ngag rnams dag /kun rdzob stong pa rnam dag nas/ /mi gnas sna tshogs zung 'jug bde/ /81—6

'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i rtog pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las sprul pa rnam par dag pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /bde bar gshegs rnams 'dus pa'i sku/ /sna tshogs lus can 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /nam mkha' gang ba'i bsam gtan byam/ /skad cig bsam gtan mngon rdzogs shing / /skad cig yi ge rnam dgod byed / /skad cig la ni gsang sngags 'don/ /'jigs gzugs skad cig sprul pa 'gyed/ /tshar gcod zil gyis gnon ①mdzad phyir/ /skad cig khros spyan nag po 'bar(snye/ /mkha' la gzigs pas lha rnams skrag /sa la gzigs pas klu rnams skrag /rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams dang / /bla ma la yang phyag 'tshal zhing / /rtag tu mchod de dga' chen bskyed / /lus ngag yid kyi sdig bral gang / /dkon mchog gsum mchod bde don gnyer/ /sangs rgyas bzhugs shing chos gsungs pa'i/ /smon lam dag pa'i blo bskyed bya/ /byang chub sems kyang bskyed bya zhing / /dge ba'i phung po dus gsum du/ /gzhan gyi don du bsngo ④bar bya/ /byams dang ②snying rje bsam par bya/ /dga' ba'i dge la yid kyis dmigs/ /nam mkha' che mtshungs blo yis ni/ /btang snyoms chen po bsgom ⑥par bya/ /de ltar dad ldan brtson 'grus can/ /g.yo sgyu (7bral zhing bla ma bkur/ /snying brtse le lo med pa yi/ /srid pa'i sred pa spong byed pa/ /dga' ba'i tshal lam ne'u gsing (nyedang / /phug gam lha khang stong pa 'am/ /shing drung nags dgon ljongs (she)rnams su/ /bde ba'i yid kyis gnas par bya'i/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po yongs su rdzogs pa thams cad mkhyen pa 81—7

zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rig pa 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /nam mkha'i ①dbyings kyi dbus gnas par / /hūṃ gi yi ge las skyes pa/ /mi g.yo mgon po rgyal po'i ④skur/ /rnal 'byor dag pa'i lus bsgom bya/ /zhal gcig ②phyag gnyis brjid pa'i sku/ /lha dang lha min bdud tshogs rnams/ /shin tu skrag par mdzad pa'i phyir/ /g.yas kyis ral gri mkha' la phyar/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub byazhags pa 'dzin/ /pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan la ni/ /tshogs kyi bdag po'i steng gnas pa/ /g.yon brkyang gar bzhugs stag sham can/ /phuḥ.asgrogs klu chen brgyad kyis brgyan⑥/ /dmar ser 9༄gyen skra spyan rtsa dmar/ /spyan skum khro tshul mche ba gtsigs98pe/ /tshangs pa lha dbang khyab 'jug dang / /dbang phyug che (shegasogs lha rnams dang / /lha ma yin rnams skrag par byed/ /bskal pa'i me 'od 'bar dbus na/ /khro bo du ma'i tshogs dang bcas/ /brtan g.yo khams gsum ma lus rnams/ /rang gi sprul par 7shes byas nas/ /de ltar gus bcas yun rings su0spe/ /rgyun mi 'chad par 1gegang bsgoms pas/ /las dang nyon mongs kyis bslad pa'i/ /tha mal pa yi nya rnam rtog ldog /bdag 'dod lha yi skornal 'byor la/ /shin tu yid pobartan byed gyur 17na/ /ral gri la sogs grub brgyad kyi/ /snod du rnal 'byor pa de 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen pos mi bzad pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs 3 tshonas rig pa 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /nam mkha'i 'osnyedabyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /haṃ gi yi ge las skyes par/ /drag chen khro bo'i rgyal po ni/ /sngo nag zhal gsum phyag drug bsgom/ /ral gri chu gri sta re ni/ /g.yas kyi phyag na 81—8

rim bzhin 'dzin/ / sdigs mdzub hu)'khor lo kha ṭ+wāṃ ni/ /g.yon gyi phyag na rim bzhin 'dzin/ /spyan gsum khro gnyer ②gyin du bskyod/ /dbu spa sma ra gyen 'greng ser/ /rol pa'i klu yi ②rgyan gyis brgyan/ /thod pa'i phreng ba stag sham can / /glang chen pags pas stod g.yogs byas/ /rus pa'i rgyan gyis rab brgyan cing / /pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan dbus na/ /g.yon brkyang g.yas bskum tshul du 'gying / / haṃ dze stinam mkha'i phyogs sgrogs pa/ /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid che/ /'di ltar skad cig dran pa 'am/ /ming (bshes tsam gyis 'dod pa sgrub / /de nas bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /rig pa 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /nam mkha'i (6dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /mi las skyes pa'i mi g.yo ba/ /'jigs byed chen po ñjabasam par bya/ /yi dgas 9shedrod kyi steng na 'gying / /zhal bzhi phyag bzhi zhabs kyang bzhi/ /g.yas pa ral gri rdo rje 'dzin/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub 99rithod khrag go/ /zhabs bzhi bdud bzhi'i steng na 'gying / /sna tshogs rus pa'i rgyan ldan zhing / /stag gi sham thabs rnam par brgyan57/ /stod du na ra'i pags pas brgyanahum/ /dmar ser gyen skra 'jigs tshul che/ /ha har bzhad cing rta skad 'tsher/ /khro bo du ma'i sprin spro zhing / /zhal rnams gdangs pas mche ba gtsigs/ /spyan bcu gnyis po rab tu bgrad/ /'jigs pa yang 1geni 'jigs par byed/ /char sprin mdog 'dra me chen gzi/ /thabs (nye chen 'dod pa'ang 'dis rdzogs byed/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po mi 'gyur rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rig pa 'di nyid 81—9

kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par0)/ /yi ge hūṃ las byung ba yi/ /mi g.yo mgon po gtum po che/ /bdud rnams skrag byed bsgom (snyepar bya/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'jigs pa'i sku / /pad dkar nyi ma'i steng dkyil na/ /pus ②mo sa la btsugs nas bzhugasal/ /phyag g.yas ral gri 'dzin pa ste/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub ④nags pa 'dzin/ /spyan gnyis dmar la skum pa ste/ /gzhon nu khros pa'i cha byad can//rin chen rgyan 57gyis rnam par brgyan/ /sbrul dkar po yis do shal byas/ /stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ /sna tshogs khro bo rnam par 'phro/ /bskal pa'i me yi tsho6dbus na gnas/ /gang gis nyi ma zla ba yi/ /mdun du rnam par dran byed na/ /bdud rnams ma lus zad nas ni/ /bde ba chen po'i lus rnyed 'gyur / /a ta sa yi 7)me tog gi/ /'od ldan bcom ldan lha yis mchod/ /bdag gi snying ngam snying dkyil bsgom(8)/ /myur du 'dod pa rdzogs par byed/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis du ba'i mdog /yang na sngon po be+e ḍūr 79gzi/ /bdud rnams brlag par mdzad pa'o/ /g.yon brkyang g.yas bskum bzhugs pa 'am/ /yang na g.yon pa sa la btsugs/ /thabs tshul rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan/ /sdig pa thams cad zad byed pa/ /blo gros phung po rgyas par byed/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po yongs su rgyas pa dpal gyi rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ⑩ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rig pa 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung 67ngo / /dam tshig sems dpa' lta bu yi/ /ye shes sems dpa' snying gar bsgoma'i/ /'od ni cher 'bar drag po'i gzi/ /shes bya'i sgrib las rnam par rgyal/ / de yi thugs kur kyi 81—10

mtshan ma ste/ /sa bon rtag par dmigs pa ni/ /las kyi sgrib pa rnam dag rgyu/ /las kyi las rnams bsgrub ①pa'i phyir/ /sa bon las ni 'od zer 'phros / /ye shes sems dpa' bkug nas gzhug② /des ni mi shes bag chags rnams/ /blo ldan blo la 'jog mi byed①/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun dmigs nas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur 'gyur/ /spyi bor rtsirang gi rigs bsams nas/ /rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan ⑤'gyur/ /de ltar de la brtson chen bya/ /'dis ni rgyal rnams mnyes gyur nas/ /myur du rgyal ba nyid thob 'gyur/ /'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i rtog pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las lha 'byung ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /dge byed ras ris bkra shis kyis/ /sdig pa'i dri ma rnam yibasal nas/ /sgrub po rnams la mchog ⑨ster byed/ /gtsang byed bram ze las rnyed rdoshedam/ /rgyal po'am bu mo bzang gi ras/ /'jam zhing 'thas par brdungs byas te/ /'dod pa bzhin du bri bar bya/ /rams 59nyesam mig sman khu ba dang / /sman gsum me tog gnyis ldan pa'i/ /khu ba shing spyin gsum sbyar nas7/ /gzhan yang sna tshogs tshon gyis bri'o:/ /de las khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ste/ g.yas ral gri/ g.yon pa sdigs mdzub nyunyezhags pa dang 'brel ba/ klus brgyan nyunyepa/ pad+ma dang / nyi ma dang ske/ tshogs kyi bdag po'i steng na g.yon brkyang bas 'gying zhing bskal pa'i me'i nang na khro bo du ma'i tshogs 'phro ba bri'o8/ /lha'i dbang phyug mi g.yo mgon po ni zhal gsum phyag drug pa zhal g.yas dkar ba g.yon dmar ba/ zhal re re 81—11

spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa'o/ /skra ser po gyen du brjes pa/ phyag g.yas gsum na ral gri dang / chu gri dang / sta re bsnams pa/ g.yon gsum na sdigs mdzub hu)dang / 'khor lo dang / kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa dang (mi/ klus brgyan tsho nacing thod pa'i do shal can/ stag gi sham thabs dang / glang po che'i stod g.yogs dang / thod pa lnga'i dbu rgyan can(de/ rus pas brgyan ⑤cing pad+ma dang / nyi ma'i steng na g.yon brkyang zhing g.yas bskum ⑥pa'i tshul gyis 'gying ba/ bskal pa'i me'i gzi mdangs kyi nang nas khro bo bcu 'phro ba bri'o/ /lha min rgyal po mi g.yo ba ni zhal bzhi re re la yang 9)spyan gsum gsum dang rdzunaraldan zhing 9/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis na ral gri dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis na sdigs mdzub 7dang thod khrag can/ stod la mi'i pags pa gyon zhing stag gi sham thabs can/ rus pa dang / klus yan lag brgyan bepa/ bskal pa'i me 'bar zhing khro bo'i tshogs kyi nyi sprin du ma 8'phro ba/ pad+ma la zhabs bzhis bdud bzhi mnan cing spa ser po gyen du brjes pa bri'o/ /bdud thams cad 'dul ba'i mi g.yo ba ni gtum po 3gezhal gcig phyag gnyis ral gri dang /zhags pas 'brel 15ba/ skra nag po'am ser po gyen du brjes pa/ rin po che'i cod pan dang / do shal dang / yan lag thams cad brgyan cing stag gi sham thabs can/ sbrul dkar po khose ral khar 3 thogs pa/ bskal pa'i tshogs kyi mer 1 'bar ba'i nang na khro bo du ma 'khrug cing / pad+ma dang nyi ma la pus 37mo g.yas pa 'thab stangs kyi tshul du bzhugs rdo )pa'am/ yang na g.yon pa gshed po'i tshul du btsugs shing lhag ma nam mkha' la 'greng zhing bteg pa bri'o/ /gang yang rang 'dod pa zhig de ltar bris nas/ de'i mdun du rang nyid kyi 'dra 81—12

'bag tshon sna tshogs kyis bris la/ ri mo mkhan la go ba legs par bskyed nas/mdzes pa g.yon ①du phul terin)/ bkra shis brjod nas/ rang gi gnas kyi dben pa'i phyogs su bzhugs pa (gumangon sum du mi g.yo bar bsgrubs te/ me tog la sogs pas legs par mchod nas/ ye shes kyi khro bo'i rgyal po yang 4de nyid la bstim par bya'o/ /gang yang dngos grub 'dod pas spos dang / me tog dang /sgron ma (5)dang / zhal zas dang / gos la sogs pas rgyun du mchod na sangs rgyas thams cad kyi (begasang sngags 'grub pa la gdon mi za'o/ /'dir skye bo 'ga' ni dman pa ste/ skur pa 'debs na shin tu yang lhung ri7)bar 'gyur ba'i phyir sku dben pa'i sa phyogs su sba bar bya'o/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang bsad 8)pa 'am / /ral gri la sogs brgyad rnams dang / /mchog gi sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ /rgyal ba'i gzugs brnyan las rnyed 'gyur/ /'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i rtog pa'i rgyal po las bris sku'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /gsang ba rnam par dag byed cing / /dngos grub myur phyir gsang sngags rnams/ /rim pa dbye ba ngo mtshar nyon/ /bcu bzhi'i dbyangs las yum gyis brgyan9ri/ /gsal byed gnyis pa'i dang po la//gsum pa'i lnga pas nye bar brgyanas/ /gsum pa'i gsum pa der bzhag 1lhago/ /lnga pa'i lnga pa brgyad pa la/ /dbyangs kyi gnyis pas mdzes par byas/ /me dang dbyangs bcu gsum par 'brel/ /drod gnyis pa dang drag mtha' 'brel/ /sum cu 512gsum dang dbyangs drug 'brel/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga pas brgyan no/ /nyi shu gnyis dang bcu gcig 'brel/ /de la nyi zlas rnam brgyan 1 pa'o/ /gsang 81—13

sngags rgyal po yi ge bcu/ /stong khri 'bum mam ①bye ba bcu/ /sa ya bzlas kyang lha mthong 'gyur/ /snying po sdig bral dga' ba ste/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags/ /sdug bsngal zad byed bde ba che/ /sgrub pa rnams la skyed ②byed pa'i/ /gsang sngags drag po dran byed na/ /'jig rten 'dir yang tshe ring 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas 'gyur ro gzhan ci smos/ / bom swa bhā ba shud ṅgāḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shurnyo3 haṃ/ gzung ba dag pa ye shes kyi sngags so/ /oṃ shun+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ād+ma ko3 haṃ/ 'dzin pa'i sems dag pa ye shes kyi sngags so/ /oṃ badz+ra shud ṅgāḥsarba dharmā badz+ra shurnyo3 haṃ/ sku brtan pa rdo rje ye shes kyi sngags so/ /oṃ kā ya bārtsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma ko3 haṃ/ sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes kyi sngags so / /oṃ a tsa la te dza badz+ra puspe/ dhū pe/ dri pe/ gan dhe/ rna bi bye sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥdzaḥrdu baṃ hoḥ/ sa:dz+nyā sarba satā ā+oṃ/ i me ba dzi groṇ+ḍa kha kha khā hi khā hi bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa ṇi rtsu phaṭa/ mchod pa dang gtor ma'i sngags so/ /zho dang 'o ma 'bras chan dang / /sā lu dkar dang til dkar dang / /gro dang nas dang bra bo dang / /shing tog la sogs rtag par mchod/ /oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ maṇ+ḍa la ma d+me ā gats+tsha ya/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ spyan drang ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa ma ma sha hūṃ a mu ka su sha rī raṃ tī la ya r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ ka ti mu ta stam bha ya/hre di tī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ pā de tī la ya swā hā/ phur bus gdab pa'i sngags so/ /na maḥs man+ta kā ya lngartsit+ta badzā ṇ+ḍaṃ/ oṃ a tsa la kā na tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa sbo ṭa ya hūṃ ṭ+wāṃ mo haṃ/ las la bskul ba'i sngags so/ /na maḥs man+ta kā ya lngartsit+ta badzā ṇ+ḍaṃ/oṃ a tsa la kā na tsaṇ+ḍa ta na ta na/ mas mas/ mo ṭa mo ṭa/ tas tab/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ā be sha ya ā be sha ya/ ma hā man+t+ra bha la ka /81—14

dhu na dhu na/ ti ni ti ni/ kha da kha da/ baspyo na/ ma ra ma ra duṣ+ṭa na duṣ+ṭa na rak+ṣa haṃ/ sar+pā na/ ku ru ku ru/ ki ri ki ri/ ma hā bi badz+ra/ sbo ṭa ya sbo ṭa ya/ hūm̐ hūṃ r+ghaṃ/ tri ba lirto raṃ ga na rak+ta/ oṃ oṃ oṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ a tsa la te dza / sbo ṭa ya spro ṭa ya/ rtsu rgyu/ a marnyi ka /kro dha ma hā ba la/ sho tā ya/ma nā ya/ man+ta haṃ mi/ shud+dha tu mok+ṣa/ du pya du/ badz+ra nā ma tai/ a pra ti ha te bh+yaḥ/ dzā lā ya tā ya/ a sa ha na/ ma hā swā hā/ las thams cad kyi rjes su 'gro ba'i sngags so/ /na maḥs man+ta kā ya wā rtsit+ta badzā ṇ+ḍaṃ/ oṃ tra tra a mo gha/tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa/ sbo ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ tra ma ya tra ma ya rtsu/ tra ta haṃ me/ oṃ ba lin+ta te dzo mā li ni swā hā/ cho ga thams cad kyi rjes su 'gro ba'i sngags so/ /na maḥs man+ta kā ya wā rtsit+ta badzā tsā/ oṃ a mo gha e h+ye nyi a pra ti ha ta e gye nyi a tsa la wa te dza/ a nan+ta ka na/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ tsu ru tsu ru/ ta ṭi ta ṭi/ ta ṭa ta ṭa/ bisne ghā ta ya/ mā ra ya/ khā da ya/ sbo ṭa ya/ tra ta s+t+waṃ/ tsa me na/a nu brnya/ ā dz+nyā ku ru/ a sa ha da/ a na a gra/ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ma ṭa ma ṭa / haṃ haṃ/ a ṭi ba la/ e h+ye hi ma hā kā ru ṇa/ bi ṣa ṇa/ nan+ta nan+ta/ā be sha ya ā be sha ya/ a tsa la te dza/ sarba tra a nut+ta re ki tsa ta/ ta ṭa ta ṭa / dharma dharma/ phaṭa phaṭa haṃ/za༅ 'di ni bsrung ②ba dam pa'i sngags so/ /khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba'i/ /gang gis gsang sngags rnams shes na/ /yi ge tsam gyis chabadud brlag byed/ /mang du brjod na smos ci dgos/ /'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i rtog pa'i ④rgyud kyi rgyal po las gsang sngags rnams 'byung ba'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //81—15

de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /gsang sngags grub pa las byung ba'i/ /las kyi sbyor ba'i dbye ba yis/ /'dod rnams shin tu 'grub byed de/ /bsam gtan rnam dag chos rnam (1)dag /ye shes rnam dag sku rnam dag /rang byung (mirnam dag don rnam dag /bya ba rnam dag byed pa dag /sgyu ma sgyu ma'i ye shes che / /sgyu 'phrul lta bu'i 'khrul 'khor dang / /mig yor smig ②rgyu'i gzugs brnyan 'brel/ /sna tshogs chu bur bzhin g.yo ba'i/ /gang gis bdud las rgyal byed pa'i/ / yungs kur ④rgyal po bsgrub par bya/ /rgyal gyi skar mar btsugs byas te/ /thod pa dkar po dri chus bran/ /'di ni las rnams kun bya'i phyir/ /dus su bsrung bzhing bskyed bya ste/ /dus su mchod dang gtor ma byas bar chad kun las rnam rgyal yin/ /yang na gro ga'am spra tshil la sbrul nag po'i gzugs byas nas gu gul tshil chen gyis bdug cing sngags drag tu brjod de/gang 'dod pa'i lus la byabs nas/ khrus byas te rtswa ku sha'i chun pos 'og nas g.yug cing / /nā ga rā dza sa ma ya dun ti/ /phu ṭa phu ṭa (zhephaṭa ces brjod na / gang la klu gnod (3)pa de sos par byed do/ /yang na gong du bstan pa'i yungs kur tshon)dang / gu gul gyis bdug cing sngags drag tu brjod na klu 'bros sol/ /slar /smyo yang mi ldog go/ /'byung po la sogs pa'i gdon gyis zin pa la yungs kur 7bskyed pa la sngags mang du bzlas nas gtor na 'byer hu)ro/ /byis pa gsar du btsas pa bsrung rmogeb ni kham phor la nyusnyerdo rgyus kyis bris pa bcang ngo ske/ /spra tshil gyi gzugs sor bzhi pa'i tshad du byas pa'i snying gar tshabasgrub bya'i ming dang bcas pa'i sngags bcug lhasal kha la tsher ma btsugs na bsgrub bya'i kha la tsher ma btsugs par 'gyur ro/ /rkang pa la btsugs na rengs so/ /snying la 81—16

gtsugs tshin dran pa stor bar byed do/ /mi'i rje ngar (0gyi rus pa'i phur bu'am/lcags phur yan lag gang dang gang la btab pa de zha rgu ri)ba'am rengs par byed do / /dur khrod kyi thal ba la stimang du bsngags ⑤nas dgra bo'i sgo 'og tu btab na 'byer ro/ /g.yul du zhugs nas ral gri la bsngags te/ bzung (6rin rgyal lo/ /gang la yang chagator ma'i bye brag gis 'grub nges so/ /dur khrod du phyin te snod thod pa la pad snal (she)dkar po'i sdong bu dang / tshil chen gyi mar me byas la tshes brgyad dam bcu bzhi la sbar ba'i du ba mig la byugs na gzhan gyis 994rimathong na dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te nyi ma'am zla ba gzas bzung hu )ba'i tshe mi g.yo mgon po'i sku kham pa la byas nas me tog she la pa li ku'am/ daṇ+ḍit+pa las 1lhamachod cing sngags mtshan thog thag bzlas pas tshe lo stong thub bo/ /yang zla ba gzas bzung pho ba'i tshe dum bu drug pa'i thod par khrag sna tshogs blugs te/maṇ+ḍal nag po'i thog tu bzhag nyurtenas kha me long gis bcad de/ de'i steng du kham pa las byas pa'i mi g.yo ba bzhag (7ste/ rang nyid gcer bu'i lus ma he'i rnam lngas byugs te/ mtshan thog thag bzlas na srid pa gsum mthong bar 'gyur rol/ /yang nyi ma dang 8zla ba gzas bzung 7ba'i tshe maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa byas nas ṅgā grwa bzhir ral gri btsugs la/ rang nyid gcer bu lus thams cad thal bas byugs te mtshan thog thag bzlas na srid pa gsum gsal bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te gter kha dbye bar 'dod pas mi g.yo mgon po'i sku kham pa las byas la/sman drug la sogs pa dri zhim po thams cad dang lhan cig pa'i rin po che'i snod kha sbyar du bcug nas maṇ+ḍal dkar po'i dbus su khri'u la bzhag 1snyenas/ dus gsum du mchod cing bskor ba brgya rtsa brgyad byas te/ gsol ba gdab 19cing a 81—17

ga 0)ru la sogs pa'i spos sreg ( cing bstod pa byas na zla ba gsum gyi rjes su gter rnyed nges so/ /gal te char 'bebs par 'dod na/ klu yod pa'i gnas su klu'i dkyil 'khor byas te/ spra tshil lam bag zan la dga' bo la sogs pa'i gzugs byas te kha dog tha dad par byas nas maṇ+ḍal der gzhug ste / dam tshig pa bskyed nas dbus su mi g.yo mgon po dang bcas pa la ye shes kyi lha bcug nas / ka ra dang / bu ram dang / sbrang dang / 'o ma la sogs pas mchod cing rtsa ba'i sngags 'brug ltar bsgrags pas klu rnams skrag ④nas char pa'i rgyun 'bebs par byed do/ /gal te mi 'beb tshogen thod pa dum bu gcig par klu'i (ye gzugs rnams 97 bcug la/ gdug pa can gyi mes bsros dun char shing rta'i 'phang 99ci lo tsam zhag bdun du 'bebs pa la the tshom med do/ /'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i rtog pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las sbyor ka phra mo'i le'u ste pho )lnga pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /bsam gtan brtan 7las byung ba ni/ /'khrul med nyid de gnod rnams sel/ /khams gsum rgyal po cher nyon cig /spro bsdu'i rim pa goms gyur las/ /ji srid 'dod pa'i 8dus bar du/ /rang sems gnas nas brtan par 'gyur/ /dngos med dngos sogs ma lus pa'i/ /rnam rtog rab rib kun bsal nas/ /nyon mongs nad rnams ma lus pa /bag chags dang bcas gtan nyusnyebacom nas/ /'phral du yang ni brod dga' 0skye/ /spro yang mi dmigs bsdu mi dmigs/ /skye med 'gag med ting nge 'dzin/ /'byung med 'gro med bsam gtan la/ /gnas na ye shes myur du thob/ /bla med ye shes yon tan dang / /mthu rnams che bar 'gyur ba ni/ /bla ma mnyes 81—18

las rnyed 'gyur ba'i/ /de nyid bdud rtsi bcud kyis len/ /gus pas 6)rtag par nyin mtshan du/ /rgyun chad med par goms byas na(mi/ /myur du phyag rgya chen po yi / /dngos grub snod du 'gyur ba yin/ /'bad rtsol byang chub yan lag ste/ /le lo gnyid dang g.yeng ba spang / / sngags gsal dusadamigs pa brtan gyur 55)cing / /bsam gtan thon nas 'khrul 'khor brtsam/ /skar ma rgyal gyi nyin par la/ /gro ga'am yang na shin rinashun la/ /gur gum gi (7wang tsan dan gyis/ /rdo rje rgya gram mu khyud bcas/ /dbus su ming dang sngags spel bri / /mu khyud la ni rtsa sngags bri/ /rwa kun la ni hūṃ dang ming / /spel te g.yas nas bskor la bri/ /dkyil 'khor dkar po'i dbus su ni/ /me tog dkar po'i steng bzhag nas/ /lha yi ④skur ni bskyed byas te/ /stong rtsa brgyad du bzlas byas nas/ /gang zhig 'dod pa'i dpung pa 'am/ /lus la bcangs na srung 2bar byed/ /kham phor sar pa la rdo rgyus kyis bris te/ sgor bcangs na gsar du btsas pa'i byis pa srung mngo / /dur khrod kyi ras la sngags ming dang bcas pa bris te/ spra tshil gyis gtums 51nyenas dur khrod kyi tsho/2bum par bcug nas / kha rdo rje rgya gram gyis bcad de sbas na mngal skems par byed do/ /phyung nas 'o mas bkrus na sos so/ /gal te bsad rmonyepar 'dod na dkyil 'khor gru gsum nag por byas pa'i steng du kham pa las byas yopa'i mi g.yo mgon po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas pa gnyis na ral gri dang / rdo rje sdigs mdzub lodang thod khrag g.yon na 'chang ba byas pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa tshebazhugs so/ /de nas dri ma drug dang bag zan las bsgrub bya'i gzugs sor brgyad byas nasanyunye/ rdo rje rgya gram gyi 'khor lo bsad (12pa'i sham bu dang bcas pa 81—19

snying gar (1)bcug ste/ de'i sku'i zhabs su bzhag ②nas rang nyid lha'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pas zur bzhir mi rus sam seng ldeng ngam/ lcags las byas pa'i phur bu sor bzhi pa bzhag dun)pa la thun mtshams thams cad du btab pas ④shes pa brgyal bar bsam mo/ /de'i 'od kyis mdun gyi phur pa mi g.yo bar bsgoms pa'i thugs bskul nas/ de las khro bo lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa grangs med pa spros pas/ bsgrub bya rlung gi 'khor lo la bzhag (5danas 'ongs pas skad cig tsam gyis phung po gtor nas/ shes pa ling ga yil bstim par bya'o/ /de ltar zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig tu byas pas hom khung du bsreg 7)pa'am/ mnan pa byas na dbang phyug chen po yang gsod par nges na gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/yang na dha tshonanodu ra dang / khyi khrag dang / nya'i khrag gis 'khor lo ral gri'i ⑨rtse mo ltar rno bar byas nas/ lte ba'i dbus su gru gsum ma'i 7nang du bsgrub bya'i ming dang rgyud du bcas pa bris la/ de zhags pas bskor bar bya'o/ /rtsibs rnams su sngags kyi rkang pa brgyad pa bri'o1lha/ /mu khyud la ming dang bcas pa'i snying po bri'o/ /de'i rgyab kyi mu khyud la las thams cad pa bri'o/ /mu khyud gsum pa la rdo rje dang ral gri spel nas bri bar bya'o/ /de nas thod pa kha sbyar gyi nang du bcug nas zhing spas bcings te/ bsgrub bya dag za 12ba'i bsam gtan dang ldan pas khro bo shin tu khros pas khrag 'dren pa'i lta bas bltas 1lhan bzhag nyi shu rtsa gcig gis gang la byas pa de khrag tu skyugs nas 'chi'obo/ /dur khrod du sbas na mtshon gyi bskal pa babs nas 'chi'o/ /shing gcig gi rtsar sbas na rengs so /chu mdor sbas na 'byer ro/ /lam rgya gram 7du sbas na smyo'o/ /lha rten zhabs su sbas na zha bor 'gyur ro/ /klu yod pa'i sar sbas na mdzes zin pa la the tshom 1 tsho81—20

med do/ /rang nyid kyi nyal ba'i zhabs su sbas na 'dod pa'i bu mo khugs so/ /ci ste rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags na dmag kyang rengs so/ /de dag thams cad la khro bo 'bar ba dud pa'i kha dog dang ldan pa phyag bzhi zhabs bzhi spyan gsum dang ldan par blta'o/ /dur khrod kyi ras la dmag dpon gyi ming dang spel ba'i sngags rdo rje rgya gram gyi lte bar bris la mtha' yi ge lo brgyad kyis mnan te / de'i phyi rol du dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor la rdo rje rgya gram ༅bris la de spra tshil las byas pa'i tshogs kyi bdag po'i snying gar bcug 9genas gang 'thab pa'i mtshams su bzhag ban dmag rengs so/ /gzhan yang gza' skar la bltas te 'phyar ④ro/ /bskrad par 'dod na gro ga'am ras la bya rog dang 'ug pa'i khrag gis gong du gsungs pa'i 'khor shrī/lo bris te/ u tsā ṭa 65ya spel bar bya'o/ /char che ba'am ser ba gcad 7)par 'dod na/ gro ga la gur gum mam gi 8ci/wang gis 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa byas la mu khyud gsum pa byas te/ rtsibs bzhi la snying po'i sngags yi ge hūṃ la bskor ba bris la/ dbus kyi lte bar yi ge k+ṣi 'bris te / de la rtsa ba'i sngags g.yon skor 1 du bris nas/ mu khyud dang po la las thams cad pa'i sngags bri'o/ /gnyis pa la ral gri'i phreng ba/ gsum pa la kun tu me ri'o/ /de ltar dmigs te mchod nas rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags na char ches pa 11dang ser ba 'chad 12par 'gyur ro/ /yang bsad mi par 'dod pas kham pa'i spar bu la mi g.yo ba'i snying po mtshal gyis g.yon skor 1 du bris nas dkyil 'khor gru gsum gyi nang du gong du bstan pa'i ling ga'i snying gar 15ming dang bcas pa bcug nas gan rgyal 7du steng du kha gzar te las thams cad pa'i sngags bzlas shing zhag bcu drug tu las bya'o/ /de nas dur khrod kyi sa las 1 81wa 21

byas pa'i mchod rten khru ①gang pa nag po'i bum pa'i nang du rang gis bsrung ②ba nyid bcug nas/ mchod rten bang (kyerim gsum man chad stong pa'i nang du tsha tsha lnga bzhag ④pas gru gsum kha bkag (gecing lho phyogs su bzhag ༅go/ /des zla ba gnyis na 'chi nges so/ /gal te gzhan gyi rig sngags gcad ⑦par 'dod na dbang chen gyi dbus su tshogs kyi bdag po bris te/ zur thams cad rdo rje rgya gram 98༄gyis mtshan par byas nas/ grwa thams cad lo gyis mtshan pa ste/ rdo rje phur pas bsgrub bya'i ling ga'i (7steng du mnan na/ zhag bdun gyis rig ⑩sngags 'chad do/ /yang na r+ghaṃ bzhi mgo sprad ⑩pa'i 'khrul 'khor ro/ /da hunyeni tsu tsurnya ra'i 32pags pa la 'khrul 'khor rengs pa'i sbyor ba dang bcas pa'am/ spu la sdong bu byas shing tshil la mar me byas nas/ du ba de bzhar yinas mig la bskus na dgras mi mthong ngo / /yang dpral bar thig le bya ste lag pa la bskus na gang la reg pa de dbang du 'gyur nges so/ /rkang pa la bskus na dpag tshad brgyar 'gro nus so/ /sā 8lu'i phye ma la gzugs byas te phye ma des bskus na dgra rengs par byed do/ /dur khrod kyi thal ba dang bcas pas dgra bo'i sgo'am dpung la gtor na nad kyis 4thebs so/ /tsu tsurnya rmonyera'i pags pa la 'khrul 'khor bris nas/ dbugs kyis brgyangs te sngags stong bzlas na dgra de sbos nas 'chi'o38/ /de la sngags ni/ tar+ya thā/ na mo 31stu te/ ma hā ga ṇa pa ta ( — )ye swā hā/ oṃ ga ṇa ga ṇa dzo nyam dhi pa ta ye swā hā/ oṃ ga ṇaḥg ṇa ( nyapa ti pra dzi ti ⑫ye swā hā/ na mo so:stu ti ma hā ga ṇa pa ta steye swā hā/ oṃ kun tra ka aṭa/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ dā ra dā ra/ bi dā ra bi dā ra/ ha na ha na/ groṇ+ḍa groṇ+ḍa zhe/ dā dha ba dā sidha ba/ ga ra ga ra/ r+ghaṃ dza s+t+waṃ dza/ dzi bha dzi bhasbyo ste/ mo ha mo ha/ de 81—22

sems dpa' yi/ / skyil krung 0)gis bzhugs khros nas ni/ /sngon po rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan/ /bsam rdzusal la du la phug dang / /'o ma zho dang sbrang dkar dang ske/ /mar dang chan dang sran ma sha /btsos pa'i sha dang shing tog ②rnams/ /dus dang dus su mchod byas na/ /gter rnams 'di yis ster ④bar byed/ /yang na bdag nyid mi g.yo ba/ /zhal gsum phyag drug khros pa'i sku/ /ral gri mda' dang rdo rje g.yas/ /zhags pa gzhu dang mdung thung g.yon/ /khams gsum gang ba'i rtsu las bskyed/ /sna tshogs mdog can khro bo ni/ /du ma mtshon cha rnams bzung geb/ /rang las spro zhing bsdu byed pa'i/ye/ /mdun du tshogs kyi bdag po ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis (7)pad+ma la/ /bzhengs te mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ /bskyed nas btsos pa'i shas 98)mchod nas/ /bsnyen pa stong byas las rnams 'grub/ /yul gyi tshwa (9nadang sa gsum la/ /tshogs bdag de yi tshigazugs byas nas/ /gnod pa'i ming dang ldan bcug na/ /lo nyes mi ngas phyugs ngas sogs11/ /gang gi mtshan nas bzung ba de/—snye/ /gnod pa kun las srung 412bar byed/ /'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i rtog pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las 'khrul 'khor gyi le'u ste drug pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /las rnams grub pa'i yan lag tu/ /gces par gyur pa'i sbyin sreg 'go/ /tshal ni gnyis te rtsub ngos dang / /yid 'ong rang gi khyim du bsgrubabo/ /sa ni las kyi dbye bas shes/ /skyon dang bral bas thab brtsig bya/ /rgya la 7sor tshad nyi shu bzhi/ /de yi ngos la sor bcu gnyis / /dpangs ni de yi rgya las ni/ /sor bzhi chung bar bskor bar bya/ /81—24

pad+ma'i dbyibs can brgyan ①bltas nas/ /ral gri 'bar ba dgod par bya/ /zur bzhir rdo rje phyed pa bzhi/ /thab khung kha la rdo rje yi/ /phreng ba gsal por bskor bar bya/ /'di ni 'phrin ②las kun gyi'o/ /yang na khru gang nang gru ( kyigasum / /rim gsum sum gnyis sor tshad do/ /nang du rdo rje rgya gram bri/ /gsad ④pa la ni bsngags (shepa'o/ /til dang 'bras dang 'o ma dang / /zho dang mar dang sbrang rtsi dang / /pa la sha dang be shing sogs⑥/ /me tog dkar po yod pa ste/ /dkar gsum mngar gyis bsres pa rnams/ /zhi ba'i las la shin tu shis/ /sā (7lu nas dang gro dang ni/ /rgya rtsi che dang na gu la/ /sardzo gu gul gur gum bcas/ /tsam pa zho dang (nyenye'u shing / /me tog gser mdog la sogs rnams/ /rgyas pa'i las la shin tu shis/ /tsan+dan dmar dang gur gum (9)dang ske/ /bra bo til dang rgya 1 )sran dang / /khre dang cung tse tsho12spel ba dang / /ba ser mo yi 8bdud rtsi lnga / /na ga khro dang tsan+dan dmar/ /me tog dmar po dbang la shis/ /bsad nyusnyel khrag dang dug yungs kur/ /tshwa skegasum ling gar rigebacas pa'o/ /gos dkar rgyan yang dkar po ste/ /yo nya9byad kun kyang 1 dkar byas dang / /bsam pa bzang pos shar bltas pa/ /'dis 518ni zhi ba'i las rnams 'grub/ /rgyan gos yo byad kun ser zhing / /rgyas pa'i yid byas byang du bltas / /dga' ba'i dkyil 'khor bskor byas na/ /'dis ni rgyas pa'i las 'grub byed/ /rgyan dang gos dang yo byad kun/ /kha dog dmar zhing snum gyur nas / /myos pa'i yid lta bus bltas na/ /dbang gi las rnams 'grub par byed / /rgyan gos gnag cing yo byad gnag /rtsub pa'i yid bltas khros pa'i skad / /'byin cing lho yi phyogs su bltas/ /drag po'i las rnams myur du 81—25

'grub / /de la las byed pa'i dus su mi rus la byas pa'i phur pa mi g.yo bar bsgoms la/ sngon du bsnyen pa song bas dang pos kha/ gnyis pas snying ga① /gsum pas lte ba/ bzhi pas pus ②mo rnams su dam par gdab bo/ /sbra tshil lam / thal chen nam/ bag zan la ling ga ①byas la ske tshe ④dang / re lcag dang ske/ nya'i rngog gzhob rnams brdungs la khrag dang sbyar nas gro ga la rdo rje rgya gram bris pa'i dkyil du ming dang sngags spel te bris pa'i snying kur snyibacug la/oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā (nyaro ṣa ṇa a mu ka su 9)ste bha ya/ tī la ya hūṃ phaṭa ces gdab bo/ /bsgrub bya'i shes pa rlung gi steng du bzhag ⑧la dbugs dang bcas pa drang ngo / /gal te gso po)bar 'dod na phur bu dang ming bton te 7'o ma blug cing / oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa che ge mo shīn+ta ku ru kurban+tu ye 0swā hā/ zhes brjod na zhag bdun nas sos par 'gyur ro/ /yang gsod pa'i las bya bar 'dod na/ r+ghaṃ las skyes pa'i mi g.yo ba nyi long ba zhes bya ba shin tu dmar ba'i mig gcig yod pa/ral gri dang zhags pa can kha dog ljang nag rtsub cing 'khrug pa/ rin po che'i brag phug tu gnas pa la dus rtag par rgyun du mchod nas gru gsum thams cad kyi dbus su bsams te kyi sha dang khrag dang dug dang gzugs brnyan rnams zhal du bsregs na myur du 'chi'otsha/ /rengs par 'dod pas rnga mo'i rus pa la dze ta ya dze ta ya zhes stong rtsa brgyad du bsreg tshego/ /lkugs par 'dod na ra'i sha la bha ti ra bha ti ra zhes khri tsho gsum bsreg ⑩go/ /smyo bar 'dod ⑩na khyi sha dang chang dang dug sna tshogs pa la ud+mardonan+da nye/ zhes stong rtsa brgyad bsreg phyego/ /dgra bo'i mig long bar 'dod pas skyer pa'i shing dang bong bu'i rtug pa la a ta 3 )ka ra zhes stong rtsa brgyad du bsreg 31go/ /sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang / rnga mo'i rus pa 81—26

la mo ha ①ya zhes stong rtsa brgyad bsregs na rmongs par byed do/ /yung ba dang tsan+dan la dz+wa ra da pa na ya zhes brgya ( shertsa brgyad bsregs na yams 'chad do/ /sbal pa dzi dur dang khyi nag po'i sha la tsi ti dz+wa lī ④ma pa na ya/ stong bsregs na mdze 'chad do/ /khu ba dang / khrag dang / dha (dedu ra la su tri tshin+da ⑥zhes stong rtsa ⑦bsregs na mngal skams 2)so/ /gtum po drag po'i nga rgyal gyis/ / drur ba'am gi wang stingam lan tshwa'am0/ /rgya skyegs bsregs na yams nad dang / /'khrugs skyedang 'jigs dang 'byung po saldog /zho dang ku mu da 8dang sbrang / /bya rgod klad 8pa khā yi tshilas/ /'di rnams bsregs na smyo nad dang / /sgang tshe dang bu mi thon pa sel/ /kye 3 tshogazhan yang sngags kyi rgyal po 'dis/ /sna tshogs las rnams 'grub 'gyur zhing / /brtan pa chen po'i ye shes ni/ /'ga' las myur du thob byed cing / /g.yo 'dod sred la bla ma slu/ /tshig la sems zhing r+shanyedon mi tshol/ /bag med g.yeng dang ser sna dang / /brkam chen snying rje med pas ni/ /bskal pa brgya 37dang stong phrag tu/ /bsgrubs kyang nam yang mi 'grub ste / /lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sgo/ /ngal ba las ni gzhan du min/ /bza' btung zhim po sna tshogs rnams/ /rtag par nyin re dus gsum sne stadu/ /grogs po kun la byin pas kyang / /lan gcig bla ma mchod pa yis/ ‘/brgya yi ༷ nyuchar yang mi phod do/ /de nas de'i tshe lha'i dbang po dga' rab dbang phyug 'al sogs pa lha'i bu drug khris khro bo chen po mi g.yo ba la bstod pa/ kye ho brtse 3 ba'i sems mnga' 'on kyang 'khrugs 'dra zhing / /dga' zhing shin tu dag kyang ra ri sna tshogs spras/ /lha yi 2nyekhams rnams ri —nyekun la ral gri phyar ba'i 39tshe/ /lha min tshogs kun brgyal zhing rab tu skrag par snang / /srid pa'i nyon mongs kun la 81—27

bsdigs pa'i sdigs mdzub ①kyis/ /bdud rnams brgyal zhing skrag nas ②skad phyung rdo kyithag ring 'bros/ /yi ge phyed pa a ho'i ⑦ku cos log phyogs skrag⑤ /che ba yi ni shin tu che gyur 56nyekhyod kyi sku/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis shin tu bsngags shing bstod/ /klu rnams 3)'dus pas ②cha shas lus kyis phyogs par brgyan49nye/ /lha dbang bu mo rnams kyis rin chen birgyan rab gsol/ /spyan bgrad ljags 'dril stag lpags 'dzin pa khyod la bstod/ /bstod pa chen po des bstod nas tshangs pa chen po la sogs pa (lhalha tshogs thams cad bcom ldan 'das la mngon par dga'o/ /'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i rtog pa'i rgyal po las sbyin sreg cho1gegi le'u ste 32bdun pa'o// //'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i rtog r+shapa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po 'bum pa las dngos grub thams cad yongs su 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i rtog pa rdzogs so12// //paṇ+ḍi ta a tu la dā 15sa badz+ra dang / bod kyi lo tsā 1 sgyub mar pa ban+de 1)chos kyi dbang phyug grags pas bsgyur ba'o// //81—28

༄sto /khro bo'i rgyal po thams cad gsang sngags gsang ba'i rgyud ces bya ba/①༄༅ga /rgya gar skad du/ kro dha rā dza sarba man+t+ra tshon gu h+ya tan+t+ra nā ma/ bod skad du/ khro bo'i rgyal po thams cad gsang sngags tshogegasang ba'i rgyud ces bya ba/khro bo mi g.yo mgon po 4la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /khams gsum zhe sdang can gzigs nas/ /zhe sdang thams cad zad bya'i 95 phyir/ /bcom ldan thugs rje'i rang bzhin can/ /zhe sdang mi g.yo mgon por mdzad/ /ngo bo nyid kyis dag pa'i bdag /sngags dang 6phyag rgya ting 'dzin dang / /rnam dag bsam gtan 'phrin (7kyilas rnams/ /bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang chen gyis/ /dur khrod 'bar ba 'khrugs pa'i sar/ /'dzin pas btud de nges zhus la/ /kye kye yang dag khro chen gtso/ /ma lus rnam dag la gnas phyir/ /mgon po mi g.yo'i gsang 98rgyud las/ /sems dpa' chen po'i ting 'dzin gang / /ngo mtshar thar pa nges par gso(9/ /de nas yang dag ye tshagasungs pa/ /dpa' bo 87—40

dur khrod gnas pas legs/ /rus pa'i rgyan nges phyag rgya drug /gnas pa'i tshogs kyi bdag nyid de/ /rgyu bzhi tshad med bzhi ru gnas/ /ye shes rtog pa'i rtog pa'o/ /rgyun ma ②chad pa'i dam pa yis/ /nyi zla shes rab thabs kyi gdan/ /sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor gnas/ /gyur pa'i mtshan ldan ye shes lnga/ /phyag rgya drug mdzes byin brlabs ②nas/ /dur khrod ma ni 'khyud pa'o/ /phung po la sogs thub par gnas/ /pad+ma rdo rje byin gyis brlabs/ /bsrung ⑧ba'i sbyor ba med pa dang / /mtshan ma bral dang 'dus ma byasal/ /byed pa rnam med rtog pas 'das/ /sku ni dug 'joms gnag pa'i tshul/ /rdo rje zhags pa bsdigs gnas pa/ /g.yon brkyang gnas pa spyan rtsa dmar/ /pad+ma gri gug shes rab tshul / /g.yon 'khyud tshim byed rgyan bral ba'i/ /thabs dang shes rab ma chags (5)dang ske/ /tha ma byin za mnan te gnas/ /'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus na'o/ /rtsu la rgya gram rdo rje gnas/ /e ⑥las chos 'byung grub pa mo/ /mtshon cha ra ba dra bas so/ /rten pa phyag rgya lha lnga ⑦gnas/ /mos pa rnam par grub pa yin/ /mos pa 2rnam par dag pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /gnyis med 'gyur ba'i gsang ba ni/ /'khor lo mi bskyod ye shes che/ /mgrin pa phreng ba'i rin chen 'byung / /rna cha gzugs kyi (pe'od dpag med/ /rus pa'i rna rgyan 7don yod grub/ /thal ba snang mdzad rnam dag go/ /mig la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ /rna ba zhe sdang ma zhes grags/ /sna ni tsoser sna'i rnam par 'bor/ /lce la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ /lus la rdo rje gti mug go/ /yid la chos kyi dbang phyug ste/ /dkyil 'khor lus 81—41

nyid rnam dag pa/ /rtsa ni thig gi rang bzhin te/ /ku ba brgyad ni rkang brgyad do / /bdud rtsi rnam lnga tshon sna lnga/ /g.yas g.yon steng 'og sgo nyid de/ /so sen ①ba spu twa ra khol/ /snying gi dbus kyi lte ba nyid/ /phung po lnga yi gtso mo ste//khams dang skye mched lha mor grags/ /'byung ba sgo ba bzhi nyid de/ /'dom ①gang gru bzhi lham pa ste/ /mi g.yo mgon po rnam par nges/ /lus kyi rnam par dag pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// // oṃ ār+ya a tsa la mār+ya ra ya ④gro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ snying po'o/ /oṃ ār+ya a tsa la kro dha bi pa ta 9shes hūṃ phaṭa/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/gsang ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ ha/ na ma hi/ swā hā hu/ bo stiṣaṭa he/ hūṃ hūṃ ⑦hol/ phaṭa haṃ/ rgyan byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /oṃ pad+ma bo lan mi yaṃ/ ṭaṃ haṃ rma rgyu'ad/ badz+ra pra ༷7ta ka ko la hūm̐ phaṭa/ shes rab thabs kyi phyag rgya ⑩byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /ka sa mā ra kha na hi mā ra kha ni sa mā ra ya phaṭa/ bsad pa'i'o7ske/ /sarba a ma me a rtsu/ thun mong grub pa'o/ / a gats+tsha 8phaṭa/bskrad pa'i'o/ /swā hā rat+na na(ste/ rgyas pa'i'o/ /dharmā 8gu ta hūṃ/ dbang gi'o / /kurma pu ta shīrta 7ku ru rgyu/ zhi ba'i'o/ /sngags kyi rnam par dag pa'i rtog pa'i 7dum bu las khro bo'i rgyal po thams cad kyi sngags gsang ba'i rgyud ces bya ba lasakyi tsho/ 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i sngags rnam par dag pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /yab yum gnyis med sbyor ba las/ /khro 81wa 42

bo'i tshogs rnams spros nas ni/ /gtso mo thabs kyi yan lag bkang / /lag pa g.yas par gshin rje'i ①gshed/ /g.yon pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /rta mgrin kha la bsam par bya/ /rdo rje la ni bdud rtsi 'khyil / /dpung pa g.yas par mi g.yo ba/ /g.yon par 'dod pa'i rgyal po'o/ /pus mo g.yas par bsam pa ni②/ /dbyig pa sngon po cher 'bar ba/ /pus mo g.yon par stobs po che/ /spyi bor gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur②/ /gnod mdzes rgyal po bsam pa ni / /rkang pa gnyis la dgod par bya/ /yang ni yab yum sbyor ba las byang chub sems sprin 'du 'phro las/ /hūṃ tshogs khro mor spros nas ni/ /gtso mo shes rab yan lag dgang ④/ /lag g.yas rdo rje ro langs ma/ /g.yon na gzhan gyis mi thub mo/ /de yi khar ni khro gnyer ma/ /gsang bar ral pa gcig ma'o/ /gzhan yang dpung pa g.yas gnas par/ /de bzhin gshegs yum rdo rje ma/ /g.yon du sna tshogs rin chen gyi/ /phyag rgya dag ni bsgom par bya/ /pus mo g.yas la gnas par yang / /sna tshogs pad+ma de bzhin gshegs/ /g.yon pa las ni sna tshogs las/ /spyi bor nam mkha'i rdo rje ma/ /rkang pa gnyis la sa yi ni / /sa 'dzin lha mo gzhag pyogepar bya/ /thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba yis/ /byang chub sems sprin 'phro 'du las/ /gdod nas grub pa'i sangs rgyas rigs/ /phyung nas lus la dkyil 'khor bkod/ /de dag phan tshun sbyor ba las/ /rjes chags chen po'i sgra yis ni/ /bde gshegs tshogs rnams bskul ⑥bya ste/ /de dag la ni yang yang gzhug /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma ko3 nyarta/ chu la nizla ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhin/ /gsal ba lha yi stirang bzhin ni / /kun kyang zhal gsum phyag drug ste/ /brjid 7pa'i khro bo gar dang bcas/ /81—43

yang na zhal gcig phyag gnyis par/ /rnal 'byor can gyis brtan ①par bsgom ni / /dngos grub rab mchog thob par 'gyur/ /de phyir nan tan bskyed par bya/ /'phags du 3pa mi g.yo ba'i rtog pa las lus kyi dkyil 'khor bkod pa'i rim pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas phyi yi rtsadakyil 'khor du/ /rigs kyi khro bo spro ba ni/ /thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba las/ /rnam par 'phrul pa 95)bshad par bya/ /rang sngags sa bon las byung ba'i/ /gti mug mi g.yo mgon po ni/ /zhal ni gnag dang dkar dang dmar/ /'bar ba'i tshogs kyis rnam par 'khrigs/ /dbyig pa 'khor lo rdo rje bsnams56sku/ /phyag g.yas na ni bsnams par mdzad/ /thugs kur sdigs mdzub 77zhags pa dang / /dril bu dgra sta g.yon pa ni/ /dbang po la sogs tshogs bcas dang / /mi bzad bgegs ni skrag par mdzad98)/ /pad+ma nyi ma mnan nas ni/ /shar gyi phyogs su bzhugs gyur pa/ /rnam snang dbu rgyan nya9)ldan pa'o/ /rang sngags sa bon las byung ba'i/ /ser sna bomi g.yo mgon po ni/ /rin chen 'byung ldan dbu rgyan can/ /gser mdog zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /spyan gsum gsus che 11nor bus brgyan(ge/ /ser dang gnag dang dmar ba'i zhal / /mche ba gtsigs nyi shing rnam par rgyu/ /'bar ba'i tshogs kyis rnam par 'khrigs / /rdo rje dbyug pa ral gri ni/ /g.yas kyi phyag na bsnams par mdzad/ /snying gar sdigs mdzub 1 zhags pa dang / /dril bu dgra sta g.yon pa na/ /g.yon brkyang pa yi gnas pa yis/ /mi bzad bgegs ni skrag 32mdzad pa/ /pad+ma nyi ma mnan nas ni/ / lho yi 35phyogs na bzhugs par gyur/ /rang sngags 81wa 44

༄sto /'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i gsang rgyud chen po/1)༄tshog /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya a tsa la ma hā gu h+ya tan+t+ra/ bod skad du/'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i gsang rgyud chen po/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa ②dus gcig na/bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po 'og min gyi gnas na rab tu dgyes shing bdud 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs risaso / /de'i tshe na byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang /rdo rje chos dang / phyag na rdo rje dang ④/ sems bskyed ma thag tu chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / rdo rje gnod sbyin dang / rdo rje khu (getshur la sogs te rab tu dga' ba'i tshogs dpag tu med pa dang thabs cig (6natu bzhugs te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa rgyu zhes gsungs te rdo rje khro bos phyogs mtshams gtams so/ /bsrung 97ba'i don du rab brtson zhing / /bgegs kyi 81wa 48

sbyor ba brlag par mdzadasti/ /hūṃ phaṭa de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis haṃ zhes gsungs ②te rang gi thugs ka sanas khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba phyung ste/ g.yas na ral gri g.yon sdigs mdzub④/ /char sprin lta bur shin tu gnag /sbrul dang thod pas yang dag brgyan(snye/ /mi bskyod pas ni byin brlabs shing / /bde gshegs 'od zer dpag med 'phros/ /dngos grub bde ba kun stsol mdzad/ /oṃ badz+ra sirnyi ⑥ཿ/ de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ / ā li kā li rab sbyor ri tshozhing ske/ /zla ba rdo rje sbyor ldan pas/ /yang dag rdzogs te mngon sangs rgyas/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i dbus su ni/ /brkyang bskum 98)tshul du yang dag gnas/ /dga' byed ma ni mdun du ste/ /rin chen phreng ma g.yas su dgod/ /glu (7)mkhan mo ni g.yon du ste/ /brtson 'grus gar byed rgyab tu gnas/ /'gugs byed ma ni shar du ste/ /rnam par 'ching ma lho ru dbod/ /gnyis med ma ni nub tu ste/ /rnam par 'phel ma byang du dgod/ /'di dag ni bcom ldan 'das sku 0yongs su rdzogs pa'i dam tshig go/ /'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i rgyud gsang ba chen po las gleng gzhi'i (7le'u ste dang po'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dbang bskur ba'i dam 12tshig rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms (3par zhugs te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka 8nas 'od zer spros te lha thams cad kyi dbu la 'od zer thim par gyur te'i / rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan 39par gyur to/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /dkyil 'khor chen po dam /nyepa ru/ /mchod pa'i tshogs ni rnam par bstim / /gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro/ /reg bya lha mo dpag med de/ /81wa 49

mchod pa'i tshogs kyis yang dag mchod/ /kye kye mtha' gnyis rnam par ma ①g.yos shing / /sprul pa'i gzugs kyis 'gro don dpag med mdzad②/ /'jigs byed chen po 'gro ba kun sgrol zhing / /srid pa gsum na dgyes par gar mdzad pa/ /srid pa'i chu bo skems ④shing mi mthun bdud rnams 'joms/ /srid pa'i rlung gis ma g.yos thugs rje mi g.yo mgon/ /rab brjid mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi bstod pa chen po'i dam tshig go / /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /rgyal po rtag ldan thod pa ru/ /lcags kyu lnga sogs gzhag tshogapar bya/ /rlung dang me yi dkyil 'khor bzhag⑤ /thod pa ru ni yang dag gnas/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi bdud rtsi chen po'i ⑥dam tshig go/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /tshangs pa brgya byin gshin rje dang / /chu bdag gnod sbyin khyab 'jug sogs/ /me dang srin po rlung gi lha/ /'byung po sa yi ⑦lha mo dang / /lha ma yin sogs 'khor bcas dgug /oṃ a ⑤kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā tsā ā bya nut+pan+da twata stiswā hā/ oṃ khā nyi khā nyi dze dze ṭ+wā hā/ bdud rtsi sha dang khrag la sogasal/ /gtor ma thams cad sbyin par bya/ /'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i rgyud gsang ba chen po las mngon par rtogs 7pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa ni/ /khru bzhi pa yi tshad du bya/ /sar pa las ni bkal (stenas kyang / /dkyil 'khor nyis 'khor ring thung la/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor thig gdab bo/ /'khor lo lta bur byas nas kyang / /rdo rje phreng bas yongs su bskor/ /gru bzhir bgyi zhing sgo (3bzhir bgyi/ /rta babs bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /dbus su ral gri chen po 81—50

dgod / /shar du rdo rje yang dag dgod/ /lho ru rin chen phreng ba ste/ /nub tu chos kyi pi bang ①ste/ /byang du rdo rje rtse gsum mo/ /sgor ni lcags kyu zhags pa dang ske/ /lcags sgrog dril bu mkhas pas bzhaga') /bcom ldan 'das kyi nunyedakyil 'khor chen po dgod pa'i dam tshig go/ /de nas 3)char pa mi (nye'abab na/ /stegs khyabu gru bzhi'i steng du yang / /dngul gyi gzhong pa bzhag menas kyang / /bag zan las ni byas pa'i gzugs/ /pad+ma sum brtsegs (shenadag tu bya/ /steng du klu yi gzugs bzhag ⑨la/ /gur gum 8gyis ni byugs byas la/ /mtshams su oṃ dang bam̐ bkod de/ /tsan+dan dkar pos sbyin bsreg 1nyabya/ /kha dog mang po sbyor ldan pas/ / klu yi tsogazugs ni nges par dgug /des kyang 'bab par ma gyur na/ /kham pa'i gab tshe 8dkar po ru/ /pri yang ku yi khu ba yis/ /ral gri brgyad pa'i 'khor lo bri/ /rgya mcho'i ngos las sa (7blangs la/ / klu yi 1gegazugs ni mngon byas te/ /nam mkha' lding gi khu bas byugatso /til mar la ni sbyin bsreg hu 7bya/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /kham phor ser po'i nang du ni / /bsgrub bya gzugs gzhug ldong lho ros kyis/ /ri rab rtse mo brgyad pa bri/ /des ni yang dag gnas par bya/ /shin tu rno ba'i lcags dag la/ /khru do tshad kyi ral gri bya/ /maṇ+ḍal dkar po'i steng du bzhagalho) /zla ba drug ni rig pa bzlas / /til mar gyis ni bskus byas nas/ /zla ba gzas zin tshe na bsgrubatsu )/ /thogs pa'i mkha' la lding bar rdo nya'agyur/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang sha sna lnga/ /grib ma dag la bskams byas te/ /lcags gsum dag gis dkris byas te'u/ /shar bltas zas ni smyung sbyo nyebar gnas/ /gzas zin tshe na khar gzhug bya/ /mnyam par gzhag (steste nyi shu bzlasatso/ /khar bcug gzhan gyis mngon mi 'gyur/ /ri 81—51

bcom ldan 'das dngos grub chen po'i dam tshig go/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /sa gzhi dkar la zlum pa la/ /tsan+dan dkar po'i me sbar te/ /ser skya'i mar gyis sbyin bsreg 91)bya/ /dngos grub chen po thob par 'gyur/ / yungs kur nagyis ni sbyin bsreg bya/ /rig ra pa 'dzin pa'i dngos grub 'thob skul/ /til nag pos ni sbyin bsreg 55bya/ /sdig pa thams cad zhi bar 'gyur / / drur ba'i ne/myu gus sbyin bsreg 7 bya/ /tshe yi rig 'dzin thob par 'gyur / /seng ldeng dag la phur pa 98bya/ /gsang sngags nyi shu gcig bzlas nas / /'dod pa'i gzugs la dbab par 9)bya/ /dgyes pas dngos grub ster bar 1 'gyur/ /'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i rgyud gsang ba chen po las dngos grub kyi le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das yongs su dgyes nas 'jam dpal la sogs pa rnams la rnam par gzigs nas/ oṃ āḥ/ zhes 31bya ba'i sgra gsungs te mi snang bar gyur 1 to/ /de nas rab tu dga' ba'i tshogs kyis rang gi bdag po mthong bar ma gyur te/ phyogs bzhi nas mngon du phyogs nas 'di yis gsol ba btab bo / /e ma bcom ldan 1 ngo mtshar che/ /stong pa'i ngang la ci ste bzhugs/ /bdag ni tshangs spyod byams pa ste/ /mya ngan 'das pa kun nas slong / /e ma'o bde ba chen po'i sku/ /tshig kun gyis ni ma spros pa/ /bdag ni rjes chags snying rje che/ /'gro ba yang dag sgrol bar mdzad/ /e ma dri med dag pa'i sku/ /stong pa'i ngang la 1 ma bzhugs par/ /rab tu dga' bas 15bdag la rol/ /'gro ba'i don la rjes chags brjod/ /e ma'o don kun grub mdzad pa/ /dag pa'i 81—52

ye shes dri med sku/ /bdag gis 'gro kun gzung 77ba'i phyir/ /gtso bo 92khyod ni yang dag bzhengs/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rab tu dgyes te sku yongs su 9gerdzogs par mdzad nas gsang sngags kyi rgyal po 'di dag gsungs so/ /oṃ ār+ya a tsa la rdu phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tī li tī la 2ya/ sarba bi spyon ban dha lde ya rtsu phaṭa/gsang sngags dang phur bu'i sngags so/ /oṃ na maḥ(6cis man+ta badz+ra tsā badz+ra rdogetsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa sbo ṭa ya/ hūṃ rtsu hūṃ tra ṭa hūm̐/ mi paṃ haṃ mi ta sha 9shes/ ma ma rgyu 9phaṭa swā hā/ shin tu rno ba'i sngags te las thams cad pa'o/ /de nas 'khor rnams kyis gsang sngags kyi don khong du chud par gyur ny-i )to/ /'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i rgyud gsang ba chen po las gsang sngags kyi le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i rgyud gsang ba chen po rdzogs so11// //bsdur mchan/48 1ci mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ 2〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉spru/ ci〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈khu 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉bzhugs/ 45〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉 dang / 5〈〈snar 〉〉khur/ 6〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉gcig 78〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉bsrungs / 〈〈snar 〉〉srung /49 1)〈〈co 〉〉〈〈khu 〉〉mdzod/ 32〈snar 〉〉gsung / 〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kha/ (〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉sdigs 'dzub / 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉bsdigs mdzub/ 〈〈khu 〉〉sdig mdzub/ 5〈〈snar 〉〉rgyan/ 65〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉sidhi/7〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉a li ka li rab sbyor/ 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ā li kā li rab sbyar/ 8〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉bskums / 95〈〈g.yung 〉〉klu/ 7〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 sku/ 11〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉skye mchog gi/ 〈〈snar 〉〉skyes mchog gi/ 15〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉spyodam/ 15〈〈snar 〉〉snyom/ 7〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉kyi thugs kha/〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉kyis thugs 1 15〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉to// 10〈〈snar 〉〉rgyan/ 1 〈〈g.yung 〉〉des/50 1〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉mi/ 5〈〈co 〉〉mdzod/ 〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉skyems/ 45〈〈snar 〉〉bzhag81—53
