༄tshog /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra a mṛ dun ta tan+t+ra/ bod skad du/ rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang thugs kyi snying po rdo rje bdud rtsi gsang ba'i pad+ma la bzhugs so/ /gzhal yas brtsegs da pa'i khang pa na/ /mā ma tī dzo dang thabs cig 95tu/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can rol te/ / de nas lha mos de zhus pa6la/ /gsang chen zhes bya cher gnas pa'i/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi rgyud kyi mchog /sngon du lha khyod kyis gsungs pa/ /bdud rtsi yi ni sgrub tsho pa'i thabs/ /bde ba chen pos bka' stsal 'tshal na/ /de nas bcom ldan rdo rjes bshad/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi bde chen po/ /bsam med zad med phra mo ste/ /don yod dbang po las 'das pa/ /dam pa zhi ba rnam dag pa/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi brjod pa yin/ /81wa 56

de nas bcom ldan rdo rje yis/ /mā ma khrir chachags dang ldan nas/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /gsang chen mngon sum du ni mdzad/ /rgyud rnams kun la gsang ba yi/ /ye shes rdo rje bdud rtsi mchog /de ni bdag gis bshad par bya/ / brtan por 'khyud ladang 'o byed dang / /dga' ba'i rol pas ②mnyam sbyor dang / /dbyangs dang sil snyan gar rnams kyis/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi rgyud kyi mchog /de ltar myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /bdud rtsi khu ba zhes gsungs te/ /'gro ba gsum ni nges bskyed do/ /khyod la dga' ma zhal bzang ma/ /de yi sgrub pa bdag gis bshad/ /nyon cig de yi sems kyis tshig /mdor bsdus nas ni ④bshad par bya/ /sems can don du phan don du/ /sbyor ba'i rdo rje bdud rtsi mchog /rnal 'byor gang gis shes gyur na/ /'khor ba'i bcings las myur bar grol/ /bstan du med cing ye shes che/ /dngos grub 'jig rten gsum sgrub 2bo/ /sku gsung thugs kyi bsgrub gyedon du/ /sgrub pa pos ni bde ba spyod/ /rdo rje pad+ma mnyam sbyor bas/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi phyung bar bya / /bha ga'i pad+mar 'o btab ste/ /rdo rje mā ma kris be'o btab/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba che/ /bcom ldan rdo rjes de gsungs so/ /bha ga'i pad+mar 'o btab pas / /de tshe dga' ba'i lha mo des/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi 9shelas byung ba'i/ /nyams dga' gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor zhus/ /cho ga'i rim pa gang gis ni/ /mchod pa (shenadakyil 'khor brtsam par bya/ /'dir ni mchod pa ji ltar te/ /de bzhin dkyil 'khor ji ltar lags/ /dga' ba chen po thob dka' tsheb/ /rab tu dgyes nas bka' stsal 'tshal/ /de nas bcom ldan rdo rje yis/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba che/ /'o btab pas ni dgar 'a'agyur te/ /bzhad nas 'di 81—57

skad bka' stsal te/ /sku gsung thugs kyi bsgrub ①don dang / /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho bsgral ba'i (༄phyir/ /dga' ba chen po sbyor ba yis/ /mā ma khris ni 'dir bris ①pa/ /zur gsum dkyil 'khor bris nas su/ /gsang ba'i pad+ma mā ma gri④//nang du snying po dang ldan pa'i/ /pad+ma (pe'adab brgyad pa ni bya/ /de dbus gsang chen rig ma dang / /gtso bo zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /dang po'i zhal ni nag po ste/ /g.yas pa la ni dkar po 'dod/ /g.yon du dmar por rab gsungs te/ /lha yi rgyan gyis brgyan byas pa/ /lha yi na bza' me tog phreng / /lha yi dri yis byug byed pa/ /lha yi dngos grub byed zhi ba/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /phyi rol du ni dkyil 'khor yang / /sgo bzhi pa ni rab tu brtags / /shar du khro gnyer ma bzhag zhinaste/ /lho na 'jigs par 'jigs byed ma / /nub na rta yi gzugs can ma/ /byang du tshogs kyi 'dren ma mo/ /mkhas pas pad+ma 'dab brgyad la/ /rig ma brgyad ni mnyam por bristi/ /mdzes pa mo dang zhi ba'i zhal/ /zla ba tshon mo dang (7dung can mo/ /ri bong 'dzin dang dkyil 'khor mo/ /ri bong 'dzin ri mo yid dga'/ /yid la bde bar byed ma dag /rig ma brgyad dang dge ma brgyad/ /thams cad zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /sna tshogs gzugs ni yid dga' ma/ /phyogs rnams dag ⑩ni mtshams dag la/ /rtag 37pa ru ni bri bar bya/ /mchod pa pi wang arnga de bzhin/ /de bzhin spos dang me tog sogs/ /dbyangs dang gar dang mchod pa ni/ /dga' ba rol pa sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba che/ /gsang ba'i 'khor lo bsgrub par bya / /ma dang bran mo bu mo dang / /sring mo gnyen mo de bzhin te/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi de dag las/ /blangs nas gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor mchod/ /ma las nyuste81—58

bdud rtsi blangs pas ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi dang mnyam 'gyur/ /sring mo nad med na so gzhon/ /bu mo yi ni 'dod kun sbyin/ /bram ze mo ni ①don yod grubarka/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor la 'dod byas/ /lce ni dril bar byas nas su/ /kha yis pad+mar blang bar bya/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba che/ /de nas myur bar dngos grub bo/ /bung ba rtse ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /bud med thams cad 'dod pa spyod / /'dus dang gru ②mo dang brkyang ba/ /yar bteg gzer ni shin tu brkyang ske/ /byed pa'i bcing ba ④sbyor ba yis/ /sa gsum dag ni bsgrub par bya/ /sha chen dang ni khrag chen gyis/ /de bzhin bshang ⑤gci khu ba dag /de dag rdo rje bdud rtsi lnga/ /nyin dang nyin du bsgrub par bya/ rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba che/ /gal te dngos grub bdag 'dod na/ /de yis don rnams thams cad ni/ /sgrub pa pos ni mchog tu bsgrub56)/ /dbang dang dgug dang 'thab pa dang / /gsod dang bskrad pa la sogs pa/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi bde chen pos/ /bya ba thams cad kun du bya/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi bde chen pog/ /bcom ldan rdo rjes de gsungs so//de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rdo rje can rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba chen po'i rdo rje bdud rtsi rgyud kyi rgyal po las gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor (8)byed pa'i mngon tshul bstan pa'i le'u (1)dang po'o// //de nas mgu ba'i lha mo de/ /pad+ma rgyas pa'i mā ma khri7/ /brtan po 'khyud 57pa byas nas sum/ /dbang po thams cad la 'o btab/ /ma mchu sos bzung 8'o btab ste/ /sid sgra sngags ni brjod par bya/ /rdo rje bcings pas sku yang 'dzin / /rdo rje can gyis gsang byas te/ /pad+mar rdo rje bcug nas su/ /81—59

chags na dga' ste 'dod par bya/ /sid sgra snyan po sgra rnams dang / / kok+ki le 0byedang gling bu sogs/ /lha mo mā ma kri dang rtse/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi bde chen pos/ /nu ma bzung (mil gzir byas te/ /sen mo ri ②mos gdab par bya/ /de yang gos ni phud byas te/ /steng 'og la yang blta bar bya/ /rgyas pa'i pad+mar 'o btab smanas/ /dga' ba'i tshig kyang brjod par bya/ /rgyas pa'i pad+ma mā ma tī/ /lha mo chen mo legs so legs/ /gtan du 'dod la chags pa yis/ /bdag gis khyod la dga' bar bya/ /gang zhig 'dod pa khyod kyis zhus/ /khyod la bdag gis mchog tu sbyin/ /de nas lha mo mā ma tī/ /tshig 'di dag ni ched du gsol / /bcom ldan nyid kyis de bzhin nyid/ /byang chub sems kyis rnam sprul 95pa/ /phra bas shin tu phra ba yis/ /zad med ye shes ji ltar rol/ /de 'dra lha yis spyod pa 96)ni/ /dbang po gnyis kyi snyoms 'jug pas/ /de dag the tshom 'byung bas na/ /bdag ni ngo mtshar dam par 'gyurasti/ /de nas bcom ldan rdo rje yis/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi bde chen bshad/ /nyon cig de nyid mā ma khri78ri / /ye shes sbyor ba 'bigs byed pa/ /shin tu phra ba lnga)gsang chen po/ /ye shes shes 7bya ngo bo nyid/ /de ni bdag gis bshad bya ste/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab bsgrub 11pa/ /mi 'jigs zad med rtag pa ni/ /gdod ma med cing dbang po spangs/ /yod nyid dang ni med nyid kyang / /dbang po dang bcas dbang po med/ /'byung ba kun tu ma mthong ba/ /sbyor ba lam gyis mthong ba'o//sbyor ba rnam pa gnyis gsungs te/ /phyi dang nang du bcas pa'o/ /phyi ni gzugs kyi phung po sogs/ /'byung ba rnam pa kun rdzob 912ste/ /sna tshogs g.yo dang mi g.yo ba/ /khams gsum dang ni ma lus par32/ /de gcig pos thuni khyab 81—60

pa ste/ /thams cad rnam shes kho na'o/ /ci phyir sems can bdag med rnams/ /rnam shes phung po brtan ①pa yin/ /blun sems snyigs ma'i mi rnams kyis/ /'ga' yang shes pa ma yin no/ /sems las ma byung sems kyi ngos/ /ye shes shes bya'i (gyengo bo nyid/ /thams cad rnam shes gcig nyid do/ /gang tshe lus la rkyen nyid 'gyur/ /chos rnams dang ni chos gcig 'gyur/ /dngos po dag (snyeni de tshe 'gyur/ /ci yi phyir na chos rnams kyi/ /mang po nyid du chos rnams kyang / /chu rgyun bzhin du rgya mtsho la/ /thar pa ni gcig kho na ste/ /mang po nyid du mi rnyed de/ /ji (4)ltar nang du cher gnas pa/ /bla ma'i zhal kho na las thob/ /bha ga'i pad+mar nam mkha' gang / /nam mkha' lnga yis brgyan 0pa ste/ /snying dang snying po rnam ldan zhing / /'dab ma brgyad kyis rnam par bklubs(ye/ /de dbus rdo rje can bzhugs te/ /byang sems bdud rtsi dang ldan pa/ /cha shas chos (7)min rnam grol bdu ste/ /thig le de yis rnam par spangs/ /der ri94ciganas rtag tu zag pa ni/ /bdud rtsi byang chub sems kyi gzugs/ /khams rnams kun gyi gzhi yin pa/ /steng 'og tu yang rnam par khyab/ /des ni mthong ba thos pa yang / /mnam ribopa dang ni myang ba yang / /rig dang bde ba'i longs spyod ni / /zas dang 1)me tog phreng ba dang / /rgyan dang gos kyis hu brgyan pa ste/ /ngag gis sna tshogs grags pa yang / / blang ba 12dang ni gzung rngub rnams/ /rol dang kun tu 'gro ba dang / /'dug dang de bzhin nyal ba dang / /sad pa dang ni log pa dang / /thams cad rmi lam mthong ba ste/ /bzhad dang de bzhin cho nge dang / /shin tu yid 'phrog gar dang ni/ /rnga rnams dag kyang brdung ba ste / /sna tshogs pa dag 'dir brjod pas/ /smyon pa dang ni myos pa'i gzugs/ /81—61

gti mug 'dod chags de de nyid/ /gzugs med mang po'i gzugs can de/ /pho dang mo dang ma ning rnams/ /du ma'i gzugs can kun gyi bdag /sna tshogs gzugs ni nor bu bzhin/ /khyab pa'i dngos kyis khyab nas su/ /de nyid dam pa 0)cher gnas so/ /de bzhin nyid de mā ma tī/ /bzlas med 'dzin pa yang med de/ /bgrang ((phreng bya ba 'ga' yang med/ /zas spangs pa yang mi bya'o / /bha ga'i pad+ma mchod byas terdo / /mkhas pas bdud rtsi bza' bar bya/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba che/ /de yis de nyid 'grub pa'o/ /gang de bdud rtsi 'bab pa'i rtsa/ /bha ga'i dbus su pad+ma ste/ /rtsa gzhan sum cu ④tsa gnyis la/ /de yi dbus su de gtso ste/ /de dag las gzhan shin tu mchog /rtsa dag dgu ni rnam par gnas/ /sgo dgu la gnas rig (snyepa dag /sgrub pa pos ni mchod par bya / /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga lha mo/ /rtag tu rdo rje can mnyam blta/ /de bas de dag rab byed na/ /chags bral zhes gsungs kun rig pas/ /de dag gsang chen mchog rab ni/ /zhal bzang ma kye sbyor bar bshad/ /sna tshogs rnam snang mdzad sogs pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pas mi shes te/ /gtan du dga' ba'i yid bde ba/ /sbyor bas dam pa rab bstan to/ /gsang ba'i pad+ma mthong nas dang / /shin tu rgyas pa'i mā ma tī/ /(6)rdo rje'i bdud rtsi bde ba chen / /de nyid bdag gis bshad par bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rdo rje can rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba chen po'i (8)rdo rje bdud rtsi rdzodargyud chen po las de bzhin nyid sbyor '-i )ba ye shes bstan pa zhes bya ba le'u phonyeganyis pa'o// //81—62

de nas mgu ba'i lha mo des/ / ha ra nu pur ①gyis brgyan te/ /'di dag dbyangs ni blangs nas su/ /sems dpa' chen po dgyes par byed/ /phyung mdzad bde chen rdo rje las/ /bdag gis mchog gi yig 'bru 'tshal bar bgyi/ /bha ga'i pad+mar bde ba chen po ste/ /rdo rje'i don te ②bde ba chen po lags/ /sa 'dzin pa dang skad phreng medang / /drug ldan la sogs mtha' 'khob tshul/ /sna tshogs thun mong rnam dag gi/ /snyan pa'i sgra yis blang bar bya/ /de rnams dbyangs dag blangs nas su/ /dga' ba yid bde rnam sprul gyis/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba che/ /sangs rgyas byang chub bsgrub par bya/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bka' stsal pas/ /de bzhin nyid kyis the tshom bcad/ /rdo rje can khyod bka' drin gyis/ /rtag par ye shes bya ba bgyi/ /bcom ldan chags pa dang bral ba'i/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi 'byung ba 'di/ /rdo rje theg pa 'byung ba yi/ /sbyor ba bdag gis bstan par bgyi/ /da dung bdag la the tshom mchis/ /phyag rgya gnyis kyi rnam sprul pa/ /ji ltar phyag rgya yang dag 'byung / /de dag gi sngags ji ltar lags/ /sngags rnams gang las skye ba lags/ /khyad par du ni lha rnams kyang / /lha ni de bdag 0the tshom na/ /mdor bsdus nas ni bdag la gsungs / /rdo rje bdud rtsi bde chen poge/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can 'di gsungs / /phyag rgya sngags dag 'byung ba ni/ /bshad de nyon cig mā ma kri ces/ /phyag rgya rnam pa gsum gsungs te/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs las 'byung / /sku ni phyag rgya mchog 'gyur te/ /gsung ni phyag rgya sngags kyi las/ /thugs kyi mtshan ma'i phyag rgya ni/ /bsam gtan ri mo gnyis med gnas/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi rgyud chen las(pe/ /sbyor ba'i phyag rgya shes tshonasabya ste/ /mtshan ma'i phyag rgya mi 81—6ni

bri'o / /phyag rgya mngon sum gzugs yin te/ /lha ni lha mo bud med do/ /dbang po thams cad bde ba ru/ /bha ga'i pad+mar mchod par bya/ /rdo rje'i pad+ma mnyam sbyor zhing / /las thams cad ni 'grub par bya/ /ji ltar dpag bsam shing chen gyis0)/ /yal ga brgya phrag stong can dang / /rtsa dang de la gzung shu ba ni / /skye ba'i rkyen du 'gyur ba bzhin/ /de ltar bdud rtsi 'bab pa'i rtsa/ /sngags dang phyag rgya'i yum yin te/ /sngags 'di rnams kyi skye ba ni/ /bha ga'i dbus su gnas pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi bde chen pos/ /rdo rje bcug nas mā ma khril/ /nyon cig sngags rnams mtshan nyid ni / /dang po rnam snang mdzad sbyor te/ /oṃ ④badz+ra a mṛ nyata ma hā su bsti/ /sa bon bzhi dang mnyam ldan la/ /swā hā yi ge yang sbyor ④ro/ /rnam par snang mdzad yang 'bul te/ /yi ge gnyis dang bzhi pa ste/ /bzhi pa yis ni mnyam ldan pa/ / mā ma tī yi (8)snying po'i mchog /brgyad dag kho na'o dbus ma yi )gang //brgyad la rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /'dab brgyad la ni sbyar byas te/ /lha mo sngags kyis sngags phyung ngo / /sgo srungs lho byedag gi sngags rnams ni/ /nyon cig skal bzang mā ma tī/ /de 17yi tha ma sngags phyung ste/ /sa bon brgyad ni sngags rig 15pas/ /stong pa'i lha yis gnon byas te/ /rnam par snang mdzad dang ldan la / /swā hā yi ge mnyam par rmolhaldan/ /dngos grub thams cad rab sbyin rnams/ /bzhi ni sgo srungs kyi tsheyin te/ /bzhi ni spos dang puspe 7sogs/ /ma ning yi ges grwa 35bzhi la/ /swā hā rnam par snang mdzad yang / /lha mo gsang ba'i mā ma khri / /rnga sogs kun gyis mchod par bya/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi bde chen po/ /bcom ldan rdo rjes nya tshode gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku 81—64

dang gsung dang thugs kyi rdo rje can hu rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba chen po'i rdo rje bdud rtsi rgyud chen po las sngags phyung ba'i (lde/ rim pa cisne)bstan pa zhes bya ba'i tsho4le'u gsum pa'o// //de nas sbyin sreg (selas dag gi/ /cho ga'i rim pa bshad par bya/ /sbyor ba'i rgyud kyi cho ga yis/ /sku gsung thugs ni sgrub 96)pa yin/ /zhi ba dang ni rgyas pa'i las/ /de bzhin dbang dang mngon spyod dang / /'thab dang bskrad 7)kyang de bzhin du/ /sngags dang phyag rgya'i bsgrub (8)pa rnams/ /de kun bdag gis bshad par bya/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi 'byung ba'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'gying byed pa / /dkur 6)brten bcas pas gnyis gnas paris/ /rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan byas te/spe/ /slob dpon dkyil 'khor 'jug par bya/ /khams gsum rnam par rgyal gyur 51shenas/ /rkang gnyis g.yas brkyang bya ba dang / /g.yon brkyang bya ba yang byas te/ /rkang mnyam dang ni sa ga yis41lha/ /sa ni sbyong bar chosabyed ma thag /sa la reg na 'jam skye'o/ /de nas bgegs rnams bskrad nyusnyenas su / / gzhan yang srul po 517la sogs pa/ /gong du bla ma phyag 'tshal yo phyi nas sa yi lha mo dgug /oṃ e h+ye hi 1 lha mo che/ /sa yi brtan ma 'jig rten yum / /rin chen thams cad rab rdzogs pa'o/ / lha yi nyu rgyan gyis brgyan nyu byed ma / / ha ra nu pur 2 ༄sgra 'byin ma37/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab tu mchod/ /yon 'di dag ni bzhes nas su/ /sbyin sreg na las ni 'grub par mdzod/ /hi hi hi smyo — hā swā hā/ bshang stegaci khrag dang khu ba yis/ /dkyil 'khor sa la gtor bar bya/ /byin brlab 5bya ba'i phyir spos ni/ /sha chen gyis dzini dbul bar bya/ /81—65

de nas rig ma 'jug byas te/ /gdol pa mo 1)dang sme sha ma/ /gar mkhan ma dang bram ze mo/ /de kho na bzhin rgyal mo dang / /dmangs rigs mo dang rgyal rigs mo/ /dri dang spos kyis (semachod byas te/ /lha yi rgyan gyis brgyan par bya/ /yan lag lnga la yi ge hri/ /bha ga'i dbus su yi ge rbu/ /spyan ma sgrol ma gos dkar mtshan / /yid dga' ma bdag bsgom par bya/ /bha ga'i dbus su slob dpon gyis/ /me tog gtor ba kho nar bya/ /de nas sngags pas hom khung ni/ /tshad mar kun tu bri bya ste/ /zhi la skum por bya ba ste/ /khru gang tsam du thig gdab po/ /khru phyed sa la brkos ④nas su/ /dkar rtsi tshon gyis byug par bri/ /kun tu 'khor lo tshul ltar yang / /glo ru mnyam por bri ba'o/ /rgyas pa la ni khru do ste/ /de la khru gang brko rdoge bar bya/ /gru bzhi pa ni mtha' mnyam du/ ci /mugs dang btsag gis bri ba'o/ /mngon spyod la ni zur gsum ste/ /sor nyi shu ni yangs pa'i tshad/ /nyi shu phyed ni brko byas na/ /dbus su rdo rje rgya gram yang / /'bar ba phreng gis 'khrugs (6pa bri/ /de bzhin dbang dang dgug pa la/ /zla gam yang dag bri ba'o/ /hom khung yang dag ston nas su/ /phyogs kyi cha yang bstan par bya/ /byang du mngon du kha bsgyur 97)te/ /sngags pas zhi ba brtsam par bya/ /rgyas pa la ni shar du yang / /mngon spyod la ni lho na ste/ /dbang ni nub tu kho na bshad/ /dgug dang bskrad kyang de bzhin no/ /mngon spyod rtag par nag po ste/ /tshon 8lnga yis ni dbang sogs bya/ /'bras dang til dang 'o ma dang / /mar dang sbrang rtsi lhan cig par/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang ldan pa yis/ /zhi ba rgyas pa sbyin sreg bya/ /bsreg (9 shing rnams kyang thams cad la/ /dri zhim 'o ma can shing ngo / /sna tshogs zas sam gtor ma yang / /'byung po thams 81—66

cad sbyin par bya/ /gtor ma gang yang sgrub pa pos/ /khrag 'thung phyag rgya chen pos sbyin/ /gang zhig yid kyi 1)'dod pa ni/ /rtag tu rnal 'byor pa yis 'grub / /dbyar gyi ②dus ni zhi ba ste/ /rgyas pa de bzhin dgun gyi dus/ /dpyid ka mngon spyod las rnams ni/ /sgrub pa pos ni thams cad bya/ /shar dus zhi (bab rab tu gsungs/ /rgyas pa de bzhin srod la ste/ /nyin phyed la 'am nam phyed la/ /rtag par mngon spyod bya ba'o/ /hom khung dbus su yi dam lnga lha/ /yi ge r+ghaṃ gis bskyed sprinas su/ /zhal ni gdangs pa bsam byas te(nya/ /sbyin sreg de la dbul bar bya/ /sbyin sreg 'bum phrag phul gyur ⑦na/ /mdun du mngon sum kho nar 'gyur/ /dang po me ni dgug bya ba/ /lha thams cad kyi mchod pa'i gnas / /'od zer phreng 'khrugs drag po'i (nyelha/ /sangs rgyas byang chub 'grub pa'o / /oṃ e h+ye hi(7)/ 'dir gshegs gdon mi za bar khyod/ /me lha mngon sum dngos grub sbyin/ /drag po khams gsum gyis mchod pa/ /khyab 'jug tshangs pas phyag 'tshal ba/ /'di dag yon yang bzhes nas su/ /zhabs g.yon brjes mekyang rdo rje can/ /oṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ 'o/phaṭa phaṭa skoswā hā/ dang po la ni yon dbul 0te/ /phyi nas lha bshos me tog dbul/ /oṃ lha yi nyugeme tog shin tu dmar / /dri zhim shin tu mdzes pa ni/ /me tog de 8ring bzhes nas su/ /'di la byin gyis brlab par gsol/ /rtsu me tog gi sngags so/ /oṃ mar me 'od zer 'bar ba ni/ /ngan 'gro 'jigs pa 'joms byed pa/ /lha yi mig byed bkra shis pas/ /mar me khyod kyis bzhes su gsol/ /hūṃ mar me'i sngags so/ /oṃ tsan+dan ga pur dang bcas pa'i/ /dri zhim spos me dge 4ba ni/ /mthu dang bcas par bya ba 'di/ /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /rdu spos kyi 81—67

sngags so/ /oṃ sna tshogs lha yi ༅7dri zhim pa/ /sna tshogs ga pur rnam brgyan (gepas / /sna tshogs yi ge rtsu las byung / /dri 'di 'bul te bzhes su gsol/ /hūṃ dri'i sngags so/ /dang por mchod pa'i cho ga ni/ /the tshom ((med par me la bya/ /phyi nas rang gi yi dam lha'i/ /bzlas 4sngags rig par brjod par bya/ /dbyangs dang gar dang zas rnams kyi55ci/ /rnam pa du mar rol byas te/ / rig ma dang neni sgrub pa pos/ /tshogs la mchod pas mnyes par bya/ /gal te dngos grub dag 'dod na/ /sku gsung thugs ni 'grub pa'o/ /bla ma me lha rdo rje 'dzin / /mchod par byas nas rdzogs par bya/ /oṃ me lha las ni grub par mdzad / /sems can thams cad bde ba 'dren/ /sku gsung thugs dngos grub don du/ /lha rnams las ni rjes su skyobs/ /me lha zhi bar gshegs nas su/ /sa gzhi zhi bar mdzad mdzod cig /rgyu dang mi rgyu bcas pa yis/ /sgrub pa po dang thams cad dang / /bdag gi bsod nams 'bras 'gyur dang / /sngags kyi dngos grub rab sbyin cig /a ā i sī u u/ ṛ rī/ bla lī/7) e e/o au/ e aḥ rtsu swā hā/ rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba che/ /bcom ldan rdo rjes (9de gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rdo rje can rdo rje 1 tshobadud rtsi bde ba chen po'i rdo rje bdud rtsi rgyud ri1nyechen po las sbyin sreg gi cho ga bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u bzhi pa'o// //khyod la mig sman bshad par bya/ /tshil chen gyi ni snying po yi/ /ban da la ni dud pa blang 1 / /'ug pa'i mgo bo bsregs nas su/ /khrag chen dang ni bsres par bya1lha/ /mtshan mo la ni btags nas su/ /zhib mor phye mar kho nar 81—68

bya / /bya rgod rje ngar bkang nas su/ /mi yi rus pa'i thur mang gis/ /mig la bskus nas gzugs kun ni1)/ /rtag tu rnal 'byor pa yis 90byed/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi las byung ba'i/ /mig sman dngos grub sbyor ba ni/ /nag po'i tshes brgyad bcu bzhi la/ /bha ga'i dbus su bsgrub par bya/ /zhi ba dang ni rgyas pa dang ske/ /de bzhin dbang 'gugs (na las byed do/ /sna tshogs drag po'i gdon rnams dang / /zhag bzhi pa yi rims dang dug /thams cad med par byed lha mo / /dga' ma khyod la bden par bshad/ /rgyal po'i khab na chen por mchod/ /dgra bo rnams kyang zad byed de na)/ /de bzhin bgegs kyang 'gag par byed/ /mig sman ldan par bzla bar bya/ /oṃ 'dod pa'i gzugs can mig yangs ma/ /bshang gci khrag la dga' byed ma/ /zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i lha mo/ /drag po'i gzugs can mā ma tī/ / trī hrī rtsu t+t+waṃ a eḥ a hā tsā 95swā hā/ dang po'i zhal ni nag po ste/ /de kho na bzhin g.yas ni dkar/ /g.yon ni dmar por de rig nas/ /g.yas phyogs ral gri 'khor lo can/ /g.yon du zhags pa dang lcags kyu/ /de bzhin rdo rje dril bu yang / /bha ga'i dbus su bsgom (6༄byas te/ /de la mig sman bsgrub par bya/ /bha ga gur gum 7gyis bkang nas/ /phyi nas ri riling ga gzhug par bya/ /de la brjod par bya sngags ni/ /oṃ yig sgra yig phye ba dang ske/ /badz+ra a mṛ 9༄ta zhes bkodabo/ /sgra sgrogs sprin dang phaṭa yig go/ /bdud rtsi dang ni mnyam ldan pas/ /bha ga'i dbus nas dbyung bar bya/ /de la sngags 'bum bzlas nas su/ /de yis thig le kho nar bya/ /bud med kyis khyo 'khol 'gyur te/ /mdun na 'don 11bcas rgyal po yang / /skyes pa gang gis de byas na/ /bud med gang la skal can 'gyur/ /rgyal po'i sna khab can chen 81—69

por tshed1/ /dgra bo rnams ni zad byed do/ /dur dur ar ku'i 'bras blangs te / /bdud rtsi dang ni bsres byas na/ /zhal gsum drag po'i gzugs dang ni/ /gshin rje'i (2)gshed khro bzlas nas su/ /sha chen da nga ni ldan byas te/ /chang dang bsres la sbyin par bya/ /rtag tu myos nas 'khor nas su/ /mi ni bskams ②nas shi 'gyur ro/ /oṃ hrīḥjiḥwi kṛ ④tā na na sarba sha r+ghaṃ bi (denā sha ya/ stam bhubha ya/ mā ra ya hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sngags pas gi'u (lewang blangs nas(1)/ /bha ga la ni yig 'bru bri/ /tsan+dan gyis ni mnyam byugs nas/ /khyod dang lhan cig gnas par bya/ /gnas ma dag ni bde chen te/ /'khor g.yog dngos por 'gyur bar ro/ /bshang gci gzugs brnyan byas nas su/ /sha chen gyi 7ni spos dbul te/ /dgra yi spa yis dkris byas nas/ /rus pa'i phye mas byug par bya/ /dgra sgor brkos nas sbas 57byas na/ /zhag bdun gyis ni shi 'gyur ro/ /bshang 11gci khrag dang bsres pa yi/ /sha chen gyis ni sbyin bsreg 'bya/ /dur khrod kyi ni bsreg 1 shing yang / /shing gcig pa dang lam mdo na/ /me yi hom khung 3 bris nas su/ /nyin phyed nam phyed sbyin bsreg mebya/ /khro chen gshin rje'i gshed po yi/ /sku la thal bas bskus pas ni/ /bsgoms nas dgra la cher gnon nas/ /gdon mi za bar shi 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi bde chen po1 rmo/ /bcom ldan rdo rjes de gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rdo rje can rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba chen po'i rdo rje bdud rtsi rgyud chen po las las chen po bstan pa zhes bya ba 18le'u lnga pa'o// //rdo rje bdud rtsi rgyud chen las/ /dpal ldan rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi/ /sgrub pa 81—70

mdor bsdus bshad par bya/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga'i 6)rim pa yang / /de yi dkyil 'khor cho ga zhesal/ /khams gsum rnam rgyal las byung yin/ /grwa sbyorabazhi par ni thig gdab ste/ /khru ④gang yang na khru do'o/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang 'dra ba/ /'od zer 'bar ba 'khrugs pa la/ /dpal ldan rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad bzhag⑤ /zhal gsum de bzhin phyag drug ste/ /rgyan thams cad kyis yongs rdzogs pa/ /phyag rgya yis ni phyag brgyan (7pa/ /rig ma (7bzhi dang mnyam ldan pa / /u ma'i sra (2)ba'i nu mar bzhugs/ /cung zad mche ba gtsigs tso)pa po/ /khro dang ldan par bzhad byed zhal/ /g.yas pa la ni mda' bris te/ /de kho na bzhin g.yon na gzhu/ /phyag bzhi pa ni bris pa la/ /phyag gnyis pas ni nu ma 7bsnams / /rig nyunyem thams cad zhal gsum ste/ /de bzhin sgo srungs (2lcags kyu dang / /de bzhin me tog spos me ma/ /dri yang yang dag bri bar bya/ /sgeg mo phreng ba de bzhin dbyangs/ /gar mkhan ma yang phyag drug nyid/ /de bzhin gling bu ma bri ste/ /pi wang ma dang rnga chen ma/ /rdza rnga ma dang sil snyan kun/ /dkyil 'khor la ni bri ba'o/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi rgyud chen las/ /skal ba bzang po yang bzhag hunyeste/ /phyag gnyis pa la zhal gcig pa/ /bzang po de dag kho na'o/ /rgyan ni thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ /sgrub pa po yang mdun bri'o/ /bgrang phreng de bzhin rdo rje dang / /dril bu 'dzin pa bri bar bya/ /gtor ma'i gtor ma mchod rdzas dang / /chang skyems ro dang dga' ston mchod/ /nag po'i tsobargyad dang bcu bzhi la/ /dkyil 'khor la ni rdul tshon skogadab/ /dbus su gru bzhi bri ba'o/ /gal te dngos grub mchog 'dod na/ /sngags yig gcig tshepa gtso bo ni / /rdo rje hūṃ mdzad bsgrub par bya/ /phyi nas slob dpon la mchod pa/ /81—71

bdag gam rgyal srid dbang nyid dam/ /bran mo bu mo de bzhin du/ /ma dang sring mo dbul bar bya/ /sku gsung thugs kyi bsgrub ②pa yi/ /dngos grub gal te bdag 'dod na/ /khams gsum rnam rgyal las byung ni/ /sngags pas rtag tu bsgrub par bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi las byung ngo / /bdud rtsi lnga dang mnyam ldan pa/ /ngan song thams cad med byed pa / /rdo rje se gol mnyam sbyor gyis/ /dpal ldan rdo rje hūṃ mdzad 'grub/ /rnal 'byor pa dang rnal 'byor ma'i/ /byang sems rnam par sprul par gsungs/ /lan grangs du mar rig ma dang / /dkyil 'khor du ni rol bar bya/ /bha ga'i dbus la tsho nimyang byas pa/ /gang dag dpa' bo sngags la gnas/ /pad+mar kha yis 'o byas nas/ /bdud rtsi khu ba kho nar blang / /lag pa yi ni sor mo la/ /gnas de la ni blang mi bya/ /blang bar gyur na 'jig 'gyur nas/ / mthu yang 'jig ( nas 'bras bu med/ /rig ma chen mos kyang phyung nas/ /rdo rje la yang 'o gdab bo/ /de ni sangs rgyas nyid du 'grub/ /khu ba'i gzugs can bdud rtsi ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi bde chen po/ /bcom ldan rdo rjes de gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rdo rje can rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba chen po'i rdo rje bdud rtsi (4)rgyud chen po las rdo rje rtsu mdzad kyi bsgrub 5pa bstan pa zhes bya ba le'u drug pa'o// //de nas lha mo mā ma tī/ /dga' ba'i rol bar cher bzhugs pas/ /thal mo sbyar nas phyag byas nas/ /dbyangs 'di dag ni ched du brjod/ /dpa' bo chu skyes sngon po'i sku/ /dpa' bo gzhan gyis yongs bskor zhing / /phyag rgya mo 81—72

tshogs mnyam ldan pa'i/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi bdag phyag 'tshal/ /ston gyi nam mkha' dang 'dra ba/ /nga ro bung ba sgra sgrogs ①ltar/ / bskal par bzhugs ②pa skal bzang ba/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi bdag phyag 'tshal/ /thams cad mkhyen pa thams cad mdzes/ /yang dag dbang po lam gyis ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi bdag phyag 'tshal/ /ma lus pa yi khams gsum la/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi dpe med pas/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi rigs chen mo / /shin tu chags pas dga' byed pa/ /sen mo rjes dang bcas pa'i sku/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi bdag phyag 'tshalakru/ /ut+pal ⑤sngon po'i 'dab (5)ma lta bur phyag sngo ba/ /sangs rgyas de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje khyod kyis bdag dang ⑦ni/ /shin tu dga' ba'i rjes su chags pas longs spyod cig /khams gsum la ni bsgrub par bya ba'i don gyi phyir/ /khyod ni skyon med dam pa'i stong pa las/ /yig 'brus rdo rjes gyur pa'i mgon po khyod/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu gang gis khyod mthong nas/ /de dag 'khor ba ru ni ga la 'gro/ /de ltar dbyangs ni blangs nas su/ /rdo rje gar ni rnam par byed/ /rked pa dang ni rkang pa dang / /dpung pa dang ni mgo bo'i gar/ /gar gyi gzhung gi mtshan nyid do/ /rjes thabs rjes su rim pa dang / /bstod (0pa dang ni 6)'gying bag ste/ /rgyas dang 'dud dang gsal po ru/ /rgyas pa dang ni smin bskyod gar/ /lag pa'i phyag rgya sbyor ba yis/ /stabs brgyad kyis ni gar byed bya/ /rgyas pa'i pad+ma mā ma khri7//gar byas nas ni lha mo des/ /rdo rje cing gis rdo rje niyi/ /rdo rje be con 'o btab byed/ /de nas bcom ldan rdo rjes kyang / /'o btab mā mashā tunyepad+mar/ /ston cig lha mo pad+ma ni/ /de la mchod pa brtsam par bya/ /bzhugs shig mi g.yo bar rig mo/ /bdud rtsi bsam gtan brtsam par bgyi/ /de bzhin nyid mchog 81—73

brtsam pa ni/ /bdud rtsi thig le'i gzugs can te①/ /mkha' yi dbus su zla ba 'dra/ /stong pa de nyid du)ched du brjod/ /'jigs med zad med phra mo ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'joms byed pa/ /lte ba'i dbus su gnas lha mo/ /snying po gsang ba'i spyod yul la/ /khu ba'i gzugs kyis zag yinas su/ /bha ga ling ga'i dkyil du gnas/ /'di ni srog chags rnams kyi ④srog /rnam par shes pa'i phung po rtename/ /sangs rgyas de bzhin rdo rje 'dzin/ /tshangs pa khyab 'jug dbang phyug che/ /sa dang chu dang de bzhin me/ /rlung dang nam mkha' kho na yang ske/ /g.yo dang mi g.yo sna tshogs pa'i/ /khams gsum la ni ma lus par/ /de ni bdag gis rtag tu bsam/ /de las bskyed de bdag dang khyod/ /tshangs pa lha dbang khyab 'jug sogs/ /byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /shes bya shes pa'i bdag nyid gtso/ /de nyid dam pa de bsam mo/ /skye ba dang ni shi ba dang / /thams cad de la 'dus pa yin/ /skyed 6)pa byed pa po de gcig /rang bdag gyur pa lhan cig pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa kun nas kun / /zhi nas rdo zhi ba khyab pa po/ /ci phyir khang pa de bkang bas/ /de bas skyes bur bshad pa yin/ /lus la gnas phyir lus can te/ /shed byed phyir na shes par 'dod/ /bdag la bdag gis rig pa'i lha/ /de phyir lha zhes 'dod pa yin/ /'jug las khyab 'jug ces gsungs te/ /ngag gis rdo rje 'dzin du 'gyur / /ston du med pa gsang ba 'di/ /nan tan du ni gsang bar bya /skyon can min dang g.yo can minardo / /dam tshig la ni mi snang ba/ /chad par lta ba med pa la/ /bla ma la chags 'dul ba can/ /phrag dog chags pa spong byed pa/ /dkyil 'khor la ni zhugs pa dang / /rdo rje bstan pa'i slob ma dag /81—74

de la rgyas pa'i bstan pa 'di/ /de bzhin nyid mchog bshad par bya/ /slob dpon rig ma dang ldan nas/ /de la dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi bde chen po/ /bcom ldan rdo rjes de gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rdo rje can rdo rje ①bdud rtsi bde ba zhuchen po'i rdo rje bdud rtsi ②rgyud chen po las dbyangs dang gar dang / dbang bskur ba dang / de bzhin nyid cher dmigs pa dag bstan pa zhes bya ba le'u bdun pa'o// //de nas lha mo yang langs nas/ /bzhad nas 'di dag zhu ba ste/ /bcom ldan 'di la the tshom zos/ /dam pa'i ngo mtshar ④bdag bskyed de/ /zhi gzugs rdo rje can de las/ /khro bo'i gzugs ni ci ltar 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi bde chen pos⑤/ /rdo rje pad+ma mnyam sbyor te/ /khro bo'i gzugs ni rnam par phyung / /'bar ba'i phreng 'khrugs drag po 4)can/ /'jigs byed la yang 'jigs par byed/ /zhal bzhi la ni phyag brgyad de/ /thod pa'i dbu rgyan tso)'jigs par brgyan/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang mgo bsnams te/ /thod pa dang ni khrag dga' ba/ /gtum po rgyu ma'i phreng (nye'akhrugs pa/ /rig ma brgyad kyis yongs su bskor/ /dur khrod chen po bzhir (7bzhugs pa/ /phaṭa yig sngags kyi nga ro can/ /'byung po ro langs tshogs pa dang / /dur khrod la ni rol mdzad pas/ /de 'og dbang dang bcas pa'i lha/ /tshangs pa ⑩khyab 'jug dbang phyug che/ /bza' byed rdo rje can chen po(te/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung gzugs ni phyung (/snye/ /dang po'i rig ma /nya'ajigs can ma/ /mi sdug 81—75

gdol pa sme sha can/ /ser mo rigs can drag mo dang / /'jigs par byed ma brgyad du 'dod/ /sngags 'di dag ni bzla byas te/ /gar yang byed nas dbyangs blang ngo / /'jigs byed chen po mche ba gtsigs/ /rgyu 3)ma phreng gi rgyan skud brgyan/ /sha chen dag ni gsol byed pa/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung bdag phyag 'tshal/ /sgrub pa po rnams phan byed phyir/ /bzlas pa'i sngags ni bshad par bya/ /gsum pa yi ni gsum pa la/ /bdun pa yi ni bzhi pa sbyor/ /bdun pa yi yang gsum pa ste/ /gnyis kyi tshig ni gnyis su sbyor/ /kun la de bzhin nyid ldan te/ /yi ge phyed kyis rnam par brgyanal/ /drug pa'i bzhi pa phyung byas te/ /bdun pa'i dngos pos gdan du bya/ /bcu gsum pa yis steng gnon pa'i/ /swā hā mthar bzhag sbyon)sngags ni phyung / /dang po rnam par snang mdzad dbul/ /khrag 'thung rtsa ba'i sngags yin no/ /sngags kyi rgyal po 'di nyid kyi/ /mthu chen nyon cig mā ma tī/ /lan cig ④tsam gyis sngags bzlas natshor / /skad cig 'jig rten gsum 'jig go/ /khams gsum mkhalus pa rnams kyang —/ /zos par byed par the tshom 6)med/ /de yis 'dod pa thams cad sbyin//dpal ldan khrag 'thung mnyam 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi bde chen po/ /bcom ldan rdo rjes de gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rdo rje can rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba chen po'i rgyud las dpal ldan khrag 'thung bskyed pa bstan pa zhes bya ba le'u brgyad pa'o// //de nas bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yis7/ /gzugs ni yang dag bshad par bya/ /zhal gsum pa la phyag drug ste/ /drag po nag po dud pa'i 'od/ /'od zer phreng rin81—76

ba 'khrugs pa dang / /gtum mos spyan ni dmar po can/ /dmar ba'i smin (1༷ma ag tshom rdo 'bar/ /drag chen po ni zil gyis gnon/ /phyag na dgra sta bsnams brtson pa/ /gtun shing rdo rje zhags pa dang / /g.yon gyi phyag gi sdigs mdzub ༷ kyis/ /sdang ba thams cad sdigs (gepar byed/ /ral gri phyag mtshan bsgom par bya/ /rig ma brgyad dang mnyam ldan zhing / /sgo srungs 9zhedang yang yang dag ldan/ /gsang ba'i pad+ma bsgom byas te/ /'dab (6)mar rig ma brgyad ni bkod/ /bdud rtsi ma dang bdud rtsi zhal/ /bdud rtsi can dang bdud rtsi spyan/ /grangs med ma dang gzugs bzang ma/ /mdzes pa'i gzugs can bde grub ma/ /thams cad zhal gsum phyag drug ste/ /phyogs dang mtshams la dgod (7)par bya/ /phyag gis pad+ma bsnams par brtson/ /de dag lha mo gar rinabyed nas/ /sna tshogs gzugs rnams mchog sbyin ma/ /bzhad cing rol par mdzad byed do/ /sngags kyi rgyal po dbyung (9dbar bya/ /rnam par snang mdzad yang 'bul nas/ /tshig 'di yis ni yongs su dgoda'i/ /dang po yi ni gnyis pa ste/ /stong pa nyid ni gdan ldan pa/ /stong 51nyepas steng nas gnon pa'i sngags / /mtha' nas swā hā sbyor byed do/ /gtan du shin tu dga' cho1lha'abyor nasal/ /bdud rtsi bdud rtsi phyung nas su/ /bdud rtsi bdud rtsi sbyor ba yis/lha/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa bsgrub par bya/ /don kun dngos grub thams cad yang 1 sku/ /de yis myur bar bsgrub ri7par 'gyur/ /pho dza'am gal te mo ri1tshedag gis18/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dran byed na/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu 'jig rten gsum/ / de yi 19phyag mthil la kun gnas/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi bde chen po/ /dus rtag par ni bsgom par bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs 81—77

kyi ①rdo rje can rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba ②chen po'i rdo rje bdud rtsi ②rgyud chen po las/dpal bdud rtsi 'khyil pa 'byung ba zhes bya ba ④le'u dgu pa'o// //de nas ro langs chen po yi/ /sgrub ⑤pa gzhan yang bshad par bya/ /nag po'i yitshes brgyad bcu bzhi la/ /ling ga gcig dang lam mdo dang / /shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang / /ri dang chu 'gram de rnams la/ /las thams cad ni bsgrub bya ste/ /de bzhin ro langs slong ba ni/ /'gags nas shi ba mo rnams ni/ /mtshan thams cad ni kun rdzogs pa/ /gdol pa mo medang sme sha can / /khyim tshos ma rnams de dag na⑧/ /mdzes pa bzang ba rma med pa/ /sum cu lhodartsa gnyis bsngags ⑩pa ste/ /lo ni nyi shu rtsa lnga bskyed/ /bud med ro yi skra bzung zhu ste/ /gtsang ba'i chu yis bkru bar bya/ /sngags dang sman gyi rdo leb la / /ga bur tsan+dan dkar 0po yis/ /de la byug par bya byas ten / /sna tshogs me tog spos rnams kyis/ /mchod cing gtor ma dbul bar bya mar khu chen pos bskus tsonas su/ /yungs kur ngo la brdeg par bya/ /8khrag 'thung zhes bya sgrub tshepa pos/ /de la dkyil 'khor yang bri ste0/ /thod pa zhes bya zla gam mam / /gzhu yi mtshul gyis bkang bar bya/ /thod pas nye bar brgyan 0byed cing ske/ / rig ma tsha )brgyad dang ldan par bya/ / sha yi ( —)khams can thod pa dbang ske/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ 'thams cad kyis 'dzin te/ /zhal gsum pa la drag po'i gzugs / /phyag drug ral gri phyag na 'dzin/ /dkyil 'khor de yi phyi rol du/ /sgo srungs 8nyem ni rab tu brtags/ /glang chan dang ni glang chen rna/ /zhal mdzes de bzhin zhal gdug ma/ /drag mo zhags dzo nyepa lcags kyu 'dzin/ /mi 81—78

sdug 'jigs pas 'jigs byed ①rnams/ /zhal gcig lapa la phyag gnyis pa(ci/ /me tog mchod pa yang dag bri/ /rnam pa sna tshogs rig ma ④yang / /dkyil 'khor la ni mchod pa bri/ /de nas dpa' bo sgrub (snyepa pos/ /dung chen gyis ni brgyan ⑥byas pa/ /thod pa'i phreng bas ⑦thod bcings pa'ini/ /khrag 'thung gzugs ni sgom ⑨byed pas/ /de la cang te'u brdungs nas su/ /gar byed cing ni khang par 'jug /de yi snying gar gnod ⑩pa'i sngags/ /bh+yo yig de 7la bzla rmogebya ste/ /lha yi dkyil 'khor mchod nas su/ /khrag chen gyis ni gtor bar bya/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung sngags chen ni/ /sgrub pa pos ni bzlas ma thag /khro dang ldan pa'i ag btsar bya/ /ro langs kyis ni gang sgrogs byed/ /de tshe sngags pas mi 'jigs te/ /khrag 'thung sngags ni dran par bya/ /langs pa'i ro langs de yis kyang nyu3/ /sgrub pa po la 'di skad smra / /dpa' chen po kye las gang yang / /bdag la bka' 455 merdo rje can/ /ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang ske/ /mkha' la rgyu bar 'dod pa dang tshe/ /sgrub pa pos ni gang 'dod pa/ /las de dag ni bsgrub (7 tshopar bgyi/ /de nas sgrub lhonyepa po yis 37ni/ /yid la gang dang gang 'dod bslang / /de ltar thams cad bsgrub bya ba/ /rgyas pa'i pad+ma mā ma khri( — )/ /ro langs bsgrub 0pa'i mchog gyur pa/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi las byung yin/ /sku gsung thugs kyi bsgrub 'don du/ /sgrub pa po yi bde yang 'dren / /rdo rje bdud rtsi bde chen po(ge/ /bcom ldan rdo rjes du sede gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rdo rje can rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba chen po'i rdo rje bdud rtsi rgyud chen po las ro langs bsgrub zhunyepa bstan pa zhes py-i yebya ba le'u bcu pa'o// //81—79

pad+ma mnyam sbyor te/ /cang mi gsung bar cher bzhugs so/ /dbugs dgag phyir nyunyenas mi g.yo nasaris/ /mi 'jigs pa dang mi gsung bar/ /ting 'dzin mchog la zhugs dpa la/ /mā ma khris ni yang zhus te/ /bcom ldan rdo rje phra mo ni / /sems can kun gyi yid la gnas/ /ci ltar rnam pa gang gis ni/ /de bzhin nyid de thob par bgyi/ /de nas bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi bde chen pos/ /bzhad (shepa mdzad nas gsung 'di ni/ /spyan yang phye nas bka' stsal pa/ /de nyid sngon bzhin bshad pa ste/ /bdud rtsi gzugs ni khu ba yin / /bdud rtsi lnga dang ldan byas te/ /rtag par rgyun du myang bar bya/ /rdzas ni re re'i mthu dag ni/ /bshad pa nyon cig mā ma khril/ /ye shes shes ⑥bya sgrub byed pa'i/ /khu ba dngas tsho)napar bza' bar bya/ /sku gsung thugs kyi bsgrub (de don du/ /khrag 99)chen rab tu bsgrub bya ste/ /gang zhig 0bud med rnams kyi 'am / /bu mo yi ni martag tu blang / /khrag hu3chen des ni mā ma tī/ /don ni thams cad byed pa po/ /drag shul shi ba rnyed na ni/ /sha chen po yang bza' bya ste / /gsal shing btsugs dang 'gags 32pa 'am/ /g.yul du bsad pa gang de ni / /zab cing bstan 1 pas za byed na/ /tshe dang nad med 'phel bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin 'dod pa'i bde ba dang / /sangs rgyas byang chub grub pa dang / /rdo rje sems dpa' bzhin du 'tsho)snye/ /'dod kun 'bras bu des sbyin no/ /rdo rje chu dang bshang gci rmi/ /rang gis bza' bar rig par bya/ /phye ma zhib mor byas pa la/ /khrag chen gyis ni bsre bar bya/ /snga dro de bzhin nyin phyed dang / /81—80

phyi dro la ni bza' bar bya/ /dus gsum zos nas rnal 'byor pas/ /de nas rdo rje chu ni btung / /nyin dang nyin du mā ma tī/ /sgrub ①pa po gang sgrub byed pa/ /lus la nad ni med 'gyur zhing / /rgas pa'i nad kyang med par byed/ /skal rinabazang rgyas pa'i mdangs ldan pa/ /rgyal po'i sgor yang rgyal bar 'dren/ /de 95cini 'dod pa kun sbyin pas/ /mchog rab de nyid thob pa yin/ /rnal 'byor de yang kun shes te/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i yon tan ldan/ /'dod chags zhe sdang las grol nas/ /brkam pa phrag dog rnam spangs nas/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi bde chen po/ /de yis sgrub sa pa 'grub pa'o/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i 〈pergyud 'di ni/ /don mang gsang ba'i rim pa can/ /ma lus rdo rje theg pa 'di/ /'di las byung gyur tshanalha mo kye/ /rgyas pa'i pad+ma mā ma khrisamer/ /'dod chags kyis ni bde 'gyur bas / /khyod la dam pa'i dngos ston na/ /bdag gis gang la yang mi ston/ /'di ni gsang chen dam pa yin/ / yid dag tshonadakun gyi bdag la gnas/ /byang chub sems dpa' ma shes te/ /gzugs med stong pa mi 'gyur bas/ /de na de nyid rig ḍa)chen po/ /rdo rje spyi gtsug nor bur 'dod/ /shin tu gsang nas gzungs lha mo/ /pha dang bu la'ang bstan mi bya/ /gal te dngos grub mchog 'dod na/ /gdan du gsang ba bstan pa dang / /bla ma la chags brtul zhugs brtan ske/ /de la sbyin nas de nyid bstan/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi rgyud 'di ni/ /bde 'grub shin tu thob dka' 11ba/ /yang dag rdzogs pas skal bzang 12zhi/ /snying po ye shes 'dus pa yin/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi rgyud chen las/ /sgrub pa po gang dbang bskur tshogeb/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems rnams kyisarlo/ /de la kun gyis phyag byed de/ /phyag ni lan gsum byas nas su/ /rdo rje slob dpon 81—81

skal bzang mchog /de nyid sems can thams cad kyi/ /'khor ba las 'dren gtso zhes gsungs/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi bde chen po/ /bcom ldan rdo rjes de gsungs so/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi rgyud chen po/ /ston pas dga' ma ①la bstan nas / /phra mo'i ②gzugs su rdo rje can/ /de nas bha gar cher bzhugs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rdo rje can rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba chen po'i rgyud las bdud rtsi lnga sgrub ①pa'i thabs bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa rdzogs stodhi// // rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud lo tsā ba gyi co zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa de// //bsdur mchan/56 3)mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉sri/ ①〈〈li 〉〉brtsogs / 0〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ cizhes〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉gcig ⑨〈〈snar 〉〉 de nas lha mos de zhus pa// (mer〈〈snar 〉〉sgrubs/ 98)〈〈snar 〉〉pa/57 91)〈〈snar 〉〉gir/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉rtan por mkhyud/ 〈〈snar 〉〉brtan par 'khyud/ (kye〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉ba las/ tsho4〈〈snar 〉〉shing / 95〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉bsgrub/ (6)〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉sgrub/ la〈〈g.yung 〉〉pad ma skas/ 〈〈pe 〉〉mā ma kyis/ 〈〈snar 〉〉pad zer mā ma gis/ (kye〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉rtsis/tshoshes〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉pa'i/ 0〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉dga'/ /77〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉dga'/58 11〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉sgrub/ 2)〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉sgrub pa'i/ tsho0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉dris/pa)〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉gi/ 95)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉pad ma'-i/ 96)〈〈li 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉gzhag 9)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈 co 〉〉por bris/ 〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉par bri/ kye〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉 ba/ ⑨〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉 ni/0〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉dang / 1nye〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉rtog 12〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bang / nyuge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lus/59 17〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉ze mo'/ 〈〈zhol 〉〉ze mo'i ni/ 〈〈snar 〉〉zer mo'i ni/ 90〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉grub/ 〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉steg 94)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ba'i/ (ge 〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉gshang / 9na〈〈snar 〉〉81wa 82
