sngags bsgrub lho)pa'i phyir/ /dus la bab pa'i tshig 'di mgon smos zhes/ /de ltar bcom ldan 'jig rten mgon pos gsungs/ /de tshe 'jig rten dbang phyug las rnams rab tu gsungs/ /ku ru kul+le'i ri mo'i lugs/ /gang zhig bris pa tsam gyis ni/ /sgrub na/pa po yis 'bras thob pa/ /de nas yang dag bshad par bya / /ri mo mkhan ni gang zhig gis/ /tshes (migangs gang dang dus gang la/ /sgrol ma 'byung las bshad pa stibazhin/ /de ni bdag gis bshad par bya/ /ri mo mkhan ni gang zhig gis/ /gang gi mig ni dmar 'gyur zhing / /lag pa de bzhin rkang pa dmar/ / bya yi mig can e rgya'i larkang / /des ni sgrol ma bri bar bya/ /dpyid kyi zla ba dang po yi/ /mya ngan med pa'i (3tshes brgyad nyin/ /thun ni phyed tsho7༄dang gnyis pa la/ /sgrol ma'i mig ni bri bar bya/ /mngar gsum bza' zhing nya la sogs/ /sha dang chang yang spang bar bya/ /dmar po'i gos kyang rtag tu bgo/ /dmar po'i 0dri yis rtag tu byug /byams pa'i sems ni bskyed byas la/ /tho rangs khrus byas bsangs nas ⑨su/ /lan gsum gos ni brjes nas bosu/ /dbang du byed ma yang dag bri/ /zhal gcig 4)mig ni yangs pa dang / /phyag bzhi ma la gur gum tsomadog /bcu drug lo lon sgeg hunyebacas 'dra/ /bud med sgyu mas tshergyags pa bri/ /gzhon nu ma dmar ser mos ⑫byas pa'i skud pa las ras byas la/ de dang thags mkhan gnyis ka tshizan dang 'o ma bza' bar bya zhing / de nas nyu pad+ma'i gdan la stod g.yogs dmar po'i gos dang bcas pas 1 rin po che'i rna cha dang / rin po che'i cod pan dang /g.yas pas mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa dang / gnyis pas mda' sna (1)rtser 'gengs pa/g.yon pas gzhu 'dzin pa dang / ut+pal dmar po gnyis pa na bsnams pa dang /81—98

'od dpag med cod pan na bzhugs pa meri'i phug na gnas pa'i ku ru kul+le'o/ /ku ru kul+le'i 'og tu ni sgra gcan la'adzin no/ /de'i steng du 'dod pa'i dbang phyug chung ma dang bcas pa'o/ /'dod pa'i lha'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ro//de la pad+ma dmar po'i gdan no/ /de la gnas pa'i sna tshogs pa'i cha byad 9sde can gyi bcom ldan 'das ma bris la/ ras ris rab tu gnas par 0bya'o/ /de'i mdun du mchod pa rnam pa bcwa ⑤brgyad byas la/ yar gyi ngo'i chu)tshes brgyad zla ba nya'i bar du bzlas pa ⑨bya'o/ /sgrol ma'i snying po ni 'di yin te/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥs swā hā zhes bya ba'i sngags so/ /de nas sngon du bsnyen pa 'bum tsam byas la/yang ston zla tha chungs sam9kye/ dpyid zla 'bring po'am/ dbyar zla 'bring po'i sangs rgyas la mchod pa'i dus tshigs kyi nyin par tho rangs kyi khrus byas la gso sbyong bzung 6)nas mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod la/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun la mchod ston chagasol/ /de nas theg pa chen po'i nyi3gsang sngags pa'i tshogs la ribemachod ston byas nas yon phul la/ kyi pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas / bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas/ ji 7ltar 'dod pa'i dngos grub blang bar bya'o/ /nyan thos kyi dge 'dun gang na bzhugs pa dang / theg pa chen po la dga' ba'i tshogs rnams la phyag byas nas bzod par gsol te/ gang na bcom ldan 'das ma'i ras ris bkram 515pa'i phyogs der nye bar song la/dngos grub gang 'dod pa'i don du rig pa 'dzin pas bsam gtan tshedang ldan par gnas la yi ge grangs kyi 'bum bzlas pa 3 bya'o/ /cha gcig gis ni shes rab 'phel/ /cha gnyis kyis ni dbang du byed/ /gang zhig cha ni gsum pa yis//mis ni dug kyang 'gugs par 'gyur/ /myos 12shing 'gying ba'i bud med rnams 81wa 99

dang ni/ /'jig rten thams cad kyis ni mchod par 'gyur/ /sbyor ba goms pas lha mo mdzes rnams la/ /sngags 'chang des ni ci 0)ltar 'dod par spyod/ /de yi 5geming tsam gyis ni ( tshomatshungs med dug can 'bros pa dang 54)/ /gdengs ma'i gtso bo'i 'od kyis dpal ldan dag kyang nya tsho bzhin 'gyur/ /bzlas brjod ldan pa yi ni dzingag gi dbang phyug byed nya'agyur bas/ / rig pas 'gying ba'i (destobs dang ldan pa'i (9rimakhas pa'ang lan med 7byed/ /rig pa 'dzin pa glang po rta yi 517rgyab tu zhon pa dang / /rig ma mdzes mas 'o legs par 'khyud cing mgul nas 'jus pa las/ /sngags rig pa yi na gtso bo yi ni 8stobs kyis rgyal bar 'gyur/ /mthar gyur pa yi nyu2rgyal srid longs spyod dag la yid kyis spyod/ /'dod pa'i lha las dga' ba'i bu la sogs pa tsheri khrod ma/ /1 — sred med bu las dpa' rtsonamo mi phyed pa las bde sogs dang / /tshogs bdag las ni dri med dbyangs kyi dbang phyug dkar mo dang / /sa tu)'dzin lha las phun ṭ+wāṃ )tshogs mnga' ba ri kāsngags kyis rnam rgyal byed/ /gsang sngags ldan par bcom ldan 'das ma gang zhig sgom byed pa/ /des gi ni sna tshogs gter dang gser dang dngul dang rna cha dang / /gos la sogs pa'i nor rnams kun la ched du gang bsams pa /sems kyis thams cad ma lus kun nas longs 22spyod byed/ /rgyal byulas 3gergyal srid dbang po'i yul 'das 27shing las 'bras bu dang / /klu dang tshu klung tshorgya mtsho rnams las chu rnams 'gugs/ /sngags dang ldan pas 'thung zhing zas la sngags kyis dag par byed/ /skye bo sngags med par ni longs na spyod grub pa med/ /nags skyes glang po rta mchog ri dgas shedang ldan pa sna/ /dug bcas gdengs ka can gyi sbrul mchog dang / /chu srin chu glang stag stodang bse dag dang / /rang gi 81wa 100

sngags kyi stobs kyis bkug nas ni/ /zhon yang ngo mtshar med par byas pa yi ni 1mig dag gis/ /lta ②bar gal te gsang sngags grub pa de yis mthong bar 'gyur / /gal te snying rje'i lta bas 'jig rten 'di ltar sdug bsngal bas/ /rgyad 9kyepar gyur pa'i mi mnyam pa la bsngags cidapa des/ /yid bzhin nor bu bzhin du 'jig rten la phan sgron 5rim yin/ /'jig rten ma lus sgron mer /khabyed cing zhi bar byed/ /bdud rnams bcom nas nor gyi char (7rgyun 'bebs par byed/ / dpag bsam (kyeshing du gyur nas 'gro rnams ci 'dod sbyin par byed / /nor gyi dbang phyug ma lus pa yi 3nanor rnams kun bkug nas/ /sems can makun la phan pa'i nye1phyir du 512sbyin par byed/ /de bzhin phongs nyusnyepa'i 'jig rten rnams kyi ched du bogos dag dang / /stan dang khyim dang bla re dag tu sgrol mas mdzad pa rimadang / /rgya mtsho'i gling du tshong ba'i gru zhig gyur pa'i 8longs pa la/ /gzings dang gru la sogs par sgrol mas mdzad par (17 'gyur / /sgrol ma de bsgoms rnal 'byor pa/ /dang po sdug bsngal lhan cig gyur18rka/ /de spangs nas ni cung zhig na/ /mis ni ston mo rnyed par 'gyur/ /gnyis par gos ni rnyed par 'gyur/ /de bzhin btsun mo dang yang 'phrad/ /de nas so rtsi longs spyod 'gyur/ /ma blangs par yang ci 'dod spyod/ /gal te tshangs spyod yin na yang / /lha mchog bskyed pa'i bu mo spyod/ /sems can gsod la dga' ba yis/ /bstan pa 'di la 'grub mi 'gyur/ /dge ba bcu la dga' 'gyur zhing / /theg pa che la sems gcig 19pas/ /rdo rje chos kyi bka' ri ribazhin du/ /dngos grub mchog ni des spyod 'gyur/ /'di ni ras ris la 'jug pa'i rtog pa ste 21dang po'o// //81—101

chos mchod pa yi 17sbyor ba yis/ /gang gi (gechos nyid brnyes ri gyur na/ /chos kyi dbyings su rang gyur pa/ /de nas yang dag bshad par bya/ /de'i rjes la dpag bsam shing gi sgrub pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /brag gi yi ge las byung ba / /dpag bsam shing ni rnam par bsgom④/ /ut+pal yongs su gyur pa las/ /shing ni g.yon du bsgom par bya/ /sna tshogs nor gyi char pa dag /nam mkha'i dkyil nas 'bab pa yis/ /'dod pa'i bsam pa rdzogs byed pa/ /de ltar bsgoms rirmen nor bdag 'gyur/ /gling bzhi pa yi sems can rnams/ /sems kyi 'od zer (6gyis bkug nas/ /rtag tu rin chen bdun rang ⑦bzhin/ /de dag la ni rab sbyin bya/ /yongs kyi gtso bo rin chen dang / /de bzhin rin chen rgya mtsho skyes/ /bud med rin chen rta rin chen/ /de bzhin ral gri rin chen dang / /glang po rin chen sogs rin chen/ /sangs rgyas rnams la yid kyis dbul/ /bud med rgyan gyis brgyan du8)byas la/ /sna tshogs gzugs can 'gying ba rnams/ /sangs rgyas 'bras bu 'dod rnams kyis/ /sangs rgyas rnams la rtag tu dbul/ /'dis ni sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /rig pa 'dzin pa thob par 'gyur/ /rin po che ni yongs rgyas pa'i/ /yongs kyi gtso bo nor dbang phyug / sangs rgyas 'bras bu 'dod pa yis/59ci /sangs rgyas rnams la dbul bar bya/ /de bzhin rin chen gzhan dag kyang / /gus dang bcas pas yongs btang na/ /rdo rje chos su gyur nas ni/ /sems can kun gyi don byed 'gyur/ /'di ni dpag bsam shing gi sgrub pa'i thabs so/ /sems nyid sangs rgyas thams cad do/ /sems nyid kyis ni rnam par grol/ /sems kyis bo 81—102

'ching ba rnams las thar/ /sems kyis grol ba dang ldan 'gyur/ /sems ma gtogs par dngos don rnams/ /gzhan dag gzhan par ma mthong ste/ /sangs rgyas nyid dang dngos grub kun/ / gang phyir phun tshogs gzhan ma mthong //tshigang yang snod dang sems can rnams/ /'byung dang 'byung las gyur pa dag /zag med lhag par mthong ba yis/ /sems tsam yin zhes rab tu bsgrags/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /sems kyi me long phyis 2byas na/ /rang bzhin glo dun bur ba yi skyon/ / rim gyis 4rab tu zad par 'gyur/ /dbyangs yig dang po las byung ba/ /dri med rdzogs pa'i zla ba ste/ /sems nyid zla bar bsgom byas nas9de/ /de yi steng du sa bon dgod/ /dro ba rnams kyi bzhi pa na/ /me yi ribemadog gi steng na 7gnas/ /yi ge i dang yang dag ldan/ /nam mkha' gnyis kyis 587rnam par brgyan/ /de yi sna tshogs 'od rnams kyis/ /'gro ba'i 9dri ma med byas nas/ /stong gsum 'di sogs mkha' dbyings te1 tsho/ /ku ru kul+le'i rir zhugs pas/ /de yis sgrol ma bskul nas ni/ /bkug nas mdun du gnas par byed/ /de nas mkhas pas sa bon la/ /mchod pa chen po'i sprin rnams spro/ /me tog spos dang mar me dang / /de bzhin dri dang lha bshos sogs / /phyag rgya phreng ba de bzhin du/ /gar dang glu yis 11mchod sogs mchod / /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags / /'gro ba'i dge la rjes 12yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung nyu / /sngags 'di lan gsum brjod nas ni/ /de nas gshegs su gsol bar bgyi/ /sems ni byams pas gnas byas la/ /slar yang der ni gzhag par bya/ /snying rje'i sems ni bskyed byas nas/ /rab dga'i sems kyang ’ 81—103

bskyed par bya/ /phyi nas thams cad btang snyoms la/ /sems tsam la ni mnyam par gzhagayon /tha mal rnam par spang ba'i 90phyir/ /sems kyang slar yang stong par bya/ /yang srid len pa'i phung po lnga/ /stong pa nyid kyi me yis bsreg9༷ / /oṃ shu n+ya tā (4dadz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+na ko3 rtas/ yud tsam stong pa'i rnal 'byor nyid/ /byas nas sems ni ngal lesos bya/ /sngon gyi tsodam bcas dran byas nas/ /sa bon tsam zhig yang dran bya/ /gcig pu mya ngan 'das pa yisal/ /sems can bslus par rdokye'agyur ba'i phyir/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho mtha' med las/ /bdag gis de dag ci ltar bsgral/ /'di ltar bsams nas brtse ldan des/ /sems med pa yi stong pa yang (pe/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin sems / /sems nyid kyis 3 rini bskyed par bya/ /sangs rgyas byin rlabs 0lelas sa bon/ /de la ut+pal zhes byar 3 'gyur/ /ut+pal dkyil du zla ba'i gzugs/ /yi ge a las byung ba'o/ /slar yang zla ba der sheges bon/ /de las rige'od zer 'phros gyur pa/ /de yis ma lus 'jig rten khams/ /rnam par sbyangs par bsgom par bya/ /de yis sbyangs shing gsal byas nas/ /'od zer kun gyis sangs rgyas tshogs/ /ut+pal 15la zhugs bsgom par bya/ /de las sgrol ma 'byung bar 'gyuras/ /bstan 'dra'i lha mo bcod mdog can/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam brgyan pas1rte/ /dam tshig gzugs ni mnyam bskyed )snyenas/ /ye shes 'khor lo yang dag bkug /yud tsam gyis ni nges 17rdzogs pa'os sku/ /ye shes 'khor lo mdun 21gnas pa/ /dam tshig phyag rgya'i sbyor ba yis 3/ /kha yi lam nas gzhug 32par bya/ /lag pa thal mo sbyar byas nas/ /mthe'u chung gnyis ni bsgom par bya//gung mo gnyis ni rtse mor sbyar/ /rtse mo'i nang du ming med gzhug /mdzub dgemo 81wa 104

gnyis ni dbu mar sbyar/ /mthe bong 91)gnyis ni 'og tu bkug /dam tshig phyag rgya 'di bcings nas/ /'khor lo bkug nas gzhug par bya/ /sangs rgyas rnams la tshigs ②bcad 'dis/ /dbang bskur bar ④ni gsol ba gdab/ /byang chub rdo rje gyesangs rgyas la/ /ji ltar mchod chen gsol mdzad pa/ /bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng skurabadag stsol/ /rgyal ba'i dbang bskur zhes bya bas56sku/ /spyan la sogs pa lnga pa'o/ /rgyal po'i me tog dbang bskur zhing / /chen por gyur pa de stsol (pemadzod/ /rdo rje chen pos dbang bskur ba/ /khams gsum po tsho noyis phyag byas pa/ /gsang ba gsum gyi gnas las byung / /sangs rgyas kun gyis 79sbyin par bya/ /sangs rgyas sgrol ma dbang bskur bas/ /chos ni gtsug gi nor bur 'gyur/ /'od zer dmar po sna tshogs kyis/ /'gro ba gsum po snang bar byed/ /dbang bskur rin chen thob 'gyur na/ /dngos grub thams cad rab sgrub byed/ /ji ltar slar bstan cho ga yisabo/ /lo phyed brtan 11par brtsams nas ni/ /gtor ma dus gsum gtang bar bya/ /sngags 'di yis ni khar ba 'am/ /khur ba la sogs cho ga yis / /mi lam mtshan ma thob par 'gyur/ /ral gri sa 'og dngos grub dang / /mi snang ba dang bcud len dang / /mi mthong ba dang mkha' spyod nyid/ /de bzhin rkang byug (12mig sman dang / /rmi lam mtshan ma ston 'gyur zhing / /dngos grub rang nyid 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gal te de la dga' 'gyur na/ /grub pa phra mo sgrol mas grub/ /'khor los sgyur 1 nas rgyal srid dang / /dbang po'i longs spyod thams cad byed/ /sgom dang bzlas par ldan pa la/ /rmi lam du yang rab grub byed/ /zla drug tha ma'i zla gcig go/ /mtshan gcig rangs 81—105

par gyo7bzlas byas te/ /ut+pal phyag rgya bcings nas ni/ /bzlas nas phyag rgya yud kyis 'bar/ /phyag rgya 'di yi 95)mthu yis ni/ /btsun mo dang bcas tshangs pa dang / /dbang po nye dbang drag po sogs/ /bkug nas dbang du 'gyur bar byed/ /deng du rinas brtsams nas dngos grub kun/ /bdag 'khor 'ching ④ba las grol (rme'agyur/ /chu dang 'dam gyi skyon dag gis/ /pad+ma gos par mi 'gyur ltar/ /dngul chu reg nas du mar 'gyur/ /bsdus nas slar yang gcig tu 'gyur/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid 'gyur nardzi / /dngos grub thob pa'i sems de bzhin/ /grub pa'i dngul chus reg gyur (7)nas/ /zangs ma gser du 'gyur ba bzhin/ /grub pa'i gsang sngags kyis reg nas/ /sngags pa sangs rgyas skur yang 'gyur/ / lha yi (8)dbang phyug du 'gyur zhing / /khams gsum kun gyi dbang phyug 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas rigs su byung nas ni/ /'khor lo bskor bar tsayang 'gyur ro/ / bltams dang marab tu 'byung mdzad pa/ /dka' 17ba spyod pa'i spyod mdzad cing / /byang chub spyod pa'ang spyod mdzad nam/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang dran par mdzad/ /lha las babs dang sprul pa dang / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /mya ngan 'das pa chen po dang / /dur khrod gshegs pa de bzhin no/ /'jig rten gsum du lus spangs nas/ /rgyal ba longs /2spyod rdzogs sku yis/ /gnas gtsang mar ni slar gshegs nas/ /sprul par r+shabyung ba'i sku yang 'ong nyuge/ /glegs bam ras ris rim pa yis/ /chos kyi sku yang 'jug par mdzad/ /gang gis de yi grub pa'i sngags/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis de nyid gsungs/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis de 9nyid kyi thugs la rnam par brtags nas byang chub sems 81—106

dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /lag na rdo rje ji ltar na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis rdo rje'i sku chos kyi dbyings kyi sku sa'i phyogs gang du dus byed par 'gyur ba yin/ de nas lag na rdo rjes sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' de dag la 'di skad ces hu)gsol to/ /gang yang byang chub sems dpa' dag gis 'di skad du/ ci ( —skultar na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje'i sku chos kyi dbyings kyi sku mi phyed pa'i sku sa'i phyogs 'ga' zhig tu dus byed par 'gyur ba yin zhes smra/ des rdo kyi'adi skad nyon cig /byang chub sems dpa' de ④dag gang mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bya ba de ni bde ba can du 'gro ba'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis smras pa/ ci lag na rdo rje sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams chos sku spangs nas bde ba can du 'gro ba'am(pe / rigs kyi bu 'on te sprul pa'i sku spangs nas longs 4)spyod rdzogs pa'i skus bde ba can du 'gro bar 'gyur/ lag na rdo rje chos kyi sku spangs nas 'gro bar 'gyur zhes bya ba de ji lta bu yin/ lag na rdo rjes smras pa/ ci ltar sgyu ma mkhan gyi skyes bu gang zhig gis dgos pa'i don bsgrub pa'i (7)phyir sgyu ma sprul nas dgos pa sgrub par byed do/ /de bzhin du/ gdod nas grub risarapa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /sems can yongs su gzung 'oba'i phyir/ /'khor los sgyur 1 tshob 'das gyur nas/ /skye ba yongs su 'dzin par mdzad/ /gang tshe sangs rgyas 'das pa na/ /de tshe 'khor los sgyur 1lhab 'byung / /de gnyis med par 'jig rten 'dir/ /nam yang 'byung ba ma yin no/ /gdul bya'i 'jig rten la brten 1lhanas/ /rkang gnyis mchog gis brtul nas ni/ /lo ni brgyad cur (1lhabazhugs mdzad de/ /sangs rgyas rgyal ba'i gnas su gshegs/ /sangs rgyas sgyu 81wa 107

ma spangs nas ni/ /rgyal ba'i shi)pho brang bde chen (lde)du/ /rab zhi bde ba chen po la / /kun du dga' ba'i gzugs kyis bzhugs/ /byed po rtag /ripa gcig pus bzhugasal/ /yin snyam drang srong rnams sems te/ /de lta'i ngo bo de min bzhes/ /de ni skad cig bsdoms tshan par 'dod/ /bdag tu 'dzin pas 'khrul pa rnams/ /rtag tu rtag pa'i don 'dod pa/ /mi rtag nyid la 'jug bya'i phyir/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi sku gtong (6rimadzad/ /dngos po kun gyi dngos bdag nyid/ /thugs kyis thams cad mkhyen te dag /'di dag (7nye'adi gnas ma yin zhes/ /byas pa'i nges pa yod ma yin/ /kun rdzob bden pa la brten 8rinas/ /stong gsum 'di sogs gdul bya la/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis chos bstan (9ci pa/ /nam mkha' mnyam par 1 norab tu 'jug /sangs rgyas 'byung ba de nyid min/ /sangs rgyas 'gags 11pa'ang de bzhin te/ /thams cad ro gcig gyur pa yi(12/ /'byung dang 'jig 1 pa'i rang bzhin no/ /de ni chos dbyings gzugs gcig stebo / /sgrib pa lnga po spangs pa'o/ /zab cing rgya ni che ba'i gzugs/ /de nyid ngo bor de nyid bzhugs/ / gnyis ka 32yod pa ma yin phyir/ /gdod nas yod pa ma yin no/ /de ni gdod nas ma skyes pas/ /skye ba ma yin 'gag 37ma yin/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis smras pa/ lag na rdo rje sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das khams gsum la 1 rjes su ston pa mdzad pa/ skye ba med pa 'gag pa med pa ci lta bu yin/ smras pa/ kye cho12byang chub sems dpa' rnams de ji snyam du sems / gang sangs rgyas ji snyed pa de gang 17zhig yod pa yin nam/ 'on te med pa zhig yin/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis smras pa/ lag na rdo rje sangs rgyas rnams ni yod pa yang ma yin med pa yang ma yin no/ /lag na rdo 81—108

rjes smras pa/ ma skyes pa ni skye ba yin/ /skyes pa phyir yang skye mi 'gyur/ /don dam nyid du dpyad 1tshon ni/ /de phyir gdod nas ma skyes pa/ /de bzhin 'chi ba rina'achi mi 'gyur/ /'chi ba med pa 'chi ba min/ /mi gnas pa la gnas pa med / /gnas pa de la gnas mi dgos/ /gal te ma skyes nyams 'gyur zhing / /ma skyes pa nyid skye 'gyur na/ /ri bong gi ni rwa nyid kyang / /skye ba dang ni 'gag par 'gyur/ /gang tshe yod pa skye 'gyur na/ /skyes pa slar yang skye bar 'gyur/ /gal te med pa skye na yang / /mo sham 4bu yang skye bar 'gyur/ /de phyir thams cad ma rig pa/ /'du byed gsum gyi mtshan nyid yin/ /phung po lnga ldan 'gro ba rnams / /snang ba tsam du rnam par shes/ /re zhig 5rigs pa 'dis byang chub sems dpa' rnams sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi mya ngan las ne'adas pa shes par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis smras pa/ thams cad skyed 7pa med pa'i phyir/ /sngags 'di ci ltar rgyud ci ltar/ /dkyil 'khor sgom 8pa ji lta bu9/ /dngos grub de ni ji ltar 'grub/ /lag na rdo rjes smras pa/rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba ni/ /dngos po rnams ni 'byung ba ltar/ /sngags dang phyag rgya sogs brten nas/ /dngos grub rnams ni 'byung bar 'gyur//dngos grub rnams ni kun rdzob pa/ /sangs rgyas pha rol phyin pa yang sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' nyid/ /kun rdzob nyid du rab sgrub 'gyur/ /rtog pa gnyis pa'o// //sngags bzlas pa yi 1 cho ga'i rim/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /gang zhig shes pa tsam gyis ni/ /sgrub pos dngos grub 'gyur bas so/ / byi ru yis 1181wa 109

ni dbang du byed/ /pus kur 1)gos ni dug zhi byed/ /shel gyis shes rab 'phel bar byed/ /las gsum la ni sbyar bar bya/ /skye gnas kyi rnam par dag pa a shwat+tha'i 'dab tshasama'i rnam pa lta bu'i thab khung byas la/ mya ngan med pa'i shing la me sbar nas/ cho ga bzhin du ut+pal dmar po brgya rtsa brgyad sbyin bsreg 7༄byas te/ gar mkhan gyi khyim nas me blangs la mngar gsum gyis bsgos (4nas / rtsa ba'i sngags dang bya ba yin no/ /phyi nas 'khrul 'khor bya ba yin te/zla mtshan gyis gos pa'i ras la dkyil 'khor gru gsum bris nas/ dkyil 'khor du bsgrub bya dang / sgrub pa po'i ming dang bcas pa'i bskul ba'i tshig dang bcas par bris te/ che ge mo bdag gi dbang du gyur cig byas nas/ de nas rtsa ba'i sngags kyis spel nas/ rgya skyegs kyi khu ba dang / lag pa g.yon pa'i srin lag gi khrag dang / ga pur dang / gur gum medang / gla (7rtsi rnams kyi tshon rtsis bri bar bya'o/ /shes rab 'phel bar 'dod na thab khung de nyid du a rga'am(7sku / ka ra bī (shera'i shing la bram ze'i sbyin sreg yi)gi me blangs la sbar ten )/a ka 511ru ku'i sha'i khyi'i ma'am/ shu dag gi sbyin sreg 8khri bya'o/ /dug zhi bar byed na thab khung de nyid du tsan+dan gyi shing la me sbar la/ ping 13ta ka ra'i me tog gi sbyin bsreg 8bya'o/ /des ni dug thams cad zhi bar 'gugs par 'gyur rol/ /sna tshogs kyi zug gzer 8rnams med par byed cing zhi bar byed do/ /mkha' lding gi rig pa'i rgyud kyi cho ga'o/ /khams gsum pa yi lam gnas pa'i/ /btsun mor grags pa ji snyed pa/ /sbyin sreg tso'akhrul 'khor sbyor ba yis/ de kun bkug nas spyod par byed/ /byams pa chags pa'i lta ba yis/ /sems de yis ni dbang du byed/ /'gro ba thams cad dbang byas nas/ /sangs rgyas 81—110

byang chub nges par spyod91ri/ /'di ni dbang du bya ba'i cho ga'o/ /rnam pa kun mkhyen zhes bya ba/ /shes rab med par thob mi 'gyur/ /de phyir de thob 'dod pa gang / /shes rab rnon po bsgrub par bya/ /bzlas dang sbyin sreg gesbyor ba yis / /chos rnams kun la spyod pa'o/ /blo ni dag gsal dri ma med/ /de nyid shes rab pha rol phyin/ /rnal 'byor pa ni grol nasibar 'gyur/ /gri ha pi da'i lo ma dang / /sha ti dang ni shing mngar dang / /bram ze mo dang ma ga ta/ /sbrang dang bcas pas bza' bar bya/ /shes rab 'phel bar bya ba'i cho ga'o// //dug rmong)rjes sbrang rtsi mar dang bcas/ /'khor lo bzang rtsa de bzhin te/ /mche (5raba'i dug gis bzung (6ba la/ /bskus dang 'thungs pas (7zhi bar mdzad/ /dug gzhil ba'i sman no/ / dza ri tsaṇ+ḍa (8)li dag dang / /nad pa'i sdi ni mar khur bcas/ /lus kyi srin bu shi ba'i ro/ /zos nas dbang du 'gyur ba yin/ /dbang du bya ba'i sman no/ /dug 'gugs pas ni 'gro ba zhi/ /shes rab 'phel bas sangs rgyas nyid/ /chos kyi 'khor lo skor (kheb ni/ /skad cig gis ni dbang byed 'gyur/ /bdag gzhan don rab bsgrub pa la/ /theg pa chen por thabs gzhan med/ /rig pa lan gcig bsgrubs 1 rig yis/ /'phral du yid ches byed pa yin/ /hrīḥ11yig myos pa'i snod bsams nas 12/ /bud med rnams ni 'dzag par 'gyur/ /lce snying dkyil du hrīḥ1/de nyid/ /bsams na blo rnams skye bar byed/ /mche bas bzung ba las bsgoms pa/ /chos kyi yi ge mdzes pa yis / /yi ge dag ni dug zhi byed/ /sgrol ma'i snying po khams gsum las/ /rgyal ba yin par brtse ba can gyis rnam shes bya/ /ngag gi skyon rnams zad pas dug sel sems gekyi skyon spangs pas/ /shes rab 'phel 'gyur lus kyi skyon 81—111

rnams zad pas dbang du byed/ /de phyir 'gro 'di mi dge la zhen (medangos grub thob mi 'gyur/ /de phyir rgyal ba'i (mi chasras kyis (sne)phan phyir sdig rnams spang bar bya ④phyir bgyi/ /phyag rgya bcing ba'i (5)khyad par gyis tsu)ni nges par lus kyi 99)skyon rnams zad par rinatsho'agyur/ /sngags kyis lce yi lhonyetshogs kyi skyon rnams gang yin pa yi 1 sems kyi skyon/ /bsam gtan dga' ba'i sems kyis dga' bar 'gyur bar 11dad pa dri med kyis/ /lus kyi yid rnams g.yo ba med pa de tshe sangs rgyas byin gyis rlobasanyuge/ /sdig med mig gis sdig lta pho snying rje ldan pa 8'jig rten gsum gyi rgyal por 'gyur/ /sbyin pas bsod nams stobs lhag gyur par sa stengs tshegatso bo sbyin bdag brtson ldan tso'agyur/ /le lo spangs pas mkhas pas dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal cung zad kyang mi myong / /de phyir sangs rgyas sras kyi snying rje'i nor dang brtson 'grus spyod pa dag la brten51rte/ /nam mkha'i dkyil du sangs rgyas rnams bltas bsam gtan stobs kyis sangs rgyas rnams la sems / /rmi lam na yang rtag tu bdag nyid sangs rgyas rnams kyis nyusnyebaskor ba mthong ske/ /mkhas pas 'chi hu'etshe du )ri rab rtser gshegs dang / /bzhon ( 7pa sna tshogs zhon pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /snying rje'i bdag nyid can gyis mthong 'gyur zhing rta/ /sdig pa byas pas dmyal ba'i grong khyer mthong bar 'gyur/ /de rnams rnam lhadag ri rgyud yin te/ /blo yang der ni gnas par 'gyur/ /de yi phyir ni 2ltaci nas kyang / /gos dkar dag gi 59btsun mor 'dod/ /de nyid dug ni zhi byed pas/ /rta mgrin gyis ni go 'phang bla 7gnas/ /'dod chags rdo rje'i tshig 8'byung ba/ /'gro ba gsum po dbang du byed/ /'dod chags kyi rigs kyi rgyud bsgrub zhu pa'o// //81—112

de nas sbyor ba gzhan 'byung bar 'gyur te/ dkyil 'khor gru gsum byas nas ni/ /slar yang gru gsum gzhan zhig go/ /dbang po 1phyogs nas brtsams nas ni/ /oṃ la sogs pa na/mkhas pas bri/ /mtshams drug tu ni sa bon drug /chos kyi sa bon dkyil du'o/ /yi ge phuḥ yi nang byas pa/ /de ni sgo yi ma them bri / /sbrul bskrad pa'i rgyud do/ /de nas bud med skal ba dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir / sbyor ba gzhan dag (4bshad par bya ste5/ 'dab snyom bdun pa'i ut+pal byas la/ de la tsho7/yi ge bdun sbyar bar bya'o/ /de'i lte ba la hrīḥ gnyis kyis brten pa'i bsgrub bya'i ming dbang du bya ba'i cho ga bzhin du gro ga'am/ yang na ‘ me tog dang bcas pa'i ras la bris la 1 ririg pa'i ril bu 11byas nas dpung pa la gdags (12par bya'o/ /bdag po bud med bran du 'gyur/ /rgyal po'ang zhabs 13'bring nyid du 'gyur/ / shin tu dag cing gtsang ma yis/ /sngags 'di btu bar bya ba yin/ /dbang du bya ba'i cho ga'o/ /1 bsrung 15ba'i don du 'khrul 'khor 'byung tshosabar 'gyur te/ ut+pal 'dab 1 bzhi byas nas ni/ /de la dbus su zla ba bri/ /shar du mda' ni bri bar bya/ /lho nyid du ni gzhu bri'o/ /mi 'jigs lag pa nub tu'o/ /byang du ut+pal bri bar bya/ / dbus kyi 1 zla bar bsrung 7bya ste/ /sa bon bdun gyis bskor ba'o/ /'khor lo na phyi yi rim pa la/ /ut+pal phreng bas brgyan 1pa'o/ /'di ni gro ga la bris la/ /rang gi dpung la gdags par bya/ /gzhan yang byis pa rgan po dar la bab ri/ /'khrul 'khor gyis ni rang srung na 'grub/ /gal te dbang phyug thob par bya 'dod na/ sa bon gyi grong khyer bris la de'i dkyil 2byudu gzhu bri bar bya'o/ /gzhu'i dkyil du rin po che'i rnam pa lta bu'i ut+pal gyi myu gu bri bar bya'o/ /ut+pal snying po'i dbus su 81—113

yi ge rdzu tsho1la yi ge bdun gyis bskor 2ba'o/ /sa le sbram gyi byang bu 9 ril mngon par bris la khyim gyi steng du nges par gzhag ji par bya'o/ /phyi rol nas ut+pa la'i phreng bas mngon par bskor bar byas nas tshes bcu gnyis (5༄sam brgyad la rin po che lnga dang ldan pa'i bum pa gang bas phab la khrus byas nas mchod 6rinas (medabazlas pa brgya rtsa brgyad byas na/ lo gcig gis nor 'dzin dang mtshungs par 'gyur ro/ /de lta bu'i rig pa'i ril bu 8yang dag par gdags par bya'o/ /de nas sbyor ba gzhan 995yang 'byung bar 'gyur te/mnya ) mig dmar la bab pa na 'gron 11bu gan rgyal 12du gnas pa rnyed na lag nyanamathil du bzhag nas sngags 'bum phrag gcig bzlas nas/ rgyan po 'debs pa snyen pha rol po las rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /'gron 17bu de blangs la ku ru kul+le'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas / tshes bcu gnyis sam/ brgyad la khrus byas nas mchod la dar gyi nang du gtums 1 cinas dpung pa la btags na/ 'dis nor gyi dbang phyug chen por 'gyur ro/ /'gron 38bu de snod du bcug pa'i nang du sba bar (/byas na nyin rer kār ṣā pa ṇa re 2 )re rnyed 21par 'gyur ro/ /don bsgrub dzo rtepa dang / rgyal srid bsgrub 2 pa dang / rgyal 2 po rnyed pa dang / 'bras bu bsgrub tsho gepa'i rgyud do/ /rtog 27pa gsum pa rdzogs so // //gang gis rdul tshon mthong tsam gyis/ /sangs rgyas myur du thob par byed/ /dkyil 'khor na mthong ba'i rim pa bzhin/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi yis nye bar brgyan ge/ /de yi dkyil du lha mo bkod/ /bha ga'i rnam pa kha dog legs/ /mda' ni shar du bri bya ba/ /gzhu 81—114

ni lho yi phyogs su'o/ /mi 'jigs lag pa nub tu ste/ /byang du de bzhin ut+pa la'o / /mtshams kyi cha ni thams cad du'o/ /rdo rje 'khor lo sogs de bzhin/ /gos dmar po yi stod g.yogs bgos17/ /dar dmar pos gdong bkab pa yin//slob ma der ni dgazhug par bya'o/ /'dis sems ma cardo rje ma'i phyag rgya 5bcings la 'khor lor 6me tog dbul bar bya ste/ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ7 zhes bya'o / /g.yogs pa bgrol 8la dkyil 'khor bstan par bya'o/ /dkyil du bab na ni mchog go/ /mda' la bab na ni 9)dbang du byas pa'i las la 1 dbang bar 'gyur ro/ /mi 'jigs pa 11sbyin pa la bab na ni dug 'gugs pa la bslab par bya'o / /ut+pal la bab 12na shes rab 'phel ba la bslab par bya'o/ /gzhu la bab na ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la bslab par bya'o/ /'jug pa'i dus su 'di skad smra bar 1 bya'o/ /khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 1 mchog tu gsang ba 'di dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs 7pa gang gi yang 1snyomadun du brjod par bya ba ma yin no/ /dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re / ya nga ba 1 ma spangs par 19'chi ba'i dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar gyur 2 ta re/ zhes pa 31brjod nas/ de'i rjes la dam tshig sbyin par bya ste/ dkon mchog gsum ni yongs mi spangs na/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa rgyas par na rgyud las grub pa yin no / /mna' bsgag par 2 yang bya ste/ chos kyis 5rgyal po dam tshig che/ /nga las blangs snyunas 'ga' nyams na/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dag /gsang sngags spyod mchog spyod pa rnams/ /khrag chen dang ni snying chen kyang / /de tshe phyungs 5 nas gsol bar byed/ /chos kyis 8bstan pa skyong na byed pa/ /nga la khyod kyis brnyas )mi bya/ /rtag tu gos dmar bgo bya zhing / /phreng 1ba 81—115

dmar po bcing bar bya/ / mtshal gyi phye ma dag gam ni/1 /dmar po'i dris (nakyang byug bya /zhing / /rin chen dmar po sogs kyis brgyan(4ri/ /chags pa'i sems kyis bsgom 5bya zhing / /sngags kyang chags pa'i sems kyis 6bzla/ /btsag 7gam sin dhu ra dag gis/ /pho brang dag ni bri bar bya/ /mtshal 8gyi phye ma dag gam ni/ /gur gum 9dang ni tsan+dan dmar/ /byi 7ru'i phye ma dag kyang rung ske/ /kur ke ta yi 11phye mas bris/ /sbyin sreg cho1 yang na 'khor lo'o/ /rab tu gnas pa de bzhin te/ /kun kyang dmar ba'i rang bzhin sbyar/ /sangs rgyas ngur smrig 12mtshon byed yin/ /srog chags gsad par sami bya zhing / /bden pa min pa yang mi smra/ /ma byin pa g.yang blang mi bya/ /gzhan gyi chung ma bsten mi bya/ /lus kyi tshalas ni rnam gsum dang / /ngag gi 1 rnam pa bzhi dag dang ske/ /yid kyi rnam pa gang gsum pa'ihon/ /mi dge ba dag spang bar 19gyis/ /chos dang de bzhin zang zing stadang / /byams dang mi 'jigs zhes bya bzhi/ /sbyin pa khyod kyis rtag tu byin/ /med na bsam gtan las kyis 1so/ /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi dag kyang / /khyod kyis rtag tu bstan na par bya/ /pha rol phyin pa'i sku dag dang / /stobs rnams dang ni dbang dag dang / /bud med 'gro ba brnyas lhami bya/ /sgrol ma'i ming can khyad par du/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i khyim pas kyang / /bud med de ni blang 2 tshomi bya/ /grong khyer sgo dang grong dag dang ske/ /yul gang na ni sgrol 35ma ni/ /sgo stengs na bzhi mdo rtsig rna ngos dang / /sum mdo dag tu khyad par du/ /gnas pa'i gnas der rtag phyag bya/ /bstod cing mchod pa chen po bya/ /gnas der gnas pa byas nas ni / /sngags la sogs pa bsgrub par bya/ /sgrol ma'i ming can bud med gang / /kha dog dmar 81—116

ser mig legs 1tshom/ /de mthong rnal 'byor gus pa yis/ /yid kyis phyag ni bya ba yin/ /brtsa 2ze'u 'bru'i me tog dang / /de bzhin ka ra bī dar 'dzin/ /gzhan yang me tog dmar po la/ /sgrub 45pa pos ni 'gom mi bya/ /de ltar sdom pa byin pas ni/ /gtsang zhing dag pa'i lha rdzas 5chu/ /bum pa 76bzhi na gnas pa'i chus/ /slob ma sngags chus dag par bya / /slob dpon gyis ni rim pa bzhin / /mda' gzhu sogs kyi /phyag rgyas bkru/ /dang por 9mda' can bum pas te1 / /gnyis pa gzhu dang ldan pas so/ /gsum pa mi 'jigs pa lag ste11/ /ut+pal gyis ni bzhi par ro12/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas shākya yis/ /seng ge'i 1 sras bcas rdo rje 'dzin/ /rgyal srid chen por dbang bskur ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis khyod dbang bskur/ /khyod kyis sangs rgyas thams cad nyid//de nyid dkyil 'khor 'di ru rnyed/ /rdul tshon 1 'di gzigs sangs rgyas rnams//rab tu dgyes par gyur pa yin/ /'di ni 'chi med nad med kyang / /mya ngan med cing phongs 5pa med/ /theg cho17pa chen po gtsang ma 'dis/ /khyod kyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'thob17/ /mda' sogs bzhi yis 18dbang bskur bas/ /dam chos snod du byas nas ni/ /slob ma la ni gsang 19ba dag /cho ga bzhin du sbyin par bya/ /de la re zhig dang po klu la bsdigs 2 pa la bslab par bya'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya21/ na mo bud dha bo dhi/ sa twe bh+yaḥn na mo asba/ ma hā a lhanur+ya pra ka lā yo / na masaste bh+yo/ bud dha ko ṭi bh+yaḥ25tabya thā phyo/ oṃ hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥ sarba nā gā ṭ+wāṃ rna/ a nan+ta ku lā ṭ+wāṃ smyo/ bā su ki ku lā ṭ+wāṃ/ shaṃ ka pā la ku lā ṭ+wāṃ/ /rko ṭa ku lā ṭ+wāṃ / pad+ma ku lā dzā ’/ ku li ka ku lā ṭ+wāṃ/ mun+d+ra rī ka ku lā nī/ ga nā ka ku lā nī / me ka ku lā rmā/ dzā la dā ku lā nī/ dza la dha ra ku 81—117

lā ṭ+wāṃ/ brdzu 1mu 5)ta ku lā ṭ+wāṃ/ saṃ brta ku lā dzā(snen/ e sa brta ku lā rmābyuge/ ku mu dha ku lā 455/ ka ha ra ku lā ṭ+wāṃ/ sau gan dhi ku lā 46)/ ha na ha na sha re na57ril/ ban dha ban dha tsa bi na tā ḍa ya tā ḍa ya up+ta la ṭ+wāṃ/ birte (8nan/ a bha yā na/ de hi de nyi99)/ pra la ya1 sta/ ka le badz+ra la da ra/ ma bha ta ra yan/ba ra ṣa na ta nā gā 11na ba shi ku su1ge/ ku ru ku ru phuḥ/ 2 ku ru ba ya ku ru ba ya1mi / phuḥphuḥ/rim ku ru kul+le hrīḥtshes swā hā phaṭa/ sngags 'dis dgon pa'i lci ba las dkyil 'khor byas la/ cho 1 ga bzhin du tsan+dan gyis byug pa pad+ma 'dab ci shem brgyad pa bris la/ shar la sogs pa 'dab 〉kyim la dga' bo la sogs pa'i klu brgyad bzhag rin snanas/ sha kha 31ra dang gu gul gyisan / rgyu skar snar ma la bab pa'i tshe/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas/ klu rnams la bdug pa byin nas/ de nas mchod pa'o/ /gal te char 'bab nasapar mi 'gyur na/ chang gis khrus byas la / seng ldeng gi mes 2 gdung bar bya'o/ /de ltar byas na char 'bab par snye'agyur ro/ /gal te char 'bebs 5par mi na tshobyed na/ mdzes du nyethobs par 'gyur ro/ /rig pa 'dzin pa 'di 27dag bya ba'i zas dang ldan par bya ba yin no / /phyi nas nye bar bsdus la chu bo chen por dor bar bya'o/ /lha yang dus su char 'bebs 1shing / /lo thog da phun sum tshogs par shog /'jig rten mtha' dag skyid pa dang / /rgyal po chos dang ldan gyur cig nga /ces yongs su bsngo ba yang tshobya'o/ /char shin tu ches pa gcad dge'adod na/ sbrul 'dul ba'i ranyami las sbrul cig da blangs la/ tsan+dan ra gyis byugs nas 'o ma blud sa)par bya zhing /sngags 'di lan bdun bsngags par 1byas pa'i bum pa dmar po ma tshos 4 pa'i nang du bcug la/ phyag rgya chen pos rgyas nyabatab nas/ bum pa bcag 9par 81—118

gyur na/ de ma thag tu char pa gcod par byed do/ /phyi nas tshogs kyis 1ston mo bya/ /yang na nyan thos dge 'dun mchod/ /khye'u bu mor 2zas skom sbyin/ /de ltar byas na klu rnams dga'/ /char ni 'bab )par 'gyur 4ba'i tshe/ /gal te 'di ltar mi byed na/ /klu rnams dga' bar ma byas pas5/ /mdze yis thebs par 96)gyur pa yin/ /rgyal po'i 7/bu dang btsun mo'i 'khor dang bcas pa khrus byas la phyir bzlog 8pa'i tshes lnga la phyir bzlog 9)pa'i rtsa ba btsal 1 nas/'o ma'am/ yang na mar dang sbyar te/ dngul gyi 11snod du blugs la btung zhing dge slong la gsol bar byas na/ lo gcig gi bar du sbrul gyi 'jigs 12pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de la mi dge ba'i las kyis 1lhagal te sbrul gyis bzung 1 na / sbrul de nyid 'chi bar 'gyur te/ lan bdun mngon par bsngags pas 'grub bopar 'gyur ro/ /yang mdze tshand sos par 'dod na/ sngags 'di nyid kyis 51 dug med par byas nas/ zos na mdze 18nad sos par 'gyur ro/ /rtsa ba'i sngags kyis chu la bsngags 19la sbrul gyis bzung ba'i rma la bkrus na dug med par 'gyur ro/ /yang klu mthong bar 'dod na/ ut+pal dmar po'i 'dab 2 ma la/ yi ge'i grangs kyis na1'bum bzlas nas/ klu 22gnas shing byin gyis brlabs pa mtshe'u la sogs par btab na na/ de'i rjes la klu'i chung ma 'dar 2 bar 'gyur ro/ /sgrub 5pa po la kye na bcom ldan 'das ci zhig bgyi zhes bka' lung nod 2 par byed do/ /sngags 8pas kyang 'dod pa de blang bar 9bya'o/ /rtog pa bzhi pa'o// //de nas gzhon nu sgra gcan 'dzin bzang pos 1gang gi 2tshe bsod snyoms la 81—119

rgyal po'i khab tu zhugs 1nas yang 'od ma'i tshal du zhugs te/ lhung bzed bkru ba'i phyir rdzing bu ring por zhugs pa na/ grags du 'dzin ma'i bus (5)dge slong dkar po dang 'khrul nas rdzing bur drangs rigepa dang / de'i tshe gzhon nu sgra gcan 'dzin bzang pos rig pa 'di bzlas so/ /bzlas pa tsam gyis ji ltar 'ga' zhig rang gi khyim nas byung ba bzhin du/ sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po yang de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du song ngo / /nye bar song nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /yab lags khyed kyis bdag la gsang sngags gang stsal ba'i mthu de bdag 5)gis mthong tshormelags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang du mthong / klu rnams kyi 9)drung du'o/ /de lta bas na bcom ldan 'das srog chags gzhan dag srung 87ba'i slad du sngags 'di bcom ldan 'das kyis bstan du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe de'i dus su sngags 'di dang / rtog pa 'di lag na rdo rje la bskul 9tanas nyan thos rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang ske/ dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma rnams la 1 stabaka' drin gsal bar byas so/ /rigs kyi bu de'i phyir gsang sngags 'di dang / rtog pa 'di tsan+dan gyi dkyil 'khor byas nas/ klog par byed pa de'i lus la dug gi gnod pa mi 'byung —/ dug gis 'chi bar mi 'gyur/ shu ba'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung /g.yan 11pa'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung / mdze nad kyi 'jigs pa mi 'byung / nad kyi 'jigs pa mi 'byung / klu'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung / sbrul gyi 'jigs pa mi 'byung ske/ stag dang gcan gzan 12gyi 'jigs pa mi 'byung / mtshon gyi 'jigs pa mi 'byung 1ri/ dgra'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung / dbul ba'i 'jigs 81—120

pa mi 'byung / dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa hu)mi 'byung bar 'gyur ro//de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bstan pa srung ②ba'i phyir/ nag po chen po nyid kyi bsod snyoms kyis gsos pa'i srin mo'i 'phrog ma la byin no/ /de yang risasngon gyi las mi dge ba la skal ba ngan par gyur pas/ nag po chen po dang rjes su mthun sapa ma yin pas gnas par mi byed/ brtse bar mi byed/ bstan pa srung 5bar yang mi byed do/ /de nas srin mo de yi mug par (nyagyur pa dang / de la nag po chen po dbang du bya bar 'dod pas/ ku ru kul+le'i rtog pa 'di gsungs sol/ /de nas bzung nas skal ba (7)che zhing bzang ba dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu de'i phyir sems can dbang du bya bar 'dod pas gsang sngags 'di nyid dang ske/ rtog pa 'di nyid 98)la goms nyunyepar bya'o/ /gzhan yang shin tu dga' ba'i bu gzugs bzang zhing mdzes pa stobs che zhing mtshan dang ldan pa zhig skyes so/ /'on kyang blo rtul 1 snabar gyur to/ /de nas shin tu dga' bas bcom ldan 'das la zhu ba 2spezhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi bu gzugs bzang zhing mdzes pa stobs che zhing mtshan dang ldan pa zhig skyes par gyur na/'on kyang blo rtul 12bar gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das de ji ltar na de'i shes rab 'phel bar 'gyuranyusnye/ gal te bdag gi bu de'i 14yi ge dang bcas par gyur na/ de lta 8na khyod kyis bstan pa rjes su bsrung tshabar bgyi'o/ /de ltar gsan nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rmo snadran pa sngon du zhugs /snyenas rtog pa 'di dang gsang sngags 'di bka' stsal to/ /de bka' stsal gyis 36shin tu dga' ba'i bu gzhon nu snar ma zhes bya ba 'di shes rab dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /lo bcu gnyis kyis bstan bcos thams cad la )'jigs pa med pa dang / bzo'i gnas kyi thabs 81—121

༄ga /sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig gis bstod pa phan yon dang bcas pa 91༄zag / ngargya gar skad du/ na maḥtā rā 2ye ka dzi tsho sha ti sto ritra gu ṇa hi ta sā ka /bod skad du/ sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig gis nabastod pa phan yon dang bcas pa snyo/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo / /phyag 'tshal sgrol ma myur ma dpa' mo/ /spyan ni skad cig glog 7dang 'dra ma / /'jig rten gsum mgon chu skyes zhal gyi ri/ /ge sar phye ba 9las ni byung ma / /phyag 'tshal ston ku'i zla ba kun du/ /gang ba brgya ni brtsegs pa'i zhal ma / /skar ma stong phrag tshogs pa rnams kyis/ /rab tu phye ba'i 'od rab 'bar ma / /phyag 'tshal gser sngo chu nas skyes kyi / /pad+mas phyag ni rnam par brgyan 11ma / /sbyin pa brtson 'grus dka' thub zhi ba/ /bzod pa bsam gtan spyod yul nyid /rtam/ /phyag 'tshal de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor/ /mtha' yas rnam par rgyal bar spyod ma/ /ma lus pha rol phyin pa thob pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i sras 81—139

kyis shin tu bsten ma/ /phyag 'tshal tut+ta ra hūm̐ yi gi①/ /'dod dang phyogs dang nam mkha' gang ma/ /'jig rten bdun po zhabs kyis namanan te/ /lus pa med par 'gugs par nus ma/ /phyag 'tshal brgya byin me lha tshangs pa/ /rlung lha sna tshogs dbang phyug mchod ma/ /'byung po ro langs dri za rnams dang / /gnod sbyin tshogs kyis mdun 57nas bstod ma/ /phyag 'tshal trad tsho ces bya dang phaṭa kyis/ /pha rol 'khrul 'khor rab tu 'joms ma/ /g.yas bskum 9gegayon brkyang zhabs kyis 6mnan te/ /me 'bar 'khrugs pa 7 shin tu 'bar ma/ /phyag 'tshal tu re tshona'ajigs pa chen mo/ /bdud kyi dpa' bo rnam par tsho'oci'ajoms ma / /chu skyes zhal ni khro gnyer ldan mdzad/ /dgra bo thams cad ma lus gsod bom / /phyag 'tshal dkon mchog gsum mtshon phyag rgya'i/ /sor mos thugs kur rnam par brgyan 31ma/ /ma lus phyogs kyi 1 'khor los brgyan nya pa'i/ /rang gi 'od kyi tshogs rnams 'khrug ma/ /phyag 'tshal rab tu dga' ba brjid pa'i/ /dbu rgyan 1 'od kyi phreng ba 1gispel ma/ /bzhad 39pa rab bzhad tut+ta ra hu tshoyis/ /bdud dang 'jig rten dbang du mdzad ma/ /phyag 'tshal sa gzhi skyong ba'i tshogs rnams / /thams cad 'gugs par nus ma nyid ma/ /khro gnyer g.yo ba'i yi ge hūm̐ gis/ /phongs pa thams cad rnam par sgrol ma/ /phyag 'tshal zla ba'i rtse mos dbu brgyan1 / /brgyan pa thams cad shin tu 'bar ma/ /ral pa'i khrod 37na 'od dpag med las/ /rtag par shin tu 'od ni mdzad ma/ /phyag 'tshal bskal pa tha ma'i me ltar/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba'i dbus na gnas ma/ /g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum 1kun nas bskor dgas/ /dgra yi nadapung ni rnam par 'joms ma/ /phyag 'tshal sa gzhi'i ngos la phyag gi/ /mthil gyis bsnun 81wa 140

cirngo zhabs kyis brdung tsho1ma/ /khro gnyer can mdzad yi ge rtsu gis / /rim pa bdun po rnams ni 'gems ma/ /phyag 'tshal bde ma dge ma zhi ma/ /mya ngan 'das zhi tsho0spyod yul nyid ma/ /swā hā oṃ dang yang dag ldan pas/ /sdig pa chen po 'joms pa nyid ma/ /phyag 'tshal kun nas bskor rab dga' ba'i/ /dgra yi 0rilus ni dun)rab tu 'gems tshim/ /yi ge bcu pa'i ngag ni bkod pa'i / /rig pa rtsu las sgron rin)ma nyid ma/ /phyag 'tshal tu re'i zhabs ni brdabs 9pas /hūṃ gi nyu 7rnam pa'i sa bon nyid ma/ /ri rab man dā ra dang 'bigs byed/ /'jig rten gsum rnams g.yo ba nyid ma/ /phyag 'tshal lha yi mtsho yi rnam pa'i11//ri dgas nyu rtags can phyag na bsnams ma/ /tā 15ra gnyis brjod phaṭa kyi yi shesal / /dug rnams ma lus par ni sel ma/ /phyag 'tshal lha yi 15tshogs rnams rgyal po/ /lha dang mi 'am ci yis 17bsten ma/ /kun nas go cha dga' ba'i brjid kyis/ /rtsod dang rmi lam ngan pa sel ma/ /phyag 'tshal nyi ma zla ba rgyas pa'inye ske/ /spyan gnyis po la 'od rab gsal ma/ /ha ra gnyis brjod tut+ta 1 ra yisal/ /shin tu drag po'i rims ni tu sel ma/ /phyag 'tshal de nyid gsum rnams bkod pa'i dī/ /zhi ba'i mthu dang yang dag ldan ma/ /gdon dang ro langs gnod sbyin tshogs rnams/ /'joms pa 1tu re rab mchog nyid ma/ /rtsa ba'i sngags kyis na bstod pa 'di dang / /phyag 'tshal ba ni nyi shu rtsa gcig /lha mo la gus yang dag ldan pa'i na/ /blo ldan gang gis rab tu brjod pas / /srod dang tho rangs langs par byas nas/ /dran pas mi 'jigs thams cad rab ster lha / /sdig pa thams cad rab tu zhi ba/ /ngan 'gro thams cad 'joms pa nyid do/ /rgyal ba bye ba phrag bdun rnams kyis/ /myur du dbang ni bskur bar 81wa 141

ltar lam dang ldan pa bskyed 17pa'i rim pa'o/ /lha mos gsol pa/ kye bcom ldan 'das dgos pa gang gis rdo rje sems dpa' bskyed pa yin/ de ltar na so so'i bum pa la dgos pa ci yod/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ skyes pa la ni dngos med bkag pa ste/ rdo rje nam mkha' yin pa'o/ /nges par bdag med pa yin zhing / bde ba skad cig ma'o/ /ji ltar tshogs pa ma lus pa dang ske/ grong khyer ba de ltar skyes pa la stobs kyis 'gog pa yis bde ba rgyas pa 'ching kyeb med na ji ltar skye/ lha mos gsol pa/ kye bcom ldan 'das lus bstan pa'i dgos pa gang lags/ lam la khrag dang byang chub kyi gsems 'dus pa las gzugs brnyan gyis (༄grol ba las med dam/ 'bras bu ster ram lta ba'i don du 'dod chags kyi phyir rab tu sbyor bar brjod dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lus rdo rje zhes brjod pa'o/ /ji ltar sgyu mar sems pas 5cin ra dang sbyor ba bzhin no/ /lam 'dus pa las khrag go zhes pa ni/ la la nā dang ra sa nā dang a ba dhū tī rnams kyis 6phung po lnga la rnam par spyad pa yis thabs cig (7)tu mnyam par gang gis shes pa'i che'i rdo rje la de'i lam 'dus pa las khrag ces brjod do/ /rab tu sbyor ba'i lus zhes brjod pa de ni ri8rnam par spyad pa mi bzod pa gang 'dod pa de rab tu sbyor ba'i lus so/ /rab tu sbyor bas rmongs pa'i phyir rab tu sbyor ba byas pa zhes brjod do/ /lha mos gsol pa/chos gang lags/ chos kyi tshogs pa'i gtam brjod pa gang lags/ mi rnams kyi bde ba 79)phun sum tshogs par bya ba'i phyir ram/ don thob par bya ba'i phyir ram / nad med par 'dod pa'i 'bras bu thob par bya ba'i phyir yin/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mir skyes pa'i tshesems can chos 17ji ltar 81—155

spyad 1 na tshegs 2med par de'i dngos grub ji lta cibar brjod par bya'o/ /dngos grub chen po brgyad rnams ni ral gri dang mig sman dang ril bu 94nodang rkang mgyogs ra kyi dngos grub dang / grub pa'i sman dang / sngags rnams la nges par dngul chu dang bcud len te/ dngos grub chen po brgyad thob nas dngos grub gzhan brtags na ji lta 6bar sems can nag po chen po'i rgyud pa rnams kyis 'grub bo/ /'dir tshogs pa med par (7ringes pa'o/ /lha mos gsol pa/mig sman dngos grub 'di las 'jug pa la bcing bya bcing byed ji ltar phra bar brjod / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ legs par bsrung 98)ba dang mig 9pa'i sgra ltar brlag pa ji lta bar sbas pa de'i sdom pa rgyas par brjod do/ /lha mos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje'i lus la rtsa du lags/ dbugs 'gro 'ong dang skad cig ma 3 du lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rtsa rnams ni sum cu rtsa nye1gnyis so/ /dbugs 'gro 'ong ni yongs su bcing ba dang ske/ lus las skyes pa'i 12dbugs phyir 'thon pa ni zla ba dang nyi ma dag gis bskyod pa'o/ /grangs kyi bye brag brjod pa ni drug brgya lhag pa'i stong phrag nyi shu rtsa gcig gis 'gro 'ong ngo / /de las 'gro ba dang 'ong ba skad cig 1snyego/ /lha mos gsol pa/ kye bcom ldan 'das ji ltar 'dod pa'i lha yis k+ṣarab tu gsal bar gang mdzad/ 'dod pa sgrub 15pa khyab 'jug gis kyang sgyu mas sprul pa byas pa bzhin lak+ṣa me 17dang dbyangs can ma dag gi 91 7phyir/ dbul po rnams la mun pa dag 1 dang bral ba ltar zhing skyong bas na 17sbyor ba bsgo ba byas pa yin nam/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kye lha mo 'dzam bu'i 21gling ba'i sems can rnams 'khor ba na 'khor zhing yod pa de rmongs pa dang / 'dod chags 81—156

mnga' bdag gis sems rab tu brtags pa med pa/ / be+e tā li'i 1)gzugs kyis yang dag par bsgrubs kyang mi skye'o/ /rigs lnga la spyad pa yis ji ltar gsungs pa'i las de ltar 'grub bo/ /gzhan dang gzhan du bgrod pa ni tshes kyi bye brag bzang po la ma byung ba 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i don du'o/ /nges par gang dang gang thob par byed par 'gyur te/ rnam grangs kyi 9kye'abras bu de rnams sol/ /dpal nag po chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las de kho na shes par byed pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// //thab khung gi rnam pa'i le'u bshad par bya ste/ lha mos gsol pa/ kye rje btsun sems can gyi phyir dngos grub brgyad kyi bya ba de'i don du sdug bsngal med par byed pa gang gis nye bar 'thob/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/zla ba rgyu ba'i dus su dbugs phyir rgyu ba bzung ste gnas pas (banges par dngos grub chen po brgyad 'grub bo/ /gang gi tshe yongs su smin par 'dod pas 'di byas na 'grub bo/ / gsad pa la (4)thab khung gru bzhi pa rgyar khru gang par me tog nag pos sbyin bsreg tshorabya'o/ /rengs pa la zlum po rgyar (7khru do pa'o97na/ /dbang du bya ba la gru gsum rgyar khru gang pa/ sa risasbyang ba khru gang brkos la bya ste9ra/me tog dmar pos sbyin bsreg ribobya ba ni blo gros can gyis 3)dom gyi pags 1 pa la bsdad la 'di bya'o/ /rkang byug sgrub pa'i don du sbyin sreg nyi gi thab khung gi mtshan nyid brjod pa zlum po khru gang pa las sbyang ba ni khru lnga brkos la bya'o/ /mig sman don du sbyin sreg 8'dir brjod pa/ sbrul gyi mgo lta bu khru phyed dang do pa las masbyang ba khru bdun brkos pa ni tsomig sman gyi thab khung ngo / /'dir ril 81—158

bu'i (1)bstan pa ni glang po che'i mig pa (5)tsam pa la/ sa sbyang ba khru bcu brkos pa 'di ril bu'i (gethab khung ngo / /bcud len gyi don du thab kyi dbyibs rna rgyan lta bu rdo khru byed dang gnyis pa la/ sa sbyang ba (5khru gsum brkos (6)pa ni bcud len gyi thab khung ngo / /rgyal po'i don du thab khung khru gang ba yin te/ dbyibs zlum po'o / /sa sbyang ba la khru brgyad brkos pa ni dngos grub sgrub pa'i don du ste/sbyor ba 'di yis dngos grub nges pa'o/ /'dir brjod pa thams cad me tog dkar pos sbyin bsreg ri7)byas na dngos grub thams cad kyi 'bras bu nye bar 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /nag po chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las thab khung gi rnam pa bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste rinariganyis pa'o// //de nas sngags kyi le'u bshad par bya ste/ sngags kyi bye (9brag gnyis las zhi ba'i sngags kyi rim pa ni oṃ yig gi ming gis rgyud 'dir shes te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa skyob 7pa zhi ba la dga' ba'i hunyesngags so/ /sangs rgyas kyi dam bca' byas pa de'i phyir ye shes chen po'i sngags brjod pa'o/ /oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ phyag gnyis pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ dz+rī dz+rī nya rtsu hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ phyag bzhi pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ ma hā hai ra ba sarba sidhi/ dā ya ka ḍi hūṃ rku kyi lha ṭaḥ/phyag drug pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ āḥ/ phaṭa hrīḥhaḥthu/ phyag brgyad pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ tī kai pas tī la tī la ri ma hā nā dā kā rā 17la bi ka rā laspyi shrī haḥ42/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ sidhi dā kā ya nyu6swā hā/ phyag bcu pa'i sngags so/ / oṃ rda zlo ta ka ṭa hai ra bā ya saṃ saṃ saṃ ru ru ru ru rtsu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ phyag bcu gnyis pa'i sngags te las thams cad byed pa dang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis 81—159

phyag byed pa dang / 'jig rten gsum 'grub pa dang / gang 'dod pa byed par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ ya ma dza ga ta 7khyo bha yak+ṣi bha ya/ tā la pa ( tā la khā hi khā nyi / groṇ+ḍa 45)ba li gra hāḥgra hāḥ( kyi/ oṃ mi rtsa ma hā r+bha ra (lde)bā ya swā hā/ dngos grub thams cad kyi don du phyag bcu bzhi pa'i sngags 'dis gtor ma rgyun du sbyin no phyi / /oṃ mi mi ro hūm̐ rtsu me rak+ṣa pā lā tsoya rtsu badz+ra phaṭa/ bdag srung (8)ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ dha ra ṇi dha ra dha ra hūm̐ hūm̐ a mu ka yo)su rak+ṣu 7ku ru swā hā/ gzhan srung 11ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ hu yo yaṃ ka rā la/ bi rā lā yonak+ṣa baṃ chibaka rā mal ma hā yo ge shwa ra sarba dā ya ka swā hā/ phyag bcu drug pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ shrī ṭī groṇ+ḍa tsheb li ( hūṃ phaṭa/ ma bya rmā 8sa put+pa dhū lho)pa/ rak+ta ta la pā ta so )le aṣ+ṭa hunyenā ga de wa 2yak+ṣa rāk+ṣa sa grosna — yi rda ba lo shu sehā hā hā/ hūṃ khā hi khā hi/ kha kha hūṃ dzaḥ gedze dze haṃ haṃ ma hā ḍa dha ra 9 stohā sa gadz+dza gardzo/ kroṇ+ḍa ba: 2 snaye he rtsu swā hā/ sran ma chen po legs par btsos phyopa dang / chang dang /0 sha so )dang / khrag gis legs par bkang rimal/ de nas mtshan mo rgyun du gtor ma sbyin pa ste/ zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig na dge ba'i mtshan ma 'byung ngo / /zla ba gcig na dngos grub ster te / lo gcig na gang 'dod pa ster ro/ /oṃ hrī dz+rī rtsu phaṭa/ 'di ni sngags kyi rgyal po sngags bklags ni pa tsam gyis sdig pa thams cad zad par 'gyur zhing rgyun du bzlas na dngos grub thams cad 'grub bo/ / sgyid snyoms zhunyedang bcas par stong phrag lnga bzlas na zhi ba nges par 'grub bo/ /khri phrag gcig bzlas na bud med dbang du 'gyur ro/ /'bum gyis rgyal po dbang du 'gyur ro/ /'bum phrag lnga yis lha dang gnod sbyin thams cad nges par dbang du 'gyur ro/ /nges par 'gugs par yang zhunyebyed na skyes pa ginyedang bud med lta smos ci 'tshal/81—160

dbang du bya ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ ma hā kā la nye rtsu hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ spyi'i sngags so/ /oṃ ma hā nan+de 2sha ra r+ghaṃ phaṭa swā hā / me'i kha dog kha la bsgoms na 'chi'o / /oṃ sa shrī ho k+ṣaḥde ba dalta māṃ yaṃ mā nanor ya phaṭa/ gsad pa'i 5sngags sol/ /oṃ ṭī he rtsa (6ha tsho te shwa rī rtsu shrī naswā hā/ gtum pa'i dbang phyug ma'i sngags sol/ /oṃ lā ke (9)ku li ke shwa rī 1 he dze swā hā/ rigs kyi dbang phyug ma'i sngags sol/ /oṃ māṃ ma (11he shwa rī 12rdu shrī ho dze/ dbang phyug ma 1 chen mo'i sngags so/ /oṃ ki li bi ka rā bol shrīḥk+ṣi be〉 hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ dus can ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ rtsa tsachu ya tsamu miya r+ghaṃ hrīḥtsartsi kā'i nya sngags so/ /oṃ tsa muṇ+ḍi12/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ i 37de ba lo groṇ+ḍa groṇ+ḍi 2 )rgyu dze ho phaṭa 21swā hā/ lha mo dum bu can gyi gtor ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ hrī hāḥrgyu shrī phaṭa swā hā/ lha mo u mā'i 35sngags so/ /oṃ āḥrgyu/ lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlabs tsho lhapa'i sngags so/ / oṃ rgyuḥk+ṣi shrī du —)o r+ghaṃ de ba dat+ta hi mā ra ya mā ra 2snyeya rtsu phaṭa/ thams cad gsad pa'i tsisngags so/ / oṃ k+ṣi ha tsā / che ge mo utsā ṭa na ya rtsu phaṭa/ bskrad pa'i sngags sol/ /oṃ (7mi rdza k+ṣe/ dgra rengs par byed pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ rdza ra t+t+waṃ ha sti s+t+waṃ bha gilhaya phaṭa/ byi ba'i mjug rnam la lan bdun du bsngags sate/ brgyab na glang po che rengs pa'o/ /oṃ khaḥhaḥphaṭa lha/ gho ṭa /sto 3bha rna zhes pas ba lang gi sha la bsngags sdo te brgyab dasnyen rta rengs par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ muḥ tsā sarba pā shu na sti bhā ya mo hā rik+taya hūm̐ phaṭa/ stag gi pags pa snal lan bdun bsngags 1nas brgyab 42na ma te dang / khyi dang / glang po che dang / ba lang dadang /ce (stespyang dang / stag dang / dom rnams nges par rengs par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ ma hā rna ta 4ge haḥ45dngul la lan bdun bzlas nas sbrul la brgyab na sbrul 81—161

rengs par bya ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ mu khaṃ s+t+waṃ bha 91)ya che ge mo'i baṃ phaṭa/ mi'i ngag rengs par bya ba la'o/ /oṃ hrīḥ mi ro tsa muṇ+ḍa dkyihaḥshrī hūṃ phaṭa/ ral gri la sogs pa rengs par bya ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ ma hi la la gi la la bhi la la ha hoḥcho du long pa rengs par byed pa'o/ /oṃ r+ghaṃ rtsu/ bud med rmongs par byed pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ haḥka ha ka ha ma 5li ni mu khe/ pra sā dha ya/ pra sā tsidha ya/ma hā kā 7la bud dha ā+oṃ/ pra hi to si/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ kā ra ya kā ra ya/sarba du/ pra du/ 5ṇ+ḍi shrīṇ+ḍi/ ma ra ma ra cizhi/ kha kha khā hi khā nyi/ shī s+t+waṃ 99skud ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ hū re hū re/ me raṃ bos phaṭa/ i rda ba li gra ha gra ha/shrī swā hā/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bya ba ma yin pa byed pa'i mi rtsod pa dang rab tu rtsod pa dgaci11 /sngags 'dis 12mi'i thod pa bza' kyi rgyus bkang la nag po'i tshes brgyad la gtor ma sbyin no/ /skad cig de nyid la 'chi'o 7rims kyis thebs par 'gyur ro/ /me yis rab tu 'tshig par 'gyur ro/ /mgo 'gems 8par 'gyur ro/ /gtor ma chen po'i sngags te dgra gnon pa'o/ /oṃ tsa muṇ+ḍisko/ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ gsad pa'i 3 sngags so/ /oṃ rtsu māṃ mi mā ra ya swā hā/ dgra gsad pa'i 1 sngags so/ /rgyu phaṭa/ a tha bha ga bān bo nyu9snyi satā na ma hā satā 1ma hā kā ru ṇi kā/ tabya thā/ oṃ kā rā la bi ka ṭi shwa ra/ hū lu hū lu/ ki li ki 22li/ ma hā rka kā tsho lhal ha la/ ā+oṃ shrī rba rtsa 25me haṃ rgyu/ma hā rna 27de shwa rā 7ya swā hā/ sngags 'di nyi ma re re la lan bdun bdun du bzlas la gdong ba bkrus na skye bo thams cad kyi 8yid du 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /dgra thams cad nges par zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /bya ba thams cad sgrub par 'dod pa de la nyis 'gyur 9du ster bar byed do/ /sgrub pa thams cad la cher dga' 81—162

ba'i gzugs nag po chen po'i sngags so/ /oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ 1phaṭa swā hā/las tshogs thams cad bsgrubs 2)pas 'bras bu 'byung bar byed pa dpal mgon po nag po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las sngags kyi le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de nas dbang gi le'u bshad par bya ste/ dang por nag po chen po phyag gnyis pa'i sngags stong phrag bcu bzlas la slob ma la dbang bskur te/ thog mar bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thub pa ( dril bu'i sgra dang / rdo rje'i sbyor ba dang ldan pas chu la sogs pa dbang lnga rnams kyi bye brag gis so/ /drug pa la rdo rje'i rim pa rnams kyis dang / bdun pa'i dbang bskur ba'i bye brag ni ji lta bar 4shes rab dang mnyam par sbyor ba'o/ /brgyad pa zhes pa ni 'di la rnal 'byor mas yongs su 'khyud pa'o/ /dgu pa la skyes bu nyid la rjes su 95)skye ba'o/ /bcu pa la nam mkha'i chu rnams kyis so/ /bcu gcig pa rnams kyis kyang rim pas yang dag pa'i rig pas bsgrubs (6 pas/ gnas dang gnas su rjes su 'byung ba thub pa ka pi la baṇ+ḍi ④shi ba ji lta bar 8rim pas zhi ba'i (9)ye shes sgrub pa 'di gsang la spyad par bya ba bdud rtsi lnga dang shes rab ma 'di rnams kyis so/ /ma dang /sring bomo dang / bya rog rkang ma dang / mi thung ma dang / sgur mo rnams dang yang dag par sbyor bar 37bya ba dang / ji ltar bka' stsal pa ltar ming thams cad yang dag par bzung 32ngo / /de ltar byas na mnga' bdag las dbang bskur ji lta ba bzhin nye bar 'gyur ro/ /bla mas slob ma brtags la sbyin par bya'o / /mnga' bdag khyod thabs dang ldan pas/ bdag nyid chen po bdag cag gis ming thams cad spyad pas sems can gyi sdug bsngal spong ba 12ji lta ba'i 81—163

lam gsungs pa zhig bcom ldan 'das skye bo rnams kyi don du gang yin pa de dbang gi don bye brag gi rim pa las ji lta bar shes par mdzod cig /dus dang tshod ji lta bar shes pa las so/ /dpal nag po chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las dbang gi rim par phye ba ste le'u bzhi pa'o// //de nas yang lha rnams dbang bskur 1ba bshad par bya ste/ dang por 2lha mo la sogs pa rnams kyis bum pa'i dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /lha mo brgyad rnams kyis ni bdud rtsis so/ /mchod yon dang zhabs bsil byin nas bstod pa dang /sngags kyis byin gyis brlab (ge pa ni/ oṃ ka la sha a bhi nā 4ya rna rtswa gerna/ oṃ shu n+ya tā a dhiṣ+ṭha te swā hā/ chu'i dbang bskur ba byin pa dang / bdud rtsi lnga byin pa ni lha mo rnams kyis pha rol tu kyi phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /lha mo rnams kyis me tog gi char 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /gla rtsi dang dri zhim po yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /sred med kyi bu la sogs pas 7byin gyis rlob par 'gyur ro/ /lha thams cad kyi dam tshig gis ri skyong zhing srog la bab kyang gtong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /'di ni nag po chen po'i rgyud las lha dbang bskur ba'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de nas yang rdo rje 'byung mo la sogs pa'i lha mo gtsor gyur pa rnams the tshom 9skyes te yid mi bde bar gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das la thams cad kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /kye bcom ldan 'das the tshom 7'di rnams bsal du gsol / /'di ltar le'u 'dir bshad pa'i gar gyi nyams dgu dang / glu nya7yis 81—164

grub par 'gyur ba de bdag the tshom 1mchis na/ glu dang gar gyis 5don ji ltar du 'gyur ba lags/ lha la dbang bskur ba nye bar spyod pa ji ltar 'gyur ba lags / zhe sdang la sogs pa'i phyag rgyas ji ltar rgyas mod 'debs par 'gyur ba lags / sa bon thams cad sngags kyi le'u las brjod pa ji ltar lags/ lha mo'i tsho kyis bon la the tshom 95skyes pa gang lags/ gzugs can gyi sa bon gyi mthu gang lags/ kye 96bcom ldan 'das dam tshig can rnams kyi tsho7)spyod pa gang lags / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ a nako yi gha ṇa pi ṭa ṭa yi ra hā hā kā re 9ma hā kā tshol/ uts+tsha la ya yi rkak+ko le gha ṇa 11ḍa ma ru 512badz+ra dzi yā 1 yi / kā ru ṇi yā 1geyi/ na ro li yā yi15/ ta ho ma 15tā māṃ 17sa ni ba bha re khā nyi yā yi18/ pi ba yi ma ya ṇa ghaṇ+ḍi19/ ha re kā li dz+nyā dza ra pa yi sa yi bā yi yā 21yi / rdu du 32ta ra mā ga pa i paste/ ka stu ra kā ta tha ri sih+la tsa 2 u sa ma lā gā bi yā yi/ si li ni/ 2 bha ra māṃ sa kri ta hi la hi yā yi lha/ nā ṭi gī tai 27ye ko na mu yi/ lī lā na bha ra ṇa mā lā gha 2 ri yā 29yi/ ta ho tsho pa ṇi yā yi/sa ri hā gā thi ṇa kun du ru pa yi yā lhayi/ ḍā ma ru nā da uts+tsha li yā lhayi/ gar ni dpal nag po chen po'i rnal 'byor gyis 'ji ltar bde ba'i sbyor bas skya rengs 7shar ba dang / bsam gtan la chags pa'i sems kyis so/ /goms pa'i rigs pa'i sems ni sangs rgyas 9thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid kyi rnal 'byor gyi ma rnams la'o/ /gzhan du ni ma yin no/ /gar dang glu 'di dag gis mchog tu bde ba 1skye bar 'gyur ro/ /'di nyid kyis bdag srung 2ba dang / tshogs srung nab dang / bdud rtsi lnga dang mchog tu dga' ba'i dbang du gyur pa'i sngags bzlas pa 'dis 'jig rten du tshegs med par bya ba byed pa de'i phyir 81—165

dngos grub rtag tu blang bar bya'o/ /bar du gar yang bya'o/ /yang yang du tshogs kyi bdag po de nyid la dang por bya rgod kyi dri dang / gnyis pa dpal sred med kyi bu'i dri 1)sna'i nye 5)bar dmigs par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa gla rtsi'i dri dang ske/ gur gum na la sogs pa'i dri sna tshogs mnyam par longs spyod par 'gyur ro ske/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi sa'o/ /de'i rjes la glu byin gyis brlabs pas bung ba'i sgra nyan pa dang / ngang pa dang / khu byug dang / go mā yu dang ske/ gal te gar byed na thams cad dang sgra bzhin no/ /de nas klu'i tshogs byin gyis brlab pa ni/ phyi'i gemi 'am ci 56dang / sred med kyi bu la sogs pa dag tshig 7rnams kun du spyad par bya'o/ /grong khyer gyi mtha' 'am/ skyed spri mos tshal lam/ nags tshal du nges par mtshon par bya'o/ /phyag rgya thams cad kyi nges par dngos grub tu 'gyur ro/ /lha mos gsol pa/ kye 497bcom ldan 'das 'dzam bu'i gling pa'i sems can gyi don byed par 'dod pa dang / bcud len byed par 'dod pa rnams de bzhin du dbang la sogs pa de rnams kyi thabs kyis 1 ji ltar 'byung ba bstan du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/lha mo rnams kyi 11phyag rgya bzhi ji lta bar shes par bya'o/ /de'i rjes su thams cad ston gyis12/ yang lha mos gsol pa/ rim pa rnams ji ltar yid ches par bshad par byed/ bcom ldan 'das sems can rnams kyis don thob par bya ba'i phyir yin nam/ lha mo ngas 12le'u brgyad pa la sogs pa 1 bshad par bya'o/ /rigs rnam pa lnga la bzhugs nas gang nyi ma re re de'i 'bras bu dngos grub nges par 'thob 15par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni nag po chen tshepo'i rgyud las spyod pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //81—166

de nas thog mar nye bar mkho ba'i mchod pa dang / sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgoms nas lhag ma nyid/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma ko3 1)rta byas nas sgyu ma'i spyod pa thams cad sbyangs nas/nag po chen po zhal gsum pa/ dbu skra ser po 'bar ba gyen du brjes pa/ skra dang smin ma 'bar ba/ mche ba gtsigs shing rgod 90pas 'jigs par mdzad pa/shin tu 'jigs pa'i zhal dang po gnag pa/ g.yon dkar po/ g.yas kyi zhal ljang gu(gyi/ stag gi pags (4 pa gos su gyon pa/ mi'i mgo bo'i phreng bas nye bar 'phyang ba/ thung zhing gsus pa 'phyang ba/ klu brgyad kyi rgyan gyi rigadengs kus brgyan 6)pa'o/ /phyag brgyad pa g.yas g.yon gyi dang po gnyis kyis lha mo la 'khyud pa/ gnyis pa gri gug /gsum pa rdo rje/ bzhi pa ḍā 7ma ru/ phyag g.yon na khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa/ gsum pa na dril bu/ bzhi pa na tho ba/ro la zhon pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang bas gnas pa/ rnal 'byor ma bzhis yongs su bskor ba/ shar phyogs kyi 8snam bu la tsaṇ+ḍi swa ri9ri phyag na gri gug dang thod pa bsnams 0pa/ kha dog dkar mo 511spa grol ba/ mche ba gtsigs 515shing 'jigs par mdzad pa/ lho'i 1 snam bu la tsartsi kā kha dog nag mo51 / gcer bu skra sil bu/ lag pas gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang bas gnas pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa 15la sogs pa 'jigs 15par byed pa'o/ /nub kyi 'phar (1 tshom la kā li kā cho1 kha dog nag po mdung rtse gsum pa dang 19thod pa bsnams pa/ skra sil bu/ thams cad snga ma smos pa bzhin no/ /byang du rigs kyi dbang phyug ma lag pa gyen du brkyang ste/ g.yon pa na thod pa kha dog 81—167

ljang gu 1/ lhag ma thams cad snga ma bzhin no/ /lha mo thams cad spyan gsum pa / lha mo bzhis yongs su bskor ba'i bcom ldan 'das lha mo la 'khyud pa/lhan cig skyes pa'i kha sbyor la mngon par gnas pa/ sbyor ba de dag spyod pa'i rnal 'byor gyis phyag brgyad pa bzhengs (sapa'o/ /dang po hūṃ las 'od byung bas ②khams gsum tsho rin gnas pa'i lha dang / bla ma dang / sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams spyan drangs la/ oṃ shu n+ya tā ⑤la sogs pas kyi'agro ba thams cad rang bzhin med par bsgoms nas r+ghaṃ gi sa bon las 'od zer byung nas des bkug pa'o/ /phyi nas 7lerdo rje dra ba rnam par bsgom par bya'o/ /rtag tu rnal 'byor pa zhal bzhi pa/ dang po nag po/ g.yas pa dmar po/ g.yon pa dkar po/ rgyab phag gi gdong pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ g.yon brkyang bas gnas pa/ kha dog nag po/ gsus pa 'phyang ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum pa/ dbu skra gyen du brjes pa/ ag tshom (8༄'bar ba/ lhag ma snga ma bzhin no/ /phyag bcu gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas g.yon dang po gnyis kyis lha mo la 'khyud pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi tshoḍa)mche bas lha mo'i mchu btsir ba/ g.yon gnyis pa na rnga ma dkar po/ gsum pa na rtse gsum pabo/ bzhi pa na thod pa / lnga pa na glang po che'i pags mapa dang / drug pa na log 'dren gyi mche ba/g.yas kyi gnyis pa na gri gug /gsum pa na 8rdo rje rtse gcig pa/ bzhi pa na tho ba / lnga pa na glang po che'i pags nya2pa/ drug pa na rdo rje/ ma ho la zhon pa/bdud thams cad zhabs kyis mnan pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ khrag 'dzag pa/zhal kha sbyor du byed pas gnas pa/ lhag ma snga ma bobazhin no/ /rnal 'byor ma bzhis yongs su bskor ba/ glu'i gemachod pa nye bar longs spyod pa rnams dang /81—168

dze gyi ①sgra chen po sgrogs pa(kye/ gad mo chen po rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung ba'i lha mchog tu dga' ba'i rang bzhin can gyi tī li tī la'i (bsgra dang ldan pa/ 'jig rten pa rab tu zhi ba'i don du 'gro ba 'di rnams dga' ba chen po'i rim pa'i mgon po ni hi li tī 0li'i sngags kyi phreng ba dang ldan pa'o/ /bud dha'i bstan pa dang ldan pa/ phyag bzhi pa bzhengs rdogepa bshad pa ni bcom ldan 'das kyis dngos grub thams cad kyi don dang / bgegs nye bar zhi bar byed pa la zhal gcig 0phyag bzhi pa/ sku mdog nag po/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs medashing 'jigs par byed pa/ lto 'phyang ba/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du brjes pa/ ag tshom kham na)ser/ klu brgyad kyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/rgyab stag la snyes khapa/ r+ghaṃ las bskyed 6pa phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas na rtse gsum dang tho ba/ g.yon na gri gug dang thod pa/ dze gyi nyanasgra 'byin pa/ phyogs lhanaganyis su rnal 'byor ma na gnyis gnas pa bsgom par bya'o/ /bgegs thams cad zhi bar bya ba'i don du phyag drug pa bzhengs pa bshad pa/ gsum pa mchog tu dga' ba'i rang bzhin can/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la nye bar phan par byed pa'i/ sdig pa la sogs pa yongs su spong ba/ dang po stong pa nyid la sogs pa yongs su bsgoms nas rnal 'byor pas dang por rdo rje gur gyi sbyor ba bya'o / /de dang dus mnyam du shehrīḥ'i sa bon las langs pa'i lha'o/ /seng ge'i steng na gnas pa/ zhal gsum pa/ dang po sprin nag po'i mdog /g.yas dkar la g.yon ljang ba/ mi brtan tshepa'i yan lag can/ mche ba gtsigs nya shing 'jigs pa/ skra dmar po gyen du brjes pa/ spyan gsum pa/ klu brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas na gri gug tho ba ḍā rtsonam ru/ g.yon na thod pa rtse gsum 81—169

ral gri/ gtum pa'i dbang phyug ma dang / ka ling ka 3)dang / rigs kyi dbang phyug ma dang / tsartsi kā rdo bzhi rnams kyis bskor ba ni kha sbyor gyi rnal 'byor gyis (ldetshoganas pa/ lha mo bzhir gnas pa thams cad kyis yang dag par bskul nas langs pa/ 'byung ba lnga las yang dag par bzhengs pa/ thams cad kyi cigaming gis bskor ba/ lha mos gsol pa/ kye (5)bcom ldan 'das rang gi lha'i gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i dngos grub kyi mtshan nyid ji ltar shes/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa/ lha mo u mā'i ༅rnal 'byor gyi bdag nyid dang /dpal nag po chen po'i skye bo la sogs pa'i don du skad cig dang cig (7༄shos gzhan dang gzhan 8)du gang bkag pa de la dngos grub mi 'jug (94)go/ /dang po goms pa'i dus su dngos grub kyi mchog gi gnas brtag par bya ste/ gang du grub pa'i gnas de'am/ sngags pa rang gi khyim mama'i/ thang stong ngam/ phyi rol bla gab med pa'am/ dben pa'i phyogs sam/ der mnyam par gzhag rtsomaste/khang stong du rtag tu bsgom 1snyepar bya'o/ /phyag bcu drug pa/ rnal 'byor ma brgyad kyis bskor ba/ yang dag par ldan pa de'i 'khor rnams sred med kyi bu la sogs pas kyang yongs su gang ba bsgom par bya'o/ /dngos grub bsgrub 3nyepa zhes ngas bsam par bya'o/ /rigs lnga la bzhugs pa/ shes rab kyis kyang mnyam par sbyor ba'o/ /rnal 'byor pas rtag tu bza' ba ni sha chen nam/ ba lang dang / khyi dang / mi la sogs pa sha lnga dang / bdud rtsi lnga rnams rtag tu bza' bar bya'o/ /'dir dngos grub 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis dngos grub sgrub bobo/ /gang rigs lnga la gnas pas ba 8ser skya'i sha bza' bar bya'o/ /de nas bdag gi sems kyis nag po chen po bsgom par bya'o/ /81—170

rnal 'byor pas phyag bcu drug pa/ rtag tu de nyid kyis byed pa brjod par bya'o//gang dang gang du phyag gnyis pa bsgoms pas dngos grub thams cad bsgrub ti pa'i don no/ /phyag rgya bsgrub rdo pa rab tu 'bad pa 9kyeyis phyi nas dus 'dir dngos grub thams cad nges pa'o/ /dngos po bsgom pa bsgom ④pa med pa'o/ /rtag tu dngos grub kyi ye shes nye bar 'thob ⑤pa'o/ /gang dngos grub thob pa'i rnam pa ji ltar 'gyur/ de nas dang po mchod pa nye bar bya ste/ dri sna tshogs pa la sogs pa spos dang (6)me tog phreng ba la sogs pa'o/ /snying gar (3)rgyu yig bltas la mchod pa la sogs pa byas nas mdun du blta bar bya'o/ /sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa byas nas tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom par bya'o/ /lag pa la dgod pa la sogs pa bya ste/ lag pa g.yas la oṃ g.yon pa la e/ gnas rnams su byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ tha mu āḥ(snyenartsu/ mig tu k+ṣi/ rna ba g.yon pa la a/ rna ba g.yas pa la ā/ sna la traṃ/ lce la hrīḥ(perkang pa gnyis la baṃ blozhu )rka/ rdo rje la hūṃ/ phyin (1stonas lus ngag yid byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /oṃ haṃ hūm̐/ snying kur 'argyu/ mgrin par oṃ/ spyi gtsug tu haṃ/ gzhal yas khang rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa/ gru bzhi pa/ seng ge'i gdan yongs su bsgom par bya'o / /stong pa nyid du bsgom nyu par bya'o/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma ko3 lha'i/ ji ltar gyur pa de nas blta bar bya ste/ pi bang (snyedang / rnga bran dang ske/ gling bu dang / ting ting shag tshedang / gar dang / glu dang / rnga sgra dang ske/ sred med kyi bu la sogs pas rtsu gi yi ge bsam par bya'o/ /rdo rje gur bcings pa 3 la sogs pa ma lus pa nyunyesngar bzhin bya'o/ /lha mos gsol pa/kye nyurtebacom ldan 'das bzhengs la sems can gyi don mdzod cig /ci'i phyir 81—171

stong pa nyid du sems/ stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin la ma zhen par gang sems can 'dzam bu'i 3)gling pa rnams la gzigs shing dngos grub sna tshogs pa rnams byin cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis lha mo ma lus pa la 5migasungs pa/ lha mo chen mo'i bdag nyid 5ltos shig ltos shig /dpal nag po chen po mchog tu dga' ba'i rang bzhin nam mkha'i rang bzhin rnams zhal bzhi pa hūṃ las bskyed pa / dang po'i zhal nag po/ g.yon ljang ga(ge/ g.yas dmar po/ rgyab ma hi ṣa'i mugadong pa can/ mche ba gtsigs 96༄shing 'jigs par byed pa ste/ 'jigs pa chen po'i nga ro shin tu drag pa/ 'jigs pa yang shin tu 'jigs par byed pa/sma ra ser po dang / skra ser po gyen du brjes pa/ zhal re re la yang tshasaspyan gsum gsum pa/ skra shin tu gyen du bsgreng 9dab/ 'od zer dang ldan pa/ klu 'jog pos dkris 1 pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ ma hi ṣa 'og tu gnon nyanyepa/ phyag bcu drug pa/ g.yas g.yon gyi 12dang po gnyis kyis lha mo la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang 1lhabs gnas pa/ bdud bzhi yang dag par mnan pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na gri gug /gsum pa na tho ba/ bzhi pa na rnga ma dkar po/ lnga pa na gshin rje'i 1 dbyug pa/ drug pa na rdo rje/ bdun pa na log 'dren gyi mche ba/brgyad pa na glang po che'i pags 12pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa/ gsum pa na rtse gsum pa/ bzhi pa na rje'u chung / lnga pa na rdo rje7ske/ drug pa na dril bu/ bdun pa na ma he'i mgo/ brgyad pa na glang po che'i pags 1 pa lto 'phyang ba/ stag gi pags 12pas rked pa dkris pa/ rigs can gyis dpung pa brgyan 19pa/ mgo bo'i phreng ba'i do shal 'phyang ba/ rked pa dang mgrin pa la sogs pa rnams la 2 )dga' bo dang / nor rgyas la sogs pa rnams 81—172

kyis yongs su brgyan zhing 17/ klu thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mkha' 'gro ma brgyad kyis yongs su bskor rin ba/ sred med kyi bu la sogs pa rnams kyi (3zhabs la 'jus 3nas phyag byed pa/ dze gyi 5skra chen po tsho6yongs su sgrogs pa/ tī li tī la'i (gesgra dang ldan pa/ 'brug gi sgra sgrogs pa/ ha hā hi dhā ho hai naho ho sgra rab tu 'byung ba/ shar gyi 'phar ma la/ gtum pa'i dbang phyug ma/ rtsa gyi sa bon las bskyed 99)pa/ phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ mgo bo'i 7phreng ba'i do shal can kha dog dkar mo mche ba rnam par gtsigs 11shing 'jigs par byed pa/ lho'i 'phar ma la tsartsi kā 12kha dog nag mo kai gi 1lhas bon las bskyed pa/ phyag gnyis na gri gug dang thodabyu pa 'dzin pa/ lhag ma sngar bzhin / nub kyi 'phar ma la kā li kācho1 / lo gyi sa bon las bskyed pa g.yas g.yon na rtse gsum pa dang thod pa/ lhag ma rnams sngar bzhin no/ /byang du rigs kyi dbang phyug ma/ ro gyi sa bon las bskyed pa kha dog ser mo/ g.yas pa gyen du bsgreng bsi/ g.yon pa na thod pa thogs pa/ lhag ma ni snga ma bzhin no/ /lha mo thams cad spyan gsum pa/ mgo bo'i phreng ba rab tu 'phyang bske/ klu brgyad kyis yang dag par brgyan pa/ ro'i steng na zhabs g.yon brkyang bas gnas 7pa/ de bzhin du gcer bu spa sil bu 1 'jigs par byed pa/phyi'i snam bu la chom rkun ma lag pa rnga ma bzung ba kha dog nag mo/ rtsa gyi 18sa bon las bskyed pa/ lhag ma sngar bzhin no/ /lho'i snam bu la lan tshwa 19ni kha dog ljang gu tsho/ rtsa gyi 2nyes bon las byung ba/ lag pas spos khang bzung ba/nub tu dga' chen mo mi gyi 22yi ge las bskyed pa kha dog dmar mos / lag pa rdo rje dang dril bu thogs pa/ byang du dga' ba'i dbang phyug ma rna gyi yi ge las 81—173

yongs su rdzogs pa/ kha dog ser mo/ lhag ma sngar bzhin no/ /lha mo u mās lhonyegatso bo la 'khyud pa kha dog dkar mo phyag bzhi pa dga' ba chen pos zhuganas pa/de bzhin du mche dugyib rnam par gtsigs ④pa/ lhag ma sngar bzhin no/ /phyag rgya shin tu dga' bas gnas pa/ sangs rgyas rnams 9gekyis sngags gsal (6)bar bshad par bya ste/ dngos grub sna tshogs mchog tu ster ba'i phyir/ dpal sems can rnams la chags pas sems can rnams la phan pa dang mi phan pa'i rnam pa mi spyod ⑦pas dga' ba chen por gnas pa'i sgrub pa pos brgyad dam bcu 'am bcu gnyis la bsgom par bya'o/ /gang rnal 'byor pa chang dang go ku da ha na la sogs pa bdud rtsi lnga dang / yang dag par ldan pas spyad par bya'o/ /rtag tu btung ba khrag gis bya'o/ /gal te the tshom za na skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gang gis 'bad pa chen pos bsnyen pa byas nas dngos grub nges par 'byung zhing des yun mi ring bar 'joms par 'gyur ro/ /gsang ba'i rigs la gnas na de bzhin du las bya'o/ /ji ltar gsal bar mi 'gyur 'a༄ro/ /gal te gang gis gsal bar byas na ni de dngos grub tu mi 'gyur ro/ /chen por mi gsal bar bsam par bya'o/ /lha mos gsol pa/ kye (khebacom ldan 'das dgongs pa'i ⑩skad ni ji ltar gsungs/ de kho na nyid ji lta ba bzhin nyan nyunyepar 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dgongs pa'i skad ni ji lta bar rgyas par chang nyugal stobs can zhes bya/ sha la ba la zhes so/ /skad chen mi yis ma rtogs par bya'o(12/ /dngos grub thob par shes par bya ba'i phyir/ rigs can lnga rab tu gsal bar bshad par bya ste/ g.yung mo rdo rje'i rigs las byung ba dang /gar mkhan ma pad+ma'i rigs las byung ba dang / bram ze mo rin po che'i rigs 81—174

las byung ba dang / tshos mkhan ma las kyi rigs las yang dag par skyes pa dang /rgyal rigs mo sku'i rigs las byung ba'o/ /phyag rgya 'di ni rang gi dngos grub ster ba dang / de 'di dag rnams la bud med rnams kyis 1rdo rje dkar po 'dzin pa sngags rdzun pas nges par de yis rab tu mchod pa dang rdzun/ rtag tu btung bar bya'o/ /kyai (4)lha mo la bshad pa de/ 'di ltar gang khyod snying rje dang ldan pas thams cad du gus pa tshan chen po'i bdag nyid kyis yongs su gzung bar bya'o / /skad gzhan gyis ngo mtshar ba dang / mi gang dbang ma bskur ba dang /skad 'dis dpal nag po chen 96 po'i dbang ma bskur ba la rab tu bshad na/de nyi ma bdun gyis 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te ma shi na yang (me)na ba dang /tshe thung ba dang / po ti mig gis mi mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /(8)dbang ma bskur ba dang / brdzun du smra ba dang / mi gus pa'i mi de rnams rnal 'byor ma dang /mkha' 'gro ma thams cad dang / lha rnams du'o)'khrug par 'gyur ro/ /lha mo gang dang gang du ngas bshad pa thams cad ma lus pa 'bad pa la ngas byin gyis brlab po/ /dngos grub chen po brgyad 'grub bo/ /rgyud thams cad 51 7kyi gleng gzhi rgyud rtsonya'adir smras pa/ de'i phyir dbang bskur ba'i mis klog pa'am 'dri bas dngos grub 'grub kyi bo/ /rje btsun bri bar bya stenyas/ sor bcu drug tsam gyi tshad tsam/ rgya skyegs kyi khu ba'am/ sen rtsi'am/ dri sna tshogs kyis bsres te/nim pa'i shing gi sgyug mgus gro ga la gzugs brnyan ji lta bar bris nas ras dmar po'am dur khrod kyi ras la brten nas lag pa byin gyis brlab pa la sogs pa bsgom par bya stege/ yang na nim pa'i shing la byas pa la rtag tu yang dag par bsam par bya'o/ /lha mos gsol pa/ kye tshabacom ldan 'das khyod nyon 81—175

cig /bzhengs shig bdag gis 'di bskul nas nag po chen po'i bdag nyid/u ṭa ṣ+ṭha ①ya/ bha rā ṭo/ kā 90ru ṇa ma rgya(5)/ nā tsā (demi ha s+t+waṃ de bi/ i thi ta tī sa ka ri ba ma yi dza ma (deyi tu hūm̐ puts+tsha (6)si kā dza dza ta ga kha ṇi ho yi sarba yā rā (7skuhā saṃ ṇa tsa tsa yi/ e ka la bi ra/ ti ṇa ṇi bhu ya ṇi ka ka ri yā kha ḍā ru (8)ha ye(pe/ats+tshan te kā lī bo bo'i/ tsaṇ+ḍi (1rnyes sa rī ku li nyurnyekhri nī bhi ri lā a ge ta yi ki puṇ+ḍi nyarteputs+tsha si lo bho lī/ a khri na an ta na na hi to he kuyi /e kā ne+e maka ri ya si sasta bā thā / ed bhu ta su ma hi nya ya ka ri nyi phonyesi dzo yi/ ji ltar bskul ba'i dus /spus bcom ldan 'das skad cig de nyid la rdzogs par longs shig /yid kyi 'gyur ba gsal bas phyag bcu drug pa rdzogs par byas nas phyag gnyis pa bshad par bya ste/ sems can rnams kyi 3 )sdug bsngal bsal ba'i don du ji ltar phan par bsams pa tsam gyis sdug bsngal thams cad la yang dag par 'don pa'o/ /lha'i rigs bsam par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa/ dang por ༷ —1hūm̐ yig bsam par bya ba dang / phyi nas mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur la ༷ 3sogs pa byas nas dngos grub 'dod pas bsgom par bya'o/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa/ sku mdog nag po skra ser po gyen du brjes pa/ro'i steng na gnas pa/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ lto 'phyang ba/ bong sa thung ba/ rnal 'byor ma gnyis kyis yongs su bskor ba dang thabs cig dgetu bsgom par bya'o/ /char sprin gyi mdog lta bu 'brug gi sgra sgrogs gepa po/ skye bo gnas pa de'i dus su sgra snyan pa/ sbas pa rnams kyis dung skyong dran par bya'o/ /kye 39lha mo mi 'grub na nye bar spyod pa la dgos pa ci yod/ lha mos gsol pa/kye 3 tshobacom ldan 'das ci'i phyir rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ji ltar du rgyu/ gal 81—176

te rigs lnga la gnas pa'i kyai ri1)lha chen po me tog gi char 'bab pa/ yan lag stong dang ldan pa/ yan lag gcig tu gyur pa/ ji ltar yan lag bzhi yis yang dag par spyod pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa sa gsum dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i rnal 'byor ma rnal 'byor nabasgrub ri pa'i don du nges par yongs su bsgrub par bya'o/ /'di ni dpal nag po chen po'i rgyud las lha rnams bzhengs pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// //de nas lha mos gsol pa/ 'on kyang mnyam par longs spyod cing longs spyod par 'dod pa'i sems can dbul po rnams kyi don du thabs ji ltar lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa/ ji ltar 'dzam bu'i gling pa'i dngos grub sna tshogs nye bar spyod pa zhes bya ba 9na/bshad par bya'o/ /rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pas sa stengs kyi 75chodangos grub rnams 'grub (6ribo mtshan mo'i cha la rdo rje'i khyim du sna tshogs pa'i nya dang / sha dang / khrag dang bcas pa bza' bar bya'o/ /bgegs 7༄nye bar zhi bar byed pa'i gtor ma bya ste sngags kyi le'u las bshad pa ji ltar 'byung ba ltar bya'o/ /dgra rnams btsir ba ar+gha'i 'dab ma la ba (8)blas sngags bris la/ rab tu sbyor ba dang ldan pas phyi nas ming bris te sa 'og tu bcug nas/ rkang pa g.yon 9pas mnan 7la sngags bzlas te/ nag po chen po'i gzugs su bsgoms nas so/ /zhi bar 'dod na 'khar nyunyeba'i snod du 'o mas bkrus la/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā ru ṇi kā 1rtasarba sha ṣ+ṭṛ ṇi 1lhamu khaṃ baṃ dha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya mo ha ya hūṃ ho phaṭa/ tsha 14ba gsum dang / bha lā ta ka dang —/ sge tshegasher dang / ke su'i rtsa ba dang / nyi ma bdun gyis rdzogs par 81—177

mu zi lhan cig phye mar byas pa blugs la/ ji ltar rnal 'byor pas sbrang rtsi dang lhan cig bza' bar bya'o/ /de'i lus la dgra yis mi tshugs so/ /de ni bsgrub par rigs pa 15)ste lus rgyas par byed pa'o/ /nyi ma nyi shu rtsa gcig tu goms pas sol/ /lte ba'i me zhan 2pa rgyas par bya ba ni de nas de nyid tsi 95)tra ka dmar po pi pi ling gi rtsa ba dang / legs mthong gi rtsa ba dang ts+tsha ba'i mar khu 94)yang dag par ldan pas byang chub kyi shing gi khu ba a ru ra 9nyebatsos pa dang / tshwa dang lhan cig tu bza' bar bya'o/ / ril bu 6nyi ma nyi shu rtsa gcig dang ldan par byas pas sngar gyi 97rigazugs bzhin du 'gyur ro/ /me'i drod chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /lus brtan tsho pa'i dngos grub bstan (9ri pa'o/ /dang po ba ru ra dang /ta nya rika'i rtsa ba dang / skyu ru ra dang / til ti la dang / de dang de mnyam par ldan pa/ nā ga mchog tu byas pa/ kha'i nang du bcug nas srin bya'i khrag mig gnyis la byugs nas 'og gi bug pa mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang nā ga khar bcug la sa ha de ba'i 'dab ma'i khu bas dngul chu bcings pa dang / khrag dang —/ ga bur dang ldan pa mig sman du bskus nyuston sa 'og gi bug pa mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /nag po chen po'i 'bras bu dang ku ba khan tshede nyusnyedang / se ba'i 'bras bu dang / se mi'abru dang 'di rnams bsres nas tsha ba gsum dang sbrang rtsi dang bcas nas btsos nas til nag po dang / lus rnam par dag par byas nas ji ltar goms pa yis man cha nges par byas nas zos na nyi ma lnga na sa'i bug pa mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /'bad de lus la byugs na gangs ti se la sogs pa mthar thug pa mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /cong zi'i chus khrus 8byas na snga ma bzhin du legs par gnas par 'gyur ro/ /tsa la ta'i khu ba dang / bya rgod kyi sha 81—178
