'dis ni nges par spen pa 'bros 15pa'am 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te ma byung na de'i tshe sngar gyi steng du bzlas na nges par 'bros par 'gyur ro/ /nag po'i brgyad kyi nub mo stag gi pags napa la bsdad nas/ oṃ ke tu khaṃ tsū phaṭa ces pa'i sngags rnal 'byor ma lnga dang stabs gcig rinatu bzlas na mjug rings /4)nges par 'bros so/ /tshes bcu bzhi la rnal 'byor ma lnga dang stabs gcig 57tu bza' ba sna tshogs pa dang chang la sogs pa btung la sngon du brjod pa'i sngags stong phrag gcig bzlas na sgra gcan nges par 'bros par 'gyur ro/ /pe chag pa'i dgra byung na de'i dus su thang phrom gyi me tog stong phrag lnga dang chang sbyin sreg 56 byas na pe chag (7pa thams cad 'bros pa dang 'chi bar 'gyur ro98na/ /oṃ hrīḥ(94 pa tai gha nu ts+tsha 0de yak+ṣiḥ6)phaṭa ces pa cho ga 'di'i sngags so/ /de rnams byas na bar du gcod pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /chu gang du byung sar/ oṃ dza la haṃ dzaḥmi zhes pa'i sngags kyis ba dmar mo'i 'o ma la stong phrag gcig dang ngo ra bzlas nas me tog kun+da stong phrag lnga'i sbyin sreg 1 byas na/ 'o ma des nges par chu rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /'bru thams cad brlag na de'i dus su skyu ru ra skam mapo stong phrag lnga dang chang sbyin sreg byas na15/ bza' ba dang / btung ba dang ske/ glu len pa dang / chang dang bcas pas lha mo lnga la mchod pa/ oṃ s+t+waṃ baṃ shīn+ti tshem ku ru swā hā zhes pa 'dis 'bru thams cad dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /gal te ma grub na de'i tshe ngas 17mtshams med pa lnga byas par 'gyur ba dang /chos thams cad brdzun 1 du 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir rnal 'byor pa klog pa dang mnyen na)pa nges par bya'o/ /gal te nyan pa dang klog pa mi byed na de'i tshe rnal 'byor pa 'chi ba dang / zhar ba dang / skur bar bya ba rnams cung zad tsam 81—229

dang mi 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /gang dang gang du bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa ltar nges par byas na myur bar thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /grong khyer na gnas pa'i mi rnams la gang gi tshe skar mda' ltung na nag po chen po phyag bzhi pa'i thang sku'am lugs ma'i mdun du 'di nyid kyi sngags kyis thang phrom gyi sa bon gyis brgya phrag lnga sbyin sreg ①byas la rnal 'byor ma lnga yis bza' ba dang /btung ba yis mchod nas ri de nas gtor ma sbyin no/ /rim pa 'di yis zhi bar 'gyur gyi gzhan gyis ma yin no/ /rab tu drag pa'i rims kyis (5)nges par thebs na de'i tshe/ oṃ hrīḥrtsisarba sa twa na nu paṃ pa ya hrīḥrige)rgyu phaṭa swā hā zhes pa'i sngags kyis me tog kun+da stong phrag lnga sbyin sreg 4)bya ba ste/ rnal 'byor ma lngas snga ma ltar zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /gang gi tshe 'brum bu dang / rgyu gzer dang ⑦/mig ser rnams la rnal 'byor ma lngas sha lnga la sogs pa rang gang 'dod pa zos 'thungs te/ sngon du song ba'i sngags stong phrag gcig bzlas nas stong phrag lnga sbyin sreg 98)byas na nges par rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /gang dang gang rgyud 'dir bshad pa rnams gzhan du ma 1—)bshad de/ de ⑩bag tsam bshad na yang lung bstan pa tsam du bshad pa'o/ /'di ni nag po chen po'i hunyergyud kyi rgyal po las gtso bor rnyed par dka' ba'i sems can thams cad la bde ba r+sha ster bar byed pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'o// //rgyal por bya ba'i don du phyag bcu drug pa3༄/ bsgom pa dang / stong phrag gcig bzlas na 7gang dang gang gis rgyal po 'thob skapar 'gyur ram mi 'gyur gyi ltas bshad par bya ste/ rgyal po 'grub par 'gyur ram/ mi 'gyur brtag pa ⑩81—230

ni bram ze kha dog nag po drung du 'ongs nas slong zhing 9)bgegs byed par nges par 'dod pa byung rdosan nges par de ni dngos grub ster ba ste/ bgegs ji lta ba bzhin du zhi bar byas nas bsgrubs na 'grub bo/ /yang gang dang gang du rgan mo'i gzugs su 'ongs nas 'gron (5)bu bzhi slong du byung na de ni rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sprul pa ste/ 'dir des nga)'grub par the tshom med do/ /gal te bshen 95)pa lag na me tog thogs pa 'ongs na 'jigs byed bgegs byed du 'ongs pa'o/ /rmi lam du bya rgod kyi rgyu ma za ba mthong na rgyal po 'thob pa'i mtshan ma'o/ /yang thang chen po mthong na yang ngo / /'di ni nag po chen po'i yirgyud kyi rgyal po las rgyal po 'grub bam mi 'grub brtag pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //'dir gzhan yang yang dag par bshad par bya ste/ bsgrub rdo dpar 'dod pa'i mi gang gis ji ltar bsgrub 7shen/ 'di ltar 'dir thabs gang dang gang gis dang por lam btsal ba ni lha mo skye bo rnams rab tu brtag par byas nas sa (pestengs kyi rgyal po de la yongs su bsgrags so/ /lam la sogs pa gang gi 7dus su zhu ba dbul na dpyid zla tha chungs pa san+ta'i (7brgyad dam/ bcu'am/ bcu bzhi nas rgyun du bsgrubs na nges par 'di la the tshom med do/ /ri'i rtse la phyin la sngon du gsungs pa'i nag po chen po bsgom mazhing sngags 'bum phrag lnga bzlas pa 8dang / lcags gsum khar bcug nas me tog pad ma 8stong phrag lnga sbyin sreg (6byas na nges par 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /dur khrod du phyin nas ro'i steng du bsdad de lag par ral gri bzung la dang por dri dang me tog la sogs pa kha dog bzang po rnams bkram pa'i steng du ral gri bskyur yin rnal 'byor pas gang 'dod 81—231

pa the tshom med par 'dis 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /nges par khang stong du tsartsi kā'i 3)thang sku bkram la sngags stong phrag lnga bzlas pa dang / phyi nas ut+pal stong phrag brgyad sbyin sreg ( bya ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ baṃ khaṇ+ḍa ri )li ni swā hā zhes pa'o/ /de nas sman rtsa ba brgyad pa dang 'o ma 'thungs 2)na nges par rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /ston zla ra ba'i tshes lnga la nag po chen po phyag bzhi pa'i thang sku bris la mchod pa chen po byas nas lcags brgyad dang gser las ril bu (snyebyas nas khar bcug ste nag po chen po'i gzungs stong phrag gcig (6)bzlas pa dang / sha chang 97)la longs spyad pa 8)yis de rnams song nas gzungs 'di bzlas te/ oṃ su mu khi su (9kyisarba ri7de hi de hi ju rdzu tsa ṭa tsa ṭa/ ri ṭa ri ṭa/ rī ku ṭa ku ṭa/ hūm̐ 3)phaṭa swā hā zhes pa zla ba drug gi bar du sbyor bas rgyal por 'gyur te/ gzhan du ni ma yin no / /gal te lo gcig tu 'khor los sgyur 12ba'i mtshan nyid chen po 'dzin pa shin tu rol pas bzhugs na 'khor los sgyur 1lhaba'i rgyal po chen po'i mtshan nyid can du 'gyur ro/ /chu 'gram gyi sa blangs pa dang / dung gi phye ma dang / phag pa'i sha rnams stabs gcig 4tu seng ge byas la yi ge baṃ khar bsams nas sngags khri phrag gcig bzlas na rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /gal te ma grub na me tog pad ma stong phrag gcig sbyin sreg 15byas na 'grub par 'gyur te the tshom lamed par skye ba 'di la thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /mtshan ma gcig pa'am dur khrod du phyin la ro'i steng du bsdad nas lag tu ral gri bzung bas tshwa gsum sbyar ba brdungs na rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /shes rab kyis gang 'dod pa'i rjes su 'gro bar bya ba'i phyir mkhas pas brtag par bya'o/ /bsam 1 pa tsam gyis zhi bar bya ba 'grub na lus kyi bya ba 'grub bo/ /'di ni nag po chen po'i rgyud kyi nya rgyal 81—232

por bya ba'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'o// //gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab stobs dang lha mo gnyis kyis stabs gcig 1tu yang dag par gsol ba btab pa/ kye 95cibacom ldan 'das gsungs shig /'dod pa dang gti mug gi 9gerang bzhin ji ltar go bar byedapya/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha mo lnga la dbang bskur ba thob pa'i mi (ldegang gis blang bar bya 56ste/ tshes brgyad dam bcu bzhi la gser srang lnga bshig la maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa gcus (7par zur bzhi ru lha mo bris nas sbyin sreg (8)gi bya ba bya'o/ /shes rab ye shes go bas thosaphyag rgya dang mnyam par rab tu sbyor zhing bza' ba dang / btung ba la longs spyad 1 rin nges par 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /kye 11tshe dang ldan pa shes rab rje mo des nges par gzhan yang nges so/ /'di ni nag po chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor gyi le'u ste nyi shu rtsa drug pa'o// //bslab pa'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /bslab pa rab tu gsal bar 'gro ba ji ltar bslab par 'dod pas slob pa'i dus su chang dang sha dang bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i shes rab la dus thams cad du gnas pas gtsug tor steng gi chu 12bo la shes rab ces pa dang / rnal 'byor ma zhes par bdag dang gzhan gyi don dang ldan pas bshad par 1 bya/ bya ba byed pas zhu ba la phyag rgya ma zhes pa dang / rdo rje'i gnas zhes pa bodang / rje mo shes par the tshom med do/ /sems g.yo 'gul med pa la bslab pa zhes bya'o/ /'di ni nag po chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po 81—233

las bslab pa'i sdom pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa bdun pa'o// //gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de kho na zhes pa ni mtshungs pa rgyun du 'gro ba'i sems rjes su gnas pa'i rang bzhin yid la mi byed pa gang la 'phel ba/ de dang ldan pa de dngos po med pa'o/ /u ṇa ༅a ra nā ehi tat+ta ha lu e he rdo riṇi dza hi ka ha wi nā saṃ ho/ tsi ④a ra go tsa ra i tsit+ta ta 'a)ha the bi na su ha la pa ri bhā si o sta re kha ṇa pi na (7thak+ka/ o udz+dza ṇi e le ④kha sa ṇi/ bha ṇa i sgye o sa wa rat+ta ka hi wi ṇa sbyi khri (8)o zhes pa dang / r+ghaṃ 0bā lo a go a ra tsihā gha raṃ gha ra gha re bla staṇi he ṭa mu k+ṣa 7nyi o/ ma hā dza nan de ⑩li a so hi ṇa bha ṇi o/ bi ha ha da te pa ri bha waṃ lha te/ ka ha wi na dza i zhes pa 'di dag ni skad ngan pa'i bye brag gis de kho na bshad pa'o/ /'di ni nag po chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las de kho na'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa'o// //gzhan yang zhing skyes brjod par bya ste/ bram ze'i rigs las skyes pa'i bud med bong ge ring ba/ mig che ba/ kha dog ser skya'am nag po ste/ 'di lta bu'i rnal 'byor mas dag par byed do/ /dmangs rigs las skyes pa'i rkang pa 'khyog pa kha dog sngo sangs sam/ ser skya'am/ nag mo skra 'khyil ④ba skad 'dzer ba ni mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /rdo rje'i rigs kyang de dang mtshungs so/ /reg mi btub pa las skyes pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa des khrums stod dang /nag pa dang / sa ri dang / lag dang / chu stod dang / nab 7so dang /bra nye dang / smin drug rnams las skyes pa'i mi de rnams kyis 'jigs byed 81—234

chen po'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro/ /snar ma dang / mgo dang / mchu dang ske/ skag rnams la yang ngo / /'di ni nag po chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las zhing skyes kyi le'u ste gyo)nyi shu rtsa dgu pa'o// //de nas zhing skyong bshad par bya'o/ /gang gis nges par bgegs yod pa'i sar phyin la ji ltar bskyed par bya ba de ltar bskyed pa ni dang por yi ge rtsu gis dmigs la mchod pa sna tshogs pas mchod la/ sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa byas pa stidang / snying gar ((rtsu yongs su gyur pa las gri gug yi ge k+ṣe dang hūṃ gis byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /de rnams yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid zhing skyong phyag gnyis pa/ gri gug dang thod pa phyag na bsnams pa/ g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pas khyi mnan pa/ phaṭa ces pa'i sgra sgrogs pa/ mche ba gtsigs ④pa/kha dog sngo nag spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra kham (snyepa gyen du brjes pa/ stags gi pags (7pa na bzar lagasol ba/ khrag 'thungs pa(8)/ rnal 'byor ma gnyis kyis bskor ba bsgoms nas sngags rgyun du bzlas so/ /chu 'gram gyi sa las phreng ba bya/ ṣa ṇa pa'i skud pa la brgyus pa thogs la/ oṃ hūṃ rtsa sarba sirnyi dā yak+ṣa ⑨ya swā hā zhes pa zla ba drug bzlas na rnal 'byor pa gang 'dod pa 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /khrag dang / chang dang / sha gsar pa dang / sran ma ma 0ṣa las byas pa'i 7zan rnams la (7gtor ma byas de yis nyi ma re sbyin no/ /ljon shing gi drung ngam/ dur khrod dam/ chu 'gram rnams su yang 'osnyede ltar bya'o/ /sa bon yi ge rtsa las zhing skyong ser skya gsum bskyed pa ni rnal 'byor pa dge ba dang /mi dge ba'i las rgyun du so sor byas nas dngos grub bsgrub par bya'o/ /'di 81—235

ni nag po chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las zhing skyong 51)bzhengs pa'i le'u ste sum cu rin)pa'o// //rtsa'i 'khor lo bshad par bya'o/ /gsum 'dres pa'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pa'i slob dpon la byang chub sems dpa' chen po gnas pa ste/ rang 'dod spangs pa la yang dag par spyod pa ni a ba dhū tī ri radang la la nā (pedang ra sa nā (ge)rnams 'dus par bya'o/ /rtsa drug cu 6)rtsa bzhi bstan tso par gyur pa'i nus pa brtsis pa ni la la nā 3)shes rab kyi rang bzhin can du (94)shes pa'o/ /ra sa nā ⑩khams bde ba'i rang bzhin can tshod shes pa'o/ /a ba dhū /lha tī ni skobade ba chen po'i rang bzhin can man 12shes pa'o/ /khams dkar po bskyed pa tustedang /khams gsum bskyed pa'o/ / aṣ+ṭha u hā nā hā 3lhayi a/ sa a la saṃ mo he(7/tsa tsa tsi u ha rā dza ne nyu tsā bhān+ti o12/ nā ha ha nā dha saṃ ku la bha wa i swa ra ha bha na i kā ri16la/ kā 3 tshol ha ka ri tsi a rna tsho )pa i swā hā/ 'di ni nag po chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las rtsa'i 'khor lo'i le'u ste sum cu bla so gcig pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems kyi rdo rjes bdag la smras ( nyepa ni sems kyi rang bzhin skad cig ma bcu drug tu yang dag par skye ba de/ ye shes chen po'i rgyu'i rang bzhin no/ /rnam par shes pa dang yul rkang pa gnyis 'du ba la bar du gcod pa'i bu mo la skad cig ma bcu drug 'dzin mar 'dod pa tsha reg dang grang 24reg ji bzhin no/ /a ha ka ha re/ i ṇi bud dha swa mo snye bhā be/ tsit+ta 27ba ḍani bo/ bha wā 7na si la/ u pa lak+ṣa snyem dza sna/ ṭī a pa la bi pa hā ra 81—236

ṇa 0)/ ti ma ṇa/ bharnyi (bka tha rna/ 'di ni nag po chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las dge ba dang mi dge ba brjod pa'i le'u ste sum cu (5 so gnyis pa'o// //de nas bsam gtan gyi bsgrub pa bshad par bya'o/ /gang dang gang gis sems can gyi sdug bsngal dgrol bar shes pa des gro ga la dug dang gcin dang khrag rnams kyis yi ge mi dang ro dang gnyis kyi bar du bsgrub bya'i ming hūm̐ phaṭa dang ldan pa'i 'khor lo bris pa(4/ de dril te mes bsros na skad cig de nyid la sbyor ba des 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /nang (5)par snga bar langs te gdong bkrus 6pa dang ske/ oṃ ma ṇi bha dā (peya ma hā kā la mā kṛ ti se na 85)pa ta (95)ye ma mi li mi li mārnya ṭ+wāṃ dha da 7tā pa ye swā hā zhes pas phogs bcwa tsho11lnga ru byug (3cing maṇ+ḍal skum po byas la/ oṃ rna dī zhusam hā kā lā ya badz+ra puthe tsū/ zhes pas me tog a 8pa rā (getsi ta nag po dbus tsos dbul lo/ /oṃ kā lā ya ka yak+ṣa nyu tshoya badz+ra pudhe r+ghaṃ zhes pas shar phyogs su'o/ /oṃ bi sna ḍā la mu khā yak+ṣa ya badz+ra phusne hūm̐ zhes pas lho phyogs su'o/ /oṃ a swa mu khā yak+ṣa nya7ya badz+ra puthe hūṃ zhes pas nub phyogs su'o/ /oṃ kri mi mu khā tsha )yak+ṣa ya badz+ra puspe tsū zhes pas byang phyogs su'o/ /mtshams rnams su ni da hu mu khri yaspyi yak+ṣi sbyi me/ sru ka ra mu khri yak+ṣi sbyi rtsu/ u lū ka mu khri swa dhi ta yak+ṣi sbyi dz+ra 1/ ad+dha su tsa ti naya mu khri yak+ṣi rje nasarba zhes pa thams cad la swā hā sbyar bas so/ /phyi nas yang me tog dbus su dbul ba ni/ oṃ muk+ta muk+ta ma hā kā ta/ ya swā hā/ oṃ sbo ṭa ka 2 )ma hā kā lā ya swā hā/ oṃ ku ru ki ta —snyem hā kā lā ya swā hā/ oṃ gā bye ri 6tsakra ma hā kā lā ya swā hā/ oṃ khi 3 ṭa ku ru ma hā kā lā ya swā hā / zhes pa rnams dang bcas pas so/ /gzungs brgya rtsa brgyad kyang bzlas 81—237

par bya'o/ /phyi nas bzod gsol byas la/ oṃ su gan+ta ①pad ma ma hā kā lā ya muḥbazhes pas gshegs su gsol lo/ /'di'i dus su shing nim pa la stan (kyebya/gos sngon po bgo zhing gzhon nu ma bdun la nyi ma re re zhing ras yug re re sbyin/rje btsun gel me tog a pa rā dzi ta (5)dbul/ bza' ba dang / btung ba sngon du gsungs pa ltar bza' btung bya/ de ltar thams cad dus gsum du byas na sangs rgyas thams cad la bsnyen bkur byas pa'o/ /maṇ+ḍal 'di bya rog skad ma bton pa'i dus su langs la bya'o/ /nam gyi cha smad la nag po yichen po phyag bcu drug pa bkram la chang 'thung zhing thun tshod re re'i bar du gzungs kyi sngags kyis byin gyis brlab pa'i 9)sbyor ba 'di sgrub pa pos byas na/ rje btsun nag po chen pos zla ba gsum gyi bar la rmi lam ston cing nges par dngos grub kyang 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /sgom chen pa'i gzugs kyis lagaser srang phyed dang gsum ster bar 'gyur ro/ /zla ba drug gi ⑨bar gyis mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub thob cing rim gyis 7thams cad 'grub ste/ nges par phyag rgya'i dngos grub 'thob par 'gyur rol/ /gal te gcig kyang ma grub na ngas 0nges par mtshams med pa lnga'i las byas par 'gyur zhing nya)lha thams cad bsad pa dang mtshungs sonyuste/ /rgyud 'di ni rnal 'byor gyi cho ga'i bcud thams cad bsdus pa nyid do/ /gal te le'u 'di'i sbyor ba la nye bar gnas nas bsgrubs na skad cig gis khyab par byed pa'i ḍo/stematshams med pa 7lnga'i rnam par smin pa nyams su myong bar 7mi 'gyur ro/ /nye bar longs spyad ④par bya ba'i mchod sbyin gyi shing ni mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i thab khung bas cung zad thung ba'o/ /zhi bar hu bya ba'i don du thang stong gi rtsi 6)ba blangs la bya'o/ /rgyas par bya ba la rje btsun gyi po )mdun du ji lta ba bzhin thab tsunye81—238

bcas la rten du byas pa'i shing 'bras bu dang ldan pa la thab khung dma' bar byas pas sotunye/ /lha mos gsol pa/ kye rje btsun sbyin sreg 95 shing gi bye brag blangs la bsreg par bya ba rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa gang lags/sems can rnams la phan pa dang bde ba'i don du gsungs shig /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de rnams kyi nang nas mchod sa sbyin gyi shing srog chags med pa/ skam pa/ thab khung bas cung zad dma' ba/ sngar bshad pa'i 'bras bu can gyi shing rgyas pa'i thab khung du lci tsho ba spangs pas so/ /mngon spyod la shing ro tsha ba tsher ma dang ldan pas dri zhim pa'am/ dur khrod nas byung ba'am / bong (5)bu'am/ rta la sogs pa'i sbangs skam pos nges par 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /dbang du bya ba la shing dri zhim pa e pa'i 'bras bu dang / me tog dang ldan pas so/ /dgug (6pa la shing tsher ma can la sogs pa ste sbyin sreg (gegi rim pa'i bye brag go/ /lha mos gsol pa/ gal te dngos grub chen po brgyad thob par (de'adod pa'i rnal 'byor pas chos brgyad dam bcu'i dus su gong du gsungs pa ltar maṇ+ḍal byas la sngags stong phrag lnga sha dang chang bza' ba dang btung ba dang bcas te bzlas par bya'o/ /nyal ba'i dus su chang phogs brgya rtsa brgyad du mnyes pas gdong bkrus nas nyal na/ rmi lam du dge ba dang mi dge ba ston no/ /de rnams kyi sngags ni oṃ ri9)mu susno mig 11ka thā 515ya hūm̐ zhes pa'o/ /de ltar nyurtemin na sngags des ce 3stespyang gi nyugesha la sogs pa chang gis sbags 3nyal/chu nang gi shing me la khri phrag gcig tu sbyin sreg nya byas na nyal ba'i dus su mar me'i mar gyis sngags brgya phrag gcig bzlas shing rkang pa la byugs te nyal na rmi lam du 'byung ba dang mi 'byung ba nges par shes 1 par 'gyur ro/ /gnyid ma 81—239

btags na/ nad rims rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /yang oṃ ma hā kā la shu tsi ra pu wi ra spu ra bsnya 1na hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags kyi rgyal po chen po yi ge bcu bdun pa 'di 'bum phrag gcig bzlas nas bsgrub par bya ba ni/ sman ga la (bar ṭa dang / su pa la na dang / ma hān+ta ra dang / i k+ṣa dar ya wa dang /sa ma ṭi ra ṇa skyidang / a la wu dang / nī ra ka la dang / ṭ+wāṃ ṭā (5kyi hā bī ka 6ridza dang / chu shing gi 'bras bu dang / sbrang dang / ṭa su rī dang / mu ti ri dang ske/ sa p+ta dang / li dang / i ga ba lī dang / ra ṇa sā su ra dang / phe ṭa wā 7cir dang / gha ṇa ṭa ka na pha la dang / su mu ri dang / tsan+d+ra 9rim su ri dang ske/ u bhak+ta tsotsi dang / la ṭa tī dang / te na ha dang / tsar+sha pri 17dang /puk+ṣa yā dang / tsa ra ṭa dang 1 / ma di ra bī dza dang / sum̐ bhā pha 51lhal dang /ha gho thur dra bya ne ha ra dang / su mu ṇi 15ṅgā tsār+ya pha la dang / a 15za pha la dang ske/ pra ha ri dang / kurnya li tsi lī 517dang / dza la tsa ra ḍibya 18dang /hab 'ibla /)dang / mā ga ṭa dang / bu ma la ha dang / a yan ta pha la dang / kuñja ru ri byedang / pu ga dang / a mu ga la dang / lhan pā ra mā glen sā dang /rnal 'byor pas rdzas bzhi bcu po 22de rnams bzung la/ zla ba dang / nyi ma gzas bzung sa ba'i dus su de rnams cha bsnyams 34la lto stong la mid nas ji srid grol gyi bar du sngags rin bzlas na skad cig de nyid la 'chi ba med de mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /gal te ma grub na sgrub 6pa pos zla phyed bskyar men lo stong phrag gcig tu 'tsho zhing dngos grub chen po brgyad 28rnams las 59gang 'dod pa de 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /zla ba dang / nyi ma gzas gtong ba'i dus su gong gi bya ba byed pa des the tshom dzo tshomed par thams cad tsho1mkhyen pa dang 81—241

gzhan yang rnal 'byor gyi le'u bshad par bya ste/ steng 'og yang dag par mnan te/ lte ba'i dbus su zla ba bsgoms na zla ba drug gis nges par 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /sna'i bug pa bkag 17ste thig le bsgoms na nyin zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig (lde)gis 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /lce stengs su 9 ribakug na rgas pa dang shi ba las grol bar 'gyur ro/ /dgang ba dang / dbyung ba dang / bum pa can rim pa ji lta babar dran par byas na zla ba phyed kyis mkha' spyod 'grub par 'gyur rol/ /rlung gis yid bsad pa la zla ba'i sbyor ba bya ba ni sngags kyi sbyor ba rnam 5par byed pas skad cig tsam gyis kyang 'phrog ste/ lag pa rab tu gcag (6)par bya'o / /'di ni nag po chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las rnal 'byor gyi le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa rdzibazhi pa'o// //'dir rnal 'byor pa gza' rnams kyi gtso bo bsgrubs nas yang dag pa'i bde ba shin tu khyab par byed pa'i sbyin bsreg 98bya ste/ bdag nyid la gur gum 9ridang —/ sman ha re ṇa 7dang khu ba dang dngul chu rnams lus la byugs na 7)phas kyi dpung 'joms par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni nag po chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las phas kyi hu dpung 'joms pa'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa 15lnga pa'o// //gzhan yang lha mos gsol pa/ kye chobacom ldan 'das nyi ma gang dang gang la sngags dang sman gyi zhu nus pa 'grub par 'gyur gsungs shig nyan par 'tshal lo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nyi ma thams cad bzang po yin 81wa 249

te / 'on kyang dus tshod la ltos par rigs pas 0stede'i phyir dus tshod brjod par bya'o / /nyi ma ni lnga pa la'o/ /zla ba ni gnyis pa la'o/ /gza' rnams kyi gtso bo ni bdun pa la'o/ /sngags pa ni bzhi pa la'o/ /gza' lhag pa ②ni gsum pa la'o / /mig dmar ni drug pa la'o/ /spen pa ni gcig pa la ste / rang rang gi dus tshod nges par 'grub par (pe'agyur ro/ /'di ni nag po chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las gzung ba dang dor ba'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa (pedrug pa'o// //gzhan yang nang gi bdag nyid can gyis mi lam bertags yil sems can rnams kyi nyarmongs pa dang bral ba'i dus tshod dang rab tu ldan par bya ba'i phyir gza' dang / skar ma dang / tshes grangs kyi go rims brjod ⑧par bya ste/nag po'i (1saphyogs kyi bcu bzhi'am/ brgyad dam/ bcu'am/ tshes gcig rnams kyis ri dang / chu stod dang / me ⑩bzhi dang / skag dang / mchu dang /nag pa dang / tha skar dang / bra nye dang / smin drug rnams dang rab tu ldan par bya'o/ /'di ni nag po chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las skar ma'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa mispebadun pa'o// //gzhan yang nam yid ches lho pa'i dus su mkhas pas rgyu ba'i rtsa gnyis mnan par bya zhing / shin tu dga' ba la sogs pa la nye bar gnas nas shes bya thams cad lte ba'i dkyil 'khor du mnan na 'gro ba rnams kyi bde ba the tshom med par thob pa ni yul rnams ye shes kyi mes bsregs nas sgyu hunyem snang ba'o/ /ma 'ongs pa'i 8dus na'ang 'gro ba rnams kyis shin tu yongs su dag pa dri ma med pa bsam 81—250

du med pa'i zhing bzang por skye bar 'gyur ro/ /rnal 'byor 'dis 'o ma 'thungs na lbu ①ba ltar dri ma med par 'gyur ro/ /rlung phyir 'don cing dag par byas na dge ba bsam pa 'grub par 'gyur ro/ / 'di ni risanag po chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las dge ba bsam pa'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa (kyebargyad pa'o// //lha mos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das lam gyi cho ga'i rim pa bshad du gsol④ / gang gis gang sbar la sbyin bsreg 2bya/ snying rje dang ldan pas sems can thams cad bde ba la ji ltar dgod/ dang por dngos grub 'dod pa'i sngags bzlas pa byas yinas sbyin bsreg nyabya'o/ /myur ba ni rtag pa bstan na bde ba'i rang bzhin ye shes go ste(she/ skad cig de la lus can rnams kyis ye shes 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni nag po chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las lam gyi 0cho ga'i rim pa'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa bodagu pa'o// //gzhan yang a tharba sha ba rī'i lho:sngags kyi le'u bshad par bya'o/ /oṃ sarba man+t+ra ṇi dā 8rna k+ṣe me ro rtsu k+ṣaḥhaḥzhes pa'i sngags kyi rgyal po 'di phogs gcig bklags na pa tsam gyis sgrub pa 8po rnams kyi sdig pa thams cad tshegs 8med par zad par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni dpal tshenag po chen nya tshopo'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las a tharba sha ba rī'i 6)sngags kyi hu)le'u ste lnga bcu pa rdzogs stong )// //ldang 'phrul gyi degatsug lag khang chen po ra sa ra mo cher pha rgyal khams pas zhus pa'i don dusagye/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po sa man+ta shrī dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba rwa ⑫dge slong chos rab snyikyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa ke ⑩81—251

༄ga /ji bzhin brnyes pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud/①༄zag /rgya gar skad du/ ya thā la bha kha sa ma tan+t+ra nā 2rim/ bod skad dul/ ji bzhin brnyes pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig sangs rgyas lnga yi (kyecod pan can/ /sa gsum kun gyi snying po dang ldan pa/ /dpal ldan dang po'i sangs rgyas ngo bo mdzad/ /de ni stimakha' dang mnyam par spyod pa'o/ /gal te de 'dra'i (51ngo bor sems dag pa/ /byis pa 'di ni don dam sgom pa yin/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi rang bzhin mthong min te/ /sangs rgyas dang ni rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / /rin chen tog dang pad sbyo65ldan 'jug pa ste/ /lha de rnams kyi rang bzhin yod ma yin/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas nam mkha'i rang bzhin no/ /dang po'i chos las 7)de rnams 'byung ba ste/ /mkha' dang lhan cig sems can khams rnams kyang / /gzhug rnams su ni bstan bcos tshad mar byas/ /gdod 81—278

nas dag pa'i go 'phang mkha' mnyam mtshungs/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi nyu)cod pan dang yang ldan/ /gang zhig chos de nyid kyi rang bzhin can/ /sa gsum po yi chos ni 'byung 'gyur ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la ni phyag 'tshal ba'i/ /bsod nams kyang ni mtha' yas 'byung 'gyur zhing / /rdo rje sems dpa' de la phyag 'tshal bas/ /chos kyi bdag nyid chen po ②'thob par 'gyur/ /sems can thams cad yongs ②su bsgom par yang ske/ /bya ba 'di ni thar pa'i rang bzhin no/ /dngos kun rdo rje sems dpar (pa)dag byas pa'i/ /thar pa chos kyi rang bzhin bya ba ste/ /chos 'di 'jig pa med pa'i rang bzhin can/ /'jig rten pas ni rang bzhin gzhan du byas/ /'di ni sku dang gsung dang thugs dag ni/ /chos 'di yi ni dang po 'byung ba ste/ /rnal 'byor gnas ni lha mo skul ⑤byed ma/ /der ni dang por chos rnams 'byung ⑥'gyur ba'o/ /der ni sngags rnams rdo rje gcig dngos bsgom/ /chos kyi rang bzhin rdo rje dngos dmigs sam/ /ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis kyang rab brgyan cing ske/ /sku mdog kyang ni sngon po'i rang bzhin can/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin dge ba ste/ /gcig pa'i rang bzhin nyid ni bsgom par bya/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi ni dbus gnas par/ /yi ge bskyed pa nyid du bsam par bya/ /yi ge'i gzugs ni yongs su gyur pa las/ /rdo rje rang bzhin nyid du bsam par bya / /mchu yi mtha' ni sngags pas bsgom bya ba/ /rang gi ngo bo nyid kyis rang bzhin te/ /gnyis su med pa'i sku yi rang bzhin can/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dmigs par bya ba'o/ /'di ni sems nyid yongs su grub pa ste/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa yis ni gsungs pa yin/ /gang zhig bsgom (pepa 'di yis sgom 2byed pa/ /81—279

sems kyi rang bzhin nyid ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /'di ni lha mo bzhi rnams ro gcig pa'o/ /ngo bo blos 11ni mkha' dang mnyam las bsgom/ /de lta'i chos byas sems kyi rang bzhin te/ /lha mo thar pa'i rang bzhin nyid du bsgom/ /rdo rje sems dpa' des mthong ba ri/ /chos rnams kun gyi rang bzhin can/ /rnal 'byor gnas dang rol pa ste/ /thams cad mnyam pa'i btsun mor bcas/ /bkod pa dag dang ldan par gnas/ /mkhas bcas dngos las byung da)de la/ /rdo rje sems dpa' gang mthong bar/ /gzung (zhinab sangs rgyas spro bsdu'o/ /bzhi yi ngo bo lha mo bzhi/ /dbus su nges par gnas pa ste/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i rang bzhin gyis/ /sa gsum la ni khyab pa'o/ / lha yi (deder ni kha bzhi pa'i/ /lha tshogs rdo rje nyid yin no/ /de la sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni/ /rnam 'phrul thams cad 'di yi'odzi/ /ci lta ci ltar sems can rnams/ /skye bar 'gyur ba lan nyid de/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi rnam 'phrul ni/ /sna tshogs rdo rje yin par 'gyur / /de las gang byung lha kun kyang / /rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam 'phrul yin / /sems can rnams ni chos kyi ngo bor blta47)/ /sa gsum thams cad gcig pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /rol pa mdzad pa sangs rgyas kyis gzigs shing / /de yis rnal 'byor dbang phyug ma kun mthong / / lha yi rinadam tshig gi le'u ste dang po'o// //rtag tu mchog ldan khyod kyi ni/ /dam tshig lha mo thams cad kyi/ /mchog tu gyur pa'i lha mo ni/ /du mchis bdag cag zhu bar 'tshal/ /de la glu bzhi gsungs pa ste/ /steng 79dang dbyer med byas pa'i chos mnyam rang snang ma/ /zhi 81wa 280

la thar pa ma dang mchog tu 0)mnyam byed ma/ /gang phyir sgyu ma'i mdzad pas sangs rgyas rnams dang mnyam/ /mkha' mnyam thams cad rol pa zhi ba med pa'o / /ru lu ru lu bh+yo ru dha/ mkha' dang mnyam pa'i chos rnams kun du rol pa ste / /sgyu ma'i rang bzhin dang ni sgra brnyan chos mnyam snang / /lhan cig gnas min cha ste rang nyid pi wang mtshungs/ /byas pa'i snang ba dang ni mnyam par gyur pa'o / /gang zhig chos rnams snang ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa/ /der ni rdo rje mdzad pa gzugs can lta bu ste/ /rdo rje'i theg pa der ni gzugs sogs 'dod yon gyi/ /bde ba mi zad sna (nasatshogs dang mnyam stsol mdzad pa'o/ /rnal 'byor gnas ni du ma'i rdo rje'i tshul 'di ni/ /du ma'i gzugs 'dzin der ni rdo rje dang mnyam zhing / / nyid dang 'dra ba'i sems dpa' rnams ni spro rin mdzad pa'i/ /rdo rje dbyings dang lhan cig mchog stsol mdzad/ /rang bdag mkha' mnyam bzhugs la bskul ba ni/ /gang zhig rtse gcig sems kyis 'di nyan cing ske/ /brjod bcas sems kyi glu 'di 'dzin pa'o/ /glu 'di nam mkha' dang ni mnyam pa ste/ /der ni gzugs bcas rdo rje len pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje'i bdag nyid thugs ni sad byed cing / /rang bzhin gcig pa'i phyir ni 4)rgyud kyang len par 'gyur/ /'di ni rdo rje'i tshig ste rdo rje gzhan rang de)bzhin/ /sngags pas thugs chud dkyil 'khor kun bsgoms shing / /chos kyi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pad mchog der bsgom pa/ /dkyil 'khor dbus gnas chos ni r+ghaṃ gi dbye ba can/ /gzugs rnams thams cad sgyu ma'i ngo bor nges par brtag /thugs kyi ngo bor gcig bsam rdo rje theg pa'o/ /sems ni mkha' mnyam sems kyi theg pa rang bzhin med/ /gnyis ku'i rang bzhin yang ni lus can ma yin te/ /81—281

der ni rdo rje la ni med pa yis(1)/ /rdo rje sems dpa' khyod ni gcig pa'i rang bzhin te/ /'jig rten pa la sgyu ma'i rang bzhin nyid du mdzad/ /sems can 'dul ba'i rang bzhin du ni sad mdzad pa/ /kye lags rdo rje sems dpa' khyod ni gcig pa'i dngos/ /lha mo bzhis smras rdo rje kun tu spangs pa ste/ /nang du gnas pa rdo rje rol par ldan pa dang / /thugs kyi ngo bo (genyid kyis der ni rab tu gnas/ /thugs kyi gsang ba'i chos ni rnam par 'byung ba'o/ /nam mkha'i rang bzhin can gyi rdo rje spro bya zhing / /spros pa'i rdo rje slar yang bsdu byas te/ /sems kyi rang bzhin du ni gcig phyir ro/ /sems ni 'gog par gyur pa na/ /kun kyang mnyam zhing mtshungs par mthong / /yang dang yang du sngags bsdus pas / /gcig pa'i rnam par bya ba'o/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u ste gnyis pa'o// // bram ze dang ni gdol pa gcig pa'i rang bzhin du/ /chos rnams kyi ni rang bzhin sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'o/ /gcig gi rang bzhin la gnas pa yi ②dngos po ste/ /de la rdo rje can gyis mnyam pa'i ngo bor gsungs/ /bram ze dang ni khyi dag gegacig pa'i dngos yin zhing / /rus pa'i rgyan rnams kyang ni sgyu ma'i rang bzhin te/ /rdo rje'i go 'phang de la len pa'i rang bzhin no/ /rnal 'byor de la mnyam pa'i ngo bor des 9de)mthong ste/ /de dang mnyam pa'i rang bzhin sems can rnams la sbas/ /de yi rnal 'byor rang bzhin lha mos gsungs pa ni/ /lha mo thams cad der ni gcig pa'i rang bzhin te/ /gtso bo dang bcas mdzes pa 96nagacig pu 'byung gyur khyod/ /mnyam pa rang bzhin de ni 81—282

sngags pa gcig pu ste/ /rdo rje rnam par sad par byed pa gcig pu nyid/ /der ni zhe snang rang bzhin dag ni zhig pa ste/ /yan lag phyed pa'i chos ni 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin/ /der ni rdo rje'i btsun mo gcig rang bzhin/ /gang tshe rdo rje la ni dbyangs kyis bstod pa'i tshe/ / lha yi nyu)g.yon gyi phyed dang gcig tu gyur par blta / /lung nyid tshad mar byas nas rdo rje rdokyesems dpa' ①de bsgom bya/ /gsung gi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u ste gsum pa'o// //glang po dang ni rta dang mi dang khyi dang ni/ /ba lang ༅sha ste thams cad ma lus gyur pa rnams/ /dam tshig de nyid gcig pa'i rang bzhin nyid yin te/ /mkha' mnyam rang bzhin can gyis rnal 'byor pas bza' ⑤ba'i/ /dam tshig 'di ni lha mo bzhi pos gsungs pa'o/ /rnal 'byor pa la bsgom pa'i sems dang ldan gyur cing / /sems gcig pa ni rdo rje 'chang nyid 'grub 'gyur te/ /dngos po nyid dang bcas pa'i thugs ni skye bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i dngos mdzad zhi ba ma gsungs snying po ste/ /'di ltar chos rnams mnyam pa nyid du rtogs bya zhing ske/ /de ltar mkha' dang mnyam par rnam par dpyad par bya/ /lha 'di rnam snang lha mo lnga rnams de'i bdag nyid/ /rdo rje theg pa la ni mnyam pa'i rang bzhin te / /skul 0byed mas ni srid pa'i lnga)rang bzhin yin phyir ro/ /gcig pa'i dang po rdo rje sems te skur mthong ba/ /rdo rje'i theg par 'dod rnams lha mos 'di skad gsungs/ /bden pa ⑧bskyed pa 'di ni rnam snang lha mos gsungs/ /'di ni zla ba'i dbus gnas bsgom pa rdo rje'i gsang sngags te/ /de ni sems gcig pa yis rdo rje rnam bsgom pa/ /rab tu 'bar ba'i rdo rje rtse gsum pa nyid do/ /81—283

rnal 'byor gnas kyi dbus gnas rdo rje'i rang bzhin bsgom/ /ngas ni rdo rje'i theg par 'di skad du/ /chos rnams gcig pa'i rang bzhin nyid du bstan/ /sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //dngos med mi rtag pa las dngos bcas lus bsgom minahu)/ /lha mos skul (kyeb byed pa'i dngos po ste/ /de ltar chos las nges par brtag bya bas/ /sems ni nam mkha' lta bu'i mtshan nyid dang / /dngos po theg pa med pa'i dngos por bya / /dngos po'i ri cicirang bzhin la ni theg pa med pa ste/ /sems ni nam mkha' nyid dang mnyam pa'i rang bzhin can/ /snga ma ci bzhin sems ni rnam par sbyar bar bya/ /ci ltar de ni dngos por bya ba ste/ /dngos po 'di ni mtheg par 'grub par mi 'gyur te/ /sems can nam mkha' lta bu'i mtshan nyid dang / /dbus su tshig ni chos la nges rtog par/ /sems las dngos po nyid du bya ba ste/ /rnam pa du ma'i tshul gyi rang bzhin gyis(5)/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bskyed par bya ba'ol/ /ci ltar dang zhing 56)rnyog pa med pa'i chu/ /'di 'dra'i sems ni myur ba'i ngo bor bsgrubadu7/ /de ltar bstan du med pa 'di ni nga yis bstan/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sku yi rang bzhin gyis/ /bzhi pa'i rnam pa'i ngo bor bya ba ste/ /de la rdo rje'i chu ni yi dam lha yi 8)rang bzhin can/ /thugs kyi ngo bo'i rnal 'byor pas bza' bya/ /chos dang dge 'dun dang ni rdo rje'i chu ste de rnams mnyam pa'i rang bzhin te/ /zhag dang khrag sogs mchog tu mdzes par rab bzhugs dngos po'i lus ni bsgyur bar bya/ /bza' dang bca' lhonyedang mal stan la sogs de rnams thams cad 'di'i rang bzhin/ /gang zhig ting nge 'dzin du nges par 81—284

bstan pa'ang de dang gcig pa'i rang bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas kyis ni gsum char rdo rje'i ngo bor nyamadzad/ /chos rnams thams cad dngos po med pa'i rang bzhin te / /rdo rje can gyis sgyu ma'i rang bzhin nyid du gsungs/ / de yi pogerang bzhin mkha' mnyam so sor snang bar 'gyur/ /sgyu ma'i ngo bor nges par bstan pa yis//rdo rje yi ni nges par 'jug par bya ba ste/ /sems can rang bzhin la ni theg par med/ /sems ni de la gnas pa'i snying po'o/ /de lta'i ngo bos (mithugs kyi bdag nyid kyi/ /sngags pa khyod ni 'grub par 'gyur ba ste/ /thugs dang spro dang slar yang bsdus bya ba/ /gsum car yang ni gcig pa'i rang bzhin no/ /sems ni ri rab rtsu dang mnyam byas te/ /dag pa'i sangs rgyas su ni sems slar bskyed / /sems dub gyur na slar yang bsdu ba dag /der ni sngags pas des brtag bsgom par bya/ /bsdus pa'i ngo bos slar yang sbyar bar bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' der ni sku (gegayos mdzad/ /slar yang nam mkha'i ngo bos khro bas te / /de ltar spros dang bsdus pa'i rang bzhin no/ /de la rdo rje sems dpa' gcig dngos grub pa'i phyir/ /de'i phyir spro ba'ang rdo rje 'chang du rigs/ /sngags pas brtan par gyur na spro/ /brtan par ma gyur 'dir spros pa/ /lus nyon mongs kyi 'bras mi 'byin/ /nges par 'grub 'gyur theg pa'i dngos/ /thams cad bden pa 'di ri45)rnams bstan/ /de lta'i chos ni bsgom tshonapa yi/ /dngos po rdo rje'i rang bzhin no/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems ni smad mi bya/ /gang yang dri ma cis kyang gos pa min/ /kye rnal 'byor pa/ bcom ldan 'das yum skul 9rgyadabyed ma ni dang po'i rang bzhin te/ /rdo rje bskyed par bsgoms pas (8༄sangs rgyas bskyed mdzad pa'o/ /lha mo rnams ni lha dang gcig pa'i rang 81—285

bzhin te/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sangs rgyas 'byor pa bskyed ①mdzad pa'o/ /rjes su 'dzin pas bsgom pa'i (misems dang ni/ /yi ge hūṃ gis kyang ni de 'grub 'gyur / /brla dang rkang pa dag tu rnam rtog pa'i/ /rmongs pa yid la bya ba ma yin no/ /'jig rten gsum gyi 'khor lo 'di nyid ni/ /rdo rje'i 'od zer gyis ni yang dag bcings/ /sngags pas nam mkha'i khams su khro bo'i lha/ /bye ba stong phrag dag ni spro bya ste/ /gcig pa'i ngo bor gyur pa'i rdo rjer ni/ /slar yang nges par bsdu bar bya ba yin/ /byang chub theg pa sems kyi rang bzhin te//byang chub kyang ni sems kyi rang bzhin no/ / gnyis ka ②rang bzhin sems kyi theg pa ste/ /sems kyang ④/mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rang bzhin no/ /rgyud gzhan dang thun mong ba'i le'u rin)ste lnga pa'o// //ji bzhin brnyes pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud rdzogs sto// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po tāk+ṣa ka ga ṇa 4)dang / lo tsā tho)ba mang 'or dge slong byang chub shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa(8) rishe)81—286

༄tsho/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang chen gsang ba 'dus pa zhes bya ba brtag pa'i rgyal po chen po/tir༄zag /rgya gar skad du/ sarba ta thā ga ta kā 2)ya bā rtsit+ta ra ha sro gu h+ya tshadas mā dza nā ma ma hā kulpa rā dza/ bod skad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang chen gsang ba 'dus pa zhes bya ba brtag pa'i rgyal po chen po/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa 4dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi snying po rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga rnams la bzhugs so/ /brjod kyis mi lang ba'i yang brjod kyis mi lang ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul phra rab snyed kyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dam tshig rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sku rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gsung rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thugs rdo rje 81—289

dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ting nge 'dzin rdo rje dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyal ba rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chu rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po me rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rlung rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha' rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gzugs rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sgra rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dri rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ro rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po reg bya rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid ①rdo rje dang / de dag la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brjod kyis mi lang ba'i yang brjod kyis mi 92)lang ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul phra rab snyed rnams ladang —/ de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam pa la yang 'di lta ste/de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje mi bskyod pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje rin chen tog dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje 'od dpag med dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje don yod pa dang de dag la sogs pa nam mkha'i khams (0thams cad dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang / thabs cig (57tu bzhugs pa ni (6)'di lta ste dper na til gyi gang bu bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis nam mkha'i khams thams cad shin tu yongs su gang bar snang bar gyur to/ /de nas 81—290

bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'dod chags chen po'i tshul zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bkod pa de dag nyid kyi sku la zhugs par mdzad do/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi bdag po yongs su mnyes par bya ba'i phyir nyid kyi sku bud med kyi gzugs su mngon par sprul nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po'i sku las mngon par byung bar gyur to/ /de la la la ni sangs rgyas spyan gyi rnam par ro/ /la la ni stimā ma khri'i rnam par ro/ /la la ni (snyegos dkar mo'i rnam par ro/ /la la ni (kyedam tshig sgrol ma'i rnam par yang dag par gnas par gyur tol/ /la la ni ④gzugs kyi ngo bo'i rnam pas/ la la ni (bsgra'i ngo bo'i rnam pas/la la ni yidri'i ngo bo'i rnam pas/ la la ni 4)ro'i ngo bo'i rnam pas/ la la ni (8)reg bya'i ngo bo'i rnam pas yang dag par gnas par gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi btsun mo'i bha ga la gru bzhi 'ordul med pa dam tshig chen po'i dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlabs pa ni/gsal ba de yi mngo bo nyid/ /sna tshogs gzugs kyis kun du rgyas/ /sangs rgyas sprin ni kun tu bkramanyalha/ /me stag 'phro ba mang po 'khrug /gsal ba la sogs dkyil 'khor ldan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i bdag po des/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bdag nyid bzhag par gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs 81—291

pa mi bskyod pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen tog dang / de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med dang / de bzhin gshegs pa don yod grub pa dang /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad rnams de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub kyi sems rdo rje'i thugs la bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub kyi sems rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad zil gyis gnon pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po snyoms par zhugs pa tsho1)de ma thag tu/ de nas nam mkha'i dbyings 'di thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i ngo bor gnas par gyur to/ /de nas nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad na gnas pa'i sems can ji snyed pa de dag thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i byin gyis tshonabarlabs kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bde ba dang yid bde ba thob par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub kyi sems rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i dam tshig byung ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ rig pa chen po skyes bu'i gzugs de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sngags kyi byin gyis dbarlabs kyis byin gyis brlabs so/ /byin gyis brlabs pa tsam gyis de ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi sems rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa de nyid zhal gsum pa'i rnam par de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gzigs par gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod ④pa la sogs pa bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po'i thugs ka (5kyinas mngon par byung ste ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do(6)/ /e ma ho rinasangs rgyas 81—292

thams cad kyi/ /byang chub sems ni rab 'jug pa(1)/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsang / /rab tu mi rtog gnas med pa'o(na / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yang rdo gcig tu 'dus nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub kyi sems rdo rje la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchod pa spros pa'i dam tshig de kho na nyid kyi rin po che'i sprin gyis yang dag par mchod de phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /'dus pa gsang ba las byung ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsang / /rdo rje snying po btus pa yi/ /de nyid bcom ldan bshad du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub kyi sems rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad legs so legs so/ /'on kyang 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyang the tshom skye bar byed pa yin na byang chub sems dpa' gzhan rnams lta ci smos/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ngo mtshar du gyurab/ rmad du byung bar gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi the tshom thams cad gcod par mdzad pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gang bcom ldan 'das 'di lta bu'i yon tan khyad par can la yang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba ston par mi spro ba (zhede / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la byin gyis brlab (6)pa mdzad nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig 'byung (7)ba'i tshig gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bde ba dang / yid bde ba myong 81—293

bar bgyi ba nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes dang / mngon par shes pa'i 'bras bu thob par bgyi ba'i bar gyi phyir yang dag par bstan du gsolam/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsol ba btab pa de mkhyen nas/ ye shes sgron ma rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ zhe sdang gi rigs kyi sngags mchog gi snying po'i 6)snying po 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /badz+ra jika(kye /de nas 'di phyung ma thag tu/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rig pa'i skyes bu de nyid mi bskyod pa'i phyag rgya chen por (7sbyor ba mchog gi gnas kyis nag po dkar po dmar po'i rnam pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje la bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te gti mug gi rigs kyi sngags mchog gi snying po'i snying po 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /dzi na dzika /de nas 'di phyung ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo cigasung thugs kyi rig pa'i skyes bu de nyid rnam par snang mdzad kyi phyag rgya chen por tsho'i/sbyor ba mchog gi gnas kyis dkar po nag po dmar po'i rnam pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i spyan sngar bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rin po che 'byung ba'i rdo rje dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/yid bzhin nor bu'i rigs kyi sngags mchog gi snying po'i snying po 'di nyid kyi sku 81—294

gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /rat+na zhuka(3) /de nas 'di phyung ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rig pa'i skyes bu de nyid rin chen tog gi phyag rgya chen por ( sbyor ba nam mkha' mchog gi gnas kyis ser po nag po dkar po'i rnam pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung tsho thugs rdo rje'i g.yas phyogs su bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'dod chags chen po'i rgyun ( 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rdo rje 'dod chags kyi rigs kyi sngags mchog gi snying po'i snying po 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /ā ro lika /de nas 'di phyung ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rig pa'i skyes bu de nyid 'jig rten dbang phyug gi rig (gepa'i bdag po chen po'i phyag rgya chen por la sbyor ba mchog gi gnas kyis dmar po nag po dkar po'i rnam pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rgyab tu bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi don yod mchog gi dam tshig 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas dam tshig dgug pa'i rigs kyi sngags (7)mchog gi snying po'i snying po 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /pradz+nyā sgrika(8) /de nas 'di phyung ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs lakyi rig pa'i skyes bu de nyid rdo rje don yod pa'i phyag rgya chen por 7sbyor ba mchog gi gnas kyis ljang khu nag po dkar po'i rnam pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i byang phyogs su bzhugs so/ /zhe snang gti mug de bzhin (nyachags/ /81—295

yid bzhin nor bu dam tshig ste/ /rigs ni lnga po 'di rnams nyid/ /'dod dang thar par bsgrub pa'o/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa rjes su chags pa'i dam tshig ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad kyi btsun mo'i mchog 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /de ṣa ra ti/ de nas 'di phyung ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rig pa'i skyes bu de nyid bud med kyi gzugs 'dzin par gyur te/shar 1)phyogs kyi grwar bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rjes su chags pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi btsun mo'i mchog 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo tshonas/ /mo ha ra ti/ de nas 'di phyung ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rig pa'i skyes bu de nyid bud med kyi gzugs 'dzin par gyur te lho phyogs kyi tsha )grwar bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'dod chags 'dzin pa/ rjes su chags pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'dod chags 'dzin pa'i btsun mo'i mchog 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /rā ga ra ti/ de nas 'di phyung ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rig pa'i skyes bu de nyid bud med kyi gzugs 'dzin par gyur te nub phyogs kyi 4)grwar bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs slu ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting 81—296

nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi shes rab 'chang ba rjes su chags pa'i rdo rje 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo //badz+ra ra ti/ de nas 'di phyung ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rig 17pa'i skyes bu de nyid bud med kyi gzugs 'dzin par gyur te/ byang gi grwar bzhugs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi btsun mo'i mchog phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin (gel snyoms par zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor byin gyis rlob pa zhes bya ba'i khro bo chen po 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /ya mān+ta kṛtan )/ de nas 'di phyung ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rig pa'i skyes bu de nyid de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bsnyengs par byed pa'i rnam pas shar phyogs kyi sgor bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor byin gyis rlob pa zhes bya ba'i khro bo chen po 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /pradz+nyān+ta kṛta(0ri/ de nas 'di phyung ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rig pa'i skyes bu de nyid rdo rje dam tshig bsnyengs par byed pa'i rnam pas lho phyogs kyi sgor bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos rin po che 'byung gnas rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'dod chags 81—297

'chang ba'i dkyil 'khor byin gyis rlob pa zhes bya ba'i khro bo chen po 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /pad mān+ta kṛtahu)/ de nas de phyung ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rig pa'i skyes bu de nyid de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung bsnyengs par byed pa'i rnam pas nub phyogs kyi sgor bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi dkyil 'khor byin gyis rlob pa khro bo chen po 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / / bisnan+ta kṛta(kye/ de nas de phyung ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rig pa'i skyes bu de nyid de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs bstengs (mipar byed pa'i rnam pas byang phyogs kyi sgor bzhugs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung dang thugs mnyes par byed pa dang ④dkyil 'khor gyi dam tshig sems dpa' rnams so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang chen gsang ba 'dus pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor byin gyis rlob (9pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi bdag po la bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mchod pa byas te phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad 56)ces gsol to/ /snying po sku gsung 81—298

thugs mchog ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi 4)gsang / /bla na med pa'i byang chub sems/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ( bshad du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i bdag pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsol ba btab pa mkhyen cing / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sems kyi yongs su rtog pa thugs kyis mkhyen nas byang chub sems dpa' de ②rnams la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /khyed kyis sems lus kyi rnam pa dang / lus sems kyi rnam pa dang / sems tshig tu brjod pas skyed cig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rnams ni nam mkha' lta bur yang dag par sbyar nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do④ / /e ma ho (bkun du bzang po yi/ /sku dang gsung thugs rdo rje can/ /skye ba med pa sbyor ba yis/ /skye ba 'di ni rab tu bsgrags/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i tshul rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dngos po med la sgom pa med/ /bsgom pa bsgom pa ma yin nyid/ /de ltar dngos po dngos med de/ /sgom rdzi)pa dmigs su med pa'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje (pede bzhin gshegs pas gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pas (8stede bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mngon par rtogs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 81—299

zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dngos po thams cad rnam bral phung po khams/ /skye mched gzung ba 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa/ /chos bdag med mnyam nyid kyis rang gi sems/ /gdod nas ma skyes stong nyid rang bzhin no/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad kyis gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje mi bskyod pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad (7mi zad pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dngos po 'di rnams ma skyes pa/ /chos dang chos nyid med pa ste/ /nam mkha' lta bur bdag med par/ /byang chub tshul 'di brtan (kyepa'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje mi bskyod pas gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje rin chen tog gis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams thams cad dngos med cing ske/ /chos kyi mtshan nyid rnam par spangs/ /chos bdag med las kun tu byung ske/ /byang chub tshul 'di brtan pa'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen tog gis gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje tshe /dpag tu med pas ye shes 'od zer sgron ma rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs sol/ /ma skyes pa yi lachos rnams la/ /ngo bo med de sgom (snyepa'ang med/ /nam mkha'i 56gnas kyi sbyor ba yis/ /'dis ni dngos po rab rdo tu bsgrags/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das/ de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje tshe dpag tu med pas gsungs 81—300

sol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje don yod grub pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad zil gyis gnon pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /gdod nas dag pa nam mkha' 3)bzhin/ /byang chub sems (micing mngon rtogs med/ /byang chub tshul 'di brtan pa'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje don yod grub pas gsungs so/ /de nas byams pa la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba'i chos nyid kyi yi ge thos nas ngo mtshar du gyur/ rmad du byung bar gyur te ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas e ma'o chos chos bshad pa ni ngo mtshar che/ /yang dag don ni dag pa'i don/ /byang chub sems khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kyi bdag med yang dag byung / /sangs rgyas byang chub rdzogs mdzad pa/ /rnam par mi rtog dmigs su med/ /byang chub sems khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun du bzang po thams cad don/ /byang chub sems ni rab skor dub/ /byang chub spyod pa rdo rje che/ /byang chub sems khyod phyag 'tshal lo / /thugs ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i dag /sku dang gsung thugs rdo rje can/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab ston pa/ /byang chub sems khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang chen gsang ba 'dus pa las byang chub kyi sems kyi le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung 81—301

thugs rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'phro ba sprin bkod pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te rdo rje bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā bād+ma ko3 1)rta/ nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus gnas par/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor bsgom babya ste/ /'od zer sprin gyi bkod pa che/ /sangs rgyas 'bar ba'i 'od dang mnyam/ /'od zer lnga ni kun du khyab/ /kun nas yongs su zlum po ste / /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis spras/ /mchod pa rnam pa lngas brgyan pa/ /bsgom par byas nas bsdus pa yis/ /gzugs ni dbus su bsgom par bya/ /rnam par snang mdzad phyag rgya che/ /sku gsung thugs kyis sematshan pa'o/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yi/ phyag rgya yang ni (pebasgom par bya/ /bsdus pa gnyis med sbyor ba yis/ /mi bskyod phyag rgya mchog rab dang / /rin chen tog gi ⑤phyag rgya che/ /tshe dpag med pa'i 'od byed dang / /don grub phyag rgya chen po rnams / /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor dag tu bsgom/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can / /yin dra nī la'i kha dog 'dra/ /rab 'bar phyag na rdo rje bsnams/ /rnam par gtsigs rimagasal 'jigs su rung / /shel ⑦dang zla ba'i 'od dang 'dra//thor tshugs phyogacod pan gyis brgyan (7pa/ /rab 'bar phyag na 'khor lo bsnams/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes par brgyan/ /'dzam bu chu bo'i gser 'od 'dra/ /sangs rgyas sprin ni kun du 'khrigs/ /rtse mo dgu pa'i rdo rje che/ /de yi phyag tu rnam par bsgom/ /ma ra ka ⑩ta'i 'od 'dra ba/ /rdo rje 'bar bas rnam par brgyan / /kun du 'bar ba'i sprin gyis khyab/ /phyag na rin chen bsnams par bsgom / /pad ma rā ga'i mdog 'dra ba/ /gtso bo 'dod chags 'od 'bar 81—302

'chang ske/ /rab 'bar phyag na pad ma bsnams/ /'dod chags rdo rje can bsgom bya/ /'od zer lnga yi mdog 'dra ba'i/ /sna tshogs don yod rdo rje can/ /zhi ba phyag na ral gri bsnams/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor du ni bsgom/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pas chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlob pa'i sngags 'di gsungs so0)/ /oṃ dharma dhā ༷ tu swa bhā ba ād+ma ko3 (5)lha/ rin chen chen po kha dog lnga/ /yungs kur ④gyi ni 'bru tshad tsam/ / sna yi (5)rtse mor nan tan du/ /rnal 'byor gyis ni rtag tu bsgom/ /rin chen brtan par gyur na spro/ /brtan par ma gyur yong mi spro/ /sangs rgyas 'bar ba mnyan (6)pa'i 'od/ /rab mchog sprin rnams spro bar bya/ /'khor lo rdo rje rin chen ches/ /pad ma ral gri mtshon cha 'dzin/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sprin chen rnams/ / spro ba'i 87)bdag nyid can gyis spro/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus gnas par/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /gsal ba'i (nyedakyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /pad ma'i dkyil 'khor yang dag gsal/ /pad ma sgom pas bsgom par bya/ /rin chen dkyil 'khor yang dag gsal/ /rin chen brtson pas bsgom par bya/ /sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor las byung ba/ /nam mkha' 'dra bar bri (9)bar bya/ /sangs rgyas rab mchog 'di rnams nyid/ /sku gsung thugs ni sgrub 7pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor rdo rje las byung ba/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i tshul thob pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang chen gsang ba 'dus pa las rdo rje bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin 81—303

zhes bya ba'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 1yang 'dus nas/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi bdag po la bstod pa'i rgyal po 'dis gsol ba btab bo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /chos kun bdag med pa yi rinamachog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /mtshan nyid thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /mtshan nyid min pa thams cad spangs/ /kun du bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /zhi ba'i chos mchog las byung ba / /ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong du rimadzad/ /kun du bzang po nga)gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /sems can kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag cing dri ma med/ /kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo sgyur/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni bshad du gsol/ /de nas ston pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /'jig rten gsum pa 55)khams gsum pa/ /'jig rten gsum mchog rdo rje gtso/ /'jig rten gsum mchog ston pa po/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor tshul//dkyil 'khor nyams dga' rab tu bshad/ /de nas de phyir thugs dkyil 'khor//mchog thugs rdo rje rab 'dra ba/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs rnams kyi/ /dkyil 'khor yang dag rab bshad bya/ /lus dang ngag sems bsgoms pa yis/ /shes rab can gyis thig gdab pa/ /thig skud sar (6pa legs bkal ba/ /tshad 7ma bzang po mdzes pa yis/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa ni/ /khru ni bcu 81—304

gnyis tshad du bya/ /ngos bzhi dang ni grwa hu)bzhi dang / /sgo bzhi bar ni rab tu brtag /de yi dbus su 'khor lo ni/ /rab tu skum po bri bar bya/ /cho ga mthong ba'i las kyis ni/ /de nas phyag rgya dgod par bya/ /de dbus rdo rje bri ba ni/ /yin dra nī la'i kha dog 'dra/ /'bar ba chen po rtse lnga pa/ /'jigs pa dag kyang rab 'jigs byed/ /shar du 'khor lo chen po ni/ /rdo rje 'bar bas rnam par brgyan/ /lho ru rin chen chen po ni/ /'od zer mang po rab tu 'khrigs / /nub tu pad+ma chen po ni/ /pad+ma rā ga'i kha dog 'dra/ /byang du ral gri chen po ni/ /'od zer 'bar ba rab 'khrigs bri/ /dbus su sprin ni zhi ba'i 'od / /spyan ni shar gyi grwa ru bri/ /mā ma tī yi rigs byung ②ba'i/ /rdo rje de bzhin lho ru'o/ /pad ma kha bye sdong bur bcas/ /nub tu kun du bri bar bya/ /byang du ut+pal mdzes pa ni/ /mthing ka sprin dang 'dra ba bri/ /tho ba kun nas 'od mdzes 'bar/ /shar gyi sgor ni bri bar bya/ /rdo rje 'bar sogs 'od bzang ba/ /dbyug pa lho ru kun du bri/ /pad ma ral gri 'bar 'od byed/ /nub tu kun du bri bar bya/ /rdo rje 'khyil ba rdo rje can/ /byang du rdo rje bri bar bya / /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa de/ /yongs su gsal bar shes byas nas/ /lus dang ngag sems mchod pa yis/ /nan tan du ni mchod par (sne/bya/ /btsun mo mdzes shing mdangs bzang ba/ /lo grangs bcu drug la (pernyed nas/ /dri dang me tog brgyan byas te/ /de dbus su ni 'dod pa 9shebya/ /yon tan ske rags (6mā ma khritshon/ /shes rab can gyis de byin brlabs/ /zhi ba spro bya sangs rgyas gnasal/ /nam mkha'i dbyings ni rab tu brgyan/ /bshang gci khu ba khrag ge)la sogs / /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas dang / /81—305

byang chub sems dpa' grags chen mnyes/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang chen gsang ba 'dus pa las/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ /kun gyi sku dang gsung thugs kyi/ /rdo rje 'chang ba'i rgyal po ni/ /gnas kyi dbang phyug kun mchog gis/ /spyod pa kun mchog chos kyi don/ /spyod pa'i mtshan nyid bka' stsal to/ /rnam par mi rtog ①don las byung / /'dod chags zhe snang gti mug 'khrugs/ /theg pa'i mchog ni bla na med/ /rab mchog dngos grub sgrub par byed/ /gdol pa snyig ②ma mkhan la sogs/ /gsod don don gnyer sems pa rnams/ /theg chen bla na med pa yi/ /theg mchog 'di la 'grub par 'gyur/ /sems can mtshams med las gsogs pa/ /sdig pa chen po byed pa yang / /de rnams kun kyang theg pa che / /mchog gi sgrub pa 'dir 'grub 'gyur/ /slob dpon smod pa po gzhan dag /bsgrubs kyang 'grub par yong mi 'gyur/ /srog gcod pa yi sems can gang ske/ /brdzun du smra la dga' ba dang / /gzhan gyi nor la chags pa dang / /rtag tu 'dod pa spyod dga' gang / /bshang gci zas su za ba ste/ /de rnams sgrub pa'i skal (peldan 'gyur/ /ma dang sring mo bu mo la/ /sgrub po gang gis 'dod byas na/ /theg chen mchog gi chos su ni/ /dngos grub rgya chen des 'thob (depo/ /sangs rgyas gtso bo'i yum dag la/ /mnyes par byas kyang mi gos te / /de ni blo can rnam mi rtog⑥ /sangs rgyas nyid du 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nas sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la (7sogs pa/ byang chub sems 81—306

dpa' ①sems dpa' chen po rnams ngo mtshar du gyur/ rmad du byung bar gyur te/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po ci'i slad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor gyi nang du 'di lta bu'i tshig ngan pa gsung zhes ②gsol to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis (sne/sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi tshig gsan nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu rnams thong ④de skad ma smra (7cig /chos nyid dag 'di sangs rgyas ni/ /snying po ye shes can rnams kyi(6)/ /snying po'i chos kyi don byung ba / /'di dag byang chub spyod pa'i gnas/ /de nas yang brjod kyis mi lang ba'i yang brjod kyis mi lang ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing ri rab la sogs ⑦pa'i rdul phra mo snyed kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'jigs shing skrag la brgyal (8)bar gyur to / /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byang chub sems dpa' de dag brgyal bar gyur pa gzigs nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi bdag po la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di dag bslang shidu gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa nyid gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i bdag po'i tso'od kyis reg pa tsam gyis/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag rang rang gi stan la gnas par gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin 81—307

gshegs pa thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur rmad du gyur①/ dgyes pas khyab par gyur nas (michos kyi dbyangs 95)'di skad ces gsungs so/ /e ma'o chos e ma'o chos / /e ma'o chos kyi don 'byung ba/ /chos don dag pa bdag med pa/ /rdo rje rgyal po phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sku dang gsung thugs rab tu dag /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam nyid gnas/ /rnam par mi 'gyur snang ba med/ /rdo rje'i ④sku la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /thugs ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtso/ /dus gsum dag gi lam du 'byung / /nam mkha' chen por (5)khams gyur pa/ /nam mkha'i lam la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /nam mkha'i (6)sku las yang dag byung / /nam mkha'i lam la gnas pa po/ /nam mkha'i (7)thugs te chos kyi mchog /spyod pa'i gnas khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang (8)thugs kyi gsang chen gsang ba 'dus pa las kun du spyod pa'i mchog gi le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje mi bskyod pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs (9te thugs byin gyis rlob 7pa'i sngags 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma ko3 hu)rta/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad kyis rdul dang bral ba'i rdo rje'i gnas zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te sku byin gyis rlob pa'i sngags 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa rtso bhā ba ād+ma ko3 (sme lha/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje tshe dpag tu med pas mnyam pa nyid 81—308

mi gnyis pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te gsung byin gyis rlob pa'i sngags 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wā 17ka badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma ko3 'a)lha/ rdo rje gsum pa sbyo de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang / /gnas dang gnas ni rnam par bsgom pa ste/ /de dag nyid mchog rab kyi sngags kyi ni/ /mtshan nyid mtshan ma ④bsgrub pa nyid du bya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje rin chen tog gis ye shes sgron ma rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te sngags 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma ko3 (ge lha/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje don yod grub pas rdo rje don yod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te sngags 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dzā badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma ko3 stirnya/ rtag tu 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas/ /sangs rgyas tshul bzhin mchod par bya/ /mchod pa rnam pa lnga rnams kyis/ /myur du sangs rgyas nyid thob 'gyur/ /zhes (7)bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi bdag po rdo rje 'chang chen pos gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi bdag po rdo rje 'chang chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sngags kyi (8)gsang chen 'di gsungs so/ /sngags dmigs pa yi lus kyis ni/ /ngag chadang yid la bskul byas pas/ /bsgrub bya rab mchog dngos grub dang / /yid ni yang dag dga' mdzes pa/ /sems kyi dmigs pa bdag med pa/ /ngag dang lus kyang rnam par bsgom/ /rnam ⑩gsum sbyor ba nam mkha' dang / /mnyam nyid gnas ni grub ṇa/nyapar bya/ /lus dang ngag dang sems dmigs pa'i/ /ngo bo nyid ni 81—309

dmigs su med/ /sngags kyi sku yi ①spyor ba yis/ /byang chub med cing sgom ②pa'ang med/ /sku gsung thugs kyi mtshan nyid 'di/ /rnam par dpyad nas bsdu ba yis/ /byang chub sbyor ba ting nge 'dzin/ /sngags kyi ②brtags pa bsgom par bya / /de nas dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis mchod/ /sangs rgyas kun mchog kun mkhyen gyis/ /sgom pu)pa'i mchog ni bka' stsal to/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya//sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms (minas/ /phra mo'i sbyor ba kun du brtsam/ / sna yi 6)rtse mor yungs kur bsamacha/ /yungs kur nirgyu dang mi rgyu ba/ /ye shes gnas ni nyams dga' ba/ /gsang ba'i ⑨yi shes brtags pa bsgom/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus yiganas par/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya / /sangs rgyas sku yi (lhaganas bsgoms te/ /de yi ⑩steng du gnas dgod dol/ /rtsu nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /spyan gyi tshul gyi sbyor ba la/ /de nas pad ma rdo rje sgomatso/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /rin chen dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya / /dang po'i sbyor ba nan tan gyis/ /de yi steng du yongs su bsgom/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /sangs rgyas tshul ni zhi ba spro/ /'khor dag khyad par dag tu spro/ / ut+pal mthing ku'i 8mdog 'dra ba/ /rtse mo lnga pa khyad par du/ /nas kyi 'bru tshad nan tan gyis/ / sna yi 7rtse mor rnam par bsam/ /tsa yin ka yi 'bru tshad kyi/ /'dab ma brgyad pa ge sar bcas/ /sna yi rtse mor 'di shis te/ /byang chub gzhol bas bsgom par bya/ /'khor lo la sogs khyad par du/ /bsgom pa der 81—310

ni brtag ①par bya/ /dngos grub thams cad yon tan gnas/ /nyams dga' byang chub gnas 'grub la'agyur/ /sangs rgyas byang chub gnas rnams ni/ /bsdu bas der ni spro bar bya/ /sku gsung (gyethugs kyi mtshan ma ④yi/ /chos kyi gnas ni rab tu dbyung / /de nas dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /de nyid don kun ston pa pos⑤/ /spyod pa kun mchog legs dag pa/ /gsang ba'i dam pa bka' stsal to/ /gzugs dang sgra dang ror 6)ldan pa/ /shes rab can gyis zla drug bsgom/ /gsang ba'i de (7nyid mchod chen (8)ni/ /legs mchod nas kyang bsgom par bya/ /zas su bshang po)gci bya ba'i phyir/ /dngos grub 'bras bu 'dod pas bya/ /bla med de nyid 'grub pa ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub skyon med pa'o / /sha yang bza' bar bya ba'i phyir/ /sha chen po ni rab tu brtag /gsang ba'i sku dang gsung dang thugs/ /dngos grub thams cad 'grub par 'gyur / /glang po'i sha dang rta yi sha /de bzhin dam pa khyi yi yisha /zas kyi phyir ni bza' bar bya/ /gzhan zas bza' bar yang mi bya/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni mnyes par 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo can yang / /'di lta bu yi /0sbyor ba yis/ /myur du sangs rgyas nyid 'thob 8'gyur/ /'dod khams dbang phyug 'jig rten 8du/ /go 'phang las ni byed par 'gyur/ /stobs ldan gtso bo gzi brjid can/ /mdangs bzang mthong na ④yid du 'ong / /mthong ba tsam gyis bskul med par/ /'jig rten 'di dag dbang byed 'gyur/ /'di ni thams cad sangs rgyas kyi/ /gsang ba byang chub dam pa ste/ /yang dag sngags kyi gsang ba 'di/ /lus ngag sems las 'da' ba'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang chen gsang ba 'dus pa las sku 81—311

dang gsung dang thugs byin gyis rlob pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi bdag pos dam tshig chen po'i de kho na nyid sngags kyi spyod pa mchog rdzogs par byang chub pa'i le'u 'di gsungs so/ /'dod pa thams cad longs spyod pa/ /bsten pas ji ltar 'dod pa las/ /'di lta bu yi sbyor ba yis/ /nges par sangs rgyas myur thob 'gyur/ /'dod pa thams cad longs spyod pa/ /ji ltar 'dod pa bsten bya zhing / /rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bya/ /dka' thub nges pa mi bzad pas/ /bstan lho)pas 'grub par mi 'gyur gyi/ /'dod pa thams cad longs spyod pas/ /bsten na myur du 'grub ②par 'gyur/ /slongs mo za zhing mi bzlas te/ / slong la ②dga' bar yang mi bya/ /'dod pa kun la longs spyod cing / /sngags kyi yan lag ma nyams babazlas/ /lus dang ngag dang sems rnams ni/ /bder gnas thob na byang chub 'thobal/ /gzhan du dus min 'chi ba dang / /dmyal bar nges par bsreg yipar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /sngags kyi spyod pa mchog spyod pas/ /chos dang mi 'gyur mchog brnyes benams/ /'dod pa thams cad bsten pas so/ /chags can 2ye shes 'dod pa yis/ /'dod yon lnga rnams rtag tu brten97)/ /byang chub sems dpa' mnyes par bya/ /byang chub nyi ma chags par bya/ /gzugs la rnam tshegasum shes byas nas/ /mchod pa'i bdag nyid can mchod bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad gzhi/ /sgra la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /lha 81—312

rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung gnas gtso/ /dri la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /sangs rgyas sogs la dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /'dod chags chos kyi 'byung gnas gtso/ /ro la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid sangs rgyas sna tshogs pa/ /sangs rgyas don yod rdo rje 'dzin / /reg bya rnam gsum shes byas nas0)/ /rang gi rigs la dbul bar bya / /de nyid bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /mi bskyod ( pa yi tshul brnyes rnams/ /gzugs sgra dri la sogs pa la/ /rtag tu sems ni sbyar bar bya/ /'di de ②sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba'i ④snying po btus pa'o/ /gzugs sgra dri sogs sngags pa yis/ /lha rnams nyid du rtag tu bsgom/ /yang na de la rigs kyi ni/ /dbye ba rnam par bsgoms (depas bsgom/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran par sbyor / /chos ni rjes su dran sgom pa/ /lus dang ngag dang sems ni bsgom/ /rdo rje rjes su dran sgom (6)pa/ /rigs ni rjes dran sbyor ba las/ /khro bo rjes su dran sgom pa/ /dam tshig rjes dran sbyor ba las/ /bsgoms na byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /bud med gzugs ldan mdangs bzang ba/ /lo grangs bcu drug lon rnyed nas/ /byin gyis rlob pa'i gnas gsum gyis/ /dben par mchod pa rab tu brtsam(7/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i btsun mo che/ /spyan la sogs pa bsgom par bya/ /dbang po gnyis ni mnyam sbyar bas/ /sangs rgyas dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /yi ge hūṃ dang oṃ dag dang / /phaṭa kyang rnam par brtag par bya / /'od zer sna lngas khyab pa yin / /rdo rje pad mo bsgom par bya/ /de ni 'bar bcas zla 'od bzhin/ /yid du 'ong ba bsgom par bya/ /sangs rgyas 81—313

rjes dran sbyor la sogs/ /byang chub 'dod pas bsgom par bya/ /de la sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa ji ltar bsgom zhe na/ /bha gar ling ga rab bzhag nas/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni bsgom par bya/ /ba spu'i bu ga rtse bar nas/ /mkhas pas sangs rgyas sprin rnams spro/ /de la chos rjes su dran pa ji ltar bsgom zhe na/bha gar ling ga rab bzhag nas/ /rdo rje chos ni rab bsgom bya/ /ba spu'i bu ga rtse bar nas1/ /mkhas pas chos kyi sprin rnams spro/ /de la rdo rje rjes su dran pa ji ltar bsgom 25zhe na/ bha gar ling ga rab bzhag nas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rnam par bsgom/ /ba spu'i bu ga rtse bar nas/ /rdo rje sprin rnams spro bar bya/ /de la rigs rjes su dran pa ji ltar bsgom zhe na/ bha gar ling ga rab bzhag nas / /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab tu bsgom/ /ba spu'i bu ga'i rtse bar nas/ /mkhas pas rigs kyi sprin rnams spro/ /de la khro bo rjes su dran pa ji ltar bsgom zhe na/ bha gar ling ga rab bzhag tsho stanas/ /khro bo'i dbang po rab tu bsgom/ /ba spu'i bu ga rtse bar mnas/ /mkhas pas khro bo'i sprin rnams spro/ /de la dam tshig rjes su dran pa ji ltar bsgom zhe na/ rang gi rdo rje pad mar tshode/ldan/ /dbang po gnyis ni mnyam sbyar te/ /rang gi khu ba'i thigs pa yis/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' mchod/ /de la dkyil 'khor rjes su dran pa ji ltar bsgom zhe na/ dbang po gnyis ni mnyam gzhag (6༄ste/ /mkhas pas rang gi khu ba dag /rnal 'byor pa mi chen pos dbyung rdo / /dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor tshul du bya/ /de la sku rjes su dran pa ji ltar bsgom zhe na/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gang zhig /phung po lnga yis rab tu rgyas/ /sangs rgyas sku yi ngo bo yis /bdag kyang de dang 'drar gyur cig /de la gsung rjes su dran pa ji ltar bsgom 81—314

zhe na/ rdo rje chos kyi gsung gang zhig /nges pa'i tshig ni phun sum tshogs/ /bdag gi tshig kyang de 'dra bar/ /chos 'dzin pa dang 'drar gyur cig /de la thugs rjes su dran pa ji ltar bsgom zhe na/ kun du bzang po'i thugs gang zhig /gsang ba'i bdag po blo ldan pa/ /bdag gi sems kyang de 'dra bar/ /rdo rje 'dzin dang 'drar gyur cig /de la sems can rjes su dran pa ji ltar bsgom zhe na / sems can kun gyi sems gang yin/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi mtshan / /bdag gi sems kyang de 'dra zhing / /mkha' dang mtshungs 1par dpa' bo rnams/ /de la sngags kyi gzugs dang sku dang gsung dang thugs thams cad rjes su dran pa ji ltar bsgom zhe na/ sngags kyi rdo rje'i sku gang yin/ /gsung gi sku ni rnam bsgom pa/ /bdag kyang de dang 'dra ba'i sku/ /rtag tu sngags 'dzin pa dang mnyam/ /de la dam tshig rjes su dran pa ji ltar bsgom zhe na/dam tshig khu chu ②cho ga bzhin/ /'bras bu 'dod pas btung bya zhing / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs gsad bya/ /dngos grub rab mchog thob par 'gyur//de la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dam tshig rjes su dran pa ji ltar bsgom zhe na/thams cad rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /skye ba med cing zag pa med/ /byang chub med cing mngon rtogs med/ /khams kyang med cing 'byung ba med/ /de la ma skyes pa rjes su dran pa ji ltar bsgom zhe na/ rang bzhin 'od gsal de nas ni / /nam mkha' mtshan med mi 'gyur des/ /gnyis med gnyis su med min zhi / /shin tu dri med nam mkha' bzhin/ /de la zhe sdang gi rigs kyi mchod pa rjes su dran pa ji ltar bsgom zhe na/ bud med sems ni rab brtan pa/ /lo grangs bcu gnyis lon rnyed nas/ /rigs kyi sbyor ba'i rab dbye bas/ /rang 81—315

gi khu bas mchod par bya/ /'dis ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i thugs dag dang / /chos 'dzin mchog gi gsung dag ni/ /tshe 'di nyid la thob par 'gyur/ /sku dang gsung thugs yang dag grub/ /dman skyes gang gzhan bshad pa rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /bzlas pas de la 'grub par 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang chen gsang ba 'dus pa las sngags kyi spyod pa mchog gi le'u ste bdun pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen tog gis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po dam pa'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang chen po la bstod pa'i rgyal po 'dis gsol ba btab po/ /rdo rje rgyal po theg pa che/ /nam mkha'i 71)spyod pas rnam sbyong bskus/ /kun du bzang po'i spyod pa mchog /rgyal mchog mchod pa bshad du gsol/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug che/ /rdo rje theg pa rab ston pa/ /nam mkha'i dbyings dang mtshungs pa'i mchog /rgyal bzhi na)mchod pa bshad du gsol/ /thar 4)pa'i lam ni rab ston pa / /theg pa gsum gyi lam 'jug mdzad/ /sangs rgyas skal mchog dag pa'i bdag /mi mchog mchod pa bshad du gsol/ /byang chub sems ni rgyas pa'i spyan / /chos kyi 'khor lo rab skor ba/ /sku dang gsung thugs shin tu dag /rdo rje theg pa khyod phyag 'tshal/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /thams cad nam mkha' mi 'gyur che/ /thams cad dbang bskur kun gyi don/ /kun dbang rdo rje rin chen 'dzin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod pa'i mchog /rdo rje gsum 81—316
