ni mi phyed gnas/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs skal mchog /rgyal ba 'byung bar 'gyur ba bshad/ /na chung yangs pa'i mig can ni/ /gzugs dang lang tshos brgyan rnyed nas/ /lo grangs nyi shu lnga 1)lon gzung / /byol song las kyang rab tu brtag /sa phyogs gtsang zhing rnam par dben pa 'am/ /rgyal ba nyid skyes zhi ba zhi ba'i gnas/ /bshang gci nachu la sogs pas byug pa yang / /rgyal ba mchod phyir rtag par rab tu bya/ /nu ma'i dbus gang 5spyi gtsug mtha' dbus su / /cho ga shes pas rkang pa'i bar du yang / /lte ba ro smad gsang ba rgyal ba'i sras / /rigs lnga rnams ni dgod par 0rab tu bya/ /nam mkha'i 95skudabyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /ye shes rgya mtsho bsgom par bya/ /bdag nyid zla ba'i dbus gnas bsgom/ /mkhas pas zhi ba rdo rje 'dzin/ /snying gar 56༄gang zhig 'dod pa ni/ /bsdu ba dag kyang rab tu bya/ /mchod rten rin chen bzhi'i rang bzhin / /'od zer phreng bas rnam brgyan pa/ /ye shes rgya mtsho dus gsum gyi/ /gnas su gyur par rnam par bsam/ /rang gi ba spu'i bu ga nas/ /mkhas pas mchod pa'i sprin rnams spro/ /mkhas pas ut+pa la dag dang / /pad ma rnam pa lnga shes bya/ /dzā rtsonati rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /lha rnams la ni dbul 8bar bya/ /me tog kur ni ka ra dang / /mal+li 9ka dang ya 1 tshozi ka /me tog ka ra bī 11ra yang ske/ /bsams nas mchod pa rab tu brtag1rta /dpag tshad brgya yi khyon tsam dul/ /'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor bsgom bya zhing / /rnam par mkhas pas rtag par ni/ /rigs rnams rab tu dgod par bya/ /de bzhin pad ma rdo rje dang / /ral gri ut+pal nyusnyemakhas pas bsgom/ /dpag tshad bye ba'i khyon tsam la/ /gru bzhi shin tu mdzes pa yi/ /mchod rten rin chen bzhi'i rang bzhin/ /gsal zhing 81—317

rang bzhin dri ma med/ /rigs rnams gnas ni mchod pa'i phyir/ /shes rab can gyis bsgom par bya/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams kyis/ /de la mchod pa rgya mtsho brtsam/ /rin chen na bza' la sogs pas/ /byang chub 'dod pas 6)rtag tu mchod/ /mchod pa rnam lnga mchog rnams kyis②/ /rtag tu lha rnams mnyes par bya/ /rin chen 'byung gnas na chung mchog /rin chen sna tshogs la sogs brgyan/ /bsgrub cing rab tu bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas kun la dbul bar bya/ /rin chen bdun gyis yongs bkang ba'i/ /zhing 'di rnam par mkhas pas ni/ /ye shes 'dod pas dngos grub 'dod/ /nyin re shes rab can gyis dbul/ /bdag po'i phyag rgyar mnyam gzhag ①la/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor dbus dag tu/ /'dod chags blo can sangs rgyas la/ /reg bya'i sbyor ba dbul (gebar bya/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /dkyil 'khor bkod pa bsgom par bya/ /rang lus de bzhin gshegs rang bzhin/ /bshang ba gci bas bla ma mchod/ /bzhin bzang yid du 'ong ba yi/ /na chung skal ba (5)mchog ldan pa/ /byin gyis (ne brlabs kyi gnas bsams (7te/ /de nyid mchod pa rab tu brtag /mig yangs khu ba blangs nas ni/ /brtan pa'i blo dang ldan pas bza'/ /'di de sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi mchod pa ste/ /ye shes rdo rje can gyi gsang / /sngags rnams dngos grub byed par gsungs/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang chen gsang ba 'dus pa las bshang gci'i 985)dam tshig gi le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //81—318

de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /thams cad nam mkha' 17mi 'gyur che/ /thams cad dbang bskur spyod pa'i mchog /kun don dbang phyug dam pa yis/ /sku gsung thugs kyi longs spyod pa/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum 92dkyil 'khor/ /sangs rgyas theg pa can la gsang / /nyams dga' mchog ni rab tu bshad/ /nam mkha'i ( )dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /mi bskyod rdo rje rab bsgoms nas/ /lag tu rdo rje bsgom par bya/ /'od 'phro mang po 'bar ba dang / /'od zer sna lngas rab tu gang / /dus gsum 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /bsgoms nas rdo rjes phye mar brlag /sku gsung thugs kyi longs spyod ni/ /rdo rjes phyer brlags ④med gyur pa/ /bsam gtan mchog de bsgoms na ni/ /thugs kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /rdo rje gsang ba 'di yis ni/ /sems can thams cad bsad na ni/ /mi bskyod sangs rgyas zhing du ni/ /rgyal ba'i sras su skye bar 'gyur/ /'di ni rigs thams cad kyi rgya mtsho las zhe sdang gi rigs kyi dam tshig gi de kho nar shes par bya'o / /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /mi shes thar pa rab sgrub 95pa/ /ngo bo nyid dag gos (6)pa med/ /byang chub spyod pa rab ston pas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub bsgrub (pepa yi/ /yang dag dam tshig bka' stsal to/ /nam mkha'i 8dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /'khor lo'i 9dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /rnam par snang mdzad rab bsgoms te/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rnam par bsgom//rin chen kun gyi sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje'i gzugs ni rab tu brtag /nor rnams thams cad phrogs nas su/ /rdo rje gsum gyis rnam par bsgom/ /yid bzhin nor bu 'dra ba yis/ /nor gyi rgya mtshos rab gang 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas 81—319

kun gyi sras rnams dang / /thub pa'i skyes bu rnams su 'gyur/ /'di ni rigs kyi hu)rgya mtsho thams cad las gti mug gi rigs kyi yang dag pa'i dam tshig tu shes par bya'o/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags thar pa rab sgrub (5 pa/ /gsang ba dag pa dmigs med pas/ /dkyil 'khor rab tu bka' stsal to/ /nam mkha'i byedabyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /pad ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /'od dpag med ni rab bsgoms 3)te/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis thams cad ni/ /dgang zhing de ru thams cad ni/ /btsun mo'i rnam pa'i sbyor bar bsgom/ /dam tshig bzhi yi sbyor ba yis/ /'di ni rdo rje'i tshul mchog go/ /dbang po gnyis ni rab sbyor bas/ /de dag thams cad nye bar spyad/ /'di ni sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /mi phyed sku gsum 95)sgrub pa'o/ /'di ni 'dod chags kyi rigs kyi yang dag pa'i dam tshig ste/ sngags pas bsgom par bya ba nyid do/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje sngags kyi don sgrub (nyupa/ /ye shes las byung bdag med pas/ /gsung ni 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya//rdo rje don yod 7rab bsgoms te/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bsgom par bya/ /brdzun gyi ngag ni rdo rje'i gnas/ /thams cad gzugs su rnam bsgom bya/ /rgyal ba'i gnas ni thams cad dang / /rgyal ba thams cad bslu bar bya/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /nam mkha'i gsung ste dri med pa/ /ye shes blo can kun gyi gsang / /sngags kyi dngos grub byed par bshad/ /'di ni dam tshig 'gugs pa'i rigs kyi dam tshig gi ri de kho na nyid de/ don ji lta ba bzhin du spro bar bya'o/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje gsum mi phyed rgyal 81—320

gnas / /dngos grub rdo rje rab ston pas/ /gsung ni 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /dam tshig dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya / /rin chen tog tu rab bsgoms te/ /gzugs rnams kun gyis 'di dag dgang ske/ /rtsub pa'i ngag 71tshol sogs pa yis/ /bsten na ye shes thob par 'gyur / /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje bkod pas de (2)skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig rdo rje tog la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams ngo mtshar zhing rmad du byung bar gyur nas rdo rje'i tshig 'di smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po khams gsum las 'das shing 'jig rten gyi na khams thams cad las 'das pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi nang du 'di lta bu rmad du byung ba'i tshig gi lam rdo rje'i tshig 'di ci'i slad du gsung ④de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis brjod kyis (demi lang ba'i yang brjod kyis 6 mi lang ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi ri rab kyi rdul phra mo snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig rdo rje tog la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu dman pa'i 'du shes dang / smad pa'i 'du shes 'di lta bu ma skyed cig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu gang 'di sngags kyi me)spyod pa ni mchog gi spyod pa'o/ /gang 'di sngags kyi spyod pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste dper na nam mkha' ni thams cad la rjes su song ba ste/ chos thams cad ni nam mkha'i khongs su gtogs pa'o/ /de dag 81—321

kyang 'dod pa'i khams na mi gnas/ gzugs kyi khams na mi gnas/ gzugs med pa'i khams na mi gnas/ 'byung ba chen po bzhi la mi gnas so/ /rigs kyi bu chos thams cad ni de ltar rjes su rig par bya'o/ /'di lta bu'i don gyi dbang mkhyen nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams sems can rnams kyi bsam pa mkhyen nas chos 'chad par mdzad do/ /rigs kyi bu de lta bu nyid kyi 91nam mkha'i tshig nges par brjod pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam tshig de dag rjes su rig par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste dper na gtsub shing dang / gtsub stan dang mi'i lag pa bskyod pa'i rkyen gyis du ba rab tu 'byung zhing me 'byung bar 'gyur mod kyi/ me de yang gtsub shing la yang tsho mi gnas/ gtsub stan la yang mi gnas/ mi'i lag pa bskyod pa la yang mi gnas so/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ri rdo rje dam tshig rjes su rig par bya ste/'gro ba dang 'ong ba la sogs pas zhes pa'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag ngo mtshar du gyur/ rmad du byung bar gyur pas ngam zhing mig gdangs te tshig 'di skad ces smras so/ /rmad byung chen po'i chos rnams ni/ /nam mkha' dang ni mtshungs pa dang / /rnam par mi rtog dag pa la/ /kun rdzob yang ni bshad pa mtshar/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang 4chen gsang ba 'dus pa las/ don dam pa'i dag pa de kho na nyid kyi don gyi dam tshig gi le'u ste dgu pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 55yang 'dus te/bcom ldan 'das dam tshig chen po'i tsho'achirdo rje de kho na nyid mngon par rdzogs par 81—322

byang chub pa sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /de nyid sngags snying kun bsdus pa/ /sku dang gsung 1thugs gsang bar bsgrags / /dngos grub chen po'i tshul gyi mchog /bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad du gsol/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /nyon mongs kun gyi rgya mtsho gtso/ /'bar ba gtum po spyan yangs pas/ /gsung ni 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /lus dang ngag dang sems rnams bsgom/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje rnams/ /rnam par mi rtog mi dmigs pa/ /mnyam nyid gar yang mi gnas pa/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i de bzhin gshegs pas pha rol tu phyin pa sngags kyi /tshul rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mi bskyod pa la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rig pa du ma bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong dang thabs cig ri tu sems can thams cad kyi don bya ba'i gar gyi rol ba ston par mdzad de/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' klas par 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams kyis rol cing dgyes par 5yongs su spyod pa yod kyang de dag sngags spyod pa la mngon par brtson pa rnams 6)la spyan ras kyis mi 'tsho ste ra/ de rgyu gang gi phyir zhe na/ kye ma 'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad na sngags spyod pa'i tshul gyis chos thos pas so/ /de'i phyir skyes bu dam pa chen po de rnams kyi spyan ras kyis btsa' ba'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i gsang ba sngags 99rithams cad kyi thugs kun du skul 1 bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i rab tu gsang ba/81—323

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig dmigs pa/ rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig dmigs pa/ chos 'dzin pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig dmigs pa/ nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las tshig gi lam nges par brjod pas sngags bsdus pa 'di gsungs sol/ /oṃ hūm̐ āḥswā hā/ de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad sras dang bcas/ /rab tu 'dar zhing brgyal 9nya)bar gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rjes su dran/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos dam tshig 'di gsungs so/ /nam mkha'i 9midabyings kyi dbus gnas par / /bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /de yi dbus gnas yi ge hūm̐/ /rang gi gzugs su rab tu brtag /rdo rje'i 'od zer cher 'bar ba/ /rnam par 'phro ba bsam par bya/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs/ /drangs par de yis rnam par bsgom/ /de ma thag nyid der 'gyur ba/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /kun gyi gtso bo dbang phyug mchog /rang gi dkyil 'khor rang rdo rjes/ /skyed par byed pa'i cho gar 'gyural/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /snying po rdo rje bsdus pa'o/ /rang sngags skyes bu bsgoms nas ni/ /gnas bzhi rnams su gzugs kyi tshul/ /zhal gsum rnam pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /kha dog gsum gyis rab tu bsgom/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje dam tshig gis de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de la 'di ni mchog rdo rje'i gsang ba'o/ /dkyil 'khor rnams kyi thugs ka yirasne)/ /dbus chud phra mo rnam nga bsgom bya/ /de yi dbus su chud par ni/ /yi ge mchog gi tshig bsam mo / / sbyor ba na)rdo rje chen po ni/ /rtse mo lnga pa rtag tu bsgom/ /rdo rje lcags 81—324

kyu'i 6)sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje gsum rnams bsgom par bya/ /de yis thugs ni gzir bya ste/ /lha yang rab tu bskul bar bya/ /'di de rdo rje thams cad kyi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab sgrub pa'o/ /rdo rje lcags kyu rnam tshonadabasgom pa/ /rdo rje pad+mo'i rigs la sogs/ /thugs ni bskul ba (5)rab bshad pa/ /'di de rol mo 'byung ba ste/ /rdo rje yi ni tshul mchog 'di/ /zhag bdun bar du byas na ni/ /gsang chen sku dang gsung dang thugs/ /ye shes rdo rje can grub 'gyur/ /'jigs shing yid ni rdo4/skrag gyur nas/ /mchog stsol ba ni rnam par gzigs/ /yid ni mgu bas dga' ba yi/ /dngos grub rgya chen ster bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /sngags kyi spyod pa'i mchog 'dzin rnams/ /gal te rmongs bdag nyid 'das na/ /de yi srog ni der zad 'gyur/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje gsum mchog ston pa po/ /'jig rten gsum mchog rdo rje gtsos(5na/ /gsung ni 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /sngags kyi skyes bu ji snyed pa/ /rdo rje gsum gyi ye shes rdzogs/ /dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /dngos po thams cad brtag par bya/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sngags kyi dam tshig sgrub pa'o/ /rig ma'i dbang phyug zhugs pa la/ /rdo rje'i sbyor ba rab bsgom zhing / /chags shing chags pa'i lta bas blta/ /'di ni dam tshig dkyil 'khor ro/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /de bzhin gshegs kun bdag nyid skyes/ /thams cad dbang bskur sangs rgyas gtsos/ /gsung ni 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /'jig rten khams ni thams cad na(6kyi/ /ji snyed bud med brjod pa kun/ /phyag rgya chen po'i sngon sbyor bas/ /de dag thams cad nye bar spyad/ /bye ba grangs med rdo rje can/ /sangs rgyas gnas ni der spro 81—325

bya / /bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi dam tshig gis 'di skad ces bka' stsal to//byang chub 'di yis 'thob par 'gyur/ /rdo rje gsum po mkha' 'dra ba'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' rgyal rgya mtsho/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyu)tshe des 'thob/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang chen gsang ba 'dus pa las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs bskul ba zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// // de nas bcom ldan 'das sku gsung thugs rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje skyes bu mchog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sngags rdo rje rig pa'i (na skyes bu mchog gi le'u 'di gsungs so/ /rdo rje gsum yig sngags kyi mchog /phyag rgya chen po rnam ( chibasgom pa/ /byang chub thams cad 'thob pa ni/ /ye shes rdo rje dag gis bya/ /oṃ yig ye shes snying po ste/ /rdo rje sku ni 'thob 50byed pa'o/ /āḥyig byang chub sprul pa'i bdag /rdo rje gsung ni 'thob (ge)byed pa'o/ /rtsu yig sku gsung thugs yin te/ /rdo rje gsum 96)ni mi phyed 'thob/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi sngags kyi skyes bus de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i dbus gnas par/ /rdo rje kun skyes dkyil 'khor bsam/ /de ru yi ge (7)rgyu bsam ste ci/ /rdo rje sprin ni 'phro skyed pa'o/ /de la 'di ni ye shes rdo rje'i snying po'o/ /phroṃ/ rdo rje'i po)dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /yi ge t+t+waṃ ni rab tu bsgoma'i/ /gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /yi ge oṃ ni rnam par bsam chos kyi 81—326

dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /yi ge āḥni rab tu bsgom/ /yi ge r+ghaṃ gyis 6)gnas bsgoms te/ /rdo rje gsum byung bsgom par bya/ /bcom ldan 'das dam tshig gsum gyi gsang bas 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /snying po dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi/ /sku gsung thugs ni mnyes byed pa/ /oṃ yig sangs rgyas sku yi mchog /oṃ āḥyig sangs rgyas gsung gi lam/ /āḥrgyu yig ye shes 'jing tshon ni thugs / /hūm̐ 'di ni byang chub tshul mchog yin/ /'di de —skusangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab sgrub 4pa/ /ye shes rdo rjes sprul pa ste/ /sangs rgyas rgyu dang 'bras bu 'byung / /'di dag sangs rgyas skyes bu nyid/ /sngags dang rig pa zhes bsgrags pa/ /bskyed pa la sogs dam tshig dag /rdo rje gsum mi phyed bsgoms shu pas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs dam tshig de kho na nyid ye shes rdo rje byin gyis rlob pa'i rgyu zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /rnam par dben (6)zhing nyams dga' bar/ /sbyor ba 'di ni kun tu brtsams(7)/ /rdo rje'i sku dang gsung thugs 'grub/ /phyogs gcig gis ni the tshom med/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i 8)dbus gnas par(9ri/ /gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor dam pa bsam/ /rang gi sngags kyi dam tshig bskyed/ /yi ge oṃ ni thugs kur dgod/ /'od zer lnga pa sprin chen po/ /rnam par snang mdzad mchog sgom pa / /'di yis sangs rgyas kyi ni sku/ /rdo rje rnam snang rgya mtshor 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas sku dang 'dra ba'i 'od/ /rdo rje gsum gyi kulpa ni/ /ye shes lnga ldan bsten cing gnas/ /phyogs tsam gyis ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das sku rdo rje gsang bas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku 7rdo rje'i 1sto'od zer bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /81—327

nam mkha'i rdo rje dbus gnas pa'i/ /chos kyi dkyil 1)'khor dam pa bsam/ /rang gi sngags kyi skyes bu bskyed/ /āḥyig ngag gi lam la dgod/ /kha dog lnga pa rdo rje che/ /'jig rten dbang phyug mchog bsgoms tsho pas/ /dam tshig ye shes rdzogs byas te/ /tshig gi dam tshig lnga yi mchog /chos kyi tshig gi lam gnas pa//rdo rje chos dang mtshungs par 'gyur/ /rdo rje gsum gyi kulpa ni/ /ye shes lnga ldan bsten cing gnas/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje'i gsung gsang bas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chogasung rdo rje'i dam tshig 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i nga ting nge 'dzin to/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i dbus gnas pa'i / /rdo rje dkyil 'khor dam pa bsam/ /rang sngags (5)skyes bu bskyed nas ni / /thugs la gnas pa'i yi ge r+ghaṃ/ /dam tshig chen po de nyid ni/ /kha dog lnga pa rnam bsgom bya/ /rdo rje kun dang rgyal ba'i gnas/ /ye shes rdo rje dag gis bya/ /ston pa rdo rje thugs las byung / /ye shes yon tan rgya mtshor 'gyur/ /rdo rje gsum gyi kulpa ni/ /ye shes lnga ldan bsten tsho(theganas shing / /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje thugs gsang bas de skad 57)ces bka' stsal to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi tsho2sku gsung thugs dam tshig rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /rdo rje chen po bsgom par bya/ /lus rnams kun la yi ge khaṃ/ /rdo rje ye shes mkha' mnyam ⑨'gyur/ /kho'i/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /yang dang yang du mchod pa dang / /kulpa gsum ni dam tshig gnas/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang gzigs mi 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das nam mkha' rdo rje'i dam tshig gis de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sku gsung thugs rdo rje mi snang ba 'byung ba bkod pa phreng ba can zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin 81—328

to / /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dbus las ni/ /rang sngags skyes bu rab bsgoms la / /snying gar nyanardo rje haṃ zhes pa/ /bzhag 9geste 'od zer rnam par bsgom/ /rta / 'jam dpal dam tshig rdzogs longs spyod/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can / /byang chub sems dpa'i dbadag nyid du/ /sa bcu dag la gnas de 'gyur / /byang chub sems dpa' ye shes dam tshig zla ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /'od zer rab 'bar yi ge / /mtshan nga)mchog rdo rje'i lus 5su ni/ /bsgoms na rdo rje'i sku mnyam 'gyur / /blo/ nam mkha' rdo rje'i dam tshig gi bkod pa'i gnas zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /mngon shes lnga dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas mngon shes dam tshig mchog/'di ni dngos grub thams cad kyi/ /sangs rgyas mngon shes mchog sgrub pa'o/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus gnas par/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor dam pa bsam/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab bsgoms la/ /ye shes oṃ yig bsgom par bya/ /oṃ/ rdo rje dam tshig gsum bsgoms pas/ /mi bskyod rdo rje gsum 'drar 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi bskyod pas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /mi bskyod pa yi 6sku 'dra dang / /gsung dang thugs mchog rtag tu 'dzin/ /'jig rten khams rnams thams cad du/ /mi bskyod rdo rjes mchod par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa'i dam tshig mngon par 'byung ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor 'od bzang bsam/ /nam mkha' rdo rje rab bsgoms la/ /rin chen oṃ yig bsgom par bya/ /oṃ/ rdo rje dam tshig gsum bsgoms pas/ /rdo rje gsum gyi tog 'drar 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das 81—329

rdo rje rin chen tog gis de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sku dang gsung thugs rdo rje yis / /rin chen tog gi 'od dang 'dra/ /de ni bdag med byang chub dang / /ye shes gsang ba mnyam gnas 'gyur/ /rin po che dam tshig longs spyod rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor dam pa bsam/ /'jig rten dbang phyug rab bsgoms la / /chos kyi oṃ yig bsgom par bya/ /oṃ/ rdo rje dam tshig gsum bsgoms pas / /rdo rje gsum dpag med 'drar 'gyur/ /lus dang ngag sems rdo rje yis / /'od dpag med dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /de ni sems can thams cad kyi / /theg chen lam ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'od dpag tu tsho1)med pas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /yon tan dpag tu med pa'i 'od kyi dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor dam pa bsam/ /rdo rje ut+pal rab bsgoms nas/ /dam tshig oṃ yig rab tu bsgom/ /oṃ/ rdo rje dam tshig gsum bsgoms pas/ /rdo rje don yod gsum 'drar 'gyur/ /lus dang ngag sems rdo rje yis/ /rdo rje don yod 'dra ba'i 'od/ /de ni dpal ldan ye shes mtsho/ /sems can kun don 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje don yod pas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /don yod pa'i dam tshig 'byung ba 'od zer ye shes kyi mchog 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor 'od bzang bsam/ /rdo rje snang mdzad rab bsgoms la/ /sku gsum oṃ yig rab tu bsgom/ /oṃ/ rdo rje dam tshig gsum bsgoms pas/ /rnam par snang mdzad mnyam par 'gyur/ /lus 81—330

dang ngag yid rdo rje yis/ /rnam par snang mdzad 'dra ba'i 'od/ /de ni ye shes rdzogs byang chub/ /sku gsum mi phyed sgrub byed 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad kyis de 57)skad ces bka' stsal to/ /lus dang ngag dang yid dmigs pa rdzogs par byang chub pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /ri bo rnam par dben pa dang / /chu klung 'bab pa rnams dang ni/ /dur khrod la sogs rnams su yang / /bsam gtan bsdus pa 'di dag bya/ /mi bskyod ye shes rdo rje sogs/ /rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil gnas bsam/ /mngon shes lnga po'i sbyor ba (5)yis/ /gnas su sangs rgyas mchog rnams bsgom/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje chen po dam tshig rdo rje mngon par mkhyen pas de skad ces bka' stsal to / /rdo rje chen po rtse lnga pa/ /'bar ba lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /gnas lngar rab tu sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje mngon shes 'dra bar 'gyur/ /me stag mang po 'khrug pa yi/ /rang sngags 'khor lo bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje lnga ni sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje mngon shes 'dra bar 'gyur/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i dkyil gnas par / /'khor lo sangs rgyas 'bar 'od 'dra/ /bsgoms nas sangs rgyas 'jug pa yis//sangs rgyas gnas dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa'i/ /rang gi lus la snang mdzad bzhag /snying gar 4yi ge oṃ bsam 5la / /sngags la rnam par shes pa bsgom/ /de'i sems 'gog pa'i rdo rjer tshud4)ske/ /gang tshe skye bar 'gyur ba (77de/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mchog sgrub pa/ /yid bzhin nor bu dpal ldan 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa'i / /rdo rje mi bskyod rab tu bsgom/ /snying gar 8yi ge hūm̐ bsgoms nas/ /sems ni thig ler gyur par bzhag59ri /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor dbus gnas 81—331

pa'i / /tshe dpag med par rab tu bsgom/ /snying gar ①yi ge āḥbasams te/ /rdo rje thig ler gtogs pa bzhag(ge /'di de dam tshig mchog gi mchog /rdo rje gsum ni mi phyed bsgom/ /'gog pa'i dam tshig ye shes te/ /sangs rgyas dngos grub 'thob 'gyur ba'i(5)/ /nam mkha' rdo rje dbyings gnas par/ /bsgom bya gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /lus ngag sems la yi ge oṃ/ /bsams na de ni bskal 4par gnas/ /nam mkha' rdo rje dbyings gnas par/ /bsgom bya chos kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /lus ngag sems la yi ge āḥ/ /bsams na de ni bskal 95 par gnas/ /nam mkha' rdo rje dbyings gnas par/ /bsgom bya rdo rje dkyil 'khor ni/ /lus ngag sems la yi ge hūṃ/ /bsams na de ni bskal rdzipar gnas/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gsum gyi rtog pa'i dam tshig gis de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sku dang gsung thugs rdo rje yi/ /rnal 'byor 'di gang nas bzung ste/ /klog gam yang na sems kyang rung / /de yang rdo rje 'dzin par 'gyur / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang chen gsang ba 'dus pa las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sngags kyi dam tshig de kho na nyid rig pa'i skyes bu mchog gi le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas ston tsho75pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /bskyed (2)pa ye shes mchog sgrub pas(9)/ /dam tshig rdo rje gsum de nyid/ /rdo rje gsung gis 7bka' stsal pa/ /mkha' dang mtshungs par mnyam gyur pa/ /rnam par mi rtog ngo bo nyid/ /chos rnams rang bzhin dag pa la/ /rol mo 'di dag rab tu bsgom/ /dgon pa chen po'i sa phyogs mchog /me tog 'bras bu sogs pas brgyan/ /ri bo skye bos dben 81—332

pa ru/ /dngos grub thams cad bsdus pa bsgrub/ /mi/ lus dang ngag sems rdo rje la/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje rab tu bsgom/ /lus dang ngag sems la spro ba/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje 'dra bar 'gyur/ /dpag tshad brgyar ni rgya che ba/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i 'od des ni/ /snang 'gyur dag pa'i bdag nyid de/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa ni/ /tshangs pa drag po la sogs lhas/ /nam yang mthong bar mi nus so/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje mchog gi dam tshig mi snang bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum las byung / /bshang gci dam tshig lnga rnams ni/ /lcags gsum dang ni ldan byas nas/ /khar bcug nas ni bsgom par bya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mi phyed pa'i/ /thugs ni de ru rab tu bsgom / /de ni de ma thag nyid du/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje 'od 'drar 'gyur/ /rang gi sngags las 'khor lo ni/ /'od 'phro mdangs nya༄mchog can bsgoms nas//sangs rgyas thams cad bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /bsgoms na sangs rgyas mnyam par 'gyur/ /ri rab sum cu (0rtsa drug gi/ /rdul phran ji snyed yod pa yi/ /de yi rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur/ /thams cad rdo rje 'dzin dang 'dra/ /'di ni 'khor lo'i dam tshig ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /rdo rje chen po rang sngags kyis(mi / /dkyil 'khor dbus su rab bsgoms la/ /rdo rje kun gyi gnas yin par / bsams na rdo rje 'dra bar 'gyur/ /ri rab sum cu (4rtsa drug gi/ /phra rab rdul rnams ji snyed pa'i/ /de snyed kyi ni bud med rnams/ /yon tan can gyi gnas su 'gyur/ /drag po dag gis phyag byas pa/ /khams gsum rdo rje chen por 'gyur/ /rdo rje mnyam pa nyid ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /pad+ma chen po 'dab brgyad pa/ /rang sngags rdo rje bsams 95nas su/ /chos rnams kun gyi 81—333

gnas yin pa/ /rdo rje chos dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /ri rab sum cu 0)rtsa drug gi//phra rab rdul rnams ji snyed pa'i/ /sangs rgyas mchod mchog dkyil 'khor du/ /dag pa'i bdag nyid 'jog par byed/ /pad mo mnyam pa nyid ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /gsum gyi kulpa'i dam tshig ni/ /ye shes lnga ldan bsten cing gnas / /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba rnam gsum bsnyen bkur byed ci/ /'od zer lnga yi ④mdog 'dra'i 'od/ /rang gi sngags la ral gri bsgom/ /mig yangs lag na thogs nas ni/ /rdo rje gsum rig 'dzin par 'gyur/ /khams gsum chen pos mchod bya dang / /tshangs dbang lha min phyag byas pa/ /stong gsum na ni gcig pu pa④/ /gsang ba 'dzin pa'i mchog tu 'gyur/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje rnams/ /sems kyis gang zhig 'dod pa ni / /rdo rje thugs las rab tu byung / /de lta bu yi dngos grub ster/ /ral gri thams cad dam pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /oṃ yig ril bu (9tsa na ku'i/ /'bru tshad du ni bsams nas ni/ /dbus su rang gi lha yi gzugs/ /bsams te kha ru bsgom par bya/ /de ni de ma thag nyid du/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 'od 'drar 'gyur/ /nyi ma shar ba'i 'od 'dra zhing / /'dzam bu chu bo'i (93gser gyi mdog /āḥ47yig ril bu 0tsa na ma'i/ /'bru tshad tsam du 49bsams nas ni/ /dbus su rang gi lha yi gzugs/ /bsams te kha ru bsgom par bya/ /de ni de ma thag nyid du/ /byang chub ye shes 'od 'drar 'gyur/ /nyi ma shar ba'i 'od 'dra zhing / /'dzam bu 57chu bo'i gser gyi mdog /hūṃ yig ril bu nyamatsa na ku'i/ /'bru tshad tsam du bsams nas ni/ /dbus su rang gi lha yi gzugs / /bsams te kha ru bsgom par bya/ /de ni de ma thag nyid du/ /rdo 81—334

rje'i sku dang 'od 'drar 'gyur/ /nyi ma shar ba'i 'od 'dra zhing / /'dzam bu 1chu bo'i gser 'od 'dra/ /mkha' dbyings gsal ba'i dkyil gnas pa'i/ /rnam par snang mdzad rab tu bsgom/ /lag tu 'khor lo rab bsgoms na/ /'khor lo'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /'khor lo chen po'i rigs bsgoms ri te//sangs rgyas sku ni rab sbyor bas/ /ye shes mchog gi sgrub pa 'di/ /ye shes rdo rje dag gis ②bya/ /mkha' dbyings rdo rje'i dbus gnas par/ /ye shes mi bskyod lgokarab bsgoms te/ /lag tu rdo rje rnam bsgoms na95ci/ /rdo rje'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /rdo rje chen po'i rigs bsgoms te/ /rdo rje'i skur ni rab sbyor bas/ /rdo rje mchog gi sgrub pa 'di/ /ye shes rdo rje dag gis bya/ /mkha' dbyings rin chen dbus gnas par/ /rin chen rdo rje rab tu bsgom/ /lag tu rin chen rab bsgoms na/ /rin chen rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur 6ri/ /rin chen chen po'i rigs bsgoms nas/ /rin chen skur ni rab sbyor bas/ /rin chen mchog gi sgrub pa 'di/ /ye shes rdo rje dag gis bya/ /mkha' dbyings chos kyi dbus gnas par/ /tshe dpag med pa rab tu bsgom/ /lag tu pad+mo rab bsgoms na/ /pad+mo'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /pad+mo chen po'i rigs bsgoms nas/ /chos kyi skur ni rab sbyor bas/ /pad+mo'i mchog gi sgrub pa 'di/ /ye shes rdo rje dag gis bya/ /mkha' dbyings dam tshig dbus gnas par/ /don yod ye shes rab tu bsgom/ /lag tu ral gri rab bsgoms na/ /ral gri'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /dam tshig chen po'i rigs bsgoms te)/ /dam tshig skur ni rab sbyor bas/ /dam tshig mchog gi sgrub pa 'di/ /ye shes rdo rje dag gis bya/ /rtse gsum ye shes lcags kyu sogs/ /rdo rje'i khyad par gyis 81—335

bsgrubs na/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sgrub pa yis/ /bsam gtan des ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das dam tshig chen po'i dngos grub rdo rjes de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /lam gyi bzhi mdo'am shing gcig drung / /mtshan ma nya)gcig dang zhi gnas su/ /rdo rje dgug pa'i (na khyad par gyis/ /sgrub pa pos ni rtag tu bsgrub/ /sbyor gsum sngags kyi skyes bu ni/ /rdo rje can gsum sbyor bsams nas/ /sku dang gsung thugs lcags kyu ni/ /sangs rgyas ye shes blo ldan gyi/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor mchog gnas pa/ /sangs rgyas dgug pa dam pa yin/ /dam tshig las byung laphyogs bcu pa/ /rdo rjes bkug nas nye bar spyod(4)ske/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dam tshig rdo rje dgug pa'o/ /rnam par snang mdzad 'khor lo che/ /rgyal gnas lcags kyu bsams nas ni/ /rdo rje pad+ma la sogs pas/ /dam tshig dgug pa'i mchog ni bya/ /khams gsum gyi dam tshig dgug pa'o/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /sangs rgyas sku ni rnam me)bsgoms la/ /lag tu sku dang gsung thugs ni/ /kyo 97ba la sogs rab tu bsgom / /'di lta bu yi (gesbyor ba yis/ /de ni gnas las byed par 'gyur/ /rnam pa rdo dkun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /rdo rje sku ni rnam bsgoms shing 99/ /lce yi rdo rje'i sbyor bas bsgom/ /rdo rje'i 1 )gsung dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /sangs rgyas skur ni rnam bsgoms la/ /lag tu bsgrub bya bsams na ni/ /rdo rje dang ni 'dra bar 'gyur/ /gsang gsum dam tshig mchod pa'i mchog /mchod pas mchod nas rab bsgrub 'di/ /de ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba'i snying po bsdus pa yin/ /bcom ldan 'das gsang ba chen po'i dam tshig gis de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sha chen dam tshig 81—336

mchog gis ni/ /rdo rje gsum mchog bsgrub par bya/ /bshang gci dam tshig mchog gis ni/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i gtso bor 'gyur/ /glang po'i sha yi dam tshig gis3)/ /mngon shes lnga nyid thob par bya/ /rta sha dag gi 92dam tshig gis/ /mi snang ba yi rdoXbadag por 'gyur/ /khyi sha dag gi dam tshig gis/ /dngos grub thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /ba glang sha yi dam tshig gis/ /rdo rje dgug pa'i mchog tu 'gyur/ /sha rnams thams cad ma rnyed na/ /thams cad bsams pas rnam par brtag /rdo rje'i sbyor ba 'di byas na/ /sangs rgyas thams cad byin gyis rlob/ /rnam pa kun mchog ldan pa yi/ /sku gsung thugs ni rdo rje can / /snying gar ④ye shes dam tshig dang / /dbu rgyan rdo rje mchog 'dzin pa/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes 'gyur la5/ /'di ni dam tshig tshul gyi mchog /dam tshig mchog gi (7bya ba ni/ /dngos grub thams cad byed pa'i mchog /dam tshig thams cad kyi ye shes rdo rje'i zas zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /lce ni dam tshig rdo rje mchog /hūm̐ yig rdo rje can bsgoms 97 te/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi sbyor ba yis/ /zos na rdo rje gsum thob 'gyur/ /'di ni rdo rje'i tshul mchog ste/ /āḥdang oṃ gyi dam tshig kyang / /'di lta bu yi sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'dra bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje 8)dam tshig bdud rtsi'i phreng ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /rdo rje dam tshig gsum 'grub 9rimachog /sku gsum rdo rje can du 'gyur / /phyogs bcu'i sems can thams cad kyi/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i rgya mtshor 'gyur/ /'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /rdo rje'i bdag nyid snang bar byed/ /'khor lo'i dam tshig grub pa mchog /sangs rgyas sku dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /gaṅgā'i bye snyed thams cad du/ /kun nas grub pa rnam par spyod/ /81—337

thams cad dam tshig mchog gis ni/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i gtso bor 'gyur/ /thams cad dam tshig gzugs 4)mchog ni/ /rdo rje sku ni rab bsgoms pas/ /mi snang gyur pa thams cad la/ /stong gsum gcig pus snang ②byed pas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 'phrog pa dang / /lha mchog bu mo dag la spyod/ /gaṅgā'i bye (bsnyed sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje gsum gyi gnas bzhugs pa/ /rang lag skyu tsuru ra bzhag bzhin/ /rdo rje'i mig gis mthong bar 'gyur/ /gaṅgā'i (5)bye snyed zhing rnams na/ /sgra grag pa ni ji snyed pa/ /rna ba'i drung na 'khod pa bzhin/ /mngon shes khyu mchog gis (7thos 'gyur/ /gaṅgā'i bye (7)snyed zhing dag gi⑧/ /sems can kun gyi sems rnams ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyi mtshan nyid canal/ /rol mo ltar byung sems rig 'gyur/ /bskal pa gaṅgā'i bye snyed du/ /'khor bar gnas par 'byung ba yi/ /sngon gyi gnas kyi gtan tshigs ⑩rnams/ /zhag gsum lon pa bzhin du dran/ /gaṅgā'i bye ma snyed kyi sku/ /sangs rgyas sprin la sogs brgyan (1pas/ /bskal pa gaṅgā'i bye snyed du/ /rdzu 'phrul mchog gi rdo rjes 'gengs / /bcom ldan 'das dam tshig mngon par mkhyen pas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de la mngon par shes pa lnga ni rdo rje'i spyan dang / rdo rje'i snyan dang rdo rje'i thugs dang / rdo rje'i gnas dang rdo rje'i rdzu 'phrul lo/ /sangs rgyas mngon shes don grub cing / /sangs rgyas sku dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /gaṅgā'i bye snyed grangs med pa'i/ /'khor gyis yongs su bskor nas su/ /rdo rje'i sku dang gsung dang thugs/ /'jig rten khams kun rnam par bkrod/ /bsnyen pa'i 1snyedam tshig sbyor ba dang / /nye bar sgrub pa 'byung ba dang / /sgrub pa'i don du dam tshig dang / /sgrub pa chen po dag dang bzhi/ /shes byas rdo 81—338

rje'i bye brag gis/ /de nas las rnams bsgrub ①par bya/ /bsnyen pa ting 'dzin rab sbyor ba/ /byang chub mchog ni bsgom par bya/ /nye bar sgrub pa grub mchog la / /rdo rje'i skye mched rnam dpyad rin pa/ /sgrub pa bskul rdzu ba rab brjod pa/ /sngags dang bdag po rnam bsgom ri pa/ /sgrub pa chen po byed pa'i tshe/ /rang sngags rdo rje can gyi gzugs/ /dbu rgyan la ni bdag po bsam/ /ye shes rdo rje 'grub (shepar 'gyur/ /bsnyen pa ye shes bdud rtsis bya/ /thams cad du ni rtag tu nyid/ /'di gang sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /sngags dang de nyid don sgrub pa'o/ /dgon pa chen po'i sa phyogs dang / /rab tu skye bos dben pa dang ske/ /ri bo nags 'dab chu ngogs su/ /rtag tu dngos grub thob par 'gyur//bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sgrub pa chen pos de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /yang na rdo rje bzhi dag gis/ /brtul zhugs brtan pas bsnyen par bya/ /rdo rje sku gsum mnyam de yis/ /bsgoms na dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /thun bzhi rnams dang rab sbyor bas/ /gnas lngar blo dang ldan pa yis/ /oṃ gyi yi ge bsgoms nas 6)ni/ /ye shes rdo rjes sdom pa bstan/ /zhag bdun dang ni zla byed dang / /zla gcig zla ba byed dang gnyis/ /rdo rje dam tshig bsgrubs na ni/ /dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur/ /zhag grangs bye brag rab dbye bas/ /nga 77)yis rgyas par rab tu bstan/ /phyogs kyi nang las dngos grub gsungs/ /gsang ba mchog las byung rnams kyis/ /de la 'di ni nye bar bsgrub pa'i sdom pa'i yul lo//sangs rgyas sku 'dzin dpal dang ldan/ /rdo rje gsum dang mi phyed dngos/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab gnas deng / /sku yi rdo rjes mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje gsum dang mi phyed dngos//— 81—339

bdag la byin gyis brlab gnas deng / /sku yi rdo rjes mdzad du gsol/ /de la 'di ni sgrub 3)pa'i sdom pa'i yul lo/ /chos nyid gsung lam dpal dang ldan/ /rdo rje gsum dang mi phyed dngos/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab gnas deng / /gsung gi 2 rdo rjes mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams / /rdo rje gsum dang mi phyed dngos/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab gnas deng ske/ /gsung gi 2)rdo rjes mdzad du gsol/ /de la 'di ni sgrub pa chen po'i sdom pa'i yul lo/ /rdo rje thugs 'dzin dpal dang ldan/ /rdo rje gsum dang mi phyed dngos/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab gnas deng / /thugs kyi rdo rjes mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje gsum dang mi phyed dngos/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab gnas deng / /thugs kyi rdo rjes mdzad du gsol/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' 'am/ /yang na chos kyi sems dpa'ang rung / /gal te rmongs bdag nyid 'da' na/ /tshal bar 'gas 'dir 4gdon mi za/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang chen gsang ba 'dus pa las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i sbyor ba dam tshig sgrub pa mchog nges par bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan bde gshegs kun/ /ye shes rdo rje mchog 'dzin dang / /sems can kun don yang dag 'byung / /byang chub sems dpa' blo ldan gyis/ /thub pa don kun rdo rje can/ /ston pa che la phyag 'tshal nas/ /dam tshig de nyid mkhyen pa la/ /mchod 5de rdo rje'i dbyangs (6)'di gsungs/ /e ma'o 81—340

sangs rgyas tshul re bzang / /e ma'o byang chub tshul gyi mchog /e ma'o chos kyi tshul re zhi/ /e mtho sngags kyi tshul re bstan 1)/ /ma skyes pa dun yi chos rnams ni//ngo bo nyid kyis (gukhyad par can/ /rnam par mi rtog yang dag la/ /ye shes 'byung bar rab tu gsungs/ /yid 'ong sngags rnams kun bsdus pa/ /rdo rje bzlas pa ye shes che/ /sku gsum 4mi phyed dkyil tshoge'akhor ni/ /sangs rgyas ye shes thob 'gyur ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /bzlas pa rdo rje'i sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi tsho6byin gyis rlob(7/ /rigs ni sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs mtshan nyid/ /sngags kyi bzlas pa de (kyering gsungs/ /ye shes rgya mtsho gsan pa dang / /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can / /sangs rgyas dus gsum byung ba rnams/ /rdo rje sngags ni rab bsgoms pas / /ye shes mnyam med thob 'gyur ba/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 9 bshad du gsol / /de nas ston pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /nam mkha' rdo rje ye shes byung / / byed skyed tsodam pa mchog gi gtsos/ /rdo rje bzlas pa 'di gsungs so/ /sngags kun don gyi bzlas pa ni/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum mtshan nyid/ /dbye ba gsum gyi rdo rje'i mthar/ /bkod pa rdo rje gsum brjod bya/ /sku gsung thugs kyi gnas rnams su/ /spro ba rnam pa gsum dag bya/ /rdo rje bzlas pa 'di yis ni/ /rdo rje gsum gyi thugs 'drar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs/ /bsgoms nas mchod pa'i mchog brtag pa/ /ye shes rdo rjes byas na ni/ /rdo rje gsum gyi thugs 'drar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs/ /bsams nas mchod pa'i mchog brtag pa/ /ye shes rdo rjes rab tu bya/ /'di ni byang chub mchog 'thob 11pa'o/ /yang na dbye ba rnam gsum gyis/ /so so so 81—341

sor spro bar bya/ /sku dang gsung thugs bdag med pa/ /ye shes sems kyis ②yang dag spro/ /brjod nas rdo rje spro bya zhing / /rdzogs nas rab tu bsdu bar bya/ /'di ni ye shes spyan phye ba'i/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni kun gyi yin/ /sku yi rdo rje rdzogs byang chub/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam dpyad ②pa/ /sangs rgyas sku zhes bya bar gsungs/ /de ni sku yi bzlas par bshad/ /gsung gi dam tshig rdzogs byang chub/ /sgra dang sgra min rnam ladapyad pa/ /gsung gi rdo rje zhes gsungs te/ /de ni gsung gi bzlas par bshad/ /thugs kyi dam tshig rdzogs byang chub/ /gnas pa'i rdo rje rnam dpyad pa/ /thugs kyi rdo rje zhes gsungs te//de ni thugs kyi bzlas par bshad/ /don gyi rjes rtogs bzlas pa ni/ /ngo bo nyid byung bzang po yis/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams ④dpyad pa/ /de ni rin chen bzlas par bshad/ /sangs rgyas zhing las thams cad du/ /sku yi sprin rnams spro ba ni/ /bzhud cing byon pa rdo rje'i don/ /de ni don yod bzlas par bshad/ /khro bo'i dam tshig shes pa yis/ /rang gi rdo rjes bsgrags dkyil 'khor / /sngags kyi yi ge'i tshig thos pa/ /de ni khro bo'i bzlas par bshad/ /'dod pa'i don gyis myos gyur pas/ /sems can kun la phan dga' med/ /sems can gti mug gnas la 'jog /de ni gti mug bzlas par bshad/ /'dod chags rdo rje las byung tshig /lus dang ngag sems la gnas pa/ /sems can 'dod chags mtshor yiganas bzhag /de ni 'dod chags bzlas par bshad / /zhe sdang rdo rje las byung sems/ /lus dang ngag sems la gnas pa/ /sems can zhe sdang gnas la bzhag(3) /de ni zhe sdang bzlas par bshad/ /dam tshig rdo rje gsum de nyid/ /dam tshig rdo rje can dbu ma/ /de nyid dam tshig rdo 81—342

rje yi/ /ma ning bzlas pa zhes bshad do/ /'dod chags de nyid 3)don bsgom pa / /rdo rje bdag po thams cad ni/ /sems can kun la phan 'dod pa'i/ /'dod chags las skyes byang chub mdzad/ /rig pa chen po spyan la sogs/ /rtag tu 'dod pa'i don brtson pa/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod dag gis ni/ /ji ltar 'dod pa bsten na 'grub/ /gti mug dam tshig las byung ba/ /rig pa'i rgyal po rdo rje can/ /ma ning dag gi gnas grub pal/ /dngos grub dam pa rab tu ster/ /khro bo zhe sdang gnas las skyes/ /rtag tu gsod la brtson pa rnams/ /gsod pa'i don gyis sgrub pa po/ /mchog gi chos can gyis 'grub 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das skyes bu chen po'i dam tshig gis de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /ye shes 'khor lo can gyis ②ni/ /snying ga'i bdabus su 'khor lo bsgom/ /gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa/ /dbus su 'khor lo'i don bsgom mo//ye shes rdo rje can gyis ni/ /snying ga'i ⑤dbus su rdo rje bsgom/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa/ /rdo rje'i sngags don bsgom par bya/ /rin chen ye shes can gyis ⑥ni/ /snying ga'i 7skadabus su rin chen bsgom/ /rin chen dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa/ /rin chen sngags don bsgom par bya/ /pad+ma ye shes can gyis ⑧ni/ /snying ga'i poradabus su pad+ma bsgom/ /chos kyi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa/ /pad+ma'i sngags don bsgom par bya/ /ral gri ye shes can gyis ⑩ni/ /snying ga'i rtsomadabus su ral gri bsgom/ /dam tshig dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa/ /ral gri'i tshesngags don bsgom par bya/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi ngos rnams su/ /sangs rgyas lnga rnams dgod par bya/ /'od zer lnga yi bye brag 8gis/ /spros na byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /sngags rnams thams cad spro 81—343

ba ni/ /bye brag rnam pa gnyis su bsgrags/ /sku gsum 1)rdo rje'i bye brag gis/ /spro ba dang ni bsdu bar bya/ /lus ni sku yi rdzu ngo bo nyid/ /sems ni thugs kyi ngo bo nyid/ /ngag ni gsung gi rang bzhin gyis/ /mchod na mchod pa'i gnas thob 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i 'khor lo (5)yis/ /rdo rje lnga ni bsgom par bya / /sku gsung 4rdo rje'i dbus su ni/ /rang gi bdag po'i gzugs bsams nas / /rang gi sngags kyi rdo rje'i gzugs/ /dkyil 'khor rnam pa bzhi dag ni/ /kha dog rnam bzhir kun brtags la/ /snying gar 95)sngags kyi don bsgom pa/ /rdo rje rnam pa bzhi yi tshilas/ /bsam gtan rdo rje can dag byed/ /'di ni sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /mchog tu rtag pa gsang chen no/ /zhi ba la ni spyan gyi tshul / /rgyas pa pad+mo rdo rje can/ /dbang la rnam par snang mdzad gnas/ /rdo rje khro bo mngon spyod la/ /'di de rdo rje thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba sku gsum las byung (merabs/ /sprul pa sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /bya ba'i rol mos mtshan pa'o/ /ma dad smra ba'i sems can dang / /slob dpon rdo rje can smod pa / /gdug pa'i sems can gzhan rnams la'ang / /rab tu bskul ba 'di bya'o / /bcom ldan 'das ye shes chen po 'khor lo rdo rjes de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /khams gsum gnas pa'i sems can rnams/ /sangs rgyas skur ni rnam bsgoms 78)la/ /dgra bo bsad kyi par bsams nas su/ /de nas las rnams brtsam 9par bya/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas pa/ /rdo rje rtse lnga zhal bzhi pa/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan/ /rdo rje sems dpar rnam par bsgom / /dus gsum dam tshig las byung ba'i/ /sangs rgyas 'khor lo rnam (11 bsgoms la/ /sangs rgyas 'khor lo stobs po che/ /lag pa g.yas pas nya 'di 81—344

bya'o / /phyogs bcu nas byung sems can rnams/ /sangs rgyas sku yi bye brag gisal/ /bsdus te gong bu'i tshul gyis su/ /de dag rang gi lus la gzhug /sangs rgyas ye shes 'khor lo can/ /slar yang spro bar 1tshorab tu bya/ /khros pas na'akhrugs pa'i khro bo bsam/ /mi sdug rab gsal 'jigs su rung / /mtshon cha sna tshogs mchog 'dzin pa/ /gsod pa'i don gyi mchog sems pa/ /gdug 3pa chen po gsod ④par byed/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid kyang / /sangs rgyas sku gsum mchog stsol bas/ /rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor gnas/ /dngos grub ster 'gyur rmongs bdag nyid/ /'di la the tshom rinami bya'o/ /'di ni nyin zhag bdun bya ste/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi 'grub bo/ /rdo rje'i 6chodam tshig ye shes kyi bka'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par(7)/ /'khor lo rdo rje 'bar bas brgyan/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan/ /rnam par snang mdzad rab tu bsgom/ /dus gsum dam tshig las byung ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa' grags chen po/ /rdo rje me stag 'phro ba can/ / de yi 5nyephyag na bsnams par bsgomatsho/ /phyogs bcu nas byung sems can rnams / /rdo rje'i sku yi khyad bopar gyis/ /'od zer tshul gyis bsdus nas ni/ /de dag bdag gi nyu1lus la gzud12/ /rdo rje thams cad spro ba ni/ /ye shes mchog gi gnyen gyis bya/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sbyor ba can/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bdag la /lhagason/ /bdag ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / / bka' yi 57'khor lo rab sbyor bas/ /gal te dam tshig las 'das na/ /rdo rje kun nas 'bar gzugs kyis/ /sku gsum 15las byung dgas par bgyi tshe/ /zhig par 'gyur 'dir gdon mi 'tshal1 tsho/ /'khor lo'i dam tshig ye shes rdo rje zhes 81—345

bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor rdo rje can/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i dbus tsho1)gnas bsam/ /gshin rje gshed ni 'khor lo che/ /rang gi rdo rje rab tu brtag(mi /dus gsum sangs rgyas sems dpa' rnams/ /sku gsum dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa/ /slar yang sangs rgyas gshin rje gshed/ /rnam pa 'dra bar spro bar bya/ /sems can dus gsum la bzhugs pa/ /gdug ②sems can dang dgra bo rnams/ /khros pas thams cad (gegasod par bsgom/ /'di ni rdo rje bka' dkyil 'khor/ /dam tshig thams cad las byung ba gshin rje gshed kyi du sku gsum gyi ye shes rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /sku gsung yithugs kyi rdo rje 'am/ /rang sngags don gyi yon tan nam/ /yang na gtsug tor dam tshig gis/ /bka' yi 'khor lo sbyar bar bya/ /sngags kun bsrung phyir ye shes mchog /rdo rje can gyis bya ba ste/ /'di ni rdo rje thams cad kyi/ /byang chub bsrung ba'i don zhes bya/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' ⑦rdo rjes de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje'i dbus gnas par/ /rnam par snang mdzad sku mchog las/ /'byung (8chiba'i sku gsum dam tshig chos/ /bsams nas gdan phyokyide rab tu brtag /mkha' dbyings sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /yongs su gang bar rnam par bsgom/ /rang sngags yi ge gnas ye shes/ /thugs kyi rnam par bsgom par bya/ /slar yang sangs rgyas sems tsam du/ /bsgoms pa rnams ni rab tu bsdu/ /thugs kyi rdo rjer byas nas su/ /sku gsum la ni de dag gzud7/ /bcom ldan 'das nam mkha'i rdo rjes de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rdo rje'i sngags rin po che rab tu ho/snang bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i ⑫ting nge 'dzin to/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab 81—346

tu bsgom/ /sangs rgyas rim par bkod nas ni/ /chu yi steng du bcag par bya//rkang pa mnyam bzhag 0)sbyor ba yis/ /spyi bo'i steng du rkang pa bsgom/ /bcom ldan 'das ngo bo nyid dag pas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rdo rje chu gter rkang ②pas gnon pa zhes bya ba'i niting nge 'dzin to/ /dbus su dbang chen dkyil 'khor ni/ /bsams te khro bo'i rigs bzhag la/ /las kyi rdo rje gnas gnon pa/ /de yi spyi bor bsgom par bya/ /mu stegs thams cad dang / phas kyi rgol ba'i 'khrul 'khor gnon pa zhes bya ba'i (geting nge 'dzin to/ /khro bo'i gzugs gsum rdo rje mchog /ge sar ser po'i mdog 'dra ba/ /thams cad ri yi rgyal po ltar/ /spyi bor bsams nas rab tu bsgom/ /sangs rgyas dpung yang gnon byed na/ /mi dbang la 'dir the tshom med/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs las byung bas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /dpung thams cad gnon pa zhes bya ba'i 7de ting nge 'dzin to/ /dgra bo skrag pa'i dam tshig la/ /bsam gtan 'di ni rab tu brtag /sangs rgyas kyis kyang gal te bgrod/ /gsal bar 'gyur 'di gdon mi za/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gsum gyi dam tshig gis 'di skad ces gsungs te/ yi ge hūm̐ las phur bu yi/ /tshad ni rtse mo lnga pa ste/ /rdo rje phur bur byas bsgom 5el/ /snying gar (3)de yis 'di rab bsgom/ /sangs rgyas dpung ni khros pa yang / /'jig par 'gyur (nye'adir gdon mi za/ /dgra rmongs pa gnon par byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /grong khyer ram ni yang na grong / /ljongs su yang ni rab sbyar bya/ /nad kun spong ba'i zhi ba yang / /'dis (9)ni rtag tu sbyar tshebar bya / /bar snang la gnas rdo rje ni/ /rtse mo lnga pa rnam par bsgom/ /bskal pa 81—347

sreg (1)pa ltar bsams la/ /slar yang rab tu bsdu bar bya/ /spro ba dag kyang slar bya'o/ /rin chen yid bzhin nor bu'i 'od/ /chos kyi sprin ni bsgoms nas kyang / /dbang bskur ldenob ni yang dag bya/ /rdo rje'i ②bsam gtan 'di yis ni/ /dgang dka' ba yang rab tu 'gengs/ /sbyin pa'i rdo rje rab snang byed / /yid bzhin nor bu dpal ldan 'gyur/ /der ni sangs rgyas chos chen dang ske/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sprin spro bya/ /bskal pa grangs med gsum yang gnas / /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis rlob/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyil/ /skyon med sku yi gsang ba'o/ /nad thams cad med par byed pa rdo rje 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /bsam gtan las byung dam bcas pa//gnas gang du ni brtsam par bya/ /'di yis bsam gtan sbyor ba yis/ /gnas na sangs rgyas byin gyis rlob/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi rgyal po che/ /rdo rje phur bur rab bsgoms la/ /phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor mchog rnams la/ /me stag 'bar ba 'dra bas gdab / /ces kyang gsungs so/ /'gro ba 'dul ba zhi ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas pa'i//zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor dam pa bsam/ /rnam par snang mdzad gzugs bsams nas / /rang gi thugs gar na don gnyer bzhag⑥ /mkha' dbyings spyan gyi mchog rnams kyis/ /yongs su gang bar rnam par bsgom/ /bsdus nas 'od kyi gong bu yis/ /nad pa la ni phab nas su/ /spu khung rtse bar nas sangs rgyas/ /sprin rnams brtul zhugs can gyis 77 spro/ /sangs rgyas sprin rnams de yi nitshe/ /de la dbang bskur rab tu stsol59ci/ /dam tshig rdo rje nad pa yis/ /skad cig gis ni dpal ldan 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kyi dam tshig gi sprin bkod pa zhes bya 81—348

ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nam mkha'i 3rdo rje'i dbus gnas par ri/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor dam pa bsam/ /chos 'dzin pa yi gzugs bsam mo /thugs kur (kyedon gnyer gzhag par bya/ /mkha' dbyings gnas ni nyams dga' bar/ /dkar mo zhes byas rab tu dgang / /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen 'od/ /'od kyi gong bu 9 bsdu bar bya/ /'di dag 'dod pa'i lus dang ngag /sems kyi gnas la dbab par bya/ /spu khung rtse bar nas rin chen/ /sprin rnams brtul zhugs can gyis spro/ /chos kyi sprin ni bsgom bya zhing / /dbang bskur ba ni yang dag bya/ /rdo rje bsam gtan 'di yis ni/ /dgang dka' ba yang rab tu 'gengs/ /de ni yid bzhin nor dpal ldan/ /sbyin pa'i rdo rje rab snang ba'o/ /chos kyi sprin gyi dam tshig bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nam mkha'i ༷thudabyings kyi dbus gnas pa'i/ /rdo rje zla gam 96chodakyil 'khor bsam/ /rdo rje nam mkha' chos mdun gzugs/ /thugs kur 77'dod pa gzhag 98)par bya/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor yongs su gang / /'od zer lnga yi sbyor ba yis/ /gzi brjid de la dbab par bya/ /de ni de ma thag nyid du/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs su byon/ /'jam dpal dang ni mnyam zhing gsal/ /gnas las byed par der (9)'gyur ro/ /dgyes pa'i bdag nyid can dbang bskur/ /dga' ston chen po stsol bar mdzad/ /mthong ba nyid kyis byung ba yi/ /'gro ba thams cad dbang du 'gyur/ /rin po che'i dam tshig gi sprin bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nam mkha' rdo rjer srin po ni/ /drag cing khro la rab gtum 1 rmodang ske/ /wa dang sna tshogs bya rog dang / /bya rgod khyi yis gang bar bsgom/ /81—349

me yi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i/ /dgra bo rnams ni rtag par bsgom/ /sangs rgyas kun la gnod byed pa/ /bsams nas rnal 'byor sbyar bar bya/ /rgyu ma rus bcud khrag la sogs/ /kun gyis drangs 0)par rnam par bsgom/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pas mnanarinar/ /bsgoms na dgra rnams 'chi bar 'gyur / /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin pas kyang / /gal te 'di ltar rab bsgoms ②na / /zla byed nang du rdzogs pa la/ /'chi bar 'gyur 'dir gdon mi za/ /rdo rje sprin dam tshig bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /rnam par snang mdzad zhal gsum pa/ /ston ku'i 4chu sgong mdog 'dra bsam/ /dkar po nag po rab tu dmar/ /thor tshugs dbu rgyan dag gis brgyan/ /rdo rje can ni zhal gsum bsam / /nag po dkar po dmar po'i zhal/ /'bar ba'i 3)thor tshugs dbu rgyan du can/ /'jig rten khams rnams 'khrug byed pa'o/ /'dod chags can ni zhal gsum bsam/ /dmar po nag po dkar bo'i zhal/ /thor tshugs dbu rgyan longs spyod can/ /bsgoms na nges par 'grub par 'gyur/ /'khor lo rdo rje pad+mo che/ /g.yas pa'i phyag tu rnam par bsgom/ /rdo rje phyag drug bzang po ni / /mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams par bsgom/ /sems can kun la phan bzhed ma / /spyan ma zhal gsum dag tu bsam/ /dkar po nag po dmar po che/ /mdzes pa'i gzugs su rab tu bsgom/ / mkha' skyes spyan (geni rgyal mo che/ /dri ma med cing zhal gsum pa/ /gnag dang dmar dang dkar (8)ba'i tshul/ /mdzes pa'i gzugs su rtag tu bsgom/ /gsung rdo rje spyan rgyal mo che/ /dmar gnag dkar po'i rnam pa yi/ /zhal gsum pa ni myur du 'grub/ /kha dog mdzes par rab tu bsgom/ /rig ma rdo rje ut+pal bsnams/ /zhal gsum rab 81—350

tu gsal ba'i mdangs/ /ser gnag 1dkar ba'i rnam pa ni/ /bsgoms na ye shes thob par 'gyur/ /khro bo chen po gshin rje gshed/ /zhal gsum drag po'i 'od bzang ba/ /rnon po 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par byed/ /kha dog nag po rab tu bsgom/ /gzhan gyis 90mi thub khro bo che/ /drag tu bzhad pa'i sgra 'byin pa / /zhal gsum 'od zer mang po dag /rab tu 'phro bar rnam par bsam /khro bo chen po rta mgrin nitsho kyi/ /bskal pa'i me bzhin rab tu 'bar/ /zhal be+egasum gdug ④pa zhabs kyis rinamanan/ /sbyor ba can gyis 96)rtag tu bsgom/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi khro bo che/ /'od zer 'phro ba rab tu 'khrug /drag po rdo rje 'bar ba 'dra/ /'jigs pa dag kyang 'jigs par byed/ /'dod pa'i ye shes khro bo che/ /zhal gsum pa ni 'jigs par byed/ /phyag bzhi 'jigs par byed pa'i mchog /ṭak+ki'i rgyal po rab tu bsgom/ /stobs po che ni rdo rje che/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mun sel ba/ /gdug tshidapa thams cad 'joms par byed/ /zhal gsum pa ni rtag tu bsgom/ /khro bo chen po dbyug sngon can/ /khams gsum dag ni 'jigs par byed/ /zhal gsum rdo rje las byung ba/ /'bar ba rnon po can du bsgom/ /rdo rje mi g.yo khro bo che/ /rdo rje las byung zur gyis blta la/ /zhi ba ral gri zhags pa bsnams/ /brtul zhugs can gyis zhal gsum bsgomatshu/ /gtsug tor tsorachen po yi ge gcig /'od zer dag ni kun tu 'phro/ /zhal gsum 'bar ba'i 'khor lo can/ /bsam gtan 'od bzang bsgom par bya//gnod mdzes ye shes mchog 'dzin pa/ /'jigs pa'i rgya mtsho yang dag byed/ /zhal gsum 'bar ba'i 'od 'phro sku/ /bsam gtan dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya//gzi brjid phung po gtsug tor 57rgyal/ /gang gzhan sngags kyi 'khor lo can/ /81—351

dam tshig longs spyod 'di rnams kyis3)/ /so so so sor bsgom par bya/ /sngags rnams kyi ni ting nge 'dzin/ /dpag tu med pa bshad pa yin/ /khro bo dag ni re re yang / /nam mkha'i steng bas (geshin tu 'phags/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par ri/ /gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor dam pa bsam sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms 4ril/ /rnam par snang mdzad rnam par bsam/ /gsal zhing zla ba bzhin zhi ba/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'dra ba'i 'od/ /me long lta bur yang dag byung / /khams gsum dag ni rgyan gyur pa/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa dag /bsams na byang chub de yis ⑤mthong / /bsam gtan rdo rje rab bsgom pa/ /de yis sangs rgyas che ba'i bdag /'jig rten thams cad dbang byed pa/ /tshe 'di nyid la thob par 'gyur/ /rnam par snang mdzad dam tshig 'byung ba mdzes pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nam mkha'i 6)dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor dam pa bsam sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms la/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rnam par bsam/ /khros pa gsal ba'i lus dang 'dra/ /'bar ba sna tshogs mnyam pa'i 'od/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /zhi ba'i ye shes gnas bsgoms na/ /rdo rje nyid ni myur du 'thob/ /bsam gtan rdo rje rab bskul ba/ /'dis ni rdo rje'i bdag nyid che/ /sems can thams cad dbang byed pa/ /tshe 'di nyid la thob par 'gyur/ /dam tshig thams cad 'byung ba mdzes pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nam mkha' gerdo rje'i dbus gnas pa984/ /chos kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa bsam/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms la/ /chos kyi sems dpa' rnam par bsgom/ /gsal 81—352

ba'i lus 'dzin zhi ba ni/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis 1rnam par brgyan/ /'od zer sprin ni 'khor lo che/ /rnam par 'phro ba rab tu bsgom/ /'di yis chos kyi bdag nyid che/ /sku gsum mi phyed las byung ba/ /ye shes rgya mtshos narnam brgyan pas/ /tshe 'di nyid la thob par 'gyur/ /chos kyi sems dpa' 'byung ba'i dam tshig 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i rdo dbus gnas par/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dam pa bsam/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms la/ /spyan ma mchog ni rnam par bsgom/ /zhal mdzes spyan ni rab tu yangs/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /mtshan rnams thams cad rab tu rdzogs/ /bud med sgyu tsho ma'i mchog ldan pa/ /khams gsum dag ni dbang byed pa/ /ye shes dngos grub thams cad byed/ /'khor lo'i yid bzhin nor bu'i 'od/ /phyag tu 'khor lo bsgom par bya/ /spyan gyi dam tshig phyag gi mchog dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i (5)dbus gnas par/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor 'od mchog bsam/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms tsho6nas/ /nam mkha' rdo rje mchog rab bsgom/ /zhal bzang spyan 7rini rab tu yangs/ /ut+pal mthing ga'i 8mdog 'dra ba/ /mtshan thorarnams thams cad rab tu rdzogs/ /nam mkha' dam tshig mchog rab bsgom / /phyag na ut+pal (7sngo dmar bsnams/ /khams gsum dag gis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas byang chub byed pa'i mchog /dngos grub rdo rje can gyi gsang ske/ /nam mkha' yum rin po che'i 'od kyi sprin rdo rje tshim par byed pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i dbus gnas par/ /chos kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa bsam/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms 11la//81—353

rdo rje chos ma rab tu bsgom17/ /zhal bzang spyan (mini rab tu yangs/ /pad+ma rā ( niga'i mdog 'dra ba/ /sgyu mas mtshan 4pa'i mchog las byung / /'dod chags chags pa 'dzin sdug 5pa/ /mtshan nyid thams cad yongs rdzogs shing / /rgyan (6)rnams kun gyis brgyan pa ste/ /phyag na ut+pal (3)dmar mdzes bsnams/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rab bsgoms pa/ /chos kyi ye shes 'byung gnas mchog /dam tshig rdo rje can gyi gsang / /chos kyi dam tshig de kho na nyid mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa kun tu ston pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i nadabus gnas par/ /dngos grub dkyil 'khor dam pa bsam / /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms la/ /sgrol ma mchog ni 6)bsgom par bya/ /zhal bzang 7spyan ni rab tu yangs/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan / /kha dog ljang ser 'dra ba'i 'od/ /bud med sgyu 0mas rab tu myos/ /rdo rje ting nge 'dzin las byung 12/ /sems can kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /ut+pal ljang ser dmar ba'i mdangs/ /phyag na bsnams pa rab tu bsgom/ /dam tshig sgrol ma mchog dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i dbus gnas par/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dam pa bsam/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms la/ /gshin rje gshed mchog rnam par bsgom(/snye/ /'bar ba'i 'od zer mang po 'phro/ /'jigs pa'i dkyil 'khor rab tu khros/ /spyan dmar mche ba rnam par gtsigs/ /phyag na ral gri bsnams par bsgomami/ /dbu rgyan snang mdzad bzhugs bsgoms na/ /rdo rje can ni dgyes par 'gyur/ /'di ni ye shes rdo rje can/ /thams cad khro bo'i dam tshig yin/ /gshin rje gshed spro ba'i snang ba bkod pa sgom 8pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nam 81—354

mkha' rdo rje'i 4)dbus gnas par/ /nyi ma'i nadakyil 'khor dam pa bsam/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms la/ /gzhan gyis mi thub rab tu bsgom/ /'bar ba'i (5)'od zer smyo /mang po can/ /sbrul gyis brgyan cing ske rags can/ /zhal ni rnam par gtsigs shing bgrad/ /kha dog dkar po rab tu bsgom/ /mi bskyod 5nodam tshig dbu rgyan la/ /bsams na rdo rje can dag dgyes ri/ /'di ni ye shes rdo rje can/ /thams cad khro bo'i dam tshig go/ /gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rdo rje bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i dbus gnas par / /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dam pa bsam/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms la/ /rdo rje rta mgrin rab tu bsgom/ /khro bo'i 'od zer mang po dag /thams cad du ni rnam par 'phro/ /gdug pa thams cad zhabs kyis mnan/ /kha dog dmar po rnam par bsam/ /rdzogs sangs dpag med dbu rgyan la/ /bsgoms na rdo rje can dag mnyes/ /'di ni rdo rje ye shes can/ /thams cad khro bo'i dam tshig yin/ /rta mgrin skyed 7pa 'byung ba rnam par bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i dbus gnas par/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dam pa bsam/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms (shesal rdo rje bdud rtsi rab sgom (9ri pa/ /'bar ba'i 'od zer mang po 'phro/ /rdo rje'i bosprin ni kun tu 'khrug /khros shing khro bcas gnag pa 11dang / /mche ba rnon po rab tu bsgom/ /mi bskyod nyusnyedam tshig dbu rgyan la/ /bsgoms na rdo rje can mnyes 32'gyur / /'di ni thams cad khro bo yis/ /'da' bar dka' 1lhaba'i dam tshig go//bdud rtsi'i dam tshig 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i mdabus gnas par/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dam pa bsam sangs 81—355

rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms la/ /ṭak+ki'i rgyal po rab bsgom bya/ /khro bo (1)'jigs pa'i cha lugs gtum/ /'jigs pa dag kyang 'jigs par byed/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /rdo rje 'od bzang bsgom par byarin/ /mi bskyod dadam tshig dbu rgyan la/ /bsgoms na mnyes pa (4rab tu 'phel/ /'di ni thams cad khro bo yi/ /'da' bar dka' ba'i dam tshig go/ /bsam gtan rdo rje rdzogs par byang chub pa dga' ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i 5dbus gnas par/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dam pa bsam/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms la/ /stobs po che ni rab tu bsgom/ /'bar ba'i 'od zer mang po 'phro/ /rdo rje gsum gyi gnas dkyil 'khor/ /khro zhing drag po zhags pa 'dzin/ /rdo rje stobs can bsgom par bya/ /mi bskyod (yedam tshig dbu rgyan 7la/ /bsgoms na mnyes pa rab tu 'phel/ /'di ni thams cad khro bo yi/ /'da' bar dka' (ldeba'i dam tshig go/ /rdo rje gsum gyi stobs zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i dbus gnas par/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dam pa bsam/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms la/ /rdo rje sngon po rnam par bsgom/ / khro bo 'jigs pa'i cha lugs can/ /'jigs pa dag kyang 'jigs par byed9/ /gzugs ni rab tu gnag la rno/ /nag po'i rgya mtsho skyed par byed/ /'bar ba'i 'od zer mang po 'phro/ /rdo rje dbyug thogs bsgom par bya/ /mi bskyod dam tshig dbu rgyan 7la/ /bsgoms na rab tu mnyes par 'gyur/ /'di ni thams cad khro bo yi/ /'da' bar dka' ba'i dam tshig go/ /rdo rje dbyug pa'i dam tshig mchog dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i dbus gnas par/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dam 81—356

pa bsam/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms la/ /mi g.yo mchog ni rnam par bsgom(1)/ /khros shing 'jigs pa'i zur gyis lta/ /ral gri zhags pa bsnams pa 'khrug /'bar ba'i tshonachi'od zer mang po 'phro/ /mi g.yo rdo rje can bsgom bya/ /mi bskyod dam tshig dbu rgyan la/ /bsgoms na mnyes pa /cirab tu 'phel / /'di ni thams cad khro bo yi/ /'da' bar dka' ba'i dam tshig yin/ /rdo rje nam mkha' (4dbyings kyi gnas/ gnon pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i dbus gnas par/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dam pa bsam/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms la/ /rig pa'i 'khor lor ri5)rab tu 'byung ske/ /mtshan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /'khor lo 'bar bas yongs su bskor 6)/ /gtsug tor 'khor lo dam tshig ni/ /rnam par 'phro ba rab tu bsgom/ /mi bskyod (7nodam tshig dbu rgyan la/ /bsgoms na chadardos pa narab tu 'phel / /'di ni thams cad khro bo yi/ /'da' bar dka' peng 〉ma tshig go/ /gtsug tor gyi dam tshig rig pa'i stobs 'khor lo zhes bya ba'i tidza nge 'dzin to/ /nam mkha' 0rdo rje'i dbus gnas par/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dam pa bsam/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms la/ /rdo rje sum+bha rab tu bsgom/ /me lce rnon po 'bar ba'i sku/ /rdo rje'i 11sprin ni rab tu 'phro/ /phyag na rdo rje rab 'bar ba/ /bsgoms na dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /mi bskyod 32dam tshig dbu rgyan la/ /bsgoms na mnyes pa 1lharab tu 'phel/ /'di ni thams cad khro bo yi/ /'da' bar dka' ba'i dam tshig go/ /rdo rje dam tshig sum+bha rab tu 'byung rnguba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /'gog pa khro bo'i 15'khor lo ni/ /sangs rgyas 'khor lo bsten tshapa yis/ /ting 'dzin rdo rje ye shes rnams/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 81—357

'khor grub par 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang chen gsang ba 'dus pa las rdo rje'i dam tshig bkod pa de kho na nyid kyi don sgom pa mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig gi bdag po rdo rje 'dzin pa chen pos zhi ba'i dam tshig gi mchog ces bya ba'i (1)ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi btsun mo 'di nyid kyi sku gsung 2)thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /oṃ ru ru spru ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dha (b.lo tsa ni saṅgātho sā la dha ni swā hā/ de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /phun sum (5)tshog kun yid bzhes (6/pa/ /mnyes shing rab tu dgyes gyur pas/ /sangs rgyas rdordo da sa su dran/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi zhi skyed ma/ /las rnams thams cad rab )pab cing / /rdo rje'i (3)dam tshig skul mdzad ma/ /shi ba sos par byed par gsungs/ /rdo rje 'chang chen pos de skad ces gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das sku gsum gyi dam tshig khro bo rdo rjes dngos po dang dngos po 8)med pa'i dam tshig rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/rdo rje 'dzin thams cad kyi btsun mo'i mchog 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las byung 99dngo / /oṃ shaṃ ka ri shārnyi boka re kus cas cas ni/ mi mas geta ya bhā nyusata ya cas thuni swā hā/ de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /rdo rje gsum ni mi phyed pa/ /rdo rje can mnyes spyan gdangs nas/ /rdo rje thugs ni rjes su dran/ /srung ba'i rdo rje sbyor ba la/ /rtag tu las ni rab bsgrub pa/ /rdo rje chen po 81wa 358

'jigs nyen la/ /rtag tu stobs ni byed par 1bshad/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'dod chags chen po'i dam tshig gzigs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ chos kyi dam tshig gi sku'i btsun mo'i mchog 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /oṃ ka ṭi bi ka ṭi ni ka 5)she ka ṭaṃ ka ṭi swā hā / de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /rdo rje chos mchog 'dzin pa rnams/ /rdo rje chos ni rjes su dran/ /mnyes nas bsam gtan thob gyur pas/ /rtag tu chos rgyas stobs dang ldan/ /rtag tu mdzad dpo che mdzad pa/ /rdo rje gsung gi bka' bzhin du/ /bzlas / pa tsam gyis byed par 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dam tshig kun nas 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ dam tshig sems dpa'i btsun mo'i mchog 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re swā hā/ de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag cher 75)skyes mnyes/ /rdo rje'i sku ni rjes su dran/ /bsam gtan ye shes thob gyur pas/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje sde chen dang ske/ /sems can khams ni kun nas su/ /skad cig gis ni bran bzhin du/ /thams cad g.yo med dbang du byed/ /ces bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pas dri ma med pa'i 'od zer gyi sprin rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ rdo rje gshin rje gshed 76napo chen po rdo rje khro bo 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /na maḥs man+ta kā ya bā rtsit+ta badzā tsā / oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba duṣ+ṭa satwa da ma ka /a si mu sa mo kyil par+sha pā sha hasta/ tsa turmu kha/ tsa tur+bha dza/ ṣa 99〈 tsa ra ṇa/ ā gats+tsha / ā 81—359

gtsu(1)ske/ sarba duṣ+ṭa pra ḍā nas pa hā ri ṇi/ ma hā bi bhā ta ka /bi kṛ tā ④na na / sarba bhū ༷5ta bha yo ka ra/ astob dzo raha sa nā di ne(7/ byā gh+ra 70tsarma ni ba sa na / ku ru ku ru/ sarba kurmā ni/ tshirnya tshirnya sarba man (she)tā na/ birnya birnya pa ra mu dā 7na/ ā kur+sha ya/ ā kusgo ya/ sarba bhū (17tā na/ ma tha ma tha/ nirma tha nirma tha/ sarba duṣ+ṭa na/ pra be sha ya pra be sha ya/ maṇ+ḍa 512la ma d+me bai ba swa bita/dzī bi tān+ta ka ra/ ku ru ku ru ma ma sarba tshekā/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa mā bi lasba/ mā bi las/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ bi sbo ṭa ya bi sbo ṭa ya/ sar+pā na nā sha yaṃ 1 ka ra ka ra/ bi ṭ+wāṃ sar+pā tshe' ba ri pū ra ka /he he bha ga bān/ kyi: / ra ya si/ ma ma sarba a sā dha rtso ya swā hā/ de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /sangs rgyas kun ni grags chen po/ /'jigs shing kun du skrag gyur nas/ /rdo rje sems ni rjes su dran/ /thod pa ma chag ma gas pal/ /gzugs mdzes yid 'ong rnyed pa la/ /rkang pas mnan pa'i tshul byas nas / /sngags 'di rjes su dran par bya/ /mā ma tī 'am spyan yang rung / /rdo rje chen po rigs mthon po/ /lan gsum dag tu brjod na ni/ /de ma thag tu nges par 'gugs/ /bcom ldan 'das thugs rdo rjes de skad ces gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyis dam tshig 'od zer 'thug 17po mchog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nasal/ bdud rtsi'i dam tshig gi rdo rje khro bo 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /na maḥs man+ta kā ya bā rtsit+ta badzā tsā/ na mo badz+ra kro dhā rdzo — )ya ma hā rdathon/ska ṭa hai ra bā ya/ a si/ mu sa sbyo — la/ par+sha pā nyesha hastu ya/ oṃ ༷ snye.a mṛ ( cigeta kuṇ+ḍa 27mi/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ brnya brnya/ ha na ha na/ da ha 81wa 360

da ha/ gadz+dza gadz+dza/ bi sbo ṭa ya bi sbo ṭa ya/ sarba bismyu (1 bi nā ya kān ge/ ma hā ga ṇa (kyepa ti/ dzī bi tān+ta tsho4ka rā tshogaya swā hā/ de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis / /sangs rgyas kun ni grags chen po/ /brgyal tsho6zhing rab tu 'jigs gyur nasal/ /rdo rje sku ni rjes su dran/ /sngags rnams kun gyi sbyor ba la/ /rdo rje bskrad pa'i las rnams ni/ /cho gas sangs rgyas dpung dag kyang / /rang nyid kyis ni skyod (pepar 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen tog 7zhenasangs rgyas kyi 'od zer rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ rdo rje khro bo chen po gzhan gyis mi thub pa 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo 59/ /na maḥs man+ta kā ya bā rtsit+ta badzā tsā/ oṃ hūm̐ dzi na ri ṭis tsos rtsu 37phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /sangs rgyas bdag nyid che skyes kun/ /'jigs shing kun du skrag gyur pas/ /byang chub sems ni rjes su dran/ /srin po ma rungs gtum po dang / /'jigs pa chen po 'khrugs pa la/ /rdo rje sems kyis rab sbyar bas/ /las rnams cho ga bzhin du byed / /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag tu med pas dpag tu med pa 'byung ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas / pad+mo 'byung ba'i rdo rje khro bo 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo ske/ /na maḥs man+ta kā ya bā rtsit+ta badzā tsā/ oṃ ju hūṃ rtsu/ ta rū 1tshal/ bi rū zhusal / sarba bi ṣa bighā ta ka /dz+wa li ta bi sbu liṅga/ astob nya hā sa/ rkeke sa 1 ris ṭā a ṭo pa ṭaṃ kā ra1 / badz+ra khu ra nir+gha 19ta na/ tsa li ta ba su dhā ta la ni shā sa mā tshoru tok+ṣip+ta dhā ra ṇi da dha ra/ dhī ṣa ṇa astob smyo hā sa/ a ba ri mi tā smyo lhab la ba rā krā ma/ ār+ya ga ḍā 2ge: ta bhū 25ta ga ṇa 7rgyu ṣi ta/ budha budha/ ha 81—361

ya spyi ba/ khā da khā da/ ba ra mar+sān/ tshirnya tshirnya/ birnya bid+dha/ pa ra mu blon/ sid+dhim di 511sha / ā be sha ya/ sarba dz+ra ra pi shā tsā dri na(mi/ sarba gra he ṣa (2)pra ti ha to bha bca/ badz+ra rdas kyi: (5 rā ya si/ i rda (7duṣ+ṭa gra ha na/ duṣ+ṭa sa bā / dhu na dhu na/ ma tha ma tha57)/ marda marda/ pā ṭa ya/ pā ṭa ya/ ma ṭa ma ṭa / bharnya bharnyan/ bud+dha dharma sat+ta a nu (9)tshwa rta kurma ku ru shī r+ghaṃ ha ya spyi bā 7ya phaṭa / badz+ra ye 11phaṭa/ badz+ra gā hu tā ya phaṭa/ badz+ra ne tā ya phaṭa/badz+ra /ṭī 1 ya phaṭa/ badz+ra khu rā ya phaṭa/ badz+ra khu skor nir+sā 57ta nā ya phaṭa/ pa ra man+t+ra bi nā sha nā ya phaṭa7/ sarba tre+e lo kya bha yo ka rā ya phaṭa/ sarba /theg pra ti ha tā 1 tshoya phaṭa/ badz+ra ku la san+ta nyusnyes nā nyurteya phaṭa/ rgyu tsū hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa zhu )swā hā/ de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /chos kyi rdo rje mchog skyes rnams/ /'jigs shing rab tu brgyal bar 'gyur smu/ /ye shes rgyal po rjes su dran/ /mkha' na dbyings dug gis yongs gang ba/ /rdo rje ha la ha la'i 'od/ /khro bo'i rgyal po bskul ba yis/ /dug rnams thams cad med par byed/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa gdon mi za bar grub pas gdon mi za ba'i dam tshig 'byung ba'i tog rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ rdo rje be con sngon po khro bo'i rgyal po 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /na maḥs man+ta kā ya bā rtsit+ta badzā 〉shuste/ oṃ e h+ye nyi ge/ bha ga bān gi / nī la badz+ra daṇ+ḍa/ tu ru tu ru/ hu lu hu lu/ hā hā/ gu lu gu lu/gu lā pa ya/ gu lā pa ya/ kra ma kra ma/ bha ga bān du lha'i yu be ge na/ zla snga 7tān shī r+ghaṃ snye/ da ha da ha/ da ra da ra/ ba ha ba ha/ pa tsa pa tsa ma tha ma tha/pā ta ya/ pā ta ya/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ mo ṭā pa ya/ mo ṭā pa ya/ sarba kurmā ris ṇi/81—362

tshirnya chatshirnya/ bhak+ṣa ya bhak+ṣa lde)ya/ asgri me da ma ( nosu/ ru dhi ra mdza 94)me da/pa sha mdza(de/ ru dhi ra/ pri ya e h+ye hi/ bha ga bān(6)/ sarba bisna 97ni/sarba bit+yā ni/ sarba man tā ṇimo / sarba mū la kurmā ṇi/ kṛ 49rmi ma ṇi ṣā dī ni/sarba gra hā na/ ha na ha na/ bhañja bhañja/ marda marda i (7de me kār+ya sā dha ya/hūm̐ ni lā 3)ya ni lā ya/ nī la badz+ra daṇ+ḍa ya/ tu ru tu ru/ bisna na 12bi nā ya /rka/ste / nā sha 8ya nā sha ya/ hu ru hu ru/ dīp+ta tsaṇ+ḍa ya/ sarba sha tū tsā skṛ da yā ni bla'i ḍa ya/ tshirnya tshirnya/ bar bibyā māṃ 17myu da ka /hūm̐ bibyā ṭ+wāṃ shiṣ+ṭa ka /sa ma ya ma nu sma ra/ /badz+ra dha ra ba tsa rna 3 tsa/ marmā ṇi nya ni krirnya39/ hūm̐ ha na ha na/da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa — dī/ ku ru ku ru/ tu ru tu ru/ hu ru hu ru/ phaṭa phaṭa hūṃ hūṃ kṛ tan+ta 0ya/ de ba ṛ sa ṣi pi dā pa kā ya/ ha na ha na9 snye/ badz+ra daṇ+ḍi na swā hā/ de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /gdug 3 pa'i mchog las byung ba kun / /yid ni 'jigs shing rab skrag nas/ /sems dpa'i rdo rje rjes su dran/ /grags chen khro bo'i rgyal po 'di/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas na geni/ /cho ga'i tshul bzhin bskul ba yis/ /gdug 7 7pa thams cad gsod par 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod pas kun nas sprin gyi dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ rdo rje stobs po che 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /na maḥs man+ta kā ya bārtsit+ta badzā bla sgrotsā/ oṃ hūṃ hūm̐ rtsu phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ u gra shu la pā ṇi 2rgyu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa / oṃ bh+yo 0ti ni rna 8 byed r+ghaṃ hūm̐ rtsu phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ra1ya swā hā/de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /stobs po che yi klu rnams kun/ /yid ni 'jigs shing rab skrag nas/ /sku gsum rdo rje rjes su dran/ /bzlas pa tsam 81wa 363

dang sbyor ba yis/ /las rnams thams cad bsgrub par bya/ /than pa byung ba'i dus su yang / /chu yi dkyil 'khor 'bebs par byed/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kun du sgrogs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs ①nas / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ṭak+ki'i (8)rgyal po chen po khro bo chen po 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /na maḥs man+ta kā ya bārtsit+ta gebadzā ca〉/ ṭak+ki hūm̐ dzaḥ/ de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag che skyes rnams/ /'jigs shing rdo rje sku gsum ni/ /rjes dran dam tshig ldan gyur nas/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rkang pa g.yas pas liṅga mnan / /rdo rje gsum gyi sngags bzlas pas/ /sngags rnams thams cad 'gugs par byed/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ye shes kyi phreng ba chu'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs de/nas/ mi g.yo ba rdo rje gtum po'i dam tshig 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /na maḥs man+ta kā ya bārtsit+ta (6badzā tsā/ a tsa la kā ṇa tsaṇ+ḍa/ nas naskyon/ mas mas/ mos mos / saskyo sas/ tab tas/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ mo ha mo ha/ mo ha ka ra/ ha sa ha sa/ badz+ra ha tshonas ku ru/ ha sa ha sa/ man raṭa man (7raṭa / gadz+dza gadz+dza/ ha na ha na/ bharnya bhan+ta7/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ā bi sha ā bi sha/ma hā man+t+ra bā 1nyel ka /dhu na dhu na/ ti ṇi ti ṇi/ khā da khā da/ bi na/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ duṣ+ṭan/ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa/ sar+pā cho12na ku ru ku ru/ ki ri ki ri/ ma hā bi ṣa ma 1 badz+ra/ sbo ṭa ya sbo ṭa ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ rgyu tri ba li skota raṅga na rta ka /māṃ māṃ 415/ ghā ṭ+wāṃ :tsha/ a tsa la tse ṭa/ sbo ṭa ya sbo ṭa ya/ rtsu rgyu a sa marnyi ka tāṭa / ma hā ba la shā ta ya/ sa ma ya ni/ gha ta ya/ ba ra sa ma ya pho tshomar+sā 81—364

na / rmā māṃ/ tsā 〉(1)/ māṃ shud r+ghaṃ 5tu lo ka /tuk+ṣu natu brdzu/ na maḥ stu a pra ti ha ta ba le bh+yo/ dzā la 95)ya/ tāṭa a sa ha na na rinenamaḥswā hā/ de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /lha kun 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /brgyal zhing yid ni rab skrag nas/ /rdo rje'i (7sku ni rjes su dran/ /khro bo chen po'i 98sngags 'di yis/ /lha chen po la sogs pa'i lha/ /mthu chen dag kyang skrag gyur nas/ /kha sbyar lus kyis 'gugs (9par 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dam tshig rnam par 'phrul pa'i nyu )rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/rdo rje 'dzin thams cad kyi dam tshig khro bo chen po gnod mdzes 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha 11rgyu/ groṇ+ḍa groṇ+ḍa 12rgyu/ gro: pa ya gro: hu pa ya r+ghaṃ/ ā na ya hoḥ14bha ga bān1ge/ bit+yā rā dza rdu phaṭa/de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /bu mo mthu chen thams cad ni/ /skra bshig 7gos dang bral bdag nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rjes su dran/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i zhabs kyis mnan/ /de bzhin gshegs kun bdag po ni/ /rdo rje 1 lcags kyu zhags pa yis/ /bcings na bu mo dgug pa'i mchog /de nas bcom ldan 'das dam tshig chen po'i de kho na nyid 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ dam tshig chen po rdo rje 1 gsum gyi gsang ba gsung gi dam tshig gi de kho na nyid kyi gnas 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /sangs rgyas rdo rje'i sku gsum 16la/ /rdo rje sems dpa' tshornam bsgom na/pa/ /zhags pa rdo rje kyo 22ba 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas dgug pa dam pa'o/ /sangs rgyas gsung sku'i sbyor ba yis/ /'khor lo chen po sbyor ba las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal chen po/ /rtag tu nges par 'gugs 28par 'gyur/ /'khor 81wa 365

lo pad+mo rdo rje ches/ /mi phyed rdo rje gsum bsgoms pas/ /rdo rje kyo 0)ba'i dbye ba yis / /sngags rnams thams cad dgug du pa'i mchog /rang sngags skyes bu bsgoms nas ni/ /thams cad rdo rje'i dngos zhi ba/ / mi yi (kyebu mo mchog rnoms kyi/ /snying gar rdo rje kyo rtsa ba sbyar/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor sbyor ba yis/ /nges par rtag tu 'gugs rin par 'gyur/ /rnam par snang mdzad gzugs chen po//zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /sha tsi der ni gnas par bsam/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i sbyor ba yis/ /lan 97grangs lnga bcu brjod na ni/ /nges par rtag tu 'gugs (7par 'gyur/ /rdo rje lcags kyu gzugs po che/ /'bar ba rnon po 'dra ba'i 'od/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor rab bsgoms la/ /nam mkha'i pad+mo dgug pa'i mchog /khro bo rdo rje'i dam tshig rang (87/ /rdo rje sa 'og gnas pa la/ /shu la rdo rje kyo 9ri zhags pas/ /lha min bu mo 'gugs pa'i mchog /btsag tsogam rdo rgyus dag kyang rung / /rdo rje kyo /lhaba'i sbyor ba yis/ /zla ba gza' 8yis zin pa'i tshe/ /khar bcug nas ni bsgrub 32par bya/ /tshangs dbang drag po la sogs lha/ /rang gi ming rnams bris na ni/ /rdo rje gsung gi bka' bzhin du/ /'jigs shing skrag nas 'ong bar 'gyur/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje rab tu bsgom/ /khro bo chen po gshin rje gshed/ /rdo rje lcags kyu rnam par bsam/ /bskal pa sreg pa'i 'khor lo che/ /bsgoms nas gnod sbyin mo dang spyad/ /phyag rgya'i dbye bas (7thams cad kyi/ /sngags kyi dbye bas thams cad du/ /dgug pa'i rab tu sbyor ba gsungs/ /gzhan du byas na 'jig par 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /yang dang yang du bskul bar bya/ /de nyid sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /rgyal po mchog tu rtag pa'o/ /81wa 366
