de nas bcom ldan 'das nam mkha' kun du rnam par 'phrul pa'i ye shes rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ rdo rje ral pa gcig ma dam tshig chen po'i gsung rdo rje'i mchog 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /oṃ shu li ni swā hā/ de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /klu yi bu mo mthu chen rnams/ /tshig par gyur cing gos dang bral/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rjes su dran/ /sngags kyi rig pa 'di yis ni/ /klu rnams thams cad 'gugs tipar 'gyur/ /klu yi ( bu mo mig bzangs mo dag /bkug nas nye bar spyad par bya / /de nas bcom ldan 'das nam mkha'i ne dam tshig 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ chos chen po'i dam tshig rdo rje khro gnyer can 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /oṃ sarba 5/bha ya/nā sha ni/ tā sa ni tā se(6ri/ tā sa ya tā sa ya/ be+e ra ṭa ṣ+ṭṛ ku ṭī ta ṭi/ be+e ra ṭi bai ra ṭi / shwe te porashe ta/ dza ṭi ni swā hā/ de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis / /rig 'dzin bdag nyid skyes ma kun/ /'dar zhing 'jigs par gyur pas ni/ /ye shes rdo rje rjes su dran/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i bu mo mchog /gser gyi rna (7cha g.yo ba rnams/ /sngags kyi rig pa 'di dang ni/ /dam tshig mchog gis dgug par bya/ /'gog pa rdo rje rgyal po ni/ /yongs su rdzogs pas mdzes mchog gis/ /ye shes rdo rje gsum las byung / /kun nas de ma thag tu 'gugs0la/ /yang na khro bo thams cad ni/ /dben pa'i gnas dang chen po ru/ /sngags pas 'bum du bzlas pa yis/ /las rnams thams cad byed par bshad/ /rdo rje slob dpon smod pa 37gzhan/ /theg pa che 12mchog smod pa dag /rab tu 'bad pas gsad par 1 bya/ /yang na gnas nas spo bar bya/ /'di yis byang 81—367

chub mchog gi ni/ /sngags kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen pos gsungs so/ /yang gsungs pa/ phyogs bcu'i sems can thams cad kyi/ /lus dang ngag sems gsod risna)pa ni/ /cho ga bzhin du bsgom byas pan/ /gdug sems can gyi dgra rnams ni/ /khrag dang chu yis gsher ba 'am/ /bshang gcis gsher bar byas pa'i gos/ /bgos nas liṅga rkang pas mnan/ /khro bo'i rgyal po sbyar bar bya/ /brgya rtsa brgyad ni yongs bzlas na/ /sangs rgyas kyang ni nges par 'jig /yang gsungs pa/ chu yis gos ni gsher bar byas/ /khro bo mchog gi bcings pa yis/ /liṅga rkang pas mnan dzo na ni/ /sangs rgyas dag kyang nges par 'jig kyi /bshang gcis gsher bar byas pa'i snyegos/ /ngan pa rul pa'i dri mnam pa/ /bgos te sngags ni bzlas byas na/ /skad cig gis skams 'chi (rmebar 'gyur/ /thal ba'i skyo mas gsher ba'i gos/ /bgos nas khro bas 'khrugs bzhin du/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas na ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa'ang 'jig par 'gyur/ /yang gsungs pa/gcer bur phud de skra bshig la/ /'jigs pa'i tshul can gtsigs 97shing bsgyur//liṅga rkang pas mnan na ni/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyang 'jig par 'gyur/ /ma mo'i gnas sam dur khrod dam/ /khang stong dang ni bzhi mdo dang / /mtshan ma gcig dang shing gcig drung / /mngon par spyod pa brtsam par bya/ /mi rus las byas phur bu ni/ /sor brgyad pa yi tshad dag la/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas byas te/ /dgra yi sgo khar sbas na ni/ /sangs rgyas sku gsum mchog sbyin pa/ /shes dang mi shes rnam spangs pa/ /zla ba phyed nang rdzogs pa yis/ /nyams sam yang na 'chi bar 'gyur/ /yang na thod pa gang ba dag /khyad par du ni mkhas 81—368

pas btsal/ /der ni sngags kyi tshig bris te/ /rdo rje'i tshig gis bzlas pa bya/ /dgra yi sgo 'am grong dag tu/ /sbas na nges par skyod 17par 'gyur/ /ta nala'i lo ma'am gzhan dag la/ /khro bo'i hūṃ dasngags ni kun bris la/ /dgra yi khyim mam sgo dag tu/ /sbas na skams shing 'chi (4bar 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das dam tshig chen po'i rgyu'i rdo rjes de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi lus dang ngag dang yid nges par 'ching ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ khams gsum pa thams cad kyi (de)lus dang ngag dang yid phur bus gdab pa'i sngags rdo rje 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /oṃ gha gha/ ghā ta ya ghā ta yal/ sarba duḥn (6༄phaṭa phaṭa/ tī la ya tī la ya/ sarba pā paṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ hūm̐ rtsu r+ghaṃ badz+ra tī la④/ badz+ra dha ra (8)ādz+nyā pa ya ti/ kā ya bārtsit+ta 9badz+ra / tī la ya rtsu rtsu hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /rdo rje rdzu 'phrul chen po kun / /brgyal zhing rab tu 'jigs gyur nas/ /nam mkha' rdo rje thugs dran gyur / /mi rus las byas phur bu 'am/ /yang na seng ldeng mchog las skyes/ /lcags las byas pa'i phur bu dag /rdo rje sku gsum 'jig par byed/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mnyam gzhag /lhal/ /'od 'phro 'khrug cing mdangs bzang ba12/ /rdo rje sku ni gsum gyi mthar1ste/ /gzugs ni bsams nas sbyar bar bya/ /rnam par snang mdzad phyag rgya che/ /yang na 'dod chags rdo rje can/ /gshin rje gshed kyi phyag rgya che/ /bsams na rdo rje gsum phur bu/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi 'khyil ba yis/ /gdug pa'i khro bo tshar gcod 1 pa/ /rdo rje'i sbyor bas bya ba yin/ /sangs rgyas bdag nyid chen po'i yang / /snying ga skanas ni rkang pa'i bar rdo 81—369

rje phur bu rnam par bsgom/ /de nyid gong du dam tshig bya/ /phur bu'i rnam par 'phrul tsho1)pa 'di/ /bsam gtan rdo rje'i sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang nges par 'debs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /phur bus btab na myur du 'chi/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po'i sku rnam par 'phrul pa'i 52/rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ sku'i dam tshig tsham ngam gyi rdo rje phur bu'i sngags 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /oṃ sbyirnya sbyirnyas )/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ dīp+ta badz+ra tsakra rtsu phaṭa / phan tshun dkri ri4ba'i tshul dang ni(5)/ /mthe bong bzhi du nani rab tu bsdam/ /rnam par snang mdzad gnas mnan te/ /rdo rje phur bu nges par gdab/ /btab ma thag tu sems dpa' che/ /rdo rje sku gsum las byung ba/ /dam tshig mchog gis ldang 7)bar 'gyur/ /nyams pa'i gnas su mi 'gyur na'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug gsung gi rnam par 'phrul pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ gsung gi dam tshig tsham ngam gyi rdo rje phur bu'i dro sngags 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /oṃ hrīḥbhū ru 9byu baḥ/ ye shes pad+mo kha phye ba/ /rdo rje sor mo nges par bzhag /'dod chags rdo rje'i gnas mnan te/ /rdo rje phur bu nges par gdab/ /btab ma thag tu rdo rje che/ /sku gsum dri med las byung ba/ /dam tshig mchog gis ldang bar 'gyur/ /nyams pa'i gnas su mi 'gyur na'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen pos thugs 7rnam par 'phrul pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ thugs kyi dam tshig tsham ngam gyis gnon 11pa'i sngags 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /oṃ badz+ra rā 81wa 370

dza hūm̐/ rtse mo lnga par bcings nas ni/ /'od 'phro mang po 'khrigs par bsgom/ /sems kyi rdo rje'i gnas mnan 1te/ /rdo rje phur bus nanges par gdab/ /btab pa tsam gyis rdo rje che/ /rdo rje dri med gsum las byung / /dam tshig mchog gis ldang bar 'gyur/ /nyams pa'i gnas su mi 'gyur na'o/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sbyor ba yis/ /cho ga yang dag byas tsam gyis/ /mkha' dbyings rdo rje mtha' ( —)klas par/ /phur bus 'debs 'dir gdon mi za/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje phur bu canachen pos de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas sangs rgyas sku gsum mchog /sems can khams la phan mdzad pa/ /mnyes shing rab tu dgyes gyur nas/ /gsung ni 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /e ma'o gsang ba'i gnas kyi mchog /e ma'o snying po kun btus 5pa/ /e mtho chos kyi gnas zhi ba / /e ma'o rdo rje rnam par 'joms/ /phur 'debs sangs rgyas thams cad dang ske/ /byang chub sems dpa' grags chen po/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje rnams / /phur bus gdab pa yang dag bshad/ /'di ni sngags rnams thams cad kyi(6)/ /phur gdab de nyid las byung ba/ /sku gsung thugs las mchog sbyin pa / /sngags kyi de nyid bsdus pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang chen gsang ba 'dus pa las sku dang gsung dang thugs rmad du byung ba sngags kyis 7'gugs pa rnam par sprul pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i 8le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /thams cad nam mkha' mi 'gyur che/ /thams cad dbang bskur ri9kun mkhyen pas/ /rdo rje gsung ni bka' stsal pa/ /81—371

spe sha can gyi bdag nyid che/ /bu mo lo grangs bcu gnyis pa/ /dben pa'i gnas su khyad par du/ /sgrub pa pos ni rtag tu bsgrub/ /bshang hu)gci'i dam tshig la sogs pas/ /gru bzhi pa ni cho ga yis/ /dkyil 'khor bya'o de ru ni/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor bsgoms pa yis/ /mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su dag /bzhin yang mdzes la rab tu bzang / /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs rdzogs pa/ /pang par bzhag nas rnam par bsgom/ /dkyil 'khor lnga yi 'khor lo yis/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rnam par bsgom/ /sngags kyi 'khor lo can gyi gsang / /mchod pa'i gnas ni nyams dga' bsgom/ /sku gsung thugs ni rdo rje can/ /rnam par snang mdzad sku chen po/ /bsam gtan sngags kyi sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni 'od 'drar 'gyur/ / btso blag ②mkhan ni bdag nyid che/ /bu mo ut+pal mthing ga'i mdog(kye /'dra ba dag ni rtag tu bsgrub/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sbyor ba yis/ /de nyid sbyor ba'i cho ga ni/ /byas nas las ni brtsam (bapar bya/ /'di ni sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /dam tshig shin tu 'da' dka' ba'o5sku/ /de ni de ma thag nyid du/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i 'od 'drar 'gyur/ /chos rnams kun 'dzin rgyal po mtshungs/ /'dod dang thar pa 4)rab sgrub ri7)pa/ /rdo rje chos ni rnam bsgoms na)pas/ /gar mkhan bu mo rab mdzes shing / /bzhin bzang mig ni dkyus (9)ring ba/ /sgrub pa pos ni rtag tu bsgrub / /de ni rdo rje chos bdag nyid/ /sa bcu la ni gnas par 'gyur/ /rgyal po gsung 'igi dam tshig 'dzin/ /kun mchog dbang phyug dam pa'o/ /bram ze rgyal rigs rje'u rigs dang / /dmangs /7rigs las byung bu mo ni/ /rdo rje chos bdag nyid 'di ni/ /gsang ba thob par byed pa bsgrub/ /rdo rje nyi ma nub 81—372

nas ni/ /sgrub pa kun tu brtsam 1par bya/ /skya rengs shar ba'i dus su ni/ /bsgom pa mchog gis 'grub par 'gyur/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs / /dri dang me tog rnams kyis brgyan/ /bsgoms na rdo rje sems dpa' mchog /grub pa myur du thob par 'gyur/ /'di ni sku gsum rgyanamachog sbyin pa/ /sangs rgyas mtshan gyis mtshan par 'gyur/ /dpag tshad brgya yi khyon tsam du/ /de yi 'od kyang snang bar byed/ /dbang po gnyis ni sbyor ba yis/ /sbyor ba thams cad btsam par bya/ /'di ni dngos grub thams cad kyi/ /dam tshig shin tu 'da' dka' ba'o/ /gal te rdo rje can grub 'dod/ /bshang dgaci'i dam tshig bza' bar bya/ /'di ni dngos grub thams cad kyi/ /dam tshig shin tu 'da' dka' ④ba'o/ /bshang gci'i 5dam tshig la tsho6sogs pas/ /dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas byang chub gnas zhi ba/ /de nyid bla na med pa 'grub/ /bcom ldan 'das 'dod pa dang thar pa'i dam tshig rdo rjes de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dam tshig chen po rdo rje khro bo zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje kun du skrag par byed pa'i khro bo 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /oṃ hrīḥjiḥbi kṛ (7tā na na sarba sha rtsu nā sha ya/ stam+bha ya/ hūm̐ rtsu phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ dug ni khrag dang kun du sbyar/ /lan tshwa ske tshe yungs mar 87te / /tsher ma'i me las khros pas bsreg /bu mo'i ming gi tshig dang bcas99/ /nyi ma gung ngam nam phyed na/ /'di ni rnam pa kun du shis/ /shes rab can gyis 7gru gsum du/ /stong phrag brgyad ni tshul bzhin bsreg /bu mo dag gi don gyi phyir/ /'di ni nyi ma gsum du bya/ /bskal pa gsum dang 1lhagrangs med ni/ /81—373

des ni rtag tu gnon par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas dang ni chos 'dzin pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 1tshogazhan yang rung / /gal te rmongs pas 'das na ni/ /de yi tshe ni der zad 'gyur/ /bcu bzhi'am ((yang na tshes brgyad la/ /dur khrod sol ba blangs nas ni/ /cho ga bzhin du sngags btab na( ri/ /de ni rtag tu ster bar 'gyur / /sngags shes pa yis gang rung ba'i/ /dgra yi gzugs brnyan byas nas ni / /bsam gtan dag gis bris na ni/ /'chi bar 'gyur 'dir (༄gdon mi za / /tho ba bsam gtan sbyor ba yis/ /de ltar byas na nges par ltung / /rtsu yig rab tu 'bar dang bcas/ /rdo rje 'bar ba rab tu bsgom/ /gdug pa thams cad 'jig par byed/ /phyag na rdo rje'i rigs dran (gete/ /rdo rgyus sol ba la sogs pas6/ /skyes pa'am bud med gzugs bris la/ /lag par sta re bsams nas su/ /mgrin snyedapa bcad par rnam par bsgom/ /sangs rgyas sku gsum rin chen mchog /sems can kun la phan 'dod pa/ /'di yis snad par 'gyur ba 'am/ /shi bar 'gyur 'dir gdon mi za/ /las kyi rdo rje rab 'bar che/ /me stag mang po 'khrigs pa can(per/ /dbus su rdo rje rnam bsgoms la / /chu rnams gnon pa'i mchog yin no/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni 'dri ba na/ /rlung la sogs pa byung na ni/ /mche ba'i phyag rgya bcings nas su/ /gdug 99ripa'i dgra ni rjes dran bya/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpas kyang / /sprul par gang zhing 7gyur pa ni/ /mthong ba tsam gyis 'gag 'gyur te/ /gzhan du byas na 'jigs par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /skye bo gdug 11pa gzhan dag kyang / /sngags 'dis skrag 1 par byas na ni/ /'chi bar 'gyur bar 12gdon mi za/ /de la 'di ni sngags thams cad kyi gsang ba'i 81—374

snying po'o/ /phaṭa/ ye shes sems dpa'i sbyor ba yis/ /dbus su gzugs ni bsgom par bya/ /sngags shes pa 1yis gnas bzhi ru/ /btsun mo rtag tu gzhag 2par bya/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /mtshan rnams thams cad kyis mtshan pa/ /pad+mo rab tu rgyas byas nas/ /sngags 'di rab tu bsgom par bya / /hūm̐/ 'od zer lnga 'od rab 'bar ba/ /rdo rje can gyi sbyor ba bsgom/ /rang lus ngag sems rdo rje la/ /phab na byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /de ni de ma thag nyid du/ /rnam par snang mdzad 'od 'dra zhing / /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /sangs rgyas sku gsum dardo rje 'dzin/ /sems dpa' thams cad skyed pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /bzhin bzangs 4phan par 'dod pa yi/ /bud med rnyed na cho ga bzhin/ /dben 5 par mchod pa brtsam par bya /gsang ba blangs nas bza' bar bya/ /de ni de ma thag nyid du/ /'jam dpal dang ni gzi brjid mnyam/ /mi snang bdag po dpal dang ldan/ /'dzam bu'i gser gyi mdangs 'drar 'gyur/ /bshad pa'am yang na bza' ba 'am /sha yang cho ga bzhin du ni/ /mngon par bsngags nas gzhug 6par bya/ /zos na mkhas rnams kyis mi mthong / /zhes 7bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen pos de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /bshang ba cho ga bzhin blangs nas/ /kham por sbyar mar gzhag 98)par bya/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bskul na ni/ /sangs rgyas nyi mas mi mthong ngo / /khyi yi sha dang rta sha dang / /sha chen dag ni cho ga bzhin/ /blangs nas kha sbyar sbyor ba yis/ /zos na de 9yis mi mthong ngo / /bshang dang lhan cig ldan pa yis/ / ril bu bolcags gsum gyis dkris pa/ /dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis 11mi mthong ngo / /khyi yi sha dang 81—375

sbyar ba yi/ /ril bu 1)lcags gsum gyis dkris pa/ /dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mi mthong ngo / /sha chen dang ni sbyor ba yi/ /ril bu (5)lcags gsum gyis dkris (kyepa/ /dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mi mthong ngo / /ba glang sha dang sbyor (peb yi/ / ril bu (snyelcags gsum gyis dkris (6༄pa/ /dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mi mthong ngo / /bshang ba las byung srog (7chags las/ /brtul zhugs can gyis ril bu 98bya/ /dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mi mthong ngo / /ga pur tsan+dan sbyar ba yi/ / ril bu (9༄lcags gsum gyis dkris pa'i/ /dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mi mthong ngo / /gi 11wang a ga ru sbyar ba'i/ / ril bu (nyelcags gsum gyis dkris pa / /dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje stobs po cher 'gyur ro/ /ga pur gur gum sbyar ba yi/ /ril bu (/nyelcags gsum gyis dkris pa/ /dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mi mthong ngo / /zhes gsungs so//rdo rje can rnams gang yang rung / /phyag rgya chen por byin brlabs bon/ /de 'drar 'gyur te dpal dang ldan/ /stobs chen pha rol gnon pa po/ /dpag tshad bye ba rdzogs pa yi/ /steng du rdo rje 'gro bar 'gyur/ /stong gsum bgrod pa dpal dang ldan/ /sangs rgyas 'od dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /'dod khams gnas pa'i bu mo dang / /lha yi longs spyod rigs brtul zhugs/ /yang na gzugs khams gnas pa la/ /stobs chen gyis ni 'dod pa spyod/ /bcom ldan 'das dam tshig mi snang ba'i rdo rje chen pos de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas sangs rgyas rab dgyes bdag /sems 'khrugs 8yid la dbang ba tidag /ngo 81—376

mtshar gyur cing spyan gdangs nas/ /gsung 15ni 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /e ma'o 'di rab ngo mtshar che/ /e ma'o gsang gnas mi 'gyur bge/ /e ma'o ngo bo nyid kyis dag /e ma'o shin tu dri med chos/ /de nas ston pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /skyed po byed po mi 'gyur che/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje chos chen pos/ /rdo rje'i gsung du bka' stsal pa/ /sems dpa' rdo rje'i sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje 'dzin rnams mnyes par bya/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab dbye bas/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje can mnyes 'gyur/ /rdo rje spyan dang gzugs sogs kyis/ /gtsug tor nomanyes par byed par dran/ /khro bo rnams la'ang de mchog ste/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje rab bsgom pa'o/ /rig pa'i rgyal po chos mchog rnams/ /rin chen tog ni rnam par bsgom/ /rig pa'i rgyal mo'i sbyor ba la/ /tshe dpag med pa rab tu bsgom//thams cad las byed sngags rnams la/ /gdon mi za ba'i ye shes bsgom/ /sngags rnams thams cad nyid la ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rnam par bsgom/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnod sbyin mo yi sngags rgyud la/ /gshin rje gshed 4nyid brtag par bya/ /thams cad sbyor ba'i sngags rnams la/ /spyi bo ru ni bskul ba shis / /bcom ldan 'das dam tshig chen pos de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /bsam gtan 'khor lo 'di yis ni/ /sngags mnyes pa yi dkyil 'khor dag /dam tshig chen po sgrub byed pa/ /sgrub po rnams la phan pa gsungs/ /de nas ston pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /gtso bo chos rnams kun dbang phyug /sku dang gsung thugs yang dag pas(ge/ /ye shes rdo rje bka' stsal te/ /ri rtse nyams ni dga' ba dang / /nags tshal rab tu dben par yang / /bsam gtan rdo rje rab bya ba / /sngags dang bzlas pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs kun/ /81—377

sngags dang bsam gtan gyis bskul bas/ /gsung gi las kyi bka' bzhin du/ /las rnams sna tshogs byed par 'gyur/ /rdo rje chos kyi gzugs chen po/ /pad+ma rā ga'i 'od 'dra ba/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje ni/ /gnas gsum du ni rigs brtag go/ /dbab 4)pa'i cho ga thams cad ni/ /byas na /na/gdon mi za bar 'grub/ /bskul dang rengs pa lha chen po/ /'phags pa'i sa ni bzhi po dag /rdo rje grub pa dag gis bya/ /de ltar byas na rtag par 'grub/ /bu mo lo grangs bcu gnyis ma'am/ /khye'u lo grangs bcu gnyis pa/ /mtshan nyid thams cad yongs rdzogs pa/ /bzung nas dbab par rab tu brtag /cho ga thams cad byas nas ni/ /las rnams rab tu bsgrub par bya/ /rnam pa gzhan du byas na ni/ /khams gsum skye bos dpyas lapar 'gyur/ /de la snying po'i sngags kyi yi ge'i tshig ni 'di rnams so/ /rtsu hāḥ.āḥdzhaiḥ.a nam mkha'i khams ni sems med cing / /rtog pa thams cad rnam 5)spangs dang / /rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid kyang / /'bab par 'gyur ro cho ga yis/ /rdzu yig rdo rje sems dpa'i bdag /hāḥ6yig sku yi rdo rje can/ /āḥ〈peyig chos 'dzin rgyal po ste/ /'di ni sngags tshig bstan 8)pa'o/ /yi ge lhaḥ7yis bskul bar bshad/ /'khor ba dang ni g.yo ba yin/ /'di ni bskul ba thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba yin par 'di rab bshad/ /khru gang tsam mam khru do 'am/ /ji srid khru brgyad lnga tsam du/ /rdo rje rgyal po rab bskul na/ /'jigs shing skrag bonas 'phar bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin thams cad sngar ji ltar/ /'di ni gsang ba thob byed pa'o/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi bdag /sku gsum gnas ni yongs dag pas/ /gsung ni 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /rtse gcig ma gyur pa 81—378

yis kyang / /brtul zhugs brtan pas bya ba 'di/ /sbyor ba gzhan min pa yis bya/ /gdug pa thams cad rnam gzhig pa'o/ /dur khrod sol dang phub sogs las/ /dgra 1)yi gzugs brnyan tshonabyas nas tsho ni/ /skra bshig gcer bur byung ba yis/ /khams gsum dag kyang 'jig par byed/ /dur khrod ro bsregs thal ba yis/ /dgra yi gzugs brnyan byas nas ni/ /stong brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas kyang / /'chi bar 'gyur 'dir gdon mi za/ /dkyil 'khor gru gsum byas pa la/ /ba lang ri sha dang rta yi shar /khyi yi sha 'am sna tshogs kyis/ /rdo rje'ang gdon mi za bar 'jig(6ri /sha chen po yis 'jig pa ni/ /thams cad rdo rje las byung dran/ /'di ni dgra rnams thams cad kyi/ /'jigs (7pa shin tu mi bzad 9she dran/ /chos mchog can gyi bshang gci yis/ /dgra yi gzugs brnyan byas nas ni/ /tsher ma'i me la khros nas bsregs(9)/ /sangs rgyas dag kyang nges par 'jig /ces gsungs so/ /chu bo'i 'gram gnyis sa yis kyang / /dgra yi gzugs brnyan byas nas ni/ /dug las byung ba'i tsher ma ni/ /til 'bru tsam gyis yan lag kun/ /dgang zhing skul ba'i tshig dang bcas/ /sangs rgyas dag kyang nges par 'jig /ces gsungs so/ /ske tshe lan tshwa 'bru mar dang ske/ /dug dang dha du ra dag ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gsad pa la/ /'di dag rab mchog gyur par bshad/ /sol khus gsher ba'i gos dag ni/ /gyon te sems ni khros nas su/ /liṅga rkang pas mnan nas ni/ /srin pos 'dzin par gdon mi za/ /rus phye khrag dang dug rnams kyis/ /gzugs brnyan rab tu byas na ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' drag po yang / /myur ba dag tu 'dzin par 'gyur/ /ske tshe dang ni yang dag ldan/ /bshang gci dag gis rdzogs pa yi//81—379

liṅga rkang pas mnan na shini/ /tsha ba chen pos 'dzin par 'gyur/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig chen po rdo rje khro bo'i snying po'o/ /na maḥs man+ta kā ya bārtsit+ta badzā (mirje/ oṃ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ brnya brnya/ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa(kyi/ gardza gardza/ bi sbo ṭa ya bi sbo ṭa ya/sarba bisna rtsanibi nā ya kān/ ma hā ga ṇa (nyepa ti dzī bi ta an+ta ka rā ༅ya hūm̐ phaṭa/sbyin sreg rtenaslar yang bsam gtan dag /lus dang ngag sems 'jig pa ste/ /ma yengs pa yi 8)sems kyis ni/ / gsod pa yin na 6)mchog 'di bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' khro bo che/ /rnam par bgrad 7pa 'jigs 'jigs lta/ /sta re 7tho ba phyag na bsnams/ /bsams nas bsam gtan rab tu brtag /de la 'di ni drag po chen po khro bo'i nyunyedam tshig go/ /mkha' dbyings sangs rgyas thams cad kyis(12ske/ /yongs su gang bar rab bsgoms la/ /gdug pa de yis bsad par ni / /bsams nas de ma thag tu 'chi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yis / /yongs su gang bar bsgoms nas ni/ /gdug pa'i sems dpas bsad ④na ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid kyang 'chi/ /sangs rgyas gnod byed dgra bo rnams//skrag cing 'jigs pas dkrugs blapar ni/ /sngags mkhan gyis ni mdun bsams na/ /'chi bar 'gyur 'dir tshagadon mi za/ /srin po khro bo sna tshogs pa / /gtum 7zhing khro bo mi bzad 32pas/ /skrag par gyur par bsams des ni//rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid kyang 'chi/ /'ug pa khra yidang bya rgod dang / /mchu rings pa ri tshadang wa rnams kyis/ /zos par bsams na de yis ni/ /sangs rgyas dag kyang nges par 'jig /sbrul nag rab tu khro ba ni/ /'jigs pa dag kyang 'jigs byed pa/ /dug gi mchog gi dam tshig ni/ /dpral bar bsams na 81—380

'di khyad 'phags/ /sbrul des zos par gyur pa yis/ /bsgrub 17bya dag kyang nges par 'jig /phyogs bcu'i sems can thams cad kyi/ /yams sam nye bar 'tshe ②ba rnams/ /'jigs pa dgra la dbab pa'i mchog /'di ni bskul rinaba'i mchog yin no/ /tho ba rab tu drag po yis/ /brtul zhugs can gyis snying gar puskabardeg /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' bzhin du/ /dgra yi srog ni med par 'gyur / /rdo rje can gyis sta re dzon sogs/ / gsheg cing gtub (6par bsams na ni/ /sku gsum gyi ni mchog sbyin pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' drag po'ang 'chi/ /bsrung ⑦ba la sogs dang po sngags/ /lha rnams kyang ni phur bus gdab/ /'di ni gsod byed mchog gi mchog /dam tshig shin tu 'da' dka' ba'o/ /phung po rdo rjes dkyil 'khor du/ /sems can ji snyed gnas pa la/ /gsang 98)bdag nyid gtogs bsams na ni/ /'di ltas mnyes 'gyur gzhan du min/ /ston pa sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje chos dang rdo rje can/ /bsam gtan sbyor bas 'chi bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje thugs kyi bka' ji bzhin/ /bcom ldan 'das khro bo chen po'i dam tshig rdo rje khro bos de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /thams cad nam mkha' thub chen po/ /thams cad dbang bskur 99 rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /ye shes rdo rjes bka' stsal pa'i/ /e ma'o ngo bo nyid kyis dag /rdo rje ⑩theg pa bla na med/ /ma skyes pa yi 12chos rnams la/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis skye bar 32bstan/ /de la 'di ni las phran tshegs thukyi rdo rje gsang ba'o / /sbrul ni mi sdug 'jigs byed pa/ /nag po 15'bar ba 'khrug cing khro/ /lce gnyis mche ba'i phreng ba can/ /rdo rgyus dag gam sol bas bris7/ /de la 'di ni klu khro bo skul nya 7ba'i snying po'o/ /khaṃ/ kha yi nang du de bsam zhing / /81—381

dug ni ha la ha la 'dra/ /sreg pa me yi kha dog dang / /bsgoms na 'gul bar gdon mi za/ /de la 'di ni dug thams cad dgug pa'i snying po'o/ /hrīḥrnam pa sna tshogs las byung dug /khams gsum na ni gnas pa kun/ /de yis khyer bar bsgoms nas ni/ /bab par gyur par rnam par bsam/ / de ni 1)de ma thag nyid du/ /dug gi rgya mtsho mi bzad 9mi'agyur/ /reg ma thag tu 'gro ba kun / /'jig pa 'di la the tshom med/ /sdig pa sbal pa la sogs dang / /sbrul rnams sna tshogs pa dag la'ang / /cho ga bzhin du rab tu bya/ /sbyor ba 'byung ba'i mtshan nyid kyis/ /de la 'di ni dug thams cad 'pho ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ/lta ba rdo rje'i dug la sogs/ /gzhan yang mi bzad pa yi dug /nam mkha' rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du/ /ye shes rdo rjes bkug nas 'jug /bcom ldan 'das dug gi dam tshig chen po rdo rjes de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de la 'di ni dug gso ba'i dam tshig rdo rje'i snying po'o/ /t+t+waṃ/ snying po 'di ni rdo rje che/ /kha dog dkar por rnam par bsgom/ /'od kyi sprin ni cher 'bar ba/ /zla ba'i 'od zer bzhin du bsil/ /gnas bzhi dag tu sbyor ba yis/ /de ma thag tu sdud pas ldang / /lan gnyis lan gsum rab bsgoms nas/ /skyugs du pa dag tu rnam bsams na/ /nam mkha'i khams kun gang ba yang / /skad cig gis ni dug med byed/ / zhes de nga)skad ces kyang bka' stsal to/ /de la 'di ni nye ba'i dug thams cad drang ba'i snying po'o/ /āḥ/ 'bras dang phol mig 'brum bu dang / /gang gzhan nad du bshad pa rnams/ /phyag na rdo rje'i bka' bzhin dul/ /bsams pa tsam gyis med par 'gyur/ /pad+ma chen po 'dab ma brgyad/ /ri bong can bzhin 5dri med pa/ /de yi dbus na 'dug bsam pa/ /'od zer 81—382

lnga ni rab rdzogs pa'o/ /sdug 1pa na ni dam tshig gnag /bskul 2ba na ni dkar po 'dra/ /bsam gtan gnas 'di gsang ba ste/ /gsang chen ye shes dri ma med/ /de la 'di ni phyi nang gi nad rnams gso ba'i rdo rje /snying po'i sngags kyi yi ge'i (4)tshig rnams sor/ /dzi na dzika / ā ro lika' /badz+ra lhaka(7) /yi ge'i tshig ni gang 'dod pa/ /dad pas yon tan thob par 'gyur/ /de 'dra'i gzugs ni bsgom par bya/ /nad kyi rdo rje bskul 8ba yis/ /dam tshig spre'u'i rnam pa 'am/ /yang na khyer 9ni byung ba'ang rung / /rang gi lus ngag sems gnas las/ /byung ba dag tu rnam par bsam/ /'khor lo 'am ni rdo rje'ang rung / /rdo rje'i go 'phang gnas bsgom 1 la/ /lus dang ngag sems dam tshig rnams/ /des ni phye mar brlag 11par bsgom/ /de nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /byang chub sems dpa' grags chen rnams/ /byin rlabs 15go 'phang dam pa dag /dgyes pa'i spyan gyis rab tu stsol/ /'di skad ces kyang bka' stsal to/ /rang lus ngag sems rdo rje la/ /sangs rgyas sprin dag rnam par bsam/ /rdo rje rgyal po sprin chen po/ /nad las thar bar bsgom par bya / /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa' blo ldan rnams/ /khros pa de la bsam par bya/ /'chi bar byed pa dam pa'i don/ /bsam gtan sbyor ba 'di dag gis/ /las skyes su yang gang grags pa/ /brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas sbyor ba yis/ /nyi ma bdun gyis 'jig par 'gyur/ /yang na rang gi sngags rgyal gyis/ /rdo rje'i bsam gtan cho ga bsam/ /'di ni nad rnams thams cad kyi/ /dam tshig shin tu 'da' dka' ba'o/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /ye shes kyo ba 'od chen po/ /'dod pa thar pa rdo rje ches/ /81—383

gsung ni 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /chos rnams rmi lam lta bu ni/ /ngo bo nyid kyis (1)ma skyes shing / /rang bzhin dag pa'i de (gyinyid la/ /'khrul pa'i rdo rje rab tu gsungs/ /bsam gtan bzlas pa'i don brtson pa'i/ /sgrub pa pos ni rtag tu mthong / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /dbye ba rnam pa gnyis su mthong / /de la 'di ni mi lam chen po'i dam tshig gi gnas te/ /byang chub ye shes mchog thob pa/ /sangs rgyas 'od ni bzang por mthong / /sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs pa yidu / /skur yang bdag nyid myur du mthong / /sems can chen po khams gsum pas/ /mchod pa byed par ④de yis mthong / /rang gzugs ye shes che 'od mnyam/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams kyis/ /nges par mchod pa ⑤byed par mthong / /rdo rje sems dpa'i 96rigazugs chen dang / /grags pa chen po rdo rje chos/ /gsang ba rdo rje grags pa che/ /mi lam dag na rang gzugs mthong / /byang chub sems dpa' 7)rdo rje can/ /sangs rgyas chen po phyag 'tshal ba/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol/ /mi lam 'di 'dra mthong bar 'gyur/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /lha yi bu mo yid 'ong dang / /khye'u dang ④bu mo dag mthong na/ /de ni dngos grub 'thob (95par 'gyur/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyang / /zhing na bzhugs par ༅nges par mthong / /thugs ni dgyes par gyur nas 17kyang / /chos mdzod yid du 'ong ba stsol/ /chos kyi 'khor lor gnas pa'i lus/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis yongs bskor ba/ /bsam gtan rdo rje la gnas pa'i/ /dam tshig sbyor bas mthong bar 'gyur/ /kun dga' skyed pho tshal sna tshogs pa/ /lha yi bu mo sogs pas brgyan/ /sangs rgyas 81wa 384

kun gyis byin brlabs pas1/ /bsam gtan dam tshig can gyis mthong /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /de ni mngon par dbang bskur mthong ske/ /rig 'dzin rgyal po chen po yis/ /mchod pa byed par nges mthong ngo ske/ /zhes kyang gsungs so/ /rdo rje las byung sna tshogs pa'i/ /rmi na/lam dri ma med mthong des/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje las/ /skyes pa bla med 'grub par 'gyur / /gdol pa khyi yi 95nisbyor la sogs/ /gal te rdo rje blos mthong na/ /blo ldan rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /sems kyi gnas ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /de la 'di ni rmi lam rnam par dpyad pa'i dam 4tshig gi snying po'o/ /rang sems sems ni dmigs pa la/ /chos rnams thams cad rab gnas pa/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i (pesems gnas 'di/ /chos med chos nyid med pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur/ rmad du byung bar gyur nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig gi the tshom gcod pa rdo rje sems dpa' la zhus pa6/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ci zhig lags / ngo bo nyid med chos rnams la/ /chos kyi de nyid kun bshad pa/ nam mkha' la ni nam mkha' bsgom / /e ma'o ngo mtshar yang dag byung / /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad nam mkha' ni chos gang dang yang mi ldan te/ mi ldan pa yang ma yin no/ /nam mkha' deng 8ni chos thams cad du gtogs la 9/ thams cad kyi rjes su blta'o snyam du yang mi sems so/ /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 81—385

rmi lam dang / rmi lam las byung bar rjes su rig par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'di lta ste/ gzhan yang nam mkha' ni brtag tu med pa/ bltar med pa thogs pa med pa'o/ /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad chos thams cad kyang rjes su rig par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'di lta ste/gzhan yang lus dang ngag dang sems dang chos thams cad dang rdo rje'i gnas kyi dam tshig ni thams cad la rjes su song ba ngo bo nyid gcig pa ste/ 'di lta ste/sems kyi ngo bo nyid do/ /lus dang ngag dang sems kyi khams gang yin pa dang /nam mkha'i khams de dag gnyis su med cing gnyis su byar med do/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'di lta ste/ gzhan yang sems can thams cad ni nam mkha'i khams su gnas te/ nam mkha'i khams de yang 'dod pa'i khams na gnas pa ma yin/ gzugs kyi khams na gnas pa ma yin/gzugs med pa'i khams na yang gnas pa ma yin te/ chos gang khams gsum na mi gnas pa de ni skye ba med pa'o/ /gang la skye ba med pa de ni chos gang gis kyang brtag par mi nus so/ /de bas na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med pa'o/ /kye lho)bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'di lta ste/ gzhan yang byang chub kyi sems ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes 'byung bar byed pa rdo rje'i gnas kyi rnam pa ste/ byang chub kyi sems de yang lus la mi gnas/ ngag la mi gnas/sems la mi gnas so/ /chos gang yang khams gsum na mi gnas pa de la skye ba med de/ /'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes 'byung bar byed pa 81—386

rdo rje'i gnas yin no/ /kye bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rmi lam ni bdag gis khams gsum du rmi lam gyi gnas mthong bar bya'o snyam du mi sems so/ /mi mi yang bdag gis 2mi lam mthong bar bya'o snyam du mi sems te/khams gsum (bgyi bya ba de rnams kyang rmi lam lta bu/ rmi lam dang 'dra ba rmi lam las byung ba'o/ /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' ji snyed bzhugs pa rnams dang / sems can ji snyed pa de dag thams cad kyang mi lam la bdag med pa'i gnas su rjes su rig par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'di lta ste/ dper na/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che ni rin po che thams cad kyi gtso bo yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa ste/ rin po che thams cad kyi gtso bo yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa gang yin pa de la sems can gang dag gis gser ram/ rin tsho po che'am dngul yang rung ste/ gang gsol ba btab 95pa de dag thams cad bsams pa tsam nyid kyis 'byor par byed de/ rin po che la sogs pa de dag kyang sems la mi gnas/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu la gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad chos thams cad dang sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyang rjes su rig par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad rab tu dgyes pa'i spyan gdangs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang la nam mkha'i khams kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i chos thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams rjes su 81—387

'brang bar 'gyur ro zhes pa ni ngo mtshar che'o/ /de nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyis zhi bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs gnyis la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gang bcom ldan 'das kyis sngags thams cad kyi rdo rje'i dngos grub kun nas btus te gsungs pa/ sngags thams cad kyi rdo rje ②kun nas btus pa'i dngos grub de dag gang la gnas pa lags/ gang nas byung ba lags/ de nas phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad la legs so zhes bya ba byin nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sngags thams cad kyi rdo rje'i kun nas btus pa'i dngos grub ni sngags thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs la mi gnas so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/'on kyang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dngos grub thams cad dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad rang gi lus dang ngag dang sems rdo rje la gnas so/ /lus dang ngag dang sems rdo rje de dag kyang 'dod pa'i khams na mi gnas/ gzugs kyi khams na mi gnas/ gzugs med pa'i khams na (kyemi gnas/ sems ni lus la mi gnas/ lus kyang sems la mi gnas/ ngag ni sems la mi gnas/ sems kyang ngag la mi gnas so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/nam mkha' ltar ngo bo nyid dag pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos gang la gnas pa lags/ gang nas byung ba lags/ rdo rje 'chang gis bka' stsal pa/81—388

rang gi lus dang ngag dang sems la gnas so/ /rang gi lus dang ngag dang sems las byung ngo / /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 1gsol pa/ sems gang la gnas/ bka' stsal pa nam mkha' la gnas so/ /gsol pa nam mkha' gang la gnas/ bka' stsal pa gang la yang mi gnas so/ /de nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad ngo mtshar nadu gyur / rmad du byung ( bar gyur nas rang gi sems kyi chos nyid la gnas nas sems shing cang mi smra bar 'khod par gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang chen gsang ba 'dus pa las sems can thams cad kyi dam tshig gi snying po rdo rje 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bco 4lnga pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yang 'dus par gyur nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i tshig gis gsol ba btab nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje rin chen gyi mchod pa'i bkod pas mchod pa byas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pas rdo rje thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor seng ge'i dam tshig gi rgyal po'i bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ rdo rje sku'i dkyil 'khor 'di sangs rgyas thams cad nyid 5kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /de nas de phyir sku'i dkyil 'khor/ /mchog thugs dkyil 'khor rab 'dra ba/ /dkyil 'khor rnams ni kun gyi snyomachog /legs par 81—389

rab tu bshad par bya/ /khru ni bcu drug tshad du bya/ /gru bzhi lham pa rab tu mdzes / /sangs rgyas kun gyi dkyil 'khor te/ /sku yi rdo rje rab tu gnas/ / de yi 1)nang du 'khor lo ni/ /cho ga rdo rjes bri bar bya/ /sngags rnams kyi ni gsang ba mchog /dbus su rnam par snang mdzad gnas/ /phyag rgya rdo rje'i gnas bya'o/ /mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'ang bri/ /sku dang gsung thugs rdo rje mchog /grwa rnams kun du dgod par bya/ /khro bo dang po rnams sgor bri(mi/ /stobs chen pha rol gnon pa rnams/ /rdo rje gsang ba rab bsgom pa'i/ /mchod pa sngags shes pa yis bya/ /'di ni sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /dam tshig shin tu 'da' dka' (5)ba'o/ /bshang dang gci ba la sogs pa/ /bye brag tu ni nges par dbul/ /'di ni sku yi rdo rje can/ /sngags rnams kun gyi dam tshig go/ /'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pas gsung rdo rje thams cad kyi dam tshig gi sprin bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas gsung rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /de nas de phyir gsung dkyil 'khor/ /mchog thugs dkyil 'khor rab tu 'dra/ /dkyil 'khor rnams ni kun gyi mchog /legs par rab tu bshad par bya/ /khru ni nyi shu'i tshad du bya/ /gru bzhi lham pa cho ga bzhin/ /grwa bzhi pa la sgo bzhi par / /rdo rje bsgoms ④pas thig gdab bo/ /nyid kyi sku yi dkyil 'khor gnas / /rdo rje'i 5)gsung gi yon tan bskyedayi/ /rgyal po chen po rdo rje chos/ /rig pa'i dbang po 'jug par bya/ /de dbus 'khor lo chen po ni/ /kun du rlum po /bri bar bya/ /mdor na phyag rgya thams cad ni/ /cho ga brtson pas bri 81—390

bar bya/ /tshe dpag med kyi phyag rgya che/ /de yi dbus su dgod par bya/ /rdo rje'i gnas ni nyams dga' nyid/ /de dag thams cad yongs su brtag /yongs su gsal bar hu)cho ga yis/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa byas nas ni/ /de nas gsang ba'i mchod pa tshan bya/ /de ltas rdo rje can mnyes 'gyur/ /bshang gci khu ba'i ②dam tshig gis/ /mchod na dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /dam tshig shin tu 'da' dka' ba'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pas kun nas sprin gyi bkod pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ rab tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gsang chen 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /rdo rje 'dzin mchog gang yin pa'i/ /gzugs ni dbus su legs bris pa/ /de yi dkyil 'khor gnas su 'gyur/ /sku gsung thugs kyi gsang las byung / /'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang 4gsung dang pa thugs rdo rje'i gnas shes pa'i gsang chen rab tu gsang ba'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pas dkyil 'khor thams cad 'khor lo 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i gsang ba 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi sngags kyi snying po'i thig gi yi ge'i gnas rnams te/ oṃ āḥ// rdo rje'i thig ni gdab pa dang / / tshon rtsi 96rnams kyang dgye ba ④dag /sngags kyi sems pas mi bya ste/ /byas na byang chub rnyed par dka' / /de bas dam tshig cho ga shes/ /sngags kyi lha rnams bcug nas su/ /81—391

byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas bsgoms la/ /dkyil 'khor rnams ni rnam par brtag1 /rgyal chen rnam par snang mdzad dang / /spyan ma yang ni gzhug par bya / /sku yi dkyil 'khor gnas yid ge'ong / /rdo rje'i sku yi yon tan 'thob/ /rdo rje chos ni rgyal po che/ /rang gi chos mas rdu /'jug par bya/ /'di ni sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /mchog tu rtag pa'i gsang ba'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /mā ma tī yang 'jug par bya/ /'di de sngags rnams thams cad kyi / /mchog tu rmad byung gsang chen no/ /de ltar byas pas myur ④du rang / /rab dang yid dbang rnams byon nas/ /rab tu dgyes par gyur pa rnams/ /gsang ba mchog ni 'dri bar byed/ /'di skad kyang gsungs ⑤so/ /sngags grub pa yis 56)bya ba ni/ /rdo rje gsang ba rmad byung che/ /khro bo'i rgyal po yis sangs rgyas / /thams cad bkug nas mchod par bya/ /rdo rje gsum dang gnas dag la / /dam tshig mchod pa dus gsum pa/ /rdo rje gsum gyi sbyor bas bya/ /sngags kyi dngos grub thob par byed/ /'di skad kyang gsungs so/ /sngags rnams thams cad nyid la yang / /rmad byung chen (7)po'i gtor ma dbul(8)/ /bshang gci ri9 sha dang 'bru lamar dang / /lnga pa sems las byung ba dang / /khu ba dag gis nya1sngags rnams kun/ /tshim par 'gyur bar kun du bshad/ /'di ni dam tshig mchog yin te/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rdzogs byed pa'o/ /thig gdab pa yi 12cho ga 'di/ /rang nyid gang tshe maspyod pa na/ /rnam par snang mdzad rab bsgoms nas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab tu bsgom/ /yang na rdo rje bdud rtsir grags / /slob ma rdo rje 'od po cherabo/ /bsgom bya las kyi go 'phang ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis nges sten skopa'o/ /sangs rgyas rgyal chen lnga rnams ni/ /rdo 81—392

rje'i thig skud gshegs rnams dgod/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba rab tu rmad 3༷byung ba'o/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bye brag gis/ /tshon rtsi dag kyang rnam par dgye72na/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /gsang chen byang chub dam pa'o/ /sngags rnams thams cad nyid la yang / /rdo rje rtsu mdzad bsgom par bya/ /mchog gi sku gsung thugs dam tshig /gnas lnga dag tu bsgom par bya/ /de ltar byas na nye dmi 'gyur/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum las skyes/ /rdo rje sems dpa' blo ldan pa/ /'jigs shing skrag nas byin rlob mdzad/ /rdo rje bum pa rnams dgod pa/ /sngags rgyud bdag pos 4shes byas par/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i (nating 'dzin gnas/ /brtan pa'i blos ni brtag 7par bya/ /dngos grub kun 'bras 'dod pa yin/ /sngags shes pas ni sbyin sreg 9bya/ /bshang gci 'bru mar sha la sogs/ /bsreg rdzas dag ni dbul bar bya/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum 'khor lo/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i sbyin sreg bodabul/ /dbus su rang gi lha yi tshigazugs/ /bsams te zhal du dbab par bya/ /'di skad kyang gsungs so/ /dbang po gnyis ni rab sbyor bas/ /brgya rtsa brgyad ni sbyin sreg 32bya / /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /dam tshig shin tu 'da' dka' ba'o/ /rnam par snang mdzad sbyor ba yis1lha/ /slob ma rdo rje gsum las byung / /āḥmuyig lus dang ngag sems la/ /bsgoms nas rdo rje sa'adzin par byed/ /rgyal chen rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /grags chen rnam par snang mdzad ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig tu/ /byin gyis brlabs ni rab tu stsol/ /de la 'di ni dkyil 'khor chen por gzhug pa'i rdo rje'i dam glutshig go/ /āḥkho bī ra rtsu/'di ni dam tshig thams cad kyi lus dang ngag dang sems kyi snying po'i sngags kyi 81—393

rgyal po'o/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje chen po dbang bskur ①ba'i gsang ba'i ye shes gsang chen no/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis nam mkha'i khams/ /yongs su gang bar rab tu bsgom/ /rdo rje'i blo yis (misil snyan dang / /dri sogs dam tshig sprin tshogs bsgom/ /'di skad kyang gsungs so/ /rdo rje (kyisku gsum sngags kyis ni/ /yungs kur ri brtul zhugs can gyis (na)brdeg /de la de yi yitshe na ni/ /rang nyid dbang bskur 7rab tu stsol/ /yang ni rdo rje sems dpa' yis/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis sangs rgyas bsgom/ /bum pa dam tshig mchog rnams kyis/ /bzung bar mkhas pas bsgom par bya/ /rtag tu slob ma blo brtan pa/ /rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad bsam/ /lus dang ngag sems rdo rje can/ /sngags shes pas ni dgod par bya/ /de la 'di ni dbang bskur ba thams cad kyi gsang chen te/slob dpon thams cad kyis (8)rdo rje'i tshig tu yinyesmra bar bya'o⑩/ /dbang bskur chen po rdo rje ni/ /khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa/ /rdo rje gsang ba gsum byung 37ba/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis sbyin par bya/ /de la 'di ni slob ma thams cad kyis rdo rje chen po'i nyi gsol ba gdab pa'i cho ga gsang chen no/ /byang chub rdo rjes nyugesangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba bzhin/ /bdag kyang rab tu bsgral 97ba'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje (snyedeng bdag stsol/ /de tshe de la dbang bskur ba/ /rab dga'i sems kyis sbyin par bya/ /lha yi gzugs kyi sbyor ba yis/ /snying gar chabadag po gzhag na par bya/ /rdo rje slob ma blo ldan lanyuge / / sngags kyi yi ge'i tshig byin la'oste/ /de la dkyil 'khor bstan par bya/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gsungs pa'i/ /dam tshig gsang du )ba bsgrag par bya//khyod kyis srog chags gsad par bya/ /brdzun gyi tshig kyang smra bar bya/ /ma byin 81—394

pa ①yang khyod kyis blang / /pha rol bud med bsten (na par bya/ /rdo rje'i lam ni 'di dag gis/ /sems can thams cad rab bskul ri )bya/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /dam tshig mchog tu rtag pa'o/ /zhes kyang gsungs so/ /sngags kyis bskul chab smras pa yi75ci/ /de la sngags kyang 6)sbyin par bya/ /sngags kyi rgyal po'i ting 'dzin ni/ /byin nas gsang ba yang dag brtsam/ /khu ba'am yang na bshang ba'ang rung / /mngon par bsngags 97/nas cho ga bzhin/ /rdo rje'i blos ni zar gzhug bya/ /'di ltas dngos grub rnyed mi dka'/ /rnam pa 'di bzhi gsang chen te/ /rdo rje can ni kun gyi gsang / /sngags kyi 'khor los bud med gzugs/ /sems can don spyod phyir gnas pa'o/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor sngags thams cad kyis tsho ramanyes par bya ba gsang ba'o/ /glang po'i sha dang rta yi sha /sha chen dag kyang bza' bar bya/ /sngags rnams kun la dbul bar bya/ /de ltar byas na mgon po mnyes/ /nyin re rdo rje slob ma la/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor bstan par bya/ /bshang gci sha yi bya ba dang / /rdo rje gsang ba'i gnas kyis kyang / /sngags rnams kun gyi yi ge oṃ/ /bsgoms na de ma thag tu 'bar/ /bcom ldan 'das sngags kyi rig pa'i skyes bu chen pos de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /dngos grub thams cad bsgrub 997pa ste/ /dam tshig chen po bsgrub 0pa'o/ /rab tu 'bad pas bsgrub bya ba/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rang nyid kyang / /mi snang stobs dang brtson 'grus dang / /rdo rje 'gugs pa mchog dag ni/ /rdo rje sku yi bka' ji bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor du ni thams cad 'grub / /bshang gci dang ni sha chen rnams/ /cha ni mnyam par byas nas su/ /kham phor sbyar mar bzhag rmolhanas ni/ /sangs rgyas kun dang lhan cig 'khod32/ /81—395

'di skad ces kyang gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni gsang ba thams cad kyi rdo rje mngag gzhug pa rab tu bsgrub 51)pa'i dam 2tshig gi mchog go/ /hrīḥ yig 'bar ba 'od bzang po/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i dbus gnas bsam/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis riganam mkha'i khams/ /yongs su gang bar rnam par bsgom/ /de yi sku gsung thugs kyi gnas/ /der ni sngags la dbab par bya/ /de la 'di ni sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi sngags rdo rje'i byin gyis rlob pa'i gnas so/ /iḥ95)kho dhīḥ phyag na rdo rje gzugs chen po(nya/ /phyag na pad+mo 'od chen dang / /gzhan gyis mi thub gzugs chen dag /bsgoms nas gsang ba'i gnas gzhag go/ /de 57)la 'di ni rdo rje gsang ba'i gnas so/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par / /mi bskyod ri pa ni rab tu brtag /tshe dpag med pa'i rdo rje che/ /rdo rje snang mdzad de bzhin te/ /thams cad 'od chen sdug bsngal ni/ /chen po skyusnying pos bskul bar bya/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje thams cad kyi snying po bskul pa'o/ / āḥ mdung the 7rtse che dang rdo rje che/ /lcags kyu 'o)sna tshogs mchog rnams kyis/ /rdo rje cho ga bzhin du bskul/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab tu 'grub/ /'di 8skad ces kyang gsungs so/ /nyams dga' ba dang ri dbang 8dang / /chu gling rnam pa sna tshogs su/ /zla phyed nang dang rdzogs pa yis/ /nges par sangs rgyas nyid thob 'gyur/ /ri rab sum cu (7rtsa drug gi/ /rdul phran ji snyed yod pa yi/ /'khor gyi tshogs rnams de dag ni/ /byang chub rdo rje can grub 'gyur/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sangs rgyas zhing du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zab mo'i chos ni thos 'gyur zhing / /sangs rgyas sa yang thob par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das dam tshig rdo rje bzhad mapa chen pos de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de 81—396

la 'di ni mngag gzhug pa thams cad kyi gsang ba rdo rje gsang chen no/ /rdo rje sems dpa' ye shes che/ /de bzhin gsung gi rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje sku yi dgod pa ches/ /mngag gzhug pa rnams rtag tu bskul/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje ye shes 'khor lo sngags kyi dam tshig gi gnas rnam pa bzhi ste/ dam tshig bskul ba dang /dam tshig gtong ba dang / dam tshig bod pa dang / dam tshig 'ching ba'o/ /mkha' dbyings rgya chen dag pa ni/ /chos rnams thams cad rnam spangs pa/ /gong bu'i tshul gyis 6)rdo rje ni/ /rmad dbyung gzugs can byed par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bu gcig pa rdo rje sems dpa' chen pos de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa'ang 9 rung / /gal te dbang du bya 'dod na/ /rdo rje mchog gsum 'dzin pa che/ /gsang ba chen po 'di bsam mo/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje stobs po che/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i dbus gnas wasam/ /mda' lnga'i rab tu sbyor ba yis/ /dbu rgyan rtse mor yang dag spro/ /gnas lnga dag tu sngags shes pas/ /rdo rje khro bo dbab par bya/ /byis pa'i blo ni grags chen gyis/ /sngangs 4 shing brgyal bar bsgom par bya/ /bsam gtan 'di ni gsang ba yi/ /skul ba dag gis phyogs gcig bsgom5/ /sngags rnams kun gyi rab tu gsang / /rdo rje'i don gyi blo yis gsungs/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i dbus gnas pa'i/ /ཿ yig sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor mchog /bsam bya rdo rje'i sngags sogs kyis/ /rdo rje gsum la sogs pa bsgom/ /mig gnas yi ge oṃ bsams nas/ /'di dag cho gas bstan par bya/ /sngags rnams kun gyi gzugs dag ni/ /sku gsung rdo rje can rnams mthong / /bkres skom la sogs nyon mongs che6/ /sbyor ba 'di ni rnam bsam 77na/ /rdo rje thugs 81—397

kyi bka' bzhin du/ /sdug bsngal thams cad byang bar 'gyur/ /rnam par snang mdzad gzugs chen po/ /don rnams thams cad 'byor bsam 0)la/ /yi ge baṃ khar gnas pa bsgom/ /oṃ yig lce la 'dug par bsam bza' bar bya ba kun gyi gnas/ /yid bzhin nor bus ②rnam brgyan pa/ /zhi ba sdug bsngal thams cad sel/ /ye shes rdo rje rab bskul ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das yid bzhin gyi nor bus de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa dpa' bo ②chen po ④de bzhin gshegs pas rdo rje bsgom (gepa'i tshig gi mchog rdo rje gsung las phyung ngo / /bīḥ nam mkha' rdo rje'i dbus gnas par/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor 'od bzang bsam/ /rdo rje sku gsum sbyor ba yis/ /bskyed de 'di ni rnam par bsam/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs rdzogs pa/ /ser po rdo rje rnam par 'gying / /zhi ba thor tshugs dbu rgyan can/ /bsams nas thams cad brtsam par bya/ /dpa' bo rdo rje'i rlabs kyi phreng ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang kun nas nges par bsgrags pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rdo rje chen po bsgom 4)pa'i tshig 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /rtsu/ nam mkha' rdo rje'i dbus su ni/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dam pa bsam/ /cho ga dag gis sangs rgyas sprin/ /rdo rje gsum mchog grags chen ni/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs kyis ltung / /skul byed rdo rje ma bsgom mo/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs rdzogs pa/ /kha dog dkar mor rab tu bsgom/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /bsams la sngags kyi gnas dgod do/ /rdo rje'i dam tshig ye shes kyi 'od zer zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /81—398

de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pas 3)bsam pa thams cad rdo rje'i longs spyod ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas ting nge 'dzin 'khor lo'i tshul 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /rdza/nam mkha' rdo rje'i dbus gnas par/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor dam pa bsam//sangs rgyas kun gyi cho ga yis/ /rdo rje bsgoms napas dbab par bya/ /rdza bha la ni nor bsgrub ③pa/ /gnod sbyin chen po bskyed par bya/ /zhi ba gnod sbyin gzugs 'dzin pa/ /thor tshugs dbu rgyan rirdo rje can/ /sangs rgyas lnga ni cho ga yis/ /gnas lnga dag tu bsgom par bya/ /de yi rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu/ /bsam gtan gnas la 'dug ④pas dbul/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i 6cho ga yis/ / de yi ⑦dbu rgyan rnam par bsam/ /de ltar byas na gnod sbyin dbang / /'brog (kyeganas dbang po 'od chen mnyes/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya'i dam tshig rdzas sgrub pa'i rtog 0gi dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pas 'dod pa nye bar spyod pa'i dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ gnod sbyin mo thams cad kyi dam tshig rdo rje'i tshig 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /k+ṣi/ mkha' dbyings rdo rje'i dbus gnas 7par/ /gru bzhi lham pa rab tu mdzes/ /thams cad rin chen bzhi las byas/ /me tog spos kyis kun du 'khrigs/ /gnod sbyin mo ni thams cad kyis/ /mkha' dbyings yongs su gang bar bsam/ / gzugs kyi sprin dag rnam bsams nas11/ /rdo rje gsum gyi sbyor bas 12dbab/ /gzugs ni gcig tu bsam par bya/ /rdo rje gsum las bye brag gis/ /de yi bsam gtan bsam par bya/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i ting 'dzin gnas/ /dbu 81—399

rgyan la ni khro bo bsgom/ /snying gar 57sngags kyi tshig bsgoms la/ /rdo rje'i sbyor ba brtsam par bya/ /gnod sbyin mo thams cad mnyam pa nyid gnas pa bsgom pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pas tshorin)rdo rje'i sngags thams cad dngos grub kyi rnam par 'phrul pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas phra mo'i dngos grub 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /sku dang gsung thugs yang dag grub / /sangs rgyas gzugs 'dzin 'od bzang po/ /'dzam bu chu ①yi gser 'od 'dra/ /dngos grub phra mo dag la gnas/ /mi snang la sogs kun grub ni/ /gtso bo rdo rje 'chang du 'gyur/ /gnod sbyin rgyal mo grub pa che/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i ④gtso bor 'gyur/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i dngos grub thams cad kyi gzugs gsang ba 75nyesngags kyi dngos grub rnams so/ /sngags kyi dngos grub yid 'ong ba'i/ /mdzes pa'i gzugs rnams thams cad ni/ /'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /mthong ba nyid kyi dga' bar 'gyur/ /gtsug tor thams cad grub pa yi/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i bdag por 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas byang chub byed pa'i mchog/sangs rgyas nyid kyang rab bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i rdo rjes de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rig pa'i brtul zhugs yang dag par len pa'i spyod pa 'di (7nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje rnams/ /lus dang ngag sems dmigs pa ni/ /rang gzugs nyid kyis rigede bya ste/ /de ltas dngos grub thob 81wa 400

par 'gyur/ /de la 'di ni sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rdo rje'i rig pa'i brtul zhugs so/ /gzugs ni thor tshugs dbu rgyan 1'chang / /chen po kha dog dkar po 'dra/ /cho ga bzhin du thams cad bya/ /sngags kyi sdom pas kun du bsdams(kye / /lo grangs bcu drug lon pa ni/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par bklubs(2)ske/ /bzhin sdug mig gi dkyus ring ba/ /rnyed nas rig pa'i brtul zhugs spyad/ /spyan gyi go 'phang longs spyod cing / /rdo rje'i (4rimatshan ma yis ni bya / /phyag rgya sngags kyi cho ga shes/ /sngags dang rgyud ni legs par bslabs95)/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i btsun mor bya/ /sangs rgyas byang chub la rab gnas/ /brtul zhugs chen pos thun bzhir ni/ /gsang ba'i mchod pa rab tu bya/ /sdong bu rtsa ba 'bras bu rnams/ /bza' dang bca' ba rmethams cad spyad/ /'di yis zhumyur du sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /bdag po ye shes rgya mtsho che/ /zla ba drug gis de dag kun/ /gdon mi za bar 'dir thob 'gyur/ /rtag tu gzhan gyi nor brku zhing / /gsad pa'ang rmad 8du byung ba che/ /'dod chags rdo rje'i gnas spyad pa/ /sdom pa 'dis ni kun du bsdams9/ /'dod chags rdo rje'i 7lcags kyu yum/ /yon tan lug rgyud 11mā ma tīr12/ /gsung gi rdo rje mchog thugs kyis/ /'di ni rnam pa kun du rigs/ /rang gi phyag rgya'am sems kyis bsam / /bsam gtan yig gsum rdo rje can/ /de ltar sangs rgyas kun mkhyen yang / /mnyes par 'gyur 'dir gdon mi za/ /sgrub pa po ni blo brtan pasal/ /nags tshal dag tu bsod snyoms tshol/ /kha zas bzang po bstar 1lhab dag /'jigs shing skrag nas ster bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje gsum bdag nyid 'das na/ /'jig cing rdo rje'i yi ger 'gyur/ /lha mo klu mo gnod sbyin ma1ri/ /81wa 401

lha ma yin mo mi mo'ang rung / /rnyed nas rig pa'i brtul zhugs bya/ /rdo rje gsum gyi ye shes bstan1/ /'di de sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba'i de nyid tshul chen te/ /rdo rje gsum gyi ye shes 'byung / /sangs rgyas byang chub rab (kye'ajug pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rig pa'i brtul zhugs kyi dam tshig gi de kho na nyid kyi rdo rjes de skad ces bka' stsal to / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi ②gsang chen gsang ba 'dus pa las dngos grub thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor rdo rje mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bcu drug pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ④yang 'dus nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa la gsol ba btab pa/ mi bskyod ④rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkhas pa che/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /gsang ba gsungs 97khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal chos rnams ni/ /ston mdzod rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri med mkha'//rang bzhin dag pas tsho dgos pa med/ /gsang ba gsungs shig khyod phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ / mi rtog (nyenam mkha' rdo rje can/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /rdo rje gsungs khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /don yod rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzogs mdzad/ /dag pa ngo bo nyid las byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis 81—402

bskul ①ba yi/ /bstod tshig zhi ba 'di rnams kyis/ /rdo rje longs spyod bstod na ni/ /de yang sangs rgyas mnyam par 'gyur/ /de nas ston pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas kun la rjes brtse bas/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i gnas dag pa/ /rdo rje gsung ni bka' stsal to/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi yi ge che/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal dag pa ni/ /nam mkha'i dbyings bzhin dri ma med/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku rdo rje'i dam tshig 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /sangs rgyas ye shes mtsho 'od kyis/ /dam tshig bzhi ni bsrung bya ste/ /sha chen rtag tu bza' bya'o/ /'di ni dam tshig mchog yin no/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i bdag pos sangs rgyas thams cad (migasung rdo rje'i dam tshig 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /dam tshig bzhi po bsrung bya ste/ /gsung gi rdo rje yi ge ches/ /bshang gci rtag tu bza' bya nyid/ /'di ni gsang ba rmad byung ba'o/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdas pos rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje'i dam tshig 'di nyid sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /rdo rje sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul ches/ /dam tshig bzhi po bsrung bya ste/ /khrag dang khu ba sbyar ba dag /brtul zhugs brtan pas rtag tu bza'/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yi/ /dam tshig de ni rmad byung che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rtag pa ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin phyir yang dag bsrung / /gang zhig dam tshig 'di srung ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'od po che/ /de yi sku gsung thugs rtogs napa/ /de ma thag tu sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 81—403

bdag pos rang sangs rgyas kyi don gyi dam tshig 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /ston pa lus kyis de rnams ni/ /rdo rje sku la rab tu gnas/ /sems can 'jug pa'i ngang tshul te/ /mchog tu rtag pa'i dam tshig go/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos nyan thos kyi bslab pa'i dam tshig 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /dge ba bcu yi (1)las kyi lam/ /byed pa ye shes spangs pa rnams/ /dman par mos pa thams cad kyi/ /dam tshig de ni rmad byung che/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos tshangs pa'i dam tshig 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /gti mug lam gyis ༷2)las gang rnams/ /byed pa 'jigs shing mi sdug pa/ /sangs rgyas byang chub ston pa ste/ /sku yi rdo rje nyid du 'gyur/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos drag po'i dam tshig 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /khams gsum par ni gnas pa yi/ /bud med rdo rje las byung kun/ /sna tshogs dngos pos spyad pa ni/ /dam tshig mchog tu rmad byung ba'o/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos khyab 'jug gi dam tshig 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /sems can skyes pa ji snyed pa/ /sku gsum dbyer med la gnas rnams/ /bsam gtan rdo rjes gsad par tshon)bya/ /rdo rje mkha' khams bdag nyid kyang / /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos rdo rje gsum gyi dam tshig gi rdo rje 'di nyid kyi/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /sku yi rdo rje tshangs par 'gyur/ /gsung gi rdo rje dbang phyug che/ /thugs kyi rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /de nyid khyab 'jug rdzu 81wa 404

'phrul che/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos gnod sbyin mo thams cad kyi dam tshig 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo ske/ /sha dang khrag ni za ba dang / rtag tu bud med 'dod mchog gzhol/ /rdo rje chen po 'di rnams kyi/ /dam tshig bsten dkas (11mnyes par bya/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos klu'i dbang po'i rgyal mo thams cad kyi dam tshig 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /phra ma dang ni 'o ma 'thung / /'dod dang dri ma nartag tu 'bad/ /dam tshig 'di rnams kyis bsgrub bya/ /gzhan du nges par nyon mongs 'gyur/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos lha ma yin gyi bu mo'i dam tshig 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /khro zhing nga rgyal khur gyis non / /spos dang me tog spyod pa skyes/ /dam tshig rdo rje sa 'og tu/ /gdul dka' rdo rje 'jigs byed de/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos srin mo rnams kyi dam tshig 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /thod rus bdug pa'i da'abru mar dang / /zhag gis rab tu dga' bar 'gyur/ /'byung po kun gyi dam tshig 'di/ /dag (4)byed rdo rje don chen byed/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi dam tshig 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /bshang ba 5)gci ba khrag bza' zhing / /chang la sogs pa rtag tu btung ske/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i sbyor bas/ /gnas kyi mtshan nyid kyis gsang bya(6nye / /ngo bo nyid kyis kun 'byung ba/ /khams gsum dag tu rnam par spyod/ /dam tshig ma lus dngos grub kun/ /phan par 'dod pas spyad par bya/ /81—405

khams gsum pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig gi rjes su 'brang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos lus kyi dngos grub kyi dam tshig rdo rje nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /lus kyi rnam gsum thams cad ni/ /rdo rje yang dag 'byung ①bar bya/ /sems can khams ni rnam kun du/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas sku byed pa'o//de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos ngag gi dngos grub kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /ngag gi las lam ma lus par/ /khams gsum dri med dkyil 'khor du/ /ngag gi grub gnas nyams dga' 'di/ /dam tshig shin tu 'da' dka' ba'o②/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos sems ((rnam par dag pa'i dam tshig nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /yid kyi rdo rje'i ④rang bzhin kun/ /brtan pa rdo rje'i blo yis bsgom/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum ldan gyi / /dam tshig bshad pa 'di yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kun du bzang po rdo rje sems dpas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos sngags thams cad kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang 5/ /rang rgyal nyan thos de bzhin te/ /sku gsung thugs kyi yo)sbyor ba yis/ /phyag 'tshal na ni nyams par 'gyur/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i bsam gtan gyi dam tshig nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /kun du sku dang gsung thugs kyi/ /dkyil 'khor rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /rdo rje 81—406

gsum gyi sbyor ba yis/ /bsam gtan sngags zlos (1)pas bsgom bya/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos sngags rdo rje thams cad kyi sdom pa nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /sems can khams rnams bsdus nas ni/ /bsam gtan rdo rjes bskul bar bya/ /rdo rje gsum phyag mchog gi mchog /dam tshig rdo rje 'byung ba'o/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ri bdag pos bsnyen pa dang / /bsgrub pa dang nye bar sgrub pa dang sgrub pa chen po'i sdom pa nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /rdo rje bshang gcis stinam mkha'i dbyings/ /yongs su gang bar rnam par bsam/ /dus gsum rdo rje dag la dbul/ /dam tshig rab tu rtag pa'o/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos rdo rje thams cad mi snang ba'i dam tshig nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /thun bzhi po ni gang zhig mchog /rdo rje mo ni ④nyin re spyad/ /slar yang rdzas kyang rtag tu dbrog /rdo rje rdzogs byed dam tshig go/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos nam mkha'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i dam tshig nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje rnams/ /dbu rgyan gyi ni bsam gtan bsam/ /rdo rje gsum gyi dam tshig kun/ /khros pa rnams kyis ④rgyal mi nus(nen/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos sngags 'chang las dang po pa thams cad kyi dam tshig nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /kha zas la ni sku'i tsho rdo rje/ /phyi rol rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / /rdo rje chos su rtag tu bya/ /mdo 'don cho ga'i bya ba la/ /bcom ldan 'das ngo bo nyid dag pa rdo rjes de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas 81—407

phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos ①rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rdo rje snying po rdo rje mnyam pa nyid rnam par dgongs nas cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /de nas yang brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi ri rab kyi rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po 'di ci'i slad du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi nang du cang mi gsung bar bzhugs pa lags/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis tsho byang chub sems dpa' de nidag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal tol/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi bdag po 'di sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i dmigs su med pa'i ngo bo nyid mi 'gyur ba'i gnas la gang ngo bo nyid med pa 4)mi 'gyur ba'i gnas rnam par dpyad 9genas cang mi gsung bar bzhugs so/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po 'di ni 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ sku yi yi ge ma skyes pa//gsung dang thugs kyang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' (6)rdo rje'i rtog par byung / /log par bzung bas gzung 7)ba yin/ /de nas 'jam dpal la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' tshonachen po rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gsung rdo rje'i tshig la log pa kun 'byung bas ma brtag botu gsol/de ci'i slad du zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i dbyangs (7kyi 81—408

ngo bo nyid spyod 6)pa gshegs pa dang byon pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po 'di yin no/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ tshangs pa la sogs pa'i byang chub chen po sems dpa' ( mngon par shes pa chen po'i gyiye shes thob pa rnams chos thams cad kyi mtshan nyid kyi ri4)ngo bo nyid mi shes pas 'di snyam du yongs su rtog par byed deXzhen/ ci rdo rje chen po'i bdag nyid 'di de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos thams cad kyi 6༄rdo rje de kho na nyid mngon par ma (7༄mkhyen nas gsang (deba'i yi ge 'chad dam snyam pa yang mchis so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byang chub sems dpa' de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /re zhig 79༄byang chub chen po sems dpa' khyed rnams lta ci smos/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba'i yi ge rnyed pa nged kyis kyang sku gsung thugs kyi byang chub mi shes so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ ngo bo nyid med pa/ mi 'gyur ba las byung ba/ skye ba med pa'i rdo rje mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pas so/ /rigs kyi bu dag sems can gyi khongs su gtogs pa'i sems can ji snyed yod pa de dag thams cad byang chub la gnas pa sangs rgyas rdo rje'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ yong ye sems can 'di dag ni sku gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid nye bar bzung nas sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i boye shes thob pa'o/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i bdag pos de bzhin gshegs pa 17thams cad dang /byang chub sems dpa' de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rang bzhin dag cing bdag med pa/ /chos kyi dbyings ni ma lus gnas/ /rtog pa rdo rje yang dag byung / /smra bya smra bya yang ma yin/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de 81wa 409

bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po phyag na rdo rje chen po la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang ①thugs rdo rje'i dngos grub gang nas yang dag par 'byung / gang du gnas gang du med par 'gyur ba lags/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje 'chang gis bka' stsal pa/ bcom ldan 'das rang gi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rgyud la rdo rje rab tu gnas so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub thams cad dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang / khams gsum ji snyed pa dag kyang ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis slar gsungs pa/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i dngos grub dang / khams gsum pa thams cad gang na gnas/ ye shes rdo rje'i bdag pos bka' stsal pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi dngos grub dang / khams gsum pa thams cad ni nam mkha'i khams la gnas so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsungs pa/ bcom ldan 'das nam mkha' gang na gnas/ rdo rje 'dzin pas bka' stsal pa/ gang na yang ma yin no/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' de dag ngo mtshar du gyur/ rmad du byung bar gyur nas dbyangs 'di dag brjod do/ /e ma'o rdo rje ((e rdo rje/ /e ma'o rdo rje'i bstan pa ni/ /gang du lus dang ngag sems med/ /de ru sku ni rnam sgom tsho —pa/ /de nas ston pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /rdo rje gsum mchog mchog chen mchog /rdo rje gsum mchog dbang phyug gis/ /81—410

dngos grub dag ni thams cad kyi/ /rig pa'i skyes bu bsgom pa gsungs/ /mkha' dbyings rdo rje'i dbus gnas par/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ / sku yi 6)rdo rje rab bsgoms nas/ /spyi bor rdo rje rab tu bsgom/ /zhal gsum sku gsum yang dag byung / /rnam par 'phro ba bsam par bya/ /rdo rje 'khor lo 'dzin bsams na/ /myur du byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /thams cad rigs kyi bye brag gis/ /gsang ba 'di ni rnam par bsam/ /gzhan du rnam par bsgom pa ni/ /de dag dngos grub mchog mi 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das rig pa'i skyes bu rdo rje gsang bas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /khams gsum las byung rgyal mo che/ /mnyes (5)par byed pa rnam par bsam/ /'di ltas mnyes 'gyur khyu mchog ni/ /rdo rje sku gsum mtshan (kyepa rnams/ /gang zhig la la 'di sgom pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' grags chen rnams/ /'od chen pos ni zhag bdun gyis/ /sku gsum dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos sku gsung thugs rdo rje bsdus pa'i gsang ba gsang chen snyinyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig ni/ /phyag rgya chen po'i don rtogs (5)pa//kun mtshan nyid kyis (nyacho ga bzhin/ /bsgoms 97)na sangs rgyas nyid thob 'gyur/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos yang sgrub (8)po thams cad kyi lus dang ngag dang sems kyi gsang chen nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /gal te byang chub mchog 'dod na/ /lag pa'i phyag rgya mi bcing ngo / /sngags rnams kun gyi dam tshig 'di/ /rgyal ba rnams kyang mi 'da'ol/ /de nas yang phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag 81—411

pos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dam tshig nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo ske/ /bshang gci khu ba khrag rnams ni/ /smad pa nyid du yong mi bya/ /cho ga bzhin du rtag tu bza'/ /gsang 'di rdo rje gsum byung yin/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos gsung rdo rje'i dam tshig nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /khams gsum lam ni nyams dga' bar/ /bud med ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /thams cad cho ga bzhin du spyad/ /gsung gi rdo rje mi smad do/ /de nas yang phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos thugs kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /rdo rje sku gsum la gnas pa'i/ /dam tshig ji snyed yod pa kun/ /rdo rje gsum gyi dam tshig gis/ /mgu bya thugs rdo rje mi smad/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gsum gyi dam tshig chen pos de 97skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas yang phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i rdo rje nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni/ /sangs rgyas lngar geni rab tu bsgrags / /rdo rje'i skye mched rnams nyid ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor mchog /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa nga thams cad kyi bdag pos khams gsum bsags pa'i rdo rje nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /sa ni spyan zhes bya ba yin/ /chu'i khams mā ma tī 5)zhes bya/ /dkar dang sgrol ma zhes bya ba/ /me dang rlung du rab tu bsgrags/ /mkha' dbyings rdo rje'i dam tshig ni/ /de nyid rdo rje 'dzin pa yin/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gnas kyi dbang phyug rdo rje sems 81—412

dpa' chen pos de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje shi)de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid kyi gnas zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /snyoms par zhugs nas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la gzigs nas cang mi gsung bar gegyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i gsang chen (5)gsang ba 'dus par mngon par dbang bskur ba'i slob dpon la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis ji ltar blta ri nibar bgyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa de bzhin gshegs pa 5thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis 567byang chub kyi sems rdo rje nyid du blta bar bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub kyi sems rdo rje dang slob dpon 'di ni gnyis su med cing gnyis su dbyer 7med do/ /rigs kyi bu ji snyed mdor bsdus 8te bstan na ni phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' gang rnams bzhugs pa dang 'tsho ba dang skyong 59)ba de rnams thams cad kyang dus gsum du byon nas/ rdo rje slob dpon de la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchod pa rnams kyis/ yang dag par mchod nas rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro zhing / ngag rdo rje'i yi ge'i (7tshig 'di skad du yang 'byin to / /bdag cag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi pha'o/ /bdag cag de 81—413

bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ma'o/ /bdag cag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ston pa'o/ /zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /'di lta ste gzhan yang rigs kyi bu sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das phyogs bcu na①/ ji snyed bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de rnams kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las byung ba'i bsod nams kyi phung po ji snyed pa de bas kyang / slob dpon gyi ba spu'i bu ga gcig gi bsod nams khyad par du 'phags so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu byang chub kyi sems ni (shesangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi snying por gyur pa bskyed (kyepa gnas par gyur pa nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi 'byung gnas yin pa'i bar du'o/ /de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' chen po byams pa yid 'jigs shing skrag risnyenanas cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod (snyepa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen tog dang / de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med dang / de bzhin gshegs pa don yod grub pa dang ske/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyis rdo rje 'dzin pa dngos grub kyi dam tshig thams cad dmigs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad la bka' stsal pa/byang chub sems dpa' khyed rnams thams cad nyon cig /gang yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dus gsum gyi rdo rje ye shes yang dag par byung ba de rnams kyang byon nas gsang ba 'dus pa'i slob dpon la mchod pa byed cing phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de nyid de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ston pa bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdag po yin pa'i phyir 81—414

ro / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub rnams gang la gnas / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 3)bka' stsal pa/ sku gsum gsang ba'i sku gsung thugs ni rdo rje slob dpon gyi lus dang ngag dang sems rdo rje la gnas so/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis gsol pa/ lus dang ngag dang sems rdo rje gang la gnas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang la yang mi gnas so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po de dag ngo mtshar du gyur rmad kun)du byung bar gyur nas cang mi smra bar gnas par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pas gsang ba'i rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bka' stsal pa/ khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byang chub kyi sems 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor chen po nyon cig /de nas yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyis tsho thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dkyil 'khor chen po bshad du gsol/ bde bar gshegs pa bshad du gsol / /nam ④mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas bsam/ /gru bzhi lham pa rab tu mdzes/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor sbyor ba yis/ /bsam gtan rdo rje rab bskul bya/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor bsam gtan gyis/ /'khor lo can kun gdan 81—415

du bya/ /mchod pa 51)cho ga de nyid kyis/ /blo dang ldan pas rtag tu bya/ /slob dpon snying gar (2cirab bsgoms nas/ /dbang bskur ba (kyeni yang dag spyad/ /mkha' dbyings sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /yongs su gang bar rnam bsgoms la / /thams cad dbang bskur gnas gsum gyis/ /cho ga bzhin du dbab par bya / /'di yis sems can thams cad la/ /phan bzhed byang chub thob 'gyur zhing ske/ /dngos grub thams cad rmad byung che/ /sku gsung thugs ni 'grub par 'gyur / /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje zhes bya ba bsam gtan gyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /de nas slar yang phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rje'i sbyor ba zhes bya ba sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i gsang ba nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /hūm̐ hrīḥkho/ sha rus la sogs dkyil 'khor ni / /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas bsam/ /sku dang gsung thugs gsum snying po/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom par bya/ /drag po mi sdug kun du khros / /ut+pal sngon po'i kha dog 'dra/ /phyag bzhi pa ni cho ga yis/ phyag na thod pa bsnams par bsgom/ /lnga yi 'od zer rab gsal ba'i/ /rang lce (gebartul zhugs can gyis bsgom(5/ /bsam gtan rdo rje'i sbyor ba yis/ /khrag drang ba yi 6mchog yin no/ /rtse gsum rdo rje dam tshig dang / /phur bu drag po mchog dag gis/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyi sku dag kyang / /rdo rje'i sbyor bas gzir bar bya/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos slar yang rdo rje kha zas kyi dam tshig gis rtsonabya ba nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /bza' ba'am btung ba gang cung zad/ /brtul zhugs can gyis 81—416
