gang za ba/ /bshang gci (1 sha yi sbyor ba yis/ /cho ga bzhin du yongs su brtag(gyi /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje mchod pa'i mchog nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /nyer spyod lnga yi mchod mchog gis/ /mchod bya de dag kyang mchod bya/ /'di ni rdo rje thams cad kyi/ /dam tshig shin tu 'da' dka' ba'o/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi mchod pa gsang ba nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /rang gi khu ba sogs bzung bas/ /cho ga bzhin du kun mchod bya/ /sangs rgyas byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /de nas yang phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi sdom pa nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /sems can khams rnams mtha' yas kyi/ /ma rnams dam tshig 'dzin pa ni/ /dam tshig gsum gyi rdo rjes na)spyad/ /sdom pa 'di ni rmad byung che//de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos thams cad sgrub pa'i sdom pa'i rdo rje nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /lus dang ngag sems longs spyod rdzogs/ /gsang ba gsum gnas rdo rje skyes/ /bzang po bdag gis bsgrub par bya/ /min na thams cad 'jig par 'gyur/ /de nas yang phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos thams cad sgrub pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i sdom pa nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /mtho gang tsam gyis dpags ri par ni/ /mgo bor dkyil 'khor brtag par bya/ /81—417

oṃ yig dbus su gnas bsams nas/ /bdud rtsi lnga bo dbab par bya/ /rdo rje sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /skad cig 1)gis ni gzi can 'gyur/ /lus dang ngag sems bder gnas par/ /'gyur bar rige'adir ni the tshom med/ /de nas yang phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi (5)bdag pos sngags thams cad 'dzin pa'i lus dang ngag dang sems kyi gsang ba nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /mchod rten dag gi las mi bya/ /glegs libam bklag pa'ang (srimi bya zhing / /dkyil 'khor dag kyang yong mi bya/ /rdo rje mchog gsum phyag mi bya / /de nas yang phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos dug thams cad bsal 56ba gnon pa 'dren pa'i gsang ba nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /oṃ/ 'od zer dkar 'bar phreng ba can/ /'khor lo'i dbus su chud par bzhag /'od zer ser po 'khrigs pa yis/ /ser po lta bur bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje gsum 'od dam tshig gis/ /sa bon 'di ni gsang gsum byung / /de nas slar yang phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos lus dang ngag dang sems srung (7)ba'i 'khor lo'i sngags rdo rje dang ldan pa nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /oṃ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ brta brnyan/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ a mṛ (gete rtsu phaṭa/ gro ga sogs la 'khor lo ni/ /las kyi rdo rje la gnas par/ /rgyu yig dbus su bzhag bonas su//ming ni dbus su bri bar bya/ /sngags kyi yi ge'i tshig rnams kyis/ /yang dag brgyan te rtag tu bzhag /'di ni sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba gsum gyi gnas bsdus pa'o/ /de nas slar yang phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos rdo rje añja na'i 1lhaganas nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje 81—418

las phyung ngo / /lam gyi bzhi mdo'am shing gcig drung / /ma mo'i gnas sam zhi gnas su/ /de ru rdo rje añja na/ /thod par rtag tu dbab par bya mar khu chen po dang / khrag dang bshang ba dang pad+ma'i skud pa dang / arga'i skud pas me mar gyi snying po byas la mar ngo'i 17bcu bzhi'i nam phyed na/ rdo rje añja na mkhas pas dbab par bya'o/ /sngags de nyid lan brgya rtsa brgyad btab na dngos grub rnam pa gsum du 'gyur ro/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das kun du bzang pos gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rinaphyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po la 'di skad ces gsol to / /bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i yi ge du rtogs pa dang ldan na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' sa chen po de dag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i dam tshig gis spyod (4)pa'i rdo rje 'di la dad cing bsgom 5)par 'gyur/de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po phyag na rdo rjes (kyi /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /(com ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gsang ba'i yi ge gsum rtogs pa dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' de dag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byang chub kyi spyod pa'i rdo rje gang yin pa 'di la dad cing bsgom (77par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 98༄gsol pa/ gsum po gang zhig lags/ rdo rje 'dzin pas bka' stsal pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku rdo rje dang /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje ste gsum po 'di dag go/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyis bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje'i zhabs gnyis la phyag 81—419

'tshal nas cang mi gsung bar bzhugs par gyur to/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad la bka' stsal pa/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sngon byung ba na brjod kyis mi lang ba'i yang brjod kyis 1 mi lang ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing (ge rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa'i bskal pa 'das nas/ gang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad kyang 'das nas / thub pa chen po 'od srung mo mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i bar gyis kyang ma gsungs so/ /de rgyu ci'i phyir zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das gsang ba chen po'i gnas kyi don ma bshad pa ni de'i tshe de'i dus na sems can rnams la skal ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gsang ba 'dus pa 'di la skad cig thang cig yud tsam nyid kyis sangs rgyas kyi byang chub rdzogs par byed do/ /gang zhig gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma dpag tu med pa snyed 4kyi bskal par byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis 'bad cing btsal (5kyang byang chub thob par mi 'gyur ba de gsang ba 'dus pa la mngon par dga' ba'i byang chub sems dpas tshe 96)'di nyid la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis gsung rdo rje'i yi ge'i tshig 'di thos nas rab tu ngus sol/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyis byang chub sems dpa' de rnams la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /byang chub sems dpa' khyed rnams ma ngu shig /sdug bsngal gsum ma skyed 7༄cig /de nas de bzhin 81wa 420

gshegs pa de dag thams cad la byang chub sems dpa' de rnams kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ji ltar mi ngu bar bgyi/ ji ltar sdug bsngal gsum mi bskyed (7par bgyi/ de rinargyu ci'i phyir zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das gsang ba gsum gyi yi ge'i skal ba ma mchis te/tha na ming thos pa'i skal ba riyang ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de skad ma zer cig /yi ge ni thun mong ba ste/ rigs kyi bu ji ltar khyed rnams kyis mi shes pa dang ma thos pa de bzhin du / nged de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis kyang rigs kyi bu gang gsang ba gsum gyi yi ge 'di dag yang dag par ma thob cing mngon par rdzogs par sangs ma rgyas so/ /de 4)rgyu ci'i phyir zhe rigan / gsang ba gsum gyi yi ge rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad cang mi smra bar gnas par gyur rto6)/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi snying po rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga rnams la bzhugs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi btsun 7mos bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la dga' bas bstod pa/ sems can khams ni gnas kyi dbang phyug khyod ni rdo rje'i thugs/ /dga' ba yid 'ong don can na 'dod pas bdag la bskyab 9)tu gsol / /mgon pos gal te de ring bdag ni gsan (7par mchis bzhed na/ /sems can yab gnyen mchog chen bdag la dgyes 31par mdzad du gsol/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi btsun mo mā ma khris bcom ldan 81—421

'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje 'chang chen po la rdo rje 'dod pa dga' ba mchod pa'i mchog gi yi (14)ge'i tshig 'dis yang dag par bstod pal/ rdo rje'i sku khyod bka' yi rinasa'akhor lo sems can mang por phan/ /sangs rgyas rnams don byang chub mchog don phan pa rjes ston pa/ /mgon pos gal te de ri skuring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /chags pas 'dod chags dam tshig bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ /de nas 'jig rten dbang phyug gi btsun mo sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i spyan gyis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje 'chang chen po la 'dod pa nye bar longs spyod pa'i dam tshig gis yang dag par bstod pa/ khyod ni rdo rje'i gsung ste ④kun la phan zhing thugs brtse ba/ /'jig rten dag ni dgos pa'i don mdzad pa la rtag tu brtson/ /mgon po 55gal te de (6)ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /rab dga'i spyod pa kun du bzang pos bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs dam tshig rdo rje'i btsun mo'i 7rabacom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje 'chang chen po la bde ba dang yid bde ba'i dga' ba 'dis bstod do/ /khyod ni rdo rje 'dod pa dam tshig mchog gi phan don che/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gdung mchog mnyam nyid rjes su thugs brtse 98)ba/ /mgon pos gal te de yonaring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /yon tan rin chen dam pa'i bogater gyur bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa 'dod pa thams cad nye bar longs spyod pa'i dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi btsun 81—422

mo de dag la dam tshig gi 'khor los 'dod pa spyod cing cang mi gsung bar gyur to / /de nas nam mkha'i dbyings 'di dag thams cad ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i (1dam tshig gi khu bas ༷na/yongs su gang ste/ bum pa rdo rje chus gang ba ltar gnas par gyur to/ /de nas rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings 'di na gang sems can sku gsum yang dag par 'byung ri dab de rnams rdo rje'i dpal gyis yang dag par rig 94)pa de dag thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas (5dardo rje gsum gyi ye shes can du gyur to/ /de nas brtsams te sems can thams cad kun nas tsho6)bzang po/ kun du bzang po zhes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rjes dbang bskur bar gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad chos thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid mthong ngam/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyis phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes mnyam pa nyid dang / rdo rje ye shes kyi spyod pa mthong lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa mthonge lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi btsun mo'i bha ga las mngon par byung nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa phyag na rdo rje chen po (7la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gang gi phyir 'dod chags kyi yi ge'i tshig gis sangs rgyas kyi byang chub rjes su rtogs par bya'o zhes bya ba ni bcom ldan 'das ngo 81—423

mtshar to/ /bde bar gshegs pa ngo mtshar to/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad de skad ma gsungs 1shig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos thams cad ni nam mkha' rdo rje'i dam tshig dang mtshungs pa'i phyir gzugs kyi phung po ma yin/ tshor ba'i phung po ma yin/ 'du shes kyi (kyephung po ma yin/ 'du byed kyi phung po ma yin / rnam par shes pa'i phung po ma yin/ khams ma yin skye mched ma yin/de bzhin du 'dod chags ma yin zhe sdang ma yin gti mug ma yin/ chos ma yin chos ma yin pa yang dzodam yin no/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang /byang chub sems dpa' de rnams la bka' stsal pa/ khyed rnams kyis 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsang ba 'di bsgom 4par gyis shig /de (geci'i phyir zhe na/ phyogs bcu na gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'di rnams la chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i skal ba 56riyod pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos rdo rje chos la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig gi de kho na nyid 'di zung shig /khyod ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 7)chos thams cad kyi dbang phyug rdo rje zhes bya bar dbang bskur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje chos kyis de bzhin du bgyi'o zhes gsol nas cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas de 81—424

bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge gsum la rang gi sku dang gsung dang thugs zhugs par gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad khams gsum pa thams cad kyi lus rdo rje la gnas shing de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku mnyam pa nyid la dmigs nas cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gsung rdo rje khams gsum pa thams cad kyi ngag rdo rje la gnas shing de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung mnyam pa nyid la dmigs nas cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa phyag 17na rdo rje khams gsum pa thams cad kyi sems rdo rje la gnas shing de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs mnyam pa nyid la dmigs nas cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang chen gsang ba 'dus pa las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig dang sdom pa rdo rje'i byin gyi rlabs tshonakyi rgyal po zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bcu bdun pa'o// //de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang chen gsang ba 'dus pa zhes bya ba brtag pa'i rgyal po chen po rdzogs so ri// //5rgya gar gyi mkhan po thad 96sgoṅgā ka ra warma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha geb dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ slad kyis paṇ+ḍi ta bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rje btsun nyi ma'i dbang po'i zhal (8)snga nas chag lots+tsha 99ba dge slong chos rje dpal gyis gus pas zhus shing dag par bcos te gtan la phab pa 781—425

༄ga /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa zhes bya ba rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po/hunye༄༅ga /rgya gar skad du/ shrī gu h+ya sa ma dza ma hā tan+t+ra rā dza nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa zhes bya ba rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang ske/ thugs kyi snying po rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga la bzhugs so/ /brjod kyi mi lang ba'i yang brjod kyi mi lang ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul phra rab snyed kyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la/ 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dam tshig rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sku rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gsung rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thugs rdo rje dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ting nge 'dzin rdo rje dang /81—442

byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyal ba rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chu rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po me rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rlung rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha' rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gzugs rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sgra rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dri rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ro rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po reg bya rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid rdo rje dang / de dag la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brjod kyis mi lang ba'i yang brjod kyis mi lang ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul phra rab snyed rnams dang /de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha'i dbyings dang mnyam pa la/ 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje mi bskyod pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje rin chen dpal dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje 'od dpag tu med pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje gdon mi za ba dang / de dag la sogs pa nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs pa ni / 'di lta ste/ dper na/ til gyi gang bu bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad shin tu gang bar snang bar gyur to// //81—443

de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad chen po/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'dod chags chen po'i tshul zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bkod pa de dag thams cad nyid kyi sku la zhugs par mdzad do/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyis/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi bdag po yongs su mnyes par bya ba'i phyir/ nyid kyi sku bud med kyi gzugs su mngon par sprul nas/bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po'i sku las mngon par byung bar gyur to/ /de la la la ni sangs rgyas spyan lta bu/ la la ni mā ma tī 91)lta bu/ la la ni gos dkar mo lta bu/ la la ni dam tshig sgrol ma lta bu/ la la ni gzugs kyi ngo bo lta bu/ la la ni sgra'i ngo bo lta bu/ la la ni dri'i ngo bo lta bu/ la la ni ro'i ngo bo lta bu/ la la ni reg gi ngo bo lta bu/ der yang dag par gnas par gyur ro(na / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi snying po rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga la dam tshig chen po'i dkyil 'khor rdul med pa gru bzhir ②byin gyis brlabs pa ni / gsal ba de yi ngo bo nyid/ /sna tshogs gzugs kyis kun tu rgyas/ /sangs rgyas sprin gyis kun tu khyab/ /'od zer 'phro ba mang po 'khrug /gsal ba la sogs dkyil 'khor ldan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis gnas/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang ske/ thugs rdo rje'i bdag po de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus su bzhag par gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mi 81—444

bskyod pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen dpal dang / de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag tu med pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa gdon mi za bar grub pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad rnams/ de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub kyi sems rdo rje'i thugs la zhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub kyi sems rdo rje/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad zil gyis gnon pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu/ de nas nam mkha'i dbyings 'di thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i ngo bor gnas par gyur to/ /de nas nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad na gnas pa'i sems can ji snyed pa de dag thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i 517byin gyis brlabs kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bde ba dang / yid bde ba thob par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub kyi sems rdo rje/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje dam tshig 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ rig pa chen po'i skyes bu'i gzugs 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs kyis byin gyis brlabs so/ /byin gyis brlabs ma thag tu/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi sems rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa de nyid zhal gsum pa lta bur / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gzigs par gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod pa la sogs pa/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka (2)nas byung ste/ ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /81—445

e ma'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /byang chub sems ni rab byung ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsang / /rab tu mi rtog gnas med pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yang gcig tu 'dus nas/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub kyi sems rdo rje la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchod pa spros pa de kho na nyid kyi dam tshig rin po che'i sprin gyis yang dag par mchod de/ phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /'dus pa gsang ba las byung ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsang / /rdo rje snying po 'dus pa yi/ /de nyid bcom ldan bshad du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub kyi sems rdo rjes/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad legs so/ /legs so/ /'on kyang 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyang the tshom skye bar byed pa yin na/ byang chub sems dpa' gzhan rnams lta ci smos/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur/ rmad du gyur te/ the tshom thams cad gcod par mdzad pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gang bcom ldan 'das 'di lta bu'i yon tan khyad par can du gyur pa yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor du/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi gsang ba ston par mi spro ba ste/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la byin gyis brlab pa mdzad de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje dam tshig 'byung ba'i tshig gis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 0)bde ba myong ba bgyi 81—446

ba nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes dang / mngon par shes pa'i 'bras bu thob par bgyi ba'i bar gyi phyir yang dag par bstan du gsol/de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang ske/ thugs rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsol ba btab pa de mkhyen nas/ ye shes lho)sgron ma rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ zhe sdang gi rigs kyi sngags mchog gi tsho2)snying po 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /badz+ra sgrikardob /de nas 'di phyung ma thag tu/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi rig pa'i skyes bu de nyid mi bskyod pa'i phyag rgya chen por sbyor ba'i thabs kyi nag po dkar po dmar po'i tshul du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje la zhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ gti mug gi rigs kyi mchog gi snying po'i snying po 'di nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo ④/ /dzi na dzika /de nas 'di phyung ma thag tu/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi rig pa'i skyes bu rnam par snang mdzad kyi phyag rgya chen por sbyor ba'i thabs kyis dkar po nag po dmar po'i tshul du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang /gsung dang / thugs rdo rje'i spyan sngar bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rin po che 'byung ba'i rdo rje dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rigs kyi mchog 81—447

gi snying po'i snying po 'di nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo ske/ /rat+na :ka /de nas 'di phyung ma thag tu/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi rig pa'i skyes bu rin chen dpal gyi phyag rgya chen por sbyor bas nam mkha'i gnas kyis ser po nag po dkar po'i tshul du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang /gsung dang / thugs rdo rje'i lho phyogs su bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'dod chags chen po'i rgyun 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ 'dod chags kyi rigs kyi mchog gi snying po'i snying po 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /a ro lika /de nas 'di phyung 1)ma thag tu/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi rig pa'i skyes bu de nyid/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi rig pa'i bdag po'i phyag rgya chen por sbyor ba'i thabs kyis dmar po nag po dkar po'i tshul du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje'i rgyab tu bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi grub pa gdon mi za ba'i mchog /dam tshig 'byung ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ dam tshig 'gugs pa'i rigs kyi mchog gi snying po'i snying po 'di nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las byung ngo / /pra dz+nyā jika /de nas 'di phyung ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi rig pa'i skyes bu grub pa gdon mi za ba'i phyag rgya chen por sbyor ba'i thabs kyis ljang gu dusadang / nag 81—448

po dang / dkar po'i tshul du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang /gsung dang / thugs rdo rje'i byang phyogs su bzhugs so/ /zhe sdang gti mug 'dod chags dang / /yid bzhin nor bu dam tshig ste/ /rigs lngar gtogs pa 'di rnams kyis/ /'dod dang thar pa rab sgrub pa'o/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje 'dzin/ rjes su mnyes par byed pa'i dam tshig ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ rdo rje 'dzin thams cad kyi btsun mo'i mchog 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang /thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo 517/ /de ṣa ra ti/ de nas 'di phyung ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi rig pa'i skyes bu de nyid/ bud med kyi gzugs 'dzin par gyur te/ shar phyogs kyi grwar bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rjes su mnyes par byed pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi btsun mo'i mchog 'di/nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /mo ha ra ti/ de nas 'di phyung du ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi rig pa'i skyes bu de nyid/ bud med kyi gzugs 'dzin par gyur te/ lho phyogs kyi grwar bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'dod chags 'dzin pa/ rjes su chags pa byed pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'dod chags 'dzin pa'i btsun mo'i mchog 'di/nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /rā ga ra ti/ de 81—449

nas 'di phyung ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang ske/ gsung dang / thugs kyi rig pa'i skyes bu de nyid/ bud med kyi gzugs 'dzin par gyur te/ nub phyogs kyi grwar bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs slu ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi shes rab 'chad pa'i btsun mo'i mchog 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /badz+ra ra ti/ de nas 'di phyung ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang /gsung dang / thugs kyi rig pa'i skyes bu de nyid/ bud med kyi gzugs 'dzin par gyur te/ byang phyogs kyi grwar bzhugs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi btsun mo'i mchog dam tshig phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad rdo rje 'khor lo zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor byin gyis rlob pa zhes bya ba'i khro bo chen po 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang /thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /ya mān+ta kṛta0) de nas 'di phyung ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi rig pa'i skyes bu de nyid/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bsnyengs par byed pa'i tshul du shar phyogs kyi sgor bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mngon par byang chub pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor byin gyis rlob pa'i khro bo chen po 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang /81—450

thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /pradz+nyān+ta krita/ de nas 'di phyung ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi rig pa'i skyes bu de nyid/ rdo rje'i dam tshig bsnyengs pa'i tshul du lho phyogs kyi sgor bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos rin po che 'byung gnas rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'dod chags 'chad pa'i dkyil 'khor byin gyis rlob pa zhes bya ba'i khro bo chen po 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang /gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /pad mā n+ta kṛtañja/ de nas 'di phyung ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang /gsung dang / thugs kyi rig pa'i skyes bu de nyid de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung gi tshul du nub phyogs kyi sgor bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi dkyil 'khor byin gyis rlob pa zhes bya ba'i khro bo chen po 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / / bisgyun+ta kṛtan / de nas 'di phyung ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi rig pa'i skyes bu de nyid/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang /gsung dang / thugs kyi tshul du byang phyogs kyi sgor bzhugs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs mnyes par byed pa dang ske/ dkyil 'khor gyi dam tshig sems dpa' rnams so/ /de bzhin gshegs 81—451

pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi gsang ba 'dus pa las/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor byin gyis rlob pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste dang po'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang /gsung dang / thugs kyi bdag po la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mchod pa byas te/ phyag btsal 51)nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi mchog /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsang / /bla na med pa'i byang chub sems/ /bcom ldan snying po bshad du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang ske/ thugs rdo rje'i bdag pos/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsol ba btab pa mkhyen cing / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sems kyi yongs su rtog pa yang thugs kyis mkhyen nas/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /khyed kyis sems lus lta bu dang / lus sems lta bu dang / sems tshig tu brjod pa lta bur bskyed cig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag gis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs nam mkha' lta bur sbyar nas/ ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o kun tu bzang po yi/ /sku dang gsung thugs rdo rje can/ /skye ba med pa'i tshul gyis su/ /skye ba 'di ni rab tu bsgrags / /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang —/ gsung dang / thugs rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa/ de bzhin gshegs 81—452

pa thams cad kyi mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i tshul rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dngos po med pas sgom pa med/ /bsgom par bya ba sgom pa min/ /de ltar dngos po dngos med pas/ /sgom pa dmigs su med pa'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mngon par rtog ①pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dngos po thams cad dang bral ba/ /phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa/ /chos bdag med pa mnyam nyid pas/ /rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa/ /stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyis gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje mi bskyod pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mi zad pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dngos po 'di rnams ma skyes pa/ /chos dang chos nyid med pa ste/ /nam mkha' lta bur bdag med pa/ /byang chub tshul 'di brtan pa 'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod pas gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen dpal de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams thams cad dngos med cing / /81—453

chos kyi mtshan nyid rnam par spangs/ /bdag med chos las kun tu byung / /byang chub tshul 'di brtan pa 'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen dpal gyis gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag tu med pa 'od zer 'bar ba rdo rje sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /ma skyes pa yi chos rnams la/ /ngo bo med de sgom pa'ang med/ /nam mkha'i tshul du sbyor ba yis / /dngos po dag tu rab tu bsgrags/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag tu med pas gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa grub pa gdon mi za ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad zil gyis gnon pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /gdod nas dag pa nam mkha' bzhin/ /byang chub med cing mngon rtogs med/ /byang chub tshul 'di brtan pa'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa grub pa gdon mi za bas gsungs so/ /de nas byams pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba'i chos kyi de kho na nyid kyi yi ge thos nas ngo mtshar du gyur/ rmad du gyur te/ ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas e ma'o chos/ /chos bshad pa ni ngo mtshar che/ /yang dag don ni dag pa'i don/ /byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag med pa yi chos las byung / /sangs rgyas byang chub rdzogs mdzad pa/ /rnam par mi rtogs dmigs su med/ /byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun tu bzang po 81—454

thams cad don/ /byang chub sems ni rab bskor ba/ /byang chub spyod pa rdo rje che / /byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs / /sku dang gsung thugs rdo rje 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab ston pa / /byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa las byang chub sems kyi le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang /gsung dang / thugs rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'phro ba'i sprin bkod pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ rdo rje bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ad+ma (1)ko3 haṃ/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor sgom pa ni/ /'od zer sprin gyi bkod pa che/ /sangs rgyas 'bar ba'i 'od dang mnyam/ /'od zer sna lngas kun tu khyabal/ /kun nas yongs su zlum po ste/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis khyab/ /mchod pa rnam pa lngas brgyan (2pa/ /mdor na de ltar bsgoms nas su/ /gzugs ni dbus su bsgom par bya/ /rnam par snang mdzad phyag rgya che/ /sku gsung thugs kyi ②mtshan pa'o/ /sku gsung thugs ni rdo rje yi/ /phyag rgya chen po bsgom par bya/ /tshogs gnyis dang ni ldan pa yis/ /bsdus dang gcig tu sbyor ba yis/ /mi bskyod pa yi rgya mchog dang / /dkon mchog dpal gyi rgya chen dang ske/ /tshe dpag med pa'i 'od byed dang / /thogs med grub pa'i rgya chen 81—455

rnamasal/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can / /in+d+ra nī la'i kha dog 'dra/ /rab 'bar phyag na rdo rje bsnams/ /rnam par gtsigs la 'jigs 'jigs lta/ /shel dang zla ba'i 'od 'dra ba/ /thor tshugs cod pan gyis brgyan (nya)pa/ /rab 'bar phyag na 'khor lo bsnams/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes par brgyan/ /'dzam bu chu bo'i gser 'od 'dra/ /sangs rgyas sprin gyis kun tu 'khrigs/ /de yi phyag na rdo rje che/ /rtse mo dgu pa rnam par sgom/ /marga ta yi 'od 'dra ba/ /rdo rje 'bar bas rnam par brgyan(ge/ /kun tu 'bar ba'i sprin gyis khyab/ /phyag na rin chen bsnams par sgom/ /pad+ma rā ga'i mdog 'dra ba/ /gtso bo 'dod chags 'bar ba mnga' rab 'bar phyag na pad+ma bsnams/ /'dod chags rdo rje can bsgom bya/ /'od zer sna lnga'i 'od 'dra'i sku/ /gdon mi za ba rdo rje can/ /zhi ba phyag na ral gri bsnams / /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ sku dang / gsung dang / thugs byin gyis rlob pa'i sngags 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ dharma dha tu swa bhā wa ge)ad+ma ko3 ④lha/ rin chen chen po kha dog lnga/ /yungs kur gyi ni 'bru tshad tsam/ /sna yi rtse mor nan tan du/ /rnal 'byor gyis ni rtag tu sgom/ /rin chen brtan par gyur nas spro//brtan par ma gyur yong mi spro/ /sangs rgyas 'bar ba 'dra ba'i 'od/ /mchog rab sprin rnams spro bar bya/ /'khor lo rdo rje rin chen dang / /pad+ma ral gri mtshon chen 'dzin/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sprin chen rnams/ /spro ba'i bdag 81—456

nyid can gyis spro/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor dbugs 3)gnas par/ /'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dra bar ni/ /pad+ma sgom pas bsgom par bya/ /rin chen dkyil 'khor 'dra bar ni/ /rin chen brtson pas bsgom par bya/ /sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor las byung ba/ /nam mkha' 'dra bar bri bar bya/ /'di dag sangs rgyas rab kyis chos(2// /sku gsung thugs ni bsgoms pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor rdo rje las byung ba/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i tshul 'thob pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang —/ thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa las/ rdo rje bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yang 'dus nas/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang /thugs kyi bdag po la/ bstod pa'i rgyal po 'dis gsol ba btab bo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis gnas/ /chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /mtshan min thams cad yang dag spangs/ /kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /zhi ba'i chos ni mchog las byung / /ye shes spyod pa rnam spyod pa/ /kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /sems can kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag cing dri ma med/ /kun bzang thugs 81—457

mchog kha lo sgyur/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /de nas ston pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /'jig rten gsum pa khams gsum pa/ /'jig rten gsum mchog rdo rje gtso/ /'jig rten gsum mchog ston pa po/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis 1)gnas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi thugs/ /dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor rab 'dra ba/ /dkyil 'khor rab tu nyams dga' bshad/ /de nas thugs kyi dkyil 'khor mchog /thugs kyi rdo rje rab 'dra ba/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs rnams kyi/ /dkyil 'khor rab tu bshad par bya/ /lus ngag sems ni bsgoms pa yis/ /shes rab can gyis thig gdab pa/ /thig skud sar pa legs bkal pa/ /tshad ma rab tu mdzes pa yis/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa ste/ /khru ni bcu gnyis tshad du bya/ /ngos bzhi dang ni grwa bzhir ldan/ /sgo bzhi par ni rab tu brtag /de yi dbus su 'khor lo ni/ /rab tu skum po bri bar bya/ /de nas las kyi cho ga ni/ /mthong bas phyag rgya dgod par bya/ /de'i dbus rdo rje bri ba ni/ /in+d+ra nī la'i kha dog 'dra/ /'bar ba chen po rtse lnga pa / /'jigs pa dag kyang rab 'jigs byed/ /'khor lo chen po shar phyogs su / /rdo rje 'bar bas rnam par brgyan/ /rin chen chen po lho phyogs su/ /'od zer mang pos rab tu 'khrigs/ /pad+ma chen po nub phyogs su/ /pad+ma rā ga'i kha dog 'dra/ /ral gri chen po byang phyogs su/ /'od zer mang pos rab tu 'khrigs / /dbus na sprin dang 'dra ba'i 'od/ /spyan ni shar gyi grwa ru bri/ / ma mā kā tsho yi rigs 'byung ba'i/ /rdo rje de bzhin lho phyogs su/ /pad+ma kha bye sdong bur bcas/ /nub phyogs su ni bri bar bya/ /ut+pal mdzes pa byang phyogs sum/ /mthing kha sprin dang 'dra bar bri/ /tho ba 'bar ba 'od gsal ba/ /shar 81—458

phyogs sgor ni bri bar bya/ /rdo rje 'bar sogs 'od bzang ba/ /be con lho yi phyogs su bri/ /pad+ma 'bar ba 'od byed pa/ /nub kyi phyogs su bri bar bya/ /rdo rje 'khyil ba rdo rje can/ /byang gi phyogs su rdo rje bri/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa de/ /yongs su gsal bar shes byas nas/ /lus dang ngag sems mchod pa yis/ /nan tan du ni mchod par bya/ /bud med rab tu mdangs bzang ba/ /lo grangs bcu drug lon pa ni/ /dri dang me tog phreng brgyan hu)te/ /yon tan ska rags mā ma bīr(ge/ /shes rab can gyis byin brlabs ③la/ /de yi dbus su mnyes par bya/ /sangs rgyas zhi ba'i gnas spros pas/ /nam mkha'i dbyings ni rab tu brgyanali/ /bshang (snyegaci khu ba khrag la sogs/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de ltar byas nas sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sems dpa' grags chen mnyes/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang /gsung dang / thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ /kun gyi sku dang gsung thugs kyi/ /rdo rje 'chang ba'i rgyal po ni/ /gnas kyi dbang phyug kun mchog gis/ /spyod pa kun mchog chos kyi don/ /spyod pa'i mtshan nyid bka' stsal to/ /rnam par mi rtog don las byung / /'dod chags zhe snang gti mug rigs/ /theg pa mchog ni bla med pa'i/ /dngos grub rab mchog sgrub par byed/ /rigs ngan rtsig ma mkhan la sogs/ /gsod don don gnyer sems pa rnams/ /theg chen bla na med pa yi / /theg mchog 'di la 'grub par 'gyur/ /sems can mtshams med la 81wa 459

sogs pa'i/ /sdig pa chen po byed pa yang / /rdo rje theg pa rgya mtsho che/ /theg pa mchog ni 'di la 'grub/ /snying nas slob dpon smod pa dag /bsgrubs kyang 'grub par yong mi 'gyur/ /srog gcod pa yi sems can gang / /brdzun du smra la dga' ba dang / /gzhan gyi nor la chags pa dang / /rtag tu 'dod pa spyod gang dang / /bshang 1)gci zas su za ba ste/ /de dag sgrub pa'i snod du 'gyur/ /ma dang sring mo bu mo la/ /'dod pa bas ni mnyes byas na/ /theg chen mchog gi chos nyid kyi/ /dngos grub rgya che des 'thob bo/ /sangs rgyas gtso bo'i yum dag la/ /rnam par mi rtog blo can gyis/ /mnyes par byas kyang mi gos te/ /de ni sangs rgyas 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nas sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams ngo mtshar du gyur / rmad du gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po ci'i slad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor gyi nang du 'di lta bu'i tshig ngan pa gsung zhes gsol to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi tshig gsan stinas/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu rnams thong /de skad ma zer cig /snying po ye shes can rnams kyi/ /sangs rgyas chos nyid dag pa 'di/ /snying po chos kyi don las byung / /byang chub spyod pa'i gnas 'di yin / /de nas yang brjod kyis mi lang ba'i yang brjod kyis mi lang ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing / ri rab la sogs pa'i rdul phra mo snyed kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'jigs skrag nas brgyal dbar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de 81—460

bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byang chub sems dpa' de dag brgyal bar gyur pa gzigs nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang /gsung dang / thugs kyi bdag po la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di dag bslang bar gsol / de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang /gsung dang / thugs rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje'i bdag po'i 'od kyis reg pa tsam gyis/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag rang rang gi stan la gnas par gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur/ rmad du gyur/ dgyes pas khyab par gyur nas chos kyi dbyings 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /e ma'o chos e ma'o chos/ /e ma'o chos kyi don 'byung ba/ /chos don dag pa bdag med pa/ /rdo rje rgyal po phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sku dang gsung thugs rab tu dag /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam nyid gnas/ /rnam par mi 'gyur snang ba med/ /rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /thugs ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtso/ /dus gsum dag gi lam du byung / /nam mkha' chen po dbyings gyur pa/ /nam mkha'i lam la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /nam mkha'i sku las yang dag byung / /nam mkha'i lam la gnas pa po/ /nam mkha'i thugs te chos kyi mchog /spyod pa'i gnas la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thoms cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang ske/ thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa las/ kun tu spyod pa mchog gi 81—461

le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje mi bskyod pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ thugs byin gyis rlob pa'i sngags 'di gsungs sol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa ko3 haṃ/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad rdul dang bral ba'i gnas rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ sku byin gyis rlob pa'i sngags 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā pa ād+ma ko3 haṃ/de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag tu med pa/ mnyam pa nyid mi gnyis pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/gsung byin gyis rlob pa'i sngags 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bā ka badz+ra swa bhā wa ād+ma ko3 haṃ/ rdo rje gsum po de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang / /gnas ni gnas kyi rnam par bsgom par bya/ /sngags kyi mtshan gyis shin tu mtshan byas la/ /mchog rab 'di yis bsgrub pa nyid du bya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dkon mchog dpal/ ye shes sgron ma rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ sngags 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa ād+ma 0)ko3 haṃ/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa grub pa rdo rje gdon mi za ba/ rdo rje gdon mi za ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ sngags 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dzā (gebadz+ra swa bhā wa ād+ma (bko3 haṃ/ rtag tu 'dod pa'i yon 81—462

tan lngas/ /sangs rgyas tshul bzhin mchod par bya/ /mchod pa rnam pa lnga rnams kyis/ /myur du sangs rgyas nyid thob 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi bdag po rdo rje 'chang bas gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi bdag po rdo rje 'dzin gyis/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sngags kyi gsang ba 'di gsungs so/ /sngags la dmigs pa'i lus dang ni/ /ngag dang yid kyis bskul nas su/ /yid ni dga' zhing mgu ba yis/ /dngos grub rab mchog bsgrub par bya/ /sems la dmigs pa bdag med pa/ /ngag dang lus kyang rnam par bsgom/ /nam mkha' bzhin du mnyam pa'i gnas/ /sbyor ba rnam gsum bsgrub par bya/ /lus dang ngag dang sems dmigs na/ /ngo bo nyid ni dmigs su med/ /sngags kyi lus su sbyor ba la/ /byang chub med cing bsgom 91)pa'ang med/ /sku gsung thugs kyi mtshan nyid ni/ /'di ni mdor na rnam dpyad nas/ /sngags kyis brtags pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /byang chub sbyor ba bsgom par bya/ /de nas dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin / /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis mchod/ /sangs rgyas kun mchog kun mkhyen gyis/ /sgom pa'i mchog ni bka' stsal to/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms nas/ /phra mo'i sbyor ba kun tu brtsam/ /sna yi rtse mor yungs kur bsam/ /'gro dang mi 'gro yungs kur la/ /ye shes gnas ni nyams dga' ba/ /gsang ba'i ye shes kyis brtag sgom/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /sangs rgyas sku 81—463

yi gnas bsgoms te/ /de yi steng du gnas bzhag go/ /hūṃ/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /spyan gyi tshul du sbyor ba la/ /rdo rje pad+ma rnam par bsgom/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /rin chen dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /mchog gi sbyor ba nan tan gyis/ /de yi steng du yongs su bsgom/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /sangs rgyas tshul ni zhi ba spro/ /'khor yang khyad par dag tu spro/ /ut+pal mthil ku'i tsho1)mdog 'dra bal/ /rtse mo lnga pa khyad par du/ /nas kyi 'bru tsam nan tan gyis/ /sna yi rtse mor rnam par bsam/ /tsa na ka yi 'bru tsam la/ /'dab ma brgyad pa ge sar bcas / /sna yi rtse mor 'di shes te/ /bsgoms pas byang chub gzhol bar 'gyur / /'khor lo la sogs khyad par du/ /bsgom pa der ni brtag par bya/ /dngos grub thams cad yon tan gnas/ /nyams dga' byang chub gnas 'grub 'gyur / /sangs rgyas byang chub gnas rnams ni/ /de ru mdor na spro bar bya/ /sku gsung thugs kyis mtshan pa yi/ /chos kyi tshig rnams rab tu brjod/ /de nas dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /de nyid don kun ston pa pos/ /spyod pa kun mchog legs dag pa/ /gsang ba'i dam pa bka' stsal to/ /gzugs dang sgra dang ror ldan pa/ /shes rab can gyis zla drug sgom/ /gsang ba'i de nyid mchod chen gyis/ /legs par mchod nas bsgom par bya/ /dngos grub 'bras bu 'dod pa yis/ /zas su bshang gci zos na ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub skyon med pa/ /yang dag bla med grub par 'gyur/ /zas su sha rnams za ba dang / /sha chen dag ni rab brtags na/ /sku dang gsung thugs gsang ba yi/ /dngos 81—464

grub thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /glang po'i sha dang rta yi sha /de bzhin dam pa khyi yi sha /zas kyi phyir ni bza' bar bya/ /zas gzhan dag ni ma zos na / /byang chub sems dpa' blo can dang / /sangs rgyas rnams ni mnyes par 'gyur / /'di lta bu yi sbyor ba yis/ /myur du sangs rgyas nyid thob 'gyur/ /'dod khams dbang phyug 'jig rten na/ /go 'phang las ni byed par 'gyur/ /gtso bo gzi can stobs dang ldan/ /mdangs bzang mthong na yid du 'ong / /mthong ba tsam gyis bskul med par/ /'jig rten 'di dag dbang du 'gyur/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba byang chub dam pa ste/ /yang dag sngags kyi gsang ba 'di/ /lus ngag sems las 'da' ba'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa las/ sku dang / gsung dang / thugs byin gyis rlob pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang /gsung dang / thugs kyi bdag pos/ dam tshig chen po'i de kho na nyid sngags kyi spyod pa'i mchog mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i le'u 'di gsungs so/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /ji ltar 'dod par bsten na ni/ /'di lta bu yi sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas myur du thob par 'gyur/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad ni/ /ji ltar 'dod par bsten bya ste/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bya/ /dka' thub sdom pa mi bzad pas/ /bsten kyang 'grub par mi 'gyur gyi/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod 81—465

thams cad la/ /bsten na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /slong zhi mo za zhing mi bzla ste/ /slong namo'ang dga' bar mi bya'o/ /'dod pa kun la longs spyod cing ske/ /sngags kyi yan lag ma nyams bzlas/ /lus dang ngag dang sems rnams ni/ /bde bar gnas na byang chub 'thob/ /gzhan du dus min 'chi ba dang glu/ /dmyal bar nges par sreg par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /sngags kyi spyod pa mchog spyod rnams/ /chos mchog mi g.yo brnyes pa yang / /'dod pa thams cad bsten pas so/ /chags can ye shes 'dod pa yis/ /rtag tu 'dod yon lnga rnams bsten/ /byang chub sems dpa' mnyes par bya/ /byang chub nyi ma chags par bya/ /gzugs la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /mchod par byed pas mchod par bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad gzhi ci/ /sgra la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung gnas gtso/ /dri la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /sangs rgyas sogs la dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /'dod chags chos kyi 'byung gnas gtso/ /ro la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid sangs rgyas sna tshogs pa/ /sangs rgyas thogs med rdo rje 'dzin/ /reg la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /bdag gi rigs la dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /mi bskyod pa yi tshul brnyes pa'o/ /gzugs sgra dri ri4skul sogs pa la/ /rtag tu sems ni sbyar bar bya/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba'i snying po btus pa'o/ /gzugs sgra dri sogs sngags pa yis/ /lha nyid du ni rtag tu bsgom/ /yang na de la sgom 87wa 466

pa ni/ /rigs kyi tshul du rnam par bsgom/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran par sbyor//chos ni rjes su dran sgom pa/ /rdo rje rjes su dran sgom pa/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs rnams sgom/ /rigs ni rjes su dran par sbyor/ /khro bo rjes su dran sgom pa / /lha ni rjes su dran par sbyor/ /bsgoms na byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /bud med gzugs ldan mdangs bzang ba/ /lo grangs bcu drug lon pa la/ /byin gyis brlabs kyi gnas gsum gyis/ /dben par mchod pa rab tu brtsam/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i btsun mo'i mchog /spyan la sogs par bsgom par bya/ /dbang po gnyis ni mnyam sbyar bas/ /sangs rgyas dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /yi ge hūṃ dang oṃ dag dang / /āḥdang phaṭa kyang rab brtag bya/ /'od zer rnam lngas khyab pa yi/ /pad+mo rdo rje bsgom par bya/ /'bar bcas zla 'od bzhin du dkar / /yid du 'ong ba bsgom par bya/ /sangs rgyas rjes dran sbyor la sogs/ /byang chub 'dod pas bsgom par bya/ /de la sangs rgyas rjes su dran1/ /dran pa ji ltar sgom zhe na/ /bha ga la ni liṅga bzhag /sangs rgyas gzugs ni bsgom par bya/ /ba spu rnams kyi bu ga nas/ /mkhas pas sangs rgyas sprin rnams spro/ /de la chos rjes su dran pa ji ltar sgom zhe na/ bha ga la ni liṅga bzhag /rdo rje chos ni bsgom par bya/ /ba spu rnams kyi bu ga nas/ /mkhas pas chos kyi sprin rnams spro/ /de la rdo rje rjes su dran pa ji ltar sgom zhe na/ bha ga la ni liṅga bzhag /rdo rje sems dpa' rnam par bsgom/ /ba spu rnams kyi bu ga nas/ /rdo rje sprin rnams spro bar bya/ /de la rigs rjes su dran pa ji ltar sgom zhe na/bha ga la ni liṅga bzhag /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab tu bsgom/ /ba spu rnams kyi bu ga nas/ /mkhas pas rigs kyi sprin rnams spro/ /de la khro bo rjes su dran 81—467

pa ji ltar sgom zhe na/ bha ga la ni liṅga bzhag /khro bo'i dbang po rab tu bsgom / /ba spu rnams kyi bu ga nas/ /mkhas pas khro bo'i sprin rnams spro/ /de la dam tshig rjes su dran pa ji ltar sgom zhe na/ bdag gi rdo rje pad+mar ldan/ /dbang po gnyis ni mnyam sbyar te/ /rang gi khu ba'i thigs pa yis sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' mchod/ /de la dkyil 'khor rjes su dran pa ji ltar sgom zhe na/ dbang po gnyis ni mnyam gzhag ste/ /mkhas pas rang gi khu ba dag /rnal 'byor pas ni rtag tu dbyung / /dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor tshul du bya/ /de la sku rjes su dran pa ji ltar sgom zhe na/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gang yin/ /phung po lnga yis rab tu rgyas/ /sangs rgyas sku yi rang bzhin gyis/ /bdag kyang de dang 'drar gyur cig /de la gsung rjes su dran pa ji ltar sgom zhe na/ rdo rje chos kyi gsung gang yin/ /gsung de nges tshig phun sum tshogs/ /bdag gi tshig kyang de 'dra ste/ /chos 'dzin pa dang 'drar gyur cig /de la thugs rjes su dran pa ji ltar sgom zhe na/ gsang ba'i bdag po blo ldan pa/ /kun tu bzang po'i thugs gang yin/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa lta bur ni/ /bdag gi sems kyang de 'drar gyur/ /de la sems can rjes su dran pa ji ltar sgom zhe na/ sems can kun gyi sems gang yin/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi mtshan/ /de ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /mkha' dang mtshungs par spyod gyur cig /de la sngags thams cad kyi gzugs dang / sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rjes su dran pa ji ltar sgom zhe na/ sngags kyi rdo rje sku gang yin/ /gsung gi sku yang rnam sgom pa / /bdag kyang rtag tu de 'dra bar/ /sngags 'dzin pa dang mnyam gyur cig /de la dam tshig rjes su dran pa ji ltar sgom zhe na/ dam tshig khu phyung cho ga bzhin//81—468

'bras bu 'dod pas btung bar bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs bsad na/ /dngos grub rab tu 'thob par 'gyur/ /de la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dam tshig rjes su dran pa ji ltar sgom zhe na/ rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal ba/ /thams cad ma skyes zag pa med/ /byang chub med cing mngon rtogs med/ /khams kyang med cing 'byung ba'ang med/ /de la ma skyes pa rjes su dran pa ji ltar sgom zhe na/ thams cad rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /mtshan med mi 'gyur nam mkha' bzhin/ /gnyis med gnyis su med min bzhin/ /shin tu dri med nam mkha' bzhin/ /de la zhe snang gi rigs la sogs pa'i mchod pa rjes su dran pa ji ltar sgom zhe na/ bud med sems ni rab brtan pa/ /lo grangs bcu gnyis lon rnyed pa/ /rigs kyi sbyor bas rab bsgoms te/ /bdag gi khu bas mchod par bya/ /'dis ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i thugs dang ni / /chos 'dzin mchog gi gsung dag kyang / /tshe 'di nyid la thob par 'gyur / /sku dang gsung dang thugs kyang 'grub/ /gang gzhan phra mor bshad pa rnams / /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms te/ /bzlas pa tsam gyis de 'grub 'gyur / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa las/ sngags kyi spyod pa mchog gi le'u ste bdun pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje dkon mchog dpal gyis / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po dbang phyug dam pa rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la/ bstod pa'i rgyal po 'dis gsol ba 81—469

btab bo/ /rdo rje sems dpa' theg pa che/ /nam mkha'i spyod pa rnam sbyong ba/ /kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa mchog /rgyal mchog mchod pa bshad du gsol/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug che/ /rdo rje theg pa rab ston pa/ /nam mkha'i dbyings dang mtshungs pa'i mchog /rgyal bzhi mchod pa bshad du gsol/ /thar pa'i lam ni rab ston pa/ /theg pa gsum gyi lam la gnas/ /sangs rgyas skal mchog dag pa'i bdag /mi mchog mchod pa bshad du gsol/ /byang chub sems ni rgyas pa'i spyan/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor ba/ /sku dang gsung thugs shin tu dag /phyag 'tshal rdo rje theg pa la'o/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin / /thams cad nam mkha' mi 'gyur che/ /thams cad dbang bskur kun gyi don/ /kun dbang rdo rje rin chen 'dzin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod pa'i mchog /rdo rje mi phyed gsum gnas pa/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs skal mchog /rgyal ba 'byung bar 'gyur ba bshad/ /na chung gzhon nu mig yangs pal/ /gzugs bzang gzhon pas brgyan 17pa ni/ /lo grangs nyi shu lnga lon rnyed/ /byol song las kyang rab tu brtag /sa phyogs gtsang zhing rnam par dben pa 'am / /rgyal nyid skyes zhi zhi ba'i gnas rnams su/ /bshang gci chu la sogs pas byug pa 'am/ /rgyal ba mchod phyir rtag par rab tu bya/ /nu ma'i dbus bar spyi gtsug mtha' yi bar/ /cho ga shes pas yang na rkang pa'i bar/ /lte ba rked pa gsang bar rgyal ba'i sras/ /rigs lnga rnams ni dgod par rab tu bya/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /ye shes rgya mtsho bsgom par bya/ /bdag nyid zla ba'i dbus gnas par/ /mkhas pas snying gar (2)bsgom par bya/ /zhi ba rdo rje 'dzin 'dod na/ /bsdu ba dag kyang rab tu bya/ /rin chen sna 81—470

bzhi'i mchod rten la/ /'od zer phreng bas rnam par brgyan1/ /ye shes rgya mtsho dus gsum gyi/ /gnas de yin par rnam par bsam/ /bdag gi ba spu'i bu ga nas / /mkhas pas mchod pa'i sprin rnams spro/ /mkhas pas ut+pa la dag dang / /pad+ma rnam pa lngar shes bya/ /dzā ti rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /me tog kurnyi kā ra dang / /ma lbi kā dang yu tsho rathi kā/ /me tog ka ra bī ra bsam/ /mchod pa thams cad rab tu brtag /dpag tshad brgya yi khyod getsam du/ /'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor bsgom byas la/ /rnam par mkhas pas rtag par ni/ /rigs rnams rab tu dgod par bya/ /de bzhin pad+ma 94nirdo rje dang / /ral gri ut+pal mkhas pas bsgom/ /dpag tshad bye ba'i khyon tsam du//gru bzhi shin tu mdzes pa yi/ /mchod rten rin chen sna bzhi pa/ /gsal zhing rang bzhin dri ma med/ /rigs rnams thams cad mchod pa'i phyir/ /shes rab can gyis gnas su bsgom/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams kyis/ /de la mchod pa rgya mtsho brtsam/ /rin chen na bza' la sogs pas/ /byang chub 'dod pas rtag tu mchod/ /mchod pa rnam lnga mchog rnams kyis/ /rtag tu lha rnams mnyes par bya/ /rin chen 'byung gnas na chung mchog /rin chen sna tshogs mchog gis brgyan/ /sgrub tshe rab tu 'grub pa'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas kun la dbul bar bya/ /zhing 'di rin chen sna bdun gyis/ /mkhas pa dag gis yongs bkang la/ /dngos grub 'dod pas sbyin pa'i phyir/ /nyin re shes rab can gyis dbul/ /bdag po'i phyag rgyas mnyam gzhag la/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor dbus dag tu/ /'dod chags blo can sangs rgyas la/ /reg pa'i sbyor ba dbul bar bya/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /dkyil 'khor 81—471

bkod pa bsgom par bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdag gi lus/ /bla ma bshang dang gci bas mchod/ /bzhin bzang shin tu mdzes pa yi/ /na chung skal ba mchog ldan pa/ /byin gyis brlabs kyi gnas bsams te/ /sangs rgyas mchod pa rab tu brtag /mig bzang brtan pa'i blo ldan pas/ /khu ba blangs nas bza' bar bya/ /'di ni sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi mchod pa ste/ /ye shes rdo rje can gyi gsang / /sngags rnams dngos grub byed par gsungs/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang /thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa las/ bshang 6)gci'i dam tshig gi le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /thams cad nam mkha' mi 'gyur che/ /thams cad dbang bskur spyod pa'i mchog /dbang phyug dam pa kun don gyis/ /sku gsung thugs la longs spyod pa/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum dkyil 'khor/ /sangs rgyas ye shes can gyi gsang / /nyams dga' mchog ni rab tu bshad/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje mi bskyod rab bsgoms nas/ /lag tu rdo rje bsgom par bya/ /'od 'phro mang po 'bar ba dang / /'od zer sna lngas rab tu gang / /dus gsum pa yi sangs rgyas rnams/ /bsgoms nas rdo rjes phye mar brlag /sku gsung thugs kyi longs spyod ni/ /rdo rjes phyer brlags ( med gyur pa/ /bsam gtan mchog de bsgoms na ni/ /thugs kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /rdo rje gsang ba 'di lta bus/ /sems can thams cad bsad na ni/ /mi bskyod 81—472

sangs rgyas zhing dag tu/ /rgyal ba'i sras su skye bar 'gyur/ /'di ni zhe sdang gi rigs kyi dam tshig gi de kho na ste/ rigs thams cad kyi rgya mtsho yin par shes par bya'o/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /mi shes thar pa rab sgrub pa/ /ngo bo nyid dag gos pa med/ /byang chub spyod pa rab ston pas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sgrub pa ni/ /yang dag dam tshig bka' stsal to/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /rnam par snang mdzad rab bsgoms te/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rnam par bsgom/ /rin chen kun gyi sbyor ba 6)yis/ /rdo rje'i gzugs ni rab tu brtag /nor rnams thams cad phrogs nas su/ /rdo rje gsum du rnam bsgoms na/ /nor gyi rgya mtshos gang ba yi/ /yid bzhin nor bu 'dra bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sras rnams dang ske/ /thub pa'i skyes bu mchog tu 'gyur/ /'di ni rigs kyi rgya mtsho thams cad las/ /gti mug gi rigs kyi dam tshig yang dag pa nyid du shes par bya'o/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags thar pa rab sgrub pa/ /gsang ba dag pa dmigs med pas/ /dkyil 'khor rab tu bka' stsal to/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /dpag med tshe ni rab bsgoms te/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis thams cad dgang / /bud med lta bur sbyar ba ni/ /dam tshig bzhi yi sbyor ba yis/ /thams cad de ru bsgom par bya/ /'di ni rdo rje'i tshul mchog gonatsho/ /dbang po gnyis ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /de dag thams cad nye bar spyad/ /'di ni rdo rje thams cad kyil/ /mi phyed sku gsum sgom pa'o/ /'di ni 'dod chags kyi rigs kyi yang dag pa'i dam tshig ste/ sngags pa rnams kyis bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas rgyal po rdo 81wa 473

rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje sngags kyi don sgrub pa/ /bdag med ye shes las byung bas/ /gsung ni 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje thogs med rab bsgoms te/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bsgom par bya/ /thams cad gzugs su rnam bsgoms nas / /rdo rje tshig gi brdzun smra bas/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gnas rnams dang / /rgyal ba thams cad bslu bar bya/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /nam mkha'i gsung ste dri med pa/ /ye shes blo can kun gyi gsang / /sngags kyi dngos grub thob par bshad/ /'di ni dam tshig 'gugs pa'i rigs kyi dam tshig gi de kho na nyid de/ don ji lta bu kyorabazhin du spro bar bya'o/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin / /rdo rje mi phyed gsum rgyal gnas/ /rdo rje dngos grub rab ston pas/ /gsung ni 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /dam tshig dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /dkon mchog dpal ni rab bsgoms te//gzugs rnams kun gyis 'di dag dgang / /rtsub pa'i ngag la sogs pa ni/ /bsten na ye shes thob par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje bkod pas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje dpal la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams/ ngo mtshar du gyur cing rmad du gyur nas / rdo rje'i tshig 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po khams gsum las 'das shing 'jig rten thams cad las 'das pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi 'khor gyi nang du/ 'di lta bu'i yang dag pa ma 81—474

yin pa'i tshig gi lam/ rdo rje'i tshig 'di ci'i skad du gsung / de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ brjod kyis mi lang ba'i yang brjod kyis mi lang ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi ri rab kyi rdul phra mo snyed 17kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje dpal la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu/ dman pa'i 'du shes dang / smad pa'i 'du shes de lta bu 'ang 5ma skyed cig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu/ 'di lta ste/ sngags kyi spyod pa ni spyod pa'i mchog go/ /'di lta ste/ sngags kyi spyod pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu/ 'di lta ste/ dper na/ nam mkha' ni thams cad kyi rjes su song ba ste/ chos thams cad kyang nam mkha'i khongs su gtogs pa'o/ /chos de dag thams cad kyang 'dod pa'i khams na mi gnas/gzugs kyi khams na mi gnas/ gzugs med pa'i khams na mi gnas/ 'byung ba chen po bzhi la 'ang (ldemi gnas so/ /rigs kyi bu/ chos thams cad kyang de ltar rjes su rig par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni don gyi dbang de lta bu mkhyen cing / sems can rnams kyi bsam pa mkhyen nas chos 'chad par mdzad do/ /rigs kyi bu/ de ltar nam mkha' (4)tshig nges par brjod pas/de bzhin gshegs pa'i dag tshig de dag rjes su rig par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu/'di lta ste/ dper na/ gtsub shing dang / gtsub 5 stan dang / mi'i lag pa bskyod pa'i rkyen gyis du ba 'byung zhing me 'byung bar 'gyur mod kyi/ me de 'ang phyigatsub shing la 'ang (7)mi gnas/ gtsub stan la'ang tshan/mi gnas/ mi'i lag pa bskyod pa la'ang yinami gnas so/ /rigs kyi bu/ de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs 81wa 475

pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig 'gro ba dang / 'ong ba la sogs pa rjes su rig par bya'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag ngo mtshar du gyur/rmad du gyur nas/ ngam zhing mig gdangs te tshig 'di skad ces smras so/ /rmad byung chen po'i chos rnams ni/ /nam mkha' dang ni mtshungs pa dang / /rnam par mi rtog dag pa las/ /kun rdzob tu yang bshad pa mtshar/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa las/ don dam pa'i dag pa de kho na nyid kyi don gyi dam tshig gi le'u ste dgu pa'o// // de nas bcom/ ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yang 'dus te/bcom ldan 'das dam tshig chen po'i rdo rje de kho na nyid mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi 3)gsang ba de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag btsal tsho ste/ 'di skad ces gsol to/ /de nyid sngags snying kun bsdus pa / /sku dang gsung thugs gsang bar bsgrags/ /dngos grub chen po'i tshul gyi mchog /yang dag bcom ldan bshad du gsol/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /nyon mongs kun gyi rgya mtsho gtso/ /'bar ba drag po spyan yangs pas/ /gsung ni 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /lus dang ngag dang sems rnams ni/ /rnam par mi rtog mi dmigs pa/ /gang na'ang mi gnas mnyam pa nyid/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rjer sgom/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rang bzhin gyis dag pa pha rol tu phyin pa sngags kyi tshul rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad la 81—476

'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /bcom ldan 'das/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mi bskyod pa la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rig pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma dang thabs gcig tu sems can thams cad kyi don bya ba la rol pa ston par mdzad de/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' klas (1)par 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams kyis rol cing / dgyes par yongs su spyod pa yod kyang / de dag sngags spyod pa la mngon par brtson pa rnams la/ kye ma/'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sngags kyi spyod pa'i tshul gyis monachos rdzogs par gyur to snyam nas spyan ras kyis mi 'tsho ste/ de bas na skyes bu dam pa de dag la spyan ras kyis btsa' ba'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje'i gsang ba/ sngags thams cad kyi snying po kun du bskul bar byed pa zhes bya ba/ rab tu gsang ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi dam tshig la dmigs pa/ rdo rje 'dzin thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi dam tshig la dmigs pa/ chos 'dzin pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang /thugs kyi dam tshig la dmigs pa 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang /thugs rdo rje las tshig gi lam nges par brjod pas sngags bsdus pa 'di lta bu gsungs so/ /oṃ āḥ// de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa kun/ /rab tu 'dar zhing brgyal bar gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rjes su dran/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos dam tshig 'di gsungs so/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par / /bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /de yi dbus gnas yi ge hūṃ/ /81—477

rang gi gzugs su rab tu brtag /rdo rje'i 'od zer cher 'bar ba/ /rnam par 'phro ba bsam par bya/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni sku gsung thugs/ /drangs par de yis rnam bsgoms na/ /de ma thag tu der 'gyur ba/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /kun gyi gtso bo dbang phyug mchog /rang gi dkyil 'khor rang rdo rjes/ /bskyed par byed pa'i tshul du 'gyur/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /snying po rdo rje bsdus pa yin/ /rang sngags skyes bur bsgoms na ti ni/ /gnas bzhi rnams su gzugs kyi tshul/ /zhal gsum lta bu'i sbyor ba yis/ /kha dog gsum du rab tu sgom/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje dam tshig gis de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje mchog gi gsang ba'o/ /snying ga'i (gedabus su phra mo yi/ /dkyil 'khor rnams ni bsam par bya/ /yi ge mchog tu gyur pa'i tshig /de yi dbus su bsam par bya//rdo rje chen po rtse lnga pa/ /rtag tu sbyor bas bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje kyo ba'i sbyor ba yisal/ /rdo rje gsum rnams bsgom par bya/ /de yis snying gar 5kyebardab byas te/ /lha rnams ji snyed bskul bar bya/ /'di ni rdo rje thams cad kyi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab bsgrub pa'o/ /rdo rje pad+mo'i rigs la sogs/ /rdo rje kyo ba rnam bsgom zhing / /snying ga ri4 ru ni bskul bar bshad/ /'di ni rol mo'i 'byung ba ste / /rdo rje yi ni tshul mchog 'di/ /zhag bdun bar du byas na ni/ /ye shes rdo rje can gyi gsang / /sku dang gsung thugs 'grub par 'gyur/ /mchog stsol ba dag rnam par gzigs/ /yid ni 'jigs shing skrag gyur nas/ /yid la mgu zhing dga' gyur pa'i/ /dngos grub rgya chen ster bar gyurasnyi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /sngags kyi spyod pa'i mchog sgrub pas/ /rmongs 81—478

pas 'da' bar byas na ni/ /de yi srog ni der zad 'gyur/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje gsum gyi ston pa mchog /'jig rten gsum mchog rdo rje gtsos / /gsung ni 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /sngags kyi skyes bu ji snyed pa/ /rdo rje gsum gyi ye shes rdzogs/ /dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /dngos po thams cad brtag par bya/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sngags kyi dam tshig sgom pa'o/ /rig ma'i dbang phyug zhugs pa la/ /rdo rje'i sbyor ba rab bsgom zhing / /chags la chags pas blta bar bya/ /'di ni dam tshig dkyil 'khor ro/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi sras/ /thams cad dbang bskur sangs rgyas gtsos/ /gsung ni 'di skad bka' stsal to//'jig rten khams ni thams cad na/ /bud med ji snyed yod pa kun/ /phyag rgya che sogs sbyor ba yis/ /de dag thams cad nye bar spyad/ /bye ba grangs med rdo rje 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas gnas ni der spro bya/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi dam tshig gis de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rdo rje gsum po mkha' 'dra ba'i/ /byang chub 'di yis thob par 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa' rgyal rgya mtsho/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe des 'thob/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang /gsung dang / thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po bskul ba zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i sngags kyi skyes bu mchog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams 81—479

cad kyi sngags kyi rdo rje rig pa'i skyes bu'i le'u 'di gsungs so/ /rdo rje gsum yig sngags kyi mchog /phyag rgya chen po rnam sgom pa/ /byang chub thams cad thob pa'i lho)phyir/ /ye shes rdo rje dag gis bya/ /oṃ ni ye shes snying po ste/ /rdo rje'i sku ni thob byed pa'o/ /āḥni byang chub bdag med pa/ /rdo rje gsung ni thob byed pa'o/ /k+shi ni sku gsung thugs nyid de/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum thob pa'o / /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang ske/ thugs kyi sngags kyi skyes bus de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i dbus gnas par/ /dkyil 'khor rdo rje kun skyes bsam/ /rdo rje'i sprin ni 'phro bskyed pa/ /de ru yi ge r+ghaṃ bsam mo/ /de la 'di ni ye shes rdo rje'i snying po'o/ /rgyu/ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /hūṃ zhes bya ba rab tu bsgom/ /gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /yi ge oṃ ni rnam par bsam/ /chos kyi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /yi ge āḥni rab tu bsgom / /yi ge r+ghaṃ gyis gnas bsgoms te/ /rdo rje gsum 'byung bsgom par bya/ /snying po dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi/ /sku gsung thugs ni mnyes byed pa/ /oṃ ni sangs rgyas sku yi mchog /oṃ āḥni sangs rgyas gsung gi lam/ /āḥrgyu ni ye shes thugs kyi 'jings/ /hūṃ/ byang chub tshul mchog 'di yin te/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab bsgrub pa/ /ye shes rdo rjes sprul pa ste/ /sangs rgyas rgyu dang 'bras bu 'byung / /'di dag sangs rgyas skyes bu ste/ /sngags kyi rig pa zhes kyang bsgrags/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pa'i/ /dam tshig dag gis rdzogs par 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi dam tshig de kho na nyid kyi ye 81—480

shes rdo rje byin gyis rlob 0pa'i dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /dben zhing rab tu nyams dga' bar/ /sbyor ba 'di ni kun brtsams na/ /rdo rje sku dang gsung dang thugs/ /zla ba phyed kyis nges par 'grub/ /gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ni/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i dbus bsams te/ /rang gi sngags kyi dam tshig bskyed/ /yi ge oṃ ni snying gar 5bzhag /'od zer lnga yi sprin chen po/ /rnam par snang mdzad mchog tu sgom/ /'di yis sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku/ /rdo rje rnam snang rgya mtshor 'gyur/ /ye shes lnga ldan bsten na ni/ /sangs rgyas sku ni 'dra ba'i mdog /rdo rje skal pa gsum du gnas/ /zla ba phyed kyis 'grub par 'gyur / /bcom ldan 'das sku rdo rje gsang bas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku rdo rje'i 'od zer bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /chos kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa ni/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i dbus su bsamatshu/ /rang gi sngags kyi skyes bu bskyed/ /āḥni ngag gi lam bzhag ste/ /kha dog lnga yi pad+ma che/ /'jig rten dbang mchog bsgoms pa yis/ /dam tshig ye shes rdzogs byas te/ /tshig gis dam tshig lnga yi mchog /chos kyi tshig gi lam gnas pa/ /rdo rje chos dang mtshungs par 'gyur/ /ye shes lnga ldan bsten na ni//rdo rje skal pa gsum du gnas/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje'i gsung gsang bas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje'i dam tshig 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ni / /nam mkha' rdo rje'i dbus su bsam/ /rang sngags skyes bu rdzogs byas la/ /sems la yi ge hūṃ gnas pa/ /dam tshig chen po'i de nyid ni/ /kha dog rnam lngar bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje kun dang rgyal ba'i gnas/ /ye shes rdo rje dag gis 81—481

bya / /ston pa rdo rje'i thugs 'dra ba/ /ye shes yon tan rgya mtshor 'gyur/ /ye shes lnga ldan bsten na ni/ /rdo rje skal pa gsum du gnas/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje'i thugs gsang bas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi dam tshig rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /rdo rje chen po bsgom par bya/ /lus rnams kun la khaṃ dmigs na/ /rdo rje ye shes mkha' mnyam 'gyur / /khaṃ/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /yang dang yang du mchod pa dang / /skal ba gsum du dam tshig gnas/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang gzigs mi 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das nam mkha' rdo rje dam tshig gis de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sku dang / gsung dang / thugs mi snang ba 'byung ba bkod pa'i phreng ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /rang sngags skyes bu rab bsams nas/ /snying gar (1)rdo rje haṃ zhes pa/ /bzhag ste 'od zer rnam par sgom/ /haṃ/ 'jam dpal dam tshig longs spyod la / /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /sa bcu dag la gnas pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpar de 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes kyi dam tshig rdo rje zla ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /'od zer 'bar ba'i yi ge dz+rī/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus su bsam/ /mtshon mchog rdo rje'i lus ngag gis/ /rdo rje'i sku dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /smri/ nam mkha' rdo rje'i dam tshig gi bkod pa'i gnas zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /sangs rgyas mngon shes dam tshig mchog /rdo rje 'chang dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /'di ni dngos grub thams cad kyi/ /sangs rgyas mngon shes mchog sgrub pa'o/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas 81—482

par / /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor dam pa bsam/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab bsgoms la/ /ye shes oṃ ni bsgom (1par bya/ /oṃ/ rdo rje dam tshig gsum bsgoms pas/ /mi bskyod rdo rje gsum 'drar 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi bskyod pas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /mi bskyod pa yi sku 'dra dang / /gsung dang thugs mchog 'dra ba 'dzin/ /'jig rten khams rnams thams cad du / /mi bskyod rdo rjes mchod par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa'i sku dang mnyam par mngon par 'byung ba'i dam tshig rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus su ni/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor 'od bzang bsam/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje rab bsgoms la/ /rin chen oṃ ni bsam par bya/ /oṃ/ rdo rje dam tshig gsum bsgoms pas/ /rdo rje gsum dpag med 'drar 'gyur/ /lus dang ngag sems rdo rje yis/ /dkon mchog dpal gyi 'od dang 'dra/ /de ni bdag med byang chub dang / /ye shes gsang ba 'dir gnas 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje dkon mchog dpal gyis de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rin po che'i dam tshig longs spyod pa rdo rje'i tshul zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus su ni/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor dam pa bsam/ /'jig rten dbang phyug rab bsgoms la/ /chos kyi oṃ ni bsgom par bya/ /oṃ/ rdo rje dam tshig gsum bsgoms pas/ /rdo rje gsum dpag med 'drar 'gyur/ /lus dang ngag sems rdo rje yis/ /'od dpag med dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /de ni sems can thams cad kyi/ /theg chen lam ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje tshe dpag tu med pas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /yon tan dpag tu med pa 81—483
