rdo rje 'od kyi dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus su ni/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor dam pa bsam/ /rdo rje pad+ma la bsgoms la/ /dam tshig oṃ ni rab tu bsgom/ /oṃ/ rdo rje dam tshig gsum bsgoms pas/ /rdo rje gdon mi za bar 'gyur/ /lus dang ngag sems rdo rje yis / /rdo rje thogs med 'dra ba'i 'od/ /de ni dpal ldan ye shes mtsho/ /sems can kun don 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gdon mi za bas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gdon mi za ba'i dam tshig 'od zer gyi ye shes kyi mchog 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus su ni/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor dam pa bsam/ /rdo rje snang mdzad rab bsgoms la/ /sku gsum oṃ ni rab tu sgom/ /oṃ/ rdo rje dam tshig gsum bsgoms pas/ /rnam par snang mdzad mnyam par 'gyur/ /lus dang ngag yid rdo rje yi/ /rnam par snang mdzad 'dra ba'i 'od/ /de ni ye shes rdzogs byang chub / /sku gsum mi byed sgrub byed 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad kyi de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /lus dang / ngag dang / yid dmigs pa mngon par byang chub pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /rnam par dben pa'i ri bo dang / /klung dang 'bab chu rnams dang ni/ /dur gyi khrod la sogs par yang / /bsam gtan bsdus pa 'di dag bsgom/ /mi bskyod ye shes dag la sogs/ /rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil du bsam/ /mngon shes lnga po'i sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas mchog gi gnas su bsgom/ /bcom ldan 'das dam tshig chen po'i rdo rje mngon par mkhyen pas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rdo rje chen po rtse lnga pa/ /'bar ba lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /gnas lnga dag tu sbyor 81—484

ba yis/ /rdo rje mngon shes 'dra bar 'gyur/ /me stag mang po 'khrug pa yi/ /rang sngags 'khor lo bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje lnga yi sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje mngon shes 'dra bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil nyid du/ /'khor lo sangs rgyas 'bar 'od 'dra/ /sangs rgyas 'jug par rab bsgoms na/ /sangs rgyas gnas dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /bdag gi lus la snang mdzad bzhag /snying gar 1yi ge oṃ bsams la/ /sngags la rnam par shes pa bsgom/ /'gog pa'i rdo rje sems nyid du/ /gang tshe de la skye 'gyur na/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mchog 'dzin pa/ /yid bzhin dpal ldan lta bur 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /rdo rje mi bskyod rab tu bsgom/ /snying gar na yi ge hūṃ bsgoms nas/ /sems ni thig ler gyur par bzhag /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /tshe dpag med pa rab tu bsgom/ /snying gar 2yi ge āḥbasams te/ /rdo rje thig ler gyur par bzhag /'di ni dam tshig mchog gi mchog /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgom pa/ /'gog pa'i dam tshig ye shes te/ /sangs rgyas dngos grub thob 'gyur ba/ /rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings gnas par/ /gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /lus ngag sems la yi ge oṃ/ /bsams na de ni skal par gnas/ /rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings gnas par/ /chos kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /lus ngag sems la yi ge āḥ/ /bsams na de ni skal par gnas/ /rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings gnas par/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /lus ngag sems la yi ge hūṃ/ /bsams na de ni skal par gnas/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gsum gyi rtog pa'i dam tshig gis de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sku dang gsung 81—485

thugs rdo rje yi/ /rnal 'byor 'dir gyur phyin chad ni/ /klog gam yang na sems kyang rung / /de yang rdo rje 'dzin 'drar 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa las / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sngags kyi dam tshig de kho na nyid rdo rje'i rig pa'i skyes bu mchog gi le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas ston pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /bskyed pa ye shes mchog sgrub pa/ /dam tshig de nyid rdo rje gsum/ /rdo rje gsung gis bka' stsal pa/ /mkha' dang mtshungs par mnyam gyur pa/ /rnam par mi rtog ngo bo nyid/ /chos rnams rang bzhin dag pa las/ /rol mo 'di dag rab tu bsgomanyam/ /dgon pa chen po'i sa phyogs su/ /me tog 'bras bu sogs kyis brgyan/ /ri bo dben pa'i sa phyogs su / /dngos grub thams cad bsdus pa sgrub/ /rma/ lus dang ngag sems rdo rje la / /rdo rje 'jam pa rab tu bsgom/ /lus dang ngag sems la spros pas/ /rdo rje 'jam pa 'dra bar 'gyur/ /dpag tshad brgya yi khyon (5tsam du/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i 'od dag gis/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa yi/ /dag pa'i bdag nyid snang bar 'gyur/ /tshangs pa drag po la sogs lhas/ / nam yang sbyo dmathong bar mi nus so/ /rdo rje 'jam pa mchog gi dam tshig mi snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum las byung / /bshang gci dam tshig lnga rnams ni/ /lcags gsum las byung ldan byas te/ /khar bcug nas ni bsgom par bya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mi phyed pa'i/ /thugs ni de ru rab bsgoms nas / /rdo rje 'jam pa'i 'od 'dra bar/ /de ma thag tu de 'gyur ro/ /81—486

'khor lo 'od 'phro mdangs mchog can/ /rang gi sngags kyis rab bsgoms nas//sangs rgyas thams cad bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /bsgoms nas sangs rgyas 'dra bar 'gyur/ /ri rab sum cu rtsa drug gi/ /rdul phran ji snyed yod pa yi/ /rdo rje 'dzin dang 'dra ba kun/ /de yi rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur/ /'khor lo'i dam tshig ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /rdo rje chen po rang sngags kyi/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su rab bsgoms nas/ /rdo rje kun gyi gnas yin par/ /bsams 1na rdo rje 'dra bar 'gyur/ /ri rab sum cu rtsa drug gi/ /rdul phran ji snyed yod pa yi/ /de snyed kyi ni bud med rnams/ /yon tan can gyi gnas su 'gyur/ /drag po dag gis phyag byas pa/ /khams gsum rdo rje chen por 'gyur/ /rdo rje dam tshig ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /pad+ma chen po 'dab brgyad la/ /rang sngags rdo rje bsams nas su/ /chos rnams kun gyi gnas yin par/ /bsams na chos dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /ri rab sum cu rtsa drug gi/ /rdul phran ji snyed yod pa yi/ /sangs rgyas mchod mchog dkyil 'khor du/ /dag pa'i bdag nyid 'jog par byed/ /pad+mo mnyam pa nyid ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /ye shes lnga ldan rab bsten na/ /bskal pa gsum du yun du gnas/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba gsum la bsnyen bkur tshon)byed/ /'od zer lnga yi mdog 'dra'i 'od/ /rang gi sngags kyi ral gri bsgom/ /mig yangs lag na thogs na ni/ /rdo rje gsum rig 'dzin par 'gyur/ /khams gsum kun gyis rab mchod cing / /tshangs dbang lha min phyag byas pa/ /stong gsum na ni gcig pu pa/ /mi mchog gsang ba 'dzin par 'gyur/ /gang rnams 'dod dang bsam pa dag /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje'i thugs 81wa 487

las rab tu byung / /de lta bu yi dngos grub ste/ /ral gri thams cad kyi dam pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /oṃ ni ril bu tsa na ku'i/ /'bru tshad tsam du bsams nas ni/ /dbus su rang gi lha yi gzugs/ /bsams te khar bcug rnam bsgoms na/ /de ni de ma thag tu yang / /byang chub sems dpa'i 'od 'drar 'gyur/ /nyi ma shar ba'i 'od 'dra zhing / /dzasbu 3chu bo'i gser gyi mdog /āḥni ril bu tsa na ma'i/ /'bru tshad tsam du bsams nas ni/ /dbus su rang gi lha yi gzugs/ /bsams te khar bcug rnam bsgoms na/ /de ni de ma thag tu yang / /byang chub ye shes 'od 'drar 'gyur/ /nyi ma shar ba'i 'od 'dra zhing / /dzasbu 2 chu bo'i gser gyi mdog /hūṃ ni ril bu tsa na ku'i//'bru tshad tsam du bsams nas ni/ /dbus su rang gi lha yi gzugs/ /bsams te khar bcug rnam bsgoms na/ /de ni de ma thag tu yang / /rdo rje'i sku dang 'od 'drar 'gyur/ /mkha' dbyings gsal ba'i dbus gnas par/ /rnam par snang mdzad rab tu bsgom/ /lag tu 'khor lo rab bsgoms na/ /'khor lo'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /'khor lo chen po'i rigs bsgoms te/ /sangs rgyas skur ni rab sbyor zhing / /ye shes 'di ni rab sgrub pa/ /ye shes rdo rje dag gis bya/ /mkha' dbyings rdo rje'i dbus gnas par/ /ye shes mi bskyod rab bsgoms te/ /lag tu rdo rje rab bsgoms na/ /rdo rje'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /rdo rje chen po'i rigs bsgoms te/ /rdo rje'i sku ni rab sbyor zhing / /rdo rje'i mchog 'di sgrub pa ni/ /ye shes rdo rje dag gis bya/ /mkha' dbyings rin chen dbus gnas par/ /rin chen rdo rje rab tu bsgom/ /lag tu rin chen rab bsgoms na/ /rin chen rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /81—488

rin po che yi rigs bsgoms nas/ /rin chen skur ni rab sbyor zhing / /rin chen mchog 'di sgrub pa ni/ /rdo rje ye shes dag gis bya/ /mkha' dbyings chos kyi dbus gnas par/ /tshe dpag med pa rab tu bsgom/ /lag tu pad+mo rab bsgoms na/ /pad+mo'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /pad+mo'i rigs chen bsgoms nas su/ /chos kyi skur ni rab sbyor zhing / /pad+mo'i mchog 'di sgrub pa ni/ /ye shes rdo rje dag gis bya/ /mkha' dbyings dam tshig dbus gnas par/ /gdon mi za ba'i ye shes bsgom/ /lag tu ral gri rab bsgoms na/ /ral gri'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /dam tshig chen po'i rigs bsgoms nas/ /thogs med dam tshig rab sbyor zhing / /dam tshig mchog 'di sgrub pa ni/ /ye shes rdo rje dag gis bya/ /rtse gsum ye shes lcags kyu sogs/ /rdo rje khyad par gyis bsgrubs na/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sgrub pa yis/ /bsam gtan des ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das dam tshig chen po'i dngos grub rdo rjes de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /lam gyi bzhi mdo'am shing gcig drung / /mtshan ma gcig dang zhi gnas su/ /rdo rje dgug pa'i khyad par gyis/ /sgrub pa pos ni rtag tu sgrub/ /sbyor gsum rdo rje can rnams kyi/ /sbyor gsum sngags kyi skyes bu bsam / /sangs rgyas ye shes blo ldan gyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi kyo ba btang / /rlung gi dkyil 'khor mchog gnas pa/ /sangs rgyas dgug pa dam pa yin/ /dam tshig las byung phyogs bcu pa/ /rdo rjes bkug nas nye bar spyod/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi rdo rje dam tshig dgug pa'i cho ga'o/ /rnam par snang mdzad 'khor lo che/ /rdo rje pad+mo la sogs pas/ /rgyal gnas lcags kyu bsams nas ni / /dam tshig dgug mchog kyo bas bya/ /khams gsum gyi dam tshig dgug 81—489

pa'o / /rnam pa'i mchog rnams kun ldan pa'i/ /sangs rgyas sku ni rnam bsgoms la / /lag tu sku dang gsung thugs kyi/ /skyo ba la sogs rab tu bsgom/ /'di dag lta bu'i sbyor ba yis/ /de ni gnas las byed par 'gyur/ /rnam pa'i mchog rnams kun ldan pa'i/ /rdo rje'i sku ni rnam 17bsgoms la/ /rdo rje'i sbyor bas lce bsgoms na/ /rdo rje'i gsung dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /rnam pa'i mchog rnams kun ldan pa'i/ /sangs rgyas sku ni rnam (5)bsgoms la/ /lag tu bsgrub bya bsams nas ni/ /rdo rje dang ni 'dra bar 'gyur/ /gsang gsum dam tshig mchod pa'i mchog /mchod pas mchod nas rab tu sgrub/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba'i snying po bsdus pa yin/ /bcom ldan 'das gsang ba chen po'i dam tshig gis 7༄de skad ces gsungs so/ /sha chen dam tshig mchog gis ni/ /rdo rje gsum mchog bsgrub par bya/ /bshang (5)gci dam tshig mchog gis ni/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i gtso bor 'gyur/ /glang po'i sha yi dam tshig gis//mngon shes lnga dag thob par 'gyur/ /rta sha dag gi dam tshig gis/ /mi snang ba yi bdag por 'gyur/ /khyi sha dag gi dam tshig gis/ /dngos grub thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /ba lang sha yi dam tshig gis/ /rdo rje dgug pa'i mchog tu 'gyur / /sha rnams thams cad med na yang / /thams cad bsams pas rnam par brtag /rdo rje sbyor ba 'di byas na/ /sangs rgyas thams cad byin gyis rlob / /rnam pa'i mchog rnams kun ldan pa/ /sku gsung thugs ni rdo rje can/ /snying gar 5ye shes dam tshig dang / /dbu rgyan rdo rje mchog 'dzin pa/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes gyur pa/ /dam tshig mchog gis bya ba ni/ /dngos grub thams cad 'grub pa'i mchog /dam tshig mchog gis rab tu bya/ /dam tshig 81—490

thams cad ye shes rdo rjer gyur pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /lce yi dam tshig rdo rje mchog /rdo rje can gyis k+shi bsgoms 1te/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi sbyor ba yis / /thos na rdo rje gsum thob 'gyur/ /āḥdang oṃ gyi dam tshig kyang / /'di ni rdo rje'i tshul mchog ste/ /'di lta bu yi sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje mi phyed 'dra bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i dam tshig bdud rtsi phreng ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /rdo rje dam tshig dngos grub mchog /sku gsum rdo rje can du 'gyur/ /phyogs bcu'i sems can thams cad kyi/ /nor bu yid bzhin rgya mtshor 'gyur/ /'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /rdo rje'i bdag nyid snang bar byed/ /'khor lo'i dam tshig grub pa'i mchog /sangs rgyas sku dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /gaṅgā'i rin bye snyed thams cad du/ /grub pa kun tu rnam par spyod/ /dam tshig dam pa thams cad kyi/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i gtso bor 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i sku ni rab bsgoms pas/ /thams cad dam tshig mchog tu 'grub/ /mi snang gyur pa thams cad la/ /stong khams dag ni snang bar byed/ /sangs rgyas kun las 'phrog pa dang / /lha yi bu mo mchog la spyod/ /gaṅgā'i bye snyed sangs rgyas rnams / /rdo rje gsum gyi gnas bzhugs pa/ /rang lag skyu ru ra bzhag bzhin/ /rdo rje mig gis mthong bar 'gyur/ /gaṅgā'i bye snyed zhing rnams na/ /sgra bsgrags pa ni ji snyed pa/ /mngon shes rna bas thos pa ni/ /rna ba'i drung na 'khod pa bzhin/ /gaṅgā'i bye snyed zhing dag gi/ /sems can kun gyi sems rnams ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyis mtshan pa yi/ /rol mo las byung sems rig 'gyur / /bskal pa gaṅgā'i bye snyed du/ /'khor ba dag na gnas pa yi/ /sngon gyi gnas kyi gtan tshig rnams/ /zhag gsum lon pa bzhin du dran/ /gaṅgā'i 81—491

bye ma snyed kyi lus/ /sangs rgyas sprin la sogs brgyan pa/ /bskal (1)pa gaṅgā'i bye snyed du/ /rdo rje rdzu 'phrul mchog gis 9 da'agengs/ /bcom ldan 'das dam tshig mngon par mkhyen pas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de la mngon par shes pa lnga ni/ rdo rje'i spyan dang / rdo rje'i snyan dang / rdo rje'i thugs dang / rdo rje'i gnas dang / rdo rje'i rdzu 'phrul lo/ /sangs rgyas mngon shes lnga don 'grubaske/ /sangs rgyas sku dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /gaṅgā'i bye snyed grangs med pa'i / /'khor gyis yongs su bskor nas su/ /rdo rje'i sku dang gsung thugs kyis / /'jig rten khams kun bgrod par 'gyur/ /bsnyen pa'i dam tshig sbyor ba dang / /nye bar sgrub pa 'byung ba dang / /sgrub pa'i don gyi dam tshig dang / /sgrub pa chen po dag dang bzhi/ /rdo rje'i bye brag shes byas la/ /de nas las rnams bsgrub par bya/ /bsnyen pa'i ting 'dzin rab sbyor ba/ /byang chub mchog ni bsgom par bya/ /nye bar sgrub pa grub mchog la/ /rdo rje skye mched rnam par spyad / /sngags kyi bdag po bsgoms pa yis/ /sgrub pa'i tshe ni bskul bar gsungs / /sgrub pa chen po byed pa'i tshe/ /rang sngags rdo rje can gyi gzugs/ /dbu rgyan la ni bdag po bsam/ /ye shes rdo rje 'grub par 'gyur/ /bsnyen pa'i ye shes bdud rtsi dag /thams cad du ni rtag par bya/ /'di ni sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /sngags kyi de nyid don sgrub pa'o/ /dgon pa chen po'i sa phyogs dang / /rab tu rnam par dben pa dang / /ri bo nags 'dab chu ngogs su/ /rtag tu dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sgrub pa chen pos de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /yang na rdo rje bzhi dag gis/ /brtul zhugs brtan pas bsnyen pa bya/ /sku gsum mnyam pa nyid gyur pa/ /81—492

bsgoms na dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /dus bzhi dag tu rab sbyor bas/ /blo dang ldan pas gnas lngar ni/ /ye shes rdo rje yi ge oṃ/ /bsgoms na sdom pa yin par bshad/ /zhag bdun dang ni zla phyed dang / /zla gcig zla ba phyed dang gnyis / /rdo rje dam tshig bsgrub na ni/ /dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur/ /zhag grangs bye brag rab bskul ba/ /nga yis rgyas par rab tu bstan/ /gsang ba mchog las byung ba la/ /zla ba phyed kyis 'grub par gsungs/ /de la 'di ni nye bar sgrub pa'i sdom pa'i yul lo/ /sangs rgyas sku 'dzin dpal dang ldan/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum 'byed pa/ /byin gyis brlabs kyi gnas byas te/ /rdo rje sku dang ldan par bya/ /mi phyed rdo rje gsum bsgoms pas/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /de la sku yis mtshan pa yi/ /byin gyis brlabs kyis gnas mdzad do/ /de la 'di ni sgrub pa'i sdom pa'i 17yul lo/ /chos kyi gsung lam dpal dang ldan/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum 'byed pa/ /byin gyis brlabs kyi gnas byas te/ /rdo rje gsung dang ldan par bya/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas / /phyogs bcu na bzhugs sangs rgyas rnams/ /de la gsung las byung ba yi / /byin gyis brlabs kyis gnas mdzad do/ /de la 'di ni sgrub pa chen po'i sdom pa'i yul lo/ /rdo rje'i thugs 'dzin dpal dang ldan/ /rdo rje mi 2phyed gsum 'byed pa/ /byin gyis brlabs kyis gnas byas te/ /rdo rje thugs dang ldan par bya/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /phyogs bcu na bzhugs sangs rgyas rnams/ /de la thugs las byung ba yis/ /byin gyis brlabs kyis gnas mdzad do/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' 'am/ /yang na chos kyi sems dpa'ang rung / /rmongs pas 'da' bar byed na ni/ /tshal par 'gas 81—493

par gdon mi za/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang /thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i sbyor ba'i dam tshig sgrub pa'i mchog bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan bde gshegs kun/ /ye shes rdo rje mchog 'dzin pa/ /sems can kun don yang dag 'byung / /byang chub sems dpa' blo ldan gyis/ /thub pa don kun rdo rje can/ /ston pa che la phyag btsal 17nas/ /dam tshig de nyid mkhyen pa la/ /mchod de rdo rje'i dbyangs 'di gsungs/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas tshul re bzang / /e ma'o byang chub tshul gyi mchog /e ma'o chos kyi tshul re zhi / /e ma'o sngags kyi tshul re brtan/ /ma skyes pa yi chos rnams ni/ /ngo bo nyid kyis khyad par can/ /rnam par mi rtog yang dag rig /ye shes 'byung ba rab tu bshad/ /yid 'ong sngags rnams kun bsdus pa/ /rdo rje bzlas pa ye shes che/ /sku gsum mi phyed dkyil 'khor dang / /sangs rgyas ye shes thob 'gyur ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed 2gsum bsgoms pa'i/ /rdo rje bzlas pa'i sbyor ba yis / /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis rlob/ /rigs dang gsang sngags thams cad kyi/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi mtshan/ /gsang sngags zlos pa de ring gsungs / /ye shes rgya mtsho gsan pa dang / /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /sangs rgyas dus gsum las byung rnams/ /rdo rje sngags kyi nanorab bsgoms pas/ /ye shes mnyam med thob 'gyur ba/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 4bshad du gsol/ /de nas ston pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /nam mkha' rdo rje ye shes 'byung / /byed skyed 81—494

dam pa mchog gi gtsos/ /rdo rje bzlas pa 'di gsungs so/ /sngags kyi don kun bzlas pa ni/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyis mtshan/ /rdo rje dbye ba gsum gyi mtharal/ /bkod pa rdo rje gsum zhes bya/ /sku gsung thugs kyi gnas rnams su/ /spro ba rnam pa gsum dag bya/ /rdo rje bzlas pa 'di yis ni/ /rdo rje gsum gyi thugs 'drar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs/ /bsgoms nas mchod pa'i mchog brtag pa/ /ye shes rdo rjes byas na ni/ /rdo rje gsum gyi thugs 'drar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs/ /bsams nas mchod pa'i mchog brtag pa/ /ye shes rdo rjes rab tu bya/ /'di ni byang chub mchog thob pa'o/ /yang na dbye ba rnam gsum gyis/ /so so dag tu spro bar bya/ /sku dang gsung thugs bdag med pa/ /ye shes sems kyis yang dag spro/ /brjod nas rdo rje spro ba ni/ /rdzogs nas rab tu bsdu bar bya/ /'di ni ye shes spyan phye ba'i/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni kun gyi yin/ /sku yi rdo rje rdzogs byang chub / /dngos dang dngos med rnam dpyad pa/ /sangs rgyas sku zhes bya bar bshadam/ /de ni sku yi bzlas par bshad/ /gsung gi dam tshig rdzogs byang chub/ /sgra dang sgra min rnam dpyad pa/ /gsung gi rdo rje zhes bshad de1/ /de ni gsung gi bzlas par bshad/ /thugs kyi dam tshig rdzogs byang chub/ /gnas pa'i rdo rje rnam dpyad pa/ /thugs kyi rdo rje zhes bya ste/ /de ni thugs kyi bzlas par bshad / /don gyi rjes 'gro bzlas pa ni/ /ngo bo nyid med bzang po yis/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas rnam dpyad pa/ /de ni rin chen bzlas par bshad/ /sangs rgyas zhing rnams thams cad du/ /sku yi sprin rnams spro ba dang / /bzhud cing byon pa rdo rje'i don/ /de ni thogs med bzlas par bshad/ /khro bo'i dam 81—495

tshig ye shes kyis/ /rang gi rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor grags/ /sngags kyi yi ge'i tshig thos pa/ /de ni khro bo'i bzlas par bshad/ /'dod pa'i don gyis myos gyur pa/ /kun tu skyob cing phan par dga'/ /sems can gti mug gnas la 'jog /de ni gti mug bzlas par bshad/ /'dod chags rdo rje las byung tshig /lus dang ngag sems la gnas pa'i/ /sems can 'dod chags mtshor gnas bzhag /de ni 'dod chags bzlas par bshad/ /zhe sdang rdo rje las byung sems / /lus dang ngag sems la gnas pa'i/ /sems can zhe sdang gnas la bzhag /de ni zhe sdang bzlas par bshad/ /dam tshig de nyid rdo rje gsum/ /dbu ma dam tshig rdo rje can/ /de nyid dam tshig rdo rje yi/ /bzlas pa ma ning zhes bya 'o/ /'dod chags de nyid don sgom pa/ /rdo rje bdag po thams cad ni / /sems can kun la phan 'dod pa'i/ /'dod chags byang chub rdzogs par mdzad / /rig pa chen mo spyan la sogs/ /rtag tu 'dod pa'i don brtson pa/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod dag gis ni/ /ji ltar 'dod pa bsten na 'grub/ /gti mug dam tshig las byung ba/ /rig pa'i rgyal po rdo rje can/ /ma ning dag gi gnas grub pa/ /dngos grub dam pa rab tu ster/ /khro bo zhe sdang gnas las skyes / /gsod la rtag tu brtson pa dag /sgrub pa mchog gi chos can la/ /gsod pa'i don gyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das skyes bu chen po'i dam tshig gis de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /ye shes 'khor lo can rnams kyi/ /'khor lo snying ga'i 1dbus su bsgom/ /gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas paral/ /dbus su 'khor lo'i don bsgom mo/ /ye shes rdo rje can rnams kyi/ /rdo rje snying ga'i 2dbus su bsgom/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /81—496

rdo rje'i sngags don bsgom par bya/ /rin chen ye shes can rnams kyi/ /rin chen snying ga'i (gedabus su bsgom/ /rin chen dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /rin chen sngags don bsgom par bya/ /pad+mo ye shes can rnams kyi/ /pad+mo snying ga'i rdo dbus su bsgom/ /chos kyi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /pad+mo'i sngags don bsgom par bya/ /ral gri ye shes can rnams kyi/ /ral gri snying ga'i nadabus su bsgom/ /dam tshig dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /ral gri'i sngags don bsgom par bya/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi ngos rnams su/ /sangs rgyas lnga rnams dgod par bya/ /'od zer lnga yi bye brag gis/ /spros na byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /sngags rnams thams cad spro ba ni/ /bye brag rnam pa gnyis su bsgrags / /sku gsum rdo rje bye brag gis/ /spro ba dang ni bsdu ba bya/ /lus kyis sku yi ngo bo nyid/ /sems kyis thugs kyi ngo bo nyid/ /ngag gis gsung gi ngo bo nyid / /mchod nas mchod pa'i gnas su 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i 'khor lo yis/ /rdo rje lnga rnams bsgom par bya/ /dbus su bdag po bsams nas ni/ /sku gsung rdo rje rang gi gzugs/ /rang sngags rdo rje'i gzugs dag gis / /dkyil 'khor rnam pa bzhi dag tu/ /kha dog rnam bzhir kun brtags la / /snying gar bsngags kyi don bsgoms par/ /rdo rje rnam pa bzhi yi las/ /bsam gtan rdo rje can dag byed/ /'di ni sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba rab tu bzang po yin/ /zhi ba la ni spyan gyi tshul/ /rgyas la rdo rje pad+mo can / /dbang la rnam par snang mdzad gnas/ /rdo rje khro mo mngon spyod la/ /'di ni rdo rje thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba sku gsum las byung ba/ /sngags rnams kun ni sprul pa ste/ /bya ba'i rol mos mtshan pa 'o/ /ma dad smra ba'i sems 81—497

can dang / /rdo rje slob dpon smod pa dang / /gdug pa'i sems can gzhan rnams la'ang / /rab tu bskul ba 'di bya 'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ye shes chen po'i 'khor lo rdo rjes de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /khams gsum gnas pa'i sems can rnams/ /sangs rgyas sku 1)ni rnam bsgoms la/ /dgra bos bsad par bsams nas su/ /de nas las rnams brtsam par bya/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /rdo rje rtse lnga zhal (babazhi pa/ /rnam pa'i mchog rnams kun dang ldan/ /rdo rje sems dpar rnam par bsgom/ /dus gsum dam tshig las byung ba/ /sangs rgyas 'khor lo rnam bsgoms la/ /sangs rgyas 'khor lo stobs po che/ /lag pa g.yas pas 'di bya'o/ /phyogs bcu nas byung sems can rnams/ /sangs rgyas sku yi bye brag gis/ /bsdus te gong bu'i tshul gyis su//rang gi lus la de dang gzhugadumi /sangs rgyas ye shes 'khor lo can/ /slar yang spro bar rab tu bya/ /khro bas 'khrugs pa'i khro bo rnams/ /mi sdug 'jigs su rung ba'i gzugs/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs mchog 'dzin pa/ /gsod pa'i don gyis don sems pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid dam/ /gdug pa chen po gsod par byed/ /sangs rgyas sku gsum mchog stsol pa'o/ /rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor gnas/ /nyi ma bdun du 'di byas na/ /sangs rgyas dngos grub ster bar 'gyur/ /rmongs pas grub pa mi ster na/ /'chi bar 'di ni gdon mi za / /rdo rje'i dam tshig ye shes kyi bka'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus su ni/ /'khor lo rdo rje 'bar bas brgyanaris/ /rnam pa'i mchog ni kun dang ldan/ /rnam par snang mdzad rab tu bsgom/ /dus gsum dam tshig las byung ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa' grags chen ni/ /rdo rje 81—498

me stag 'phro ba can/ /de yi phyag na bsnams par bsgom/ phyogs bcu nas byung sems can rnams/ /rdo rje sku yi khyad par gyis/ /'od zer tshu'/ gyis bsdus nas ni/ /de dag bdag gi lus la gzung / /spro ba rdo rje thams cad kyi/ /ye shes mchog gi gnyen gyis bya/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sbyor ba can/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bdag la gson/ /bdag ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /bka' yi 'khor lo rab sbyor ba/ /gal te dam tshig las 'das na/ /rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba yis/ /sku gsum las byung dgas par bgyi/ /zhig par 'gyur bar gdon mi 'tshal/ /'khor lo'i dam tshig ye shes rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to / /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor rdo rje can/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i dbus su bsam / /gshin rje gshed kyi 'khor lo che/ /rang gi rdo rje yin par brtag /dus gsum sangs rgyas sems dpa' rnams/ /sku gsum dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa dag /gshin rje gshed kyi mdog 'dra ba/ /slar yang sangs rgyas spro bar bya/ /dus gsum la bzhugs sems can dang / /gdug sems can gyi dgra bo rnams/ /khros pas thams cad gsod par bsgom/ /'di ni rdo rje bka'i dkyil 'khor dam tshig thams cad las byung ba gshin rje gshed kyi sku gsum gyi ye shes rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje 'am/ /rang sngags don gyi yon tan nam/ /yang na gtsug tor dam tshig gis/ /bka' yi 'khor lo sbyar bar bya/ /sngags kun bsrung 1phyir ye shes mchog /rdo rje can gyis bya ba ste/ /'di ni rdo rje thams cad kyi/ /byang chub bsrung ba'i don chen bya/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rjes de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i dbus gnas par / /chos kyi snang mdzad sku mchog las/ /byung ba'i sku gsum dam tshig dag /81wa 499

mkha' dbyings rdo rje'i dbus gnas par/ /bsams nas gdan du de rab brtag /mkha' dbyings sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /yongs su gang bar rnam par bsgom/ /rang sngags yi ge'i gnas ye shes/ /thugs kyi rnam par bsgoms (1par bya/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni sems tsam du/ /bsgoms nas slar yang rab tu bsdu/ /thugs kyi rdo rjer byas pa'i phyir/ /sku gsum la ni de dag gzud/ /rdo rje'i sngags rin po che rab tu snang bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /rnam pa'i mchog rnams kun ldan pa'i/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab tu bsgom/ /sangs rgyas rim bzhin bkod nas ni/ /chu yi steng du bcag par bya/ /rkang pa mnyam gzhag (5)sbyor ba yis/ /spyi bo'i steng du rkang pa bsgom/ /bcom ldan 'das ngo bo nyid dag pas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rdo rje rgya mtsho rkang pas gnon pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor bsgoms nas ni / /dbus su khro bo rnam bzhag la/ /las kyi rdo rje rkang pa yis/ /de yi spyi bor gnon par bsgom/ /mu stegs can dang / phas kyi rgol ba thams cad kyi 'khrul 'khor gnon pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /rdo rje gsum mchog khro bo'i tshul/ /ge sar ser po'i mdog 'dra ba/ /thams cad ri yi rgyal po ltar/ /bsams nas spyi bor rab tu bsgom/ /sangs rgyas dpung yang gnon byed na/ /mi dbang la ni dogs pa med/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs las byung bas de skad ces bka' stsal to / /dpung thams cad gnon pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /dgra bo skrag pa'i dam tshig gi/ /bsam gtan rab tu brtag pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas dag gis 'das na yang / /'gas par 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ /bcom ldan 81—500

'das rdo rje gsum gyi dam tshig gis de skad ces gsungs so/ /hūṃ las phur bu bsam pa ni/ /rtse lnga pa yi tshad du ste/ /rdo rje phur bu de yis ni/ /snying gar 1de ni rab bsgoms na/ /khros pas sangs rgyas dpung dag kyang / /'jig par 'gyur ba gdon mi za/ /dgra rmongs par byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /grong ngam yang na grong khyer ram/ /ljongs dag tu ni rab sbyor ba/ /nad kun spong ba'i zhi ba yang / /'dis ni rtag tu sbyar bar bya/ /rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa ni/ /bar snang dag la rab tu bsgom/ /sreg pa'i bskal pa ltar bsams na/ /slar yang rab tu bsdu bar bya/ /spro ba dag kyang de nas bya/ /rin chen yid bzhin nor bu'i 'od/ /chos kyi sprin ni bsgoms nas kyang / /dbang bskur ba ni yang dag bya/ /rdo rje'i bsam gtan 'di yis ni/ /dgang dka' ba yang rab tu 'gengs / /sbyin pa'i rdo rje rab tu bsgom/ /yid bzhin nor bu dpal ldan 'gyur / /sangs rgyas sprin dang chos chen dang / /rdo rje sems dpa' der spro bya//bskal pa gsum gyi yun gnas shing / /sangs rgyas thams cad byin gyis rlob/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba'i sku ste skyon med pa'o/ /nad thams cad med par byed pa rdo rje 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /bsam nas las byung dam bcas pas/ /gnas gang du ni yang dag spyad/ /bsam gtan sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /gnas na sangs rgyas byin gyis rlob/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi rgyal po che/ /rdo rje phur bu rab tu bsgom/ /me stag 'bar ba 'dra ba yis/ /phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor gdab par bya/ /'gro ba 'dul ba zhi ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ni/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus su bsam/ /rnam par snang mdzad gzugs bsams 81—501

nas / /rang gi thugs kur 917'dod pa bzhag /spyan la sogs pa mchog rnams kyis / /mkha' dbyings yongs su gang bar bsgom/ /bsdus nas 'od kyi gong bu yis / /nad pa la ni dbab par bya/ /ba spu'i bu ga nas sangs rgyas/ /sprin rnams brtul zhugs can gyis spro/ /sangs rgyas sprin rnams de yi tshe/ /de la dbang bskur rab tu rtsol/ /nad pa rdo rje dam tshig gis/ /skad cig gis ni dpal ldan 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kyi dam tshig bkod pa'i sprin zhes bya ba'i ting nge 2'dzin to/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor dam pa bsam/ /chos 'dzin pa yi gzugs bsams nas/ /snying gar rdo nye'adod pa bzhag par bya/ /mkha' dbyings gnas ni nyams dga' bar/ /dkar mo zhes byas rab tu dgang / /'od kyi gong bur bsdus nas ni/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen 'od/ /lus dang ngag dang sems gnas la/ /'dod pa la de dbab par bya/ /ba spu'i bu ga nas rin chen/ /sprin rnams brtul zhugs can gyis spro/ /chos kyi sprin rnams bsgoms nas su/ /dbang bskur ba ni yang dag bya / /rdo rje bsam gtan 'di yis ni/ /dgang dka' ba yang rab tu 'gengs/ /sbyin pa'i rdo rje sgrub pa de/ /yid bzhin nor bu dpal ldan 'gyur/ /chos kyi sprin gyi dam tshig bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus su ni/ /rdo rje'i zla gam dkyil 'khor bsam/ /rdo rje nam mkha' chos mdun gzugs/ /'dod pa snying gar gzhag napar bya/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor yongs su gang / /'od zer lnga yi sbyor ba yis/ /de ni gzi brjid dbab par bya/ /de ni de ma thag tu yang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs su byon/ /'jam dpal gyi ni mdog dang 'dra/ /81—502

gnas las byed par de 'gyur ro/ /dbang bskur ba ni dga' ston che/ /dgyes pa'i bdag nyid de rtsol bas/ /bltas tsam skyed pa nyid kyis kyang / /'gro ba thams cad dbang du 'gyur/ /rin po che'i dam tshig gi sprin bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nam mkha' rdo rje srin po ni/ /drag cing khro la rab gtum par/ /wa dang bya rog sna tshogs dang / /bya rgod khyi yis gang bar bsgom / /me yi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /dgra bo rnams ni skrag par bsgom / /sangs rgyas kun la gnod byed pa/ /bsams nas rnal 'byor sbyar bar bya/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pas mnan/ /rgyu ma khrag dang rkang la sogs / /thams cad drangs par rnam bsgoms te/ /bsgoms na dgra rnams 'chi bar 'gyur/ /gal te de ltar rab bsgoms na/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin pa yang / /zla ba phyed ni tshun chad kyis/ /'chi bar 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ /rdo rje dam tshig sprin bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /rnam par snang mdzad zhal gsum pa/ /ston ku'i sprin gyi mdog 'dra bsam/ /dkar po nag po rab tu dmar/ /thor tshugs dbu rgyan dag gis brgyan/ /rdo rje can ni zhal gsum bsam/ /nag po dkar po dmar po'i zhal/ /'bar ba'i thor tshugs dbu rgyan can/ /'jig rten khams rnams 'khrug byed pa'o/ /'dod chags can ni zhal gsum bsam/ /dmar po nag po dkar po'i zhal/ /thor tshugs dbu rgyan longs spyod can/ /bsgoms na nges par 'grub par 'gyur/ /'khor lo rdo rje pad+mo che/ /g.yas pa'i phyag tu bsnams par bsgom/ /rdo rje phyag drug mtshon cha ni/ /bzang po sna tshogs bsnams par bsgom/ /sems can kun la phan bzhed ma/ /spyan ni zhal gsum dag tu bsam/ /dkar po nag po rab 81—503

dmar ba/ /mdzes pa'i gzugs su rab tu bsgom/ /mkha' skyes spyan ni rgyal mo che/ /zhal gsum du ni rtag par bsgom/ /gnag dang dkar dang dmar ba'i tshul/ /mdzes pa'i gzugs su rnam par bsgom/ /chu skyes spyan ni rgyal mo che / /zhal gsum du ni rnam par bsgom/ /dmar dang gnag dang dkar ba ste/ /kha dog mdzes par rnam par bsgom/ /rig ma rdo rje ut+pal bsnams/ /zhal gsum rab tu gsal ba'i mdangs/ /ser dang gnag dang dkar ba'i zhal/ /bsgoms na ye shes thob par 'gyur/ /khro bo chen po gshin rje gshed/ /zhal gsum drag po'i 'od bzang ba/ /rnon po 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par byed/ /kha dog nag po rab tu bsgom/ /gzhan gyis mi thub khro bo che/ /drag tu bzhad pa'i sgra 'byin par/ /zhal gsum 'od zer mang po dag /rab tu 'phro ba rnam par bsam/ /khro bo chen po rta mgrin ni/ /bskal 91pa'i me bzhin rab tu 'bar / /zhal gsum gdug pa zhabs kyis mnan/ /sbyor ba can gyis rtag tu bsgom / /rdo rje mi 'chi khro bo che/ /'od zer 'phro ba rab tu 'khrug /drag po 'khor lo 'bar ba 'dra/ /'jigs pa dag kyang 'jigs par byed/ /'dod pa'i ye shes khro bo che/ /zhal gsum pa ni 'jigs par byed/ /phyag bzhi 'jigs par byed pa'i mchog /ṭak+ki rgyal po rab tu bsgom/ /stobs po che ni rdo rje che/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mun sel ba/ /gdug pa thams cad 'joms par byed/ /zhal gsum par ni rtag par bsgom/ /khro bo chen po dbyig 2rasngon can / /khams gsum dag ni 'jigs par byed/ /zhal gsum rdo rje gsum las byung ske/ /'bar ba rnon po can du bsgom/ /rdo rje mi g.yo khro bo che/ /rdo rje las byung mi g.yo ba/ /zhi ba ral gri zhag dpa bsnams/ /brtul zhugs can gyis 81—504

zhal gsum bsgom/ /gtsug tor chen po yi ge gcig /'od zer dag ni kun tu 'phro/ /zhal gsum 'bar ba 'khor lo can/ /bsam gtan dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /gnod mdzes ye shes mchog 'dzin pa/ /'jigs pa'i rgya mtsho yang dag byed/ /zhal gsum 'bar ba 'od 'phro can/ /bsam gtan dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /gzi brjid phung po gtsug tor rgyal/ /gang gzhan sngags kyi 'khor lo can/ /dam tshig longs spyod 'di rnams kyis/ /so so dag tu bsgom par bya/ /ting nge 'dzin ni dpag med pa/ /sngags rnams kyi ni bshad pa yin/ /khro bo dag ni re re yang / /nam mkha'i steng du shin tu 'phagasam/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor dam pa bsam/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms la/ /rnam par snang mdzad rnam par bsam/ /gsal zhing zhi ba zla ba bzhin/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'dra ba'i 'od/ /me long lta bur yang dag byung / /khams gsum dag gi dkyil 'khor du/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa dag /bsams na de yis byang chub mthong / /bsam gtan rdo rje rab bsgom pa/ /'di yis sangs rgyas che ba'i bdag /'jig rten thams cad dbang byed pa/ /tshe 'di nyid kyis 'thob par 'gyur/ /rnam par snang mdzad kyi dam tshig 'byung ba mdzes pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ni/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus su bsam/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms la/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rnam par bsam/ /khros pa gsal ba'i lus dang 'dra/ /'bar ba sna tshogs mnyam pa'i 'od/ /rnam pa'i mchog rnams kun dang ldan/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /zhi ba'i ye shes gnas bsgoms na/ /81—505

myur du rdo rje nyid thob 'gyur/ /bsam gtan rdo rje rab bskul ba/ /'dis ni rdo rje'i bdag nyid che/ /sems can thams cad dbang byed pa/ /tshe 'di nyid la thob par 'gyur/ /dam tshig thams cad 'byung ba mdzes pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /chos kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa ni/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje'i dbus su bsam/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms la/ /chos kyi sems dpa' rnam par bsgom/ /gsal ba'i lus 'dzin zhi ba ni/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /'od zer sprin gyi 'khor lo che/ /rnam par 'phro ba rab tu bsgom/ /'di yis chos kyi bdag nyid che/ /sku gsum mi phyed las byung ba/ /ye shes rgya mtshos rnam par brgyan91/ /tshe 'di nyid la thob par 'gyur/ /chos kyi sems dpa'i dam tshig 'byung ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ni/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje'i dbus su bsam/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms la/ /spyan gyi mchog ni rnam par bsgom/ /zhal bzang spyan ni rab tu yangs/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /mtshan rnams thams cad rab tu rdzogs/ /bud med sgyu ma'i mchog ldan pa/ /khams gsum dag ni dbang byed pa/ /ye shes thams cad grub par byed/ /'khor lo yid bzhin nor bu ster/ /phyag tu 'khor lo bsgom par bya/ /spyan gyi dam tshig phyag gi mchog dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor 'od mchog can/ /mkha' dbyings rdo rje'i dbus su bsam/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms nas/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje rab mchog bsgom/ /zhal bzang spyan ni rab tu yangs/ /ut+pal mthing ku'i mdog 'dra ba/ ci/mtshan rnams thams cad rab tu rdzogs/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje mchog rab bsgom/ /81—506

khams gsum dag gis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas byang chub byed pa'i mchog /dngos grub rdo rje can gyi gsang / /ut+pal sngo dmar phyag na bsnams/ /nam mkha' yum gyi rin po che/ /'od kyi sprin rdo rje tshim par byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /chos kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa ni/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i dbus su bsam / /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms la/ /rdo rje chos 1ma rab tu bsgom / /zhal bzang spyan ni rab tu yangs/ /pad+ma rā ga'i mdog 'dra ba'i/ /sgyu mas mtshan pa'i mchog las byung / /'dod chags chags pa 'dzin sdug pa/ /mtshan nyid thams cad yongs rdzogs shing / /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa yi/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rab bsgoms pa/ /chos kyi ye shes 'byung gnas mchog /dam tshig rdo rje can gyi gsang / /ut+pal dmar po phyag na bsnams/ /chos kyi dam tshig de kho na nyid mngon par byang chub pa kun tu ston pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /dngos grub dkyil 'khor dam pa ni/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje'i 2dbus su bsam/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms la/ /sgrol ma'i mchog ni bsgom par bya/ /zhal bzang spyan ni rab tu yangs/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /kha dog ljang ser 'dra ba'i 'od/ /bud med sgyu ma rab tu myos/ /rdo rje ting nge 'dzin las byung / /sems can kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /ut+pa la ser po'i mdog 'dra ba'i/ /gsal ba phyag na bsnams par bsgom/ /dam tshig sgrol ma mchog dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ni/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje'i dbus su bsam/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms la/ /gshin rje gshed mchog rnam par bsgom/ /'bar ba'i 'od zer mang po 'phro/ /'jigs pa'i dkyil 'khor rab tu khros/ /81—507

spyan dmar mche ba rnam par gtsigs/ /phyag na ral gri bsnams par bsgom/ /snang mdzad dbu rgyan rnams bsgoms na/ /rdo rje can ni dgyes par 'gyur/ /'di ni ye shes rdo rje can/ /gshin rje gshed kyi spro ba'i snang ba bkod pa bsgom pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ni/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje'i dbus su bsam/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms la/ /gzhan gyis mi thub rab bsgom pa/ /'bar ba'i 'od zer mang po can/ /sbrul gyis brgyan 1zhing ska rags can/ /rdo rje dgyes pa 'jigs 'jigs lta/ /kha dog dkar po rab tu bsgom/ /mi bskyod dam tshig dbu rgyan la/ /bsams na rdo rje can dag mnyes/ /'di ni ye shes blo can gyisatshon/ /khro bo kun gyi dam tshig gol/ /gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rdo rje bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ni/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje'i dbus su bsam/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms la/ /rdo rje rta ni rab tu bsgom/ /khro bo'i 'od zer mang po dag /thams cad du ni rnam par 'phro/ /gdug pa thams cad zhabs kyis mnan/ /kha dog dmar po rnam par bsam/ /rdzogs sangs dpag med dbu rgyan la/ /bsgoms na rdo rje can dag mnyes/ /'di ni rdo rje ye shes can/ /khro bo kun gyi dam tshig yin/ /rta mgrin skyed pa 'byung ba rnam par bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ni/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje'i dbus su bsam/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms la/ /rdo rje mi 'chi rab tu bsgom/ /'bar ba'i 'od zer mang po 'phro/ /rdo rje'i sprin rnams kun tu 'khrug /khros shing khro bcas gnag pa dang / /mche ba rnon po rab tu bsgom/ /mi bskyod dam tshig dbu rgyan la/ /bsgoms na khro bo 'dzin 81—508

mnyes 'gyur/ /'di ni khro bo thams cad kyi/ /'da' bar dka' ba'i dam tshig go/ /mi 'chi ba'i dam tshig 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ni/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje'i dbus su bsam/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms la/ /ṭak+ki rgyal po rab tu bsgom/ /khro bo 'jigs pa'i cha lugs gtum/ /'jigs pa dag kyang 'jigs par byed/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /rdo rje 'od bzang bsgom par bya /mi bskyod dam tshig dbu rgyan la/ /bsgoms na rab tu mnyes par 'gyur/ /'di ni khro bo thams cad kyi/ /'da' bar dka' ba'i dam tshig go/ /bsam gtan rdo rje rdzogs par byang chub pa dga' ba zhes bya ba'i ting 1'dzin to/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ni/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje'i dbus su bsam/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms la/ /stobs po che ni rab tu bsgom/ /'bar ba'i 'od zer mang po 'phro/ /rdo rje gsum gyi gnas dkyil 'khor/ /khros shing khros pa zhags pa 'dzin/ /rdo rje stobs chen bsgom par bya/ /mi bskyod dam tshig dbu rgyan la/ /bsgoms na rab tu mnyes par 'gyur/ /'di ni khro bo thams cad kyi/ /'da' bar dka' ba'i dam tshig go/ /rdo rje gsum gyi stobs zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ni/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje'i dbus su bsam/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms la/ /rdo rje sngon po rnam par bsgom/ /khro bo 'jigs pa'i cha lugs can/ /'jigs pa dag kyang 'jigs par byed/ /gzugs ni rab tu gnag la rno/ /rgya mtsho nag po skyed par byed/ /'bar ba'i 'od zer mang po 'phro/ /rdo rje'i dbyig thogs bsgom par bya/ /mi bskyod dam tshig dbu rgyan la/ /bsgoms na rab tu mnyes 81—509

par 'gyur/ /'di ni khro bo thams cad kyi/ /'da' bar dka' ba'i dam tshig gol/ /rdo rje dbyig pa'i dam tshig mchog dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin tol/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ni/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje'i dbus su bsam/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms la/ /mi g.yo mchog ni rnam par bsgom/ /khros shing 'jigs pa'i zur gyis lta/ /'khrugs pa ral gri zhags pa bsnams/ /'bar ba'i 'od zer mang po 'phro/ /mi g.yo rdo rje can du bsgom/ /mi bskyod dam tshig dbu rgyan la/ /bsgoms na rab tu mnyes par 'gyur/ /'di ni khro bo thams cad kyi/ /'da' bar dka' ba'i dam tshig go/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dbyings kyi dam tshig zhabs kyis gnon pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ni/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje'i dbus su bsam/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms la/ /rig pa'i 'khor lo rab tu bsgom/ /mtshan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /'khor lo 'bar bas yongs su bskor/ /gtsug tor 'khor lo sgyur dam tshig /rnam par 'phro ba rab tu bsgom/ /mi bskyod dam tshig dbu rgyan la/ /bsgoms na rab tu mnyes par 'gyur/ /'di ni khro bo thams cad kyi/ /'da' bar dka' ba'i dam tshig go/ /gtsug tor gyi dam tshig rig pa'i stobs 'khor lo zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ni/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje'i dbus su bsam/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bsgoms la/ /rdo rje sum+bha rab tu bsgom/ /me lce rnon po 'bar ba'i sku/ /rdo rje'i sprin ni rab tu 'phro/ /phyag na rdo rje rab 'bar ba/ /bsgoms na dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /mi bskyod dam tshig dbu rgyan la/ /bsgoms na rab tu mnyes par 'gyur/ /'di ni khro bo thams cad kyi/ /'da' 81—510

bar dka' ba'i dam tshig go/ /rdo rje'i dam tshig sum+bha rab tu 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /'gog 17pa khro bo'i 'khor lo ni/ /sangs rgyas 'khor lo bsten pa yis/ /ting 'dzin rdo rje ye shes rnams/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor grub par 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang ske/ thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa las/ /rdo rje dam tshig bkod pa de kho na nyid kyi don bsgom pa mngon par byang chub pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o/ / //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig gi bdag po/ rdo rje 'dzin pa na chen po zhi ba'i dam tshig gi mchog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi btsun mo'i mchog 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las byung ngo / /oṃ ru ru sbu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dha (5)lotsa ne sarba at+pa sā dha ni swā hā/ de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /'byor pa kun la dgyes pa rnams/ /mnyes shing rab tu dgyes gyur nas/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje rjes su dran/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi zhi 'byung ba/ /las rnams thams cad rab sgrub cing / /rdo rje'i dam tshig bskul mdzad ma/ /shi ba sos par byed par gsungs/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das sku gsum gyi dam tshig rdo rje khro bo/ dngos po dang / dngos po med pa'i dam tshig rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ rdo rje 'dzin thams cad kyi btsun mo'i mchog 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las byung ngo / /oṃ shaṃ kā re shīn+ta ka re/ /lhus lhus lhuṭi ni bhā ta ya ni ghā ta ya 81—511

lhuṭi ni swā hā/ de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /sku gsum dbyer med rdo rje can / /mnyes pa'i spyan ni gdangs nas su/ /rdo rje'i thugs ni rjes su dran/ /rdo rje srung ba'i sbyor ba yi/ /las rnams rtag tu rab sgrub pa/ /rdo rje chen po 'jigs nyen la/ /rtag tu stobs ni byed par bshad/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'dod chags chen po'i dam tshig la gzigs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ chos kyi sku'i btsun mo'i mchog 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang ske/ gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /oṃ ka ṭi bi ka ṭi 1)ni ka ṭi ka ṭaṃ ka ṭi swā hā/ de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /rdo rje chos mchog 'dzin pa rnams/ /mnyes nas bsam gtan thob gyur nas/ /rdo rje'i chos ni rjes su dran / /rtag tu chos rgyas stobs mdzad pa/ /rtag tu mdzod po che dang ldan/ /rdo rje gsung gi bka' bzhin du/ /bzlas pa tsam gyis byed par 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dam tshig kun nas 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ dam tshig sems dpa'i btsun mo'i mchog 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re swā hā/ de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag che las skyes / /mnyes shing ye shes thob gyur nas/ /rdo rje'i sku ni rjes su dran/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje sde chen dang / /sems can khams na ma lus pa/ /skad cig gis ni bran bzhin du/ /thams cad g.yo med dbang du byed/ /ces bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa/ dri ma med pa'i 'od zer gyi sprin rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 81—512

zhugs nas/ rdo rje gshin rje'i gshed po chen po rdo rje khro bo 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang ske/ gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /na maḥs man+ta kā ya waka 1tsit+ta badzā (2ritsā/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba duṣ+ṭa satwa da ma ka /a si mu sa la pa ra shu/ pā sha hasta/ tsa tur bhu dza/ tsa tur mu kha/ gargya ra ṇa/ ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha/ sab duṣ+ṭa pra ṇa a pa hā ri ṇi/ mahā bisna ghā ta ka /bi kṛ tā na na/sarba bhū ta/ bha yaṃ ka ra/ asto sta hā sa nā de ni/ byā gh+ra tsam ni ba sa na/ ku ru ku ru sarba kusmyu ṇi/ tshin+da tshin+da sarba man tān/ rnyirta snyirnya pa ra mu dā na/yak+ṣa ya.u kuṇ+ḍa ya sarba bhū tā ni/ ma tha ma tha/ nirma ril/tha nirma tha sab dugle na/pra be sha ya pra be sha ya mas la ma d+me/ bai ba swa ta/ ṭī bi tān+ta ka ra ma ma sarba kuju ku ru ku ru/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ mā bi lo ba mā bi lo ba sa ma ya ma nu sma ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ bi sbo ṭa ya bi sbo ṭa ya/ sab shā pa ri pū ra ka sasban nā shā ya ri pun/ ka ra ka ra he he bha ga ban/ 16 rā ya si/ ma ma sarba aṅgā na/ sa dha ya swā hā/ de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /sangs rgyas grags pa chen po kun/ /'jigs shing kun tu skrag gyur nas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rjes su dran/ /thod pa ma chags ma gas par/ /gzugs mdzes yid 'ong rnyed pa la/ /rkang pas mnan pa'i tshul byas nas/ /sngags 'di rjes su dran par bya/ /mā ma ki 'am spyan yang rung / /rdo rje'i rigs chen las byung ba/ /lan gsum dag tu brjod na ni/ /de ma thag tu nges par 'gugs/ /bcom ldan 'das thugs rdo rjes de skad ces gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad/ dam tshig gi 'od zer stug po'i mchog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ khro bo mi 'chi ba'i 81—513

dam tshig 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /na maḥs man+ta kā 17ya wāka tsit+ta badzā tsā/ na mo badz+ra kro dhā ya/ mahā rdatho ta ka ṭa r+bha ra bā ya/ a si mu sa la pa ra shu pā sha hastu ya/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ brnya brnya/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ gardza gardza/bi sbo ṭa ya bi sbo ṭa ya/ sarba bisnan/ bi nā ya kān/ mahā ga ṇa pa ti ṭī bi tān+ta ka rā ya swā hā/ de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /sangs rgyas grags pa chen po kun/ /brgyal zhing rab tu 'jigs gyur nas/ /rdo rje'i sku ni rjes su dran / /sngags rnams kun gyis sbyor ba dang / /rdo rjes bskrad pa'i las rnams la / /sangs rgyas nyid kyi dpung dag kyang / /tshul bzhin byas na skyod par 'gyur / /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen tog /sangs rgyas kyi 'od zer rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/rdo rje khro bo gzhan gyis mi thub pa 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang /thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /na maḥs man+ta kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badzā tsā/ oṃ hūṃ ṭī na ri nyis hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /sangs rgyas bdag nyid che skyes kun/ /'jigs shing kun tu skrag gyur te/ /byang chub sems ni rjes su dran/ /srin po ma rungs gtum po dang / /'jigs pa chen po 'khrugs pa dang / /rdo rje sems kyis rab sbyor na/ /las rnams cho ga bzhin du byed / /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag tu med pa/dpag tu med pa rdo rje 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyom/sa par zhugs nas / pad+mo 'byung ba rdo rje khro bo chen po 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang /thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /na maḥs man+ta kā ya wā (2)ka tsit+ta badzā tsā/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ 81—514

rgyu / ta ru la/ bi ru la/ sarba bi ṣa ghā ta ka /dz+wa li ta bi sgru lo 1ga /astob hā sa/ ke sa ri sa ṭa a ṭo pa/ ṭaṃ kā ra/ badz+ra khu ra nir bhā ta na tsa li ta ba su dhā ta la/ ni shā sa mā ru to ta k+ṣi ba ta dhā ra tsā dha ra/ ṭī ṣa ṇa asgyus hā sa/ a pa ri mi ta ba la pa rā kra ma/ ār+ya ga ṇa/ ṭī ta bhū nata ga ṇa/ dhu ṣi ta/ bu dh+ya bu dha/ ha ya shrī ba/ khā da khā da/ pa ra man+ta na/ tshin+da tshin+da/ birnya bid+dha ri/ pa ra mu drwa na/ sidhi ma me di sha /a be sha ya/ sarba dz+wa ra pi shā tsā drin/ sarba gra he ṣā a pra ti ha to bha ba/ badz+ra rda ṣ+ṭa kurdzi ra yis/ i rda duṣ+ṭa gra haṃ duṣ+ṭa sarbe bā/ dhu na dhu na/ ma tha ma tha/ ma ra da ma ra da/ pā ṭa ya pā ṭa ya/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ brta brta/ bud+dha dharmā saṃ gha a nu dz+nyā tai kurma ku ru/ shrī sgri ra/ha ya shrī bā ya phaṭa/ badzā ya phaṭa/ badzā gā tā ya phaṭa/ badz+ra ne tā ya phaṭarka/ badz+ra dehā ya phaṭa/ badz+ra khya rā ya phaṭa/ badz+ra khu ra nir bhā ta na ya phaṭa/tre+e lo kya bha yaṃ ka rā ya phaṭa/ sarba kurmi 6 a pra ti ha tā ya phaṭa/ badz+ra ku la san tā sa nā ya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis//chos kyi rdo rje che mchog skyes/ /'jigs shing rab tu brgyal bar 'gyur/ /ye shes rgyal po rjes su dran/ /mkha' dbyings dug gis yongs gang ba/ /rdo rje ha la ha la'i 'od/ /khro bo'i rgyal po bskul ba yis/ /dug rnams thams cad med par byed/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa gdon mi za bar grub pa gdon mi za ba'i dam tshig 'byung ba dpal rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ rdo rje be con sngon po bro bo'i rgyal po 'di/nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /na maḥs man+ta kā ya wā 5)ka tsista badzā tsā/ oṃ e h+ye hi/ bha ga bān 'gri la badz+ra daṇ+ḍa/ tu ru tu ru/81—515

hu lu hu lu/ hā hā/ gu lu gu lu/ gu ta/ pa ya gu lā pa ya/ kra ma kra ma/ bha ga bān/ bā yu be ge na/ bhū tān shrī sgri/ da ha da ha/ da ra da ra/ ba ha ba ha / pa tsa pa tsa/ ma tha ma tha/ pā ta ya pā ta ya/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ mo ṭā pa ya mo ṭā pa ya/ sarba kurmā ṇi/ tshin+da tshin+da/ bhak+ṣa ya bhak+ṣa ya/ asgri 1me da ma nasu ru dhi ra madz+dza 5me da/ ba sha 54)madz+dza ru dhi ra/ pri ya e h+ye hi bha ga bān zhe/sarba bisna ni/ sarba bit+yā ni/ sarba man+t+ra ni/ sarba mū la kurmā ṇi/ kri tsho tri ma ṇi ṣa dī ni/ sarba gra hā na/ ha na ha na/ bhañja bhañja/ ma ra da ma ra da/ i dam kār+ya sā dha ya/ hūṃ nī lā ya/ nī lā badz+ra daṇ+ḍa ya/ tu ru tu ru/ bisnan bi nā ya ka nā sha ya nā sha ya/ hu ru hu ru/ dīp+ta tsaṇ+ḍa ya/ sarba sha lja ṇ+ḍaṃ trī (7)da ya ni pi ḍā yā/ tshin+da tshin+da pa ra bibyā ṭ+wāṃ ts+tsha da ke/ hūṃ bibyā ṭ+wāṃ shiṣ+ṭa ka /sa ma ya nu sma ra/ badz+ra dha ra ba tsā ṭ+wāṃ tsa/ marmā ṇi ni krin+ta hūṃ/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha / pa tsa pa tsanano/ ku ru ku ru/ tu ru tu ru/ hu ru hu ru/ phaṭa phaṭa/hūṃ hūṃ kri 9tan+ta ya/ de ba ri ṣi bi dru pa kā ya/ /ha na ha na/ badz+ra daṇ+ḍi na swā hā/de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /gdug pa'i mchog las byung ba kun/ /yid ni 'jigs shing rab skrag nas/ /sems dpa'i rdo rje rjes su dran/ /khro bo'i rgyal po grags chen 'di/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas pa dang / /cho ga'i tshul bzhin bskul ba yis/ /gdug pa thams cad gsod par 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod pas/ kun nas sprin dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ rdo rje stobs po che 'di nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /na maḥs man+ta kā 7 ya wā ka tsit+ta badzā tsā/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ u gra shu la pā ṇi/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/81—516

phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ byo ti ni ra nā da/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ mahā ba la 1)ya swā hā/ de nas 'di ni gsungs ma thag /stobs po che yis klu rnams kun / /yid ni 'jigs shing rab skrag nas/ /sku gsum rdo rje rjes su dran/ /bzlas pa tsam gyi sbyor ba yis/ /las rnams thams cad sgrub par byed/ /than pa byung ba'i dus na yang / /chu yi dkyil 'khor 'bebs par byed/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kun tu 'joms pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ḍak+ki'i 2rgyal po khro bo chen po 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / na maḥs man+ta kā ya wā ka tsi t+ta badzā ṇ+ḍaṃ/ ḍak+ki hūṃ dzaḥde nas 'di ni gsungs tsam dgyis//sangs rgyas bdag nyid chen po kun/ /'jigs shing dam tshig ldan gyur nas/ /rdo rje sku gsum rjes su dran/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sbyor ba yis/ /ling ga rkang pa g.yas pas mnan/ /rdo rje gsum gyi sngags dag gis/ /sngags rnams thams cad 'gugs pa'i mchog /de nas bcom ldan 'das ye shes kyi phreng ba'i chu'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ mi g.yo ba'i rdo rje gtum po'i dam tshig 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /na maḥs man+ta kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badzā ṇ+ḍaṃ/ a tsa la kā ṇa tsaṇ+ḍa/nas nas/ mas mas/ mos mos/ shas shas/ tas tas/ ha na ha na/da ha da ha/ mo ha mo ha/ mo ho ka ra/ ha sa ha sa/ badz+ra ha 94sa ku ru/ ha sa ha sa/ marda ra ṭa marda ra ṭa/ gardza gardza/ ha na ha na/ brnya brnyan/tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ā bi sha ā bi sha /mahā man+t+ra/ bā la ka /dhu na dhu na/ ti ṇi ti ṇi / khā da khā da/ bisnan mā ra ya mā ra ya/ du// bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa/ saṅgā ku ru ku 81—517

ru / ki ri ki ri/ mahā biṣa ṇa badz+ra/ sbo ṭa ya sbo ṭa ya/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ tri ba lī ta raṃ/ ga na rta ka /s+t+waṃ ā+o s+t+waṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ a tsa la tse ṭa/ sbo ṭa ya sbo ṭa ya/hūṃ hūṃ/ a sa marnyi ka tā ṭa/ mahā ba la shā ta ya/ sa ma ya ni/ gha ta ya//1)pa ra sa mar+sān kyi/ s+t+waṃ māṃ/ tsā tsā māṃ shud dha 0tu lo ka /tu ṣ+yo (4༄tu badz+re/ na mo stu ā pra ti ha ta ba le bh+yo/5kyi/ dzā la ya/ ta (6)( a sa ha na nam swā hā/ de nas 'di ni gsung (7)tsam gyis/ /lha rnams 'khor du bcas pa kun/ /brgyal zhing yid ni rab skrag nas/ /rdo rje'i sku ni rjes su dran/ /khro bo chen po'i sngags 'di yis/ /lha chen dag la sogs pa'i lha/ /mthu chen dag kyang skrag gyur nas/ /kha sbyar lus su 'gugs par 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dam tshig rnam par 'phrul pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/rdo rje 'dzin thams cad kyi dam tshig khro bo gnod mdzes 'di/ /nyid kyi sku dang /gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ/ groṇ+ḍa groṇ+ḍi hūṃ/groṇ+ḍa 8pa ya groṇ+ḍa pa ya hūṃ/ ā na yo bha ga waṃ 94bi r+ya rā dza hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /bu mo mthu chen thams cad ni/ /skra bshig gos dang bral gyur nas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rjes su dran/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 7zhabs kyis mnan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun bdag po'o11/ /rdo rje lcags kyu zhags pa yis/ /bu mo rnams ni 'gugs pa'i mchog /de nas bcom ldan 'das dam tshig chen po'i de kho na nyid 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ dam tshig chen po'i rdo rje gsum gyi gsang ba gsung gi dam tshig gi de kho na nyid kyi gnas 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /sangs rgyas rdo rje sku gsum la/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rnam 81—518

par bsgom/ /zhags pa rdo rje kyo ba 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas dgug pa dam pa'o/ /sangs rgyas sku gsung sbyor ba yi/ /'khor lo chen po'i sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /rtag tu nges par khugs par 'gyur/ /mi phyed rdo rje gsum bsgoms pas/ /'khor lo pad+mo rdo rje che/ /rdo rje kyo ba'i khyad par gyis/ /sngags rnams thams cad dgugs pa'i mchog /thams cad rdo rje'i dngos zhi ba/ /rang sngags skyes bu bsgoms nas ni/ /mi yi bu mo mchog rnams kyi/ /snying gar 17rdo rje kyo ba sbyor/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor sbyor ba yis/ /nges par rtag tu 'gugs par 'gyur/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dag la ni/ /rnam par snang mdzad gzugs chen bsgom/ /de na sha ci gnas par bsam/ /rdo rje mi 'chi'i rdo sbyor ba yis/ /lan grangs lnga bcu brjod na ni/ /nges par rtag tu 'gugs par 'gyur / /rdo rje kyo ba gzugs chen po/ /'bar ba rdo rje 'dra ba'i 'od/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor bsgoms na ni/ /nam mkha'i bu mo 'gugs pa'i mchog /khro bo rdo rje dam tshig ni/ /rdo rje sa 'og gnas pa dag /shu la rdo rje kyo ba'i gnas/ /lha min bu mo 'gugs pa'i gnas/ /btsag gam rdo rgyus dag kyang rung / /rdo rje kyo ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /zla ba gzas ni zin pa'i tshe/ /khar bcug nas ni bsgrub par bya/ /tshangs pa drag po la sogs lha/ /rang gi ming rnams bris nas ni/ /rdo rje gsung gi bka' bzhin du/ /'jigs shing skrag nas 'ong bar 'gyur/ /rnam pa'i mchog rnams kun ldan pa/ /rdo rje 'jam pa rab tu bsgom/ /khro bo chen po gshin rje gshed/ /rdo rje kyo ba rnam par bsam/ /bskal pa'i sreg pa'i 'khor lo che/ /bsgoms nas gnod sbyin mo dag spyad/ /kun gyi phyag rgya'i khyad par dang / / bosngags kyi dbye bas thams cad du/ /dgug pa'i rab tu sbyor ba 81—519

gsungs / /gzhan du byas na 'jig par 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che / /yang dang yang du bskul bar bya/ /de nyid sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /rgyal po mchog tu rtag pa 'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das nam mkha' kun du rnam par 'phrul pa'i ye shes rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/rdo rje ral pa gcig pa dam tshig chen po'i gsung rdo rje'i mchog 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /oṃ bu le ni swā hā/ de nas 'di ni gsung tsam gyis/ /klu yi bu mo mthu chen rnams/ /tshig par gyur cing gos dang bral/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rjes su dran/ /sngags kyi rig pa 'di yis ni/ /klu rnams thams cad 'gugs par 'gyur/ /klu yi bu mo mig bzangs dag /bkug nas nye bar spyad par bya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das nam mkha'i dam tshig 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ chos chen po'i dam tshig rdo rje khro gnyer can 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /oṃ sarba bha ya/ nā sha ni tā sa ni tā si/ tā sa ya tā sa ya/ bi ra ṭa bh+ri ku ṭī ta ṭi/bai ra ṭi be+e ra ṭi/ shwe te shwe te/ dza ḍi ni swā hā/ de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis / /rig 'dzin bdag nyid skyes ma kun/ /'dar zhing 'jigs par gyur pas ni/ /ye shes rdo rje rjes su dran/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i bu mo mchog /gser gyi rna cha g.yo ba rnams/ /sngags kyi rig pa 'di dang ni/ /dam tshig mchog gis dgug par bya/ /'gog pa rdo rje rgyal po ni/ /yongs su rdzogs pas mdzes mchog gis/ /ye shes rdo rje gsum las byung / /kun nas de ma thag tu 'gugasal/ /yang na khro bo thams cad ni/ /dben pa'i gnas dang chen po ru/ /sngags pas 'bum du bzlas pa yis/ /lam rnams thams cad phyed par bshad/ /81—520

rdo rje slob dpon smod pa gzhan/ /theg pa che mchog smod pa dag /rab tu 'bad pas gsad par bya/ /yang na gnas nas spo bar bya/ /'di yis byang chub mchog gi ni/ /sngags kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen pos gsungs so/ /yang gsungase pa/ phyogs bcu'i sems can thams cad kyi/ /lus dang ngag sems gsod pa ni/ /cho ga bzhin du bsgom byas la/ /gdug sems can gyi dgra rnams ni/ /khrag dang chu yis gsher ba'am/ /gshang gcis gsher bar byas pa'i gos/ /bgos nas liṅga rkang pas mnan/ /khro bo'i rgyal po sbyar bar bya/ /brgya rtsa brgyad ni yongs bzlas na/ /sangs rgyas kyang ni nges par 'jig /yang gsungs pa/ chu yis gos ni gsher bar byas/ /khro bo mchog gi bcings pa yis/ /liṅga rkang pas mnan na ni/ /sangs rgyas dag kyang nges par 'jig /bshang gcis gsher bar byas pa'i gos/ /ngan pa rul pa'i dri mnam pa/ /bgos te sngags ni bzlas byas na/ /skad cig gis skams 'chi bar 'gyur/ /thal ba'i skyo mas gsher ba'i gos/ /bgos nas phro bas 'khrugs bzhin du/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas na ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa'ang 'jig par 'gyur/ /73yang gsungs pa/gcer bur phud de skra bshig la/ /'jigs pa'i tshul du gtsigs shing 'gyur/ /rkang pas liṅga mnan na ni/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyang 'jig par 'gyur/ /ma mo'i gnas sam dur khrod dam/ /khang stong dang ni bzhi mdo dang / /mtshan gcig dang ni shing gcig drung / /mngon par spyod pa brtsam par bya/ /mi rus las byas phur bu ni/ /sor brgyad pa yi tshad dag la/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas byas te/ /dgra bo'i sgo khar sbas na ni/ /sangs rgyas sku gsum mchog sbyin pa/ /81—521

shes dang mi shes rnam spangs pa/ /zla ba phyed ni tshun chad kyis/ /bskams sam yang na 'chi bar 'gyur/ /yang na thod pa gang ba dag /khyad par du ni mkhas pas btsal/ /der ni sngags kyi tshig bris te/ /rdo rje'i tshig gis bzlas par 0skubya / /dgra yi sgo 'am grong dag tu/ /sbas na nges par skyod par 'gyur/ /ta la'i lo ma'am gzhan la'ang rung / /khro bo'i sngags ni kun bris la/ /dgra yi grong ngam sgo dag tu/ /sbas na 'chi 'am bskams par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das dam tshig chen po'i dpal rdo rjes de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang /thugs nges par 'ching ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas / rdo rje khams gsum pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs gnon pa zhes bya ba'i sngags 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /oṃ gha gha/ bhā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭan phaṭa phaṭa/ tī la ya tī la ya/ sarba pā paṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ badz+ra tī la ya/ badz+ra dha ra ā dz+nyā pa ya ti/ kā ya wā ka tsi t+ta badz+ra tī la snoya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ de nas 'di ni gsungs ma thag /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul chen po kun/ /brgyal zhing rab tu 'jigs gyur nas/ /nam mkha' rdo rje thugs dran 'gyur/ /mi rus las byas phur bu 'am/ /yang na seng ldeng rtse las skyes/ /lcags las byas pa'i phur bu dag /rdo rje sku gsum 'jig par byed/ /'od 'phro 'khrug cing mdangs bzang ba'i / /rdo rje sems dpar mnyam gzhag khel/ /rdo rje sku ni gsum gyi mthar/ /gzugs brnyan bsams nas sbyar bar bya/ /rnam par snang mdzad rgya chen nam/ /yang na 'dod chags rdo rje can/ /gshin rje gshed kyi rgya chen dag /bsams 81—522

na rdo rje gsum yang gnon/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yis/ /gdug cing khro ba tshar bcad la/ /sangs rgyas bdag nyid chen po yang / /rdo rje'i sbyor bas bya ba yin / /snying ga ri1)nas ni rkang pa'i mthar/ /rdo rje phur bu rnam par bsgom/ /gong du'ang dam tshig de nyid bya/ /'di ni phur bu'i rnam 'phrul yin/ /bsam gtan rdo rje'i sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas dag kyang nges par 'bebs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /phur bus btab na myur du 'chi/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po'i 2sku rnam par 'phrul pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ sku'i dam tshig tsham ngam gyis gnon pa zhes bya ba'i sngags 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /oṃ badz+ra tshin+da tshin+da/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ dip+ta badz+ra tsakra hūṃ phaṭa / phan tshun dkri ba'i tshul du bya/ /mthe bong bzhi ni rab tu bsdam/ /rnam par snang mdzad tshul gnas te/ /rdo rje phur bus nges par gdab/ /btab ma thag tu sems dpa' che/ /rdo rje sku gsum las byung ba/ /dam tshig mchog gis ldang bar 'gyur/ /yang na 'chi ba'i gnas su 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug gsung rnam par 'phrul ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ gsung gi dam tshig tsham ngam gnod pa rdo rje'i sngags 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /oṃ hri bhur bhu ba/ ye shes pad+mo kha bye ba/ /rdo rje sor mo nges par bzhag /'dod tsho )chags rdo rje'i tshul gnas te/ /rdo rje'i phur bus nges par 'debs/ /btab ma thag tu rdo rje che/ /sku gsum dri med las byung ba/ /btab pa tsam gyis ldang bar 'gyur/ /yang na 'chi ba'i gnas su 'gyur/ /de 81—523

nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin chen po/ thugs rnam par 'phrul pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ thugs kyi dam tshig tsham ngam gyis gnon pa'i sngags 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /oṃ badz+ra rā dza hūṃ/ rtse mo lnga par bcings nas ni/ /'od 'phro mang po 'khrigs par bsgom/ /rdo rje thugs kyi tshul gnas te/ /rdo rje phur bus nges par gdab/ /btab pa tsam gyis rdo rje che/ /rdo rje dri med gsum las byung ske/ /btab ma thag tu ldang bar 'gyur/ /yang na 'chi ba'i gnas su 'gyur//sku gsung thugs kyi sbyor ba yis/ /cho ga legs par byas nas ni/ /mkha' dbyings rdo rje mthas klas par/ /phur bus 'debs par gdon mi za/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje phur bu chen pos de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas sangs rgyas sku gsum mchog /sems can khams la phan mdzad pa/ /mnyes shing rab tu dgyes gyur nas/ /gsung ni 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /e ma'o gsang ba'i gnas kyi mchog /e ma'o snying po kun bsdus pa/ /e ma'o chos kyi gnas zhi ba//e ma'o rdo rje rnam par 'joms/ /phur 'debs sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa' grags chen te/ /sku gsum thugs kyi rdo rje rnams/ /phur bus gdab pa yang dag bshad51/ /'di ni sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /phur gdab de nyid las byung ba/ /sku gsung thugs ni mchog sbyin pa'i/ /sngags kyi de nyid don bsdus pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang /gsung dang / thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa las/ sku dang / gsung dang ske/ thugs rmad du byung ba'i sngags kyis 'gugs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i rgyal po zhes bye ba'i le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //81—524

thams cad dbang bskur kun mkhyen pas/ /rdo rje'i gsung ni bka' stsal pa/ /smre sha can gyi bdag nyid che/ /bu mo lo grangs bcu gnyis pa/ /dben pa'i gnas su khyad par du/ /sgrub pa pos ni rtag tu sgrub/ /bshang 1tshogaci dam tshig la sogs pa/ /de ru cho ga bzhin du ni/ /dkyil 'khor gru bzhi lham par bya/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa yis/ /mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su dag /rab tu bzang la bzhin yang mdzes/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs rdzogs pa/ /pang par bzhag nas rnam par bsgom/ /dkyil 'khor lnga yi 'khor lo yis/ /sangs rgyas rnams su rnam par bsgom/ /sngags kyi 'khor lo can gyi gsang / /mchod pa'i gnas ni nyams dga' bsgom/ /sku gsung thugs ni rdo rje can/ /rnam par snang mdzad sku chen po/ /bsam gtan sngags kyi sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni 'od 'drar 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sbyor ba yis btso blag (gemakhan ni bdag nyid che/ /bu mo ut+pal mthing ga'i rimadog /'dra ba dag ni rtag tu sgrub/ /sbyor ba'i cho ga de nyid ni/ /byas nas las rnams brtsam par bya/ /'di ni sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /dam tshig shin tu 'da' dka' ba'o/ /de ni de ma thag tu yang / /rdo rje sems dpa'i 'od 'drar 'gyur / /rgyal po chos rnams kun dang mtshungs/ /'dod dang thar pa rab sgrub pa / /rdo rje chos ni rnam bsgoms pas/ /gar mkhan bu mo rab mdzes shing / /bzhin bzang mig ni dkyus ring ba/ /sgrub pa pos ni rtag tu sgrub/ /de ni rdo rje chos kyi bdag /sa bcu la ni gnas par 'gyur/ /rgyal po gsung gi dam 81—525

tshig 'dzin/ /mnga' bdag dam pa kun gyi mchog /bram ze rgyal rigs rje'u'i (17rigs / /dmangs rigs las byung bu mo ni/ /rdo rje chos bdag bsgrub par bya/ /'di ni gsang ba thob byed pa'o/ /rdo rje nyi ma nub nas ni/ /sgrub pa kun tu brtsam par bya/ /skya rengs 5'char ba'i dus su ni/ /sgom pa'i mchog gis 'grub par 'gyur/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /spos dang me tog rnams kyis brgyan / /rdo rje sems dpa' mchog bsgoms na/ /grub pa myur du 'thob par 'gyur/ /'di ni sku gsum mchog sbyin pa/ /sangs rgyas mtshan gyis mtshan par gyur/ /dpag tshad brgya yi khyon tsam du/ /de yi 'od kyang snang bar byed/ /dbang po gnyis ni sbyor ba yis/ /sbyor ba thams cad brtsam par bya/ /'di ni dngos grub thams cad kyi/ /dam tshig shin tu 'da' dka' ba'o/ /rdo rje can gyi grub 'dod na/ / bshang gci'i 4)dam tshig bza' bar bya/ /'di ni dngos grub thams cad kyi/ /dam tshig shin tu 'da' dka' ba'o / /bshang rigaci'i dam tshig la sogs pas/ /dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis / /sangs rgyas byang chub gnas zhi ba/ /de nyid bla na med pa 'grub/ /bcom ldan 'das 'dod pa dang / thar pa'i dam tshig rdo rjes de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dam tshig chen po'i rdo rje khro bo zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje kun tu skrag par byed pa'i rdo rje khro bo 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /oṃ trīḥji wi kṛ tā 6)na na/ sarba sha thun nā sha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ dug ni khrag dang kun tu sbyar/ /lan tsha ske tshe yungs mar te/ /khro zhing tsher ma'i me la sreg /bu mo'i ming dang tshig tu bcas//81—526

nyi ma gung ngam nam phyed na/ /'di ni yong ye rab tu shis/ /shes rab can gyi gru gsum du/ /stong rtsa brgyad ni tshul bzhin bsreg(1) /bu mo dag gi don gyi phyir / /'di ni nyi ma gsum du bya/ /bskal pa grangs med gsum du yang / /de yis rtag tu gnon par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas sam ni chos 'dzin pa'am/ /yang na rdo rje sems dpa'ang rung / /gal te rmongs pas 'das na ni/ /de yi tshe ni der zad 'gyur/ /bcu bzhi'am yang na tshes brgyad la/ /dur khrod sol ba blangs nas ni/ /cho ga bzhin du sngags btab na/ /de ni rtag tu ster bar 'gyur / /sngags shes pa yis gang rung ba'i/ /dgra yi gzugs brnyan byas nas su / /bsam gtan dag gis bris na ni/ /'chi bar 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ /tho ba bsam gtan sbyor ba yis/ /phab na nges par lhung bar 'gyur/ /hūṃ ni rab tu 'bar dang bcas/ /rdo rje 'bar ba rab tu bsgom/ /phyag na rdo rje'i rigs dran te/ /gdug pa thams cad 'jig par byed/ /rdo rgyus sol ba la sogs pas/ /skyes pa'am bud med gzugs bris la/ /lag par sta re bsams nas su/ /mid pa bcad par rnam par bsgom/ /sangs rgyas sku gsum rin chen mchog /sems can kun la phan 'dod pa/ /'di yang snad par 'gyur ba'am / /shi bar 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ /las kyi rdo rje rab 'bar ba me stag mang po 'khrigs pa can/ /dbus su rdo rje bsams na ni/ /chu rnams mnan pa'i mchog yin no/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni 'dri ba na/ /rlung la sogs pa byung na ni/ /mche ba'i phyag rgya bcings nas su/ gdug pa'i dgra ni dran par bya/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /gang zhig sprul par gyur pa yang / /mthong ba tsam gyis 'gag 'gyur te/ /gzhan du byas na 'jig par 81—527

'gyur / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /skye bo gdug pa gzhan dag kyang / /sngags 'dis skrag par byas na ni/ /'chi bar 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ /de la 'di ni sngags thams cad kyi gsang ba'i snying po'o/ /phaṭa/ ye shes sems dpa'i sbyor ba yis/ /dbus su gzugs ni bsgom par bya/ /sngags shes pa yis gnas bzhi ru/ /bud med rtag tu gzhag nya)par bya/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /mtshan rnams thams cad kyis mtshan cing / /pad+mo rab tu rgyas byas nas/ /sngags 'di rnam par bsgom par bya/ /hūṃ/ 'od zer lnga ni rab 'bar ba'i/ /rdo rje can gyi sbyor ba bsgom/ /rang lus ngag sems rdo rje la/ /phab na byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /de ni de ma thag tu yang //rnam par snang mdzad 'od 'dra zhing / /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /sangs rgyas sku gsum rdo rje 'dzin/ /sems dpa' thams cad bskyed pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /bzhin bzang phan par 'dod pa yi/ /bud med rnyed na cho ga bzhin/ /dben par mchod pa brtsam par bya/ /gsang ba blangs nas bza' bar bya/ /de ni de ma thag tu yang / /'jam dpal dang ni gzi brjid mnyam / /mi snang bdag po dpal dang ldan/ /dzasbu'i (5)gser gyi mdangs 'drar 'gyur/ /bshang ciba'am yang na bza' ba 'am/ /sha dag kyang ni gzhug par bya/ /cho ga bzhin du bsngags nas ni/ /zos na sangs rgyas kyis mi mthong ske/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen pos de skad ces bka' stsal to / /bshang 94ba cho ga bzhin blangs nas/ /kham phor sbyar mar gzhag 97par bya//brgya rtsa brgyad du bskul na ni/ /sangs rgyas nyi mas mi mthong ngo / /khyi yi sha dang rta sha dang / /sha chen dag ni cho ga bzhin/ /blangs nas sbyor ba'i thabs 81—528

kyis ni/ /zos na de yis mi mthong ngo / /bshang 1dang lhan cig sbyar ba yi/ /ril bu lcags gsum gyis dkris pa/ /dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mi mthong ngo / /khyi yi sha dang sbyar ba yi/ /ril bu lcags gsum gyis dkris pa/ /dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mi mthong ngo / /sha chen dang ni sbyar ba yi/ /ril bu lcags gsum gyis dkris pa/ /dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mi mthong ngo ske/ /ba lang sha dang sbyor ba yi/ /ril bu lcags gsum gyis dkris pa/ /dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mi mthong ngo / /bshang (2rib las byung srog chags las/ /brtul zhugs can gyis ril bu bya/ /dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mi mthong ngo / /ga bur tsan+dan sbyar ba yi/ /ril bu lcags gsum gyis dkris pa/ /dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba yi / /sangs rgyas kun gyis mi mthong ngo / /gi waṃ a ga ru sbyar ba'i/ /ril bu lcags gsum gyis dkris pa/ /dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje stobs po cher 'gyur ro/ /ga bur gur kum sbyar ba yi/ /ril bu lcags gsum gyis dkris pa/ /dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mi mthong ngo ske/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa gang yang rung / /phyag rgya chen por byin brlabs po rinas/ /da ni de 'dra'i dpal ldan pa'i/ /stobs chen pha rol gnon par 'gyur/ /dpag tshad bye ba rdzogs pa yi/ /steng du rdo rje 'dra bar 'gyur/ /stong gsum bgrod pa'i dpal ldan pa/ /sangs rgyas 'od dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /'dod khams gnas pa'i bu mo dang / /lha yi longs spyod rigs brtul zhugs/ /yang na gzugs khams gnas pa la/ /stobs chen gyis ni 'dod pa spyad/ /bcom 81—529

ldan 'das dam tshig mi snang ba'i rdo rje chen pos de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas sangs rgyas rab dgyes bdag /sems 'khrul yid la dbang ba rnams/ /ngo mtshar gyur cing spyan gdangs nas/ /gsung ni 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /e ma'o 'di rab ngo mtshar che/ /e ma'o gsang gnas mi 'gyur ba/ /e ma'o ngo bo nyid kyis dag /e ma'o shin tu dri med chos/ /de nas ston pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /skyed pa byed pa mi 'gyur che/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje chos chen pos/ /rdo rje'i gsung du bka' stsal pa/ /sems dpa' rdo rje'i sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje 'dzin rnams mnyes par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab dbye ba/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje can mnyes 'gyur/ /rdo rje can gyi gzugs la sogs/ /gtsug tor 'jog par byed par bshad/ /khro bo'i nang na de mchog ste/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje rab bsgom pa'ol/ /rig pa'i rgyal mo chos mchog rnams/ /dkon mchog dpal ni rnam par bsgom / /rig pa'i rgyal mo sbyor ba la/ /tshe dpag med pa rab tu bsgom/ /thams cad las byed sngags rnams la/ /gdon mi za ba'i ye shes bsgom/ /sngags rnams thams cad nyid la ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rnam par bsgom/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnod sbyin mo yi sngags rgyud la/ /gshin rje gshed ni brtag par bya/ /sngags rnams thams cad nyid la ni/ /spyi bo nas ni bskul ba shis / /bcom ldan 'das dam tshig chen pos de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /bsam gtan 'khor lo de yis ni/ /sngags mnyes pa yi dkyil 'khor dag /dam tshig chen po sgrub byed pa/ /sgrub pa po la phan par gsung / /de nas ston pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /gtso bo chos rnams kun dbang phyug /sku dang gsung thugs yongs dag pas/ /ye shes rdo rje bka' stsal to/ /ri rtse nyams ni dga' ba 81—530

dang ske/ /nags tshal rab tu dben par ni/ /bsam gtan rdo rje rab bya ba/ /bzlas dang sngags kyi sbyor bas so/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs kun/ /sngags kyi bsam gtan gyis bskul bas/ /gsung gi las kyi bka' bzhin du/ /las rnams sna tshogs byed par 'gyur/ /rdo rje chos kyi gzugs chen po/ /pad+ma rā ga'i 'od 'dra ba/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje la/ /gnas gsum du ni rigs brtag go/ /dbab pa'i cho ga thams cad ni/ /byas na gdon mi za bar 'grub//bskul dang rengs dang lha chen po/ /'phags lam bzhi po dag kyang ni/ /rdo rje grub pa dag gis bya/ /de ltar byas na rtag par 'grub/ /bu mo lo grangs bcu gnyis ma'am/ /khye'u lo grangs bcu gnyis pa/ /mtshan nyid thams cad yongs rdzogs pa/ /bzung (7nas dbab pa rab tu brtag /cho ga thams cad byas nas ni / /las rnams rab tu bsgrub par bya/ /rnam pa gzhan du byas na ni/ /khams gsum skye bos dpyas par 'gyur/ /de la snying po'i sngags kyi yi ge'i tshig 'di rnams so/ /hūṃ haḥ.āḥdzhaiḥ2nam mkha'i khams ni sems med cing / /rtog pa thams cad rnam spangs dang / /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag nyid kyang / /cho ga bzhin du byas na 'bab/ /hūṃ ni rdo rje sems dpa'i bdag /haḥni sku yi rdo rje can / /āḥni chos 'dzin rgyal po ste/ /'di ni gsang tshig bstan pa 'o/ /lhaḥni bskul bar byed par bshad/ /'gul ba dang ni g.yo ba yin/ /'di ni bskul pa thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba yin par 'di rab bshad/ /khru gang tsam mam khru do 'am/ /khru brgyad tsam mam lnga tsam du/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab bskul na/ /'jigs shing skrag tsho nas 'phar bar 'gyur/ /snga ma bzhin du thams cad 'gyur/ /'di ni gsang ba thob pa 'o/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 81—531

'dzin / /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi bdag /sku gsum gnas ni yongs dag pasal/ /gsung ni 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /rtse gcig ma gyur pa yis kyang / /brtul zhugs brtan pas 'di dag bya/ /sbyor ba gzhan min pas bya ba/ /gdug pa thams cad rnam gzhig pa'o/ /dur khrod sol dang phub sogs las/ /dgra yi gzugs brnyan byas nas ni/ /skra bshig gcer bur byung nas ni/ /khams gsum dag kyang 'jig par byed/ /dur khrod ro bsregs thal ba yis/ /dgra yi gzugs brnyan byas nas ni/ /stong rtsa brgyad du bzlas pas kyang / /'chi bar 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ /dkyil 'khor gru gsum byas pa la /ba lang sha 'am rta yi sha /khyi yi sha 'am sna tshogs kyis/ /rdo rje'ang gdon mi za bar 'jig /sha chen gyis ni thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje las byung 'jig par bshadal/ /'di ni dgra rnams thams cad kyi/ /'jigs pa shin tu mi bzad yin / /dgra yi gzugs brnyan byas nas ni/ /bshang 1)gci dag gi chos mchog can / /tsher ma'i me la khros nas bsregs/ /sangs rgyas dag kyang nges par 'jig /chu bo'i 'gram gnyis sa yis kyang / /dgra yi gzugs brnyan byas nas ni / /til 'bru tsam gyis yan lag kun/ /dug las byung ba'i tsher ma yis/ /bskul ba'i tshig dang bcas pas dgang / /sangs rgyas dag kyang nges par 'jig /ske tshe lan tshwa 'bru mar dang / /dug dang da du ra dag ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bsad pa la/ /'di dag mchog tu gyur par bshad/ /sol khus gsher ba'i gos dag ni/ /gyon te sems ni khros nas su/ /rkang pas ling ga mnan nas ni/ /srin pos khyer bar gdon mi za/ /rus phye khrag dang dug rnams kyis/ /gzugs brnyan rab tu byas na ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' drag po 81—532

yang rka/ /myur ba dag tu 'khyer bar 'gyur/ /ske tshe bshang 1gci sbyar ba yis/ /ling ga yongs su gang bar ni/ /blugs la rkang pas rab mnan na/ /tsha ba chen pos btab par 'gyur/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig chen po'i rdo rje khro bo'i snying po'o/ /na maḥs man+ta kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badzā tsā/oṃ hu lu hu lu/ ཿṣ+ṭha tāṣ+ṭhatshon/ brnya brnya/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ gardza gardza/ bi sbo ṭa ya bi sbo ṭa ya/ sarba bisnan bi nā ya kān/ mahā ga na pa ti dzī bī tān+ta kā rā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ sbyin sreg yang na bsam gtan dag /lus dang ngag sems 'jig pa ste/ /ma yengs pa yi sems kyis bya/ /'di ni gsod 9 ripa'i mchog yin no/ /rdo rje sems dpa' khro bo che/ /rnam par bgrad pa 'jigs 'jigs lta/ /sta re tho ba phyag na bsnams/ /bsams nas bsam gtan rab tu bya/ /de la 'di ni drag po chen po'i khro bo'i dam tshig go/ /mkha' dbyings thams cad sangs rgyas kyis/ /yongs su gang bar rab tu bsgom//gdug pa de yis bsad par ni/ /bsams na de ma thag tu 'chi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /yongs su gang bar bsgoms nas ni/ /gdug pa'i sems pas bsad (na/na ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid kyang 'chi/ /sangs rgyas gnod byed dgra rnams la/ /skrag cing 'jigs pas dkrugs par ni/ /sngags mkhan gyis ni mdun bsams na/ /'chi bar 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ /srin po khro bo sna tshogs pa/ /gtum zhing khro ba mi bzad pas/ /der ni skrag par byas bsams na/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid kyang 'chi/ /'ug pa khu dang bya rgod dang ske/ /mchu ring ba dang wa rnams te/ /de yis zos par bsams na ni/ /sangs rgyas dag kyang nges par 'jig /sbrul nag rab tu khro ba ni/ /'jigs 81—533
