pa dag kyang 'jigs par byed/ /dug gi mchog gi dam tshig ni/ /dpral bar bsams na khyad 'phags pa'i/ /sbrul de zos par bsams na ni/ /sangs rgyas dag kyang nges par 'jig /phyogs bcu'i sems can thams cad la/ /yams sam gnod par byed pa rnams/ /'jigs pa nges par 'bebs pa'i mchog /'di ni bskul ba'i mchog yin no/ /tho ba rab tu drag po yis/ /brtul zhugs can gyis snying gar brdeg1 /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' bzhin du/ /dgra bo'i srog ni med par 'gyur/ /rdo rje sta re la sogs pas/ /gsheg cing gtub par bsams na ni/ /sku gsum gyi ni mchog sbyin pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' drag po'ang 'chi/ /srung ba la sogs sngags rnams dang / /lha rnams kyang ni phur bus gdab/ /'di ni gsod par byed pa'i mchog /dam tshig shin tu 'da' dka' ba'o/ /rdo rje'i phung pos ji tsam du/ /sems can dkyil 'khor gnas pa la/ /gsang bdag nyid gtogs bsams na ni/ /mnyes par 'gyur te gzhan du min/ /ston pa sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje chos dang rdo rje can/ /rdo rje thugs kyi bka' bzhin du/ /bsam gtan sbyor bas 'chi bar 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das khro bo chen po'i dam tshig khro bos de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /thams cad nam mkha' thub chen po/ /thams cad dbang bskur rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /ye shes rdo rjes bka' stsal pa/ /e ma'o ngo bo nyid kyis dag /rdo rje theg pa bla na med/ /ma skyes pa yi chos rnams la / /rgyal ba rnams kyis skye bar bstan/ /de la 'di ni las phran tshegs kyi rdo rje gsang ba'o/ /sbrul ni mi sdug 'jigs byed pa/ /nag po 'bar ba 'khrug cing khro/ /lce gnyis mche ba'i phreng can ni/ /rdo rgyus dag gam sol bas bri/ /81—534

de la 'di ni klu khro bo bskul ba'i snying po'o/ /khaṃ/ mi bzad par ni 'gyur ba'i dug /rdo rje'i dbus na 'dug par bsam/ /dug ni ha la ha la mtshungs/ /sreg pa'i me yi kha dog bzhin/ /bsgoms na 'gul bar gdon mi za/ /de la 'di ni dug thams cad 'byin pa'i snying po'o/ /hrīḥ/ rnam pa sna tshogs las byung dug /khams gsum na ni gnas pa kun/ /de yis khyer bar bsgoms nas ni / /'bab par gyur par rnam par bsam/ /de ni de ma thag tu yang / /mi bzad dug gi rgya mtshor 'gyur/ /reg ma thag tu skye bo kun/ /'jig pa 'di la the tshom med/ /sdig pa rus sbal la sogs dang / /sbrul rnams sna tshogs pa dag kyang ske/ /sbyor ba 'byung ba'i mtshan nyid kyis/ /cho ga bzhin du rab tu bya/ /de la 'di ni dug thams cad 'pho ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ/ lta ba rdo rje'i dug la sogasal/ /gzhan yang mi bzad pa yi dug /nam mkha' rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dul/ /bsams na ye shes rdo rjes 'dren/ /bcom ldan 'das dug gi dam tshig chen po rdo rjes de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de la 'di ni dug gso ba'i dam tshig rdo rje snying po'o/ /hūṃ/ rdo rje chen po'i snying po 'di/ /kha dog dkar por rnam par bsam/ /'od kyi sprin ni shin tu 'bar/ /zla ba'i 'od zer bzhin du bsilam/ /gnas bzhi dag tu sbyor ba yis/ /de ma thag tu 'byung bar 'gyur/ /lan gsum legs par bsgom pa ni/ /skyugs pa dag tu rnam bsams na/ /nam mkha'i khams kun gang ba yang / /de ma thag tu dug med 'gyur/ /zhes de skad bka' stsal to/ /de la 'di ni nye ba'i dug thams cad drang ba'i snying po'o/ /āḥl/ 'bras dang phol mig 'brum bu dang / /gang gzhan nad du bshad pa rnams / /phyag na rdo rje'i bka' bzhin du/ /bsam pa tsam gyis med par 81—535

'gyur / /pad+ma chen po 'dab ma brgyad/ /zla ba bzhin du dri ma med/ /de yi dbus na 'dug bsam pa/ /'od zer lnga ni rdzogs pa'o/ /sdud pa na ni dam tshig gnag /bskul ba na ni dkar po 'dra/ /bsam gtan gnas ni gsang ba 'di / /ye shes dri med gsang chen yin/ /de la 'di ni phyi nang gi nad rnams gso ba'i rdo rje snying po'i sngags kyi yi ge'i tshig rnams so/ /dzi na dzika /ā ro lika /badz+ra sgrika /nad kyi rdo rje bskul ba yis/ /yi ge'i tshig ni gang 'dod pa / /dad pas yon tan thob 'gyur ba/ /de 'dra'i gzugs ni bsgom par bya/ /dam tshig spre'u dang 'dra ba'am/ /yang na khyi las byung ba'ang rung / /rang gi lus ngag sems gnas las/ /byung ba dag tu rnam par bsam/ /'khor lo'am ni rdo rje'ang rung / /bsgoms na rdo rje'i go 'phang gnas/ /lus dang ngag sems dam tshig rnams/ /des ni phye mar brlag par bsgom/ /de nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /byang chub sems dpa' grags chen rnams/ /byin rlabs go 'phang dam pa dag /dgyes pa'i spyan gyis rab tu stsol/ /'di skad ces kyang bka' stsal to/ /rang lus ngag sems rdo rje la/ /sangs rgyas sprin dag rnam par bsam/ /rdo rje rgyal po sprin chen po/ /nad las thar bar rnam par bsgom/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /blo ldan byang chub sems dpa' dag /de la khros par bsams na ni/ /'chi bar byed pa dam pa yin / /bsam gtan sbyor ba 'di dag gis/ /las skyes su yang gang grags pa/ /brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas sbyor ba yis/ /nyi ma bdun gyis 'jigs par 'gyur/ /yang na bdag gis sngags rgyal gyis/ /rdo rje'i bsam gtan cho ga bsam/ /'di ni nad rnams thams cad kyi/ /dam tshig shin tu 'da' dka' ba'o/ /de 81—536

nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /ye shes kyo ba 'od po che/ /'dod dang thar pa rdo rje ches / /gsum ni 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /chos rnams mi lam lta bu ste/ /ngo bo nyid kyis ma skyes shing / /rang bzhin dag pa de nyid la/ /'khrul pa'i rdo rje rab tu gsung / /bsam gtan bzlas pa don brtson pa'i/ /sgrub pa pos ni rtag tu mthong / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /dbye ba rnam pa gnyis su mthong / /de la 'di ni mi lam chen po'i dam tshig gi gnas te/ byang chub ye shes mchog thob pas/ /sangs rgyas 'od ni bzang por mthong / /sangs rgyas rdzogs longs spyod pa yi/ /skur yang bdag nyid myur du mthong / /sems can chen po khams gsum pas/ /mchod pa byed par des mthong ngo / /ye shes chen po'i 'od 'dra'i gzugs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yis//'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams kyis/ /rtag tu mchod pa byed par mthong / /rdo rje sems dpa'i gzugs chen dang / /grags pa chen po rdo rje chos/ /gsang ba rdo rje grags pa cher/ /mi lam dag na rang gzugs mthong / /byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje can/ /sangs rgyas chen po phyag 'tshal ba'i/ /rmi lam 'di 'dra mthong gyur pa/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub ste/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /lha yi bu mo yid 'ong dang / /khye'u dang bu mo dag mthong na / /de ni dngos grub 'thob par 'gyur/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyang / /zhing na bzhugs par nges par mthong / /thugs ni dgyes par gyur nas kyang / /chos mdzod yid du 'ong ba stsol/ /chos kyi 'khor lo sgyur ba'i lus / /sangs rgyas kun gyis yongs bskor ba/ /bsam gtan rdo rje la gnas pa'i / /dam tshig sbyor bas mthong bar 'gyur/ /kun dga' ra ba skyed mos 81—537

tshal / /lha yi bu mo sogs pas brgyan/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin rlabs pas/ /bsam gtan dam tshig can gyis mthong / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yis / /de ni mngon par dbang bskur mthong / /rigs 'dzin rgyal po chen po yis / /mchod pa byas par nges mthong ngo / /yang gsungs pa/ rdo rje las byung sna tshogs pa'i/ /rmi lam dri ma med mthong na/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje las / /skyes pa bla med 'grub par 'gyur/ /gdol pa khyi yi sbyor la sogs/ /gal te rdo rje blos mthong na/ /blo ldan rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /sems kyi gnas ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /de la 'di ni rmi lam rnam par dpyad pa'i dam tshig gi snying po'o/ /rang sems rnams ni dmigs pa la/ /chos rnams thams cad rab tu gnas/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i gnas sems 'di/ /chos med chos nyid med pa'o / /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur / rmad du gyur nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang /gsung dang / thugs kyi dam tshig gi the tshom (17gcod pa rdo rje sems dpa' la zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ 'di ci zhig lags/ /chos rnams ngo bo med pa la / /chos kyi de nyid kun bshad pa/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar las byung ba/ /nam mkha' la ni nam mkha' bsgom/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad/ nam mkha' ni chos gang dang yang mi ldan te/ mi ldan pa'ang rinanom yin no/ /nam mkha' de nga ni chos thams cad du gtogs la/ thams cad kyi rjes su blta'o snyam du yang mi sems so de 81—538

bzhin du bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mi lam lta bu dang /rmi lam gyi dam tshig las byung bar rjes su rtogs par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad/ 'di lta ste/ dper na/ nam mkha' rtag 17tu med cing bltar mi snang ba thogs pa med pa de bzhin du/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad chos thams cad kyang rjes su rtogs par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'di lta ste/ dper na/lus dang / ngag dang / sems dang chos thams cad rdo rje'i gnas kyi dam tshig ni/ /thams cad kyi rjes su song ba ngo bo nyid gcig pa'i phyir te/ 'di lta ste / sems kyi ngo bo nyid do/ /lus dang / ngag dang / sems kyi khams gang yin pa dang / nam mkha'i khams de dag gnyis su med cing gnyis su byar med dol/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'di lta ste/ dper na/sems can thams cad nam mkha'i khams la gnas te/ nam mkha'i khams de 'ang la'adod pa'i khams na gnas pa 'ang tsho ma yin/ gzugs kyi khams na gnas pa 'ang cingam yin/ gzugs med pa'i khams na gnas pa 'ang 5ma yin te/chos gang khams gsum na mi gnas pa de ni skye ba med do/ /gang la skye ba med pa 'di ni chos gang gis kyang brtag par mi nus so/ /de bas na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad/ chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med pa'o/ /kye/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad/ 'di lta ste/ dper na/byang chub kyi sems ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes 'byung ba rdo rje'i gnas byed pa ste/ byang chub kyi sems de yang lus la mi gnas/ ngag la mi gnas / sems la mi gnas so/ /chos gang khams gsum na mi gnas pa de la 81—539

skye ba med do/ /'di ni ye shes 'byung ba rdo rje'i gnas yin no/ /kye/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad/ rmi lam de ni bdag gis khams gsum du rmi lam mthong bar bya'o snyam du mi sems so/ /mi yang bdag gis mi lam mthong ngo snyam du mi sems so/ /khams gsum gyi bya ba de rnams kyang / rmi lam lta bu/ mi lam dang 'dra ba/ mi lam las byung ba'o/ /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' ji snyed pa rnams dang /sems can ji snyed pa thams cad kyang / rmi lam bdag med pa'i gnas su rjes su rtogs par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'di lta ste / dper na/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che ni/ rin po che thams cad kyi gtso bo yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa ste/ rin po che thams cad kyi gtso bo yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa gang yin pa de la/ sems can gang dag gis gser ram/ rin po che'am/ dngul yang rung ste/ gang bslangs pa de dag thams cad bsams pa tsam gyis 'byor par byed de/ rin po che la sogs pa de dag kyang sems la yang mi gnas/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu la yang gnas pa ma yin no/ /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad chos thams cad dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyang rjes su rtogs par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de 1bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad rab tu dgyes pa'i spyan gdangs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang —/ thugs rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das/ gang nam mkha'i khams kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i chos thams cad la 81—540

sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams rjes su 'brang ba de ngo mtshar to/ /de nas sangs rgyas dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyis/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs gnyis la phyag btsal 1tshonas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gang bcom ldan 'das khyed kyis sngags thams cad kyi rdo rje'i dngos grub mdor bsdus te gsungs pa/ sngags thams cad kyi rdo rje mdor bsdus pa'i dngos grub de dag gang la gnas/ de nas phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad la legs so zhes bya ba byin nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sngags kyi dngos grub thams cad ni/ sku dang dang gsung dang thugs la mi gnas so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'on kyang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sngags kyi dngos grub thams cad dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad ni bdag gi lus dang ngag dang sems rdo rje la ni gnas so/ /lus dang / ngag dang ske/ sems rdo rje de dag kyang / 'dod pa'i khams na mi gnas/ gzugs kyi khams na mi gnas/ gzugs med pa'i khams na mi gnas/ sems kyang lus la mi gnas/ lus kyang sems la mi gnas/ ngag kyang sems la mi gnas/sems kyang ngag la mi gnas so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ nam mkha' ltar ngo bo nyid dag pa'i phyir/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang /gsung dang / thugs rdo rje la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos gang la gnas gnas byung / dpal rdo rje sems dpas bka' stsal pa/ rang gi lus dang / ngag dang / sems las 81—541

byung ngo / /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsol pa/sems gang na gnas/ bka' stsal pa/ nam mkha' la gnas so/ /gsol pa/nam mkha' gang na gnas/ bka' stsal pa/ gang na 'ang ①mi gnas so/ /de nas sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dag ngo mtshar du gyur/ rmad du gyur nas/ rang gi sems kyi chos nyid la gnas nas sems shing cang mi smra bar 'khod par gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang ske/ thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa las/ sems can thams cad kyi dam tshig gi snying po'i rdo rje 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bco lnga pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yang 'dus par gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang /gsung dang / thugs rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi dam tshig gis gsol ba btab nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje rin chen gyi mchod pa'i tshogs kyis mchod pa byas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa/ rdo rje thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor seng ge'i dam tshig gi rgyal po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ rdo rje'i sku'i dkyil 'khor 'di sangs rgyas thams cad kyi na sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las byung ngo ske/ /de nas sku yi dkyil 'khor mchog /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor rab 'dra ba/ /dkyil 'khor rnams ni kun gyi mchog /legs par rab tu bshad par bya/ /khru ni bcu drug tshad du bya/ /gru bzhi lham pa rab tu mdzes/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 81—542

dkyil 'khor te0)/ /sku yi rdo rje rab tu gnas/ /de yi nang du 'khor lo ni/ /rdo rje'i cho gas bri bar bya/ /sngags rnams kun gyi gsang ba mchog /phyag rgya rdo rje'i gnas su bya/ /dbus su rnam par snang mdzad gnas/ /mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'ang bri/ /sku dang gsung thugs rdo rje mchog /grwa rnams kun tu dgod par bya/ /stobs chen pha rol gnon pa yi/ /khro bo rnams kyang sgor bri 'o/ /rdo rje gsang ba rab bsgoms pas/ /mchod pa sngags shes pa yis bya/ /'di ni sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /dam tshig shin tu 'da' dka' ba'o/ /bshang 2dang gci ba la sogs pa/ /bye brag tu ni nges par dbul/ /'di ni sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /sku yi rdo rje las dam tshig /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pas gsung rdo rje thams cad kyi dam tshig gi sprin bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ gsung rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor 'di nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /de nas gsung gi dkyil 'khor mchog /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor rab 'dra ba/ /dkyil 'khor rnams ni kun gyi mchog /legs par rab tu bshad par bya/ /khru ni nyi shu'i tshad du bya/ /gru bzhi lham pa cho ga bzhin/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi par/ /rdo rje bsgoms pas thig gdab bo/ /de dbus 'khor lo chen po ni/ /zlum por kun tu bri bar bya/ /mdo ru phyag rgya thams cad ni/ /cho ga bzhin du bri bar bya/ /tshe dpag med kyi phyag rgya che/ /de yi dbus su gzhag 3par bya/ /rdo rje gnas mchog de nyid du/ /thams cad yongs su dgod par bya/ / yongs su gsal bar cho ga bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa byas nas ni/ /de nas gsang ba'i 81—543

mchod pa bya/ /'on tang rdo rje can dag mnyes/ /bshang 3)gci khu ba'i dam tshig gis/ /mchod na dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /dam tshig shin tu 'da' dka' ba'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung gi dkyil 'khor ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa kun nas sprin gyi tshogs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ rab tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gsang ba 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /rdo rje 'dzin mchog gang yin pa'i/ /gzugs ni dbus su legs bris pa/ /de yi dkyil 'khor gnas su 'gyur/ /sku gsung thugs kyi gsang las byung / /'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje'i gnas ye shes gsang ba yin te/ rab tu gsang ba'o/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi 'khor lo 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi sku dang /gsung dang / thugs rdo rje'i gsang ba 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang /thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi sngags kyi snying po'i thig gdab pa'i yi ge'i gnas rnams so/ /oṃ āḥ/ rdo rje'i thig ni gdab pa dang / /tshon rtsi dag ni dgye ba dag /sngags kyi sems las mi bya ste/ /byas na byang chub rnyed par dka'/ /de bas dam tshig tshul shes pas/ /sngags kyi lha rnams phab nas su/ /byin gyis brlabs kyis gnas bsgoms la/ /dkyil 'khor rnams ni rnam par brtag /rgyal chen rnam par snang mdzad dang / /yang na spyan ni dbab par bya/ /sku yi dkyil 'khor gnas yid 'ong / /rdo rje sku yi 81wa 544

yon tan 'thob/ /rdo rje chos ni rgyal po che/ /rang gi chos mas dbab par bya/ /'di ni (1sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba rab tu rtag pa yin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ / ma mā mi'i yang dbab par bya/ /'di ni sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba rmad du byung ba'o/ /de ltar byas na byin rlob cing ske/ /yid la dbang ba nyid gshegs te/ /rab tu dgyes par gyur nas ni/ /gsang ba dag gis mchog kyang stsol/ /'di skad kyang gsungs so/ /sngags kyi sems pas bya ba ni/ /rdo rje gsang ba rmad po che/ /khro bo'i rgyal pos bkug nas ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya/ /rdo rje dri med gsum dag gi//dam tshig mchod pa dus gsum pa/ /rdo rje gsum gyi sbyor bas bya/ /sngags kyi dngos grub thob par byed/ /'di skad kyang gsungs so/ /sngags rnams thams cad nyid la yang / /rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma dbul/ /bshang ( gci sha dang 'bru mar dang / /sems las byung ba'i tsan+dan dang / /khu ba dag gis sngags rnams kun/ /tshim par 'gyur bar kun tu bshad/ /'di ni dam tshig mchog yin te/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rdzogs byed pa'o/ /thig gdab pa yi cho ga 'di//bdag nyid gang tshe spyod pa na/ /rnam par snang mdzad bsgoms nas su/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab tu bsgom/ /yang na rdo rje mi 'chir grags/ /slob ma rdo rje 'od po che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bsten pa yi/ /las kyi go 'phang bsgom par bya / /sangs rgyas rgyal chen lnga rnams ni/ /rdo rje'i thig skud dag la dgod/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba rab tu rmad byung ba'o/ /rnam pa nyi shu rtsa lngar ni/ /tshon rtsi dag kyang rnam par bsgom/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba byang chub dam pa yin/ /sngags rnams thams cad 81—545

nyid la yang / /rdo rje hūṃ ni bsgom par bya/ /sku dang gsung dang dam tshig mchog /gnas lnga dag tu bsgom par bya/ /de ltar rtag tu byas na ni/ /rdo rje mi byed gsum las skyes/ /rdo rje sems dpa' blo ldan pa/ /'jigs shing skrag nas byin rlob mdzad/ /rdo rje bum pa bzhag pa ni/ /sngags rgyud bdag pos shes bya ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin gnas/ /brtan pa'i blos ni brtag par bya/ /dngos grub kun gyi 'bras 'dod pa'i/ /sngags shes pas ni sbyin sreg 97bya/ /bshang rigegaci 'bru mar sha la sogs/ /sbyin sreg (btu ni dbul bar bya/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum dag la/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i sbyin sreg dbul/ /dbus su rang gi lha yi gzugs/ /bsams te zhal du dbab par bya 'di skad kyang gsungs so/ /dbang po gnyis kyi dam tshig gis/ /sbyin sreg brgya rtsa brgyad du bya/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /dam tshig shin tu 'da' dka' ba'o/ /rnam snang mdzad kyi sbyor ba yis/ /slob ma rdo rje gsum las byung ske/ /āḥni lus dang ngag sems la/ /bsgoms nas rdo rje gzung 9༄bar bya/ /rgyal chen rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /grags chen rnam par snang mdzad dag /sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig tu/ /byin gyis brlabs ni rab tu gsol/ /de la 'di ni dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug pa'i rdo rje'i dam tshig go/ /āḥkhe bi ra hūṃ/'di ni dam tshig thams cad kyi lus dang / ngag dang / sems rdo rje'i snying po'o / /de la 'di ni rdo rje chen po'i dbang bskur ba'i gsang ba'i ye shes gsang ba'o / /sangs rgyas kun gyis nam mkha'i khams/ /yongs su gang bar rab tu bsgom / /rdo rje'i rigs ni 'dzin pa yis/ /sil snyan dri yi sprin rnams bsgom/ /'di skad kyang gsungs so/ /rdo rje sku gsum sngags kyi (5)ni/ /yungs tsho0)kar dag 81wa 546

gis brdeg par bya/ /de la de yi tshe na ni/ /bdag nyid dbang bskur rab tu stsolaske/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /yang na sangs rgyas bsgom par bya / /bum pa dam tshig mchog rnams kyis/ /bzung bar mkhas pa dag gis bsgom / /rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad bsam/ /slob ma rtag tu blo brtan la/ /lus dang ngag sems rdo rje can/ /sngags shes pas ni dgod par bya/ /de la 'di ni dbang bskur ba thams cad kyi gsang ba slob dpon thams cad kyi rdo rje'i tshig tu smra bar bya'o/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje gsang ba gsum las byung / /khams gsum dag gis phyag byas pa/ /rdo rje dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /de la 'di ni slob ma thams cad kyis rdo rje chen po'i gsol ba bya ba'i cho ga gsang ba'o/ /byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba bzhin/ /bdag kyang rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /de tshe de la dbang bskur ba/ /rab tu dgyes nas stsol bar mdzad / /lha yi gzugs kyi sbyor ba yis/ /snying gar 1bdag po gzhag (2par bya//rdo rje slob ma blo ldan la/ /sngags kyi yi ge'i tshig byin la/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni bstan par bya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis gsungs pa yi/ /dam tshig gsang ba bsgrag par bya/ /khyod kyis srog chags gsad dpar bya/ /brdzun gyi tshig kyang smra bar bya/ /ma byin par yang khyod kyis long / /bud med dag kyang bsten par bya / /rdo rje'i lam ni 'di dag gis/ /sems can thams cad bskul bar bya/ /'di skad kyang gsungs te/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /dam tshig mchog tu rtag pa'o/ /sngags kyis bskul ba smras pa yis/ /de la sngags kyang sbyin par bya/ /sngags kyi rgyal po'i ting 'dzin dang / /gsang ba sbyin pa brtsam 81—547

par bya/ /khu ba'am yang na bshang 1 ba'ang rung / /cho ga bzhin du bsngags 9minas ni/ /rdo rje'i blos ni bza' bar bya/ /'on tang dngos grub rnyed mi dka'//rnam pa 'di bzhi gsang chen te/ /rdo rje can ni kun gyi gsang / /sngags kyi 'khor lo bud med gzugs/ /sems can don spyod phyir gnas pa'o/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor thams cad kyang sngags kyi mnyes par bya ba gsang ba'o / /glang po'i sha dang rta yi sha /sha chen dag kyang bza' bya zhing / /sngags rnams kun la dbul bar bya/ /de ltar byas na mgon po mnyes/ /nyin re rdo rje slob ma la/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor bstan par bya/ /bshang (kyegaci sha yi bya ba dang / /rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig dag gis/ /sngags rnams kun gyi yi ge oṃ/ /bsgoms na de ma thag tu 'bar/ /bcom ldan 'das sngags kyi rigs pa'i skyes bu chen pos de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /dngos grub thams cad bsgrub ④pa dang la/ /dam tshig chen po bsgrub 95)pa dang / /sangs rgyas byang chub nyid dag kyang ske/ /nan tan du ni bsgrub par bya/ /mi snang stobs dang brtson 'grus dang ske/ /rdo rje dgug pa'i mchog dag kyang / /rdo rje sku yi bka' bzhin du/ /dkyil 'khor dag gis thams cad 'grub/ /bshang 76cigaci dang ni sha chen rnams//cha ni mnyam par byas nas su/ /kham phor sbyar mar bzhag na ni/ /sangs rgyas kun dang lhan cig 'khod/ /'di skad ces kyang gsungs te/ de la 'di ni gsang ba thams cad kyi rdo rje mngag gzhug 7༄pa rab tu sgrub pa'i dam (zhesatshig gi mchog go/ /hrīḥni 'bar ba'i 'od bzang po/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i dbus su bsam / /sangs rgyas kun gyis nam mkha'i khams/ /yongs su gang bar rnam par bsgom/ /de yi sku gsung thugs kyi gnas/ /der ni sngags kyi dbab par 81—548

byam/ /de la 'di ni sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi sngags rdo rje byin gyis rlob pa'i snying po'o/ /āḥs dhīḥ1phyag na rdo rje'i gzugs chen dang / /phyag na pad+mo 'od chen dang / /gzhan gyis mi thub gzugs chen dag /bsgoms nas gsang ba'i gnas bzhag go/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje gsang ba'i gnas so/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /mi bskyed 2pa ni rab tu brtag /tshe dpag med pa'i 'khor lo che/ /rdo rje snang mdzad de bzhin te/ /'od chen sdug bsngal chen po yis/ /thams cad snying pos bskul bar bya/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i snying po thams cad bskul ba'o/ /āḥ4 mdung rtse che dang rdo rje che/ /lcags kyu sna tshogs mchog rnams kyis/ /rdo rje cho ga bzhin bskul na/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab tu 'grub/ /'di skad ces kyang gsungs so/ /nyams dga' ba yi ri dwags 55dang / /chu gling rnam pa sna tshogs su/ /zla ba phyed ni tshun chad kyis / /sangs rgyas thob pa gdon mi za/ /ri rab sum cu rtsa drug gi/ /rdul phran ji snyed yod pa yi/ /de yi 'khor tshogs lhan cig tu/ /'khor lo can gyi byang chub 'grub/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sangs rgyas zhing du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zab mo'i chos kyang thos 'gyur zhing / /sangs rgyas sa yang 'thob par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das dam tshig rdo rje bzhad pas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de la 'di ni mngag gzhug pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i rdo rje gsang ba'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' ye shes che/ /de bzhin gsung gi rdo rje 'dzin / /rdo rje sku yi dgod pa ches/ /mngag gzhug pa dag rtag tu bskul/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje ye shes 'khor lo sngags kyi dam tshig gi gnas so/ /dam tshig bskul ba dang / dam tshig gtong ba dang / dam tshig bod pa dang / dam 81—549

tshig bcing ba'o/ /mkha' dbyings rgya chen dag pa ni/ /chos rnams thams cad rnam par spangs/ /gong bu'i tshul gyis byed pa ni/ /rdo rje rmad byung gzugs can no/ /bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bu gcig pa rdo rje sems dpa' chen pos de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa'ang rung ske/ /gal te dbang du bya 'dod na/ /rdo rje mchog gsum 'dzin pa che/ /gsang ba chen po 'di bsam mo/ /rdo rje 'jam pa stobs po che/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i dbus su bsam/ /mda' lnga'i sbyor ba dag gis ni/ /dbu rgyan rtse mo yang dag spro/ /gnas lnga dag tu sngags shes pas/ /rdo rje khro bos rab tu dbab/ /sngangs shing brgyal bar bsgom pa ni/ /byis pa'i blo ni grags chen gyis/ /bsam gtan 'di ni zla phyed du/ /gsang ba'i bskul ba dag gis bsgom/ /sngags rnams kun gyis rab gsang ba/ /rdo rje'i don gyis blo yis gsungs/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor mchog dag ni/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i dbus bsam pa/ /sngags kyi rdo rje hūṃ la sogs/ /rdo rje gsum la sogs par bsgom/ /oṃ ni mig gi dbus bsams nas/ /'di dag cho ga bzhin ducha/ /sngags rnams kun gyi gzugs dag ni/ /sku gsung rdo rje can du mthong / /bkres skom la sogs nyon mongs che/ /sbyor ba 'di ni rnam bsam na/ /rdo rje thugs kyi bka' bzhin du/ /sdug bsngal thams cad byang bar 'gyur/ /rnam par snang mdzad gzugs chen po//bsam na don rnams thams cad 'byor/ /baṃ ni kha yi nang du bsgom/ /oṃ ni lce la 'dug par bsam/ /bza' bar bya ba kun gyi gnas/ /yid bzhin nor bus brgyan napa ste/ /zhi ba sdug bsngal thams cad sel/ /ye shes rdo rje las byung ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das yid bzhin gyi nor bus de skad ces bka' stsal 81—550

tol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa dpa' bo chen po rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pas/ rdo rje bsgom pa'i tshig gi mchog /rdo rje'i gsung phyung ba'o1)/ /bī/ sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor 'od bzang po/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i dbus su bsam/ /rdo rje sku gsum sbyor ba yis/ /bskyed de 'di ni rnam par bsam/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs rdzogs pa/ /cung zad ser ba rdo rje 'gying / /zhi ba thor tshugs dbu rgyan can/ /bsams nas thams cad brtsam par bya/ /rdo rje dpa' bo rlabs tshon kyi phreng ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kun nas dbyangs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ rdo rje chen po sgom pa'i tshig 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /rtsu/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ni/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i dbus su bsam/ /sangs rgyas sprin gyi cho ga yis/ /rdo rje gsum gyi grags che ni/ /lus dang ngag dang sems la dbab/ /bskul byed rdo rje ma bsgom mo/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs rdzogs pa/ /kha dog dkar mor rab tu bsgom/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /bsams la sngags kyi tshig dgod do/ /rdo rje'i dam tshig ye shes kyi 'od zer zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa/bsam pa thams cad rdo rje longs spyod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi 'khor lo'i tshul 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang /gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /rdza/ sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor dam pa dag /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus su bsam/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi cho ga yis / /rdo rje bsgom pas dbab par bya/ /dzam+bha la ni nor sgrub pa/ /gnod 81—551

sbyin chen po bskyed par bya/ /zhi ba gnod sbyin gzugs 'dzin pa/ /thor tshugs dbu rgyan rdo rje can/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi cho ga yis/ /gnas lnga dag tu bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu de yis/ /bsam gtan gnas la 'dug la dbul/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i cho ga yis/ /dbu rgyan de la rnam par bsam/ /de ltar byas na gnod sbyin dbang / /gnod gnas dbang po 'od chen gnyis/ /rdo rje dam tshig gi phyag rgya rdzas sgrub pa'i tog gi dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin torka/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa/ rdo rje 'dod pa nye bar longs spyod pa'i dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ gnod sbyin mo'i rdo rje'i dam tshig gi tshig 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang /gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /k+ṣiṃ/ mkha' dbyings rdo rje'i dbus gnas par/ /gru bzhi lham pa rab tu bzang / /thams cad rin chen bzhi las byas / /me tog spos kyis kun tu 'khrigs/ /gnod sbyin mo ni thamasari cad kyis/ /nam mkha'i dbyings ni gang bar bsam/ /gzugs kyi sprin dag rnam bsams la//rdo rje gsum gyi sbyor bas dbab/ /gzugs ni gcig tu bsam par bya lus gsum rdo rje bye brag gis/ /de yi bsam gtan bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje 'jam pa'i ting 'dzin gnas/ /dbu rgyan la ni khro bo bsgom/ /snying gar ①sngags kyi tshig bsgoms la/ /rdo rje'i sbyor ba brtsam par bya/ /gnod sbyin mo thams cad dang mnyam pa nyid du gnas pa bsgom pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa/ rdo rje'i sngags thams cad kyi dngos grub kyi rnam par 'phrul pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ dngos grub phra mo 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung 81—552

dang ske/ thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /sku dang gsung thugs yang dag 'grub/ /sangs rgyas gzugs 'dzin 'di bzang po/ /dzasbu 1)chu bo'i gser 'od 'dra/ /dngos grub phra mo dag la gnas/ /mi snang la sogs yang dag grub/ /'jam pa'i 'od dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /gnod sbyin rgyal po grub pa che/ /rig 'dzin dag gi dbang por 'gyur/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i dngos grub thams cad kyi 2gzugs gsang ba'i dngos grub rnams so/ /sngags kyi dngos grub thob pa yi/ / mdzes pa'i gzugs rnams thams cad ni/ /'jig rten khams ni thams cad du//mthong ba nyid kyis dga' bar 'gyur/ /gtsug tor thams cad grub pa ni/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i bdag por 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas byang chub byed pa'i mchog/sangs rgyas rdo rje rab bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i rdo rjes 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi rig pa'i brtul zhugs yang dag par len pa'i spyod pa 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje rnams/ /lus dang ngag sems sgom pa ni/ /rang tshul nyid kyis de byas te/ /de ltar dngos grub 'thob par 'gyur/ /de la 'di ni sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi rdo rje'i rig pa'i brtul zhugs so/ /thor tshugs dbu rgyan can gyi gzugs/ /chen po kha dog dkar po 'dra/ /sngags kyi sdom pas kun tu bsdams/ /cho ga bzhin du thams cad bya/ /lo grangs bcu drug lon pa ni/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par klubs/ /bzhin sdug mig gi dkyus ring ba/ /rnyed nas rig pa'i brtul 81—553

zhugs spyad/ /spyan gyi go 'phang longs spyod cing / /rdo rje'i mtshan mas bsgom par bya/ /phyag rgya sngags kyi cho ga shes/ /sngags kyi rgyud rnams legs par bslabs / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i btsun mor bya/ /sangs rgyas byang chub la rab gnas/ /brtul zhugs chen po dus bzhir ni/ /gsang ba'i mchod pa rab tu bya/ /sdong bu rtsa ba 'bras bu yi/ /bza' dang bca' ba spyad par bya/ /'on tang myur du sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /bdag po ye shes rgya mtsho che/ /zla ba drug gis de dag kun/ /gdon mi za bar 'thob par 'gyur/ /rtag tu gzhan gyi nor rku zhing ske/ /bsad pa'ang rmad du byung ba dang / /'dod chags rdo rje'i gnas spyad pa / /sdom pa 'dis ni kun tu bsdams/ /'dod chags rdo rje lcags kyu mo/ /yon tan lug rgyud mā ma tī/ /gsung gi rdo rje thugs mchog la/ /'di ni rnam pa kun tu rigs/ /bsam gtan yig gsum rdo rje can/ /rang gi phyag rgya sems kyi bsam/ /de ltar sangs rgyas kun mkhyen pa/ /mnyes par 'gyur ba gdon mi za/ /sgrub pa po ni blo brtan pas/ /nags tshal dag tu bsod snyoms bslang ske/ /kha zas bzang po bstar hu)ba dag /de dag skrag nas ster bar 'gyur / /rdo rje'i bdag nyid gsum 'das nas/ /rdo rje'i yi ge 'jig par 'gyur / /lha mo klu mo gnod sbyin mo/ /lha ma yin nam mi mo'ang rung / /rnyed nas rig pa'i brtul zhugs bya/ /rdo rje gsum gyi ye shes bsten/ /'di ni sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /de nyid gsang ba'i tshul chen yin/ /rdo rje gsum gyi ye shes 'byung / /sangs rgyas byang chub rab 'jug pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rig pa'i brtul zhugs kyi dam tshig gi de kho na nyid kyi rdo rjes de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de bzhin gshegs 81—554

pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa las/ dngos grub thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor rdo rje mngon par byang chub pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bcu drug pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yang 'dus nas/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang /thugs rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa la gsol ba btab pa/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che / /rdo rje dbyings ni mkhas pa che/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /gsang ba'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med/ /rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don yod rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas//bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dag pa ngo bo nyid las byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bskul ba yi/ /bstod tshig zhi ba 'di rnams kyis/ /rdo rje longs spyod bstod na ni/ /de yang sangs rgyas 'dra bar 'gyur/ /de nas ston pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas kun la rjes brtse ba / /rdo rje gsang ba gsung dag pa/ /rdo rje'i gsung ni bka' stsal to/ /e mtho sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /chos kyi dbyings ni yi ge che/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal yongs su dag /nam mkha'i dbyings bzhin dri ma med/ /de nas 81—555

phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku rdo rje'i dam tshig 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /sangs rgyas ye shes rgya mtsho yi/ /dam tshig bzhi ni bsrung bar bya/ /sha chen rtag tu bza' bar bya/ /'di ni dam tshig mchog yin no/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje'i dam tshig 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang ske/ thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /dam tshig bzhi po bsrung bar bya/ /gsung gi rdo rje yi ge ches/ /bshang (2)gci dag ni rtag tu bza'/ /'di ni gsang ba rmad byung ba'o/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos / /rdo rje 'dzin thams cad kyi dam tshig 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang ske/ thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /rdo rje sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul ches/ /dam tshig bzhi po bsrung bar bya/ /khrag dang khu ba sbyar ba dag /brtul zhugs brtan pas rtag tu bza'/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yi/ /dam tshig 'di ni rmad po che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi brtag pa 'di/ /rdo rje 'dzin gyis bsrung bar bya / /gang zhig dam tshig 'di srung ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'od po che/ /de yi sku gsung thugs rtogs pa'o/ /de ma thag tu sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos rang sangs rgyas kyi don gyi dam tshig 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /de yi lus kyi ston pa ni/ /rdo rje'i sku la rab tu gnas/ /sems can gzung ba'i ngang tshul te/ /dam tshig mchog tu rtag pa'o/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos/ nyan thos kyi bslab pa'i dam tshig 81—556

'di / nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ba'o/ /dge ba bcus 0rilas kyi lam/ /byad tsho pa ye shes spangs pa rnams/ /dman par mos pa thams cad kyi/ /dam tshig 'di ni rmad po che/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos/ tshangs pa'i dam tshig 'di/ /nyid kyi sku dang ske/ gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /gti mug las kyi lam gang rnams / /byed pa 'jigs shing mi sdug pa/ /sangs rgyas byang chub ston pa ste/ /sku yi rdo rje nyid du 'gyur/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos/ drag po'i dam tshig 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang /thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /khams gsum dag na gnas pa yi/ /bud med rdo rje las byung rnams/ /sna tshogs dngos pos spyad pa ni/ /dam tshig mchog tu rmad byung ba'o/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos khyab 'jug gi dam tshig 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /sems can las byung ji snyed pa/ /dbyer med sku gsum la gnas pa/ /rdo rje mkha' dbyings bdag nyid kyang / /bsam gtan rdo rjes gsad ( )par bya/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos rang gi dam tshig rdo rje 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang /thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /sku yi rdo rje tshangs par 'gyur/ /gsung gi rdo rje dbang phyug che/ /thugs kyi rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /de nyid khyab 'jug rdzu 'phrul che / /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos/gnod sbyin mo thams cad kyi dam tshig 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /khrag dang sha ni za ba dang / /rtag tu gzhan gyi bud med 81—557

spyod / /dam tshig dga' ba 'di rnams kyis/ /rdo rje chen po mnyes par bya /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos klu'i rgyal po thams cad kyi dam tshig 'di/ /nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /'o ma 'thung ba phra ma can/ /de dag 'dod dang dri la 'bad/ /dam tshig 'dis ni bsgrub par bya/ /gzhan du nges par nyon mongs 'gyur/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos/ lha ma srin gyi bu mo'i dam tshig 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /khro zhing nga rgyal gsod pas non/ /spos dang me tog spyod la dgyes/ /rdo rje sa 'og dam tshig ste/ /gdul dka' rdo rje 'jigs byed pa'o/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos srin mo rnams kyi dam tshig 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /thod rus bdug pa'i 'bru mar dang / /zhag gis rab tu dga' bar 'gyur/ /'byung po kun gyi dam tshig ste/ /dag byed 'di ni don chen byed/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi dam tshig 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /bshang 1)gci dang ni khrag dag bza'/ /chang la sogs pa'ang rtag tu btung / /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyor ba yis/ /gnas kyi mtshan nyid kyis gsad risabya/ /ngo bo nyid kyis kun 'byung ba/ /khams gsum dag na rnam par spyod / /sems can kun la phan 'dod pa'i/ /dam tshig ma lus spyad par bya/ /khams gsum pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig gi rjes su 'brang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 81—558

bdag pos lus kyi dngos grub kyi dam tshig 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang ske/ thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /lus kyi rnam gsum thams cad ni/ /rdo rje las ni byung bar bya/ /sems can khams ni thams cad du/ /rtag par sangs rgyas sku byed pa'o/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos ngag gi dngos grub kyi dam tshig 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang ske/ thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /tshig gi las lam ma lus par/ /khams gsum dri med dkyil 'khor te/ /tshig gi dngos grub yid 'ong 'di/ /dam tshig shin tu 'da' dka' ba'o/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos sems rdo rje'i dam tshig gi dngos grub 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /yid kyi rdo rje'i rang bzhin kun/ /rdo rje brtan pa 'dzin pas bsgom/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum ldan gyi/ /dam tshig bshad pa 'di yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kun tu mdzes dga' rdo rje sems dpas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos sngags thams cad kyi rdo rje'i snying po'i dam tshig 'di/nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rang rgyal nyan thos de bzhin te/ /sku gsung thugs su sbyor ba na/ /phyag 'tshal na ni ma rung 'gyur/ /de nas yang phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje'i bsam gtan gyi dam tshig 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /kun tu rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor la/ /bsam gtan rdo rje gsum 81—559

sbyor bas/ /sngags zlos pas ni bsam gtan bya/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos sngags sgrub pa'i dam tshig dang /sdom pa 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /mdor na sems can khams rnams ni/ /bsam gtan rdo rjes bskul bar bya/ /rdo rje gsum gyi phyag 'tshal mchog /dam tshig rdo rje las byung ba'o/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos bsnyen pa dang /sgrub pa dang / nye bar sgrub pa dang / sgrub pa chen po'i sdom pa 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /rdo rje bshang hu)gcis nam mkha'i dbyings/ /yongs su gang bar rnam par bsam/ /dus gsum rdo rje dag la dbul/ /dam tshig rab tu brtag (gepa'o/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos rdo rje mi snang ba thams cad kyi dam tshig 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /dus bzhir ji ltar mchog bzhin du/ /rdo rje mo ni nyin re spyad/ /yang na rdzas kyang rtag tu dbrog /dam tshig rdo rje rdzogs byed pa'o/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos nam mkha'i rig 'dzin gyi dam tshig 'di / nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje ni/ /dbu rgyan dag la bsam gtan bsam/ /rdo rje gsum gyi dam tshig ste/ /khros pa rnams kyis mi thub bo/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos sngags 'chang las dang po pa thams cad kyi dam tshig 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /sku yi rdo rje kha zas la/ /phyi rol rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / /mdo 81—560

gdon 0)cho ga'i bya ba la/ /rtag par rdo rje chos su bya/ /bcom ldan 'das ngo bo nyid dag pa rdo rjes de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad kyi sku dang /gsung dang / thugs kyi rdo rje mnyam pa nyid rnam par dgongs nas cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /de nas yang brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing ri rab kyi rdul rab tu phra ba dang mnyam pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po ci'i slad du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang /byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi nang du cang mi gsung bar bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi bdag po 'di / sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo nyid dmigs su med pa'i yi ge'i tshig la/ ngo bo nyid med pa'i yi ge'i tshig brjod nas cang mi gsung bar bzhugs so/ /rigs kyi bu/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po 'di sems pa ni 'di snyam du gyur to/ /sku ni mi 'gyur ma skyes pa/ /gsung dang thugs kyang mtshan ma med/ /nam mkha' rdo rje rtog las byung / /log par bzung bas zin pa yin/ /de nas 'jam dpal la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gsung 81—561

rdo rje'i tshig la phyin ci log kun 'byung bar mi rtag 0)tu gsol/ de ci'i slad du zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po 'di ni(ge/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid/ spyod par 'gyur ba gshegs pa dang / byon pa'i rjes su 'gro'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ tshangs pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ mngon par shes pa chen po'i ye shes thob pa rnams chos thams cad kyi mtshan nyid kyi ngo bo nyid mi shes nas 'di snyam du rnam par rtog ste/ ci rdo rje'i bdag nyid 'di de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos thams cad kyi rdo rje'i de kho na nyid yongs su ma shes nas/ gsang ba'i yi ge rnams 'chad dam snyam du sems pa yang ma chis so//de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /byang chub sems dpa' khyed rnams lta ci smos te/ nged (1de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ sku dang ske/ gsung dang / thugs rdo rje'i gsang ba mi 'gyur ba rnyed pa'ang sku dang /gsung dang / thugs kyi byang chub mi shes so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ skye ba med pa'i rdo rje mngon par byang chub pa ni ngo bo nyid med pa mi 'gyur ba las byung ba'o//rigs kyi bu/ sems can chen po'i khongs su gtogs pa'i sems can ji snyed yod pa de dag thams cad byang chub la gnas pa sangs rgyas rdo rje'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kye ma sems can de dag ni sku gsum rdo rje'i chos nyid kyi phyir/ sku dang ske/ gsung dang / thugs rdo rje'i ye shes thob pa'o/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje'i bdag pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' de 81—562

dag la 'di skad ces gsungs sonyu/ /rang bzhin dag cing bdag med pa/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi gnas med pa/ /rtog pa rdo rje las byung ba/ /smra bar byed pa smra ma yin/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa phyag na rdo rje chen po la phyag btsal rinanas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje'i dngos grub ji ltar yang dag par 'jug /gang na gnas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag /po rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub thams cad dang / thams cad mkhyen pa dang / khams gsum ji snyed pa dag /rang gi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi rgyud kyi rdo rje la gnas so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis slar gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje'i dngos grub dang / khams gsum thams cad gang na gnas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po ye shes rdo rje'i bdag pos gsungs pa/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang /thugs kyi dngos grub dang / khams gsum pa thams cad ni nam mkha' la gnas so / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsol pa/ nam mkha' gang na gnas / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos gsungs pa/ gang na yang ma yin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag ngo mtshar du gyur/rmad du gyur nas/ e ma'o rdo rje e rdo rje/ /e ma'o rdo rje yi bshad pa/ /gang du lus dang ngag sems med/ /de ru gzugs ni rnam par bsgom/ /de nas 81—563

ston pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis phyag byas nas/ /rdo rje gsum mchog mchog chen mchog /rdo rje gsum gyi dbang phyug mchog /rig pa'i skyes bu bsgom pa yi/ /dngos grub kun ni bshad par mdzad/ /mkha' dbyings rdo rje'i dbus gnas par/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje'i sku ni rab bsgoms nas/ /spyi bor rdo rje rab tu bsgom/ /zhal gsum sku gsum las byung ba/ /rnam par 'phro bar 1)bsam par bya/ /rdo rje 'khor lo 'dzin bsams na/ /byang chub myur du thob par 'gyur/ /thams cad rigs kyi bye brag gis/ /gsang ba 'di ni rnam par bsam/ /gzhan du rnam par bsgoms na ni/ /de dag dngos grub mchog mi 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das rig pa'i skyes bu rdo rje gsang bas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /khams gsum las byung rgyal mo che/ /mnyes par byed ma rnams bsams nas/ /rdo rje sku gsum gyis mtshan pa/ /khyu mchog des ni mnyes par 'gyur/ /gang zhig 'di dag sgom pa yi / /byang chub sems dpa' grags chen rnams/ /zhag bdun gyis ni gzi che ba'i / /sku gsum dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje bsdus pa'i gsang ba 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las byung ngo / /sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig ni/ /phyag rgya chen po'i don rtogs pa/ /cho ga bzhin du kun bsgoms na/ /skad cig gis ni sangs rgyas 'thob/ /de nas phyag na rdo rjes sgrub pa po thams cad kyi lus dang / ngag dang / sems gsang ba 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang /gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /gal te byang chub mchog 'dod na/ /lag pa'i phyag rgya mi bcing ngo / /sngags rnams kun gyi dam tshig 'di/ /rgyal ba 81—564

rnams kyang mi 'da'o/ /de nas yang phyag na rdo rjes sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dam tshig 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las/ phyung ngo —/ /bshang 0)gci khu ba khrag rnams ni/ /smad pa dag tu yong mi bya/ /cho ga bzhin du rtag tu bza'/ /gsang 'di rdo rje gsum byung yin/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes gsung rdo rje'i dam tshig 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang /gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /khams gsum dag gi lam mchog na//bud med ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /thams cad cho ga bzhin du spyad/ /gsung gi rdo rje mi smad do/ /de nas yang phyag na rdo rjes thugs kyi dam tshig 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung 90ngo / /rdo rje sku gsung la gnas pa/ /dam tshig ji snyed yod pa kun/ /rdo rje gsum gyi dam tshig gis/ /mgu zhing tshim pa dag tu bya/ /thugs kyi rdo rje mi smad rdo rido/ /bcom ldan 'das dam tshig chen po gsum gyi dam tshig gis de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas yang phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i rdo rje 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang ske/ thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni/ /sangs rgyas lngar ni rab tu bsgrags/ /rdo rje'i skye mched nyid dag kyang / /byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor mchog /de nas phyag na rdo rjes khams gsum gyi 'khor lo 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las byung ④ngo / /sa ni spyan zhes bya ba yin/ /chu yi khams ni mā ma tī/ /dkar dang sgrol ma zhes bya ba/ /me dang rlung du rab tu bsgrags/ /mkha' dbyings rdo rje dam tshig ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid yin/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams 81—565

cad kyi gnas kyi dbang phyug rdo rje sems dpa' chen pos de skad ces bka' stsal tol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ sku dang /gsung dang / thugs rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid la gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /snyoms par zhugs nas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la gzigs nas cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag btsal (1nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje'i gsang ba gsang ba 'dus par/ mngon par dbang bskur ba'i slob dpon la/ de bzhin gshegs pa tham sa cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis ji ltar blta bar bgyi/ rigs kyi bu/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis byang chub kyi sems rdo rje bzhin du blta bar bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ slob dpon ni byang chub kyi sems dang mnyam zhing rnam pa gnyis su dbyer med do/ /rigs kyi bu/ mdor bstan na/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' ji snyed 'khod cing 'tsho la skyong ba de dag thams cad dus gsum du byon nas/ slob dpon de la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchod pas yang dag par mchod nas/sangs rgyas kyi zhing der yang 'gro zhing ngag rdo rje'i yi ge'ang tshan/'di skad du 'byin to / /bdag cag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi pha'o/ /bdag cag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ma'o zhes bya ba nas/ bdag cag de bzhin 81—566

gshegs pa thams cad kyi ston pa'o zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /'di lta ste/dper na/ rigs kyi bu sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das phyogs bcu na ji snyed bzhugs pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de rnams kyi sku dang / gsung dang ske/ thugs rdo rje las byung ba'i bsod nams kyi phung po ji snyed pa de bas kyang slob dpon gyi ba spu'i bu ga gcig gi bsod nams khyad bar du 'phags so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu/ byang chub kyi sems ni sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi snying por gyur pa'o/ /skye ba'i gnas su gyur pa nas thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi 'byung gnas yin pa'i bar du'o/ /de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' byams pa yid 'jigs shing skrag nas cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dkon mchog dpal dang /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag tu med pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa gdon mi za bar grub pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad rnams/rdo rje 'dzin thams cad kyi dngos grub kyi dam tshig la dmigs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad la bka' stsal pa/ byang chub sems dpa' khyed rnams thams cad nyon cig /gang yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dus gsum gyi rdo rje'i ye shes las byung ba de rnams kyang / gsang ba 'dus pa'i slob dpon dang phrad na/ mchod pa byed cing phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de nyid ston pa yin/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa yin/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdag po yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po de dag thams cad kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la 'di skad 81—567

ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang /gsung dang / thugs kyi dngos grub rnams ci la gnas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bka' stsal pa/ sku gsum gsang ba'i sku dang / gsung dang /thugs ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi lus dang / ngag dang / sems rdo rje la gnas so91)/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis gsol pa/ lus dang /ngag dang / sems rdo rje gang la gnas/ gang la yang mi gnas so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag ngo mtshar du gyur/ rmad du gyur nas cang mi smra bar 'khod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba'i rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bos te bka' stsal pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' khyed thams cad/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byang chub kyi sems kun 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor nyon cig /de nas yang de bzhin gshegs pa dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyi thal mo sbyar nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das/ dkyil 'khor chen po bshad du gsol/ bde bar gshegs pa/ bshad du gsol/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus bsam pa/ /gru bzhi lham pa rab tu mdzes/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor sbyor ba yis/ /bsam gtan rdo rje rab bskul bya/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor bsam gtan gyis/ /'khor lo can kun bzhugs par bya/ /mchod pa'i cho ga de nyid kyis/ /blo dang ldan pas rtag tu bya/ /slob dpon snying gar narab bsgoms nanas/ /dbang bskur ba ni brtsam par bya/ /sangs rgyas 81—568

kun gyis nam mkha'i dbyings/ /yongs su gang bar rnam bsgoms la/ /dbang bskur ba yi gnas gsum gyis/ /thams cad cho ga bzhin du dbab/ /sems can kun la phan 'dod pa'i/ /byang chub 'di yis 'bab 'gyur zhing / /ngo mtshar chen po'i dngos grub kun/ /sku gsung thugs ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dam tshig gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ bsam gtan gyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /de nas yang phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje 0)sbyor ba zhes bya ba sku dang / gsung dang /thugs rdo rje'i gsang ba 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /hūṃ hri khaṃ/ sha rus la sogs dkyil 'khor ni/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus su bsam/ /sku dang gsung thugs gsum snying po/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom par bya/ /drag po mi sdug khros pa ni/ /ut+pal sngon po'i kha dog 'dra/ /phyag bzhi pa yi cho ga yi/ /phyag na thod pa bsnams par bsgom/ /'od zer lnga rnams yang dag byung / /rang lce brtul zhugs can gyis bsgom/ /bsam gtan rdo rje sbyor ba yis/ /khrag drang ba ni mchog yin no/ /rtse gsum rdo rje dam tshig dang / /phur bu drag po mchog dag gis/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyi sku dag kyang / /rdo rje'i sbyor bas gdab par bya/ /de nas yang phyag na rdo rjes rdo rje'i kha zas kyi dam tshig gi bya ba 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang /thugs rdo rje las phyung 90ngo / /bza' ba'am btung ba gang cung zad/ /brtul zhugs can gyis gang bza' ba/ /bshang 9 —rigaci sha yi sbyor ba yis/ /cho ga bzhin du yongs su brtag /de nas yang phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje mchod pa'i mchog 'di//81—569

nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /mchod pa'i yo byad mchog lnga yi/ /mchod pas de dag mchod par bya/ /'di ni rdo rje thams cad kyi/ /dam tshig shin tu 'da' dka' ba'o/ /de nas yang phyag na rdo rje 0)de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi mchod pa gsang ba 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi (5)rdo rje las phyung ngo / /dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /bdag gi khu ba la sogs pa/ /cho ga bzhin du kun mchod na/ /sangs rgyas byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /de nas yang phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyod pa/ lus dang ngag dang sems kyi sdom pa 'di/ /nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /sems can khams rnams mtha' yas kyi/ /dam tshig 'dzin pa'i ma rnams la/ /dam tshig gsum gyi rdo rje spyad/ /sdom pa 'di ni rmad po che/ /de nas yang phyag na rdo rjes sgrub pa po thams cad kyi sdom pa'i rdo rje 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang /gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /lus dang dag sems longs spyod kyi//gsang ba gsum gnas rdo rje skyes/ /bzang po bdag gis bsgrub par bya/ /'dir ni yong ye 'jig par 'gyur/ /de nas yang phyag na rdo rjes sgrub pa po thams cad kyi rdo rje sems dpa'i sdom pa 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang /thugs rdo rje las phyung (dngo / /mtho gang tsam gyi dpags par ni/ /spyi bor dkyil 'khor brtag par bya/ /oṃ ni dbus su gnas bsams nas/ /bdud rtsi lnga po dbab par bya/ /rdo rje'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /skad cig dag gis gzi can 'gyur/ /lus dang ngag sems bder gnas par/ /'gyur bar 'di ni dogs pa med/ /de nas yang phyag na rdo rjes sngags 'dzin pa thams cad kyi lus 81—570

dang ske/ ngag dang / sems kyi gsang ba 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang /thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /mchod rten dag gi las mi bya/ /glegs bam bklags ①pa'ang mi bya zhing / /dkyil 'khor dag kyang yong mi bya/ /rdo rje gsum mchog phyag mi bya'o/ /de nas yang phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos/ dug thams cad 'byin pa'am/ gnon pa dang /'dren pa'i gsang ba 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /oṃ/ 'od zer dkar po'i phreng ba can/ /'khor lo'i dbus su chud par bzhag /'od zer ser po 'khrigs pa ni/ /ser po lta bur bsgom par bya/ /rdor gsum 'od zer dam tshig gis/ /sa bon gsang gsum las byung ba'o/ /de nas yang phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos / lus dang / ngag dang / sems srung ba'i 'khor lo'i sngags rdo rje dang ldan pa 'di/ nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /oṃ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ brta brnya/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ gro (mig la sogs 'khor lo ni/ /las kyi rdo rje la gnas par/ /haṃ ni dbus su bzhag nas su/ /ming ni dbus su bri bar bya/ /sngags kyi yi ge'i tshig rnams kyis/ /brgyan (5)te rtag tu gzhag (gepar bya/ /'di ni sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba gsum gyi gnas bsdus pa'o/ /de nas yang phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos/ rdo rje añja na'i dam tshig 'di / nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /lam gyi bzhi mdo shing gcig drung / /ma mo'i gnas sam zhi gnas su/ /de ru rdo rje añja na/ /thod par rtag tu dbab par bya/ /tshil chen po dang / khrag dang /81—571

bshang 3)ba dang / pad+mo'i skud pa dang / arga'i skud pas me mar gyi snying po byas la/ tshes nyi shu dgu'i nam byed na/ rdo rje añja na dbab par bya'o/ /de nyid la sngags brgya rtsa brgyad btab na/ dngos grub rnam pa gsum du 'gyur ro/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang pos gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das/gsang ba'i yi ge du dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i dam tshig gi spyod pa'i rdo rje 'di la dad cing sgom par 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa de dag la 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad/ gsang ba'i yi ge gsum dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyod pa'i rdo rje gang yin pa de la dad cing sgom par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsol pa/ gsum po gang zhig lags/ rdo rje 'dzin pas bka' stsal pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku rdo rje dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje ste gsum mo/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyis / bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje la phyag btsal ②nas cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' de dag la bka' stsal pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad/ sngon byung ba na 81—572

brjod kyis mi lang ba'i yang brjod kyis mi lang ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rdul rab tu phra ba dang mnyam pa'i bskal pa yang 'das nas/ gang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad 'das pa nas/ thub pa chen po 'od srung mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i bar gyis kyang ma gsungs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das gsang ba chen po'i gnas kyi don bshad pa de/ de'i tshe de'i dus na sems can rnams la skal ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba 'dus pa 'di la/ skad cig 0)thang cig yud tsam gyis sangs rgyas kyi byang chub rdzogs par byed do/ /gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi bskal par byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis 'bad cing btsal (shekyang byang chub thob par mi 'gyur ba de/ gsang ba 'dus pa la mngon par dga' ba'i byang chub sems dpa' tshe 'di nyid la de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis gsung rdo rje'i yi ge'i tshig 'di thos nas rab tu ngus so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyis byang chub sems dpa' de rnams la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /byang chub sems dpa' khyed rnams ma ngu zhig /sdug bsngal gsum la ma sgoms ( ——)shig /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la/ byang chub sems dpa' de rnams kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad/ ji ltar mi ngu bar bgyi/ ji ltar sdug bsngal gsum mi sgom par bgyi/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gsang ba'i yi ge'i ming tsam thos pa'i skal ba yang ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 81—573

bka' stsal pa/ de skad ma zer cig /yi ge ni thun mong ba 0)ste/ rigs kyi bu khyed rnams kyis ji ltar mi shes pa dang ma thos pa de bzhin du nged de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis kyang /rigs kyi bu/ gsang ba'i yi ge 'di dag ma thos shing mngon par sangs 92)rgyas sol/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gsang ba'i yi ge rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad cad mi smra bar gnas par gyur to//de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje'i btsun mo'i bha ga la bzhugs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang ske/ thugs kyi btsun mos/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje 'dzin chen po la dga' bas bstod pa/ sems can khams na gnas kyi dbang phyug khyed ②ni rdo rje'i thugs/ /dga' ba yid 'ong don chen 'dod pas bdag la bskyab tu gsol/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /sems can yab chen gnyen mchog bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi btsun mor mā ma khris/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje 'dzin chen po la/ rdo rje 'dod pa'i dga' ba'i mchod pa'i mchog gi yi ge'i tshig 'dis yang dag par bstod do/ /rdo rje'i sku khyod bka' yi 'khor lo sems can kun la phan/sangs rgyas don du byang chub don dam rjes su phan ston pa/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /'dod chags dam tshig chags pas 81—574

bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po la/ 'jig rten gyi dbang phyug gi sku dang /gsung dang / thugs rdo rje'i spyan gyis/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la 'dod pa la nye bar longs spyod pa'i dam tshig gis yang dag par bstod pa/ /khyod ni rdo rje'i gsung ste kun la phan zhing thugs brtse ba/ /'jig rten dag gi dgos pa'i don mdzad pa la rtag tu brtson/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /rab dga'i spyod pa kun tu bzang po bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang /gsung dang / thugs kyi dam tshig rdo rje'i btsun mos/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje 'dzin chen po la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bde ba dang / yid bde ba'i dga' ba 'dis bstod do / /khyod ni rdo rje 'dod pa dam tshig mchog gi phan don che/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gdung mchog mnyam pa nyid gzigs pa/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /yon tan rin chen mang po'i gter gyur bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa 'dod chags thams cad nye bar longs spyod pa'i rdo rje'i dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi btsun mo de dag la dam tshig gi 'khor los 'dod pa spyod cing cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /de nas nam mkha'i dbyings 'di dag thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang /thugs rdo rje'i dam tshig gi khu bas yongs su gang ste/ bum pa rdo rje chus gang ba 81—575

ltar gnas par gyur to/ /de nas rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings 'di na gang sems can sku gsum gyi dam tshig las/ yang dag par byung ba de rnams rdo rje'i dpal gyis reg nas/ thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje gsum gyi ye shes can du gyur to/ /de nas brtsams te sems can thams cad kun tu bzang po kun tu bzang po zhes/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rjes dbang bskur bar gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /bcom ldan 'das/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad chos thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid mthong ngam de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje ye shes kyi spyod pa mthong lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa/ mthong lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi btsun mo'i bha ga las mngon par byung nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa phyag na rdo rje chen po la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gang 'dod chags kyi yi ge'i tshig gis sangs rgyas kyi byang chub rjes su rtogs pa de ni/ bcom ldan 'das/ ngo mtshar to / /bde bar gshegs pa/ ngo mtshar to/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad de skad ma zer cig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos thams cad ni nam mkha'i rdo rje'i 81—576

dam tshig dang mtshungs pa'i phyir gzugs kyi phung po ma yin/ tshor ba'i phung po ma yin/ 'du shes kyi phung po ma yin/ 'du byed kyi phung po ma yin/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po ma yin/ khams ma yin/ skye mched ma yin/ de bzhin du 'dir 'dod chags ma yin/ zhe sdang ma yin/ gti mug ma yin/ chos ma yin chos ma yin pa yang ma yin no/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa phyag na rdo rjes/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' de rnams la bka' stsal pa/ khyed rnams kyis 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje 'di bsgo bar gyis shig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ phyogs bcu na gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de rnams chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la skal ba yod pa'i phyir rol/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos/ rdo rje chos la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig gi de kho na nyid 'di gzung zhig1 /khyod kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis chos kyi dbang phyug rdo rje zhes dbang bskur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje chos kyis de bzhin du bgyi'o/ /zhes gsol nas cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge gsum la rang gi sku dang / gsung dang /thugs zhugs par gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa sku rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad khams gsum thams cad kyi lus rdo rje la gnas shing / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku mnyam pa nyid la dmigs nas cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /81—577

de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gsung rdo rje khams gsum thams cad kyi ngag rdo rje la gnas shing / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung mnyam pa nyid la dmigs nas cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa phyag na rdo rje khams gsum thams cad kyi sems rdo rje la gnas shing / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs mnyam pa nyid la dmigs nas cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi gsang ba gsang ba 'dus pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig dang / sdom pa rdo rje'i byin gyis brlabs kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bcu bdun pa'o// //de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs gsang zhing rab tu gsang ba zhes bya ba rtog pa chen po'i rgyal po rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po thab ka ra warma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī dz+nyā 1)na ka ra bas bshad nas/ zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba 'gos lhas btsas kyis zhus gtugs g.yar khral du 'tshal ba'o/ /'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud la lo chen gyis bsgyur ba mang du snang na'ang / 'gos kyis 'gyur bcos mdzad pa nyung bar snang la/'grel ba'i bshad pa 'gos 'gyur gyi steng nas byed pa la rgyud kyi 'gos 'gyur gal che bar mthong nas bris pa'o// //81—578
