ni ci/ /pradz+nyā :ka 1ces gang la bgyi/ /rigs 'dir de bzhin gang zhig lags na / /mo ha zhes ni gang la bgyi/ /de ṣa zhes bya ge 'dir gang lags④/ /rā ga zhes ni ci la bgyi/ /badz+ra sngags ni gang la bgyi/ ra ti zhes 'dir gang la bgyi/ /phun 95sum tshogs pa gang zhig lags/ /ya mān+ta kṛta yidon ni gang / /de bzhin pradz+nyā n+ta sakṛta /ci/ /pad mān+ta kṛta (7ming ci lta/ /de bzhin bighan+ta kṛta 57ci/ /kun du spyod pa gang ci lags/ /de bzhin sngags kyi spyod pa gang / /'dir ni bzlas pa gang zhig lags/ /rgyas btab pa zhes gang la bgyi/ /chos 'byung ba ni ji ltar bsgom/ /de bzhin sdom pa ji lta bu/ /zhe snang gti mug 'dod chags chos11/ /sems can don mdzad ji lta bu/ /dkyil 'khor zhes ni gang la bgyi/ /phyag rgya'i dgod pa ji 51nyaltar lags/ /'dir ni me tog ci zhig lags / /mchod rten zhes ni gang la bshad/ /ye shes 'khor lo hunyeji ltar shes/ /'dir ni gnas shes 6gang la bshad/ /mgon po bskul ba ji lta bu/ /gtong ba dag kyang ji lta bu/ /ji ltar de rnams spyan 8drang bgyi/ /bcing ba 'dir ni ji lta bu/ /dbang bskur ba ni ji ltar stsal/ /de bzhin rig pa'i brtul zhugs gang ske/ /bdud rtsi lnga rnams ci 39ltar bza'/ /de bzhin dpa' bo lnga gang lags / /dngos grub tha mal ji lta bu/ /de bzhin mchog kyang ji lta bu/ /de la thabs ni rnam pa du/ /de bzhin thabs byung ji lta bu/ /rnal 'byor rdo rje can kun gyi/ /bka' ni ji ltar bsgo bar bgyi/ /las kyi mchog gi tshogs rnams ni//sna tshogs ji ltar byed par 'gyur/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de hunyernams kyis zhus pa'i tshig nye bar gsan nas/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje 'dzin pa la dmigs 81—586

par mdzad nas skad cig cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' che/ /snying rje'i bdag nyid rab dga' nas/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bde bar gshegs/ /mgon la yang dang yang rab bskul/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyis 1byang chub sems dpa' de rnams la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /(bsku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yis/ /sku gsung thugs ni rdo rje la/ /bzhag nga)nas byang chub sems dbang po/ /zhus pa rgya chen mnyan 5par gyis / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyis rjes su gsungs pa'i 6)bka' spyi bos rab tu mnos te/ bcom ldan 'das legs so legs so/ /bde bar gshegs pa legs so legs so zhes gsol nas/ rang rang gi tsho lus dang ngag dang yid rdo rjes byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje tshon)la dmigs te cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad rang rang gi thugs rdo 99)rje chen po la dmigs par byin gyis brlabs 1 rinas byang chub sems dpa' chen po de 11dag rnams la zhus pa de dag gsung gcig gis bka' stsal pa/ sku gsung thugs ni rnam pa gsum/ /gsang ba zhes ni bstan pa yin/ /sangs rgyas thams cad ces bya ba/ /tshogs pa 'dus pa yin par bshad/ /lnga pa dang ni dgu pa dang / /bcu bdun pa dang bcu gsum pa/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems rnams kyis/ /bstan pa dag ni sgrub chen yin/ /bzhi pa dang ni bcu drug pa/ /brgyad pa de bzhin bcu gnyis pa/ /slob dpon spyi yi las dang ni/ /dngos grub brtul zhugs sdom pa yin/ /drug pa dang ni gnyis pa dang / /bcu pa dang ni bcu 81—587

bzhi pa/ /drag spyod rjes su chags pa dang / /nye bar sgrub ①pa'i sdom pa'o/ /bdun pa dang ni gsum pa dang / /bcu gcig pa dang bco 98)lnga pa/ /dngos grub zhing dang mtshan ma ni/ /bsnyen pa sgrub 9kyepa'i sdom pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi las/ /tshar gcod phan 'dogs spyod pa dag /dul dang gdul dka' zhi ba yi/ /sems can rnams kyi 'jug pa'o/ /bskyed 0pa'i rim dang 'brel ba yi/ /bsnyen pa rdo rje'i (5)cho ga bzhi/ /thun mong dngos grub 'brel pa yin/ /mchog tu gyur pa'i gzhung 3)nyid do/ /dkyil 'khor brtul zhugs 'brel ba yi/ /gzhung ni slob dpon phun tshogs pa'o/ /bla mas sngags kyi lam gyis ni/ /slob ma yongs su smin bya ba/ /brtul zhugs bzang dang dbang bskur ba/ /rang gi slob ma bdag nyid che/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems rnams kyis ri/ /ston pas yongs su grol ba yin/ /thabs dang shes rab snyoms 'jug pa/ /rnal 'byor zhes ni bshad pa yin/ /gang zhig dngos med shes rab ste/ /thabs ni dngos po'i mtshan nyid do/ /rgyud ni rgyun zhes bya bar grags / /rgyun de rnam pa gsum 'gyur te'ad/ /gzhi dang de bzhin rang bzhin dang ske/ /mi 'phrog 9)pa yis rab phye ba/ / rnam pa /khurang bzhin rgyu yin te/ /de bzhin mi 'phrogs 'bras bu'o/ /gzhi ni thabs shes nyamabya ba ste/ /gsum gyis rgyud kyi don bsdus pa'o/ /rigs 8ni lnga dang gsum dag dang / /ngo bo nyid gcig 5nye rigs brgya'o/ /byang chub rdo rje bcas gsungs pa/ /de ni phyi ma'i rgyud du 'dod/ /de nyid rnam pa lnga ru bshad/ /gsang ba rnam pa gsum du bshad/ /lhag ma'i lalha ni gsang 15chen te/ /dam pa'i tsherigs ni rnam pa brgya/ /thog ma tha ma med zhi ba/ /dngos dang dngos med (7zad pa'i ri12gtso/ /stong nyid snying rje 81—588

mi phyed pa1)/ /byang chub sems zhes (2)bya ba yin/ /sku gsung rdo thugs kyi rdo rje yis / /mi phyed dbye ba'i ngo bo (na)nyid/ /rigs 5 dang lhan cig ldan pas na/ /rig pa'i skyes bu zhes brjod do/ /rgyu lnga dang ni 'bras bu lnga/ /rdo rje zhes ni bshad pa yin/ /'chang ba 'dzin pa zhes grags te67/ / rnam shes rdo rje 'dzin du 'dod3)/ /badz+ra jika 785ni rnam shes yin/ /yod dang med dang dbus las 'das / /'byung dang 'byung las gyur las byung / /sems can kun gyi lus yin te/ /skye las rgyal ba (9)dzi na dzika /don rnams thams cad 'byung bas na//sems ni rin po che zhes bya/ /tshor ba po yis tsho11nges tshor bas tshor ba rat+na :ka nyustetu 'dod3lha/ /mtshan gzhi nyu )mtshan nyid dngos po yis/ /kun la kun gyis thams cad du/ /dga' ba'i mtshan nyid mtshan gzhi ni/ / ā ro lika 1lhaces bshad pa yin/ /rnam shes rab mthar phyin byed pa/ /gang yin de ni shes rab ste/ /'du byed sems pa tshe'adzin pas na/ /pradz+nyā sgrika nyu 1ces bya bar bshad//rigs ni 8rgyud ces bya bar bshad/ /rgyud ni thog ma zhes brjod de/ /mi 'jigs yoskye ba med gang yin/ /mgon po de ni yin par bshad/ /rgyu 'bras gnyis la snang bas na/ /rnam shes zhe sdang yin par bshad/ /bems po bcings pa'i rang bzhin pas/ /gzugs ni gti mug ces byar bshad/ /bdag tu rlom tsho )pa'i ngo bo bas/ /tshor ba dregs 1pa yin par bshad/ /dngos la chags pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /'du shes yang dag chags bdag nyid/ / rgyan gyis drang ba'i 32bdag nyid can/ /'du byed rtag tu phrag dog yin/ /byang chub sems kyi ngo bo nyid/ /srid pa kun 'byung thams cad du/ /'dod chags zhe sdang rmongs ldan pa'i/ /sems ni 'dod pa zhes byar 2lhabashad/ /dam tshig sna 81wa 589

tshogs 'dra ba yin(1)/ /mngon phyogs las las skyes 'bras bu/ /gnyis med ye shes chos rnams la/ /nga rgyal byed pa rmongs zhes 2)bshad/ /de la phan tshun 'dzer ba ni/ /zhe sdang zhes ni bya bar bshad/ /mtshan nyid 'dod chags zhen pa yin/ /ye shes thabs ni rdo rjer bshad/ /dga' ba rdzogs pa'i longs spyod mchog /bud med bde mchog phun sum tshogs/ /gti mug zhe snang 'dod chags dang / /rdo rje la dga' rtag par gnas/ / des na (bsangs rgyas rnams kyi thabs/ /rdo rje theg pa zhes bshad do/ /mi 'jig ( )bdag nyid chos rnams ni / /ma skyes pa yi 55ngo bo nyid/ /dngos po kun gyi dam tshig ste/ /de nyid gshin rje mthar byed do/ /rnam shes min bdag chos rnams ni/ /don dam mi 'gyur dag gyur te6/ /sems kun gyi ni dam tshig ste/ / de nas rdzirgyal ba shes mthar byed/ /brjod med bdag nyid chos rnams ni/ /ming dang gzugs blo dngos po med/ /chos rnams kun gyi dam tshig ste/ / des na (na/khyab bdag pad mthar byed/ / mi rtog ri9bdag nyid chos rnams ni/ /rang bzhin gyis ni zhi ba'i dngos/ /rdo rje kun gyi dam tshig ste/ / des na 7gtso bo bgegs mthar byed / /mi 'jig 11rnam par mi shes pa/ /brjod du med dang rtog bral ba/ /sangs rgyas byang chub ye shes 'di/ /shes na bde ba thob par 'gyur/ /gti mug gti mug longs spyod pas/ /gti mug zad phyir gshin rje gshedaphoge/ /des na lus mthar byed pa ste/ /des na shes bya mthar byed 'gyur/ /nyes pa nyes pa longs spyod pas/ /nyes pa zad phyir shes mthar byed/ /des na sems ni mthar byed de15/ /des na nyon mongs mthar byed 'gyur/ /'dod chags 'dod chags longs spyod pas/ /'dod chags zad pas pad mthar byed/ /81—590

des na 0)chags pa (semathar byed de'o zhi/ /de bzhin snyoms 'jug mthar byed 'gyur④ / /nyon mongs kun zad gang yin dang / /de bzhin las ni thams cad zad / /sgrib pa kun zad ye shes ni/ /bgegs mthar byed ces bya bar bshad/ /nyon mongs rdo rje'i tsosgrib dag na/ /las rnams thams cad rnam par dag /las rnams thams cad rnam dag pas/ /las skyes 'bras bu rnam dag 'gyur/ /gzung ⑥dang chags pa nyid dang ni/ /rnam pa de bzhin mi g.yo dang / /rgyu nyid 'bras bu nyid dag ste/ /drug las thugs ni kun du 'byung / /'dod pa'i rgyal po la sogs drug /khro bo'i dbang por ( rnam par grags/ /dam tshig rdo rje la sogs drug /sa la sogs pa rnam pa lnga/ /'byung dang 'byung las gyur par grags / /rig pa'i rgyal por tshon /zhes bshad do/ /gzugs kyi rdo rje la sogs drug /rdo rje'i ⑨bdag po zhes bshad do/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje las/ /bdag nyid chen po kun du 'byung / /thabs dang shes rab las byung ba'i/ /phung po khams dang skye mched gzugs/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /sngags pas 7sbyor ba nges byas la/ /thams cad dag par mos pa yis/ /'jigs pa thams cad spangs nas su/ /dogs pa med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /sngags pas humaseng ge bzhin du spyod/ /'di la mi bya ci yang med/ /de bzhin mi bza'ang tu yod ma yin/ /smra bar mi bya cung zad med/ /rtag tu mi bsam ci yang med/ /mnyam par ma bzhag rtso sbyor ba yis/ /rtag pa nyid du mnyam par 'jogatso /gang gis sems kun la spyod pa/ /kun du spyod pa zhes bshad do/ /dbang po dang ni yul rnams kyi/ /rkyen gyis gang dang gang byung yid/ /yid de man zhes 8bya bar bshad/ / tra ni skyob par 7byed pa'i don/ /'jig rten 81—591

spyod las rnam grol bar/ /gang bshad dam tshig sdom pa ste/ /rdo rje kun gyis bsrungs 1pa ni/ /sngags kyi spyod pa zhes bshad do/ /rang rang gi ni ngo bo nyid//snying po yid kyis 2rnam bsams te/ /gsang sngags zlos 90pa'i dbye ba yis/ /zlos par byed cing spro zhing bsdu/ /sangs rgyas sna tshogs rdo rje'i bdag /ye shes sa bon dag gis bsdu / /byang chub bdag med sa bon gyis/ /brtul zhugs can gyis bdag med gzung 95/ /sna tshogs bzhin du sna sgyuratshogs spro/ /dus gsum sa bon dag gis bzla / /bzlas pa 8༄smra bar grags pas na/ /ngag kun bzlas pa zhes bshad la/ /sngags kun 'bod pa zhes bshad de/ /de nyid bskul 9cichibar smra ba'o/ /ji ltar thugs sogs byin rlob pa/ /ting nge 'dzin kyang de bzhin no/ /de rnams spyi bor dbang bskur tsodang / /de bzhin kun du mchod pa'o/ /rdo rje 'chang ba gang yin pa'i/ /rig pa yod pa'i sbyor ba dang / /bdag byin brlab 511sogs de bzhin te/ /de yi longs spyod bzhir shes bya/ /dpa' bo rdo rje gcig pu yi/ /spyi bor dbang bskur re re ste/ /snying po phyag rgya sngags tsam dang 12/ /rang rigs rim gyis 1 rgyas gdab pa'oḥste/ /'bras bus rgyu ni rgyas gdab cing / /rgyu yis 'bras bu rgyas gdab par/ /bsgom 8gyi gzhan du dngos grub ni/ /bskal pa bye bar 'byung mi 'gyur/ /longs spyod bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /rig pa'i skyes bu rdo rje can/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbye ba yis/ /gru gsum du ni rnam par bsgoms/ /kun nas ser ba'i 1 sgyu'akhor lo ni/ /rtsibs bcu de dbus rnam par bsgom18/ /rtsibs kun la ni khro bo bcu/ /ye shes bdag nyid bcu las byung / /'gog pa'i rdo rjes bsgom bya zhing / /mchog tu mdzes pas 19bsgrub par bya/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i sprin spros 3 )pas mi 81wa 592

g.yo ba dang mtshungs par 'khor/ /de ltar chos 'byung ye shes ni/ /rang bzhin dri ma med zhi ba/ /bsgoms pas skad cig nyid kyis ni/ /sangs rgyas 1spyan ni rab tu 'byung / /rdo rje can gyis chos bstan pa/ /rim pa gnyis la yang dag brten/nas/ /bskyed pa yi (2)ni rim nyid dang / /de bzhin rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /sgrub pa dang ni nan tan dang / /dam tshig de bzhin sdom pa rnams / /sngar ni de kun rgyas par ni/ /rim pa'i dbye bas phye ba yin/ /gzugs dang sgra tsho4)sogs 'dod pa ni/ /bde sdug gnyi ga'i 95)bdag nyid can/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug sogs/ /rtag tu snying la (6༄skye bar 'gyur/ /chags la 'dod chags rdo rje can/ /rdo rje 'dra bar rin chen 'byung / /rin chen bzhin du dam tshig shes/ /'dod pa de rnams dam tshig mtshungs/ /rnam bcas dang ni rnam pa med/ /kun 'gro yi ge gsum bdag nyid/ /bya ba dang ni dbrog pa dang / /spro (7skudang rang gi bzlas pa bya'o 8ri/ /de ltar zhe snang gti mug dag /sa gsum du ni bskyed par bya/ /gsang ba'i bdag pos rgyas btab 79cing ske/ /rdo rje can gyi 7don byed do/ /zhe sdang sbyor ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ /zhe sdang 'khor lo bskyed 11nas su/ /rdo rje drag pos bcom nas ni/ /ye shes rdo rje can gyis bsdu/ /de ni spro bas rtogs 12byas la/ /de bzhin slar yang bsdu bar bya'o / /'di lta'i sbyor ba 1dgoms byas na/ /zhe snang rdo rjer sabadag nyid 'gyur//khams gsum po ni ma lus pa/ /bsad bedang de bzhin gso ba dang glu/ /skad cig tsam gyis byed par ni/ /mngon du nus par the tshom med/ /gti mug sbyor ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ /gti mug 'khor lo bskyed nas ni/ /rgyan la sogs pa gang ci'ang rung / /de dag thams cad rtag tu brkya1 / /gti mug sems kyi rgya 81wa 593

mtsho bsgom(11/ /rin chen kun gyis rin/rab tu dgang / /gti mug 'khor lo can kun gyis/ /sbyin pa'i char ni rab tu 'bebs/ /rdzas rnams thams cad ma lus par/ /rab tu sbyin dang dbrog pa nyid/ /sems kyi rdo rje brtan (0po yis/ /skad cig tsam gyis dbye bar kha'agyur/ /'dod chags sbyor ba'i rnal 'byor pas//'dod chags 'khor lo bskyed nas ni/ /lha mo thams cad phrogs nas su/ /'dod pa'i sbyor bas 'dod pa spyod/ /dga' sdug bde bas 95)rangs pa yis/ /'dod pa'i rtsed mos 6)rnam par 'phrul/ /de nas 'khor lo can kun la/ /lha mo rab tu dbul bar bya/ /khams gsum dag tu byung ba yi/ /lha dang lha min chung ma yang 7)/ /skad cig tsam gyis 'dod spyod na/ /mi yi bud med smos (kyeci dgos / /dkyil 'khor dang ni dbang bskur dang / /las mchog gi ni tshogs rnams dag /nyams su len 99nacing byin rlob pa/ /grub pa'i bgrod pa gzhan yin no/ /bha ga'i dkyil 'khor zhes grags dang / /byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor dang / /lus kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bshad pa/ /gsum po dkyil 'khor yin par gsungs/ /phung po skye mched khams rnams ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rgyas btab pa'o/ / des ni tshertag par rgya dgod pa/ /dkyil 'khor zhes ni bstan pa yin/ /12lcags kyu dbyig to /tshartse gsum dang / /ral gri mtshams su rnam par dgod/ / 'dod rgyal dbyig sngon stobs mi g.yonyuge/ /steng du 'khor lo 'og gnod mdzes/ /rig rgyal rdo rje can rnams kyi/ /'khor los sgyur 57ba drug gi rgya/ /sa la sogs pa 8sems dpa' yi/ /phyag rgya rang gi dkyil 'khor pa/ /me long pi wang mdung dang ni/ /de bzhin snod kyi dang sna tshogs ras/ /chos 'byung ba yi phyag rgya drug /rdo rje'i bdag po rdo rje can/ /81—594

sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /khro rgyal rnams kyis rgyas gdab bo/ /de nas gzhan yang dpa' bo gcig /rigs ni kha dog dag gis brtag /lha mo dgu dang nam mkha'i khams/ /me tog ces ni bshad pa yin/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbye ba yis/ /rigs kyi rim gyis 1)dgod par bya/ /mchod rten sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /bzhugs tshon gnas pho brang yin par bshad/ /ye shes sems dpas dun)gang reg pa/ /ye shes 'khor lo zhes bshad do/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje gsum yi ge/ /sa bon yi ge gnas zhes ( ribashad/ /sku gsung thugs kyi de nyid ni/ /sad par byas pas 95 bskul bar bshad/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams rnams su/ /'od zer 'gyed pa gtong ba'o/ /rdo rje can kun spyan 'dren pas/ /rdo rje can kun spyan drang ba'o/ /rdo rje can gyi gnas de yi/ /'od zer gyis ni rdo rje kun/ /bsdus nas gong bu'i tshul gyis su/ /bcings pa bcing ba yin par bshad/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yis/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /sku gsung thugs ni 96)rgyas btab ste/ /ri mo'i dkyil 'khor brtag par bya/ /dbang bskur dbye ba rnam gsum du/ /rgyud 'di la ni rab tu brtag /bum pa'i dbang bskur dang po ste/ /gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba/ /shes rab ye shes gsum pa ste/ /bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no / /mig yangs sngags kyi snod du rung / /me tog bcas shing sa bon byung / /blangs nas gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba/ /sngags pas slob ma dag la sbyin/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /dri chu rkang dang yang dag ldan/ /rdo rje pad+ma'i sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje can kun yang dag bsdu/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yis/ /de dag thams cad snying gar 7ribasdu/ /rdo rje'i lam nas byung nas 81wa 595

su / /slob ma'i khar ni dbab par bya/ /'di ni gsang sngags de kun gyi/ /dbang bskur ba yi go 'phang mchog /las mchog gi ni tshogs rnams dang / /gsang sngags thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /mchog tu dad cing shes rab che/ /gzugs bzang sgrub 17pa po la dgan/ /sbyor ba gcig gis bya ba goms/ /dam tshig dag gi nadam tshig can/ /bla ma la ni slob ma yis/ /yon rnams rab tu phul nas ni/ /bla mas de ni byin brlabs lde te/ /sgrub pa po la sbyin par bya/ /rmongs pas gti mug bdag nyid sbyor/ /gti mug dga' dang yang dag ldan/ /gti mug rgyun gyis dbang bskur riman/ /gti mug rdo rjer bdag nyid 'gyur/ /zhe sdang sdang ba'i bdag nyid sbyor/ /zhe snang dga' dang yang dag ldan/ /zhe snang rgyun gyis dbang bskur na/ /zhe sdang rdo rjer bdag nyid 'gyur/ /chags pas 5'dod chags bdag nyid sbyor/ /'dod chags dga' dang yang dag ldan/ /'dod chags rgyun gyis dbang bskur na/ /'dod chags rdo rjer bdag nyid 'gyur / /shes rab ye shes bdag nyid sbyor/ /rdo rje dga' ba (snyonayang dag ldan/ /ye shes rgyun gyis dbang bskur na/ /shes rab ye shes bdag nyid 'gyur/ /rig pa'i lha mo de nyid ni/ /rdo rje can gyi slob mas blang / /lag par lag pa bzhag 7nas ni/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams dbang na byas la/ /slob ma'i mgo bor lag bzhag 9)ste/ /bla ma rdo rje can gyis bsgo/ /thabs gzhan gyis ni 'tshang mi rgya/ /de bas rig pa 'di mchog yin/ /chos kun gnyis su med pa la / /dngos po gnyis su btags 7pa yin/ /de bas 'khor ba rnam bral b.ranyaste//rtag tu khyod 12kyis mi bya'o/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs bla med pa'o/ /rmongs pa gang zhig 'das gyur na/ /de yi dngos 81wa 596

grub mchog mi 'gyur/ /tha mal 1lus kyi chos la ni/ /dri ma lnga rnams snang ba ni / /ye shes lnga yis byin brlabs pas/ /bdud rtsi lnga zhes bya bar bshad/ /sbar midang de bzhin sreg kyepa dang / /snang bar byed cadang gzugs snang ba/ /sngags kyi lus su rab sbyor bas/ /bdud rtsi lnga ni bza' bar bya/ /rdo rje rtsu las byung ba ni/ /bar snang la gnas bsam par bya/ /āḥ(5)las byung ba'i pad+ma ni / /de yi 'og tu bsgom par bya/ /oṃ gyis mtshan pa'i bdud rtsi ni/ /de yi dbus su gzhag par bya/ / rdo rje'i pad+ma mnyam sbyor ba 6)/ /'bar bas rnal 'byor tshim par bya/ /shel ri dang mtshungs par snang gyur cing / /ye shes nyi ma gnyis par gyur(8)/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams rnams kyi/ /mtshon cha mchog gis drangs 99rinas ni/ /bdud rtsi de ru phab nas kyang / /bza' ba'i sbyor bas bza' bar bya/ /bsgrub nya bya'i dngos grub cho ga yis/ /de bzhin dpa' bo lnga rnams bza'/ /yig gsum sa bon las bskyed bya/ /gzhan 11du de ni 'grub mi 'gyur8/ /mi snang la sogs dngos grub ni/ /tha mal pa zhes bshad pa yin/ /sangs rgyas nyid bsgrub 1lhasangs rgyas kyis/ /dngos grub mchog ces gsungs pa yin/ /thabs ni rnam pa bzhi po dag /byang chub rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rnal 'byor rgyud ni thams cad du/ /rnal 'byor pa yis rtag par bsngags / /bsnyen pa'i cho ga dang po ste/ /nye bar sgrub 8pa gnyis pa yin / /sgrub pa yang ni gsum pa ste17/ /sgrub pa chen po bzhi pa'o/ /thun mong mchog gi bye brag gis/ /bsnyen pa rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur/ /rdo rje bzhi po thun mong ste/ /ye shes bdud rtsi mchog yin no/ /dang po stong nyid byang chub ste/ /gnyis pa sa bon bsdu ba nyu yin/ /gsum pa gzugs ni rdzogs pa ste/ /bzhi pa 81—597

yi ge dgod pa'o/ /rdo rje rnam bzhi 'di dag gis/ /tha mal sgrub )tshol bsnyen pa kunabya / /mchog gi 95)ye shes bdud rtsi nyid/ /sbyor ba drug gi (41bya ba yi(5)/ /bsnyen pa yan lag drug gis ni/ /byas pas sgrub 96)pa mchog tu 'gyur/ /gzhan du bsgrubs 7par gyur na ni/ / dngos grub mchog ni 'byung mi 'gyur/ /(she so sor sdud dang bsam gtan dang / /srog rtsol de bzhin 'dzin pa dang / /rjes su dran dang ting 'dzin te/ /sbyor ba'i yan lag drug tu bshad/ /dbang po bcu po rnams kyi yang / /rang gi 'jug gnas 7thams cad du/ /'dod pa so sor sdud nyu )pas na/ /so sor 3)sdud pa zhes bshad do/ /'dod pa lnga ni mdor bsdus nas / /sangs rgyas lnga ru sbyor ba yis/ /brtag pa bsam gtan zhes bshad denyan / /bsam gtan de ni rnam lngar 'gyur/ /rtog dang dpyod 12dang dga' ba dang ske/ /de bzhin bde ba nyid dang yang / /sems kyi rtse gcig nyid dag ste/ /lnga po der ni bsam gtan bsdu/ /gsang ba'i rgyud ni thams cad du/ /rnam pa du mar yongs bshad pa/ /gsang ba gsum 'byung birtog pa ste/ /de yi longs spyod byed 7pa'o/ /dga' dang 'dra ba gsum pa ste/ /bde ba bsdus pa (7bzhi pa'o / /shes dang shes bya byung zad pa'i/ /rang sems lnga par shes par bya(1 tsho/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos zhi ba ni/ /'dod pa kun la rab tu gnas/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin dbugs/ /'byung ba lnga yi ngo bo nyid/ /gong bu'i gzugs kyi phyung nas ni/ /sna yi rtse mor /sherab tu brtag /rin chen kha dog sna lnga pa/ /srog dang rtsol 17ba zhes byar bshad/ /rang sngags snying gar bsams nas ni )/ /srog ni thig ler gyur par bzhag /rang dbang rin chen dag pa yin/ /gzung zhutsāb 'dzin pa yin par bshad/ /sems ni 'gog pa'i rdo rjer gyur/ /mtshan 81wa 598

mar (1)nyer 'dzin 'byung bar 'gyur/ /mtshan ma'i khams ni rnam pa lngar/ /byang chub rdo rjes gsungs pa yin/ /smig rgyu 'dra ba dang po ste/ /du ba lta bu gnyis pa yin/ /mkha' snang 'dra ba gsum pa ste/ /mar me ltar 'bar bzhi pa'o / /sprin med nam mkha' lta bur ni/ /rtag tu snang ba lnga pa'o/ /brtan gyur ②rdo rje'i lam nas ni/ /nam mkha'i khams su spro bar bya/ /rjes dran gang zhig rnam bsgom 9༷pa/ /de dang 'dra bar spro bar bya/ /rjes su dran pa zhes bshad de/ /so sor snang ba de la skye/ /thabs dang shes rab snyoms 'jug pas//dngos po thams cad mdor bsdus pa/ /gong bu'i tshul gyis bsdus nas ni/ /dbus su gzugs ni rnam par bsgomachos/ / yud kyis (de ye shes rdzogs byed pa6/ /ting nge 'dzin ces (3)bya bar gnas/ /so sor sdud la snyoms 'jug na/ /sngags rnams thams cad byin gyis rlob98na/ /bsam gtan ye shes snyoms 'jug na/ /mngon shes lnga po 'thob (9)par 'gyur/ /srog dang rtsol ⑩bas nges par ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis nyanyagazigs/ /rtag tu 'dzin pa'i stobs kyis ni / /rdo rje sems dpa' yang dag 'byung nyarte/ /rjes dran mnyam par sbyor ba yis / / 'od kyi 3rnyedakyil 'khor 'byung bar 'gyur/ /ting 'dzin dbang gyur tsam gyis ni/ /sgrib pa rnams dang bral bar 'gyur/ /snying po de ni thugs ka 7ru / /zla ba rdo rje'i sbyor bas blta/ /mtshon cha mchog gis drangs nas ni/ /sems ni sngags kyi dngos byas tetshe/ /sngags kyi gzugs kyi tshul gyis ni/ /byang chub tshigs bcad brjod par bya/ /cho ga yang dag sbyor bsgom 17pas/ /rang gi dkyil 'khor la gnas te1 / /sems de ye shes gzugs kyis ni/ /bsgom hunyepa nye bar bsgrub 19pa'o/ /ji srid mthong ba de srid du/ /rnam gnyis zla 81wa 599

ba drug tu bsgom17/ /'dod pa kun la longs spyod pas/ /thams cad du ni rtag tu bya/ /gal te zla ba drug gis ni/ /ji skad gsungs pa ma mthong na/ /ji skad bshad pa'i cho ga dang / /sdom pa tshalan gsum brtsam tsho0par bya/ /de ltar byas kyang sgrub 4pa pos/ /mthong ba 'byung bar ma gyur cing / /gang tshe bya ba 5ma grub na/ /drag shul sbyor bas bsgrub (6par bya/ /de ri kyitshe de yi ye shes ni//'grub pa nges par nye bar 'byung / /rigs kyi dbye ba'i sbyor bas ni/ /rdo rje phur bus phur bu gdab/ /de nas dbang du bya ba dang / /srung 984)ba'i sbyor ba dag kyang bya/ /'dod chags chen po'i tshul nyid kyis(shen/ /ye shes 'khor lo can ’ rnams bsdu/ /lha mo dgu ni spros nas su/ /bsgrub par bya ba'i lus la dgod / /yongs su gyur las phyag rgya bzhi11/ /dkyil 'khor der ni brtag lhonyepar bya/ /bdag nyid dbus su gnas byas 1 la/ /'khor lo can kun bsdu bar bya / /thams cad rdo rje'i dngos byas la/ /de 'og byang chub bsgom par bya/ /bskul ba'i glu dbyangs bzhi yoyis ni/ /lha mos snying po bskul ba yis/ /dus gsum rdo rje'i rang bzhin sems/ /ye shes lta bur lus sgom bomo/ / dregs pas 7kha dog rnam par dbye1 / /de bzhin nyams kyi 12snying po ste/ /dbang bskur bas ni rang gi rgyu/ /gzhi 36yis 'bras bu phye ba yin/ /sngags kyis )chos ni byed 'gyur la/ /rig pa'ang chos kyi phyag rgyas so/ /'khor los sgyur )ba'i rgyal po drug /gtsug tor zhes ni rnam par grags/ /rdzu 'phrul chen pos zhugelongs spyod bzhi/ /rig pa'i rgyal mo zhes byar grags/ /de bzhin rdo rje'i bdag po rnams/ /'dod pa thams cad ces byar bshad/ /bsam gtan rdo rje gethams cad la/ /dbang bskur ba ni rab tu bsngags/ /cho ga'i sbyor ba 'di 81wa 600

yis ni/ /ye shes lus dang lhan cig tu/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yis/ /gnyis su med par byed sgrub pa/ /sngar bshad pa yi rim gyis ni/ /rig 1pa'i skyes bu rdo rje can/ /bdag dang 'dra bar dkyil 'khor bskyed/ /sgrub 27pa chen po zhes bshad do/ /bsnyen pa'i dus su gtsug tor che / /sbyor ba nyid kyis 47gzugs su dmigs/ /nye bar sgrub pa'i dus su ni/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i gzugs kyi bar/ /sngags pa cho ga shes pa yis/ /sgrub pa rang lha'i sbyor bas bya / /sgrub ④pa chen po'i dus su ni/ /gtso bo sangs rgyas bdag po'i sku/ /'di ni rdo rje can kun dang / /rnal 'byor mchog gi gsang ba che/ /de lta'i rnam phyes shes byas nas/ /dngos grub mchog ni bsgrub par bya/ /gzhan du bskal pa bye bas ni/ /sangs rgyas skyob pa rnams kyis kyang / /dngos grub mchog ni zhi ba dag /nges par 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /bsgrub 6bya bsgrub 7༄par yang dag sbyor/ /gang yin de ni bsnyen par bshad/ /rdo rje pad+ma mnyam sbyor ba/ /nye bar sgrub dun pa zhes bshad do/ /yi ge rgyu dang phaṭa ldan pa/ /bskyed 99)pa sgrub pa zhes bshad panya dī/ /ngo bo nyid ni zhi bde ba/ /sgrub pa chen po zhes bshad do/ /dpal 11ldan sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag /rdo rje 'chang ba chen po'i gnas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thabs las byung / /de nyid chos rnams chos nyid do/ /las dang rjes mthun (1rtagang gang gis/ /rnal 'byor pa yis sbyor ba dmigs / /dkyil 'khor de dang de bskyed nas/ /dam tshig mi zad bsgom par 12bya / /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yis/ /dam tshig dang po bsrung bar bya /de nas gtsug tor dam tshig ni/ /cho ga ji skad gsungs las byung / /las dang gang gang rjes mthun tshepas/ /rang gi 'khor la 17bka' yang bsgo/ /bsgrub 81wa 601

bya'i lus gang yin pa la'ang / /dkyil 'khor rnam par bsgoms nas su/ / de yi ri1)lus gnas 'khor lo la/ /de yi nyes pa bsgrag par bya/ /de nas de rnams des 9gebacom nas/ /byung bar gyur pa (kyernam par bsgom/ /dngos po kun gyis rnam bsgoms nas/ /dngos po kun gyis drangs nas ni/ /de ni rang gi 'khor lor gzhugaci ri /ji skad gsungs pa'i rdzas rnams kyis(5ci/ /de yi gzugs brnyan byas nas ni/ /khro bas khyab pa'i sems kyis ni/ /rkang pas mtshan ma mnan ⑥par bya/ /de nas bka' mnos khro bo rishenani/ /sna tshogs tshogs kyis bskor ba rnams / /sgrub pa rdo rje can gyis ni/ /bsgrub bya gsang phyir gtang (gebar bya/ /khro bo'i rgyal po des bskor nas/ /de ni bcing zhing brdeg (9)pa dang / /de nas gdungs tsheshing skrag mgyur pa/ /sgrub pa pos ni dgug par bya/ /rdo rje gsum gyi sngags kyis ni/ /de yi gzugs brnyan la phab nas/ /sngags pas rdo rje dag gis ni/ /spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga nya ru/ /phur bu'i sngags kyis 8phur bu gdab / /yams dang nye bar 'tshe ba kunali/ /sna tshogs yul las byung ba rnams / /gzugs de la ni phab nas su/ /de rnams kyis 7ni phur bus gdab/ /de nas sbyor ba thams cad kyis/ /cho ga ji skad gsungs pa bzhin/ /'khrul 'khor sngags kyi sbyor la sogs/ /las kyi dbye bas sbyar cibar bya/ /mtshan ma mnan nyu nas bzlas pa 'am/ /khro bo'i dkyil 'khor sbyin sreg hu)gam/ /bsgom phonyepas gdug 2 ripa'i sems can ni rje/ /zos par gyur par rab tu brtag /zhi la zhi ba'i sems kyis bya/ /rgyas la dga' ba'i yid kyis te/ /dbang la chags ri risnyepa'i yid du bya/ /khro la gtum dzo 2pas rab tu bsgrub/ /ces ( stepa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyis byang chub sems 81—602

dpa' sems dpa' chen po de rnams kyi the tshom thams cad bcad par 1tshomadzad nas / the tshom thams cad gcod napar mdzad pa sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje rang gi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje la zhugs te/ rang gi /sku dang gsung dang thugs kyis gedamigs nas cang mi gsung bar bzhugs par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag thams cad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad la bstod pa'i rgyal po 'dis bstod do/ /thams cad sku khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /thams cad gsung la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /thams cad thugs khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /thams cad mdzad la phyag 'tshal 'dud//sku gsung thugs ni rdo rje yi/ /sku gsung thugs ni thob 'gyur bas/ /sems can sangs rgyas mi mnyam mnyam/ /bsgrub bya su yin sgrub po gang / /sgrub pa'i dbang po bdag nyid che/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gsod pa yis/ /ji ltar sdig pas gos mi 'gyur/ /gal te gos 'gyur 'bras bu 5gang / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de rnams la legs so legs so 6)zhes bya ba byin 7te/ sems dpa' chen po legs so legs/ /bdag nyid chen po legs so legs/ /gsung dbyangs chen po legs so legs/ /mchod pa chen po legs so legs/ /slob dpon byang chub rdo rje can/ /dpal ldan sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag /dngos rnams thams cad sgyu ma bzhin/ / skyed dang sdud 84par mdzad pa po/ /des na de yi sdig mi 'gyur(9)/ /bsod nams dag kyang de bzhin rnal/ /gang la sdig dang bsod nams med/ /de ni byang chub yin par gsungs/ /mgon po de yi slu ba yis/ /lus can thams cad 'jig mdzad cing ri11/ /ngan 'gror skye bar 81—603

mi 'gyur zhing / /byang chub kyang ni rnyed mi dka'/ /sngon ni mi bzad nyatsholas byas pas/ /gal te dmyal ba rnams su ni/ /skye bo skye 'gyur de rnams kyi/ /dmyal ba rnams kyi 'bras bu che/ /byang chub rdo rjes bsgrub 2dbya 'di/ /ye shes kyis ni rgyas btab pas/ /sems can rnams la 95)sbyor ba des/ /mchog (getu phan btags shes par bya/ /tshar gcod pa dang rjes bzung dun)las/ /bdag nyid chen po de yis bya/ /sgrub pa chen po'i mthar thug par/ /byas nas las rnams brtsam par bya/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de rnams rdo rje can thams cad kyi phyi thugs rje chen po'i tshul gyis ri7)chos thos pas dga' zhing rab tu dga' la mgu 8ba'i yid kyis legs so zhes bya ba gsol te 9kyi/mgon po chen po legs so legs/ /thub pa chen po legs so legs/ /chos rnams chen po legs so legs/ /thugs rje chen po legs so legs/ /e ma'o kun du bzang po yi/ /thugs rje chen po dri ma med/ /gdug pa'i mi bzad las kyis kyang / /sangs rgyas nyid kyi 'bras bu stsol/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de rnams la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu de lta bas na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis chadabang bskur ba'i gsang ba 'dus par dbang bskur ba'i sngags pas 'jigs par mi bya zhing / /skrag 7par mi bya/ dngang bar sna mi bya'o / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub rdo rje las byung ba/ /zhe snang rdo rje che la sogs / /sngags kyi rgyun ni bsdus nya pa dag /yongs su spang bar mi bya'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag thams cad kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad la mgrin gcig pitu tshigs su bcad pa 81wa 604

mdzad / /bud med gzugs su slar sprul te/ /rang gi ngo bo ji bzhin du/ /de sku'i 1)sku las byung bar gyur/ /de nyid gsum ni mnyam sbyor las/ /rang gi gsang sngags de dag bsgom/ /yan lag kun las nges grol zhing / /shin tu phra ba nyid du gyur/ /dbu dgos 2ming las byung ba ni/ /zhi gnas dang ni lhag mthong ste/ /dngos med ngo bo nyid yin pas/ /rang nyid kyang ni mi shes so/ /'on (sne kyang 'di ltar thub pa la/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams gsol ba 'debs/ /bcom ldan canadagongs pa lung bstan pa/ /chos kyi mchog ni bstan du gsol/ /khyab bdag khyed ni chos 'di rnams/ /dngos med nyid ni thugs su chud/ /'gro ba'i don ni rab sgrub 5 pas/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bur mdzes/ /gang zhig yang dag shes gyur na/ /'jig rten pa dang rtsod med cing / /de bzhin 'jig rten 'das pa dang / /'jig rten shin tu 'das de bzhin/ /gang 'di zhi ba nyid kyi (6)chos/ /zhi gnas shin tu sngon 7'gro ba/ /byang chub sems dpas 8thos na yang / /de bzhin nyid kyi bde ba byed/ /de nas sa snying la sogs pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /mgon po rnam snang chen po la/ /de dag gis ni zhus gyur pa/ /gang shes bla med byang chub ni/ /ma 'ongs skye bos thos 'gyur ba'i/ /gsang sngags de nyid don 'byung ba/ /rnal 'byor bcom ldan bshad du gsol/ /lan gnyis gsol kyang 79rimagon po ni/ /mi gsung bar ni rnam par bzhugs/ /rdo rje can gyis 7de shes nas/ /de nas slar yang zhus par gyur/3/ /gang 'di zhi gnas la 12sogs pa'i/ /rnal 'byor zab mo bla med pa / /de ni 'di ltar sngags pas bsngagasami / /'tshal 'gyur de ni gtso bos gsungs / /bya ba dag bya'i rnal 'byor chosadang / /rnal 'byor 'ba' zhig pa bo81wa 615

nyid dang / /lung ni yang dag gang yin pa/ /de ni bstan par mdzad pa'i rigs / /zhus pa'i don ni mkhyen nas ni/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs / /gsang sngags tshul ni mchog gyur 'di/ /gsang ba khyod la bstan par bya/ /'di skad ces bya'i gsang sngags che/ /gsang sngags kun don sngags (1ster ba'o/ /der ni lnga yi bdag gyur cing / /sbyor ba bzhi dang bcu yi rdzun)bdag /lnga pa lnga po'i ming 'di ni/ /gsal dang mi gsal dag tu sbyar/ /rgya mngon phyogs pa'i sbyor bshad pa/ /dkyil 'khor lnga yis brgyan (5)pa yin/ /bcu bdun zhes ni bshad pa 'di'i/ /gsungs pa'i don de ma shes pas/ /sngags pas gsang sngags sbyor ba dag /de tshe ji ltar byed par 'gyur/ /don 'di rtogs par gyur nas ni/ /sna tshogs don ni ston pa dang / /'gro ba'i don ni rab sgrub pa/ /gsang sngags rig pa mchog rnams byed/ /bdag ni stong dang yang dag sbyar/ /yi ge a ni steng du gnas/ /phyi ma zhes bya gnas byas ④la / /sngags pas sems can don rnams bya/ /yi ge a gnyis sbyor (snyeb gang / /a sgo las skyes nyid du 'gyur/ /steng 'og phyogs kyi rnam pa de/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /gang zhig 'di las gsungs pa ni/ /bsam mi khyab pa'i thabs chos nyid/ /bdag gis 56zhes rtogs de 'gyur ba/ /thogs med rtog 3)pa 'di gnas so/ /ston pa po dang bstan dang gnasarin)/ /phra rab tsam gyi ngo bo med / /kun rdzob dus gsum sbyor gcig pa 9/ /sngags pa rnams kyi 8thos de 'gyur / /shin tu grangs med bskal pa ru/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis gang mkhyen pa / /sngags pa rnams kyis dus gcig na/ /skad 37cig la rdzogs byang chub thob / /kun mkhyen kun rig 12thugs chud pa/ /gsang sngags ston pa'i chos 81—616

can te/ /de nyid kho na bcom ldan mchog /sku gsung 1thugs rdo rje las skyes/ /mi rtog (banam mkha' ji bzhin te / /gsang sngags thams cad nyi ma 'dra/ /sa la rlung bzhin sngags pa ni/ /'dod pa kun la nye bar spyod / /thams cad 'gyur ba gang gang yin(5ri/ /de de stong 6pa nyid du 'gyur/ /de bzhin sbyor ba de mthong bas/ /kun rig de ni de bzhin gshegs/ /de bzhin nyid gzugs brnyan gyur pa/ /de ni sku yi (7rdo rjer gyur/ /'gro ba yang dag tshim par 'byung (na/ /mi phyed (gegasung gi rdo rjer gyur/ /nam mkha'i gnas 3 kyi sbyor ba gang ske/ /bsam mi khyab par spro bdag nyid/ /de nyid ye shes rgya mtsho la/ /thugs kyi rdo rje yang dag byung 1lha/ /sems can kun gyi sems gang yin/ /nam mkha' yongs su brtags pa ste/ /de yang de ru kun 12gnas pas/ /bud med chos gcig pu yi gzugs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis gang brten pa/ /sar 1 gyur de ni bcu gsum pa/ /de ni bud med ces bshad de/ /de bas chos de bha ga yin / /bya ba la sogs ji skad bshad/ /dam tshig chen 14po gcig tu gyur/ /dngos med chos nyid gcig pu ru/ /'di ni de dag mnyam par 'gyur/ /dam tshig sku gsung thugs dang ni/ /ting 'dzin de bzhin rgyal ba dang / /sa dang chu dang de bzhin me/ /rlung dang nam mkha' nyid dag dang / /gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro/ /reg dang de bzhin chos kyi dbyings/ /'di rnams rdo rje'i mtha' can byung / /byang chub sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul che/ /de ltar brjod mi lang zhes pa/ /brjod mi lang ba nyid gyur rnams/ /sangs rgyas zhing gi ri rab kyi / /rdul phran gyi ni grangs mnyam pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems chen dang ske/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs/ /mi bskyod rnam snang mdzad 81—617

rin chen/ /dpag med tshe dang gdon mi za/ /'di dag nam mkha'i khams mnyam pa'i/ /rdo rje snying po de bzhin gshegs/ /dper na til 'bru mtshungs pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /nam mkha'i khams ni yongs khebs pa/ /de rnams der ni yang dag snang / /de nas mgon po rnam snang mdzad / /de bzhin nyid dang gcig tu gyur/ /gang yang dam tshig sngon 'gro dang ske/ /sku rdo rje sogs ming can gyi(7)/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems chen dang ske/ /don yod thams cad de bzhin gshegs/ /'di rnams sku yi yan lag grags / /zhi gnas bsam mi khyab las byung / /ma skyes gcig pu gzigs pa ni//'dod chags chen po'i (getshul du gyur/ /'dod chags chen po'i tshul mchog gi/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs te/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi tshogs/ / de ni nyid kyi sku la bcug92ri /de ni (4)de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /de ni rnam par snang mdzad che/ /'di nyid mnyes 9gepar bya ba'i phyir/ /nyid sku bud med nyid du mdzad/ /de nas mgon po bsam yas las/ /bud med gzugs su byung bar gyur/ /de ni sangs rgyas spyan 'dra dang / /mā ma tī 'dra sbyor ba dang / /gos dkar 6mo 'dra'i gzugs dang ni/ /sgrol ma'i gzugs su yang dag gnas//sgra yi ngo bo'i gzugs can dang / /dri yi ngo bo'i gzugs dang ni/ /de bzhin ro yi ngo bo'i gzugs/ /reg gi ngo bo'i gzugs can dang / /la la gzugs kyi ngo bo yis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams bzhugs/ /de nas tshul gsum don gcig dang / /mi bskyod pa yang bstan phyir dang / /'jig rten rgyang pan tso)gdul don du/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i tshul byung ngo / /gnyis med mnyam pa nyid rnal 'byor/ /rdo rje bud med bha ga mchog /dam tshig chen po'i dkyil 81—618

'khor du/ /de ni mi bskyod 3)yang dag bri/ /zur bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ sbyor gzhi (kyegacig tu sbyor ba nyid/ /dri ma med par byin brlabs dpa/ /kun nas shin tu gsal ba'i gzugs/ /sangs rgyas sprin gyis kun du khyab/ /'bar ba mang pos ④rnam par 'khrug(5 /gsal ba la sogs dkyil 'khor ldan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /de nas de ni bcom ldan 'das/ /de bzhin gshegs kun bdag po 'di/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus su yang 6/ /rnam par bzhag ste bzhugs par gyur 7/ /mi bskyod rin chen dpag med dang / /don grub rnam snang de bzhin gshegs/ /de rnams byang chub sems rdo rje'i/ /thugs la rnam par bzhugs 98༄par gyur/ /de rnams zil gyis mnan pa'i phyir/ /de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub sems/ /dngos med ngo bor gcig par ni/mkha' 'dra rdo rje las byung gzigs/ /shes rab ting 'dzin gzhi gcig pu/ /de ni grib ma ltar thugs chud/ /rdo rje'i rang bzhin skur mdzad nas/ /'gro don mnyam dang mi mnyam mdzad/ /ji ltar mtshams gnas nyi ma yis/ /'gro ba gnyid log sad par byed/ /de bzhin de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /byang chub sems kyis sad par (9)byed/ /sku gsung thugs ni rdo rje gcig /de rnams skye bar bzhed pa yi / /byang chub sems kyi ngo bo yis/ /rdo rje'i sngags su mdzad par gyur/ /rig pa skyes bu'i gzugs dag ni/ /sngags kyis 11byin brlabs phonyebla na med/ /der (12ni zhal gsum pa lta bur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis gzigs/ /de nas mgon po bcom ldan gyis/ /thugs rjes 7bzhugs pa las byung ste/ /byang chub sems ni rab bskor la/ /lan gsum ched du brjod pa mdzad/ /bsam mi khyab cing dpag 17med gang / /de bzhin gshegs 81—619

pa kun gyi 1tshogasang / /rdo rje byang chub sems gcig las/ /spyod yul der ni gyur pa yin/ /de nas gsang tshul thos pa dang / /de 'og gsang ba'i bdag pos ni/ /khyab bdag rnam par snang mdzad la/ /ji bzhin tshul du de btud zhus / /phung po khams la sogs pa'i chos/ /'dus la gang zhig gnas pa'i rnams / /rten 'brel las skyes yin par ni/ /khyad (na chos ston par mdzad pas khums / /dman 5)pa'i chos rnams 'di dag ni/ /zhe sdang la sogs rkyen dang ldan / /'di dag ji ltar bde byugashegs dang / /rdzu 'phrul chen po rigs ma lags / /byang chub sems dpa' sems tsho chen de/ /lus la dunasogs pa ji ltar 'gyur / /gang zhig phyi dus skye bo yis/ /'di dag 'tshal bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /'od chen ldan pas bka' stsal pa/ /ma 'ongs skye bo mthong nas ni/ /gang zhig khyod kyis nga dris pa/ /legs so legs so sems dpa' che/ /gsang ba'i bdag po khyod legs so/ /smras don ji lta ji lta bar / /de ltar khyod la lung bstan bya/ /ma 'ongs dus na mi rnams ni/ /'jig rten rgyang pan 7rimachog gzhol 'gyur/ /log par lta ba la gnas te/ /ci dga' bar yang spyod par byed/ /la la glu dang gar la dga'/ /dgod 8)dang sgeg la mchog tu gzhol/ /dri dang phreng ba la dga' zhing / /de bzhin 'khrig pa la dgar 'gyur/ /rmongs pa la la sdang ba dang / /de bzhin gti mug la rab gzhol/ /la la de bzhin 'dod chags zhen/ /shes pa gzhan dag 'dod par 'gyur/ /nya dang sha dang de bzhin chang / /bshang gci khu ba khrag rnams ni/ /skyes bu glen pa za byed ri9cing / /med par smra ba chos su sgrogasaribo/ /ma dang sring mo la sogs pa/ /bgrod min la ni 'gro ba (17dang / /pha dang ma 81—620

yang gsod pa dang / /de bzhin srog chags gzhan rnams gsod/ /brdzun 91)gyi tshig nyid smra ba dang / /khyad par du yang brku (geb dang / /gzhan gyi chung ma'i thad 'gro zhing / /smad pa gzhan yang byed par 'gyur/ /la la dam chos spong ba dang ske/ /de bzhin mtshams med byed pa ste/ /sna tshogs sdig pa byas nas kyang / /sngags pa dngos grub 'dod par 'gyur/ /gzer nad dug dang sbyar ba'i dug /sna tshogs nad ni mi bzad par(5ci/ /'di rnams kyis ni gzir gyur nas/ /zhi ba nyid ni 'dod par 'gyur/ /'dor bar byed pa rmongs pa de/ /mi bzad sdig nganapa byas pa dang / /log par lta la mchog gzhol rnams/ /ngan song gsum du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de rnams rjes su gzung ba'i phyir/ /gsang ba 'di ltar bstan pa yin/ /gang zhig yang dag thob pa nyid/ /'dir ni de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur/ /gsang ba'i bdag po mkhas rnams kyis/ /tshul mchog 'di ni rnyed gyur nas/ /don gsal yang dag rnyed pa dang / /de yang nga rgyal dag tu ltung / /de rnams tshogeting 'dzin zhi nyid dang / /shes rab nyid kyang shin tu ring / /rab tu dga' dang ldan pa yis/ /rnal 'byor pa ni bdag nyid ces / /mngon pa'i nga rgyal la rtag dga'/ /sgyu 6ridang bcos ma'i chos dang ldan / /mya ngan 'das dang gzhan 'gro ba/ /phan tshun dag ni sun yang 'byin/ /gsang sngags smra ba la brten 97rinas/ /gcig la gcig ni rtsod par 'gyur/ /de rnams bdud kyi byin brlabs 90kyis/ /gal te dngos grub phra thob na/ /des ni mngon par nga rgyal bas/ /mkhas pa snyam du shes par 'gyur/ /tshogs pa'i nang du rtsod pa dang / /khyi bzhin kha zas la spyod 'gyur 9/ /rang las 'bras las byung ba yi/ /phan pa la ni gnod pa byed/ /de rnams dge dang mi dge 81—621

rnams / /bdag cag rnams kyi stobs yin zer/ /mngon sum sangs rgyas 'dra ba yi 1/ /slob dpon smod cing bsnyen bkur (2)med/ /skad cig gcig gis sdang ( byed cing / /de la skad cig gis rjes chags/ /khyi dang phag dang khu rnams kyi / /spyod pa dag ni ston par byed/ /de rnams phan tshun rnam 'tshe bar / /mngon par dga' bar byed par 'gyur/ /gsang ba 'dus pa mi shes par / /dam tshig la 5sogs byed par 'gyur/ /gsang ba srung bar mi byed par / /thams cad du ni ston par byed/ /'jig rten la ni smad (6)byas nas/ /gzhan dag la yang rab gsal byed/ /bdag nyid rtsa ba med par ni/ /dam tshig 'das par byed par 'gyur/ /sgra bcas spror 7)ldan gyis bskul bas(shes/ /rang la rang gi glags rnyed med/ /de nyid ye shes 'byung ba yi/ /ting 'dzin de yis shes mi 'gyur/ /nyes pa cung zad tsam gyi phyir/ /mngon spyod rab tu byed par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor rab sbyor dman pa yi/ /sngags pa rnams ni 'grub mi 'gyur/ /phyi rol bstan bcos la (9)rtag dga'/ /de yi sbyor la gcig tu mkhas / /rang gi dam tshig yongs spangs nas/ /lcags kyu med pa bzhin du spyod / /sngags dang phyag rgya'i sbyor ba yis/ /de rnams 'tsho ba sgrub par 'gyur/ /gang du rnyed pa thob 'gyur bar/ /dam pa'i chos ni ston par byed/ /de rnams yang dag sdud byed pa'i/ /gsang ba dgongs pas bshad pa yin/ /dam tshig nyams te gnas pa rnams/ /'di yis thams cad dgug par bya/ / rang gi ⑩rjes rig mi shes na/ /de rnams zhi bar ga la 'gyur/ /de nas rjes su gzung don du/ /tshul 'di dag ni gyur pa yin/ /de nas bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs / /gcig tu 'dus par gyur nas su/ /de bzhin gshegs kun bdag 81—622

po la/ /rang mchod de nyid dam tshig sprin/ /yang dag 'byung bas legs mchod de/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni 'di skad gsol/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gsang ba mchog /de bzhin gshegs pa kun bsdus pa/ /'dus pa gnyis med rnal 'byor pa'i/ /nyams dga' rdo rje ri1)snying po 'di/ /de nyid bsdus pa rnams kyi mchog /de nyid bcom ldan bshad du gsol/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs kun la / /bcom ldan 'das kyis slar gsungs pa/ /gang yang 'di ltar gsol 'debs pa/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams legs so (2)legs/ /'di ni de bzhin gshegs rnams kyang / /the tshom skye bar byed yin na/ /byang chub sems gzhan ci smos zhes(snye/ /de bzhin gshegs de rnams la gsungs/ /de nas ngo mtshar rmad byung nas/ /the tshom thams cad gcod mdzad pa'i/ /bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs kun gyi / /bdag po la ni 'di skad zhus/ /bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs kun gyi(5)/ /yon tan kun gyis churaphul phyung yang / /gtso bo 'dir 7ni ston mdzad par/ /ji ltar spro ba mnga' ma gyur/ /byin gyis brlab 85pa'i gnas mdzad de/ /de bzhin gshegs yid bde la 59༄sogs/ /ye shes rgyu 'bras thob pa'i phyir/ /de ni yang dag bshad du gsol/ /de bzhin gshegs kun bdag po ni/ /de rnams zhu bar mkhyen nas su/ /ye shes sgron ma rdo rje grags/ /ting 'dzin zhe 7snang rigs 'byung ba/ /gtso bos mi bskyod snying po ni/ /sku gsung thugs ni dpal ldan pas/ /de nas yang dag phyung ba ni/ /badz+ra jika 11ces bya ba'i sngags/ /de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /zhe 32sdang rigs byung las skyes pa/ /de ni rig pa skyes bur 'gyur/ /mi bskyod rgya chen thabs kyis sbyor/ /zhal gsum gnag nyunyedang dkar dang dmar/ /bdag nyid chen po de 7zhal yin/ /81—623

rdo rje gsum 'dir de bzhin gshegs/ /bzhugs pa ye shes zhes bya'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs bdag po/ /dam tshig 'byung rdo rje zhes bya①/ /ting nge 'dzin la gtso bo ni/ /snyoms par zhugs sbyonadapa nyid du mdzodage / /de nas dzi na dzika sdom ces pa'i/ /snying po de bzhin yang dag phyung / /de nas gsungs pa tsam gyis kyang / /gti mug rigs byung las skyes pa/ /rig bcas skyes bur (5༄gyur pa ni/ /rnam par snang mdzad de bzhin gshegs/ /dkar dang gnag phyi dang dmar bcas pa'i/ /zhal gyis mdun du bzhugs par gyurangan/ /de nas rin chen byung ba yi/ /dpal zhes bya ba'i ting 'dzin la/ /snyoms par zhugs nas bder nagashegs kun/ /bde dang yid bder gyur pa'i phyir/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen rigs/ /de bzhin gshegs kun bdag po 'di/ /de nas rat+na lhaka ces bya'i9/ /snying po dpal ldan de tshe byung 3 )/ /de nas 3)phyung ba tsam gyis ni/ /rig dang bcas pa'i skyes bur gyur/ /ser dang dkar dang gnag pa yi12/ /zhal dang rin chen 'byung ldan ni/ /rdo rje gsum gyi bdag po yi / /lho phyogs logs su bzhugs par gyur/ /de yang byang du gzigs gyur te412 / /mnyam nyid ye shes zhes bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan bdag po de/ /rdo rje gsum gyi dam tshig bdag /'dod chags chen po skolas byung ba/ /rdo rje zhes ni bya ba yi15/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs te/ /'dod chags chen po'i rigs las byung / / ā ro lika 30ces bya snying po/ /rdo rje gsum las nye tshode nas phyung glu/ /de nas phyung ba tsam gyis ni/ /de 'og bcom ldan gtso bo ni/ /rig dang bcas pa'i skyes bur gyur/ /'jig rten dbang po 'od dang mtshungs/ /dmar dang dkar dang gnag 18pa'i zhal/ /dpal ldan rigs chen po yi 1681—624

bdag /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bdag po yi/ /nub phyogs su ni bzhugs par gyur / /de nas bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /don yod dam tshig ces bya ba'i/ /ting 'dzin rdo rje yang dag byung sgyunyari/ / rdo rje rdo de la snyoms zhugs 9 nanas/ /snying po mchog gi mchog ces bya'o/ /dam tshig rnams ni dgug pa'i rigs/ /snying po pradz+nyā sgrika ④ces pa/ /rdo rje gsum zhes bya las byung (ge)/ /de nas phyung 6ba tsam gyis ni/ /don yod rdo rje sbyor ba yi kyi/ /de nyid mgon po bcom ldan 'das / /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /rig dang bcas pa'i skyes bur gyur/ /ljang dang gnag (shedang dkar ba'i zhal/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bdag po yi/ /byang phyogs su ni bzhugs par gyur/ /zhe sdang gti mug rigs dang ni/ /de bzhin yid bzhin rin chen dang / /'dod chags dam tshig ces bya ba/ /'dod tshodang thar pa rab bsgrubs (9 pa'o/ /de nas khyab bdag rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags dam tshig 'byung ba yi/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs te/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa btsun mo mchog /sku gsung du thugs kyi rdo rje las/ /dam pa dag ni phyung bar gyur(lha/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi yum gcig pu/ /yum zhes bya bar yang dag bshad/ /de ni de bzhin gshegs bdag po/ /gang phyir lha mo btsun mo mchog /sku dang gsung nyugethugs las byung ba/ /dwo ṣa 1lhar ti zhes byar grags/ /rig pa skyes bu zhes bya ba'i/ /de ni bud med gzugs 'dzin mchu/ /zhal gsum lta bu'i gzugs kyis ni/ /me yi phyogs su rnam par bzhugs/ /de nas rjes mnyes rdo rje grags/ /sku gsung thugs rdo rje las byung / /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs tesko/ /rdo rje gsum las byung ba ni/ /de ni mo ha ra ti ste/ /gang phyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i yang / /rig pa skyes bu byung ba ste/ /zhal 81—625

gsum lta bu'i rnal 'byor ma/ /gnyis med mnyam pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi yid 'ong gcig(nye /gsang ba bsdus pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /bden bral phyogs su rnam par bzhugs/ /de nas rjes chags rdo rje zhes/ /bya ba rdo rje gsum las skyes/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs nas/ /bde ba chen po phyung ba ni/ /'di ltar rā tshon ga ra ti phyung / /zhal gsum pa yi gzugs can te55)ske/ /gtso bo bud med gzugs 'dzin pa/ /de ni rig pa skyes bur gyur/ /gos med ye shes las byung ba/ /rdo rje gsum gyi dam tshig mchog /de bzhin gshegs pa'i btsun mo ste/ /rlung gi phyogs su rnam par bzhugs/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das bdag po/ /rdo rje gsum gyi dam tshig can/ /bslu (geb rdo rje zhes bya ba'i/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs nas/ /de bzhin gshegs kun btsun mo mchog /zhal gsum lta bu'i gzugs can ma/ /badz+ra ra ti zhes bya ba/ /rdo rje gsum las phyung bar gyur/ /de ni phyung ma thag tu yang / /gtso bo rig ma (lde)skyes bur gyur/ /bud med kyi ni gzugs 'dzin te/ /dbang ldan phyogs su rnam par bzhugs/ /de nas bcom ldan mgon po de/ /rnam snang rdo rje las byung ba'i/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs te/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje la/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir 56ni gshin rje'i 7)gshed/ /khro bo chen po phyung ba dang / /phyung nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams/ /bstengs par bya bar shar phyogs bzhugs / /de nas bdag po bcom ldan 'das/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi / /mngon byang rdo rje zhes bya yi/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs te/ /khro bo chen po phyung ba ni/ /pra dz+nyān+ta kṛta nyukyerdo rje can/ /de nas dpal ldan phyung ba ni/ /rig pa skyes bur yang dag phyung / /dkyil 'khor chen po'i sbyor ba 81—626

las / /'od chen phur bu'i gzugs lta bu/ /rdo rje dam tshig bsnyengs 1byed pa/ /lho yi sgor ni rnam par bzhugs/ /de nas rin chen 'byung gnas grags/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs te/ /gsung gi dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtsor/ /rdo rje gsum las khro bo che/ / pad mān+ta kṛta (na/'od po che/ /bdag po de nas phyung bar gyur/ /de nas phyung ba tsam gyis 'dir/ /gtso bo'i rig pa skyes bur bcas / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi'ang / /gsung gi tshul du rnam sprul zhing / /gos med ye shes bla med pa/ /nub kyi sgor ni bzhugs dpar gyur//bcom ldan de nyid sna tshogs pa/ /thugs kyi rdo rje ting 'dzin la/ /kun nas snyoms par zhugs nas ni/ /de nas gtso bos phyung bar gyur/ /khro bo chen po rnam phyung ba/ /kun nas bgegs mthar byed pa ste/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor sbyor ba yis/ /byang gi sgor 4ni rnam par bzhugs/ /de nas dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin / /dkyil 'khor mchog 'di thos pa dang / /mgon po rnam par snang mdzad che/ /de la slar yang zhus gyur pa/ /mkha' dang dbyer med sbyor gcig cing ske/ /dngos med de bzhin gshegs pa rnams/ /dga' ba'i mchog sogs bgyis nas ni/ /ji ltar de rnams zhus par gyur(ge/ /'di dag thog mtha' yod min na/ /'di yi gtso bo ji ltar 'gyur(rme/ /phyogs kyi cha rnams bzhag pa la / /'di ni gang gis rnam par sbyang ri ci/ /gsang ba 'di ni mi srid ces/ /theg pa gsum po rtog pa dang / /so so'i skye bo'i tshig gis kyang / /spang ba dag kyang bgyid par 'gyur/ /gang zhig nyan thos rnams dang ni/ /de bzhin mdo sde las spangs pa'i/ /zhe sdang sogs dang 'dod lnga sogs/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams sten samadzad pa/ /rjes su spyod dang thun mong ba'i/ /bya ba de dag phyin 81—627

ci log /dga' mtha'i spyod pa de rnams ni/ /de bzhin gshegs de rnam 0)mdzad pa/ /tshig gcig la ni dpag med don/ /gsang ba dam pa 'di dag ni//mgon po gang zhig ma 'ongs pa'i/ /skye bos ji ltar 'tshal bar 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan bka' stsal pa/ /phyag na rdo rje tshul 'di ni/ /dgongs pa gsang ba bla med pa/ /dris pa rnams ni bshad par bya/ /zhe sdang gti mug de bzhin chags/ /lus la rdon sogs pa'i phung po (55)lnga / /'di dag bdag med rtogs nas ni/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas ni tshul gsum gnas/ /pha ni zhi gnas yin zhes bya / /ma ni lhag mthong yin par bshad/ /de bzhin nyid shes lus su 'gyur5/ /zhi ba rnal 'byor pa yi zas/ /ji ltar bzo bos bder gshegs kyil/ / sku yi tsigazugs brnyan byas pa ltar/ /gang zhig sku lta bu yi sku/ /de bzhin gsung gi rnam pas gsung / /thugs kyi rnam pas thugs su ni/ /zhi gnas la sogs pa las byung 7ci/ /phung po la sogs chos rnams ni/ /stong zhing rten 'brel las byung mthong / /ye shes nyi ma shar ba'i gzugs/ /zhi las rnal 'byor pa rnams byed/ /de bas sku gsung tshon)thugs rdo rje/ /grib ma lta bur byung ba yin/ /de bzhin phung po khams la sogs/ /dam tshig gcig la rnam par gnas / /de nas tshul gsum don 99)gcig pa/ /zhi gnas la sogs pa las byung ske/ /de bas 7rdo rje tshul yid 'ong / /gsang ba'i bdag po mnyan par gyis11ske/ /stong pa rten 'brel las byung bar/ /rnal 'byor pa yi sherdo rje zhes/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas 1 rnal 'byor ni/ /phung po la sogs chos 'byung ༅ba/ /lus dang 1glengag sems kun rtog ni/ /phung po sogs byung 'byung las gyur/ /'di dag dngos med yang dag sbyar/ /de las ting 'dzin skyes par gyur / /81—628

'di dag ting 'dzin gnyis med sbyor/ /mi phyed rdo rje nyid du gyur37/ /zab dang rgya chen rtogs ②byang chub/ /de rtogs pas ni sems dpar gyur/ /'di dag nam mkha' mtshungs gyur pa/ /chen po zhes bya shes byed pa'o/ /de la rtogs ②pa mtha' yas pa/ /rdo rje theg par ston pa yin/ /ting nge 'dzin ni de nyid las/ /rdo rje'i theg pa byung ba yin/ /'di las 'jig rten 'das 'gyur zhing ske/ /de bzhin 'jig rten shin tu 'das/ /dngos 4don de bzhin nyid gcig pu/ /gsang ba 'jig rten pa zhes bshad/ /ma skyes pa las byung ba ni/ /kun rdzob dang ni don dam yin/ /bdud gyur lha yi 5bur bshad de/ /phung po nyon mongs 'chi bdag bcas/ /'di las dngos med pas rgyal bas/ /rgyal ba'i rdo rjer /ne rnam par bshad/ /lus sogs phyi yi phung por bshad/ /'byung dang 'byung las gyur pa (7cigang / /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /'di dag rdo rje'i rigs can 'gyur/ /dngos po gang dang gang dag gis/ /phung po lnga po brtags gyur ri )pa/ /de rnams (9de bzhin yang dag dmigs/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams su 'gyur/ /ji ltar me long mtshungs gsal 7ba/ /dngos po kun gyi bdag nyid can/ /der ni bdag gis bdag mthong ba11/ /dkyil 'khor mchog 'gyur rnal 'byor pa/ /phung po de bzhin gshegs grags pa51ge / /de bzhin nyid las spros bya bci1lha/ /chos kyi sku can rgyal ba yi/ /mchod pa chen por de 'gyur ro/ /'di ni spros dang bsdus pa dag /de ni dga' bar yongs su bsgrags / /sems can gang zhig longs spyod cigar+sā /de ni gsol 'debs zhes bshad do/ /yang dag shes rab thabs gnyis med10/ /mkha' dbyings dbyer med rab sbyor ba / /de ni 'dod chags che tshul 'gyur/ /rnal 81wa 629

'byor pa ni mngon bzhugs pa'o/ /rdo rje theg pa rnal 'byor che1)/ /bdag nyid nges par sbyor ba gang / /dngos napo thams cad bde skyed ri kyipa'i/ /yid bde ba ni skye bar 'gyur/ /zhal gsum rnam thar gsum du gang / /mthong zhing de las ④phung po sogs/ /lha yi bdag nyid rig 'gyur ba/ /de nyid gsum du bshad pa yin / /dngos med pa ni lam gyi mchog /mya ngan 'das par gnyis med 'jug /'on kyang so sor gyur pa der / /chos kyi sku las zhe sdang gyur/ /bcom ldan bdag po de nyid ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs phyung (lezhing / /mya ngan 'das tshul rdo rje can/ /de nyid dbang po kun byed pa'o/ /dam tshig la sogs 'byung ba'i chos/ /rang gis rig par tsho rim gyur kyang / /der ni gnas pa yang dag bshad/ /de ni gti mug de bzhin sems/ /gang gis (kyiji ltar brtags chos kyis/ /longs spyod rdzogs zhes bya byed pa/ /de ni yid bzhin rin chen 'byung / /rin chen chen po'i 95)rigs kyi 1 cigatso/ /de nyid bcom ldan 'dod chags ni/ /kun mkhyen ye shes las byung ba/ /gnas med gnas pa'i sbyor gyur pa/ /'dod chags chen po'i tshul gyi mchog /ji ltar 'dam gyi hunyapad+ma ni / /de yi nyes pas tshogegos mi 'gyur/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor rig pa mchog /'dod pa kun la nye bar spyod/ /'gro ba gcig tu 'dod pa khyab/ /de nyid rdo rje rigs mchog yin/ /chos dang longs spyod sprul pa ste/ /gsum po de dag mdor bsdus pa'o1ri/ /zhe sdang gti mug de bzhin chags/ /rdo rje dga' ba'i mtha' can gtso/ /ngan 'gro gsum 'don pas bud med/ /gcig pu yin yang du mar gyur/ /gsum po yang dag 8'dug gyur pa/ /gshin rje shes rab gyur 8de bzhin/ /pad+ma bgegs gyur 7khro bo ste/ /mthar 'byed 51 —tshomatha' yi ming can 81—630

no / /'jug pa la sogs gsum nyid la/ /phung por grags te de bzhin gshegs / /skrag 0)byed gshin rje'i (migashed kyis kyang / /thams cad 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /rdo rje dam tshig skrag byed pa(mi/ /de bzhin gshegs (4rirab mthar byed gtso/ /pad+mo'ang gsung zhes bya bar gyur/ /'chi bral rnal 'byor grub pa yin/ /bgegs mthar byed kyang thugs kyi gtso/ /rigs pa'i bdag nyid can (snyebadag po/ /'di ltar rtag spyod 96)rnal 'byor pa/ /gsang ba'i lus kyis rnam par spyodardo sku/ /dgongs pa lung ston rdo skal gnas par/ /gang zhig yid ni bzod gyur pa/ /des 'di duspyodade bzhin bya ba dang / /de nas gsang ba yang dag bsrung ⑩/ /nu zho zas kyis bu gso nyunyebazhin/ /srid pa gsum na bcom ldan gtso/ /sems can bsam dbang ji bzhin du/ /chos kyi bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad/ /chos dang longs spyod sprul pa yis / /sku gsum gcig tu sbyor ba las / /bcom ldan gsang ba dgongs mdzad pa/ /bden pa ma yin brdzun nyagepa'ang min/ /zhe sdang gti mug rin chen dang / /'dod chags sna tshogs rigs 7byung ba/ /dgongs pa'i rigs kyi brdar gyur pas/ /gleng gzhi 8yin te dang po'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs bdag la/ /slar yang de bzhin tsogashegs 91 tshokun gyis(sem/ /lhag par mchod pa byas nas 917ni/ /thub chen de la 'di skad gsol/ /dgongs pa 3 skurdo rje dam pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun ye shes/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /gsang ba bcom ldan bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de rnams kyisanisto/ /zhu ba yang dag thugs chud cing / /byang chub 81—631

sems dpa' yongs rtog 9)pa/ /thub nyid kyis rigeni rnam mkhyen pa/ /de nas byang chub sems kun la/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad gsungs/ /lus sems de dang 'dra ba dang / /de bzhin ngag ni tshig brjod lta'itsho na/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /khyed 0)kun gyis ni bskyed par bya/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' la/ /ston pas ji bzhin ston par mdzad/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs rnams kyis/ /sku dang thugs dang de bzhin gsung / /de 'dra'i tshul du sbyar nas ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /sku gsung thugs rdo rje can la/ /ched du brjod pa ched du brjod/ /e ma kun du bzang po yi/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung las skyes pa/ /skye ba med pa'i tshul gyis 95)ni/ /skye ba 'dir ni rab tu bsgrags/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs bdag po/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rje gsum/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye/ /mngon rdzogs byang chub rdo rje yi7/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs nas/ /dpal ldan byang chub sems 'di gsungs/ /dngos po med pa'i dngos gnas na/ /dngos dang dngos med gnyis ka ri min/ /de ltar dngos po dngos med pas/ /sgom pa dngos por yod ma yin/ /de nas dpal ldan rnam snang mdzad/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /gnyis med dam tshig rdo rje grags/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs 'ori/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi mchog /gsang ba dgongs pa rdo rje can/ — /byang chub sems ni thams cad nas/ /de ni yang dag bka' stsal to/ /dag pa de bzhin gshegs kun gyi/ /phung po khams sogs rnam spangs shing / /gzung tshedang 'dzin pa las grol ba/ /chos bdag med pa'i stong nyid can/ /byang chub sems ni 'di gsungs pa/ /rten cing 81—632

'brel 'byung ming can te/ /thog ma med nas ma skyes brda1/ /rang sems mnyam pa nyid kyang yin/ /de nas mi bskyod de bzhin gshegs / /kun gyi gnyis med mi zad ②pa'i/ /ye shes ting 'dzin snyoms 9༄zhugs te/ /byang chub sems ni 'di gsungs so/ /dngos po 'di dag ma skyes pas/ /phung por grags pa'i chos nyid med/ /nam mkha' lta bur blta rinadaka' ba'i/ /bdag med byang chub ces bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan dkon mchog dpal/ /bdag med rdo rje zhes bya ba'i/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs nas/ /byang chub sems 'di rab tu gsungs/ /chos rnams thams cad dngos med cing / /chos kyi mtshan nyid rnam spangs pa/ /bdag med chos las yang dag 'byung / /byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o/ /de nas 'od dpag med mtshan can/ /ye shes 'bar ba sgron rdo rje'i/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs te/ /byang chub sems ni 'di gsungs so/ /ma skyes pa yi chos rnams la/ /dngos po med cing bsgom pa'ang med/ /nam mkha'i gnas su ri sbyor ba yis/ /dngos po zhes ni 7rab tu bshad / /de nas de bzhin gdon mi za/ /zil gyis gnon pa'i rdo rje yin/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs te/ /byang chub sems ni 'di gsungs so/ /chos 'di rang bzhin 'od gsal zhing / /gzod 79nas dag pas mkha' dang mtshungs / /byang chub med cing mngon rtogs med/ /byang chub sems ni yin par bshad/ /de nas dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /byang chub sems ni thos pa dang —/ /dgongs pa'i don ni rab bshad par/ /rnam par snang mdzad che tshal gsungs / /dngos po med cing dmigs med pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' mkha' dang mtshungs/ /gsang ba'i tshul ni 'di thos nas/ / dngos po yi ni 1781—633

rtog pa skye/ /lus la sogs pa gsung sbyor bas/ /sems ni de rnams skyed par 1)byed / /yang dag byang chub du ma'i mthar/ /'di la so so skye bo smra/ /thub pa'i gsung ni de rnams la/ /rang gi sgra bzhin 'dzin par byed/ /bsam pa'i dbang ni ji bzhin du/ /'gro ba'i don du bka' stsol cig /de nas bcom ldan bdag po 'di/ /rnam par snang mdzad thub pa che/ /legs zhes (snyelan gsum gsungs nas ni/ /lag na rdo rje la 'di gsungs/ /rnam par mi rtog don de nyid/ /rab tu phye ste bshad par bya/ /tshig tu brjod dang ①dmigs par bshad/ /brda byadang don dam pa yin no/ /rkyen dang nyan thos rnams kyi dang 5ra/ /mdo dang gsang sngags 0spyod rnams kyis(be+e/ /de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa yi/ /byang chub sems ni 2bla na med/ /de bzhin yang dag sbyor ba 'di / / dngos po'i 6stegasang ba bla na med/ /gnyis med dam tshig rdo rje dang / /pad+ma de las skyed par byed/ /tshig tu brjod pa thun mong ste/ /sangs rgyas sku ni dmigs can yin/ /gsang sngags de nyid ces bya brda'i/ /de bzhin nyid ni don dam pa'o/ /dang po gcig ni dgu dbus na/ /gang zhig bcu yis ma bcings pa/ /de ni bcings med shes 17bya ste/ /de shes pa ni mchog gi ⑫gnas / /dbyangs dang gsal byed yi ge ste/ /grangs dgu yi ni rjes 'jug pa/ /as bcings phan tshun sbyor ba las/ /gang gis shes te 'gro ba'i bla/ /gang zhig shes pa rnam grol ba/ /'bras bu phun tshogs grub 'dod pa/ /de ni de nyid grub 'dod de1 / /gzugs med pas ni gzugs spangs pa/ /'byung ba'i tsomatha' ni yang dag ldan/ /cha la sogs pa bcu drug gnas/ /lnga pa lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /bzhi ni gsum du nges par sbyar/ /yi ge oṃ bcas ring por bcas//81—634

yon tan sbyor sogs phyis dang mtshungs/ /thung ngu ma lus ngag tu 'gyur/ /gcig min du ma ma yin no/ /ya yi don gyis 1gang yang rung / /bya ba'i dngos grub 'dod gyur pa/ /ra la sogs pa gsum nyid kyisan// /'gro ba'i don la rab tu 'jug /yi ge gang zhig sngar bshad dang / /gang yang mngon du phyogs pa rnams/ /bud med skyes pa ma ning ste/ /khams la sogs par rab tu brtag /'og nas steng du bcas par ni/ /shes rab da blos ni nges par sbyar/ /drug bshad bzhi dang gsum dang gcig /dngos med ngo bo gcig las byung / /de ni ya sogs don sbyar na/ /dus gsum shes pa'ang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /mkhas pas sgyu ma mig 'phrul bzhin/ /'gro ba rnams ni sgyu mthar bya/ /brjod pa yi ni sngags 'di dag /dngos med ngo bo las byung ba/ /de ni yongs su gyur pa'i gzugs / /lha ru nye bar mtshon pa gang / / brda yis (4)de nyid gsum gnas pa / /rang bzhin bzlas pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /ming med brjod du med pa ste/ /byang chub sems mchog 'di yin no/ /gsum po de nyid gcig gyur pa/ /'gro ba med cing 'ong ba med/ /'gag med rab tu zhi ba ste/ /rtag dang chad pa rnam spangs pa/ /dus gsum mkhyen pas ma byas pa'i/ /rtog pa nam mkha' dbyer med mtshan/ /de nyid kho na don dam ste/ /so so rang rig mtshan nyid do / /de 'di sems can kun zhes bya'i/ /sangs rgyas byang chub ngo bo nyid/ /byang chub sems dpa' gcig 'byung yang ge / /rten cing 'brel 'byung rang bzhin can/ /gang 'di byang chub sems bdag tsinyid/ /rnal 'byor pa ni nyi 'drar 'gyur/ /'di ni rnam rtog kun bral yang / /rigs kun la ni 'jug par 'gyur/ /sreg dang skems tshadang bde can dang / /kun zar 'gyur ba'i (8)81—635

me bzhin no/ /'di ni lhas kyang mchod bya bar/ /sems can la (1)la rnam par gnas / /byang chub sems 'dod bdag nyid de/ /'gro (geb bu gcig bzhin lta zhing ske/ /gang zhig bdag dang mnyam gnas pa/ /byams pa chen po de bskyed bya//phyin ci ma log 'di mthong nas/ /byang chub sems ni yang dag 'byung / /des ni snying rje cher gyur nas/ /des ni 'khor ba nges par 'joms/ /sems can kun dang de bzhin bdag /byang chub sems la nam mthong na/ /'on kyang 'gro ba'i don byed pa/ /de las dga' ba skye bar 'gyur/ /'khor ba dngos po yod min la/ /sems can rnams kyang de dang 'dra/ /byang chub sems ni mthong nas ni/ /btang snyoms chen por gyur pa yin/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa yis/ /thos pa'i byang chub sems dran zhing / / slar yang de don mtshan nyid ni/ /nga)rnam par snang mdzad che la zhus/ /'khor dang cig rigeshos zhes bya ba/ /'di kun byang chub sems yin na'achi/ /ji ltar so sor gyur nas ni/ /phan tshun 'gal bar rab tu gnas/ /bdag nyid kyis ni bdag nyid la/ /gnyis su 'gog byed gang yang med/ /gang zhig nor bu gcig las byung / /mi mthun phyogs su ji ltar snang / /dman medang bar ma de bzhin mchog /'khor bar nyon mongs mi bzad pas na/ /sems can kha cig shesagazir ba dang / /byang chub sems la'ang 7sbyar bar gyur11/ /de lta'i rnam rtog kun rtog 8par/ /ma 'ongs skye bo bgyid 'gyur gyi/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung las byung ba/ /'di dag 'tshal bar mi 'gyur ro/ /dngos po med pa'i chos rnams la/ /byis pa rnams ni rtsod par 'gyur/ /de rnams rtsod pa nyunyemed pa'i phyir/ /dgongs pa bshad par mdzad du gsol/ /de nas bdag po bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje 81—636

can la gsang dgongs pa/ /shin tu rnyed dka' ri1)byang chub sems/ /de ni yang dag bka' stsal to/ /phyi ma'i mtha' gang stong pa gcig /sngon gyi mthar thug de bzhin te/ /sems de mngon du byas nas ni/ /ci dga' bar ni bya ba yin/ /sems ni de yis ma mthong bas/ /lta ba so sor gyur pa yin/ /de bas de rnams 'khor ba ru/ /'gro ba drug gi rdo ming du gyur/ /des (yin tshangs pa khyab 'jug dang / /dbang phyug che la kun du sten④/ /zla ba nyi ma bya ba yi75/ /kun du spyod pa 6)de rnams byed/ /sum cu (7)rtsa gsum par bshad dang / /dga' ldan gyi dudeni gnas dag dang / /de bzhin gzhan dag dmyal bar yang lta bas skad cig dag gis 'gro/ /yi dgas (9su yang 'gro ba dang / /'gro ba sna tshogs dag tu 'gro/ /gang tshe ma rig kun bsten 7pas/ /bdag nyid kyang ni mi shes so/ /'du shes can dang 'du shes med/ /sems can du brtags 'di gnas pa/ /de rnams rlung las byung ba ste/ /rlung las 3nyeslar yang 'gag pa yin / /nyin dang mtshan mo'i cha yis kyang / /rang gi 32rnam par rtog par 1 lhung ske/ /de nas 'khor bar skrag bzhin du/ /sna tshogs 'gro bar de dag 'gro/ /mi rtog pa yi sems de ni/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor gnas gyur kyang / /de ni phyin ci log gyur pas/ /khyi dang ce blaspyang glang po dang / /sems de ltar yang 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin du ni pha 515nyid dang / /ma tsheyi rigs ni spyig mkhan dang / /sme sha can dang rigs ngan dang / /bza' dang mi bza' bya kun dang nyanye/ /byang chub sems de skye bar 'gyur/ /bram ze la kyi sogs 'jig rten shes / /byang chub sems las 'byung bar 'gyur/ /phung sogs dngos po med gyur hurtelas/ /rang gis myong bar ni )shes par gyur sto/ /de ni 'jig rten shes 81wa 637

zhes bshad/ / kun mkhyen 1pa ni byang chub sems/ /nye bar dmigs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas sku ru 'di 'byung ste/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i rang bzhin nyid / /tshig gis brjod pa tsam du 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /rdo rje snying po'i don gsungs pa/ /'gro ba'i bla ma gcig pu la/ /phyag ②'tshal nas ni slar nagasol pa/ /'jig rten pa yi rin/lung nyid ni/ /byang chub sems ni rab gsungs na5kyi/ /ji ltar 'jig rten las 'das pa/ /ma 'ongs pa yis ji ltar rtogs/ /lta ba thams cad rab spang ri /phyir/ /khyed kyis chos rnams ston mdzad na/ /ji ltar byang chub sems de nyid/ /lta ba de ni rab brtan (7)'gyur/ /dgongs pa'i tshig la rmongs pa rnams/ /gsungs pa'i don ni ma rtogs nas/ / gsungs pa 8'di las gzhan min zhes/ /de ni ji bzhin sgrar 'dzin to/ /de nas bcom ldan sna tshogs pas/ /lag na rdo rje la gsungs pa/ /khyed gsung (gedagongs pa ma rtogs pa/ /dri 1 bar byed pa legs so legs17/ /byang chub sems ni rlung gyur cing / /nam mkha' la ni rnam gnas pa/ /sems can kun gyi srog gyur gang / /lnga yi bdag nyid bcu ming can/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis zhes grags pa/ /ngo bo nyid rnam gsum du gyur12/ /rlung zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems / /dbang po kun gyi gtso 'di yin/ /ji ltar mi mngon phra ba las/ /rtag tu gsal bar brjod pa yin/ /'gro ba yul sogs las byed pa/ /'dir ni de la rten 1dpa yin/ /zhi ba dang ni rgyas pa dang / /dbang dang de bzhin mngon spyod rnams/ /de nyid gsum gnas la rten 7nas/ /de kun byang chub sems kyis byed/ /ji srid 'jig rten gdags 15pa dang / /de bzhin btags chosapa sna tshogs rnams/ /rnam rtog byang chub sems shes pa'i/ /rlung las rtag tu 81—638

'byung ba yin/ /bde sdug la sogs chos rnams kyi/ /sa bon lta bur bshad pa yinam/ /byang chub sems kyi ngo bo 'di/ /phung sogs gnyis med mkha' dang mnyam / /shes rab thabs dang 0)sbyor ba yis/ /byang chub sems ni 'gro bar 'gyur / /klog dang bsam gtan rnam spangs dunanopar/ /bdag por rang nyid zlos rdzu cig de/ /nyin dang mtshan mo'i dbye ba yis/ /nyi zla rab tu sbyor ba yis/ /dngos po med par 'gro khyab pa/ /byang chub sems kyi rlung gcig pu/ /dge dang mi dge 'bras spangs nas/ /nam mkha' 'dra bar 'gyur ba yin/ /'gro ba'i don ni shes pas kyang / /ming ni de bzhin nyid ces bya/ /dbyangs kyi thung ngu nyin mor bshad/ /ring po mtshan mo yin par bshad/ /dbyangs dang gsal byed dbye ba las(pe/ /de nyid ming las sbyar bar bya/ /e ma'o 'gro ba'i bya ba byung ske/ /de nyid gzhan las de nyid gsal/ /de las 'jig rten pa yi brdatshor/ /myur du mngon par shes par 'gyur/ /de nas gsang ba'i bdag pos ni/ /byang chub sems 'di thos pa dang / /gtso bo rnam snang chen po las/ /khyab bdag la ni slar gsol (6)pa/ /sems can thams cad skyed pa po/ /sna tshogs gzugs can sems 'di ni/ /de bas dngos po med gyur kyang / /srid pa dag tu rab tu grags/ /byang chub sems ni mkha' mnyam pa/ /legs par rjes su myong mdzad pa/ /'gro ba'i don ni mdzad pa po/ /skye bo mchog la de bstan gsol / /sgrub pa yi ni thabs tsam zhig /shes nas rgyud la rgyab kyis 7phyogs/ /'di ltar bdag ni slob dpon zhes/ /ma 'ongs pa na smra bar 'gyur/ /bdag gi tshig ni 'di nyid dag /yin zhes smra /dezhing byas pa 'jig /des tsonani dgongs pa'i byang chub sems/ /ji bzhin don du mi shes so/ /de bzhin 81—639

'jig rten pa rnams ni/ /skal med chos kun rnam spangs la/ /rig pa yang ni mi mthong bas/ /de rnams la yang gnas med 'gyur/ /de bas byang chub sems bdud rtsi/ /de ni smra bar rigs pa yin/ / 'brel pa'i nyi ①ma thob pa ni / /ma 'ongs pa na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan sna tshogs pas/ /grags ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa la nas/ /byang chub sems kyi nges pa'i don/ /slar yang de nyid la gsungs pa/ /nang na ma yin phyi rol min/ /gnyi ga ming du'ang 'gyur ma yin/ /rtag pa ma yin skad cig min/ /de ni so so rang rig yin/ /mi rtog nam mkha' ji bzhin du/ /byang chub sems ni rdo rje 'dzin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'gro ba'i don/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bur 'byung (snen/ /'das dang ma 'ongs pa nyid dang / /da (bltar zhes ni bya ba dang / /sangs rgyas sku yang 'byung 'gyur ba/ /don dam gcig ni kun rdzob yin/ /rig byed dus dang me yi bad(5ra/ /nyi zla rlung gi gzugs can te/ /bzhi 5yephyed gsum pa dag las byung / /byang chub sems gcig dbye ba nyid/ /de ni shes rab thabs zung 'brel / /de bzhin bde byed 'dzin pa dang / /ha ni so la gnas pa yi(pe/ /gnas skabs ji snyed de bzhin tshor du/ /ming ni yod pa ma yin pa/ /de 'di byang chub sems su 'gyur/ /rdo rje nang du zhugs (r+sha gyur pa/ /bsam bya'i snying po'ang de nyid yin/ /lhod pa gnas zhes bya ba ni/ /tsheg skodrag bcas pa'i rlung yin rnal/ /rang nyid ldog 11par byed pa'i mchog /de ni srog dbang yid kyang yin/ /nga rgyal dang ni de bzhin blo/ /de dang ldan pa byang chub sems/ /bzhir grags cha las yang dag byung / /yod nyu med rab tu zhi ba can/ /dngos po med pa'i sems 'di ni/ /rang rig gcig pu'i nyu yul yin no0/ /de nyid don ni rig 81wa 640

byed pa/ /dgongs pas yang dag bshad pa yin/ /de nas gsang ba'i 1dgongs pa 'di/ /chos kyi 2)yi ge mchog thos nas/ /byams pa zhes la nasogs pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /ngo mtshar rmad 4byung legs skyes nas/ /ched du brjod pa ched du brjod/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas e ma'o chos / /e ma'o chos ni ston mdzad pa/ /dngos kun dag pa'i don gcig pu/ /dag pa de nyid don dag ster/ /rnam par mi rtog mdza' mtshungs bshad/ /byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag med chos las yang dag byung / /byang chub tshogs ni rdzogs byed pa/ /ngo bo med cing dmigs su med/ /byang chub sems la phyag ge'atshal lo/ /kun bzang gcig las yang dag byung / /dgongs don byang chub ster ba po/ /byang chub spyod mchog rdo rje mchog /byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab sgrub (7pa/ /rdo rje gsum ni rang bzhin gcig na /byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgongs pa lung ston la dad par/ /gang gang 2yid ni bzod gyur pa/ /dam tshig gsum gyis rdor+shaci rdo rje las/ /des ni de bzhin bya ba yin / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje gsum gyi gsang ba las/ /yang dag byang chub sems bshad pa/ /le'u gnyis pa yin par bshad// //de nas de nyid gsang rdo rje/ /gsum dang tshul gsum lam gsum mchog /rnam thar gsum dang dkon mchog gsum/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun bdag po//de bzhin gshegs pa kun bkod pal/ /'phro ba'i sprin gyi 11rdo rje can15/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms 1 zhugs te/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin la gsungs/ /rdo rje 81—641

bkod 1)pa mchog 'di yi/ /le'u brtul zhugs bzang po nyon/ /'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /phra mo rnal 'byor dag la bzhugs/ /oṃ ni gcig dang yang dag ldan/ /shu n+ya tā ni (geganyis pa ste/ /dz+nyā na zhes ni gsum pa layin// badz+ra zhes bya 4)bzhi pa'o/ /swa bhā bād+ma kuḥlnga pa(snye/ a haṃ zhes pa drug par brjod phyi / /de ltar bde (7)gshegs drug po (8)ni/ /skye bo mchog la bstan pa yin//oṃ shu n+ya tā ri9)zung dang po'i/ /dz+nyā na badz+ra gnyis pa yin/ /swa bhā bād+ma ko3 haṃ hunyegyur / /de nyid gsum ni 'dir brtags pa'o/ /de nyid gsum ni gcig gyur par / /mi gsal gsal ba'i ming can no/ /mkha' dbus sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor ni/ /'od zer sprin gyi tshogs chen po/ /yi ge ma yi 'od kyis khyab/ /kun nas yongs su skum po'o/ /'dod yon lnga yis kun du khyab/ /mchod pa rnam pa lngas brgyan 8pa/ /mdor na de ltar bsgoms nas su/ /dbus su gzugs ni bsgom par bya/ /rnam par snang mdzad phyag rgya mchog /de nyid gsum gyi rdo rjes nyanyamatshan/ /yang na rdo rje gsum mgon gyi/ /phyag rgya yang ni rnam par bsgom/ /mi bskyod pa yi phyag lirgya che/ /tshogs ni gnyis med sbyor (7ba dang ske/ /dkon mchog dpal gyi rgya chen dang / /tshe dpag med pa'i 'od byed dang ske/ /de bzhin don yod gzugs can rgya/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor dag tshetu bsgom/ /rdo rje gsum gcig rdo rje can/ /in+d+ra nī la'i lho mdog 'dra ba/ /rab 'bar phyag na rdo rje bsnams/ /rnam par gtsigs pa 'jigs 'jigs lta'i / /'dzam bu kyi chu bo'i gser 'od 17'dra/ /sangs rgyas sprin gyis 3 byerab tu 'khrigs / /de yi /phyag na rdo rje che/ /rtse mo dgu pa rnam par bsgom/ /shel dang zla ba'i 'od 'dra ba/ /thor tshugs cod pan dag gis brgyanasade/ /rab 81—642

'bar lag na 'khor lo bsnams/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /mar ka ta yi zhi)'od 'dra ba/ /rdo rje 'bar bas rnam par brgyanan)/ /'bar zhing ( )'bar ba'i tshogs kyis khyab/ /rin chen de la rnam par bsgom ri/ /'dod chags chen po rdo rje can/ /pad+ma rā ga'i mdog 'dra zhing / /thor tshugs cod pan dag gis brgyan(2/ /phyag na pad+ma bsnams par bsgom/ /sna tshogs rdo rje gdon mi za/ /'od chen sna lnga'i 'od 56 'dra ba/ /zhi ba sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor du/ /phyag na ral gri bsnams par bsgom/ /de ltar rnal 'byor bshad pa dag /gsang ba'i bdag pos thos nas ni/ /phra mo'i rnal 'byor cha dag kyang ske/ /de bzhin gshegs bdag la zhus pa/ /phung po khams sogs sbyor ba yis / /de bzhin gshegs pas bka' stsal na/ /mkha' dbus sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor du/ /de rnams kyang ni ji ltar 'gyur/ /cig 7shes phyi rol du bsgom pa/ /dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas ming 8can ni/ /dngos po med pa'i dngos po la/ /sgom pa po rnams ji ltar brtag /mgon po phra mo'i rnal 'byor 'di / /dkyil 'khor gang zhig bka' 465 zhes9ri/ /gang zhig ma 'ongs pa rnams ni/ /'di ltar mchog tu'ang som nyi 1 'tshal/ /lag na rdo rje grags ldan pa / /phra mo'i rnal 'byor de nyid skyes/ /'gro ba gnyis med sbyor ba yis phra ba dgongs pas gsungs pa yin/ /rnam lnga mngon par byang chub 'di/ /ma 'ongs skye bo'i rgyur gyur pa spe/ /chos ni yang dag sdud gyur 1lhagang / /ji lta ji ltar ston par byed/ /phung po nyid ni 1lhasangs rgyas gyur/ /byang chub don gyi rkyen las byung / /de yang de bzhin gshegs bshad pa/ /de nyid cingaganyis med sbyor bas so/ /ston dang 'jog pa po 'di ni/ /blo yi dngos grub ston pa po/ /81—643

thog mtha' med pa rnal 'byor ni/ /phra mo zhes ni bya bar brtag /mi gsal gsal bar yang dag sbyor/ /dngos med ngo bo las skyes pa'o/ /gzod ma nyid nas rab grub pa/ /gcig dang du ma rnam spangs pa/ /rten 'brel chos zhes ①grags pa ste/ /dngos po thams cad gcig tu byung rdzus/ /bdag nyid 'di 'drar byas nas ni/ /chos kyi dkyil 'khor yang dag bri/ ri/ /dmar dang nag ④dang de bzhin ser(5/ /dkar po nyid ni mdo ru ste/ /bzhi bzhi gcig tu sbyor ba yang //gos dkar la sogs yang dag bri/ /de rnams dbus su lha mor bcas zhi sbyor mchog dang mchog min can(6)/ /steng dang thad ka mnyam dang 'og /ji lta ji ltar gos dkar sogs/ /me dang rlung dang dbang chen dang / /chu ste so so'i dkyil 'khor la/ /bcwa (khebargyad dag tu yang dag bshad/ /de yang 'di nyid dag la bshad/ /ji ltar 'o ma khyad par ni/ /mar sar (sheganas par gyur pa yin / /de bzhin gos dkar la (9)sogs la/ /zhi ba nyid ni de gnas so/ /gzugs la sogs pa nang gi chos/ /mthong ba de ni lhag mthong yin/ /mi bskyod la sogs grangs ji bzhin/ /rtog pa dag ni zhi boganas yin/ /'di gnyis dngos po med pa'i bdag /de bzhin nyid ni zhi zhes bya/ /de bzhin nyid kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gzhug /lhapar bya/ /rnal 'byor pa yi 12dbugs rngub dbyung / /sbyor ba de nyid gcig pa nyid/ /shes rab thabs la gnas nas ni/ /sngags kyi yan lag ma nyams bzlas/ /bya ba thams cad nyid du yang / /rnal 'byor rig pas nyal sogs la/ /ming mang nyurtabarjod du med pa dang / /dus gsum 'das pa rtag tu bzla/ /gos dkar la 'isogs bzlas bshad pa/ /brgya phrag gnyis dang nyi shu lnga/ /bzhi pa legs par 81wa 644

bsgres pa yis0tsho/ /sbyor bzhis bsdus pa (2brgya phrag dgu/ /dgu brgya dag tu gang bstan pa/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i ri rim gyis ni/ /de ni so sor 'byung ba las/ /nyi khri gcig rigastong drug brgya'o/ /de 'dir gsang ba dgongs pa yis/ /phra mo'i rnal 'byor bstan pa yin/ /klog 5nodang bsam gtan med mod kyi/ /'on kyang bzlas pa yin par bshad/ /de ltar rnam pa mang po yirme/ /'gro la phan pa'i gsung thos nas/ /de bzhin gshegs kun bdag po la/ /rdo rje can gyis slar yang zhus/ /gang zhig bsgoms na ma 'ongs 'gro/ /thams cad mi rtog par 'gyur ba/ /rdo rje gsum gyi snying po mchog /snying po bcom ldan bshad du gsol / /de nyid gsum nyid (7 med sbyor ba/ /de ni phra mo'i rdo rje bsgom/ /myur ba la (she)sogs gsum spangs pa'i/ /rnal 'byor par yang bdag cag 'gyur//de ni bdag rig yid ches shing (9/ /zhi ba nyid ni mi shes 'gyur/ /phra mo'i rnal 'byor gtso spangs te/ /log pa'i rnal 'byor kun du bstenas/ /ston pa po yi sbyor smra 7zhing / /phra mo zhes bya de nyid ni/ /ma 'ongs dus na spong 'gyur ba/ /de nyid de ni nges par byed/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin smra ba'i/ /lung bstan pa ni gsan pa dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa kun bdag po/ /chos dbyings 12ngo bo nyid ces bya'i(2/ /ting nge 'dzin de kun nas ni/ /snyoms par zhugs pa nyid du mdzad/ /dpal ldan snyoms par zhugs mdzad nas/ /gsang sngags 'di ni bka' stsal to'i/ /sku gsung thugs ni rdo rjer bshad/ /khyad par du ni byin rlob pa/ /gnyis med skardo rje gsum sbyor bas/ /de ni yang dag bshad par bya / /oṃ ni dang por shes par bya/ /dharma zhes bya gnyis pa'o/ /dhā tu zhes bya gsum par bshad/ /swa bhā bar 15grags bzhi pa'o/ /āt+pa kuḥ1 ni lnga pa yin/ /81wa 645
