sbyor ba ni/ /phyag rgya gcig pu'i sbyor ba dang / /gsang sngags gcig pus mi 'grub ces/ /khyod ni chos rnams ston 7par mdzad/ /'di 2ni sngags sbyor gcig pu las/ /phyag rgya bstan par ma mdzad na/ /gsang sngags gcig skyes dngos grub ni/ /'jig rten pa rnams ji ltar bsgrub( ri/ /sngags la dmigs pa'i sbyor gyur dang nga/ /lha rnams kyi yang sbyor las byung / /'gro ba'i don ni rab bsgrub ༷ pa/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bur 'gyur/ /'jig rten 'das pa zhes bya dang / /yang na shin tu 'jig rten 'das/ /mgon po 'jig rten pa rnams kyi(6)/ /ji ltar 'gro la de du niphan 'gyur/ /spyan drang ba nadang gshegs su gsol / /'dir ni ji ltar legs par brjod/ /gang gis 'dir ni dngos grub 'grub / /lha rnams mngon phyogs ji lta bu/ /'di dag ma 'ongs skye bo yis/ /gang zhig shes na yang dag par/ /nges par rnam rtog med 'gyur ba/ /mi 99yi skyes bu 'di dag gsungs/ /de nas mgon po bcom ldan 'das/ /dgongs pa'i gsang ba dam pa ste/ /phyag rgya'i nges pa 57'jig rten pa'i/ /phyag na rdo rje la gsungs so/ /rnam rtog masna tshogs lcags zhes bya/ /nyes pa gsum tshogs bdag nyid las/ /gsang sngags skyes bu'i sbyor ba yis/ /de ni mi mchog dag tu 'gyur/ /gser 'gyur rtsi yi rnam pa yis1ge/ /lcags ni gser du byed pa yin / /de bzhin sngags kyi de nyid kyis/ /mi ni bder gshegs byed pa yin/ /nges byas sbyor ba'i gsang sngags ni12/ /zhi bde dngos grub ster bar 'gyur/ /phyag rgya med pa'i sngags gcig pus/ /sngags kyi skyes bur 'gyur ba yin/ /dngos med pa las yang dag skyes/ /sngags kyi skyes bu 'byung ba ste/ /'di ni phyag rgya chen po ste/ /'gro ba'i don ni rab sgrub skepa'o/ /spyan drang bar ni 81—697

bzhugs pa yis/ /myur ba 1)yis ni gshegs (kyesu gsol/ /gnas pa yis ni de bsgrub sa)pa'o/ /yid rton bdangos grub dam pa yin/ /de ni skyes bu'i sbyor ba yis / /phyag rgya che dang gcig bsgrub ⑤las/ /myur ba la ⑥sogs gsum ldan pa//de ni phyag rgya yin par bshad/ /'bad de bla mas slob ma yig/ /rna ba'i drung du bshad par bya/ /myur ba dang ni 'jug pa dang / /gnas pa'i rjes su sbyor ba rnams / /spyan drang ba dang gshegs su gsol/ /'di dag phyag rgyar (0yang dag gyur / /sgrub pa la ni myur la 994sogs/ /ci rigs pa ni nges par sbyar/ /phung po la (7sogs chos rnams kun/ /stong zhing rten 'brel las byung ba/ /mthong zhing de bzhin sbyor ba las/ /chos kyi skur ni de gnas 'gyur/ /'dir hunyeni gsang sngags sbyor 'gyur med/ /phyag rgya'ang chos sku 'di nyid yin/ /de lta na yang 'gro ba'i don/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bur byed/ /'on te rdo rje 'dzin gang zhig /sbyor ba gsum dang ldan pa'i mi/ /spyan drang ba dang gshegs su gsol / /de bzhin du ni gnas gyur pa'o/ /nye ba'i tshig ni spyan drang ba/ /ring nas lag par rab tu sbyor/ /de bzhin gsang 8sngags de nyid kyang / / gnyi ga nyagel ni yang dag sbyor/ /rigs kyi dbye ba sbyor ba yis/ /phyag rgya bud med yin par bshad/ /sems kyi rkyen sbyor bdag nyid ni/ /'jig rten par 'ini rab tu brtag /rang gi mtshan mar 8yang dag sbyor/ /rigs kyi dbye ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /phyag rgyas sa 8gsum la gnas pa/ /sa 'og klu yi bu mo yang / /brtul zhugs can gyi sems kyis dgug /gzhug pa'i rim rtso pa nyid dang ni/ /de rnams gnas pa'i sbyor ba nyid/ /dngos med de nyid gcig pu yis/ /'gro ba thams cad dgug par bya/ /gzhan yang gsang ba po 12yi mchog /sems kyi 81—698

rgyan (1)ni nyid ltos dang / /dngos med byang chub 'thob pa la/ /gsang sngags med cing phyag rgya med/ /'jig rten na ni rtog ci snyed(2na/ /dus gsum du ni kun 'byung ba/ /de ni dngos med sems gcig las/ /rnal 'byor pas ni skad cig rtogs/ /byang chub kun rdzob ma yin la/ /de las gzhan du'ang rnyed mi 'gyur/ /gnyi (geg las min gzhan las min/ /mun pa'i sgron ma mtshungs par 'gyur/ /sems can bsam pa'i dbang gis sngags/ /gsang ba 'di ni rab ston te/ /de ni sgrub dang bsgrub bya dang / /rnam par mi rtog brtags pa'o(ge / /sems can kun gyi longs spyod du/ /sngags kyi skyes bu rab tu gnas/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sbyor ba ni/ /rnam par dben par tshor)rab tu brtag /gsal dang mi gsal yang dag ldan/ /klung 6skudang 'bab chu la 57)sogs yin/ /mya ngan 'das pa gnas sbyor ba/ /dur khrod la /sogs pa yi ming / /'di ni sngags rig mchog (9༄rnams kyi/ /bsam gtan bsdus las spyod pa'o/ /'jig rten 'das pa de nyid 'dir/ /'jig rten pa ni bzlog 7pa'o/ /mi bskyod ye shes la hunyesogs pa/ /rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil du bsam/ /mngon shes lnga yi sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas mchog gi gnas su bsgomanyan/ /rdo rje mngon shes rdo rje che/ /dam tshig mchog tu bka' stsal to/ /rdo rje chen po rab mdzes ba rtse lnga pa la de bzhin 'khor12/ /rang bzhin lnga ru sbyor ba yis/ /mngon shes lnga por 'gyur ba yin/ /mngon shes lnga yi ting 'dzin la/ /gnas nas bla na med pa brtag /gtso bo me stag mang po 'khrug /rang sngags 'khor lo bsgom par bya / /rdo rje la ni rab dgod pas1 / /rdo rje mngon shes skye bar 'gyur/ /nam mkha'i 3gerdo rje dbus gnas par/ /'khor lo rdo rje 'bar 'od 'dra/ /sangs 81wa 699

rgyas 'jug par rab bsgoms na/ /sangs rgyas mchog dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /lus la rnam par snang mdzad gzhag1 /snying gar 2yi ge oṃ bsams na/ )/ /sngags la mngon shes bsgom par 'gyur / /'gog pa rdo rje gyur pa'i sems/ /nam zhig bdag nyid bdag las skyes / /sangs rgyas kun mchog 'byung ba yi(4)/ /dpal ldan yid bzhin nor bur 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /der ni mi bskyod rab tu bsgom/ /ju ni snying ga'i 5)zla gnas par/ /bsams (6)la sems ni de ru bzhag /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /tshe dpag med pa rab tu sbyor/ /āḥ rini snying ga'i 987thig ler gnas/ / bsams la rdo rje'i yang (gedag bzhag /'di ni dgongs pa'i mchog gi mchog /rdo rje mi phyed gsum sbyor skyes / /'gog pa'i dam tshig ye shes te/ /sangs rgyas dngos grub cher 'byung ba'o / /nam mkha'i 7rdo rje dbus gnas par/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /sku gsung thugs kyi yi ge oṃ/ /bsams na bskal pa gcig tu gnas / /nam mkha'i 31rdo rje dbus gnas par/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /lus dang ngag sems yi ge āḥ/ /bsams nyurten bskal pa dag tu gnas/ /mkha' dbyings rdo rje dbus gnas par/ /rdo rje'i (snyedakyil 'khor bsgom par byas/ /lus dang ngag sems yi ge hūm̐/ /bsams na de ni bskal par gnas/ /bcom ldan bdag po rdo rje gsum/ /dam tshig rtogs mapas de skad gsungs/ /dgu tshamatha' can gyi yi ge 'di/ /sngags kyi skyes bu mchog tu 'gyur / /brjod du med cing ming med la/ /shes dang shes bya rnam spangs pa'ang ske/ /kun rdzob la ni legs gnas nasanyu / /tshig gi sngags su 'di brjod 81—700

do / /rdo rje gsum gyi rdo rje can/ /rnal 'byor 'dir 'gyur phyin cad ni/ /gang zhig klog gam sems kyang rung / /rdo rje ye shes lta bur 'gyur/ /ji ltar gsang ba'i rgyal dbang po/ /dgongs pa lung ston 'di 91༄gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis ②de lung bstan9kye/ /khyad par du yang byin gyis rlob/ /klog cing sgom dang ldan par ni/ /bris nas gang du 'jog gyur pa/ /de ni (4kyisangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rigs skyes rgyal ba'i sras su 'gyur/ /khams gsum thams cad bcom nas ni/ /myur bar de bzhin gshegs 'gyur zhing / /'khor los sgyur ⑤ba'i bu bzhin du/ /byang chub myur du des 'thob bo/ /khams gsum sku dang gsung thugs kyi/ /sngags pa'i yan lag gyur pa ni/ /sangs rgyas 'dus la brten pa yis/ /de ni dngos po med par 'joms/ /dngos med gcig tu 6rirdzogs longs spyod/ /phung sogs yan lag don las byung97༄/ /bde gshegs sems can spangs pa ni/ /sngags pa sngags las gyur pa yin/ /ji ltar nam mkha' rang mtshan nyid/ /skad cig pyogekyang ni 'dor mi byasal/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas thams cad kyang / /rigs las skyes pa byin gyis rlob/ /dgongs la lung ston 7la gnas nas/ /gsang ba'i huXrin chen yang dag bsrung 12/ /mig gzugs hunyerang gi ngo bo nyid/ /spyod pa ci dga' byed par 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs kun ye shes ni/ /gsang ba'i dgongs pa'i ming can te/ /sku dang gsung mthugs gsang ba dang / /gsang sngags dam tshig de nyid byung / /de ni rig pa skyes bu mchog /bcu gcig par ni yang dag bshad//ras ni bris dang mtshungs par 'byung / /'thob pa'i phyir ni le'ur 15gyur/ /81—701

de nas dpal ldan rnam snang mdzad/ /bskyed gyo)pa ye shes bla ma gtso/ /de nyid dam tshig mchog gyur pa/ /rdo rje gsung gis bka' stsal to/ /mkha' dang mtshungs shing mi rtog la/ /rang bzhin gyis ni dam chos can/ /dngos med shin tu dri med la / /dam tshig gcig tu gyur kyang ni(sa/ /gar dang glu dang rol mo dang / / dgod dang sgeg lapas rab mdzes pas/ /'jig rten sangs rgyas gar mkhan gyisabla / /rol mo 'di dag rab tu bsgom/ /gzhon nus bsgrubs (pepa'i sems can ni/ /ji lta ji ltar ston pa bzhin/ /gar sogs rtsed (7mos byang chub ni/ /myur du de nyid las 'thob 'gyur/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lngar ldan pa/ / de yi ming ni yid ldan pa/ /pyogedakon mchog gsum la skyabs su gnas/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /sems can gang 'di mthong ba dang / /thos shing rig tshozhedapar gyur pa ni/ /de ni u dum wā 9ra yi/ /me tog 'dra bar gyur pa yin / /sems can kun gyi gtso bo 'di/ /gsung gi rdo rje chos nyid skyes/ /gcig dang du ma las grol ba/ /rten 'byung gsal bar byed pa yin/ /de nas gsang ba'i bdag mchog de/ /chos kyi de nyid marab ston pa/ /thub chen rnam par snang mdzad la/ /thal mo sbyar ba byas nas zhus/ / mgon po 11de nyid bsdus pa las/ /rol mo 'dir ni gyur pa dang / /'jig rten pa de gar byed pal/ /gsungs te ma 'ongs skye bo ni/ /chos dbyings de ni gar min na/ /gtso bo ji ltar gar bgyid lags/ /rmongs pa'i 'jig rten rgyang pan garanyin/ /gsang mthon myos pas bskul ba yin/ /chos dbyings de ni glu min na/ /gtso bo ji ltar glu len 'gyur/ /rmongs pa'i 'jig rten rgyang pan 512gru/ /gsang mthon samyos pas bskul ba lags/ /chos dbyings de ni rol mo min/ /gtso bo 81wa 702

ji ltar rol mor 'gyur/ /'jig rten rgyang pan rmongs (19rol mo/ /gsang mthon myos pas bskul ba lags/ /chos dbyings de rgod (2ma lags na/ /gtso bo ji ltar rgod par 'gyur/ /rmongs pa'i 'jig rten rgyang pan na/rgod/ /gsang mthon myos pas bskul ba lags/ /chos dbyings de sgeg ma lags na/ /gtso bo ji ltar sgeg par 'gyur/ /rmongs pa'i 'jig rten rgyang pan (4)sgog /gsang mthon myos (zhedapas bskul ba lags/ /de ltar rnam pa mang po la/ /gzhan rnams kyang ni sbyor byed cing / /bza' dang min las sbyor ba yis6)/ /rnal 'byor pa ni bdag yin snyam/ /rdo rje yi ni tshig mchog 'di/ /yod med rab tu zhi ba nyid / /de yi rang bzhin gcig sbyor bdag /yang dag mchog bsdus de nyid mchog /de nas de nyid yang dag gzung 77)/ /rnal 'byor rigs mchog rnal 'byor pa/ /de nyid gsum mnyam nyid sbyor ba/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni rol mo ston//sna tshogs tshul gyis rnam dgod pas/ /nor can ming ni nyams la rdogesogs/ /gcig pu'ang yi /dpag med dngos bshad pa'i/ /gar gyis skye dgu dga' bar bobyed / /rdzogs pa'i byang 911chub sogs dngos grub/ /sna tshogs khyed 12kyis gsungs pa rnams/ /sems zhi ba yi 1lharnal 'byor pa/ /de rnams lhun gyis grub par 'gyur/ /mgon po shes rab 'di srid du/ /thabs kyis mchil 7par nye bar sbyor/ /sngags kyi gzan gyi sbyor ba yis/ /khyed ni 'jig rten pa rnams 'dzin / /bshad du zin kyang mi rig pa/ /dgongs pa'i gsang ba dam pa ni/ /gzhan rnams la ni ston mdzad pa/ /ngo bo nyid ni 1lhagazhan min pa'o/ /phyi rol sngags don dngos grub ni/ /de nyid du ni tshol mod kyi/ /'gal ba'i rjes 'jug chos nyid can/ /der yang 'grub rilapar 'gyur ma 1 yin/ /de rnams 81wa 703

gsang ba mi srung zhing / /sred pa yis ni sten ①par byed/ /bcom ldan 'das gsung gsang ba ni/ /gsang mchog tshig gis sgrogs (kyepar byed/ /khyod bka' las 'das dman pa rnams/ /sngags kyi nus pa rnam spangs pa/ /'jig rten pa rnams snang 'gyur zhing / /de rnams 'grub par 'gyur ma yin/ /sred pa'am dad pa dag gis kyang / /rkyen (kyedang de bzhin nyan thos rnams/ /gsang ba la ni smig rgyu bzhin/ /rigs skyes gzhan yang ltung bar 'gyur/ /mgon po de ni der gnas shing / /nyams shing 0blo gros dman par gnas/ /de nas tshig min gyur par 'byung (5 / /tshig gi bdud rtsi sbyor ba las/ /chos kyi tshul 'di thos pa dang / /phyi nas 'jigs shing skrag par 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa' lhung 'gyur bar/ /bdag nyid che de byed par 'gyur/ /de bzhin byang chub 'gyur ba dang / /sngags pa rnams kyang gsang ba lags/ /shes rab pha rol phyin sbyor ba/ /gsang ba mdo sde rnam smra ba/ /gdong g.yogs pa yi sbyor ba yis/ /de tshe tshig gis rig skyes pa/ /gsang sngags la (6)sogs chos rnams la / / dad pa tso)rnams ni skyed mi byed/ /log pas mkhas pa'i nga rgyal ni/ /byis pa phyi nas byed par 'gyur/ /a yi dog pa'i ras 'di ni/ /sbyor bshes rdo rnams kyi 'di ma yin/ /de rnams dad pas rjes 'jug pa/ /gtam dag kyang 9 ni byed par 'gyur/ /sgyu ni g.yo yi tshul gyis na'i/ /rgyal po rnams ni slu bar byed/ /steng du g.yogs pa dag gis ni/ /brgyad gnyis pa yi 11tshul du byed / /de ni ma 12skyes pa yi 1lhabadag /ras kyi rgyu med pa nyid ni/ /āḥ7yi dog ras 12nyid rgyal po'i/ /yang dag dngos grub byed pa'i mchog /dam pa'i skye ba sanyid mthong na/ /de ni longs spyod lam skyed min/ /de bas skye bo med 81—704

gcig pu(7/ /bya ba'i sems ni rab tu 'jug /der ni mche ba can ming rin)'gro//de la btsal 'dab 'ba' zhig gyo/yin/ /rgyal po dngos grub chen po'i ras/ /bar chad shin tu ⑤mang po pa/ /bya ba de ni rnam par 'joms/ /sgrib pa med pa'i rnal 'byor can/ /des (6 ni tshig de thos pa dang / /rgyal po'i bar du yid dga' zhing / /dngos grub chen po'i rigs mchog las/ /su zhig bdag ni 7nizlog par byed/ /ras kyi (nyebar chad byed pa dag /de la chad pas gcad 9par bya / /'di la 'jigs pa'i sems 'ong ri7la/ /skye bo med par khyed 37kyis ni/ /rgyal rigs tsodag gam rigs bzangs sam3lha/ /gang zhig mi srun rigs tshacan rnams / /dog pa med pa ras 'jig nyagepa/ /de dag thams cad brlag par bya/ /de nas rgyal po sbyin pa ni/ /rgyud kyi slob dpon bdag nyid cheshi/ /rin chen rin thang med lnga sogs/ /bde ba kun gyi 'bras bu'o/ /'di yis nyu tshogadong ni g.yogs nyunyenas su/ /rgyal po 'bras bu longs spyod cig / āḥyi dog (17pa ras de byin/ /ji ltar skye bzhin rgyal po byas rte/ /rin chen rin thang med blangs rnams / /'di ni ji ltar bzhag 21nas su/ /de nas de ni mi snang ba/ /rgyun can gyis geni de tshe byas/ /de la sogs pa'i sna tshogs tshig /rigs skyes pa la de rnams smra/ /rang nyid 'jigs shing gzhan rnams kyang / /skrag par byed cing the tshom na med/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs bdag po/ /'byin pa ston pa mnga' bdag gtso/ /phyag na rdo rje go byed pa/ /snyan 0pa'i gsung gis tsho rnyibaka' stsal pa/ /rdo rje rdo rje chen po legs/ /rdo rje thal mos ston par byedan / /rdo rje 'di ni zhus gyur pa/ /de nyid bsdus pa dam pa'o/ /rdo rje thal mo de nyid 'di / /lung bstan bya yis na de nyon cig /de nyid gsum du gyur pa de/ /rdo 81wa 705

rje thal mor yongs su brtag /de nyid gsum ni lha gsum ste/ /tshangs dang khyab 'jug dbang phyug che/ /de ru nga 0)ni lha gsum 'gyur/ /oṃ āḥrgyu dang grangs mnyam pa'i/ /gsang sngags 'jug pa thams cad ni/ /sna tshogs lus can gcig ming can/ /zhi ba nyid ni gang du ston/ /der ni nga ②yang gnas pa yin / /dpral miyon de la bzhin mi sdug /de yi skyes bu ming ldan ming / /de rnams lag pa'i dbus nas ni/ /thim ④sogs ji bzhin grangs su bshad/ /lag pa g.yon ni drag por gyur(57// /g.yas pa de bzhin khyab 'jug ste/ /gnyis pa sbyor bar 6)tshangs pa yin/ /de bas yon tan gsum bdag dang / /rig dang mchod sbyin snyan tshig ste/ /rig byed der gyur gsum du bshad/ /srid srung 77)zhi ba nga yin te/ /mthar ni 'gro ba gnas pa yin/ /lag pa gnyis pa 'di dag ni/ /bzhi po'i byed phyed (8narnam brgyad pa/ / phyed po'i tsham gyi hūm̐ ⑨mchog ni/ /rab tu zhi bar rab tu bsgrags7/ /nyi ma zla ba mi rnams der/ /so sor yongs su bsgrags pa yin/ /yi ge phyed tsam mchog gyur pa(7/ /shis pa zhi ba skyon med pa/ /yon tan oṃ dang yi ge phyed/ /oṃ zhes gsal bar brjod pa yin/ /sna yi rtse mor yang dag ldan/ /gtsug mtha' dang ni lag pa skoganasal/ /nyi ma zla ba'i sbyor 3lhab las/ /ye shes me ni nges par skye/ /lce dang rkan gyi mtshan ma ni/ /sbyor las thar bar 7de bshad de/ /āḥlcage 'og tu āḥshidang yang dag ldan/ /de steng yi ge āḥha nyid de/ /thad ka ru ni ma bshad de/ /khyod ni yig 1 phyed zhi ba nyid/ /yi ge oṃ ni tshangs pa ste/ /āḥ/rteni khyab 'jug yin par bshad/ /hūṃ ni rlung du gyur pa yin/ /de nyid drag po zhes bya'o/ /zhi ba'i phyed phyed zhes tsho )bya ba/ /der ni bdag yongs bsgrags pa yin/ /gnas 81—706

dang 'pho dang skye ba dang / /gzhan gyi lus las 1)yang dag 'pho/ /ye shes rang nyid med (5)yin te/ /khyab du kyipar 'dzin pa de bzhin no/ /ral gri la 94/sogs dngos grub der/ /byang chub phyi rol nyid 'grub 'gyur/ /gnyis po 'di dag gnas pa yi/ /rnam dag 'di dag rab tu brtag /tshangs pa la sogs pa rnams deraX5)/ /ma 'ongs pa rnams sgom par 'gyur/ /de ni mtho ris sogs 'gags (6)pas/ /de bzhin 'gyur ba sel ba (7)yin/ /rnal 'byor pa rnams srog 98rinaspangs nas/ /gnyis spyad par ni rnam par gnas/ /shin tu sbyor gcig gyur song bas/ /'jug 'gyur ba ni drag po yin/ /nam mkha' dgag pa'i (9risbyor ba yang / /tshangs par gzhol ba'i bdag nyid can/ /mngal gyi gzugs gyur khyab 'jug ste/ /de yi dbus na dbus bzung ribob/ /spu yi cha ni stong las gcig /zhi de rnam par mi rtog nyid/ /thar pa gcig pur de ston bya/ /thar pa'i 1nyengo bo nyid ma yin/ /de lta bas na 'di log bya12/ /zhi ba nyid ni sgrogs 1lhapa'o / /ston pa de rnams phye nas ni/ /zhi ba'i chos rnams smra bar 'gyur/ /thabs chen de bzhin shes rab dag /'di 'dra mthong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /tshangs la sogs pa'i lha rnams kun/ /khyod sakyi thal mo dag la gnas/ /de rnams phyag rgya ston byed cing / /sngags ni bye ba 'amatha' yas pa/ /'di nyid du ni nyi zla dang / /sbyin sreg 17las can me dang ni/ /lo dang zla ba'i sbyor ba dang //rtag tu 'char 51 —dang 'phel 'grib dang / /de nyid gsum gyi 412sbyor skyes 'di/ /de nyid gcig pu rnam par gnas/ /zhi ba nyid kyi sbyor chos la(19/ /de yang gcig dang du ma spangs/ /khyed kyi thal mo tsho /las byung ba/ /de bas de ni 'da' mi bya/ /de bzhin gshegs kun spangs 'gyur bas 1/ /de ni spang lhabar mi bya 81wa 707

zhing ske/ /'di dag dngos med la ltos pas/ /rnal 'byor pa ni mchog tu 'dod//gzhan du rnam rtog nyid las ni/ /dngos grub 'bras bu'i snod mi 'gyur/ /de bas thal mo sbyar (1)ba 'di/ /sems can rjes bzung )midam pa yin/ /ma bsdus pa tshogeyi sems can rnams/ /bsdu ba'i don du khyod kyis bya/ /smad (pebya 'on pa lkugs (5)pa dang / /de bzhin long bar gyur pa dang / /gang zhig 'phye bo la sogs gyur/ /de rnams la ni phan phyir bya/ /de la sogs pa mdor bsdus pa/ /de ni khyed ⑥kyi thal mor ri7)gnas/ /de ni 'jig rten 'das gtsor gyur/ /de nyid bsdus pa'i rgyu can no/ /de ni nang min phyi ma yin/ /gnyis min gzhan gyi rgyu las min / /phyag rgya tshogs pa las skyes min/ /'jig rten rkyen las byung ba min/ /rdo rje thal mo bsdams pas na smyo/ /ming ni rdo rje thal mor gyur/ /sems can rnams kyis rtogs dka' (7ba'i/ /snying po rtogs 77par bya ba'i hostomachog /phyag rgya 'di lta bu 'di yin/ /phyi nang gnyis kyi ming can no/ /mi bskyod rin chen dpag med de/ /dngos grub rnam snang de bzhin gshegs/ /'di dag lag pa g.yas pa yi/ /mthe'u chung la sogs rnams la gnas/ /gnyis por gcig 'gyur 1 dge 'dun te/ /de 'di (7skyabs ni gsum yin te/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun rnams/ /gcig dang gsum du brtags pa yin//phan tshun bcings pa'i rdo rje nyid/ /shes rab thabs kyi gnas mthong 8yin/ /thal mo bcings pa tsam gyis kyang / /sangs rgyas thams cad nyid thob 'gyur/ /skyabs slogasum dang ni 1 de nyid gsum/ /rdo rje gsum dang rnam thar gsum/ /zhal gsum mdog gsum spyan gsum dang / /lha gsum dang ni khams gsum dang ske/ /dus gsum dam tshig mchog gsum dang tsan/ /tshul gsum dkyil 'khor 81—708

gsum du 'gyur/ /sbyor ba gsum dang lam gsum ste1/ /ji srid rtogs pa'i 'dod (gepa rnams/ /de ni thal mor tsho ཿsbyor 'di yin/ /'dod nor yon tan gsum gyi mchog /rim dang bslab 94)pa ster ba dag /ma 'ongs skye bos 'thob dzon par 'gyur/ /de nyid du ni der 'gyur na/ /gcig dang du ma tsho6)rnam par spangs / /chos bshad bshad pa dngos med pa/ /'gro'i ba rkyen gyis yang dag sdud / /'di ni mkhar 7)ltar rang bzhin gcig /gnas med gnas pa zhes bya ba / /bsdu bar tsho8)byas par gyur pas kyang / /sku gsum 99)don gyi chos nyid do/ /'di ni thog mtha' med pa ste/ /dngos po med cing gnas med pa/ /mtha' med zad pa med par 'gyur0/ /sku gsum dag ni 1)rkyen las ni/ /rnam pa'i 'jug pa'i ye shes te/ /de las sangs rgyas snying por gyur/ /hūm̐ gis sems can yang dag 'byin/ /sangs rgyas skur tsho12ni rab tu brtag /oṃ nya ni thams cad sdud pa ste/ /āḥ7ni gnas pa por 15'gyur ro/ /gcig pu rnam gsum de bzhin lnga/ /gsal dang mi gsal sbyor ba ni/ /rten 'brel chos nyid 'di yin te / /de nyid kyi ni sngags bshad pa'o/ / zlos dang 17bsam gtan rnam bral bar / /de yi lhun grub 'bras bu ster rje/ /rang bzhin grub pa 'di yin te/ /'dod pa'i bzlas nyu2par de bshad do/ /rnal 'byor pa la de gsal te/ /byis 19rnams de la phyin ci log /rkyen las byung ba de nyid gsum/ /dngos po med par de bshad do/ /de nyid bsdus pa bshad pa ni/ /yid min pa yi bzlas par gyur( )ske/ /yid rten chagacig ni mdor bsdus las/ /rings dang dal dang gnas pa rnams/ /zhi ba'i chos nyid 22la skye ste/ /nam mkha'i dbyings dang mnyam par thim / /dngos po med pa'i de nyid 'di/ /rten 'byung chos zhes 22bya ba yin/ /81wa 709

longs spyod rdzogs pa'i bsdus de 0)gyur/ /sprul pa bsam mi khyab ces dben/ /sdud pa por kyeni gang gyur pa/ /de yang phul du gyur pa'i ming / /rdo rje la sogs (5)yang dag sbyar4)/ /sems can rnams ni de sbyor (5)byed/ /dam tshig la sogs sngon de ni/ /de nyid kyis ni rdo rjer 561sbyar/ /sems can dgongs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /de yi chos rnams ston par byed/ /rnam pa dgu po thog mtha' can / /sdud 7)pa po rnams byas pa yin/ /gsang sngags de nyid gnas dgod pas / /sems can rnams ni der 'jog ste/ /gsol ba 'debs dang phyag 'tshal dang / /'jig rten rnams la gsol ba nadang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams mnyes byed de/ /khyod kyi thal mor 59gnas pa yin/ /gang zhig sems can sangs rgyas gyur/ /de bzhin gnyis med chos nyid can / /gnas med gnas pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /thams cad sangs rgyas rnams gnas so/ /sna tshogs mtshon pa de nyid do/ /mthong ba gsal byed thal mo yin/ /de bas de rnams mgu gyur pa/ /chos kyi de nyid rkyen las so/ /rgyu med rang gi de nyid 'di/ /khyed kyi phyag rgya'i sbyor las byung / /gang zhig shes pas 31'dod 'grub pa'i/ /dngos grub des ni thob par gyur/ /āḥ12nyid der ni mi gsal ba'i/ /rgyu nyustelas sbyor bar gyur pa yin/ /dog par de ni yongs nya tshobashad de/ /dngos po med par ras kyi siming / /'phags pa gshin rje gshed bsgoms la/ /gzhon nu'i gzugs su'ang bsgom par bya/ /dog pa de yi ras don las/ /mi snang ba la sogs grub cing / /yid bzhin nor bu 'dra ba'i mchog /'gro ba'i don gcig yang dag byung / /āḥ7yi dog ras mtshon pas ni/ /'jig rten pa la dgongs pas bshad/ /'di ni chos dang rdzogs longs spyod/ /sprul pas de ni 81—710

gsum du 'gyur/ /byis pa rtog par bya ba'i phyir/ /de ni rnam pa lngar yang 'gyur / /tha mal byis pa'i chos rnams gang / /rnam lnga gcig pa'i rnal 'byor pa / /de yang shin tu ldan sems can/ /sems can sogs la rnam par gnas/ /rtag pa ltar ni so sor snang / /'gro ba dus gsum mtshan nyid gcig /skye ba med las skyes pas na/ /gcig dang du ma rnam spangs pa'o/ /shes 'dod de tshe sngags pa ni/ /'gro ba byis pa de tshe spyod/ /de nas gsang sngags grub 'gyur bske/ /rnam par 0)mi rtog cig rinashos nyid/ /ya yi sde bsogs gnas byas te/ /sngags ni na ri bri bar bya/ /rang gi sde bcas gnas dag ni/ /yi ge a bzhin sngon 'gro ba/ /so so gzhan pa'i bzhi pa ni/ /i u dang ni ring por bcas/ /a i au u pa)ya ste mtha'/ /bzhi po dang bcas zlum por bri/ /bsam gyis 9ge)mi khyab sbyor ldan pa'i/ /'gro ba mnyam bzhag 67bskyed pa yin/ /'di dag rang skyes gnas gzugs kyi/ /chu yi yi ger zhugs par 'gyur/ /de nas gzhon nu'i gzugs nyid kyang / /rnam par bsgoms pas skye bar 'gyur/ /cha bcas dbang gnas sngags pa ni/ /bla med dngos grub thob ri7)par 'gyur/ /nā tshan ga yi ni grangs bzhin du/ /skud sogs sbyor la gang gnas pa/ /nyi shu yi ni sngon ma yang ske/ /de ni ras te bzhi pa'ang yin/ /sngon med cha lugs gzugs kyis ni/ /khams gsum dag ni lta bar 'dod/ /'gro ba'i don ni byed gyur pa'am9kyi/ /mnyam nyid ye shes de nyid las/ /yon tan gsum ni brda 7byas pa/ /yon tan med pa'i yon tan ming / /gzhon nu'i spyod pa'i lus kyi ming / /lta ba 'di ni ba ra skyes/ /de ni sgo glegs mtha' 1lhayin te/ /i u dang ni ring por bcas / /yi ge gsum bcas thig 512ler ldan/ /tsheg 518drag mtha' yi ring sde

can / /yi ge a ni yig sbyor ba'ang / /bcu gcig par yang gyur pa yin/ /de nyid ring po ring ba'i 37mthas/ /bcu gnyis pa yi grangs su 'gyur/ /de nyid yi ge ur sbyor las/ /yi ge oṃ zhes brjod pa yin/ /snga ma'i ri mo'i ②sbyor ba yinadus / /ming ni bcu bzhi par 'gyur ro/ /ci ste a las sngags pas ni/ /āḥ.e nyid du ni blta bar gebya/ /de bzhin a bayi sbyor ba las/ /yi ge a (7)ni ci 'dod par/ /ji bzhin grangs kyis (8༄yang dag blta/ /re re'ang a yi sbyor bas bsgo / /i ṛ '-i tso u'i tshogs las kyang / /sngags pa ya ra la wa'i gzugs/ /lkog ma mkha' 7dang bar dang ni/ /rkan dang spyi bor gang gnas pa/ /gang tshe ā ku'i 37sde grangs las/ /a hu yi kha yi rgyab na gnas/ / i tshan hu phrag pa lag pa dang / /tshigs (7rnams la ni de bzhin no/ /dpung pa dang ni lag pa dang / /lag pa g.yon par rab tu brtag(8 /dpyi dang brla dang byin pa 8dang / /rkang pa g.yas g.yon de bzhin no/ /gzugs de yi ni grangs mnyam pas/ /ta tshan bla tshoshin tu dngos grub ster/ /u tshan de bzhin dbus dang ni/ /lag pa ru ni yongs su bshad/ /rkang pa yang ni ri ti'i tshan32/ /'das pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa yin/ /de bzhin nyidi kyi sbyor ldan pa'i/ /sngags pa rnams kyis shin tu mthong ske/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i (yodangos grub pa/ /me tog gis mdzes phreng ba bzhin / /rang rgyud kyis 3 )ni nang nyid du/ /lha mchog dag ni bya ba yin/ /dgongs pa la sogs rnam pa kun/ /de nyid las ni bdag 'grub 'gyur/ /tsha ba'i gzhi 1bzhi sde na sbyor bas/ /mkhas pa yis ni sgo ‘ snyernams bya/ /ka tsa ṭa 3 )ta pa tshan yang / /dbus dang shar la ༷ gesogs sngon 'gro/ /'gro la phan pa'i 'dod pa yang / /ma spel bar ni mthong ba yin/ /thams cad kyang ni rdzogs yi 81—712

ge / /yi ge ha 1)yis mchod par bya/ /sna tshogs pa ni 'byin byed cing / /'gro ba dus gsum gcig pa'i dngos/ /yi ge a ni lus su bya/ /lhag ma rnam pa dang bcas pa/ /mtshams med lnga yi (0sbyor ba las/ /sngags pa 'gro ba phan par ston/ /sha thog mthar (5)gnas sngags las skye(4)/ /dbang bskur gsum po (lde spyi las skye/ /gzugs (7med rtogs pa'i chos rnams ni/ /skad cig 7gcig gis nges sbyor gyur/ /de tshe dkyil 'khor med byas pa/ /'jig rten pa yi 8chos dgar 'gyur/ /a ku ha gnas byang phyogs gnas/ /yod pa nyid kyang dus gsum 'das/ /gang dang gang nas byung ba yi/ /gsang sngags bsam gyis 9rimi khyab gsungs/ /de dang de ni bzhugs gyur pa/ /rang gi mtshan ma cig 1 )shos nyid/ /gzugs med 'di la gnas yod pa/ /cha ni gsum zhes bya bar 'gyur / /steng 'og phyogs 11kyi cha rnams su/ /dngos med pa ni rnam par gnas / /dngos po gcig gyur mthong ba dang / /'gro bcas tshangs pa 'gro bdag nyid/ /tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi po las/ /smon lam la sogs bsgom 12bya ba'o/ /'gro pho don gtogs 'dod pa yi ritshayon tan gyur bdag 515la/ /dgyes pa'i bde mchog dga' ba'i 'dod pa mdzod/ /sngon chad mdzad pa'i smon lam rab mchog dgongs nas ni/ /thub pa rdo rje'i tshig mchog rnam par dbye bar gsol/ /nor bu rin chen dag gis 9rnam brgyan sku yi hu tshomachog /'gro ba'i don lho byed sring mo bdag la brten nya9par mdzad/ /lhag pa'i snying rje las byung rab mchog ldan pa'i sku/ /bdag ni yongs su bzung la chos rnams don yod mdzod/ /sring mos kyang ni khyad par du/ /de ltar bskul ba tsam gyis )ni/ /de nas yongs su 'dzin mdzad de/ /rig pa'i pad+ma dpal du mdzad/ /shin tu 81—713

snyan cing yid 'ong dbyangs kyis ni/ /phan pas myur du 'gro ba gnyis med 'dir snod gyur/ /bla ma bdag ni gal te gson par mchis bzhed na/ /dga' ba las byung chos dga' bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /'gro ba dang ni 'ong dang gnas pa tsam 'di ni/ /nam yang ltos 6)par gyur pa dag gi mnga' ba lagasal/ /kun du song ba'i bdag nyid can gyi dam tshig ston/ /'dod pa'i yon tan rnams dang khyed bdag 'dod pa 'a mdzod/ /dgongs pa'i ye shes rdo rje yis / /sangs rgyas yon tan gcig la bzhugs/ /bzlas brjod sbyin sreg (kyede bzhin khrus/ /dkyil 'khor yongs su brtags pa mdzad/ /'dod pa med cing chags la zhi/ /de yang don dam dag gyur yin/ /spyod dus de bzhin sngags pa ni / /bzlas brjod dngos po med pa yin/ /bsnyengs pa yang ni yid bzang ldan / /mda' dang rig byed yon tan dang / /zung dang zla dkyil rnal 'byor pa / /dbyangs kyi yi ge gzhag gepar bya/ /ha yi sde tshan ka sde dang / /bcu gnyis phyed phyed dag tu sbyar/ /gshin rje'i gshed (dekyi gzugs 'di ni/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dag la dgod/ /de nas sngags pa mdun 'dug ste/ /dgongs pa'i don gyis brtag tsho6)par bya/ /phung po khams la sogs blta (7)ba/ /brda las ji ltar lus yin bzhin/ /ma byin len pa byang chub sems/ /kun rdzob bstan rdon pa rdzun 3)smra ba/ /phung po srog chags gyur pa ste/ /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bud med yin/ /mi sbyin tshig dang rkang pa ste/ /de bzhin rten pa nyid kyang ni/ /dus gsum sbyor ba gcig pu ru/ /sngags pa yis ni de bya'o/ / bshang ba 7zhes ni yul la bshad/ /gci tsho11ba zhes ni dbang po yin/ /de dag za bar nyi bshad pa ni/ /ma skyes gcig pur mthong ba'o/ /khrag gi pags yi par 81—714

yang dag bshad/ /sa bon lus zhes nyabya ba yin/ /rkang ni sems kyi kun rtog ri na pa / /za ba dngos med gyur pa'o/ /smon lam dbang gis 'di rnams ni/ /bi mu ra shu pa /kyes 'di/ /lha rnams sbyor ba'i chos nyid du/ /bdud rtsi zhes ni brjod pa yin/ /dgongs pa yis ni bshad pa la/ /byis pa rnams ni yi ger rtog /rdo rje theg la gnas khyod kyang / /chos nyid de yang mi shes so/ /rtog pa kun las rnam 'das pas/ /chos kyi dbyings te mkha' dang mtshungs/ /de 'dra 'jig rten rgyang pan 94)pa/ /mthon po'i gsang gis rtog par byed/ /yi ge gang gis mi gang zhig /'gro la gsal bar rtog byed pa/ /'gro don gcig pa'i sbyor ba las(de)/ /de nyid kyi (6 ni de nyid mthong / /gang zhig rnam smin smin pa yi(7ste / /sems ni dngos grub la gzhol 8ba/ /rdzogs longs spyod pa'i skur sbyor las / /dngos po med pa nyid du byung / /bdag nyid bsam gyis mi khyab gzugasal/ /kun rdzob don gyi gnyen por 99'byung / /sprul pa'i lus las sngags 7pas ni/ /sgyu ma bzhin du ston par byed/ /gsang ba'i dngos po 11de nyid 'di//'jam dpal ye shes dam pa'o/ /rdo rje gsum gnas sbyor ba yis/ /bsgom pa'i bdag nyid can gyis bsgom/ /nam mkhar rtogs 12pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /phung po dgon pa chen por 'dod/ /gnas med gnas pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /de bzhin nyid gnas sa phyogs yin/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i dpag bsam nyi shing //dngos grub sna tshogs me tog ldan/ /sprul pa'i 'bras bu shin tu mdzes/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub ris/ /dngos med dben pa nyams dga' ba/ /rdo rje zhes bya des bobasgrub bya/ /phung sogs yan lag thams cad de/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba dngos grub gyur/ /sngags 'don par ni gang gyur pa/ /bsdus pa 81—715

sngags tsho1)ni gcig pu pa/ /lus sogs rdo rje gsum la ni/ /rdo rje 'jam pa bsgom par bya/ /lus la sogs pa rdo rje gsum/ /de nyid gsum nas spro bar bya / /rdo rje gsum dang lus 3)sbyor las/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje 'dra bar 'gyur/ /nam mkha' 9rimatha' yas yang dag rtog /sems sbyor ba ni dpag tshad yin/ /lnga bcu gnyis gyur gang yin pa/ /brgya brgya pa (nanas mngon phyogs la/ /ci rigs gcig pa'i yang dag rtogs/ /sna tshogs rdo rje 'bar gcig (pestsol/ /dpag tshad brgya yi khyon tsam du/ /'bar ba'i rdo rje snang ba yis/ /sa la sogs pa brgyan 6)pa ni/ /de ni snang ba zhes bshad do/ /tshangs pa dbang po la sogs lha / /dad pas de la phyag kyang byed/ /'di ni mi snang byed pa ste/ /ting 'dzin 'jam pa'i rdo rje nyid/ /rnam par smin pa ldog gyur cing / /ji skad gsungs pa 'grub par 'gyur/ /phung po la sogs grangs mnyam par/ /mi bskyod la sogs rab tu brtag97) /bshang gci sbyangs (zhes las de (9)gyur pa/ /gang zhig dam tshig ces bya'o/ /dam tshig ces (bobya de dag mchog /mi phyed rdo rje gsum 'byung bas / /dkon mchog gsum ni mnyam byas te(lha/ /bdag med pa yang bsgom par bya/ /dkon mchog gsum ni lcags gsum yin/ /bdag med ces bya ba 8yin te/ /gang 12'di rnam rtog gcig nyid du/ /bcug pa ril bu tsheyin par 'dod / /sangs rgyas rnams kyis mi byed 8pa'i/ /sgom 8pa sems kyi dam pa'o//de ltar de nyid shes bsgoms na1 / /skad cig gis rnam nya rdo rjer 'gyur3)/ /'khor lo 'od 'phro mtshungs par gyur3 / /rang gi 21sngags kyis rnam bsgoms tsunanas / /sangs rgyas kun gyi 3lhaganas bsgoms na/ /sangs rgyas 'dra bar 'gyur bar bshad/ /sum cu 2 rtsa drug gnas sbyor ba'i/ /ri rab kyi ni rdul phran 81—716

rnams / /de snyed de yi rjes 'brang rnams/ /dam tshig rdo rje zhes bya ba'o51/ /gnas ni lha yi sbyor ba ste/ /sna ni ri rab ces bya'o/ /bdag nyid chen po sum cu (mibadun/ /nam mkhar spro ba bsam mi khyab/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje bdag po ste/ /'di dag ①'khor du gyur pa yin/ /'jig rten pa yi rang ngo bo(4)/ /phyi yi ri rab brtag pa yin/ /dam tshig rdo rje zhes bya ba'i/ /'khor lo'i ting nge 'dzin ces bya/ /'khor lo dngos grub rnyed sla ba/ /skad cig sbyor bas bsgrub (5)pa'o/ /rdo rje chen 6)po rang sngags kyis/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su rab bsgoms na / /rdo rje kun gyi gnas mchog ste/ /thugs kyi rdo rje 'dra bar 'gyur/ /ri rab sum cu (nyertsa drug gi6)/ /rdul phran ji snyed yod pa yi/ /de snyed bud med de yi 1 tshoni/ /gsum hunya'agyur gnas su 'gyur ba yin/ /khams gsum gyi ni rdo rje che/ /drug nya2po yis ni phyag byas 'gyur/ /rdo rje dam tshig ces bya ba'i/ /ting 'dzin 'di ni yang dag bshad/ /pad+ma chen po 'dab 12brgyad pa/ /rang sngags rdo rje las byung ba / /chos rnams kun gyi gnas bsgoms na/ /rdo rje chos dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /sum cu 8rtsa drug gnas sbyor ba'i/ /ri rab rdul phran grangs snyed kyi/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje mchog gi ni/ /dkyil 'khor la bdag 1gebadag nyid 'jog /gos med mnyam nyid ye shes kyi/ /rdo rje pad+mo grub 17bcas sbyin/ /so sor rtog pa zhes bya ba'i/ /ting nge 'dzin ni yang dag bshad/ /shin tu grangs med bskal par ni/ /grangs kyi ming gis gnas par ni/ /gnas shing sgom 1 par byed pa yin / /de yi ye shes lngar ldan pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa ni/ /'jig rten phan phyir gsungs pa rnams/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas mtha' yas pa'i / /yon tan gsum ni yongs su bsten/ /'od zer lnga yi mdog 'dra ba'i/ /81—717

rang sngags las byung ral gri ni/ /blo ldan lag pa (7de bzhag na/ /rdo rje rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /rang gi sngags kyi khong ②chud 'di/ /ho ho hūṃ de khams gsum pa/ /pad+ma spangs pa'i tshangs pa cher/ /rnal 'byor pa de 'gyur ba yin/ /khams gsum kun gyis (8)cher mchod cing / /tshangs pa ④lha min phyag byas pa/ /stong gsum mi yi mchog gcig pu/ /dpag 9dechen po yi tshangs par 'gyur/ /thugs kyi rdo rje mchog bsgoms pas/ /dngos grub ji ltar 'dod pa dag /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje las/ /de (6༄ni de ma thag tu 'thob/ /rang gi rdo rje ting 'dzin 'di/ /dngos med gcig pu yang dag byung / /byang grol la yang de mi gnas / /ral gri lakha dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /oṃ ni ril bu 8)tsa na ku'i/ /'bru tshad (9ritsam du bsams nas ni/ /dbus su rang gi lha yi gzugs/ /bsams te khar bcug rnam bobasgoms na/ /byang chub ye shes 'od po cher7/ /blo ldan de ma thag de lho 'gyur/ / 'dzam bu'i 1 chu bo'i gser mdog gam/ /nyi ma 'char ba'i tshamadog 'dra ba'i/ /tsa na ka yi 'bru tshod tsam/ /yi ge'i skodam pa āḥbasam mo/ /de yi dbus su lha yi gzugs/ /khar bcug nas ni rnam bsgoms na/ /byang chub ye shes 'od po che/ /de ni de ma thag tu 'gyur/ / 'dzam bu'i chu bo'i gser mdog dang / /nyi ma 'char ku'i mdog 'dra ba'i97/ /nam mkha'i dbus na gnas pa yi/ /tsa 1 na ka yi 'bru tshod rnya tsam/ /yi ge hūm̐ ni rnam bsams 16te/ /dbus su rang gi skulha bsams na sto/ /khar bcug nas ni rnam bsams na/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'od po che/ /dpal ldan de ma thag tu 'gyur / / 'dzam bu'i chu bo'i snyegaser mdog dang / /nyi ma 'char ku'i mdog 'dra ba'i/ /rnam par snang mdzad mkha' dbyings kyi/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su 81—718

rab bsgoms la/ /lag tu 'khor lo rnam 6)bsgoms na/ /'khor lo'i risarig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i sku mdog sbyor ba yang / /'di ni ye shes mchog sgrub pa'o/ /'khor lo chen po'i (kyerigs bsgoms te/ /ye shes rdo rje dag gis bya / / 'dzam bu'i byachu bo'i gser mdog gam/ /nyi ma 'char ku'i 'od 'dra ba'i / /nam ⑤mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /rdo rje mi phyed rab bsgoms te/ /lag tu rdo rje bsgoms na ni/ /rdo rje'i rig ⑥pa 'dzin par 'gyur / /rdo rje mchog gi bsgrub ⑦pa 'di/ /rdo rje sku yi sbyor ba las/ /rdo rje rigs kyi mchog bsgom pa')/ /ye shes rdo rje dag gis bya/ /nam mkha'i (9༄khams kyi dbus gnas par/ /rin chen la ni rin chen bsgomatshu/ /de nyid lag tu legs bzhag na/ /rin (lhachen rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /rin chen mchog gi bsgrub pho pa 'di/ /rin chen sku yi sbyor ba las/ /rin chen rigs kyi mchog bsgom (1nyepa/ /ye shes rdo rje dag gis bibya/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /tshe dpag med pa rab bsgoms (8la/ /lag tu pad+ma bsgoms na ni / /pad+ma'i rig tsog 'dzin par 'gyur/ /pad+ma mchog gi bsgrub zhu pa 'di/ /pad+ma'i skur ni sbyor ba las/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen bsgoms pa ni/ /ye shes rdo rje dag gis bya/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas parayin/ /don yod mchog ni rab bsgoms la/ /lag tu ral gri rab bsgoms na/ /ral gri'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /dam tshig mchog ni 'di bsgrub tshepa/ /sku yi dam tshig sbyor ba las/ /dam tshig rdo rje rigs bsgoms pa/ /ye shes rdo rje dag gis bya/ /bsgrub bya rdo rje'i so byedabye ba yis/ /mdung thung rdo rje lcags kyu 7sogs/ /sku gsung thugs kyi bsgrub na pa yis/ /bsam gtan nyid kyis bsgrub 2 par 'gyur/ /81—719

dam tshig chen po 'byung ba yi0tsho/ /dam tshig dngos grub ces (kyebya ba'i/ /mi phyed rdo rje gsum dbang phyug/ sna tshogs bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs/ /sdug bsngal dang ni kun 'byung nyid/ /'gog dang lam ni (sde)bzhi po ni/ /lam gyi bzhi mdor yang dag bshad/ /sgrub rinepa po ni gnas ming can/ /shing gcig drung du yang dag rtog /chos dang rdzogs longs spyod ming can/ /sna tshogs mtshan gcig yang dag dgod/ /mtshan ma rkyen gyi gzugs can no/ /'byin dang rngub 5 pa nyid dang ni/ /gnas pa yis ni nyer mdzes pa/ /yid rton (6)pa yi mnyam sbyor la/ /rab tu zhi ba'i zhi gnas su/ /dus gsum rtog pa gcig las 'das/ /rdo rje lcags kyu khyad par du/ /sgrub ④pa po ni rtag tu bsgrub(ge)/ /sbyor gsum sngags kyi skyes bu ni/ /sbyor gsum rdo rje can bsam ⑨pa sku gsung thugs kyi 0lcags kyu'o/ /sangs rgyas ye shes blo can gyi/ /mi gsal gsal bar yang dag ldan/ /de bzhin nyid kyi ngo bo las/ /'gro ba thams cad dgug par bya/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor mchog gnas pa/ /sangs rgyas dgug pa dam pa yin/ /gnas med gnas pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /de nyid sngags don rnal 'byor pas/ /'gro ba 'dod pa'i longs spyod kyang / /mi gsal sbyor bas sbyor bar byed/ /gang yang dam tshig phyogs rnams ni/ /mkha' dbyings dbye bas gnas pa rnams/ /de nyid rdo rje bkug nas ni/ /sngags rig pas ni spyad par bya / /nam mkha'i khams ni dgug pa 'di/ /dam tshig chen po rdo rje can/ /sngags kyi 11de nyid gcig sbyor las/ /lcags kyu de rnams 'grub yopar 'gyur/ /dam tshig rnams ni dgug pa'i mchog /rgyal gnas lcags kyu bsams nas ni/ /rnam par snang mdzad 'khor lo che/ /rdo rje pad+ma la sogs bya/ /me long lta bu'i 81—720

sngags pas ni/ /sangs rgyas sku ni rnam par bsgom/ /lag tu sku dang gsung thugs kyi/ /lcags kyu la sogs rab tu bsgom/ /de ni sbyor ba 'di nyid kyis/ /de nyid las ni lha rnams dgod/ /de ni de ma thag tu yang / /dngos grub kun ster las byed 'gyur/ /sku dang gsung thugs thams cad ni/ /mtshan nyid gcig par bsgom par bya/ /lce yi rdo rje sbyor ba yis/ /gsung gi rdo rje de tsho1)mnyam bsgom/ /brtul zhugs can gyis phyi nang gnyis/ /gsang ba'i rdo rje mchog mchod do/ /dngos med dam tshig sbyor ba yis(5)/ /ji lta (sderaji ltar rab bsgrub ④pa/ /dam tshig gsum gyi rnal 'byor pa'i/ /de ni yang dag yin par bshad / /gsang ba'i snying po bsdus pa yi/ /dngos grub kun gyi mchog tu 'dod / /bcom ldan dam tshig chen po yi/ /rnal 'byor pas ni de skad gsungs / /de nas phyag na rdo rje ni/ /go byed gsang ba yang dag gsungs/ /gang zhig shes na rnal 'byor pa'i(5ci/ /mnyam gzhag 〈pemachog ni thob 'gyur ba'i/ /gsang dbang de nyid dam pa yi/ /de ni de yis yang dag bshad/ /rnal 'byor chen po gcig bdag nyid/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam pa'i gnas/ /byas na dam tshig yang dag pa/ /sha chen la ni yang dag sbyar/ /dngos med pa yi sha chen gyi/ /dam tshig mchog la gnas nas ni/ /blo ldan bdag nyid sgom pa ni/ /rdo rje dngos grub longs spyod ster na/ /rdzogs longs spyod yul bshang ba yin/ /de nyid ye shes dbang po gci / /dam tshig 'di dag nyid kyis ni/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i gtso bor 'gyur/ /longs spyod rdzogs phung las byung ba/ /glang po'i shar ni de rab brtag /dam tshig gcig tu legs sbyor las/ /mngon shes lnga dag thob par 'gyur/ /dbang po gnyis ni rta sha ste/ /dngos med de nyid las 81—721

sbyor las/ /dam tshig gcig tu legs sbyor na/ /mi snang gnas kyi mchog tu 'gyur / /1)phung sogs yan lag gang gyur pa/ /dngos med de ni khyi sha yin/ /dam tshig gcig tu yang dag sbyor/ /dngos grub thams cad rab bsgrub ②pa'o/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas spyan rdo ba lang sha /khro bo'i rgyal po 'grub par 'gyur/ /dam tshig gcig tu yang dag sbyor/ /rdo rje dgug pa'i dam pa'o/ /'di ni 'jig rten par gyur las/ /dgongs pas cig (4nashos bzlog pa yin(pe/ /sha chen dang ni bshang gci dang / /glang (3po rta khyi ba lang dag /mi rtog gcig pa'i sgrub pa yis / /dam tshig gcig tu de 'grub 'gyur/ /bstan pas 'di ni sgrub pa ni/ /sngags kyi longs spyod rnal 'byor pa/ /rdo rje sbyor ba'i gsang ba yis/ /sgrub pa 'di dang ldan par 'gyur/ /de 7ni sangs rgyas byin rlob (kyecing / /rnam kun rdo rje can gsum dang / /snying gar (9)ye shes dam tshig dang / /dbu rgyan la ni rdo rje 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas thams cad tshim 'gyur ba'i/ /'di ni dam tshig sdom pa'o / /dngos grub thams cad ster ba'i mchog /dam tshig mchog 'dis ⑩rab tu bya/ /dam tshig kun gyi dam pa ste/ /rdo rje zas kyi ting 'dzin tonyunye/ /de nas 'gro la phan pa'i mgon/ /gtso bo rnam snang chen po la/ /gsang ba'i dgongs pa dam pa ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas slar yang zhus/ /gang zhig spyi bor brtags bepa ni/ /gcig pu nyid du gyur pa des/ /ri rab sum cu 3nyertsa drug tu/ /mu stegs rnams kyis 'tshal bomi 'gyur/ /rang gi bstan bcos brda duskoyis ni/ /phyi rol pa de rnam rtog la/ /ting 'dzin brtags pa 'di dag kyang / /'di la rang gi ngo bo med/ /tshangs sgo mdzod kyi rgyud las 7ni/ /ri rab gcig dang bcas par bshad/ /byis pa mchog ni rmongs byed par+sha 7/ /gsung 'di skye bo 81—722

ltung bar 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan bdag po 'dis/ /rdo rje can la slar gsungs pa/ /legs so rdo rje legs pa che/ /skyes bu dam pa khyod legs pa/ /rkyen dang nyan thos theg pa dang 1ni/ /'dir ni nga yis gsal bshad pa/ /sangs rgyas kyis bshad ye shes dag /theg pa chen po mi mthong ngo / /tshad yod pa dang (geyongs chad pa'i/ /rang gi lus la gang bshad de/ /ye shes de rnams dri med 'dod/ /khron pa'i rus sbal zhes bya'o/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam ye shes / /rdo rje theg pa bla med pa/ /mchog sbyin nga /kyeni khyed bzhin du/ /rgya chen de yis mi mthong ngo / /rdo rje theg pa rgya mtsho ste/ /de yis yang dag ma mthong bas / /rang gi lung ni tshad ma yis/ /gzhan yod pa ni min zhes smra/ /theg pa chen la gsang ba rnams/ /sung la bcal tshochenate de smra ba/ /de rnams sngon bzhin gsal min zhes/ /nga yi tshig las bltas te smra/ /de nyid rjes su bzung 95ba'i phyir / /rdzogs sangs rgyas pa 6bsgom pa rnams/ /gang gis shes na rtog med 'gyur / /gsang ba dgongs pas (7rigasungs pa yin/ /sngags kyi de nyid don byang chub/ /sna tshogs dngos grub 'bras bu sterisar/ /dgongs na ⑨ji lta ji lta bar / /de ni nga yis yang dag bshad/ /dam tshig rdo rje lce la ni / /rdo rje can gyis 37rgyu bsams te/ /rnal 'byor pas ni bdud rtsi lnga/ /zos na rdo rje gsum thob 'gyur/ /āḥ'i dang oṃ 1 nagyi gsang ba dag /'di ni rdo rje gsum mchog ste/ /'di lta bu yi sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i tshobo'od chen 'gyur/ /'di ni rdo rje'i bdud rtsi yisko/ /phreng 'gyur dam tshig rdo rjer 7bshad/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yang dag 'byung / /ting nge 'dzin ni bshad pa yin/ /rdo rje gsum gyi dam tshig mchog /sku gsung rdo rje can du 'gyur/ /de nyid sems can thams 81—723

cad kyi/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i rgya mtsho che/ /'jig rten khams ni thams cad dul/ /sangs rgyas sku dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje dam tshig dngos grub mchog /rdo rje bdag nyid de snang byed/ /gaṅgā'i 0)klung gi bye ma snyed/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni thams cad du/ /grub nas 'di ni der sbyor ba'i(5)/ /rig pa 'dzin par de 'gyur ro/ /sku yi rdo rje bsgom bdag nyid/ /grub mchog dam tshig la gnas pa//mi snang gyur pa kun gyi mchog /stong khams (5)dag ni snang bar byed/ /lha /sheyi bu mo mchog phrogs (5)nas/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor ma 55)legs sbyor/ /gaṅgā'i bye snyed ces bya ba'i57)/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ma lus kun/ /dpe de dang ni grangs gcig pa/ /sangs rgyas dus gsum rnam spangs pa/ /lag tu skyu 2ru ra bzhag bzhin/ /rdo rje mig gis de mthong 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni gang dag tu/ /sgra grag 99༄pa ni ji snyed pa/ / rna ba bol gnas ma nor bar/ /skad cig gis ni de kun thos/ /gaṅgā'i bye snyed zhing dag na17/ /sku la sogs pa gsum gyis lho mtshan/ /sems zhes bshad pa'i sgom tsho/2pa mchog /sems can rnams kyi (gede nyid rig /bskal pa gaṅgā'i bye snyed du/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje'i bla mchog gis 'gengs/ /rdo rje bsam mi khyab sngon 'gro/ /rang gi rna ba sems bcas pasal/ /gaṅgā'i bye ma'i 3 ming can gyi/ /gnas kyi kyisnyedangos grub thabashad pa yin/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi 3 stamangon shes nas ṭ+wāṃ/ /'di ni yang dag bka' stsal to/ /mngon shes drug ni don grub pa'i snye/ /de ni sangs rgyas 'dra bar 'gyur / /gaṅgā'i klung gi bye snyed kyi/ /'khor rnams kyis sa ni rab mdzes pas/ /sku sogs rdo rje gsum 'di ni/ /'jig rten khams rnams kun tu spyod/ /yid rton bde byugacig bsten 25pa ste/ /de nyid gsum mnyam gnyis med pa/ /81—724

bsten 0)te dam tshig gcig gyur pa/ /ye shes nye bar sgrub 2pa'o/ /yid rton mnyam pa'i sbyor ba las/ /sgrub pa yi ni dam tshig 'gyur/ /'bras bu mngon sum byas sbyor ba/ /sgrub pa chen po bzhi pa'o/ /rkyen dang nyan thos mdo sde pa/ /'di dang ldan pa rab tu bsngags/ /sems la dmigs dang 'dir sbyor ba/ /skad cig gis kyang de 'grub 'gyur/ /bsnyen pa'i dam tshig sbyor gcig dang / /nye bar bsgrub par (migang gyur dang / /sgrub pa'i dam tshig nyid dang ni/ /sgrub pa chen po bzhi pa yin/ /'di la yang dag 'jug 'gyur ba/ /ji lta ji ltar 'jig rten sogs/ /sa dang shing gi rin chen sogs/ /lha nyid du ni rab tu brtag /chos kyi dbye bas shes par bya/ /rdo rje ye shes sgrub pa po/ /bsten risapa'i dam tshig yang dag sbyor/ /byang chub mchog ni rnam par bsgom5nye/ /gzugs dang sgra dang de bzhin gri(6ci/ /ro dang reg bya chos rnams la/ /dngos grub mchog ni rnam dpyad pa/ /de ni nye bar sgrub par 'gyur/ /sngags pa 9)skugang yin bsgoms (2nyenas ni/ /bskul bar sgrub par byed pa (7)yin/ /rang sngags rdo rje can gyi gzugs/ /de ni sgrub pa chen por 'dod/ /bsnyen pa rdo rje bdud rtsi gang bo/ /sngags pas kun du brtag par bya/ /dngos grub 'dod pas gnas pa ni/ /dbu rgyan 37la ni mchog gang bsam/ /'di ni sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /de nyid gsum gsang yang dag 'byung / /sngags kyi de nyid don gnyer ba'i/ /sgrub pa pos ni dben pa bsten/ /sna tshogs lung gi (12yang dag rtog /sngags ni dgon pa chen por 'dod/ /de yi dpag bsam shing longs spyod/ /sa phyogs zhes ni yongs su bsgrags/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sbyor ba ni/ /rnam par 1snyedaben pa chen por bshad/ /ri 'or 14rdzogs pa'i 81—725

thang chen po dang rgyal mtshan de mo yis/ /'di yi zhus chen legs par bgyis pa'o/ /stag 81wa 750

spag /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba mngon par brjod pa rgyud thams cad kyi snying po gsang ba rnam par phye ba zhes bya ba/tsho)༄zag /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badz+ra mā nasal a bhi dhā rigen ma hā yo ga tan+t+ra sarba tan+t+ra hre du rid ya ra ha 57su bi rin bha da kai shinoyi ti/ bod skad du/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng tshon ba mngon par brjod pa rgyud thams cad kyi snying po gsang ba rnam par phye ba zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa 99)dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi snying po rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga rnams la tshad med pa'i phyag rgya chen pos mngon par rtogs nyu tshopas bzhugs te/ dpag tu med pa'i rdo rje'i rigs dang 'brel ba'i byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma dang thabs cig 11tu thams cad kyi 81—752

phyag rgya chen po mngon par rtogs pa 6)mngon du bya ba la bzhugs pa/ gnyis su med pa'i bde ba chen po nyams su myong bas dgyes pas mchog tu pad+ma (5)dgyes pa/chos thams cad kyang ji lta ba bzhin nyams su myong ba mthong bas rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi de kho na nyid la mngon du phyogs pa/ rdo rje 'chang ①chen po'i dam tshig bla na med pa'i dbang du gyur pa la rab tu mkhas pa 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dam tshig rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhe sdang rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chags ④pa rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje las dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje ye shes dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chu rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po me rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rlung rdo rje dang / de lta bu rnams gtso bor gyur pa dam tshig chen po'i rigs dang 'brel ba ⑤byang chub sems dpa' stong phrag bdun cu 96)rtsa gnyis dang / gzhan yang rigs chen po dang 'brel pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong la ni (7)'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha' la 'gro ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha' rnam par rgyas pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i zla ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i gtsug tor dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mtshams rnams kyis nges par grol ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje sems ca 81—753

dpa' dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje snying po dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje blo gros dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje rgyal po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje dam tshig dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje chos dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje longs spyod dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje spyi bo dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 1)rab kyi rtsal gyis rnam par gnon pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam rtog med pa'i spyi gtsug dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam rtog med pa'i sgra dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam rtog med pa'i chos dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam rtog med pa'i dam tshig dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dga' ba'i rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rab tu dga' ba'i rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sna tshogs dga' ba'i rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lhan cig skyes pa'i rdo rje dang / gzhan yang dpag tu med pa'i rdo rje'i theg pas lhag par grol ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams dang thabs cig (btu bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das de yang chos kyi 'khor lo ni shin tu bskor(2)/ sangs rgyas kyi stimadzad pa shin tu yongs su mthar phyin/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs ni shin tu yongs su rdzogs pa de 'khor la zhal rab tu 'dzum par bcas pas bzhugs so/ /de nas 81—754

bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i 'khor rgya chen po rnams la gzigs nas/ de dag 6)snod du rung bar bya ba'i phyir rdo rje phreng ba mngon par byang chub pa'i rdo rje theg pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad las 'od zer gyi dra ba chen po bkye ste (kyebazhugs so/ /'od zer gyi dra ba chen po des kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de rnams la reg pas tsho )mchog tu dga' ba thob pa ni gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba dang ldan pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po ji lta ba bzhin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag nyid dga' ba dang bde ba dang mchog tu mgu ba skyes nas brgyal ri4)bar gyur to/ /de nas yang de'i dus su bcom ldan 'das kyi 9semadzod spur 'od zer gyi dra ba chen po bsdus par gyur to(6)/ /bsdus pa de yang rdo rje'i lam nas lcags kyu'i rnam pa can gyi 'od zer chen po nye bar phyung 57)bar gyur pa des brgyal (87ba de dag la reg nas rdo rje phreng ba lta bu nyid rdo rje'i lam nas gtsug tor gyi 'khor lo la zhugs nas gnas so/ /slar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag bde ba chen po rjes su myong bar gyur te59)/ rdo rje'i yi ge hūṃ brjod pa de nyid kyis bde ba chen po de nyid nyams su myong ba nyid kyi thugs ku'i tsheste ba'i rtsa sbubs nas 'od zer chen po phyung ste rang rang 37gi stan la 'khod par gyur to/ /de nas de rnams chu'i gting nas 'thon mi pa lta bur sems nyusnyedaga' ba skyes te༄/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ngo mtshar chen po'i cho 'phrul mthong nas shin tu mig gdangs te/bcom ldan 'das la dbyangs gcig gis yang dag par bstod 8do/ /bcom ldan ro gcig 7gyur pa yi/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' bas rgyas/ /bcom ldan 81—755

mchog tu ngal bso 6)kye/ /ngag gi lam gyi spyod yul 'das/ /bcom ldan nyid kyi ri dgyes nyams ltar( ska/ /'gro ba gsum po yang dag bde/ /e ma'o lhan cig skyes bdud rtsi/ /ro bsten thugs rje chen po skyel/ /bcom ldan (gesems can thams cad kyi/ /sems can don kun gsal bar mdzad/ /de nyid gsum gyi ro gcig pa/ /phyag rgya chen po rab dbye (6skab/ /bcom ldan rnal 'byor che la dgyes / /'ching ba thams cad gcod mdzad kyi/ /bcom ldan dgyes pa cher mdzad cing / /'gro ba skal bzang nges par mdzad/ /e ma'o rdo rje theg pa bde / /rab tu dga' zhing mgu ba stsol/ /e ma'o sngags (peni rab rgyas pa/ /rang byung 98)go 'phang sgrub pa po/ /e ma'o shin tu zab mo'i chos/ /dmigs pa med par 99)ston par mdzad/ /e ma'o rdo rje 'chang (7chen gtso/ /gsang ba'i bdag 31po shin tu gsang / /e ma'o mchog tu byang chub pa/ /e ma'o spros pa rnam nyugespangs shing / /bden pa'i don ni gsal mdzad pa/ /theg pa'i sgron mas nyanasnang bar mdzad/ /mgon po bdag cag khyed 97drin gyis/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang thob/ /mgon po bdag cag lam log zhugs/ /khyed kyis yang dag lam la bkodas/ /mgon po tshabadag cag mun par 'thoms(1 / /ye shes snang ba thob par mdzad/ /dam tshig rdo rje nyi ma kyenyusnye/ /phyag rgya chen po'i don ston mdzad / /bcom ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod517/ /thugs rje'i phyag rgya che bdag nyid/ /phyag 'tshal gnyis med dga' ba'i mkha'/ /dga' ba'i zla ba khyed la 'dud/ /ces bya ba la sogs pa'i tshigs su bcad pas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa mdzad nas slar yang 'dus par gyur te/ rdo rje'i phreng ba mngon par brjod pa zhes bya ba shin tu phra ba'i sa ji lta ba'i shu )ngo bo 'dri bar 81—756

'dod nas yid la byed pa gcig pa dang / sems rtse gcig gis dga' bar byed pa'i gsung nyan par 'dod nas ba shi spu ldang ba dang dbugs g.yo ba dang bcas pas yang dang yang du bcom ldan 'das la phyag byed cing rang gi stan la 'khod nas sems re dogs dang bcas pas gnas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de rnams kyi de lta bu'i sems kyi rtog pa thugs kyis mkhyen nas slar yang rdo rje'i rinaphreng ba mngon par byang chub pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas gsang ba'i rdo rje las rang gi rig ma phyung tsho ci ste/ sgeg pa khu)la sogs pa'i nyams dang ldan pa bdag nyid kyis 'dod chags dang bral ba'i gzugs spangs nas sgeg pa la sogs pa'i nyams dang ldan pa'i gzugs blangs nas rang rang gi rig ma la 'khyud de(5)/ phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor la rjes su zhugs nas/slar yang de dag de lta bu'i gzugs nyid du mthong ste ngo mtshar 6)skyes nas mig gdangs te ri mo'i bkod ri7)pa lta bur mthong ba nyid kyis ci yang mi smra bar gyur pas de la 'khor rnams yang dag par 'khod par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rang gi rig ma yang dag par bskul te/ phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor dor nas nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje las rdo rje (8btsun mo rdo rje rigs kyi snying po 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ āḥrgyu/ de nas de skad du gsungs ma thag tu 9bcom ldan 'das kyi ba spu'i bu bog las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / rig ma dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / khro bo'i rgyal po rnams phyung bar gyur to/ /phyung nas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi shar la sogs pa'i phyogs su rang rang gi stan la gnas par gyur te(17/ kha cig ni rnam par snang mdzad kyi gzugs kyis so/ /kha cig ni rin chen 'byung ldan gyi gzugs kyis so/ /kha cig ni 'od dpag tu 81—757

med pa'i gzugs kyis so/ /ji srid gnod mdzes rgyal po dang / /gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba'i0)/ /rgyal po'i bar gyi (5)gzugs kyis so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das cung zad cig ci yang mi gsung bar bzhugs tshomiso/ /gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyis 4)dbyangs gcig gis ched (snyedu brjod nas smras pa ni/ e ma'o rdo rje rigs chen po/ /rdo rje phreng ba'i don ston mdzad / /e ma'o rdo rje theg gsal ba/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi don ston mdzad/ /ces lan gsum brjod nas de dag gis rdo rje 'chang chen po la phyag 'tshal nas 'dug par gyur to/ /de nas de'i tshe skad cig thang cig (7yud tsam de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i 'khor rgya chen po 'dus pa de dag mthong nas phyag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to//bcom ldan ye shes rdor dbang phyug /gsang ba'i pad+ma'i nang bzhugs pa/ /dam tshig chen po'i rnal 'byor dbang / /thugs rjes bdag gi (3)tshig gson cig /bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje theg pa mngon 'dod pal/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /'di dag lus kyis (kyephyag 'tshal 'khod/ /snyigs ma lnga yi dus na ni/ /ma 'ongs pa yi ⑨sems can rnams / /brtson 'grus chung zhing bsod nams chung / /lta ba ngan pa mang po dang ske/ /tshe thung ba yi sems can rnams/ /go 'phang mchog ni thob phyir 7zhu/ /rgyal ba'i sras ni de dag dang / /ma 'ongs pa yi pho7sems can rnams/ /'khor ba las ni pha rol du/ /gang gis myur du thar bar 'gyur/ /gtso bo rdo rje 'chang chen la/ /'di ltar bdag ni gsol ba 'debs/ /'gro ba'i gtso bo khyod drin gyis/ /de nyid mchog ni bdag gis 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi tso81—758

gsang ba yi/ /rgyud rnams kun gyi don bsdus pa/ /bla na med pa'i rim pa gnyis / /rdo rje phreng ba mngon rtogs pa/ /cung zad 'dri bar 'tshal lags kyis(1)rka/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor nirdzus/ /khyod kyis bdag la bstan du gsol / /dpal ldan 'dus par brda 90tsam gang / /rnal 'byor bla na med rgyud du / /thub pa chen pos chos phung po/ /brgyad khri dang ni bzhi stong ngo / /de skad smras nas mdun 'dug ste/ /lus kyis rdo ciphyag ni byas nas kyang / /ye shes chen po bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'gro ba'i bla/ /rdo rje gsum ni ro gcig don/ /de nyid gsum gyi go 'phang ston(5ci/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi sbas pa'i don/ /bdag la bstan par mdzad du gsol/ /rdo rje phreng ba'i (6)ming ni ci / /'dus pa ci zhig stong ba (7)ci/ /thig le'i dbye ba dang ni sgra/ /gsang ba dang ni dam tshig dang / /sdom pa dang ni sgra tsam dang / /rlung gi de nyid bde chen ci/ /rdo rje pad+mo mnyam sbyor dang / /sngags kyi de nyid rnal 'byor pa/ /rlung rnams dang ni 'khor lo dang / /grangs ni ci tsam gang du gnas/ /rnal 'byor lus la rtsa gang lags/ /rnam pa sna tshogs sogs skad cig /dga' ba bzhi dang rdzas dang ni/ /sngags dang rlung dang thig le dang 78)/ /yi ge gsum gang de nyid gsum/ /de bzhin sna yi rtse mo gsum/ /lus kyi stong nyid ye shes dang ske/ /lha rnams kyang ni ji ltar gnas/ /de rnams kyi ni ming ni ci/ /'char ba dang ni nub pa ci/ /mgon po dga' rnams ji ltar ni/ /yang dag skye ba gsal bar (9)gsungs/ /sngar bshad rtsa rnams rtag tu ni/ /rdo rje'i lus la ji ltar rgyu/ /mtshams kyi rtsa gsum de dag ni/ /gtso bo ru ni ji ltar gsungs/ /rlung rnams ji ltar ldang ba dang / /gtso bo de rnams ji ltar thim/ /de ni 81—759

mkha' 'gro mar sdud pa/ /gtso bo ji ltar yang dag 'thobazhi)/ /rnam rtog rlung ni (2)rab bcad nas/ /rnam rtog med par ji ltar 'char( —3/ /rtsa rnams ji ltar nub pa dang / /sbyor ba drug gis ji ltar rtsom/ /dus kyi mtshan nyid ji lta bu/ /gsang ba'i yang ni 'bras bu ci/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rdo rje dang / /rigs kyi dbye ba ji lta bu/ /phyag rgya'i dbye ba ji tsam zhig /phung po la sogs skye mched dang ske/ /phyag rgya chen po'i ming ni ci/ /ro rnams kyi ni dbye ba dang / /bdag gi sgra ni gang la gnas/ /stong nyid dbye ba bsdus pa dang / /stong pa nyid ni gang du skye/ /nyin mo dang ni mtshan mo gang / / ā li kā li brda (gedang ni/ /mtshams kyi 'char ba ji lta bu/ /rgyud gsungs sngon ni bsnyen (gepa sogs/ /cho ga nyi shu'i las dang ni/ /rgyu mtshan ci zhig 'bras bu'ang ci/ /mchod pa'i cho ga ji ltar gsungs/ /de bzhin lha mo'i rang bzhin dang / /lha mo'i ming ni ji ltar gsungs / /rgyud du thog mar gsungs pa yi(6)/ /'di skad bdag sogs ji lta ④bu / /'di skad ces sogs dang po'i ngag /don rgyas par (0ni ji ltar 'gyur/ /nang gi bdag nyid sbyin sreg beci/ /bdud rtsi lnga ni bza' ba dang / /rnal 'byor ma tshogs 'dus pa dang / /de bzhin gsang ba'i brda bodang ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yi/ /dkyil 'khor rnams ni ji ltar gsungs/ /sangs rgyas dam chos dge 'dun gyi/ /ming rnams bshad pa ji lta bu/ /bla ma ston pa slob dpon dang / /rdo rje 'chang ni bshad pa ci/ /slob ma'i yon tan gang ldan na / /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi snod du 'gyur/ /de yi spyod 37pa'i dbye ba du(nye/ /de yi 'bras bu ji lta bu/ /zhi ba rgyas pa dbang dang ni/ /de bzhin bsad phonyedang bskrad pa dang / /rengs thupar byed pa nyid dang ni/ / ji ltar bsgrub par sbyor 81wa 760

ba dang / /1)bsgrub 'a)bya la ni mngon spyod dang / /sngags kyi tshig ni ci zhig dang ske/ /mgon po khro bo'i bzlas pa ci/ /dngos grub brgyad ni thob pa dang / /mngon shes lnga ni ji ltar thob/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyis (bde nyid mthong / /skad cig gcig la mngon byang chub/ /lus brtan (sku)pa dang rgas pa med/ /bcud kyis len gyi tsosbyor ba dang / /gser 'gyur sogs kyi sbyor ba dang / /rdo rje'i phyag rgya dngos grub che/ /'gro ba'i bla ma ji ltar 'thob/ /lus kyi rang bzhin gzhal yas khang / /de ni rang bzhin ji lta bu/ /'dis ni gnas sogs ji ltar gnas/ /thim dang longs spyod bdag po dang / /rlung ni gang gi mtshan nyid ci/ /de dag 'jig (3par ji ltar 'gyur/ /de ltar dri tshig rdzogs pa dang //lag na rdo rje thal sbyar te/ /'gro ba'i bla ma'i mdun 'dug nas/ /lus kyis tsho7phyag byas de nas ni/ /gtso bos rdo rje sems dpa' la/ /legs so bya ba byin (nasanas ni/ /tshangs dbyangs zab mo snyan pa yis/ /'gro ba'i mgon pos gsungs pa yin/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba mngon par rtogs pa las gsol ba gdab pa dang dri ba dang / slob ma'i las nyid la sogs pa rgyud kyi gleng gzhi'i 7le'u zhes bya ba ste dang po'o// //de nas bcom ldan rdo rjes gsungs/ /de nyid gsung gis 'gro mgon 7gyis / /lag na rdo rje la bos te/ /yang dag dris pa nges bshad pa/ /snying po'i don ni don bsdus pa/ /dbye bar humadaka' ba'i dngos po kun/ /khyod kyis dri bar byas 8pa rnams/ /rdo rje dbang phyug gsang chen bdag /bya ba spyod pa'i rgyud rnams dang / /rnal 'byor rgyud ni gang du yang / /mchog tu gsang ba ma 81—761

gsungs pa/ /rdo rje'i dbang phyug de nyid mchog /dris pa'i lan rnams gsal por ni/ /nges par nga yis rab bshad bya/ /skad cig gis ni spyan phye la/ /mchog tu rmad nya)byung ston mdzad la/ /thugs rjes khyab pas (kyede skad gsungs/ /de phyir khyod ni legs par nyon/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das thugs rjes thugs brlan cing the tshom thams cad gcod pa la phyag na rdo rjes gsol ba btab ste mchog tu gsang ba'i tshig gis (babashad pa gsungs pa ni/ dbang bskur ba ni gtso bo ste/ /dngos grub thams cad rtag tu gnas/ /nga ④yis ji bzhin don bshad kyis(zhes/ /de phyir thog mar yang dag nyon/ /thog mar slob ma gang gi tshe/ /blo ldan yang dag dbang bskur na/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor la/ / de yi 765tshe na snod du 'gyur/ /yang dag dbang bskur (7)gyis dben na/ /sgrub pos rgyud kyi don shes kyang / /slob dpon slob mar mtshungs (8)par ni/ /mi bzad yinadamyal ba chen por 'gro/ /de phyir yang dag bla ma ni/ /rab tu gus pas bsnyen bkur bya/ /dbang bskur thob cing de nyid shes/ /blo ldan snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /zab cing rgya che dri ma med/ /gnod dang 'tshe ba rnam par spangs/ / skal bzang 7lus ni rdzogs pa dang / /mtshan dang dpe byad rnam par brgyan37/ /chags pa che la gcig tu dga'/ /yul la phrag 32dog rnam par spangs/ /bag yod rtag tu dga' ba dang / /rnal 'byor ma yi mngal nas skyes/ /rdo rje theg pa (1lhagacig tu mos/ /theg pa dman chal rgyab kyis phyogs/ /de la sogs pa'i yon tan ldan/ /bla ma slob mas bsnyen bkur bya/ /yang dag bla ma rnyed nas ni / /slob ma'i rang bzhin dri ma rnams/ /dag dang rtogs dang smin byas nas/ /ji bzhin ye shes bzang dang ldan/ /ji ltar rin chen bdar 8ba dang / /81—762

gser ni bsregs dang bcad 0)pas brtag /de bzhin du ni slob ma yang / /lo ni bcu gnyis bar du kun)brtag /de phyir phan tshun de lta bus/ /dus kun du ni de ltar brtag① /gzhan du bgegs ni 'byung 'gyur te/ /dngos grub 'joms shing sdug bsngal sterab/ /dug ni sngags kyis 'joms pa bzhin/ /sngags kyi dag ⑤byas bcud len byed/ /de phyir 'bad pa thams cad kyis(6/ /sngags kyi slob ma rtogs byas nas/ /bla ma dbang bskur la sogs kyis/ /dngos grub phyir ni ji lta'i don/ /de phyir dbang bskur slob ma ni/ /ma dag pa yang dag par 'gyur(pe/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde chen la/ /de la lag na rdo rjes zhus/ /dbang bskur ji ltar rgyud du ni/ /gtso bo ru ni gsungs pa lags/ /rdo rje sems dpa' thams cad mkhyen/ /the tshom thams cad gcod mdzad pa/ /de kho na nyid mkhyen pas ni/ /lag na rdo rje la gsungs pa/ /don de ji lta ba bzhin du / /nga yis yang dag bshad kyis (nyenyon/ /dbang bskur ba yi dbye ba ni/ /dang po'i dbang ni gtso bo ste/ /gnyis pa gsang ba'i ming can no/ /gsum pa kun nas sbyor ba ste/ /bzhi pa'i don ni dam pa'o/ /gtso bo dbye ba bcu gcig ste / /bcu gnyis pa ni gsang ba'o/ /bcu gsum pa ni yang dag sbyor/ /bcu bzhi pa ni don dam ste/ /dbang bskur re re sa re'o/ /rnam pa gsum ni rgyu yi dbang ske/ /bzhi pa 'bras bur shes par bya/ /dga' ba la sogs rim pa yis/ /thams cad la ni nga yis khyab/ /mar ngo yi ni tshes gsum dang / /de bzhin tshes bcu tshes bcu bzhi/ /yon tan bzang ldan slob ma la/ /bla mas cho ga bzhin dbang bskur/ /lus phra lo ni bcu drug lon/ /gzugs dang skal ba (shedag gis brgyanari7/ /sngo bsangs mig ni yangs pa dang / /snying rje'i bsam ldan nyu781—763

yang dag mos/ / ngag snyan 0tshodabang bskur ((thob pa dang / /rnal 'byor rgyud la lhag par mos/ /yang na lo ni nyi shu lon/ /nyams dga' bde bar byed pa ste / /de las lhag par skal (gyimed 'gyur/ /de ni dngos grub ring du byed/ /lhag par 'jam ③pa'i bu mo la/ /chung ma'am yang na sring (gemo 'am yang na bu mo'am 'dad pa yis/ /bla ma la ni dbul bar bya/ /gser dang rin chen gos dang ni/ / mu tig (menaphreng ba sna tshogs pas/ /mchod nas bla ma'i mdun 'dug nas/ /slob ma yis ni 'di skad brjod/ /deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ /gtso bos bdag ni mchod pa bzhes/ /de lta'i rnam pas mnyes nas ni / /bdag nyid kun gyis bla ma mchod/ /bla ma'i ngo bo rdo rje 'chang / /de phyir yang dag bla ma mchod/ /de nas bcom ldan yum phyag rgya/ /yang dag mchod nas bsten par bya/ /bsten pa las ni gang byung ba/ /ltung ba skal bzang kha la ni/ /sbom po tha ltag dzoci sbyor ba yis/ /yang dag par ni longs spyad hustebya / /de las skyes pa'i ye shes ni/ /bde ba chen po rang rig pa/ /dbyung tshurngub pa ni ro gcig cing / /rab tu dga' bas mchod par bya/ /rtsu phaṭa sngags kyi 1rtanor bu'i sgor/ /bkod de rdo rje rab bskyod bya/ /dga' rnams ji lta ba bzhin du/ /skad cig de la skyes gyur pa/ /dga' ba'i sems kyis bde ba la/ /rdo rje btsun mo'i kha nas brjod/ /de yang slob ma'i lag tu ni/ /gtad nas gsal bar 'di skad brjod/ /ji ltar pad mchod bya ba ni/ / byos la e bai (snyemachog gi gdong / /gang phyir rdo rje dbyings dbang phyug /rang nyid 'di yi snying la zhugs/ /thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /rnal 'byor pa yis thob mi 'gyur/ /shin tu phra ba'i dngos de yang / /bde chen rnal 'byor pa yis 81—764

rtogs / /rab tu 'bad pas bsten 0)par bgyis(kye/ /lhan cig skyes dga'i mtshan nyid ni/ /dbang bskur gtso (8)bor gyur pas na/ /thams cad ji lta ba bzhin thob/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba mngon par rtogs pa las slob dpon dang slob ma brtag pa dang dbang bskur ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas de nyid gzhan yang nyon/ /rdo rje phreng baba'i don gsal ba/ /rgyud rnams kun du sbas pa ni/ /dri ba gzhan la brjod mi bya/ /rdo rje phreng (5 ba zhes bya'i ming / /de yang sa ni bcu gsum pa/ /dga' ba bzhi yi don gyi (snyaganas/ /thams cad stong pa dga' ba ste/ /ngag gi spyod yul rnams las 'das/ /gnyis pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ /skal bzang rnal 'byor kun gyi mtha'/ /rnal 'byor ma yi ngag gi yul/ /stong nyid ye shes rdo rje dang / /rdo rje phreng ba zhes bshad do/ /stong nyid rdo rje gsang pad+ma/ /rtsa ni rdo rje dbyings dbang phyug /ye shes mchog tu bde ba che/ /lhan cig skyes dga' rmad byung ba/ /rdo rje de yang rnam rtog rnams/ /'bigs par (7byed par yongs su grags/ /phreng ba de rnams kyi yang rgyun/ /byang chub sems kyi rdo rje rnams/ /mi phyed pas ni nardo rjer gsungs/ / rgyud rnams kun du sbas pa ni/ /gang yang rung bas brjod mi bya / /⑨de ni dbugs yisu yongs su grags/ /phreng ba rgyun ni mi 'chad 11par/ /dga' ba rab 'bab bdag nyid kyis/ /rnam rtog rlung kun 'bigs par byed/ /rlung la 'bigs par mi nus so/ /nyin dang mtshan mo rtag tu ni/ /brgya dang brgyad lhag gsal bar yang / /rnam rtog rang bzhin rlung rnams ni/ /'char 81—765

ba dang ni 'joms 6)pa dag /ji lta ba bzhin rab dbye yis/ /rlung rnams kyi ni ming nyon cig /btang bzung dang ni dung phyur dang / /myos pa dang ni blo ngan dang / /bsil byed dang ni g.ya' ba ②dang / /ngar snabs chadang ni sta re dang ske/ /gzegs pa chu srin dza sha dang / /rnam par gtsigs dang myos pa'i dus / /'dod myos chu ba chu srin dang / /sna tshogs skyed dang 'dud pa dang / /snyems tsho0dang rnga dang sgra sgrogs (5)dang / /rlung lha dang ni gnad 'bigs dang / /me dang dus 56)dang ci bgyi dang / /rdo rje mchog sbyin tsu ta dang / /sbra (mem dang ni zla ba'i 'od/ /kum po dza dang ral (2)pa can/ /yungs nag rab bkram dus 'gugs dang / /sdig pa dang ni g.yon can sten(pe/ /grims mo dang ni mgrin pa dang / /kun sel mchog ster smyo byed dang / /nga rgyal mtsho dang tshogs bdag dang ske/ /rtsangs 8pa dang ni sa yi blo/ /theg pa bzang dang mchog tu skyes/ /dri med phru mgu nyi ma dang / /gsal byed dang ni nyi ma gnon/ /stobs bzhin nga ro dang ni dus/ /sdom pa dang ni mchongs nas 'gro/ /sbrang ma khyi tsodang mtshan ma dang ske/ /thod dang skur bo drang po dang / /sa dang sa la 'gro ma dang / /bram ze dang ni sna 'gyur nyugeganas/ /ma mo'i rigs dang lce ④bskyod pa/ /mi smra dang ni rnga sgra'i sprin/ /dga' bar byed dang mig yangs dang / /dri med 'od srung 'ide tso dang / /sna tshogs mchu dang mig mnyam dang / /mdzes dang chos kyi dbyig pa dang ske/ /'gro kun snying stobs brtan ④pa dang / /za phod bong 0bu snyom las dang ske/ /kha gdangs sgra chen stobs kyis rtse/ /rtsa bran dbang byed g.yo sgyu nyunyecan/ /gtso bo che dang rtag rtso)tu dga'/ /glog so )phreng dang ni dga' byed dang / /dbugs dbyung lhar ga lce dang ni/ /bde mchog u dum bā sbyo nyer rmongs/ /pad+ma'i 81wa 766

dra ba pad+ma bskor/ /dgra sta rma bya rlung dang ni/ /rdo rje dbang phyug rlung gi ming //de ltar nga yis bstan pa yin/ /bcom ldan dris pa'i rlung rnams kyi/ /gnas rnams kyi ni dbye ba yis/ /de dag gang las ldang ba dang / /mched (1)pa rnams su bgyid pa lags/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rlung gi khams 5)kyi mtshan nyid ni/ /'khor lo drug la khyab pa'i rlung / /chos kyi 'khor lo rtag tu gnas / /srog ces bya bas 'gro la khyab/ /rnam rtog med pa mtshan ( tshobyed na/ /nam mkha' mchog las shar nas ni/ /rlung gi rang bzhin 'joms par byed/ /rlung de dgu yi rnam par rgyu/ /chos kyi 'khor lo'i cha na gnas/ /mtshan phyed dus nas brtsams nas ni/ /'khor lo drug la dgu bdag nyid/ /nyi ma phyed kyi mtha' ru ni/ /rlung rnams kyang ni ldang bar byed/ /nyi ma phyed nas 4ribartsams nas ni/ /'khor lo drug las dgu bdag nyid/ /mtshan phyed kyi ni dus kyi mthar(ge / /rlung rnams gsal bar rgyu ba na(nya/ /de nyid gnas kyi dbye ba yis/ /sna tshogs pa yi rtog par 'gro/ /rnam par rtog pa rnams tshome)phye nas/ /de dag ming rnams bshad par bya/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang / /rgyags dang nga rgyal mngon par zhen/ /phrag dun)dog khro dang ser sna dang / /g.yo dang sgyu la cha lugs ngan/ /blo rgod brkam chags gnyid 9ridang ni/ /the tshom dang ni ngar 'dzin dang / /dga' dang chags bral dregs 7pa dang / /'chab dang sred 11dang bag chags dang / /sgyu hurtedang rmongs dang 'dod chen dang / /rtsod dang rtse 'jo spyi brtol dang / /tshul 'chos dregs 12dang kun nas gdungs/ /rnam 'gyur ma zhi shes bzhin med/ /bems skopo log pa'i nga rgyal dang / /'gyod dang khrel ni med pa dang / /gus pa med dang ches pa med/ /blo dman ngo tsha 81wa 767

med dang 'ching / /ngo tsha shes dang ngo tsha dang / /mi ster ba dang mya ngan dang / /yid gnyis dang ni rlom 0)sems med/ /bsgrims dang the tshom ngal ba (midang / /dbang dang 'khrul ba'i snying stobs dang / /snyam sems pa dang brgyal ②ba dang / /thim pa dang ni mi srun dang / / gya gyu snyoms ciskadang myos pa dang / /rig byed min (5)dang bag yod dang / /gnas ngan len dang nyam chung nyid/ /yid mi bde dang lhag par rtog /skrag (6)dang rmugs dang gnyid dang ni/ /brkam (pechags rol pa khrung khrung dang / /'tshe ba le lo yon po nyid/ /bsam dang spyod dang zhum pa dang / /kun rdzob de nyid don yod dang / /ster dang dga' ba'i 'dod pa dang / /'jigs dang 'dar dang phra bdag nyid/ /gsal dang rnam gsal lhad 'jug dang / /'brel (kyedang rtag pa'i de nyid dang / /rus stisbal ngoms med gnod pa dang / /mi gsal ba dang yid du 'ong / /gnas med mang du smra ba dang / /bdag nyid skyes bu nyid dang ni/ /ya mtshan dga' dang skye bo ngan / /dman pa'i de nyid sdug bsngal gsum/ /'khor ba la ni chags pa dang //rtag tu brgya dang brgyad lhag pa/ /nyin dang mtshan mor rtag tu ni/ /rlung gi rang bzhin rgyu ba yin/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba ⑩mngon par rtogs pa las rdo rje phreng ba'i tshig dbye ba'i le'u ste 3lhagasum pa'o// //de nas rdo rje gsum nyi ma/ /gsang ba'i pad+ma kha 'byed pa/ /bde 3)ba chen po'i go 'phang (1lhabazhugs/ /'dus pa'i mchog don rab gsungs pa/ /'dus pa 'dres pa zhes ni bshad/ /'dres pa nga yis khyod la bshad/ /'khor lo bzhi dang tha mi dad/ /sngags ni lhan cig cho ga bzhin/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 81—768

sbyor ba/ /gang tshe gsang ba'i rtsa gnyis ni/ /yang dag sbyor ba reg 1gyur pa/ /de tshe nam mkha' rnam rgyas nyid/ /nam mkha' las ni skyes pa'i rlung / /de yis me ②ni rab tu 'bar/ /rtsa ni stong phrag bdun cu gnyis/ /rtsa rnams rab sad gzi brjid kyis/ /bde ba kun gyi go 'phang mchog /bde ba chen po'i 'khor lor khyab/ /bde ba chen po'i byang chub sems/ /rnam par zhu nas rtsar gnas par(lde)ske/ /rdor gsum rang bzhin gcig 'gyur phyir/ /khams rnams ro gcig gyur pa dang / /phung po rnams ni yongs zad dang / /ngal bso ba 4ril rlung rnams ni/ /dga' ba rnams ni yang dag skye/ /de nas byang chub sems kyang ni / /gnas kun nas ni zhu gyur nas/ /ngo bo gcig tu gyur pa dang / /rtsa ni gcig gi 'bras bu ni/ /ro gcig tu ni gyur pa la/ /'dres pa zhes ni de la gsungs / /phung po khams dang dbang po dang / /yul rnams su ni sbas pa rnams / /rnam rtog kun nas zad pa las/ /bde ba chen po yang dag skye95ri/ /ro gcig pa ni ngal bso ba/ /de ni 'dus pa 'dres pa ste/ /de kho na nyid mchog gsang ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang gsungs96/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba mngon /ra rtogs pa las 'dus pa'i tshig lhag par bshad pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// // 1nge/ 1re//nyemi ༷༷/ /// /nye) 1rdordo /)/ /// nas gzhan yang da na/ci / nga da na rab rgyas pa/ / nga pa nyid ni chos rnams kun/ /nang du khyab pa'ang chos nyid de ri/ /de nyid yang dag shes pa ni/ /de bzhin nyid dang rnam 8mi rtog /bdag dang gang zag chos rnams ni/ /bdag med rang bzhin gcig pa nyid/ /stong pa nyid dang rang 81—769

rig dang / /thams cad bdag nyid rtag bzhugs pa/ /rnal 'byor gcig pus rtogs pa ste/ / rtog ge pa yi 3)spyod yul min/ /chos rnams thams cad mdor bsdus pa/ /'khor lo drug tu rnam par brjod/ /de nas nang du'ang khyab pa ni// rtsa yi na 'khor lo legs rgyas pa/ /de ni nam mkha' khyab cing phra/ /khyab byed zhi ba'i mtshan nyid can/ /dmigs pa med cing rten pa med/ /gzugs med nyon mongs med pa dang / /rnam par mi rtog mchog tu zhi/ /rang bzhin med cing dri ma med/ /gnyis su med cing bya ba med/ /gzung (2)dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs/ /dus dang dpe bolas 'das pa ste/ /ngag gi lam gyi spyod yul bral / /chos nyid chos ni thams cad kyis/ /ji lta ba bzhin mngon par brjod/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam par bral/ /dge dang mi dge'i srid las grol/ /de ni kun nas bsgribs (5)pa med/ /nam mkha' lta bur mchog tu khyab/ /chos rnams ji lta ba bzhin skye(6)/ /de ni de bzhin nyid ces brjod/ /gang nas kyang ni ma 'ongs shing / /gang du yang ni 'gro ba med/ /rmongs dang 'khrul (7pa gcig pu las/ /de ni rab tu spro bar snang / /bde ba dang ni sdug bsngal spangs / /'dod chags zhe sdang sogs mi gos/ /'khrul dang rnam par 'khrul par 'brel/ /rtog pa dang bral dri ma med/ /bdag dang srog dang skye ba po/ /skyes bu de bzhin gang zag dang / /shed las skyes dang shed bu dang / /byed pa po dang tshor ba po/ /shes pa po dang mthong ba po/ /sgro 'dogs pa yi (8)rnam par spangs / /phung po skye mched khams la sogs/ /rnam shes dang ni gzung yiri/ba yis / /sgrib pa med cing mchog tu phra/ /nam mkha' mchog la yang dag gnas/ /de ltar ma lus stong nyid don/ /brjod tsodang brjod bya'i don dang bral/ /81—770

ming tsam gcig pu kho na yang / /rang byung mchog tu rmad 1)byung ba'o/ /brjod pa yi ni kun rdzob tu/ /de ni nga yis rin yang dag bshad/ /rang rig shin tu phra ba'i phyir/ /de kho na nyid mthong ba med/ /bdag nyid rang gi ngo bor /rig /pha rol gzhan gyi spyod yul min/ /de ni rang rig par bshad do/ /chos kun gnas ni zhi ba'o/ /rnam rtog gis 'khrul rtog ge (4rigang / /mi shes pa yi rmongs pa rnams/ /don dam par ni mi shes shing / /kun rdzob dgra yi mdzod 'dzin pa / /ye shes mchog ni mi shes shing / /rtog ge stong nyid smra bar byed/ /rnal 'byor bsam gtan rnal 'byor pas/ /de ni mchog tu phra bar spyod/ /stong nyid yang dag nam mkha' che/ /shes dang shes bya rnam par spangs/ /rtog pa'i rnam pa rnams dang bral/ /stong pa nyid kyi 'khor lor brjod/ /phung po lnga yi bdag nyid lus/ /'khor lo drug gi phug nang na/ /zla ba phyed pa'i cha lta bu/ /stong nyid rlung gi 'khor lor gnas/ /phyed min gang ba med pa dang / /ji ltar bag chags chu zla bzhin/ /rlung gi 'khor lo srog tu bshad/ /mtshan phyed skad cig ma la 'char/ /de ltar yang dag bsgom ri pa ni/ /'di ni stong nyid sgom byed pa'o/ /don dam gnyis med rnal 'byor gyis/ /yang na rgyu 'bras sbyor ba'i phyir/ /de ni rang bzhin 'grub par bsgom/ /don dam rang gi ngo bor ni//kun rdzob kyang ni de bzhin du/ /bsgoms pas 'khor ba 'joms par 'gyur/ /ji ltar til la til mar ni/ /gnas pa nyid la mthong mi 'gyur/ /de bzhin lus la stong pa nyid/ /gnas kyang bsgribs pas mthong ba med/ /bla ma'i zhal las 'di shes par/ /yang dag rig (6pas kun rdzob spangs/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba ri mngon par rtogs pa las stong pa nyid kyi don 81—771

bstan pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad kyis 1)nyon/ /thig tshonale'i dbye ba bla na med/ /'jig rten thig le nadabye bas dben/ /'khor bar yang dang yang du 'khor/ /mdzod spu'i dbus na gnas pa ni/ /thig le rlung du yang dag bshad/ /sngags kyi de nyid kyis ni 'byed/ /rnal 'byor mdud pa bkrol nas ni/ /rlung gi de nyid rig pa de/ /mchog tu 'byed (4)pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /sbyor ba de yang mi shes par / /rlung dang sngags kyi rnal 'byor gyis/ /brjod risnyedang brjod bya'i dpe las 'das/ /mig 56 gsal log par mthong rnams kyis/ /bsam gtan bsgom bya dang bral ba'i/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni thob pa dka'/ /rnal 'byor ma yi drin gyis ni/ /zhal nas zhal du brgyud nas (7riganas/ /bcom ldan bde ba chen po la/ /rdo rje sems dpas slar zhus pa/ /'gro ba'i mgon gyis bstan du gsol / /thig le'i dbye ba rig bcas pa/ /rnal 'byor mchog ni gang gis shes / /sbyor bas mdud pa 'byed par byed/ /khams gsum pa yi 'gro ba 'di/ /myur du dngos grub mchog tu 'gro/ /de skad zhus nas rdo rje can/ /rdo rje dbang phyug la gsungs pa/ /mchog tu gsang 8ba 'di nyid ni/ /gang du'ang gsal bar ma gsungs pa/ /thig le'i dbye ba de yang ni/ /nga yis bshad kyis (9ci de nyid nyon/ /snying gi pad sbubs bonam mkha' la/ /ye shes rdo rje rtag tu bzhugs / /steng dang 'og la brten nyu1nas ni/ /srog dang thur sel rlung chen gnas / /de yang dbye bar dka' 12ba yi/ /dbus su mdud pa gsum gyis dkris1 la/ /de yis mchog dang bcom byas pas/ /steng du 'gro ba thob mi byed/ /81—772
