des bcom slar yang ri1)rnam lnga rgyu/ /srog dang thur sel gyen rgyu dang / /khyab byed dang ni mnyam gnas nyidan/ /rtse mo lnga las rgyun du ni/ /rtsa lnga la ni yang dag brten/ /rgyags dang rnam par rgyas pa dang / /myos dang btung dang mdza' (5)bo ste/ /de dag rtsa 4ni lngar shes bya/ /rdo rje'i 'og tu gsal bar khyab//steng gi srog gi dbus na yang / /rdo rje'i lte ba'i mkha' dbyings 'gro/ /srog ces bya ba'i rlung chen po/ /lte ba mdud pa dang phrad pas/ /bcom nas kyang ni rnam lngar rgyu/ /rtse mo rnams la rtsa 5lngar ni/ /zla ba'i cha dang sna 6dang ni/ / bsnyen bkur lkog 7)shal mchin pa ste/ /rtsa ni lnga yi ming yin no/ /rtsa ni lnga las rgyu ba'i rlung 9)/ /klu dang rus 9sngal rtsangs pa dang / /lha 7sbyin dang ni gzhu las rgyal/ /de ltar rtsa de dang bcas pa/ /lus kyi thur du 'gro bas na/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i rtsa rnams ni/ /yang dang yang du bskul byas nas/ /bskul 11bas kyang ni rgyas pa na/ /gti mug chen pos dbang du byed/ /de steng chos kyi 'khor lo na32/ /gnas pa'i rtsa ni bskul sna byas nas/ /de rnams lhan cig rtsa de dag /zhe sdang gis ni dbang du byed/ /yang dag bskul nas de steng gi/ /longs spyod mchog tu ngo mtshar skye/ /rtsa de rnams dang lhan cig tu/ /chags pa chen pos dbang byas nas/ /bskul ba dang ni de steng gi/ /spyi bo'i 'khor lo'i bde chen du/ /rtsa de rnams dang lhan cig tu/ /byang chub sems kyis gang bar byed / /rnam rtog rnam par rgyu byed cing / /sna tshogs dbye ba thams cad las/ /steng ma rnams kyang thur du 'gro/ /srog gis sarab tu bcom nas ni/ /de dag thams cad rdo rje'i rtser/ /zhugs nas thur du kha bltas pa'o/ /de yang thur du mi 'gro ste/ /ma rig mdud pa'i 'khor lo ni/ /rnam par shes pa'i shing rta'i 81—773

rlung ske/ /de ni bag chags dang 'dres pas/ /mig dang rna ba de bzhin sna/ /lce ste rnam par shes pa bzhi/ /rtse mo bzhi nas phyung 1)nas ni/ /bag chags rnam shes dang 'dres nas/ /rnam shes dbang po lhan cig tu/ /don ni rab tu rgyas par byed/ /slar yang lam de nyid nas ni/ /ji lta ba yi rim pas 'jug /de yi dngos nyid de sbyor bas/ /rnam shes bsten (5)pa'i skad cig la/ /de yi bag (guchags bcas kyis (4ri'aphel/ /'khrul bcas (5)'khor ba'i 'khor lo las de ltar bag chags kyis bslad pa'i/ /rnam shes las kyi ngo bor 'gro/ /de nyid kyang ni srog sbyor bas/ /khams gsum par /ne ni 'khrul pa'o/ /byed po las kyi 'bras bur myong / /gzhan nyid du ni 'khor ba med/ /de phyir 'khor ba gzhom don du/ /thig le go 'phang rin gsal bar dbye/ /bsgom 98)pa la ni 'bad par bya9kyil/ /ma rig gzhan ni mi shes pa/ /dbus kyi mdud pa de yang ni/ /de phyed na ni dngos grub 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor grub pa ste/ /ye shes lnga ni thob nas ni/ /mngon shes lnga ni thob pa dang / /mchog tu gsang bob thob nas ni / /blo bzang 97ji lta ba bzhin gnas/ /phreng ba mi dgos bsgom mi dgos/ /bya ba mi dgos dgag nya༄mi dgos/ /sngags kyi de nyid gcig pu yis/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'thob12/ /las chos dam tshig phyag rgya yimi/ /dbye ba 'di ni ma tshigasungs so/ /'khor lo'i dbye bas ma yin zhing / /de bzhin dga' ba sogs kyis (7min/ /phyag rgya chen po'i go 'phang gsal/ /sngags kyi de nyid kyis ni 'thobanyurte/ /stong nyid ye shes rdo rje dang / /gnyis med bde ba de nyid dang / /gsang ba'i thig le'i dbye ba dang / /rnal 'byor grub pa'i bde chen po/ /ma rig sgo nga'i sbubs phoshe'abyed cing / /'jig nyunyetshogs lta ba'i ri bo 81—774

'joms / /phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub dang / /rab tu byed pa mchog tu bshad / /sngags kyi de nyid nges sbyor bas/ /rigs shing yan lag gsal ba gang ske/ /rnal 'byor ma yi bka' drin dang / /bla ma'i zhal las nges ༅rtogs 'gyur / /man ngag med pa'i bzlas pa ni/ /sngags kyi rgyal po blo rmongs byed/ /de yis (shedaka' ba gcig pu dang / /chu bsrubs 95mar ni mi 'gyur ltar/ /de bzhin man ngag dang bral sngags/ /skyes bus ji srid 'tsho yi ri4ribar/ /bzlas kyang de yi ba'abras bu yi/ /cha tsam thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /mi shes pa yi mi 'ga' zhig /rgya mtsho bzhi 46)yi pha mtha' yi/ /sa la shin tu 'gro 'dod pa/ /lam ni gang yin mi 'dri gang / /de ltar bdag nyid 'gro bar byed/ /de bzhin dka' (7ba cher byed pa'i/ /man ngag dang bral sgrub pa po/ /'bras bu med cing mkhas pa yang / /sgrub pa po ni khong khro skye/ /khong khro skyes pa'i skad cig la//'bras bu med cing ngu 'bod 'gro/ /de phyir 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /dad pas bla ma brgyud pa las/ /man ngag dag ni bslab par bya/ /gang phyir brgyud pa'i lung gis khyab/ /brgyud pa'i rim pas 8ciganas par byed/ /de ni rnal 'byor ma zhal dang / /bla ma'i zhal las 'bad pa yis/ /de nyid mchog ni bslab par bya/ /sngags kyi man ngag brgyud 9 pa'i lung / /de thos lag na rdo rjes kyang / /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba che/ /the tshom thams cad gcod pa lam//phyag byas nas ni zhus pa ni/ /khyed kyis bstan pa 'di nyamanyid mchog /bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po ni/ /sngags kyi dngos grub bla na med/ /gang bslabs 'iskad cig dngos grub 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan rdo rjes gsungs/ /sngags kyi de nyid rab gsal ba/ /de nyid mchog tu gsang ba ni/ /gang du'ang nga yis ma 81—775

bshad pa/ /skal ba med pa phyarabasam pa'i rgyus/ /rgyud rnams kun du sbas /kyebyas la / /de ni nga yis bshad kyis (2nyon/ /sngags kyi rgyal po bla na med/ /sngags kyi spyad pa spyod pa yis/ /gang gi myur du dngos grub 'gyur/ /thog mar uṣ+ṭha'i tha ma bri pa/ /dbyangs yig drug pas rnam par brgyan5)/ /sde tshan 96 tha ma'i mtha' dang ldan/ /dbyangs med pa yi cha dang bcas/ /uṣ+ṭha'i mtha' la dbyangs yig 'di/ /dgu pa dang ni yang dag ldan/ /mthar ni tsheg me'edrag mchog gi sgra/ /sngags kyi gtso bo btu bar bya/ /de ltar yi ge gnyis kyi ming / /sngags kyi brda 8)ni rmad byung ba/ /'dzin pa thams cad spangs pa'i phyir/ /sgra dang thig le'i ming du byas/ /rlung gnyis kyis ni phye 79)nas ni/ /ma rig mdud ⑩pa 'byed par byed/ /phyag rgya chen po mchog gi rgyu/ /mchog tu zhi ba'i yi ge gnyis / /man ngag thob pa'i 'dod pa'i don/ /gang gis zla ba drug bzlas na/ /thig le'i sgra yi go 'phang gsal/ /'dod pa'i don kun sgrub par byed/ /skye bos dben pa lha yi gnas/ /sgra yi tsher ma 37rnams dang bral/ /bgegs med skal bzang nyams dga' ba/ / skyed mos 32tshal gzhi 1snyebade ba che/ /'dod pa lnga la longs spyod pas/ /sngags kyi gtso bobo 'grub par 'gyur/ /'di ni gzhan yang bshad kyis nyon/ /khyim du bde ba'i phyag rgyas gnas/ /gang gis tshogedangos grub mchog tu 'gyur/ /sgrub po bde ba'i stan 'dug nas/ /mig gnyis sna rtser gtad byas nas/ /sna ni lce yi mtshad du bzhag /phrag gong bsnyams 0la lce rkan sbyar/ /so dang mchu ni bde bar bzhag /dbugs kyi 'byung rdub klod 12nas ni/ /cung zad cung zad rtsol bral nas/ /ji lta ba bzhin 'byung rdub ni/ /rdo rje skyil 1 krung legs gnas pas/ /de ltar phyag rgya dang ldan pas/ /yi ge 81—776

gnyis ni rtag tu bzlas/ /thig le'i dbye bas bde ba che/ /zla ba drug gis 17rnal 'byor mchog /thob 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud 92ni dang po 'di / /a ba dhū tī tshon)dri med gnas/ /rlung gi de nyid ye shes che kyi/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yi ni rgyu/ / ril bu (5noral gri ro langs dang / /rgyal po mig sman bcud kyis len/ /dmag dpung rengs dang rtsig 96)pa 'bigs/ /rig 'dzin gyi ni go 'phang 97)mchog /mi ri snang ba dang gter mthong ba/ /'dod dgur bsgyur 9nodang gzugs mthong dang / /gser 'gyur dang ni dug las rgyal//me 0yi nang du 'jug pa dang / /mngon shes lnga yi go 'phang dang / /ye shes lnga ni thob par 'gyur/ /de ltar skad cig gcig 11la ni/ /byang chub mtshan nyid go 'phang ngo / /dka' 15ba spyod pa spangs nas ni/ /shes rab snying rje yang dag ldan / /bshad pa'i bde ba chen po ster/ /sdom nyisapa mi dgos sbyin sreg min/ /phreng ba mi dgos bgrang mi dgos/ /'di ni bskyed 1 rim dbye mi dgos/ /gsungs pa'i dka' 8thub sogs mi dgos/ /sngags kyi rnal 'byor gcig pu yis / /bla ma'i zhal las brgyud mipa dang / /zla ba drug tu 1 tshomangon sbyor bas/ /go 'phang mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba hu3mngon par rtogs pa las thig le'i dbye ba dang rnal 'byor mchog thob par byed pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang de nyid nyon/ /bla na med pa nā da'i 19don/ /gang gis shes pa tsam gyis ni/ /tshe 'di nyid la dngos grub 'gyur/ /sgra yang mi shigs 2 tshopar ni bshad/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal dri ma med/ /rnam pa kun las rnam 81wa 777

par grol/ /lte ba sprul pa yang dag gnas/ /sbrul gyi lce ltar phra ba ni/ /gnyis med ye shes rmad 1)byung bdu ni/ /tshangs pa khyab 'jug drag po dang / /dbang phyug dang ni rtag zhi ba/ /de dag de ltar rin po che/ /skyed pa po yi (kyepha dang mas/ /yi ge med cing gong du ri4)med/ /'byung ba chen po 6)rnam par spangs/ /dus dang rtog pa rnams (6)las grol/ /skye med zad med rmad du byung sti/ /'dzin pa kun la zhen la sogs/ /spangs shing lhag ma rwaped pa dang / /mchog gi mchog ste zhi ba med/ /dngos po kun gyi dbus na gnas/ /rnam rtog med cing brten (8na pa med/ /kun gzhi rnam shes zhes gsungs pa/ /nyon mongs can gyi yid kyis ni / /bems (7po rnams kyis sad par byed/ /mchog tu gnyis med rnal 'byor gyisal/ /thob pa'i go 'phang bla na med/ /gnyis med mchog tu gsal ba dang / /rlung gi de nyid yang dag rten/ /yi ge hoḥyis bskul nas ni/ /me yi 'khor lo sad par byed/ /de lta'i nā da'i go 'phang don/ /bla ma'i zhal las 7yang dag gnas / /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba ⑩mngon par rtogs pa las nā da'i 8tshig rnam par bshad pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang gsang ba'i don/ /bla na med pa bshad kyis 3stenyon/ /gsang ba bha ga zhes su gsungs/ /bha ga de bzhin chos 'byung ba/ /bde ba chen po'i go 'phang rtenas/ /dga' ba skyed 8par byed pa'i rgyutshi/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yi ni gnas/ /ye shes lnga yi pho tshobadag nyid gsal/ /ye shes chen po spros pa med/ /rnam par rtog pa thams cad spangs/ /bral dga'i mtha' ste ⑫mchog tu phra/ /lhan cig skyes dga' kun bdag gnas/ /dga' bral la sogs 87wa 778

skad cig gnas/ /phra ba yang dag byang chub sems/ /srog la phan par 'tsho ba ste / /srang mda'i 0)'khrul 'khor lta bur gnas/ /dus bral rnam rtog med pa ste / /stong nyid skye med 'chi ba med/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lor thim pa dang / /bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo skye/ /bsam gyis mi khyab zhi ba ste/ /chags bral 'gro kun skye ba med/ /rdo rje pad+ma mnyam sbyor bas/ /bde ba thams cad ster bar byed / /rlung gi de nyid rig pa yis/ /rtsa yi nadabus su 'dzin par byed/ /gang de skye ba nyams myong bar/ /gsang ba zhes ni bya bar grags/ /de nyid gsang ba yi ni mchog /bla ma'i zhal la lhag par gnas/ /phan tshun brgyud pa'i rim pa yis/ /bla ma bzang po'i zhal las 4)shes/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba (snyemangon par rtogs pa las gsang ba chen po'i tshogs ma lus par bstan ⑥pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste brgyad (7pa'o// //de nas gzhan gang na)sdom pa'i don/ /de kho na nyid bshad kyis (95nyon/ /sdom pa srung bar byed pa gang / /de ni byang chub sems zhes brjod/ /rdo rje'i ri7rtse mor sems 'dzin pa/ /de ni bsrung 3lhab zhes ni grags/ /dbang po rnams ni yul rnams la/ /'jug cing rtag tu gang gnas pa/ /de ni sdom pa bsrung nya ba dang / /dam tshig bsrung 51nyebar bshad pa yin/ /gdul dka' 0tshul 'chos g.yo sgyu 8can/ /rmongs dang sems khros g.yo can dang / /dad med rtog ge ba lhan cig /rtags kyis yonye bar 'tsho ba dang / /nyan thos nor la brkam nya chags can/ /de kho na nyid sun 'byin cing / /don dam pa nya ni mi shes pa/ /med par lta /tsho)dang tshul khrims 'chal/ /gtam dang tshig ni kyal ( )pa dang / /81wa 779

'dri ba la sogs mi bya zhing / /se gol gtogs nyu)pa tsam du yang / /de dang lhan cig gnas mi bya/ /las kyi phyag rgya nyams dga' ba/ /gal te byis pa'i skye bo dang / /de dang lhan cig dam tshig ni/ /mi bya rnal 'byor nyams par 'gyur / /skyed narin dam tshig dbus zhugs dang / /pad snod phyag rgya sogs brten dzo dang / /brkam 94skudang 'brel pas 'jug pa dang / /dam tshig la ni 'jug mi bya/ /snod dang cang te'u gri gug dang / /glegs bam dang ni bgrang phreng dang / /dam tshig med pa gzhan dag la/ /gang du'ang bstan par mi bya'o//dge slong sdom la gnas pa la/ /rnal 'byor spyod sogs bya ba dang / /man ngag rnams ni bstan mi bya/ /ras ris la sogs mi bstan cing / /gang gis dam tshig lhan cig tu/ /ji ltar spyod pa yang dag spyod/ /bla ma la yang smra min na/ /gzhan rnams la ni smos ci dgos/ /dbang po yul la spyod pa ni/ /gang nas de ni bsdams ldanas ni/ /stong nyid gnyis med sgyu ma la96/ /sogs pas kun rdzob lhag spyad tsho non/ /shes rab ye shes dbang bskur sogs/ /nyams su myong ba'i bde ba yis/ /bde ba chen po'i dran pa yis/ /dbang po rnams ni yul las ldog /bdag bstod 98)gzhan la smod pa dang / /ye shes snyems (she)sogs nges spangs pa/ /blo ldan rdo rje dbang phyug gi/ /yang dag sdom pa bshad pa yin/ /de lta bu sogs dam tshig ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yis rtag bsrung bya/ /gzhan du rnal 'byor nyams 7par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor ldan pa rdo rje can/ /bgrang phreng dang ni dbu rgyan dang / /rus pa'i rang bzhin phyag rgya dang / /glegs bam bsam gtan ras ris dang / /thod pa la sogs rnal 'byor ma/ /thams cad du ni dngos grub phyir/ /bla ma la yang sba bar bya/ /sngags ni tshig tu brjod mi 81wa 780

bya / /mchu 'gul 517bar yang rinami mngon zhing / /cung zad mgrin par brjod bya yisal/ /sngags kyi rgyal po de ltar bzlas/ /gsang las dngos grub mtshungs pa med / /gang phyir de ni sdom par bshad/ /snod min nor ni chen po dang / /ldan yang rgyud las skyon du gsungs/ /bla mas bla med dngos grub phyir/ /'bad pa yis ni spang bar bya/ /bza' btung gos la sogs pa dang / /nor ni chen po la chags shing / /snod min slob ma man ngag mchog /rmad du byung ba smra ba gang / /rnal 'byor shes pa tshe 'di la/ /de ni dmyal ba ngu 'bod 'gro/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba mngon par rtogs pa las sdom pa'i tshig gtan la dbab pa'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang de nyid nyon/ /dam tshig don ni bla na med/ /bza' ba yi ni dam tshig gang / /de ni de yi don bshad bya/ /bza' ba ru ni bshad pa gang ske/ /de ni bdud rtsi lnga ru brjod/ /rlung gi de nyid sbyor ba yis/ /zhu nas ro gcig slar yang ni/ /rdo rje lam nas steng song ste/ /gcig tu gyur pa bza' ba'o / /dam tshig lus dang ngag yid kyis/ /de nyid gsum dang gang shar dang //'khor lo bzhi po rnams la yang / /bde ba nyams su myang ba gang / /de dang ro gcig rnal 'byor pa/ /rtag tu spyod pa bza' ba'o/ /byang chub sems kyi de nyid mchog /bde ba chen po'i go 'phang thim/ /zhu ba rlung gi de nyid kyis5ge / /bza' ba bsam gtan bzang po'o/ /spyi bo thod pa'i slad nas ni/ /de tsam rnal 'byor pas rtag tu/ /de la snying rje brteng ba ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' bde ba che/ /snod mchog gsang ba'i pad+mar 95rlugs/ /rten ni bza' ba 81—781

rab rtogs byed/ /sems kyis ri1)bdud rtsi 'thung byed na(mi/ /bdud rtsi lnga (0yi ro rdzas 'thung / /de za ba ni rdo rje 'chang / /glang mo (0rta khyi ba lang (5)mi/ /byang chub sems dang bcas pa'i khrag /bsres nas skad cig de la bza' de ni bdud rtsi lnga zhes brjod/ /rnam rtog dang ni kun rtog gi(6)/ /stong pa nyid du gsal ba'i snod/ /rdo rje can gyis rtag tu bza'/ /stong nyid ye shes pha rol 'gro / /dga' ba gsum pa'i bde ba ni/ /lhan skyes lhan cig snod du ni/ /rdo rje can gyis (7༄rtag tu bza'/ /bde ba chen po'i go 'phang gnas/ /rnam rtog rlung rnams thams cad ni/ /zhi ba'i de nyid snod bzang por/ /rlung gi de nyid shes pas bza'/ /rnam rtog med pa'i go 'phang gnas/ /phyag rgya gsum dang yang dag sbyor/ /phyag rgya chen por bshad snod du/ /rnal 'byor de nyid shes pas bza'/ /srog dang rtsol ba'i go 'phang gnas/ /rnam rtog dang ni kun rtog gis/ /sgom dang sgom min sogs 'khrul pa/ /srog chen po (kyeyi snod du ni/ /rnam rtog dra ba'i sa bon sogasaX9)/ /phung po'i bud shing snod bzang por ye shes chen po'i me yis min/ /sngags kyi de nyid rtogs pas bza'/ /bdud bzhi'i bokhro bo chen po yi/ /stobs kyi rig hu7pas sgrub pa po(1rte/ /sgrub pos legs par mnyam gzhag tsho12nas/ /rtag tu rnal 'byor snod du bza'/ /rlung dang sngags dang rdzas rnams kyi/ /thig le gsum ste bla na med/ /mi shigs go 'phang snod du ni/ /zos na rnal 'byor pha rol 'gro/ /stong nyid ye shes mtshungs med pami / /snying rje'i snod kyis skomachog tu ni/ /ye shes chen po tsomanyam gzhag ⑩nas / /btung zhing rtag tu btung ba'o/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig ces nyunyesu bshad/ /rdo rje pad+ma yang dag sbyor/ /de kho na nyid mchog skyes gang / /de tshini skal ldan 81wa 782

snod la ni/ /rnal 'byor pas 'thungs (1)nyams dga' ba/ /bsgrub 2par bya ba'i de nyid mchog /nyon mongs dang bral lhan cig skyes/ /phyag rgya chen po'i don bsgrub bya/ /de lta bu sogs dam tshig sogs/ /gzhan ni gang du'ang nangs ma bshad/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang mchog /bla ma'i zhal las gsal bar rtogs / /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ④ba mngon par rtogs pa las dam tshig gi don gtan la dbab tshan/pa'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad kyis (6)nyon/ /sgra tsam don ni bshad par bya/ /gang gis shes pa tsam gyis ni/ /'pho ba med pa'i go 'phang 'thob chos kyi 'khor lo'i pad sbubs (pesu/ /sgra tsam yang dag gnas pa ni/ /chags med snang ba med pa dang / /gnyis su med cing dri ma med/ /dpe bral g.yo ba med pa dang / /gzhi med bla gab med pa dang / /lha yi dbang phyug ye shes mchog /'byung dang rngub pa rnam par spangs/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyi lha dbang phyug /de lta bu ni rnyed par dka'/ /mchog tu zhi ba bde ba che/ /gzugs mchog 'chi ba med pa'i mchog /rten cing 'brel 'byung rang bzhin gyis/ /rgyan chang ro yis myos pa ltar/ /mchog tu nang du song gyur nas/ /de bzhin rnam pa kun gyi gnas / /sngags kyi de nyid rig pa'i rten/ /rang gi nyams (84)myong rtog pa'i gnas / /de nas ston pa bla med pa/ /rdo rje sems dpas (she)zhus pa ni/ /bcom ldan de nyid zhi ba mkhyen/ /sngags kyi de nyid rab dbye ba/ /gang gis rnam par shes tsam gyis/ /de kho na nyid 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nas rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /sngags kyi de nyid bla na med/ /mchog dang rab mchog phra ba 81—783

dang ske/ /ye shes chen po mchog chen po/ /snying po yi yang snying po mchog /yang dag bshad kyis mnyan ①par gyis/ /rgyud rnams kun du sbas pa rnams/ /gsang ba'i go 'phang 'pho ba med/ /lte ba'i 'khor lo de nyid mchog /sgra tsam du ni yang dag gnas/ /stong nyid chen po'i dbus su thim/ /bde ba chen po'i go 'phang gsal/ /gnyis med 'jigs bral zhi ba dang / /snang ba med cing kun rdzob med/ /gnyis med ting 'dzin sbyor ba yis/ /sngags kyi de nyid rab gsal ba/ /thog ma med cing zhi ba dang / /dngos dang dngos med bdag nyid gtso / /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa/ /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin ni/ /de tshe thog mar stong nyid sgom/ /snang ba med pa'i go 'phang zhil/ /rang bzhin med gnas nyams dga' ba/ /rnam rtog med la mchog tu brten9 na/ /stong nyid ye shes mtshungs pa med/ /byang chub sems kyi rgyud dang ni/ /yi ge hūṃ las yang dag byung / /rnal 'byor shes pa rmad 90byung che/ /de nyid gsum ni ro gcig don / /a ba dhū tī'i (gego 'phang gnas/ /slar yang dga' ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /'jug pa la sogs rnam par spangs/ /bde ba chen po'i go 'phang ni/ /byang chub sems ni dri ma med/ /sna tshogs skad cig dbyer med pa/ /brjod la pa'i bdag nyid dbyangs bral ba/ /rtag tu gnas pa'i rgyun gyis kyang / /byang chub sems ni 'bab pa ni/ /sngags kyi rnal 'byor gyis ni thob/ /skye med zhi ba'i thig le tsam/ /sngags kyi spyod pas spyad pas tsho na/ /ye shes mchog ni rang rig pa'o / /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba (8 mngon par rtogs pa las sgra tsam gyi 99ri don gtan la dbab pa'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// //81—784

de nas rlung gi de nyid mchog /don dam pa ni bshad kyis 1 nyon/ /rnal 'byor pa yis ((rlung bsgoms na/ /myur du dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /rlung gi thig le ye shes che/ /phra zhing de nyid tshalde)go 'phang gsal/ /dngos grub kun byed nyams dga' ba/ /gnyis med rnal 'byor mi zad pa/ /skye med kun 'gro zhi ba dang / /lus rnams kun la khyab pa dang / /ma pham stong pa bsam mi khyab//thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /sgom dang bsam gtan rnal 'byor gyis / /thig le rang gi ngo bo shes/ /chos rnams gcig tu gyur pa'i gnas/ /sngags kyi de nyid kyi ni rgyu/ /bag chags kun las rnam par grol/ /kun mkhyen bde ba kun gsal rideb/ /sna yi rtse mor de nyid mchog /'od zer thig le bsam par bya/ /srog dang rtsol ba yang dag sbyor/ /rtog pa rnams kyi grangs ster ba/ /skal (5༄bzang ye shes lnga yi bdag /sangs rgyas lnga yi cho ga ni/ /rin chen lnga yi sbyor ba'i gzugs/ /'byung ba lnga yi bdag nyid tsam/ /thog ma lus kyi phyag rgya'i dngos/ /ngag gi grangs kyi zlos (khamatshan nyid/ /yid kyi rnal 'byor che la zhen/ /sgom pa'i go 'phang mi zad (3)pa/ /dbugs kyi tshegs 98)ni bgrang ba dang / /rlung gi rnam par dpyad pa dang / /gnas kyi dbye ba rtsa rnams kyi/ /dus kyi dbye ba rtogs pa dang / /rlung rnams kyi ni zlog 9pa dang / /rtog pa dang bcas spangs pa ste/ /de ltar mdor bsdus rnam 7drug gis/ /'byung dang rngub pa zhes su brjod/ /thog mar 'byung dang rngub pa rnams/ /nyi khri dang ni tshig stong dang / /de bzhin grangs ni brgya phrag drug /nyin dang mtshan mo nges pa ni/ /ji srid grangs ni thob pa'i gnas/ /nyin zhag nyi shu rtsa bdun du/ /grangs kyi rjes su sbyor ba yis/ /grangs ni yang dang yang du brtag /81—785

dus mtshams kyi ni rab dbye bas/ /de nas rjes su zlos par 'gyur/ /thun tshod (7so sor srog rnams dang / /rtsol ba ru ni brtag pa ste/ /nyis stong bdun brgya'i grangs kyis ni/ /yang dag par ni nges bzung ②med/ /yongs su gsal bar bcad nas ni/ /nyin zhag nyi shu rtsa bdun la/ /'khor lo bzhi yi ②dbye ba yis / /nyin dang mtshan du nges par ni/ /de rjes gnas kyi rtsol ba yis tha dad du ni rab tu brtag /rtsa yi 'khor lo rgyu ④ba yis/ /'byung dang rngub pa nges (nyepar ni/ /nges par gzung ba'i sbyor ba lasadu/ /rtsa yi 'khor lo spyad ⑦par bya/ /de yi 'khor lo'i rtsa dbye bas/ /nyin zhag nyi shu rtsa bdun las/ /de rjes gnas kyi sbol pa'i sa/ /gnas kyi dbye bas brtag par bya/ /gnas ni ⑧so sor brtags pa yis/ /brgya dang brgyad ni lhag par rgyu/ /rnam rtog med pa'i sbyor ba mchog /rtog pa spangs pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin bdag /brgya dang brgyad ni lhag par rgyu/ /'di ni yang dag rnal 'byor mchog /nyin zhag nyi shu rtsa bdun gyis/ /mtshan nyid sgom pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /ji ltar gnas par yonyerang ngo bo/ /rtog dang bcas pa'i rnal 'byor pa / /de nas ⑩rnal 'byor log yinas ni/ /rtog pa dang bral rlung chen po/ /rtsa yi 'khor lo rnam par rgyu/ /de thob nas ni log 8pa dang / /kun nas nyon mongs rnal 'byor pas/ /nges pa la ni don dam pa/ /nyin zhag nyi shu rtsa bdun las / /las dang po pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /blo dang ldan pa log pa las/ /de nas dgag pa de dag kyang / /yang dag rnal 'byor stobs kyis ni/ /srog dang rtsol tunyeba'i rnam rtog rnams/ /kun nas rab tu spangs nas ni/ /rlung gi de kho na nyid rgyu / /rnal 'byor mchog ni bsgom par bya/ /gnyis med mchog gi rnal 'byor 81—786

gyis① / /nyin zhag nyi shu rtsa bdun la/ /rlung gi de kho na nyid rten/ /'khrul pa'i rnal 'byor dag pa ni/ /de la rtse gcig sems kyis (mini/ /rtog med de kho na nyid kyisani/ /rlung gi de nyid rnal 'byor mchog /yang dag rtsol la byas pa gsal/ / khang bzangs ④byid pa bzhin du ni/ /thog mar sa ni yongs su sbyang ⑤/ /de steng stibagegs dang bral byas la/ /gnas ni legs par dag par bya / /khang bzangs skal ba gnyams dga' ba/ /blo ldan ji ltar 'dod par bya/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor spyod pas mchog /rlung gi de nyid rnam par bsgom/ /snga ma bzhin du mnyam gzhag (nyenas/ /srog dang rtsol ba'i sbyor ba dang / /rnal 'byor mchog gi ye shes che/ /rnal 'byor rig pa bsgom par bya/ /thog mar rlung gi de nyid dang / /de nas sngags kyi de nyid gsal/ /de la rlung gi 'od zer mchog /gsal ba chen po'i kha dog lnga/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lnga rang bzhin / /phung po lnga yi rang ngo bo/ /de ni ye shes lnga dag pa/ /rlung lnga ru ni rgyu bar byed/ /mngon par byang chub rnam pa lnga'i/ /de nyid mtshan nyid go 'phang mchog /sna yi rtse mo de nyid mchog /rlung lnga dang ni rang ngo bo/ /rlung gi thig le zhes ni bshad/ /yang dag de nyid gsal ba yang / /sna rtser yungs kur du'oskude yang ni/ /rgyud gzhan rnams su gsungs pa ni/ /sna rtser yungs kur (7de yang ni/ /srog dang rtsol 7ba'i brtag pa ste/ /srog dang rtsol ba la gnas pa/ /'od lnga sangs rgyas rnams su bsgom/ /steng gi sna las nges 'byung ba/ /g.yas dang g.yon dang gnyis ka 8yang / /dal bar rgyu dang rnam bzhir 'gyur/ /nang gi dus ni yin par bshad/ /lkog ma snying ga hu)lte ba dang / /gsang ba'i pad+mar 'gro 'ong ston/ /thun phyed kyi ni dus dag tu/ /go rims 0ji bzhin 81—787

gnas pas bstan/ /g.yas pa nas ni 'byung ba'i khams/ /me yi dkyil 'khor nyid yin te/ /kha dog dmar zhing gsal ba nyid/ /pad+ma'i (1)mgon po rgyu ba'o/ /g.yon pa nas ni 'byung ba'i khams/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba/ /ljang ser dag tu snang ba ste/ /las kyi mgon po rgyu ba'o/ /gnyis ka las ni 'byung ba'i khams/ /gser gyi mdog tu snang ba ste/ /dbang chen gyi ni dkyil 'khor nyid / /rin chen mgon po rgyu ba'o/ /dal zhing rgyu ba med pa'i khams/ /dag pa'i shel ltar snang ba ni/ / chu yi (kyedakyil 'khor nyid yin te/ /rdo rje mgon po rgyu ba'o/ /lus kun la ni gnas pa'i rlung / /bya ba kun la 'jug ②pa'o/ /'di ni rnam snang ngo bo ste/ /'chi ba'i lus la 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rlung gi de nyid gsal ba 'di/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin can/ /rnal 'byor byis pa'i yul min zhing / /rtog ge pa yis ④mi shes so/ /dngos grub thams cad gsal byed pa/ /rnal 'byor kun gyi (5dngos grub pa/ /de nyid kun gyi go 'phang gsal / /rnal 'byor kun gyi don bsdus pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang gsal / /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /de nyid mchog ni shin tu phra / /bla ma'i zhal las rtogs par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba 56)mngon par rtogs pa las rlung gi de kho na nyid bshad pa'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad kyis rtso)nyon/ /bde ba chen po phyagasal ba'i tshig/rdor sems go 'phang mi phyed pa/ /rang rig pas ni mchog gi mchog /kun rtog gis 9ribartags kyis 6stong pa/ /bde ba chen po zhes 'di brjod/ /lhan 81—788

cig skyes pa'i dus su ni/ /gzung 1)dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs/ /bde dang sdug bsngal rnam par spangs/ /zhi ba gnyis med rnam par bral/ /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin bdag /bde chen zhes ni 'di la brjod/ /rdo rje ye shes lnga yi dngos/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi rang bzhin can/ /lnga ni rtsa nas 'bab pa'i rgyun / /stong nyid rdo rje'i go 'phang gsal/ /rang bzhin med cing rten med pa②ske/ /gnyis med dngos po rnam bral zhing / /cha med cha ni rnam par spangs/ /rtag tu rtog pa kun las grol/ /'pho ba med cing zhi ba dang / /zad ri )med bde ba thams cad gsal/ /nyon mongs kun las rnam grol ba/ /bde ba thams 2cad la 'jug pa/ /stong pa stong pa chen po dang / /shin tu stong pa mchog gi mchog /stong pa dang (na)gzhan stong pa'i gnas/ /nam mkha' (6 lnga yi ngo bo nyid//mi chod ⑦mi 'gyur ngo bo nyid/ /mi tshig pa dang mchog tu 'bigs/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi ye shes mchog /rang bzhin rdo rje zhes ni brjod/ /snying rje rnal 'byor yang dag 'dres/ /mchog tu skye ba'i bde ba 'di/ /de nyid gsum po 8ro gcig pa/ /rjod 59)dang brjod bya rnam par spangs/ /bde chen zhes bya'i 'khor lor ⑩gnas/ /dbang po rnams kyi spyod yul min/ /mchog tu gnyis med rnal 'byor gyis/ /zhi ba dga' ba'i mtshan nyid gcig /'khor lo bzhi yi rim gyis thob/ /rnal 'byor bzhi yi go 'phang gsalanyunye/ /stong nyid lnga yis kun nas gang / /cha bzhi yis ni rnam bkag pa/ /rdo rje mor ni 1ge'adzin pa ni/ /sems dpa' zhes byar gtan la dbab/ /nam mkha' lnga yi 1 cha yis gang / /'di ni rdo rje sems dpar brjod/ /de nyid bde chen go 'phang ste/ /bzhi pa dga' ba kun la khyab/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma sbyor skyes/ /mi phyed dbye ba 81—789

rnam par spangs/ /de yi ngo bo de nyid de/ /rang nyid tshor ba rig pa'o/ /pha rol gzhan gyi spyod yul min/ /dpe bral mtshon par dka' ba dang / /rang gi blo la yang dag gnas/ /rang rig pa zhes bshad pa'o/ /gzhon nu ma yi hunyerab dga' bzhin/ /mchog tu gsal bar nyams su myong / /de nyid mchog dang pha rol 'gro/ /mchog ni thub pa kun la sogs/ /rtog pa gsal ba'i go 'phang ni//de ni mchog dang bde ba che/ /de nyid gsum du mtshan nyid gcig② /dngos dang dngos med las grol ③bde ba'i bdag nyid 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las ni grol bar rtogs/ /gnyis dang gnyis med rnam dpyod ④rang bzhin dang bral blo ni zhi ba'i bdag nyid can/ /gsungs pa'i nyon mongs gcod cing 'jig rten kun rtog dang ni bral ba zhes/ /shes dang shes bya'i rnam rtog dben pa spangs shing bden pa'i rang bzhin dang / /mthar gyur kun khyab zhi ba mchog dang mchog rab de nyid 'gro ba bde la stsol/ /dus ni dus kyi mtha' zhes brjod/ /bzhi pa'i dus sbyor zhes bya ba/ /'khor ba 'khrul ba'i rtog ⑤spangs shing / /mya ngan 'das pa thob pa spangs/ /mnyam pa'i nyams ni chen por myos/ /mnyam nyid ye shes mtshan nyid can/ /gzung (6)ba rnams kyi yul rnams ⑦zhes/ /kun nas gzugs la sogs pa las/ /'dzin pa dbang po rnam shes rnams/ /mig la sogs pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /de (kyedang bral zhing mchog tu phra/ /ye shes bde ba kun gyi bdag /sdug bsngal kun las rnam par grol/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs/ /bde ba sems ni zhi ba nyid/ /sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid des/ /de las rnam grol 'jigs pa med/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa po/ /stong nyid ye shes chen po'i bdag /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mi 81—790

'byung zhing / /thugs rje zhi bar mdzad pa'i phyir/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i bde mi gnas / /nyan thos ye shes zhi ba nyid/ /gnyis med mchog dang bse (1)ru'o/ /de dag bde ba rtogs (kyepa yi/ /de dang bral ba'i bde chen po/ /dgang phyir mchog tu dka' chaba'i dus/ /nyan thos ye shes zhes brjod do/ /de mtha' bral ba'i dga' ba ni/ /rang rgyal mya ngan 'das pa dang / /de ni gnyis med ye shes zhi/ /bde ba yis ④ni bye brag byas/ /dngos po mkhyen pa'i ye shes che/ /byang chub sems kyang 'dzin par byed/ /rtsa rnams kun la bde ba ni/ /bde ba chen po'i (snyego 'phang gnas/ /de yi bdag nyid de nyid ni/ /bde ba chen po zhes ni brjod/ /rnal 'byor gcig pus de nyid ni/ /rtog pa rnam rtog bdag nyid min/ /bsnyen nas bzlas (7pa sbyin sreg (0min/ /bsam gtan rlung ni bgegs ⑧pas min/ /bya ba ma yin phreng bas min/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgoms pas min/ /cung zad bzhi pa'i zhu)dbang bskur gyis/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhal nas 'thob/ /rnal 'byor ma kun kun spyod ni/ /mchog gi ye shes bde ba che / /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba 7mngon par rtogs pa las bde ba chen po'i tshig rnam par bshad pa'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad kyis nyon/ /rdo rje pad+ma mnyam par sbyor/ /gang gis yang dag dngos grub 'gyur/ /tshe 'di nyid la rnal 'byor pa/ /mi phyed rdo rje zhes ni brjod/ /de ni rlung du yang dag grags/ /yi ge a ni phye ba yis/ /rnal 'byor shes pas rtag hunyemachog stsol/ /de rten snying ga'i 8pad+ma yisanyunye/ /'dab ma brgyad kyis rnam par brgyan/ /chos kyi 'khor lo skal ba bzang / /81—791

thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /de yi 'dab ma la skyes pa/ /rnam shes brgyad ni kun rdzob bo/ /mig la sogs pa yang dag rten/ /'gro ba gsum du rnam par spyod/ /de dag 'joms pa rlung rdo rje/ /bgegs mthar byed 1)pa zhes ni brjod/ /rnam shes rnams dang gang de la/ /'jig rten skyong ba rnams su brjod/ /'jig rten gsum du kun nas khyab/ /'jig rten pa yi lha rnams gnas/ /skyong ba yang ni thams cad kyis/ /yul la sogs pa'i 'bras bu gnas/ /de la rlung gis (kyeyang dag sbyorangs/ /rdo rje pad+mo zhes ni brjod/ /rdo rje snying rjer rtso)shes par bya/ /pad+ma yang ⑤ni stong pa nyid/ /de dag sbyor ba'i mchog tu shes/ /rdo rje pad+ma mnyam sbyor ba/ /rdo rje nyi ma zhes ni gsungs/ /'od zer tshogs kyi (6)bdag nyid can/ /de rnams kyis ⑦ni 'byed pa gang / /de ni pad+ma zhes su brjod/ / de yi rin)rnal 'byor mchog tu shes/ /rdo rje pad+ma mnyam sbyor ba/ /byang chub sems kyang rdo rjer 'gyur/ /bde chen 'khor lo pad+ma'o/ /de la'ang de yi sbyor ba gang / /sbyor ba mchog tu tsormad du byung / /bla ma'i gsung ni tshordo rje ste/ /slob ma bzang gis thos pa'i snod/ /pad+ma de yi gnas de la / /de yi sbyor ba'ang mchog tu gsal/ /zhi gnas pad+ma zhes gsungs la/ /de la lhag mthong rdo rje'o/ /de gnyis gcig gyur rnal 'byor ni/ /sgom mispepa yis ni de nyid mthong / /rnal 'byor ma zhal pad+mar gnas/ /rdo rje bde chen bla na med/ /pad+ma slob ma bzang gi kha/ /man ngag gi ni don gyi snod/ /de gnyis rnal 'byor kun bdag nyid/ /yang dag de nyid don mthong byed/ /blo ldan rnam rtog bral ba yi/ /rdo rje liṅga zhes ni bshad/ /rnam rtog bral ba'i blo ldan gyisal/ /bha ga pad+ma zhes ni brjod/ /dam tshig gis brlan rnal 'byor ma(1rnye de 81—792

gnyis dngos gcig yang dag sbyor/ /gnyis med ye shes mthong bar byed/ /stong phrag gnyis dang bdun khri yi/ /rtsa rnams rdo rje zhes ni brjod/ /byang chub sems ni 'bab pa'i rtsa/ /pad+ma zhes ni yongs su grags/ /de (1 ni kun du sbyor ba des/ /dga' ba skyed par byed pa yis(khu/ /rdo rje yi yang nyams dga'i stan / /rang rig ༷kyerdo rje 'chang pad+ma/ /de la de gnyis mnyam sbyor ba/ /sangs rgyas ye shes go 'phang gsal/ /dbang bskur mchog ni rdo rje ste/ / bla ma ri4)slob ma snod bzang po/ /de gnyis mchog tu yang dag sbyor/ /yang dag de gnyis kyi ni rgyu/ /e ni pad+ma zhes su brjod/ /yi ge paṃ (sheni rdo rje nyid/ /thig le de nyid mi shigs pa/ /de gnyis (6)sbyor ba'i ngo mtshar ni/ /de ltar sbyor ba mchog tu shes / /rdo rje pad snod sdom pa ni/ /rnal 'byor ma yi man ngag dang / /bla ma'i drin gyis yongs su shes/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba 9kyimangon par rtogs pa las rdo rje pad+ma yang dag par sbyor ba bshad pa'i le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //sngags kyi de nyid ye shes mchog /bshad kyis rdo rje can ni nyon/ /sngags kyi spyod pa spyad pa yis/ /gang (shegis dngos grub myur 'grub 'gyur/ /sku gsung ༷r+shacithugs kyi rdo rje rnams/ /sngags ni gzungs bzhin bzlas brjod bya/ /de yis myur du dngos grub 'gyur/ /rlung gi de nyid pha mthar phyin/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya go 'phang zhibo/ /phyag rgya chen po'i sdom pa'i don/ /mchog gi de nyid ye shes che/ /sngags kyi de nyid bstan pa yin/ /dmigs pa pho med pa'i lho go 'phang gsal/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nges pa'i rgyu/ /sngags ni yon tan kun gyis gsal/ /lus 81wa 793

ngag yid kyi sdom pa'o/ /de nyid de skyes ye shes mchog /de nyid kun gyi don bsdus ①pa/ /snying ga'i pad+mar ②mchog tu gsal/ /de nyid ye shes bla na med/ /zla drug bzlas pas 'grub par ni/ /'gyur te gzhan du ma yin no/ /rnal 'byor mchog gi thabs dang ni/ /rnal 'byor pas ni yongs su grags/ /dmigs med zhes ②ni gang gsungs pa/ /de ni don dam par ni brjod/ /sbrul sogs pa yi dbye ba yis/ /sngags mi zlos ④pa gnyis su med/ /'on kyang mi phyed de nyid (gegasum/ /sngags kyi don dam ⑥bsdus pa'o/ /bzlas pa'i dngos grub mtshungs pa med/ /yang dag mnyam par gzhag ⑦bzlas na/ /dngos grub mtshungs (0pa med par 'gro/ /rnam dag go 'phang bzang po gsal/ /gang shes de ni 'gro ba'i bla/ /sngags don sngags de nyid dang ni/ /sngags kyi man ngag kha brgyud ⑨pa/ /sngags kyi man ngag mi gsal ba/ /gang shes de ni 'gro ba'i bla/ /de nas rdo rje sems dpa' ni/ /kun mkhyen 'gro ba'i bla ma la/ /rdo rje sems dpas yang nas yang / /phyag byas nas ni yongs su zhus/ /sngags kyi mtshan nyid ji lta bu/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis rka/ )ming dang don/ /rang bzhin ci zhig rab gsal ba/ /sngags kyi de nyid man ngag ni/ /sngags kyi sdom don ji lta bu/ /de nas bcom ldan rdo rjes gsungs/ /rnal 'byor gsum gyi 'bras bdag nyid/ /sngags kyi don dang ming mchog dang / /gnyis med ye shes mtshan nyid can/ /de kho na nyid bshad kyis nyon/ /snying po'i 7snying po'i don bsdus pa/ /thog ma med cing zhi ba dang / /dngos dang dngos med bdag nyid gtso/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa/ /sngags don rig pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /nyon mongs med cing mi gsal ba/ /rang bzhin med pa'i mchog gi mchog /ming med rang 81—794

bzhin med pa dang / /rnam pa med pa'i chen po'i mchog /gnyis pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ /bde ba yang dag 'phel bar byed/ /skal 3)bzang bde ba 'phel bar byed/ /thams cad shes shing cha dang bral/ /gnyis med ye shes rnal 'byor skyes/ /de nyid de ni don dam yang / /de nyid de bzhin nyid gzhan min / /de nyid rdo rje 'chang ba'i dngos/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin nyid/ /khyab pa kun 'gro stong pa nyid/ /nyon mongs thams cad rab tu 'joms/ /dri med dri bral dga' ba dang / /rang rig pa yi ②go 'phang mchog /dang po'i lha ste ninyams dga' bzang / /cha yi tshogs ④rnams rgyas par byed/ /man ngag gnas kyi bye brag gis/ /'khor lo'i dbye bas btu bar bya/ /rtsa dang mgrin (5)pa snying ga ༅rkan/ /rtsol ba ji bzhin brjod pa yi7/ /de bzhin du ni las bya ba//zhi ba la sogs go rims (nyebazhin/ /ji bzhin dngos grub ye shes dang / /ji bzhin nyams su myong mtshan nyid/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa ji lta bu/ /rgyun (7gyi dbye ba ji lta bu/ /rig pa ji bzhin sbyor ji bzhin/ /'bras bu ji lta ba bzhin gnas / /yang dag bsam gtan phyag rgya'i rim/ /gzugs rdzogs ⑩pa la sogs pa yi/ /bla ma brgyud 7pas yang dag gnas/ /rab tu 'bad pas bslab par bya/ /gser dang do shal 8gos dang 'di/ /rin chen sna tshogs yon tan mchog /bran dang las byed grangs med dang / /dad cing gus pa la sogs kyis / /ji ltar bzhed pa ston pa la/ /rnyed par dka' ba'i dngos rnams kyis/ /sngags kyi don ston bla ma ni/ /dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs par bya /phyag byas de rjes sngags pa yis/ /yang dag bzung 8nas 'bras bu'i don/ / mi yi8 rus pa'i sgyu 8gu dang / /sa gzhi rin chen rab 'bar ba/ /yang na dur khrod 81—795

thal ba ni/ /rab brdal dngos grub ster bar byed/ /thog mar dbang bskur blang 1)byas nas/ /mdun du dkyil 'khor la sogs bya/ /bgegs mthar byed la gtor ma ni/ /chen po gtsug lag khang du sbyin/ /sku gsung thugs ni sgrub byed pa'i/ /mtshungs pa med pa'i sngags btu bya/ /dang po'i yi ge thog mar bri//dbyangs yig lnga pa yang dag ldan/ /sde tshan tha ma'i mtha' cha ldan/ / sku yi ②sa bon du ni brjod/ /thog ma'i yi ge nyis (snye'agyur la/ / urmi ṣa ④yi cha dang ldan / /mtshungs pa med pa'i sngags btu bya/ /gsung gi (snyerdo rje snying po mchog / uṣ+ṭha ṣa 57yi cha dang bcas/ /dbyangs yig drug par yang dag ldan/ /sde tshan mtha' yi 57)mtha' char bcas/ /thugs kyi rdo rje go 'phang gsal/ /sku gsung ri nithugs kyi dam tshig gsum/ /'jig rten gsum yang 'grub par bya/ /rnal 'byor (9pa yi de nyid mchog /sngags btu ba ni bla na med/ /de nyid dngos grub thams cad byed/ /sngags rnams kun gyi don bsdus pa/ /sngags kyi theg pa kun yin no/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu sa nyid la/ /dngos grub rnams kyi rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor ye shes bla na med/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i snying po ni/ /ye shes bla na med pa'i mchog /man ngag ji bzhin sngags zlos 7pa/ /dngos grub phyir ni lung bzhin gyis/ /de yi dngos grub rgya chen 'gro/ /tshe 'di nyid la sngags shes pas/ /ye shes chen po zhes bshad pa'i/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rnal 'byor che/ /rab gsal sngags ni mtshungs pa med/ /'dod pa kun la longs spyod byed/ /gang zhig sngags ni mgul kye7pa ru/ /rtag 'chang de kho na nyid shes/ /rtog pa kun yang 'grub par byed/ /dkyil 'khor kun du zhugs pa dang / /dam tshig thams cad shes pa 51snyedang / /blo bzang 'jig rten gsum yang 'grubazhuge//81—796

rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba gyo)mngon par rtogs pa las sngags kyi de kho na nyid gsungs pa'i le'u ste bco gelnga pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad kyis ༷2)nyon/ /grangs kyi rim pa bla na med/ /ji ltar gnas pa'i rlung rnams kyi/ /rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du/ /gang gis thob pa skal ba bzang / /srog ni thams cad bdag nyid gnas ste/ /gang gis yang dag yongs su shes/ /rnal (pe'abyor mchog ni thob par byed/ /rlung gi mtshan nyid mi shes pa/ /'jig rten gsum du rnam par 'khor/ /goms pa thob pa de yang ni//bla ma rnal 'byor de shes brgyud(6ri/ /rlung gi mtshan nyid ji lta bu/ /lo tshigs kyi ni mtshan nyid ni/ /mdor bsdus (7nas ni bshad par bya/ /sprin gyi dpal las gsal ba gang / /mdor bsdus (8༄nas ni dus ni drug /lo tshigs su ni yongs su grags/ /sbyor ba gnyis ni dus yin te/ /dus de nyin zhag drug cu'o/ /nyin dang mtshan du nges pa la/ /nyin zhag gcig ces yongs su grags/ /nyin mtshan chu tshod drug cu ste/ /de bzhin dbyug gu tsa 7sha'o/ /'byung dang rngub pa'i dus drug la/ /tsa ⑩sha zhes ni yongs su grags/ /skad cig ma drug la ni dbugs / /de nyid se gol gtogs 3)pa'i tshad/ /thang cig 1snyegasum la skad cig go/ /de la yungs kur (12bskor ba tsam/ /dbugs gsum la ni thang cig 3rigo / /thang cig mde ni yud tsam mo/ /thang cig migasum la mig btsums te/ /de yang mig ni 'dzums the tshopa yi/ /tsam gsum la ni mig btsums te/ /tsam ni thal mo brdabs pa'o/ /bde ba 'char ba de gsum tsam/ /de ni thig le 'pho ba'o / /sngags pa gsum la bde bar gnas/ /de ni rab 'gyel 1snye'ajigs par nyurta81wa 797

brjodal/ /dus gsum la ni 'jigs par bshad/ /dus ni phra ba skad cig bdag /'das pa dang ni da ltar dang / /ma 'ongs pa yi mtshan nyid do/ /'das pa'i skad cig gsum du gsungs/ /da ltar yang ni skad cig gsum/ /ma 'ongs skad cig gsum du bshad/ /de las slar yang skad cig gsum/ /de ltar skad cig gsum gyi cha/ /de las cha gsum de las cha/ /de srid grangs ni ji srid du/ /rtog pa stong pa gnyis su med/ /rnal 'byor mchog ni thob par 'gyur / /srog gi ①gnas ni bla na med/ /phyogs dang dus kyi rtog pa bral/ /rigs pa'i mtshan nyid spangs pa dang / /de yi srog ni shar nas thim/ /gnyis med de ni bsdus pa'o/ /gzhan yang bshad par bya yis ②nyon/ /srog ni thim dang 'char ba yi/ /gang tshe skad cig la sogs rtogs/ /kun nas rab tu ma zhi ba / /de srid srog ni rlung gi gnas/ /grol ba'i gnas ni mi shes so/ /bshang sgo gsang ba'i dbus na gnas/ /ming ni ma skyes cha chen po/ /de yang rnam shes dang bral ba/ /ye shes lus ni bdag med pa/ /der ni skye ba mchog gi mchog /srog chags rnams kyi mchog tu brjod/ /rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo ston/ /thog mar 'byung ba bzhi po la/ /sgro 'dogs bskyed ①pa'i ngo bor byed/ /de tshe rang gi gnas su thim/ /rnam shes las ni skye ba rlung / /de las me ni skye bar 'gyur//me las chu ni 'byung bar byed/ /de las sa ni yang dag skye/ /de dag rnams las phung por byung ④/ /de phyir skye mched rnams dang ni/ /de las rnam shes rang bzhin med/ /brgya dang brgyad kyis ⑧lhag pa'i rim/ /ji ltar skye bo de yi gnas / /thim nas 'gro ba'i rang bzhin du/ /rgyags pa bskyed (nyapa'i rlung chen po / /nyon mongs yid ⑦ni 'das nas ni/ /sngags thob nas ni rnam rgyas te/ /81—798

skye mched rnams ni sdud par byed/ /de las rgyags pas chu yi ①rlung / /rgyags pa bskyed ②pa za ba'i phyir/ /phung po rnams kyang sdud byed nyid/ /rim gyis (snenalus chen sgra sgrogs ⑤byed/ /de las rgyags pa'i cha ni 'byung / /rgyags pa'i chu ni sdud par byed/ /'byung ba rnams kyis bsdus (snyenas kyang / /go rims (6)ji lta ba bzhin du/ /de la rlung ni btang bzung 'byung ⑦/ /rgyags pa'i cha ni za bar byed/ /de nas kyang ni rlung ni sdud/ /khyab cing phra la dusgrib par byed/ /de las mi zad ⑨btang bzung dang / /rnam shes skad cig sgrib par byed/ /bsgribs nas de las rnam shes kyang / /bems pho )por song nas brgyal nyunyebar 'gyur/ /skye mched cha ni sgrib par byed/ /dag pa'i ye shes mchog gi mchog /de las thim par gyur pa'i srog /rnam shes dang ni mtshungs tsunyepar ldan/ /de nyid mchog ni de ltar bshad/ /srog ni thim zhing 'char ba dang / /ji lta ba bzhin yongs su shes/ /bla ma brgyud 8pa'i rim pa 'byung / /rigs pa gzhan yang bshad par bya/ /rdo rje'i sku ni bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /'chi ba med pa'i bsgrub mipa ni/ /gang gis 'chi med lus mchog ni/ /thob pa yon tan rnams kyi rten/ /gang phyir sems can tshe thung bas/ /'chi med go 'phang bsgrub 8mi nus/ /de phyir 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /'chi ba med par rab bsgrub bya/ /bcom ldan mgon po ye shes mchog /rnal 'byor de nyid pha rol byon/ /rdo rje sems dpas phyag byas zhus/ /'chi ba med nyid 8rigs par ni/ /ji ltar yang dag thim pa lags/ de nas bcom ldan rdo rjes gsungs/ /bya ba kun bsgrub hunyego 'phang ni/ /'chi ba med pa'i rnal 'byor che/ /yang dag de nyid rnam nges pa/ /sems can tshe ni thung ba yis/ /dngos grub 'grub pa gang yang med/ /de bas 81—799

rnal 'byor bzang po rnams/ /tshe ring ba ni dge ba'o/ /de la thog mar rnal 'byor mchog /blo bzang nang gi bdag nyid bsgrubatsista/ /lce ni rkan gyi dbus sbyar ba/ /byas nas (2)de kho 2)nyid tshig bzla6)/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung (5)bcas nas ni/ /yang dag rnal 'byor rjes dran bya/ /sna rtser (7dbugs ni rgyu bya zhing / /kha ni gsal bar dgag par bya/ / rkan gyi 4)gnas son zla ba ni/ /sngags kyi rnal 'byor gyis ni zhu/ /zhu ba rlung gi rnal 'byor gyis/ /rtag tu rnal 'byor gtso bos btung / /mtshan phyed kyi ni dus tshod mthar/ /ji srid thun gcig (sam chad par/ /de srid rnal 'byor pas sngags bzla/ /rdo rje'i 6)lus ni byed par 'gyur/ /sde tshan gnyis pa'i gsum pa la/ /dbyangs bcas pa dang yang dag ldan/ /yan lag ma nyams rtag tu bzla7/ /sgrub pa po yi srog ni 'gugs / /rdzas kyang rtag tu bsten par bya/ /de nyid lnga yi rim 1nyepas skye/ /bzlas pa nyunyerdzogs nas rtag tu ni/ /lus la 'byung ba'i dri ma med/ /lcags lnga'i rang bzhin snod du ni/ /bzhag nas ji srid nyi ma ni/ /'char kur de nas de la yang / /yo ṣi rag gtam (1snyebade ba ni/ /blugs nas rtag tu rdzas kyi mchogs /bdud rtsi bdun mapa'i ming can no/ /nyal kur yang ni de 'thungs na / /dz+ras kyis tshetshe ni 'phel bar byed/ /sngags kyi rgyal po oṃ āḥrgyu/ /de nas lan bdun bzla bar bya/ /lag g.yas ba dan gyis mtshan la/ /snod bzangs 3lhade la bkab nas su/ /yi ge brgya pa'i sngags kyis hunyani/ /lan gsum du ni dag par bya/ /de phyir bud med gzhon nu ni/ /rtag tu 'khur ba bkang zhing btung ske/ /de ni bza' ba sbyin pa yang / /mar la btags popa'i 'bras dang ni//ma sha dang ni nyi dga' dang / /ra yi 'o ma kha ra kur/ /til rnams cha mnyam ( tsho81wa 800

byas nas ni/ /mos 4)pa yis ni sbyin sreg tsho bya/ /nyal kur de la bza' ba sbyinal / /bla na med pa'i bza' ba pol/ /de ltar rig tshonapas chog shes nas/ /su la'ang smra bar mi bya'o/ /thams cad sngon (6skabazhin zhi ba ni/ /myur du dngos grub ster bar byed/ /zla ba drug tu'ang gang bsten (7)pa/ /de ni rdo rje'i 98)lus su 'gyur/ /bcud kyis len dang gser 'gyur sogs/ /tshe dgug pa ni bla na med / /rab tu 'bad pas bsten par bya/ /phyag rgya che don sgrub pa pos/ /rgas pa med cing srin nad med/ /snyom po)las med cing lkugs pa med/ /glo skam ⑩rlung mkhris tsond sogs med/ /nad dang 'bras dang 'brum bu dang / /shu ba g.yan pa 'brum phran med/ /mdze nad mtshan mar 1snyerdol ba med/ /dung dang pad dkar dpal lus ldan/ /'dzam bu chu bo'i tsho/—nyegaser ltar 'bar/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i bu mo mchog /de ni rtag tu 'gugs par byed/ /de yi mdza' 8chen lha rnams te/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams sems par skobyed/ /lus kyi rang bzhin rtag tu ni/ /phyag bya tsob dang mchod par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba 3 mngon par rtogs pa las rlung gi grangs kyi rim pa'i gnas bstan (8pa'i le'u ste bcu drug pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang rtsa rnams ni/ /grangs dang gnas ni bsdus pa nyon/ /'khor lo'i grangs kyi dbye ba yis/ /ji bzhin rmad du byung ba'i mchog /'khor lo drug la rten hu7bcu drug /lus la lha yi ri )gzhal yas khang / /rnal 'byor ji bzhin gnas ji bzhin/ /mdor bsdus nas ni bshad par bya/ /rlung gi 'khor lor shu lhaganas pa'i rtsa/ /'dab drug rlung ni mkha' la spyod/ /'dab gsum me yi 81—801

'khor lor bshad/ /rtsa gsum gnas ni rim gyis 'char/ /de bzhin longs spyod 'khor lo yang / /rtsa ni bcu drug yang dag brjod/ /chos kyi 'khor lor gnas pa'i rtsa/ /brgyad ni kun la khyab pa'o/ /de bzhin sprul pa'i 'khor lo yang ske/ /drug cu rtsa bzhir 'char bar bshad/ /bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo cher / /rtsa ni sum cu gnyis su bshad/ /de ltar mdor bsdus 0)rim pa yang / /brgya dang sum cu gcig lhag par/ /rtsa rnams su ni yang dag bshad/ /gzhan dag tu ni rgyas par yang / /rtsa ni bdun khri nyis stong du/ /gnas kyi dbye bas phye ba ni/ /nges par brjod pa (mi'abum sder gsungs/ /rgyud ni chung ngu'ang 'di nyid du/ /snying po las ni snying por gsungs/ /smin ma'i dbus gnas ()rlung 'khor lo/ /bye ba 'khyil pa mi bzad pa pa/ /mi bzang (5 brtan dang mtshan nyid can / /rtsa thung drug gi mtshan nyid do/ /'dzin pa rtog med gang ba ni/ /rtsa gsum gru gsum me dkyil 'khor/ /mgrin (6)pa'i 'og tu bshad pa yin/ /dri ma dang bral gsal ba dang / /drag po dang ni gsum yin no/ /yang dag zhugs dang shin tu zhugs/ /shin tu bzang dang bzang por 'gro/ /stobs chen dang ni mi bzad 7)che/ /mdzes chen mdun du skyes pa che/ /rgyags pa'i rtag nidang rgyags pa'i cha/ /rgyags pa'i chu dang rgyags (7)smyo byed/ /rgyags dang rgyags pa'i rgyu mthun 57dang / /rgyags pa'i rlan dang rgyags pa 'chang 517/ /rtsub dang mkha' dang 'byung brlang dang / /dbugs mi bde dang g.ya' mkha' 'gro/ /'dab chags yan lag khā yi gdong / /za phod mi bzad sgra sgrogs tsodang / /dri ldan deg dang rdul ba dang / /dbyangs dang dbyangs skyes dang ni sprin/ /chu ba mthong dang rgyun ltar sngo/ /yud tsam gtso bo yud ma 0skyes/ /rgyab tu kha bltas ⑩81—802

dbyug pa dang / /dbyug snyems (3)dang ni rnying pa dang / /tshigs kyi lto 2dang tshigs kyi tshig /tshigs kyi tshad dang brtul ba dang / /tshigs kyi gnas dang tshigs kyi gdong / /tshigs 'od tshigs kyi lu gu rgyud/ /dul byed dud 'gro gzi brjid dang / /dri med dul ba'i snyems pa dang / /chu 'phyang lto dang chu 'phyang chags / / chun 'phyang chun tsho 'phyang phyed sbrang bu/ /phru gu phru gu ster dri ba(4/ /lo ma lo ma'i mgrin (5)pa dang / /rab mchog ma dang rab gsal te/ /de ltar drug cu rtsa bzhir bshad/ /lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo gnas/ /bdud rtsi mchog gis yongs su gang / /rin chen chen po pad+ma dang / /rdo rje chen po stobs po che//mgo bo che dang sgra che dang / /nyes dga' chen po (6)myos pa che/ /'di brgyad chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus/ /snying ga'i (3)pad+mar yang dag gnas/ /longs spyod longs spyod ster ldan dang / /nyi 'gro gsal dang skal ba dang / /sgom pa dang ni thal ba'i gdong / / bza' ster bza' 58)dang bkres pa dang / /bcud len ros ni skyur po)ba dang / /ro bo'ajigs pa dang ro dang ni/ /khrung khrung longs spyod 'khor lor gnas/ /grangs ni bcu drug tu ni brjod/ /de steng rim rigs 'dod pa can/ /'dod can ma dang srog gi lus/ /zla thung zla ster mdzes pa (nyani/ /'dod chags min smra ku nyunyasha dang / / sha bi tsho spo dang dag pa dang ske/ / mi dang mi 7ro ne tso 7dang / /gang la gnyis ro ldan pa dang / /kyis 8ring chang ster bdud rtsi dang / /dung can dang ni dung rna dang / /dug gi mig dang dug gi sna/ /rgyags dbang rgyags pa brkam 3 7pa dang / /rgyags pas brgyal tunyedang ngo mtshar rgyags/ /snyems pa dang ni tshogs kyi sten rte/ /sum cu 2 snartsa gnyis zhes ni brjod/ /bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo che/ /mchog tu dga' ba 81wa 803

ster bar byed/ /phra dang reg bya mchog tu phra/ /gzung ri1)dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs kyi/ /rang nyid bde chen rang bzhin dang / /gzhan dag la yang ster bar ge byed/ /de ltar yang dag rtsa yi rim/ /bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya/ /rtsa yi rim med nges par ni/ /phung po la sogs mi 'byung ngo / /phung po med na ye shes che/ /rnal 'byor pa yis thob mi 'gyur/ ci /phung po lnga yi bdag nyid lus / /mkha' 'gro lngar ni rab tu grags/ /de nyid 'byung ba lnga yis ni/ /ye shes lngar ni rnam par gnas/ /de phyir 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /rtsa yi 'khor lo shes par bya/ /ji ltar chu yi dbus kyi shing / /myur du yang ④ni 'phel nas 5)'gro/ /de las 'bras bu sogs ldan pa/ /ster bar ⑥'di la the tshom medam/ /de bzhin phung po shing zhes bya/ /rtsa yi chu yis 'phel nas ni/ /'phel bas yang dag 'bras bu ni/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ster byed/ /lha yi rnam pa'i ngo bo yis/ /rtsa rnams rang bzhin bsgom par bya/ /gnyis phrad pa las reg bya gnyis/ /gal te rdo rje lhag gyur na/ /de tshe me ni yang dag 'bar/ /de rjes me yi 'khor lo'i dbus/ /'khor lo'i ming can pad+ma rnams/ /rim gyis rim gyis bye bar 'gyur/ /'di ni rtsa las 'bab de las/ /byang chub sems ni bde ba che/ /sprul pa'i snying po yang dag thob/ /ngo bo gcig gyur bsdus nas ni/ /'bab pa'i 97nyi ma zla ba'o/ /mi dbang dkyil 'khor dbus su yang ske/ /gang phyir srad bu'i rnam par gnas/ /rgyu gcig tu (deyang shes nas ni/ /de nyid 79ci'abras bu rnam pa gnyis/ /g.yas pa 7nyi ma'i rnam pa dang / /g.yon pa zla ba'i rnam par 'byung / /gang tshe g.yas pa'i nyi ma ni/ /de tshe khrag 'gyur bde ba'o/ /gang tshe g.yon pa'i zla ba gsal/ /bde ba kun kyang de lta bu'o/ /81wa 804

de gnyis khongs su chud pa'i me/ /yan lag bdun nyid yang dag gnas/ /sngon la rlung gi rnam shes ni/ /brgya ri17lam gang tshe 'khrul gyur na/ /pha yi mkha' la mtshungs par gnas/ /de tshe chags pa'i dbang du 'gyur/ /gsang gnas zla mtshan ldan pa'i rtsa/ /me dang nyi ma 'char ba na/ /de tshe lhag par chags pas 2non / /chags pa mchog tu 'dod par 'gyur/ /rdo rje pad+ma 'dres pa'i gdong / /'jug pa pha yi kha yi rlung / /de tshe sa bon du ni 'gyur/ /sa bon las ni sems can 'byung / /de phyir rtsa las yang dag 'char/ /'bras bu ngo mtshar can ni skye / /de nyid byang chub sems kyang ni/ /'dzin pa srog ni bsdus pa'o/ /ye shes mchog dang de nyid mchog /mchog tu bde ba rmad byung che/ /ye shes rnal 'byor thob pa yis/ /mchog tu bde ba bla na med/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba nimangon par rtogs pa las rtsa'i 'khor lo'i gnas kyi rim par bstan 5gepa'i le'u ste bcu bdun pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /rnal 'byor lus la rim ji bzhin/ /rtsa rnams rtag tu yang dag ni/ /rgyud 95pa yi ni rigs kyis 6skye/ /gsal ba ru ni ma gsungs pa/ /dad pa'i bsam pa rnam spangs pa/ /skye bo skal ba med don du / /gang du'ang gsal bar ma gsungs pa/ /snyigs ma lnga zhes bya ba'i dus/ /sems can myur du dngos grub don/ /snod du bya bar 'dod pa yis(7 rang byung ye shes rmad (8byung ba/ /rnal 'byor lus kyi bde chen po'i/ /'khor lo'i rtsa ni sum cu gnyis/ /byang chub sems ni gsal 'bab pa'i/ /rtsa rnams yang dag rnam bshad bya/ /de ni bde ba chen po'i gnas/ /de ni mtshan nyid 81—805

bshad par bya/ /ka tsa ṭa ta pa'i sde tshan/ /ya ra la wa ṣa sha sa/ /de dag rim par shes par bya/ /slar yang de dag bsdus nas ni/ /sde tshan tsam ni gcig tu 'grol/ /de yang zhi ba'i ye shes mchog /byang chub sems la 0)thim nas 'gro/ /kun rtog thams cad spangs nas ni/ /bde ba kun gyi gzhi 5)yi mchog /shes dang shes bya rnam par spangs/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /de las 'khor lo gsum dbye bas/ /rtsa ni brgyad kyi dbye ba las/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sngags kyis rdo /ni/ /gsum phye ④bdun cu rtsa gnyis gsal/ /de ni stong du rab phye ba/ /so sor 'phros pa'i bdag nyid can/ /stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyis/ /rtsa rnams kyi ni grangs zhes bya/ /rlung dang mkhris pa bad kun ni / /khams gsum gyi ni dbye ba yis/ /stong phrag nyi shu rtsa bzhir ni/ /'khor lo 'khor lo'i dbye ba yis/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud kyi ni/ /nges pa'i man ngag rjes 'brangs nas5ri/ /phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor de nyid mchog / lha yi ⑥rim pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /rtsa ni so sor dbye ba yis/ /bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya'o(7kyil/ /de las yang ni sdom sbyor bar/ /song nas phan tshun kun nas brten98ni / /slar yang bdun cu rtsa gnyis 'gro/ /bde chen 'khor lo rtsa yi gnas / /rtsa ni sum cu rtsa gnyis las/ /de yang 'khor lo sdom par 'gyur/ /'khor lo re re'i gtso bo'i rtsa/ /brgyad brgyad du ni 'gyur bar gsal/ /rnal 'byor lus kyi rtsa mchog ces/ /rmad yinyebyung sum cu rtsa gnyis ni/ /yi ge sum cu gnyis dbye bas/ /rtag tu rnal 'byor gtso bos thob/ /phung po khams dang don yul nyid/ /dbang po'i sgo ni srung ba'o/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis dbye bdag nyid/ /gsal ba yi ni dkyil 'khor mchog /lus kyi gzhal yas khang du 81—806

yang ske/ /de nyid kyi ni nang bzhugs pa/ /de bzhin gshegs dang lha mo dang / /gzugs la sogs dang rgyal sras rnams/ /khro bo bcu zhes bya ba yi/ /de nyid mchog ni yang dag bzhugs/ /slar yang khro bo rgyal sras la/ /nang du mi snang bar ni 'gro/ /rgyal sras rnams ni gzugs la sogs/ /lha mo rnams la bsdus nas ni/ /de rnams kyang (1)ni sa sogs 'gro/ /de dag de bzhin gshegs lnga la/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje la/ /de dag la yang bsdus nas 'gro/ /de kho na nyid bde gcig pu/ /de la yang ni thim nas 'gro/ /gzung (midang 'dzin pa rnams las grol/ /bde ba kun rten pa yi mchog /de yang nyams myong tsam las slar/ /de ni yi ge tsam la thim/ /yi ge tsam ni thig ler thim/ /thig le yang ni sgra la thim / / sgra yang sgra tsam la ni thim( rī/ /sgra tsam 'od gsal ba la'o/ /'od gsal go 'phang yang dag par/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i (gematshan nyid do/ /rnam par shes dang chos dbyings dang / /don dam pa dang bde ba che/ /gzung tshogacidang 'dzin pa las grol ba/ /byang chub sems ni dri ma med/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i zhi ba che/ /gnyis med ye shes rmad (6du byung / /dbang bskur bzhi pa bde ba dang / /bzhi ba'i dga' ba go 'phang mchog /de la sogs ming bye brag gis / /go 'phang mchog ni gsungs pa rtsoyin/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i dbye ba yis/ /rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du/ /de ltar bskyed 98)dang rdzogs pa yi/ /rim don bla ma brgyud khalas shes/ /zhi ba gnyis med mtshan nyid can/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba 7mngon par rtogs yonapa las rnal 'byor pa'i lus kyi rtsa nyanabasdus pa'i le'u ste bcwa hu brgyad pa'o// //81—807

de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /sna tshogs la sogs skad cig bdag /yang dag gzhung lugs mtshan nyid ni/ /de nyid 0)ji lta ba bzhin nyon/ /rnam pa sna tshogs rnam par smin/ /rnam par 'joms dang mtshan nyid bral/ /skad cig ma ni bzhi zhes gsungs/ /rnam par phye nas slar bshad bya/ /rnam pa sna tshogs mngon par 'dod/ /de yi skad cig dbye bar bya/ /a yid ga na (gedang /tsusba na dang / tsu ma sha na dang / ku tsa gra ha dang / bu la tra tra ha na dang /da sha na dang / da kha da na dang / do la dang / pu tsi tsi dudang / kur pa la sogs pa'i ka ra na dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs skad cig go/ /na li stong phrag bdun cu gnyis/ /lus ni bde ba rgyas pa na/ /mgrin pa dag tu gang phyin pa/ /rnam smin zhes bya skad cig go/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ni/ /rdo rje phreng ④ba'i mtshan nyid can/ /thams cad mngon par byang chub pa'i/ /rnam pa med pa'i skad cig go/ /na li las byung shu kra 'das/ /rnam pa dang bral skad cig go / /ye shes bzhi dang stong pa bzhi/ /skad cig ma ni bzhi las rtogs/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba na/mngon par rtogs pa las skad cig ma'i mtshan nyid rgyas par bshad pa'i le'u ste bcu dgu pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /dga' ba bzhi yi mtshan nyid ni/ /lugs 'byung lugs las bzlog 6pa yi/ / ji lta ba yi rim pa yi(7/ /dga' ba'i bde ba dang po ste/ /mchog tu dga' ba gnyis pa dang / /dga' bral zhes pa gsum pa dang / /bzhi pa lhan cig skyes par bshad/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lor (8)dga' ba dang / /mchog dga' chos kyi 'khor lor gnas/ /longs spyod bral 81—808

ba'i dga' ba dang / /lhan cig skyes dang bde ba che/ /lugs bzlog 1rim pa zhes ni gsungs/ /de rjes lugs 'byung bshad bya ste/ /bde chen 'khor lo spyi bo la/ /de ni dga' bar bshad pa yin/ /longs spyod 'khor lor mchog dga' dang / /dga' bral chos kyi 'khor lor gnas/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lor lhan cig skyes/ /dga' ba nyams su myong bar byed/ /blta dang dgug dang de bzhin brda(mi/ /kha la tsuspa ( —dbyed pa yi/ /dga' ba nyams su myong bar shes/ /rnam pa sna tshogs mtshan nyid do4)/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma mchog tu/ /de bzhin skra (snyel 'dzin pa dang / /rdo rje pad+mar bzhag ltenyenas ni/ /nyams myong sa ni skad cig mchog /rnam smin zhes bya skad cig nyid/ /de nyid rgyur ni rnam par shes/ / rtsa yi tso)dbus na rab gsal 98)gnas/ /gtum 9)mo yang ni rnam rtog 'joms/ /bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo che/ /mchog gi cha ni zhu bar byed/ /bral dga'i gnas su myong ba niri 7/ /rnam rtog skad cig mtshan nyid do/ /de la ro gcig rang bzhin ni/ /rtsa ni gcig 511gi rgyun la rten/ /bde ba chen po'i go 'phang zhi/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /rnam pa sna tshogs skad cig gsungs / /stong nyid kun gyi gzhi yi mchog /chos kyi 'khor lo de las steng 1ste/ /rnal 'byor pa yis bsgrub bya ba/ /nyams su myong ba mchog dga' ste/ /rnam smin skad cig mtshan nyid do/ /longs spyod 'khor lo de las ni/ /steng du byed pa'i skad cig la/ /nyams myong bral ba'i dga' ba ni/ /rnam 'joms (1nyamatshan nyid skad cig go/ /bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo che/ /de thob mtshan nyid skad cig ma/ /lhan cig skyes dga'i nyams myong ba/ /mtshan nyid dang bral skad cig go/ /rtsa gsum kun gyi nam mkha' che/ /bornal 'byor ma tshogs yang dag 81wa 809

gzugs / /de las 1)rab sad nyams myong ba/ /mtshan nyid gcig ②par ro mtshungs pa/ /rnal 'byor chen pos nyams su myong / /slar yang mtshan nyid med par 'gro/ /rab tu sad pa nyams su myong / /stong phrag bcu drug bdag nyid do/ /bde chen go 'phang mi phyed pa/ /gnyis med rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas / /de ltar 'di ni dga' dbye ba/ /gzhan du gsal bar ma gsungs so/ /rnal 'byor ma yi bka' drin gyis/ /bla ma brgyud lapa las shes bya/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba stimangon par rtogs pa las dga' ba'i mtshan nyid rnam par dbye ba'i le'u ste nyi shu pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad kyis nyon/ /thig le gsum ni bla na med/ /gang gis shes pa tsam gyis ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yi dngos grub 'gyur/ /rtsa rnams kun du 'bab (zhi)pa dang / /byang chub sems ni zhu byas pa/ /rdo rje 'am ni pad+ma'i rtse(6kyi / /rlung ni bzung ba'i skad cig la/ /rkan dgug (medapa yi sbyor ba dang / /smi (84)gyi sngags kyi sbyor ba yis/ /rnal 'byor mchog ni thob par byed/ /bde ba kun gyi gzhi yi mchog /chos kyi 'khor lo de nyid mchog /snying ga'i (7pad+ma'i lte ba la/ /dbus su r+ghaṃ ni bkod nas ni/ /thams cad stong pa'i mtshan nyid ni⑩/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam par grol/ /de kho na nyid lus skyob pa/ /phyogs yul dus dang rnam par grol/ /steng ( stodang 'og ni rnam par spangs/ /sems bral rang gi ngo bor gnas/ /ngag gi dra ba yongs su spangs/ /rgyud dang mtshan ma dang bral zhing / /rtog pa'i spyod yul rnams dang bral/ /gnyis pa kun las ⑫rnam par grol/ /mchog tu rtag cing zhi ba'o/ /rlung gi thig le rnal 'byor 81—810

mchog /kha dog lnga pa hu)gsal ba che/ /sna rtser sbyor ba'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /kun nas kyang ni bsgom par bya/ /yi ge oṃ ni sngags kyi mchog /rnal 'byor pa yis bzla bar bya/ /snga ma bzhin du ye shes lnga/ /zhi ba la sogs de bzhin bsgrubacige / /bag chags rim pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbye ba yis / /rtsa ni gsum po 'di ni mchog /bsdus nas slar yang dbye ba ni/ /phan tshun du ni so sor 'gro/ /rdzas kyi thig le khong chud pa/ /thig le gnyis te sngags dang rlung / /sngags kyi thig le de nyid mchog /thig le gnyis ni 'od dang rdzas/ /slar yang rlung gi thig le yang / /thig le gnyis kyi nang du 'gro/ /sngags dang rdzas kyi bdag nyid can/ /rnal 'byor pa yis (miyang dag shes/ /zla ba nyi ma me yi rtsa/ /gsum zhes bya ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /la la nā dang ra sa nā/ /a ba dhū tī ④zhes bya'i ming / /sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin dang / /de nyid du ni yongs su grags/ /steng dang 'og tu khyab pa nyid/ /so sor lu gu rgyud tshul du/ /rtsa rnams kun la khyab nas ni/ /yang dag man ngag rim pas gnas//de ltar rnal 'byor mchog tu phra/ /shes dang shes bya rnam par spangs/ /dngos grub thams cad kyi ni gzhi/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rmad phyibyung che/ /gso sbyong gis min bzlas pas min/ /phreng bas ma yin 'gog pas min/ /grangs min dus min sbyin sreg min/ /'byin byed 'gogs 6)byed kyis ni min/ /ye shes chen po'i go 'phang zhi/ /rnal 'byor gcig pus rtogs par byed/ /mngon par shes pa (7lnga dang ni/ /de bzhin ye (nyeshes lnga yi mchog /thig le gsum ni rnam sgom pa/ /zhi sogs bya ba yang dag ni/ /rnal 'byor mchog gis 'grub par 'gyur / /stong nyid ye shes mtshan nyid ni/ /ye shes sems dpa' rdo rje 81—811

sems / /dam tshig sems dpa' zhes bya gsungs/ /gnas dang 6)grangs kyi dbye ba yis/ /bla ma brgyud (nyapa las shes bya/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba ris)mngon par rtogs pa las thig le gsum rnam par dbye ba'i le'u ste nyi shu ri41gcig pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang de nyid nyon/ /de nyid gsum gyi go 'phang mchog /sku gsung 95thugs kyi rdo rje yi/ /snying po bdag nyid dam tshig ni/ /yi ge gsum ni sku gsung thugs/ /snying po yang ni bshad par bya/ /de ni rnam phye (6)khyod nyon cig /de ni ji lta ba bzhin bshad/ /oṃ ni sku yi rdo rje yi(77/ /snying po ru ni yang dag bshad/ /yi ge a dang yi ge u/ /yi ge ma zhes bya ba gsum/ /āḥni chos 'khor pad+ma la/ /rlung gi 'khor lo la ni khyab/ /sgrib med pa yi tsho)rlung chen po / /srog tu gsungs pa thams cad bsdus/ /cha med cha dang bral ba dang / /dngos po dngos med dbus na gnas/ /thig le 'khor lo'i cha la khyab/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi yi ge mchog /sngags rnams kun gyi don gyi gnas/ /sngags rnams thams cad rab sad byed/ /sngags rnams kun gyi phan byed cing / /ngag gi 'khor lo rab sad byed/ /dngos su lan gsum gyi ni gzhi/ /'byung ba ⑨thams cad dbang du byed/ /zad 7med 'phel ba med pa'i gnas/ /byang chub sa bon bde ba che/ /gzugs med khams su yang dag bshad/ /'khor lo bzhi yi don bsdus pa'onyu1/ /u ni longs spyod 'khor lor gnas/ /me nyustedang nyi ma 'dra ba yi/ /mgrin pa'i mtha' nas spyi gtsug mtha'/ /khyab pa gzi brjid kyi ni lus/ /gzugs kyi khams zhes /༄bya bar shes/ /gnas ris bcu bdun 81—812

bdag nyid can/ /bde chen 'khor lo zhes byar bshad/ /yi ge ma ni thig le tsam / /gdong tshad mtha' yi 3sor bzhi tsam/ /dga' ba'i gtsug tor gnas na gnas/ /zla ba'i gzugs dang 'dra ba yi/ /bde ba chen po'i go 'phang zhi/ /rtsa ni kun la khyab pa po/ /mi phyed lus kyi go 'phang ni/ /'dod pa'i khams zhes bshad pa yin/ /bsdus na gnas ris nyi shu'o/ /de ltar rlung ni gnas gsum gyi/ /rtsa gsum gyi ni gnas su 'dus(5)/ /yi ge oṃ gyi brda (2)shes na/ /khams gsum rnam par sad par byed/ /rnam par snang mdzad 'gro ba'i gzugs//spro ba'i bdag nyid can gyi rgyu/ /rnam par rtog pa'i rlung gnyis ni/ /sna yi bu ga nas ni byung / /yang dag nyi ma zla ba gnyis/ /sbas pa nang nas rgyu bar byed//me ni 'bar ba rtse mo la/ /smin ma'i dbus su srog gi rlung / /de ltar gcig pu'ang gsum du bshad/ /gtan la phab ste 4/de nyid gsum/ /zhi ba khams gsum la khyab pa/ /skye ba'i sa bon rgyas pa'o/ /yi ge a ni ye shes mchog /gsung gi rdo rje snying po mchog /a ni gnyis dang yi ge haṃ/ /ring por byas te dbye ba gsum/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi don bsdus (5)pa/ /yi ge āḥni sngar bshad zin / /gnyis pa yang ni srog gi rlung / /stong nyid ye shes ming can te/ /srog dang rtsol ba gnyis su rigs/ /yul dang dbang po bsdus (nyupa'o/ /kun gzhi dang ni nyon mongs yid/ /gzung (7dang 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /ngo bo gcig tu gyur nas ni/ /gsung gi rdo rje brjod pa'i mchog /āḥni chos 'khor pad+ma las / /mgrin (8༄par yi ge āḥnyid 'gyur/ /srog cinyid dang ni thur sel dang / /yi ge ha yis kun nas ni/ /mgrin pa'i dbus na gnas pa bla bcings ma 7rta kha nas gsal bar brjod/ /ro 'bab pa yi khrung khrung ni/ /ro skyur 31pa zhes bya 81—813

bar gsungs/ /bkug nas rtag tu khyab par byed/ /gzugs kyi khams ni 'bar ba'o/ /ha dang de bzhin yi ge thig/ /de ni yi ge ma dang gsum/ /rkang pa nas ni mgo mtha'i bar/ /'khor lo bzhi yi don bsdus pa/ /ha ni thur sel ming can rlung / /bshang sgo du gsang ba'i dbus na gnas/ /yi ge u ③ni khyab byed rlung / /mgrin pa pad+ma'i (4༄dbus na gnas/ /yi ge ma ni srog rlung yin/ /dpral ba 2rlung gi 'khor lo la/ /de dag gcig gyur snying ga yinas/ /thugs kyi sa bon du ni brjod/ /mi bskyod snying po kha dog gnag(pe /gzugs med khams kyi ming can no/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yi/ /snying po gsum du rab tu bshad / /lag na rdo rjes thal sbyar nas/ /slar yang thams cad mkhyen la zhus/ /rdo rje gsum gyi sngags don dang / /gnas kyi dbye ba 'tshal lags na/ /'di rnams dbus na bdag po gang / /ji lta bu zhig gtso bos gsungs/ /gtso bo rdo rje 'chang ba che/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis slar gsungs pa/ /gsang ba'i mchog tu ⑧gsungs pa yi/ /sbas pa'i don ni khyod 'dri ba/ /rgyud rnams kun du ma gsungs pa/ /rab tu bshad kyis lamanyan par gyis/ /thugs kyi sa bon bdag po ste/ /kun gyi nang na rnam rtog med/ /gang phyir gtso bos gzhan rnams ni/ /sgrib dang de bzhin 'phrog pa dang / /rnam par rtog pa'i rlung gnyis ni/ /lus kun la ni khyab par byed/ /sna yi bu ga las ni rgyu/ /lus la rtag tu 'byung bar byed / /'gro ba drug gi 'khor lo'i lam/ /gang gi stobs kyis khyab par byed/ /gsum pa rnal 'byor pa yis rtogs/ /rnam rtog med par rmad bibyung che/ /rlung rnams thams cad 'gags pas na/ /skyes pa de nyid rtogs pa'o/ /rlung ni thams cad 'gog pa yang / /yang dag rigs par 31nga yis bshad/ /sprul rte81—814

pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus/ /rgyud 'di pad+ma gnyis su gsungs/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi brgyad 'dab gnyis/ /steng dang 'og tu kha bltas 1nas/ /slar yang kha sbyor tshul du gnas/ /srog dang thur sel rgyu bar (2)byed/ /de nyid rtog pa dang bcas pa/ /rlung gnyis su ni gsal bar gsungs/ /sku dang gsung gi snying po gnyis / /la la nā dang ra sa nā(mi/ /a ba dhū tī (samachog gi gnas/ /de gnyis dbus na (5)mchog gi mchog /rnam rtog med pa rlung gi rlung / /rtag tu rgyu zhing kun la khyab/ /rnam rtog gang thob rtag tu ni/ /las kun byed cing mkhas par 'gyur / /rlung gi rang bzhin bye brag ni/ /brgya dang brgyad las gang rgyal tsho67 ba/ /dus kun du ni 'phel bar rigs/ /rnal 'byor byis pas mi shes pa/ /skad cig gcig mngon rdzogs byang chub/ /de yis thob par rgyud 'dir gsungs/ /de ni gang tshe skad cig thob/ /de ni skad cig mchog tu gsungs/ /de yang ji ltar thob par byed/ /de la rigs pa ru ni brjod/ /thog mar rnal 'byor pa chen po/ /blo bzang gis ni zhi gnas bsgom/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i sbyor ba yis / /khro bo'i phyag rgya byas nas kyang / /dbang po yi ni sgo dgu la/ /thams cad du ni kun rdzob pa/ /hūm̐ bzlas pa ni mtshungs pa med/ /mchog tu rgyun mi 'chad par ni/ /zla ba gcig tu bzlas byas na/ /de rjes skad cig de la thob/ /gang phyir de ni bzlas byas na/ /snying ga'i pad+ma'ang (7steng bltas 'gro/ /de nas gsang ba'i pad+ma las/ /kha sbyor ba (8)ni de bas kyang / /rnam par rtog pa'i rlung gnyis ni/ /de las rnam par bcas nas 'gro'i/ /rnam rtog med pa'i rlung chen po/ /sku gsung rdo rje bcad mnas ni/ /rnam rtog med pa'i bde ba stera'ilha/ /sngags kyi de nyid kyis ni 'thob/ /a ba dhū tī'i nya༄rgyun la gnas/ /smin dbus 81—815

rlung ni bcad 1byas pa/ /de thob thob (2)byas (5)dga' ba ni/ /rgyun du 'chang zhing mi bzad 4pa/ /chags sogs bral zhing zhi ba dang / /rang rig bde ba chen po'o/ /'dir ni rgyu mtshan bshad par bya/ /sngags grub pa yi (5)rnal 'byor pas/ /'dar 56)dang rngul dang ba spu langs/ /rtag tu dga' ba'i bsam pa dang / /gdong (7)ni zangs mdog yid du 'ong / /kun gyis rdzun)mthong dang dga' ba dang / / grangs lhag 9༄chad pa la sogs dang / /'jig rten chos dang de bzhin gnas/ /rnal 'byor sngags kyi de nyid ni/ /gnod pa nyid du mi 'gyur ro/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba tsomangon par rtogs pa las sku gsum gyi snying po bshad pa'i le'u ste nyi shu gnyis pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad kyis nyu1nyon/ /de nyid gsum gyi tshig bstan bya/ /bdag nyid sngags sogs byed pa yis/ /ji lta ba bzhin rim pa rnams/ /bdag gi de nyid rnal 'byor mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid kyi rgyu/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin bdag /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gcig pu/ /kun mkhyen go 'phang mi gsal byed/ /rigs kyi dbye bas rab gsal 12byed/ /rigs ni lnga yi rnam pa gang / /de ni phung po'i mtshan nyid do/ /phra rags hu la sogs dbye ba yis/ /thogs bcas thogs med mtshan nyid dang / /'byung ba chen po bzhi yi mudangos/ /'di ni gzugs kyi phung por gsungs/ /der ni rnam snang ngo bo dang / /thams cad spro bar 12byed pa'i rgyu/ /bde dang sdug bsngal mchog tu zhi/ /grang dang dro ba mchog gi mchog /gang gis shin tu rig pa ni/ /de ni tshor ba'i phung por bshad/ /rin chen 'byung ldan nyid kyi mtshan//81wa 816

de bzhin gshegs pa'i spros bdag nyid/ /glang po bong bu ce 〉spyang dang / /rta dang ri dgas (thu/dang ni phag /pha dang ma dang pha yi spun/ /mdza' bo snag gi gnyen ge tshan sogs/ /gang gis yang dag shes pa ni/ /'du shes phung po'i mtshan nyid ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med/ /de ni spros pa kun nas gsal/ /'gro ba khyab napar yongs su shes/ /dge dang mi dge'i las 'bras bu/ /gzhan yang lung du ma bstan min/ /de yi 'du byed du ni bshadapa/ /don yod spro ba'i rang bzhin can/ /'khor ba dngos dang dngos med sogs/ /kun rtog 'byung ba'i bdag nyid can/ /rnam shes zhes tsho6)ni rnam par shes/ /mi bskyod spro ba'i bdag nyid can/ /de ltar phung po yongs shes na/ /lung dang rigs pa'i shes pa skye/ / dzi na dzika dang rat+na jika /ā ro lika dang pradz+nyā sgrika /badz+ra sgrika 975ces bya ba'i sngags/ /ci rigs par ni rim bzhin shes/ /spyan la sogs pa bzhi po gang / /de ni khams gsum yongs su brtagan /sra ba la sogs bzhir phye bas/ /sa yi khams su yongs su brtag9ri /gti mug dga' bar bemangon par brjod/ /de yi spyan du yongs su grags/ /zhu ba ci mchi khu ba sogs / /rdzas kyi bye brag yang dag bsten/ / chu yi 11khams su rnam par shes/ /mā ma tī yi nyugebadag nyid can/ /dro ba bza' btung smin pa dang / /gzi brjid 'phro ba nyid thams cad/ / me yi lha khams su shes par bya/ /gos dkar spro ba'i bdag nyid can/ /'byung ba rngub pa rab tu 'phel/ /rlung rnams kyi ni tshogs kyi mchog /brkyang ba dang ni bskum pa dang / /steng dang 'og tu byed pa dag /de ni rlung gi khams su shes/ /sgrol ma spro ba'i bdag nyid can/ /de ltar 'byung ba bzhi po yang / /rnal 'byor mchog nyid rnam par shes/ /mo har ti dwo ṣa k+ṇi 81—817

ra ti/ /rā ga ra ti badz+ra ra ti/ /de ltar rim pas sngags rnams ni/ /de dag mngon sum cho ga yis/ /gzugs la sogs pa yul gyi tshogs/ /lha mo'i gzugs kyi mtshan nyid du/ /rnal 'byor mchog gis rnam par shes/ /stong nyid gcig pu rgyu gcig pu/ /sngo ser sogs kyi dbye ba dang / /ring dang thung ba'i rnam pa yis/ /lha mo (1)de gzugs rdo rje ma/ /phyi rol gzung baba'i rang bzhin can / / 'khar rnga (rinasil snyan sbubs 0rol mo/ /de bzhin rnga snyan pi bang (5cidang ske/ /bstod dang smad sogs sgra dag ni/ /sgra yi rdo rje ma zhes bya/ /gzung (6)ba dang ni rang bzhin mchog /rnam par shes pa sad par byed/ /dri nga ba dang dri bzang 7dang / /sbyar ba'i dri yi mchog rnams ni/ /dri (8)rdo rje mar de 99)shes bya / /gzung tshaba'i rnam par 511cher dmar ba/ /ro drug mchog tu ldan pa ni/ /lan tshwa nyanaskyur la sogs dbye yis/ /rdo rje ro mar de shes bya/ /kun kyang gzung 512ba'i rnam pa'o/ /mig sogs dbang po la brten tshapa/ /rnam par shes pa'i tshogs brgyad ni/ /rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du/ /byang chub sems dpa' brgyad du shes/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bdag nyid che/ /mig gnyis sa yi 7snying por gsungs7/ /gzugs la sogs pa ci rigs par/ /rang gi ngo bo spro bar byed / /sgra yi rnam pa thams cad nas/ /bye brag so so ci rigs par/ /sgra yi rnam par shes pa ni/ /phyag na rdo rjer yang dag bshad/ /dri yi bye brag la spyod pal/ /so sor ji ltar rigs par 1 ni/ /sna yi rnam shes mtshan nyid ni snye/ /nam mkha'i snying po 17rnam par shes/ / ro yi tsho 7bye brag la spyod pa/ /dbye ba so so'i go rims 1bzhin/ / lce yi ri rnam shes mtshan nyid ni/ /'jig rten dbang phyug tu ni shes/ /reg bya'i bye brag la 2spyod pa/ /bye brag so so'i go rims ste81—818

bzhin / /reg bya'i rnam shes mtshan nyid ni/ /sgrib pa rnam par sel bar shes/ /yid kyi bye brag la spyod pa/ /dbye ba so so'i go rims 51)bzhin/ /yid kyi rnam shes zhes gsungs pa/ /'jam dpal zhes bya'i ming na can no/ /rgyus tsho pa kun la yang dag sbyor/ /dbye ba so so'i go rims ri4)bzhin/ /bag chags yul gyi bdag nyid can/ /byams pa ru ni rnam par shes/ /rtsa rnams so so'i mtshan nyid can/ /bde ba kun gyi gzhi yi 55rimachog /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin can / /'di ni kun du bzang por bshad/ /de ltar rnam shes tshogs brgyad mchog /yang dag de nyid bla na med/ /mig sogs dbang po'i rnam shes ni/ /gzugs sogs mthong ba'i rang bzhin no/ /rje ngar dpung pa brla (6)thal gong / /sgo gnyis dang ni thams cad kyiri ri/ /shes pa bcu yi tshon)mtshan nyid ni/ /khyab pa rnams su yongs su shes/ /gshin rje mthar byed shes mthar byed/ /pad+ma mthar byed bgegs mthar byed/ /'dod pa'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba/ /dbyig (9sngon dang ni stobs po che/ /gnod mdzes gtsug tor 'khor lo sgyurang/ /de ltar de rnams gnas dbye bas/ /ye shes gsum gyis yongs su gsal/ /ngo bo gcig tu gyur nas ni/ /yang dag de kho na nyid rten/ /gang gis de nyid cho ga bzhin / /bla ma brgyud pa las shes 51rtabya/ /sngags kyi de nyid rnal 'byor mchog /ye shes chen po legs rgyas pa/ /skye med zad 12med mi gsal dang / /'gyur ba med cing sgrib pa med/ /gnyis med 'jigs bral zhi ba dang / /bde ba chen po'i go 'phang mchog /sbrul dang btus dang mtha' med dang / /mgo med yongs su dbye ba yis/ /oṃ dang hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā'i mtha'/ /sbrul zhes bya ba mngon par brjod/ /rang ming yon tan dang ni gzugs/ /btus pa'i mtshan 81—819

nyid ming can no/ /oṃ la sogs pa zhabs med pa/ /mtha' med ces bya'i ming can no/ / swā yi 1mtha' can oṃ med pa/ /mgo med ces dzon ni bshad pa yin/ /thams cad yod la oṃ med pa/ /mgo med ces ni bshad pa yin/ /de ltar mtshan nyid shes nas ni/ /sngags kyi de nyid bla na med/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rjes 'brangs nas/ /'di yi rgya chen don shes bya/ /ye shes de nyid rnal 'byor mchog /gnyis pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ /dbang po thams ri cad mnyam par sbyor/ /dngos po thams cad gcig pu'i lus/ /ngag gi rnam rtog kun spangs pa / / snang ba 5thams cad rnam spangs pa phyi / /bdag byin brlab 97)pa'i rang bzhin can/ /kun la khyab pa rmad gedu byung / /rang rig pa yi rnal 'byor mchog /skad cig bzhi yi mtshan nyid ni/ /cha bral kun 'gro khyab pa dang / /rnal 'byor byis pas 9mi shes shing / /kun rdzob yongs su mi shes pa/ /don dam rang gi ngo bo ni/ /rdzogs pa'i rim 7pas dbye ba dang / /sngags kyi de nyid 11rab tu gsal/ /a ni de nyid mtha' thig ler/ /yang dag thim pa 12rnam par bsgom/ /thig le yi ge 12a la thim/ /a ni mtha' yi ha tsam la'o ha yang yi ge t+t+waṃ la'o/ /yi ge u ni haṃ la'o/ /yi ge haṃ yang oṃ sal thim/ /yi ge a ni thig le 15tsam/ /thig le yang ni sgra la thim/ /sgra yang sgra tsam la ni'o/ /sgra tsam mchog ni nam mkha' la'o/ /de yang 'od gsal ba la thim/ /'od gsal go 'phang gsal ba ni/ /shin tu rnam dag chos dbyings te/ /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mchog/ rab tu sad cing rab tu 'char/ /ngag gi spyod pa rnams dang bral/ /gnyis pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ /phung po lnga ni gcig pu'i gzhi / /'byung ba lnga ni yang dag bstenas/ /rnam shes brgyad kyi nyi tshogs dben 81—820

pa / / phyi yi 047yul drug bsdus pa ni/ /rlung bcus shes pa bcu bsdus pa/ /de ltar mtshan nyid kun bsdus pa'o/ /kun nas spro ba'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /gang gis bzhugs gnas srid pa gsum/ /dngos grub kun byed dpal dang ldan/ /skal ba bzang po kun 'phel ba/ /rdo rje de ni rdo rje sems/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed dbang phyug dang / /he ru ka dang dus 'khor lo/ /dang po'i nasangs rgyas thub pa che/ /kun du bzang po 'jam dpal dang / /sna tshogs spro ba'i bdag nyid can/ /sna tshogs yon tan tshogs kyi gzhi/ /kun nas spro ba'i rnal 'byor ni / /rnal 'byor chen po dri ma med/ /ye shes de nyid gsal ba ni/ /rtog pa med cing gnas pa med/ /chos dbyings 'pho ba zhes bshad do/ /bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i mtshan nyid dag4 /spa yi rtse mo 5brgyad stong 'dra/ /shin tu gsal zhing 'od gsal ba/ /lung dang rigs pa'i dbye ba yis/ /bla ma brgyud 6pa las ni shes/ /de ltar de nyid gsum de mchog /zhal tsho7)nas brgyud pa'i rim pa skye/ /gsang rinab yi ni ye shes mchog / bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid 9skad cig mchog /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba 1 mngon par rtogs pa las de kho na nyid gsum gyi dam tshig gtan la dbab pa'i le'u ste31/ nyi shu gsum pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad kyis 12nyon/ /sna rtse gsum gyi mtshan nyid ni/ /gsang ba snying ga 1rigadong sna'i ming / /gsum po rgyud las gsal ba ni/ /'khor lo gsum gyi dbye ba yis/ /rnal 'byor pa yis ri7bsgom pa'i rim/ /shin tu chags pa'i dbang song ba'i/ /sems kyi bde ba ster bar byed/ /rlung gi de 81—821

nyid sbyor ba yis/ / rtsa yi ri1'khor lo sad par byed/ /bde ba chen po kun nas skye na/ /khams gsum ro gcig gyur nas ni/ /dgug dbang cho ga bzhin du byam/ /byang chub sems ni bde ba che/ /lhan skyes skad cig mtshan nyid ni/ /rdo rje rtse mor gzung tsho bar bya/ /de nyid bde ba chen po ste/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin can/ /kun rtog thams cad rnam par spangs/ /gsang ba'i sna rtser rdzas rlo thig le/ /yang dag gzung 5)ba'i bdag nyid can/ /chags chen sems ni gcig pu yis/ /rnal 'byor mchog tu shes par bya/ /pad 'dab drug cu 6)rtsa bzhi la/ /rtsa yi 'khor lo rim bzhin 'char/ /de yi lte ba snar ni bshad/ /gsang ba 7ribade ba thams cad ster/ /snying ga'i pad+ma 'dab (she)ma brgyad/ /de yang lte ba snar ni brjod/ /zhe (9snang nyid kyi sems ni bsgom/ /gsang sngags 'bar ba'i ye shes sems/ /yang dag spro bobar byed pa'i rgyu/ /ngag gi rtog pa kun spangs pa/ /rmad 1lhabyung chen po ye shes mchog /rtag tu sngags ni nā da 'byung ske/ /rnam rtog med pa'i bde ba che/ /bsam gtan la sbyor bde ba'i mchog /man ngag thob pas bde ba rgyal/ /zhe sdang myur du dbang byas nasatso/ /zhi ba'i de nyid rgyu gcig ni/ /zla ba nyi ma me dang gsum/ /lam rtsonagasum gyi ni dbus nas khyab/ /gdong gi sna ni zhes byar bshad/ /rlung rnams gnas kyi mtshan nyid dang / /de la gnas pa'i ye shes che/ /thig le gti mug skogis gnon yisam/ /bsam gtan gti mug mchog las rgyal/ /dngos po thams cad rnam par spangs/ /ye shes lnga yi 7bdag nyid gsal/ /de kho na nyid lnga brten 1 mchog /de yi 'od zer thig le tsam/ /gdong gi sna rtser yang dag brten / /rnal 'byor mchog ni bsgom par bya/ /gti mug rgya mtsho las ni rgyal/ /81—822
