de nyid dam tshig sems dpa' yi/ /ming can du ni yang dag bshad/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig ni/ /ye shes lnga yi mtshan nyid can/ /rnal 'byor mkhas pa rnams kyis 0)ni/ /gti mug mun pa rnam (2)'joms pa/ /kun mkhyen rtogs pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi rigs gnas na/ /sna rtse bu ga las byung zhing ske/ /rlung lnga steng du yang dag rgyu/ / lus la rtag tu spyod par 'gyur/ /4kun rdzob snar 'a)ni rgyu ba yi/ /sgo de las ni rnam par byung / /g.yon dang g.yas dang gnyis ka (6)dang / /dal bar rgyu dang rnam pa bzhi/ /g.yas pa las ni 'byung ba'i khams/ /me yi dkyil 'khor nyid yin te/ /kha dog dmar po 97bzang po 'di/ /pad+ma mgon po rgyu ba'o/ /g.yon pa nas ni 'byung ba'i khams/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor dang 'dres pa/ /ljang 8ser dag tu snang ba ste/ / las kyi mgon po rgyu ba'o/ /gnyis ka las ni 'byung ba'i khams/ /gser gyi mdog tu snang ba ste/ /thoskedabang chen gyi ni dkyil 'khor nyid/ /rin chen mgon po rgyu ba'o / /dal zhing rgyu ba med pa'i khams/ /dag pa'i shel ltar snang ba ni/ /'di ni chu yi dkyil 'khor te/ /rdo rje mgon po rgyu ba'o/ /khams gsum las ni yang dag byung / /rten dang brten 7par bzung ba ni/ /rnam par snang mdzad rang bzhin te/ /'chi ba'i mthar ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi po de dag ni/ / rnam par bzhag nyu7pas rtag tu zlosanyusnye/ /sngags bzlas pa yi 1nagrangs kyis ni/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu zlos pa yin/ /de ltar rlung ni sna rtser ni/ /kha dog lnga par rnam par bsgom/ /gnyis med mchog gi rnal 'byor gyis/ /'od zer tshogs ni dri ma med/ /de yis zhi sogs bya ba ni/ /rim gyis sbyor bas 'grub par 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems 81—823

dpa' 'gro mgon la/ /de nas lag na rdo rjes zhus/ /thig le gsum gyi gzhung lugs ni/ /khyod zhabs bsnyen bkur (17gyis 'tshal na/ /'di la cung zad the tshom mchis/ /srid pa mthar mdzad gsal bar mdzad/ /rdzas dang sngags dang de bzhin rlung / /thig le gsum ni bsgoms pa na/ /rnal 'byor pa gcig 2nyid dam ni/ /yang na rnal 'byor so sor bsgom/ /de la the tshom kun gcod gtso/ /bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpas (sanagasungs/ /yun rings ri45chags chen dbang song bas/ /srid pa gsum du skyob pa rnams/ /de dag dgrol (na/ba'i don du ni/ /rdzas kyi thig le gsungs pa yin/ /zhe sdang chen po 6)dbang song ba//mi gang mi srun pa yi lus/ /de rnams myur du grol don du/ /sngags kyi thig ler gsungs pa yin/ /gti mug chen pos kun nas 'khrul/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho las skyob gang / /de dag dngos grub brgyad 'bras bu/ /thob phyir ye shes rgya mtsho ni/ /rlung gi thig ler gsungs pa yin/ /yang dag de nyid spros pa ni/ /de ltar yang dag thig le gsum/ /bsam pa ji bzhin sbyor ji bzhin/ /tshe 'di nyid la grub don du/ /sgrib pa thams cad dag pa'i phyir/ /rtse gcig pa yi sems kyis 97ni/ /ye shes gsum gnas nyams dga' ba/ /me tog 'bras bu chu yis brgyan(8/ /skye bos dben pa'i ri yi rtser/ /dngos grub thams cad bsdus pa ni/ /'bad pa yis ni bsgrub par bya/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba 9mngon par rtogs pa las sna'i rtse mo gsum gtan la phab pa'i le'u ste nyi shu 7bzhi pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad kyis 511nyon/ /stong nyid ye shes mtshan nyid ni/ /81—824

lus la gnas pa de nyid mchog /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /chos rnams (1)thams cad snang bar byed/ /mtshan nyid stong pa nyid du 'dod/ /de las ye shes bde ba che/ /'od gsal ba ni rnam dag pa/ /gang phyir a ba dhū tīr zhugs/ /yang dag stong pa nyid du 'dod/ /chos rnams rnam rtog snang ba mched 2rim/ / kun rtog thams cad gcod par byed/ /rnam rtog rlung gi ngal bso geb/ /de ni stong pa nyid du bshad/ /gtso bo chen po mi bskyod (5pa'i/ /'jig rten khams ni de nyid do/ /der ni rtag tu bzhugs pa'i sa/ /srog gi ye shes ming can te/ /gzugs med drag po chen po yi/ /zhi ba'i rang bzhin mtshan nyid can/ /de la ye shes bde ba che/ /byang chub sems kyis gang ba (yinyid / /de nyid bde chen go 'phang gnas/ /ye shes yang dag byang chub sems/ /de la sogs pa ming gi sgras/ /brjod bya gcig pu bde ba che/ /dngos po gcig dang ldan pa nyid/ /stong nyid ye shes zhes ni brjod/ /bde ba can zhes de la bshadagel/ /bde ba dge ba'i thob mtshan nyid/ /gang de bde bar gnas pa ni/ /de ni bde ba can zhes brjod/ /tshe dpag med pa'i zhing khams na/ /bde ba kun gyi gzhi yi du ramachog /byang chub sems ni tshe dpag med/ /de las byung zhing (7skye ba'i 'od/ /de phyir 'od dpag med du shes/ /bde ba kun gyi gzhi yi mchog /stong nyid rdo rje dbyings dbang phyug / ye shes rdo rje'i dbang phyug dang ske/ /7de nyid mnyam par sbyor ba ni/ /stong nyid ye shes zhes ni brjod/ /shes rab pad+ma la la nā/ /zla mtshan nyi ma 'bab pa na/ /de yang stong par rnam par shes/ /gnyis pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ /thabs kyi rdo rje ra sa nā/ /zla ba shu kra 31rab tu 'bab/ /de ni ye shes mchog tu gsungs/ /bde ba chen 81—825

po'i go 'phang mchog /de gnyis sbyor ba mchog tu shes/ /stong nyid ye shes mi zad pa/ /zla ba nya dang de nyid yin/ /rnal 'byor ma yi 3)zhal las shes/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba (kyemangon par rtogs pa las stong pa nyid kyi tshig bshad pa'i le'u ste/ nyi shu lnga pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad kyis co)nyon/ /lus ni stong pa nyid kyi gnas/ /lus ni gang gis shes pa ni/ /lha rnams kun gyi pho brang mchog /longs spyod chos dang sprul pa dang / /bde ba chen po yi ni rten/ /'khor lo yang ni gang bshad pa/ /rim pa ji bzhin ma lus pa/ /de ltar rtag tu yang dag bzhugs/ /thim dang longs spyod bdag po ni/ /lha nyid mchog tu gnyis su med/ /yang dag ngo bo'i go 'phang rten/ /ye shes chen po'i go 'phang phyir/ /bde ba chen po'i yang dag rten/ /zhe snang che dang gti mug che/ /phrag dog che dang chags dngos kyis/ /khro bo che dang rnam pa'i mchog /'khor ba'i mdud pa nges gcod pa / /sa dang chu dang de bzhin me/ /rlung dang nam mkha'i dbye ba yis/ /gzugs dang sgra dang de bzhin dri/ /ro dang reg bya nyid medang ni/ /chos kyi dbyings dang mig bzangs du dang / /rna ba sna dang lce dang ni/ /lus kyi rnam shes chos dang ni/ /kun gzhi nyon mongs can gyi yid/ /dad dang brtson 'grus dran ting 'dzin/ /shes rab dbang po'i dbye ba yis/ /dad stobs brtson 'grus stobs dang ni/ /dran pa'i stobs dang ting 'dzin stobs/ /shes rab stobs ni bla na med/ /ji bzhin gnas su yang dag shes/ /lus kyi lha ru gsal ba yin/ /sngon bzhin ming gi dbye ba yis(6༄/ /sngags kyi dbye bas 7rim 81—826

pa dang / /sngags dgod (1pa yi rnal 'byor gyis55)/ /rim bzhin gnas kyi dbye ba yis/ /lung gis du rnam par nges byas pa'i/ /yang dag gnas kyi dbye ba dang ske/ /lha mo rtag tu rnal 'byor pas/ /bdag la byin rlabs 94dgo 'phang gnas / /'dod pa lnga la longs spyod cing / /rab tu 'bad de (zhenamachod pa bya0/ /rdo shing sa yi rang bzhin gyi/ /phyi rol lha la phyag mi bya/ /bdag la byin rlabs ri7)rim de nyid/ /gzhan du srid pa gsum na med/ /de kho na nyid rnal 'byor mchog /bdag la byin rlabs (0sgrib med pa/ /sngags dang phyag rgya'i rim pa sogs / /phyi yi dngos po mi bgrang (7ste/ /de nyid thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /rnal 'byor ma la mchog tu ni/ /'bad pas byin gyis brlab par 'dod/ /bdag byin rlob thabs mtshan nyid do/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba ⑩mngon par rtogs pa las lus kyi lha ye shes kyi mtshan nyid kyi le'u ste nyi shu drug pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang lha mo yi/ /de rnams kyi ni ming bshad bya/ /'khor lo bzhi yi dbye ba yis/ /rtsa yi rim pa'i grangs kyis ni/ /las dang rdo rje pad+ma 37dang ske/ /'khor lo la sogs rigs dbye bas/ /rim pa bzhi yi dbye ba yis/ /rtsa yi rim pas yang dag bzhugs/ /'dir ni rigs ni lnga par yang / /de kho na nyid nyams myong mchog /tshor ba nyams/ su myong ba yi/ /thams cad la ni khyab par gnas/ /sprul pa rang gi rigs las skyes/ /lha mo 'di dag yang dag zhugs / /mkhyen nyugem gtum mo dpa' mo ma/ /las sgrol ma nyusnyedang yid gcugs tsom / /'khrul 'khor ma dang 'bud ma dang / / de bzhin rlung rgyu ma dang ni/ /bla81—827

snying stobs yang dag sangs rgyas ma/ /rab dang ma dang yid 'ong ma/ /grub ma sprul 'tsho sgra ma dang / /gter 'dzin lha yi 3)dbang phyug ma/ / ge sar rdzu pad+ma dri med ma/ /rlung gi lu gu da/rgyud byed ma/ /bzang mo dang ni khu yi (4cigadong / /gnyid log ma dang mi 'phel ma/ /'phar risnyem sngo bsangs 96༄dus mtshan ma/ /rtse 'jo 7ma dang skal bzang 'phel/ /na ra dza tshonasan khyi gdong ma/ /chags ma dga' ma rnam sgeg ma/ /brtson 'grus 'phel dang 99skadakar mo dang / /bdud rtsi lnga ni 'phel ba ma/ /dngos 'bebs shin tu dpa' mo dang / /pad+ma rnga bodang 'dod ma dang / /sgyu ma yid 'ong mdza' mo dang / /skyur dang chang gi dbang phyug ma/ /mi bzad 37che dang las skal 1 bzang / /me tog bzang mo gdug lha rmongs ma/ /steng gzigs zhal dang rtse gsum mtshan/ /mdzes ma dang ni ljags bskyod chosam/ /rtag bam ma dang gar ma dang / /ri dgas mamig dang chags dga' ma/ /sna tshogs rmongs par 7rol pa mo/ /dkar mo 'jig rten gsum pa mo / /ro blan dri med 'gro bstun nya ma/ /ral ga nyusnyernams ni yang dag bzhugs/ /rtag tu brgyad dang brgyad spel grangs16/ /zhal gsum phyag drug dri ma med/ /rigs kyi phyag rgya dbye ba yis/ /mtshon cha rnams kyis rin )yang dag brgyan ma/ /de dag sna tshogs rdo rje g.yas/ /g.yon pa 'gying bas ut+pa la/ /g.yas na 'khor lo rin chen dang / /de bzhin ral gri chos 'byung ni/ /g.yon gyi phyag gnyis la ni 'gyur/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung gis dgelegs bzhugs/ /zhal ni ljang khu ni spyan gsum pa/ /don yod grub pa'i cod pan can/ /zhal rnams bzhad 2stepar bsgom pa dang / /bde ba thams cad 'phel bar byed/ /rang gi ming gi dbye ba yis / /yi ge gsum dang rnam par spel/ /sngags kyis kyang geni yang dag 81—828

mchodal/ /'dod pa'i de nyid rab stsol mdzad/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rtsibs 1brgyad dbus/ /lha 'di dag ni yang dag bzhugs/ /rdor dbyings dbang phyug lā ma dang / /rdo rje phyag rgya stobs chen mo/ /rdo rje sgeg mo rdo rje gdong / /rdo rje chos ma rdo rje bzang / /rdo rje rol mor shes par bya/ /chos kyi 'khor lor dgu bdag nyid/ /zhal gsum phyag drug rnam pa dang / /sems dpa'i skyil krung gegis legs bzhugs/ /rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen dang / /g.yas pa yi ni phyag na 'dzin/ /g.yon na ral gri pad+ma dang / /dril bu 'dzin pa bla na med/ /sku mdog sngon po spyan gsum pa/ /zhal gyi mche dab cung zad gtsigs/ /rang ming yi ge gsum dang spel/ /sngags kyis tsho4)de dag rab tu mchod/ /longs spyod 'dab 5)ma bcu drug la/ /pad+ma'i dbus na lha rnams bzhugasatsho no/ /pad+ma'i sgrol ma pad dkar mo/ /pad+ma ku mu da 7ci'aphel ma/ /pad+ma'i spyan dang pad gtsug phud rka/ /pad+ma'i phreng ba 9pad skyes ma/ /pad gdan pad+ma'i dra ba ma/ /de bzhin pad+ma'i 'od dang ni/ /pad+ma'i spyan dang pad bzangs 0ma/ /pad+ma'i nang bzhugs pad skyes ma/ /pad+ma'i ge sar pad+ma ma/ /de ltar 'di ni yang dag bshad / /zhal gsum phyag drug rnam pa can/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung 1lhagis legs bzhugs/ /g.yas na 32pad+ma 'khor lo dang / /rdo rje yang ni 'debs 1lhapar mdzad/ /g.yon na ral gri dril bu dang / /rin po che yis rārnam par sgega'i /spyan gsum rnam par 'char ba dang / /pad+ma dmar po'i mdog ltar dmar / /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nyer bzhugs 7shing / /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung 3 tshogis bzhugs/ /rang ming yi ge gsum dang bcas/ /'di rnams sngags ni bla na med/ /bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo che/ /pad 'dab 18sum cu rtsa 81wa 829

gnyis la/ /rtag tu lha mo rnams ni bzhugs/ /rab tu sad pa 'bad pa can/ /'khor lo'i shugs ma rdo rje ldan/ /rin chen sgrol ma pad zhugs ma/ /sna tshogs las ma gti mug dga'/ /zhe snang rdo rje dga' chags ma/ /rdo rje las chags gzugs rdo rje/ /sgra yi rdo rje ro rdo rje/ /reg bya rdo rje chos dbyings ma/ /spyan 'od ma dang thod dbyangs ma/ /sna yi snang ba ro dga' ma/ /sku yi rgyal mtshan yid dga' ma/ /khams bcas ma dang rgyu 'bab ma/ /gshin rje 'joms hu)pa'i blo yi ni/ /bye brag rnam par rgyas ma dang / /pad+ma'i ral pa gyen du brdzes②/ /bgegs rnams thams cad 'joms (7pa mo/ /sbas pa'i mthil dang dbyug sngon ma / /shin tu brtan 4)ma stobs chen ma/ /rang byung ma dang 'khor lo'i gtsug /de ltar rtsa yi dbus nas shar/ /slar yang lha mo zhal gsum dang / /phyag drug bde ba 'phel ba can/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la yang bzhugs(5)/ /dri med pad+ma dkar mo'i mdog /zhi ba zhal gsum spyan gsum pa/ /g.yas pa'i phyag na bsnams pa ni/ /'khor lo lcags kyu rdo rje rim/ /de bzhin g.yon pa'i phyag gsum la/ /pad+ma zhags pa rin po che/ /'char yidang 'debs dang sgeg par mdzad / /pad+ma dkar po 'dra ba'i 'od/ /spyi bor rnam par snang mdzad 'chang / /rang gi ming dang yig gsum ming / /'di dag sngags ni go rims (pebazhin/ /de nyid mchog ni rab tu gsal/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sdom pa ni/ /de lta bu yi sdom pa mchog /lha mo rnams kyi de nyid mchog /rtag tu gnyid log lus la gnas / /'dod pa lnga yi longs spyod bstenaris/ /mchod pa nyid kyis spuyang dag mnyes / /rdo rje pad+ma'i bde bas mamyos/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang mchog /mnyes nas slar yang gso bar byed/ /de yi zhi sogs bya ba rnams/ /'grub 81—830

'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /bsam gtan rnal 'byor sogs spyod dang / /sngags dbyibs la sogs bya ba ni/ /dgos med mchog tu cung zad ni/ /bla ma'i lung las yang dag skyes/ /de phyir rdo rje slob dpon ni/ /'bad pas dngos grub kyis mnyes bya/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba klamangon par rtogs pa las 'khor lo bzhi'i lha mo bzhi rim pa rnam par phye ba'i le'u ste nyi shu bdun pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /'char dang nub pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /rtsa rnams kyis ni rnal 'byor mchog /dngos grub thams cad kyi ni gnas/ /mdun gnas pa yi 9geyul rnams las/ /yid la byed pas der mi 'gro/ /sngon gyi bag chags nang gnas pa/ /de tshe dbang po rab tu gsal/ /de yis de ni ( rab tu sad/ /de rnams rtsa la rim bzhin gnas/ /rab sad de yis sad byas nas / /lha mo rang yang 'khor lo las/ /de yis 'char ba'i rim par gsungs/ /nub pa yang ni bshad par bya/ /yul rnams kyang ni dngos bral med/ /yid la byed nas gzhan du gnas/ /bag chags kyang ni sad mi sad/ /rtsa rnams 'char bar mi 'gyur zhing / /lha rnams yang dag sad par ni/ / de yi 90phyir ni mi 'gyur te/ /snying gi dbus nas 5bde ba'i dngos/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma gsal ba'i 'od/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa'i gzugs kyis kyang / /de ni 'od zer bcu gnyis te/ /'od 'phel 'od zer gzi brjid ma/ /gsal ba 'bar ma 6)'od 'bar ma/ /mig la sogs pa la brten nas/ /phyi rol gzugs sogs 'dzin pa'o/ /mun sel 'od ma snang ba mo/ /gsal mdzes gsal 'od nyi ma 81—831

gsal / /phyi rol gzugs sogs rnam pa'o/ /drug po 'di dag 'og tu 'dod/ /lha mo rnams ni gang 'char ba'ang rke/ /ye shes nyi ma 'char ba yin/ /de yang yang dag nub pa ni/ /de yang mchog tu nub pa'o/ /'char ba nub pa rnams chad 2pa / /go 'phang mchog tu shes par bya/ /rnal 'byor chen po legs par sad/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma sdom pa'o/ /'di ni rnal 'byor de nyid mchog /'char dang nub pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i rjes 'brangs nas( be/ /bla ma brgyud 4pa las shes bya/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba 55)mngon par rtogs pa las 'char ba 96skudang nub pa'i le'u ste nyi shu brgyad pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad kyis ri nyon/ /dga' ba skyes tshonasapa'i mtshan nyid ni//gang gis yang dag shes pa yis/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i 9)go 'phang mchog /de ni rtsa yi 'khor lo la/ /slar yang rgyas dang bsdus pa yisayo/ /'khor lo bzhi yi yang 17dag sbyor/ /rtsa rnams brgyad dang gnyis lhag pa/ /mtshams kyi rtsa yi rim pa yang / /rtsa ni bcu drug la yang brten/ /bzhi dang bzhi yis pho rtag tu khyab/ /de rnams dga' ba'i rim pa'o/ /chu khams khong du chud pa can/ /pad+ma'i snal 1 ma lta bu yi/ / /de nas (7de yis khyab byas 7shing / /bde ba chen po phan par byed / /'khor lo so so'i dbye ba yis/ /cha bzhi pa yi nyu yi ge ha/ /shin tu phra ba'i cha dag 18tu/ /khyab pa brten 519gyi tshul du gnas/ /rim pa bzhi yi dbye ba las / /rim pa bcu drug dbye bas 'thob/ /phreng ri riba'i bdag nyid rmad 3)byung ba'o / /ro gcig pa yi 22go 'phang 'thob/ /rim gyis so sor nyams myong las/ /sna tshogs chu yi sbyor ba las/ / rim gyis 22rgya mtsho chu bzhin du/ /sbyor ba bzhi 81—832

— —wa ——————wa wa —wa wa — —————————————————— — ——— — ———— — — —— —yi 1'khor lo'i dus/ /dga' ba bzhi ni de la brjod/ /rnal 'byor ma rgyud spyod pa las/ /go 'phang mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i /sdo ༵༵༵ rdo rdo zlodi ༵ /pangon par rtogs pa las dga' ba bskyed 3pa'i mtshan de nas gzhan yang yang dag nyon/ /rdo rje brtan 4pa'i lus kyis ni/ /rtag tu rtsa rnams kyi ni rgyun/ /de kho na nyid ngas bshad bya/ /stong phrag nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni/ /rtsa ni rtag tu rmad 5byung ba/ /byang chub sems ni 'bab par shes/ /bde ba thams cad rab tu 'phel/ /rtag tu rmad du byung ba'i tshom/ /stong phrag nyi shu rtsa bzhi 7ni/ /khrag 'bab par ni shes par bya/ /nyi ma 'pho ba'i bdag nyid can/ /rtag tu rmad nadu byung ba'i rtsa/ /stong phrag nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni/ /rlung rgyu bar ni shes par bya/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i rgyud las ni/ /lus kyi gnas ni dbye ba yis/ /de nyid nyi shu rtsa bzhir brjod/ /thim dang longs spyod bdag po nyid / /grangs ni bdun cu rtsa gnyis brjod/ /re re'ang 'khor lo stong stong ngo ske/ /thim pa longs spyod bdag 'dod pa / /gtso bo yang ni bsdus pa las /gnas rnams kyi ni grangs su 'gyur/ /slar yang bsdus nas 'gro ba na1 / /gsum po brgyad brgyad dbye ba'ang ni/ /nyin dang mtshan mo'i dbye ba dang / /thun tshod skad cig sbyor ba yis/ /rtsa rnams gong nas gong du ni/ /nang du 'gro bar shes par bya/ /g.yon pa byang chub zla ba 'bab/ /g.yas pa khrag dang nyi ma 'bab / /dbus ni ’ rlung rgyu ba yis ni/ /mi 1 sad byed par shes par bya/ /la la nā dang ra sa nā/ /a ba dhū tī 1 zhes bya'i ming / /de rnams spro ba'i sbyor 81wa 833

ba yis/ /re re'i rim gyis thun brgyad brgyad/ /gsum po nyi shu rtsa bzhi ①'grol/ /thim dang longs spyod bdag po'i phyir/ /rim gyis grangs ni bdun cu gnyis/ /slar yang de spro sbyor ba yis/ /re re'ang stong stong dbye ba yis/ /rtag tu grangs nyid 'gyur ba ni(mi/ /stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis so/ /gtso bo gsum po dubaslar yang ni/ /sbyor bas ④gcig pa nyid du 'gro/ /dang po las ni rnal 'byor pas/ /phra ba de ni shes par dka'/ /bsam gyis mi khyab mchog tu ni/ /thig le nā tshan)da rnam par spangs/ /bde ba kun gyi gzhi gsang ba/ /srog gi rten gyi mtshan nyid dang / /rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug dang / /dus kyi rtsa ni rnam par bshad/ /ro gcig go 'phang bdag nyid can/ /rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud las shes/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba ⑥mngon par rtogs pa las rtsa (pe'abab pa'i mtshan nyid kyi go cha zhes bya ba'i le'u ste sum cu pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad kyis (shenyon/ /mtshams kyi rtsa yi ngo bo nyid/ /rtsa rnams sdom pa 'char klu)ba ni/ /gang gis shes na rtag tu ni/ /mchog tu dga' ba nyams myong ba/ /lha yi ye shes gsal bar byed/ /lha yi sngags su yang dag sbyor / /lha yi rnal 'byor don nges pa/ /de nyid gsum sbyor dri ma med/ /de gsum cig char 7bdag nyid sdom/ /'jig rten gsum du khyab cing phra/ /lus kun la ni yang dag brten/ /ye shes sems dpa' rdo rje sems/ /gang phyir dam tshig sems dpa' bde/ /rnal 'byor mchog tu shes par bya/ /khyab pa'i de nyid rmad 3)byung ba/ /mchog rab mchog dang phra ba dang / /rang byung ye shes 81wa 834

mi zad pa/ /byang sems sum cu rtsa gnyis 'bab/ /rtsa ni thams cad mchog tu rgyas/ /bde ba chen po'i 'khor lor gnas/ /cha kun bdag nyid rtsa ba ni/ /de yi dbus su rtsa gsum ste/ /gtso bo yang ni yang dag bshad/ /zla ba nyi ma me (1tshorgyu ba/ /'byung ba thams cad la ni khyab/ /ji ltar shing rtsa cung zad cig /sa la brtan du par gnas pa na/ /sdong bu yal ga 'dab phre'u / /sogs pa yis ni kun nas khyab/ /de bzhin skyes bu mgor ldan pas/ /phung po khams la sogs tshogs la/ /mchog tu kun nas khyab pa'o/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum dngos/ /de kho na nyid gsum sdom pa/ /'dod chags zhe snang gti mug dang ske/ /rang bzhin mtshan nyid dbye ba gsum/ /mtshan mo nyin mo mtshams kyis kyang / /dam tshig mtshan nyid rnam pa gsum/ /sangs rgyas dam chos dge 'dun ni/ /gsum phye dam tshig mtshan nyid dang / /stong nyid ye shes rdo rje ni/ /rnam gsum de nyid mtshan nyid do/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu nye 'khor ni/ /rnal 'byor gsum gyi mtshan nyid do/ /rlung dang bad kun mkhris pa (geni/ /gsum phye khams ni ⑤bsdus pa'o/ /'dod khams gzugs khams gzugs med khams/ /'jig rten gsum po'i ⑥mtshan nyid do/ /rtsa ba gsum dang 'bras bu gcig /rim bzhin gyur nas chos 'khor 'gro/ /de ni sprul pa gsum du gsal/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin gyis/ /gang tshe de la de ༅sbyor ba/ /de ni gzas (8)zin mtshan nyid do/ /gang tshe cung zad sbyor ba na/ /de tshe phyed 'dzin mtshan nyid do/ /gang phyir srog gi 6)rlung bcom na/ /de tshe 'chi ba'i mtshan nyid yin / /rtsa yi gtso bo'ang 7nyid rnams ni/ /gsum po nges pa zhes ni bya/ /rgyas par rnal 'byor ma rgyud las/ /rnal 'byor pa yis gsal por shes/ /81—835

rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba 1mngon par rtogs pa las mtshams kyi rtsa gsum gyi nges pa'i le'u ste sum cu gcig pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad kyis 2nyon/ /rlung skye ba yi mtshan nyid ni/ /dus kyi glags ni btsal ba na/ /ji ltar dngos su yang dag shes/ /bag chags nyon mongs can gyi yid/ /rang gi ngo bo gzugs gzhan mthong / /don ni shes par mi shes shing / /rlung tsam gcig pus rmongs pa'o/ /kun gzhi rnam shes bkug nas ni/ /bag chags nang du rnam par spyod / /bag chags kyis ni rnam shes bzung / /bag chags dang 'dres rim pa las/ /nang gi bag chags bsgos pa yis/ /de rnams zla mtshan dus su ni/ /mngal gyi rtsa la 'jug pa na tso/ /rdo rje khu khrag zhu thig le/ /'dres pa ru ni gyur pa dang / /kun gzhi las ni rnam shes skye/ /ji ltar chang ros myos pa bzhin/ /kun gzhi rnam shes bag chags las/ /rnam par shes pa'i rgyun ni skye/ /nyon mongs can nyid )srog rlung nyid/ /skad cig gcig la yang dag 'gro/ /thog mar 'pho ba'i dus su ni//nya yi rnam pa lta bur 'gyur/ /'pho ba gnyis pa'i dus su ni/ /slar yang khrag dang 'dres pa ni/ /steng dang 'og gi dbye ba yis/ /srog gi rlung ni gnyis su 'grol/ /thur 8sel rlung gi 'gro 'ong la/ /rus 7sbal rnam par 'dzin par 'gyur / /de nas 'pho ba gsum pa la/ /khrag dang khu ba zos pa na/ /thur 7du sel ba'i rlung gi tshogs/ / bskams nas kun du rlung ni 11'byung / /steng du kha bltas nas ni gnas/ /phag rgod 'dra ba'i lus 'chang 'gyur/ /slar yang 'pho ba bzhi pa la/ /khrag dang khu ba bsgos pa ni/ /gyen du rgyu ba'i rlung bkug nas/ /81—836

'o turte shārtseltag nashārke megro ——— seng ge'irnamapa yis bye ———/————————snyeb —tsha rlung ni spro bar byed/ /de nas 'pho ba lnga pa la/ /khrag dang khu ba 'phel nas ni//mnyam gnas rlung ni 'dar nas ni/ /me yi gzugs red rim bzhin 'gro/ /mnyam gnas rlung gis khyab byed spro/ /gang gis 'gul dang 'dar bar 'gyur/ /phung po lnga ni rdzogs pa na / /de ltar gsungs pa de las slar/ /'pho ba drug pa'i dus tshod la/ / sa yi /khams dang mig gnyis dang / /khyab byed rlung gis klu rlung spro/ /rlung gi dngos po ca'aphel bar byed/ /de nas 'pho ba bdun pa la//chu yi khams dang sna bug 5dod/ /klu yi rlung gis rus casbal rlung / /spros nas gnyis su med par sprod/ /de nas 'pho ba brgyad pa la/ /me dang sna yi bu ga 'byung ske/ /rus 7sbal rlung gis /rtsangs rlung spro/ /rang gi rang bzhin shes par byed / /de nas 'pho ba dgu pa la/ /rlung gi khams dang ro ni tshor/ /rtsangs pa zhes bya'i rlung chen pos/ /lha sbyin rlung ni spro bar byed/ /de rjes 'pho ba bcu pa la/ /lha sbyin rlung gis 9gzhu rgyal spro/ /rlung kun bsdus pa'i mtshan nyid can / /dgu pa'i dbus na khyab pa'i khams/ /phra zhing thogs med mtshan nyid can / /rtsa dang rgyu 7ma rgyus pa'i sbubs/ /sgo ni dgu po rgyas par byed/ /lus kyi mchog tu tshor ba dang / /gcig tu 11reg pa'i mtshan nyid 'dzin/ /rab sad mchog ni 12nam mkha' la/ /'od gsal bzang po yang dag gnas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi shes pa bcu/ /de lta bu nyid bshad par bya/ /'pho ba bcu ni sa bcu ste/ /rim pa yi dani rnam par shes/ /ma ni shes rab pha rol phyin/ /bha ga phyag rgya chen por brjod/ /byis pa yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /thams cad mkhyen cing thams cad gzigs/ /mgo bo'i skra ni bregs pa dang / /phru 81wa 837

ma'i chos gos dmar po bgos/ /dpal dang ldan pa thal mo sbyar/ /spyi bo sa la gtugs pa phyag /mtshan ni sum cu rtsa gnyis 'chang / /dpe ①byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan95)/ /ye shes chen po legs par sad/ /'du byed thob pa grol dang bcas/ /dpa' ( )bo chen po rnam rtog med/ /skyed byabyed sha ni 'jig (snyepar byed/ /bdud rtsi lnga ni ye shes che/ /rtag tu bdud rtsi lnga myong (nyabyed/ /dngos po thams cad rnam spangs pa⑦/ /rnal 'byor seng ge bzhin du spyod/ /'di gnyis (shemachog ni gsang ba ste/ /gang du yang ni ma gsungs so/ /rlung skyes pa yi nges pa ni/ /bla ma brgyud pa las shes bya/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba ⑨mngon par rtogs pa las rlung gis bskyed pa skyes bu skye ba 'jug pa'i le'u ste sum cu biganyis pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /rlung rnams mchog tu nub pa ni/ /gang gis yang dag shes pa yis/ /'chi ba'i skad cig mtshan nyid ni/ /phan tshun du ni yang dag sadanyan/ /skye ba'i rim ltar thim par 'gyur/ /rlung rnams yang dag skye ba ni/ /phan tshun nub pa'i nyi ma bzhin/ /thog mar lo bcu lon nas ni/ /rgyags pas 8myos pa'i rlung skyes na / /gzhu las rgyal ba'i rlung zos te/ /rim gyis sgra gcan zla ba bzhin/ /de rjes lo bcu phyin pa ni/ /rgyags chu rlung gis yang dag skye/ /lha sbyin zhes bya'i rlung ni za/ /rlung gi rim pa snga ma bzhin/ /gzhan yang lo bcu phyin pa nam/ /rgyags pa'i chu rlung skye bar 8'gyur/ /rtsangs pa zhes bya'i rlung ni za/ /de nas gzhan yang lo bcu phyin/ /lo las skyes pa'i rim pa yis/ / btang bzung ⑩rlung ni chen po yis/ /rus 0sbal rlung ni za 81—838

bar byed/ /klu yi rlung dang btang bzung 6)rlung / /stobs dang gzi brjid mtshungs pa'i phyir/ /dus gzhan lo bcur phyin pa na/ / gnod par (5)byed par mi nus te/ /stobs dang nus pa mtshungs pa'i phyir/ /gang gis gang la dunaganod pa ni/ /byed pa nyid du mi nus so/ /bcu de ④gzhan du phyin pa'o/ /long ba btang bzung stistobs chen thob/ /klu yi rlung yini rim gyis za97)/ /de nas bcu pa gzhan phyin na/ /khrag dang sha ni rnam par 'phel/ /rgyags shing myos pa'i rim pa yis/ /btang bzung (8)rlung ni za bar byed/ /de rjes lo bcu lon pa na/ /myos chu rlung ni bkug nas ni/ /tshil dang kha chu rnam par 'phel/ /de yi btang bzung (1)klu za byed/ /de nas bcu pa gzhan phyin pa'ibo/ /lo la btang bzung ⑩rlung stobs skyes/ /myos pa'i dus rlung za bar byed/ /me dang rlung ni 'phel bar byed/ / btang bzung rtso rlung nyid rnam gyur nas/ /longs spyod chen po 'phel gyur nas/ /de nas lo bcu gzhan lon nas/ /rlung gis lus rgyas lci bar 'gyur/ /chu dang rlung ni 'dres pa naphonye/ /khyab cing sgrib byas 0rim pa las/ /de las lo bcu gzhan du phyin/ /chu shing 8'bras bu bzhin du med/ /rtsa ba dang bcas med par 'gyur/ /las kyi rnam smin mtha' yis ni//de ltar rim pa bcu pa yis/ /zla ba 'am ni nyin zhag tshigazhan/ /tshe ni nyung ngur byas nas ni/ /srog zad par ni shes par bya/ /mkha' 'gro sdud pa'i rgyud las ni / /shin tu rgyas par shes par bya/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba ⑩mngon par rtogs pa las rlung gi rim pas srog zad pa rgyas par bshad pa'i le'u ste sum cu gsum pa'o// //81—839

de nas gzhan yang bshad kyis 1nyon/ / mtshan nyid 2chen po ye shes mchog /bsdu ba'i mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor mchog /snying pos snying po'i don bsdus pa/ /gang phyir mkha' 'gro mas bsdus pa/ /de phyir bsdus 4pa'i mkha' 'gro brjod/ /lte ba'i dbus na rtag bzhugs pa/ /nyi ma stong dang mtshungs pa'i 'od/ / ye shes chen po'i me 'byung ba/ /5kun rtog thams cad 'joms 6par byed/ /'char 7bas phung po 8rnam rtog ni/ /bsregs byas bar chad med pa'i lus/ /rdo rje khams kyi rnam rtog ni/ /bsdus nas slar yang rang bzhin gyis/ /gzung 9dang 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog ni/ /snying 7rjes der 1 ni slar yang sdud/ /de ltar gang la phye leb bzhin/ /'ching ba thams cad sreg par byed/ /rlung gi k+ṇi de nyid mngon sbyor bas/ /sngags kyi lus kyi sbyor ba yis/ /rnam par rtog pa tsam yang 15ni/ /sreg —pa nyid du the tshom med/ /mkha' 'gro sdud 15pa'i rgyud las nis / /rnal 'byor mchog gi rim shes na/ /mkha' 'gro ye shes rgyas par ni/ /rnal 'byor bsten pas 1 rig par bya/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud 1 dpal rdo rje phreng ba 19mngon par rtogs pa las mkha' 'gro ma sdud 0pa'i le'u ste sum cu bzhi pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad kyis 2 nyon/ /rnam rtog rlung ni rnam par gcod/ /nyin dang mtshan du da shes par ni/ /brgya ridang brgyad ni lhag par rgyu/ /rlung rnams de ni rnam rtog ni/ /gang phyir rnam par gcod par 2 byed/ /rnal 'byor de ni mchog tu zhi/ /thams cad stong pa'i ngo bor byed/ /the tshom thog mar 5sbyor ba drug /rnal 'byor rig pas na mchog tu bsgrub / /de nas 81wa 840

wa ḍā sa mewa byebyer+shadhe la ——rte rte —byerterdor+shakā — zlorngo ———— —/rte / zlu tā dzā bye kā 'joms byed cing / /bde ba skye ba ster bar byed/ /de yis rnam rtog thams cad ni/ /skad cig gis ni gcod par byed/ /rnal 'byor rjes su rnal 'byor dang —/ /shin tu rnal 'byor rnam 'byor che/ /de yi dbye ba bcwa 2brgyad kyis/ /dang po sbyor ba bsgom par bya/ /bcu bdun rjes su rnal 'byor sogs/ /de las dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ni/ /rnal 'byor mchog la dbye ba lnga/ /de las kyang ni las rgyal mchog /rnal 'byor dbye ba bcu gnyis so/ /de nyid dbye ba bzhi bcu dgu/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa bsdus pa yis / /mngon sum byed pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de la rdo rje bzlas rim mchog /rdzogs rim 5rnal 'byor yan lag ni/ /rnam par rtog pa 'joms sgyu byed pa/ /phra ba'i de 7nyid bla na med / /cho ga ji bzhin rnal 'byor pa/ /blo dang ldan pas sngon bzhin bsgom/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba gcod 8par byed/ /rnal 'byor chen po ye shes che/ / de nyid chen po rmad 'byung che/ /9nges par bsgoms pas yang dag ni/ /rnam rtog rlung ni 'joms par byed/ /don gyi rjes 'gro bzlas pa yis/ /dngos med ngo bo gcig pa dang / /stong nyid bsten 1 pa mngon par zhen/ /sgom 11pa nges par brtan par byed/ /sgrub pos yang dag bsgoms 15byas na/ /rdo rje bzlas rim bla na med/ /de yi rim ’ bzhin ye shes mchog /thob 'gyur 'di la the tshom med / /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba samangon par rtogs pa las rnam par rtog pa'i rlung gcod pa'i mtshan nyid kyi le'u ste sum cu 15lnga pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad kyis 17nyon/ /rnam rtog med pa'i rlung shar na/ /81—841

gang shes rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /rang 0)dngos go 'phang bzang po 'thob(kye /rnam rtog med pa'i rlung chen po/ /gnyis pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin bdag /sgom dang sgom min chago 'phang bral/ /rnam 'byor chen po'i ye shes che/ /gnas pa med cing dri ma med/ /phra ba'i cha kun dbus na gnas/ /thig le nā da rnam par spangs/ /kun la khyab cing zhi ba dang / /bdag byin brlab ④pa'i mtshan nyid gcig /mtshan gzhi (nyamatshan nyid rnams las grol/ /bag chags rnam ༅rtog rnam par spangs/ /tshigs ⑦dang mdud pa'i lam dang nirdo ni/ /sgom dang bsgom ⑨bya rnam par spangs/ /stong nyid ye shes mtshan nyid do/ /sngags dang phyag rgya'i rnam pa'i cha/ /rnam pa'i spyod pa rnam par spangs/ /bya ba spyod pa rnal 'byor gyi/ /rgyud rnams la yang bklag ⑩mi bya/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud chen po(/rje/ /bshad par bya ba dam tshig mchog /man ngag ji bzhin cho ga bzhin/ /thog ma nyid du bshad par rigs/ /de yi rim pa'i 7rjes 'gro shes/ /bla ma brgyud hu pa'i go 'phang mchog /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba 0mngon par rtogs pa las rnam rtog med pa'i mtshan nyid kyi le'u ste sum cu 7drug pa'o// //de nas rdo rje can gyis tsogasungs/ /rtsa rnams 7nub pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ /de kho na nyid bshad kyis tunyenyon/ /yul dang dbang po yang dag sbyor/ /rtsa rnams kyang ni 'char bar 'gyur/ /shar nas sngon bzhin song nas ni/ /bskyed (6pa'i rim pa bla na med/ /rnam rtog skye ba de yi phyir/ /brgya dang brgyad kyis no stalhag pa'i rim/ /de las skye dang rga dang na/ /'chi zhing slar yang ldog par 81—842

'gyur / /yul rnams dngos po med pa yis/ /sbyangs pa'i ye shes de nyid phyir/ /de nyid 'di ①la spyod pa'i phyir/ /dngos su yul rnams dngos med phyir/ /dbang po rnams ni skye ba min/ /de las gnyis gnyis yang dag sbyor/ /dngos dang dngos med stong pa nyid/ /de nas rtsa rnams (kyenub 'gyur te/ /'khor lo'i rim pa la yang rton①/ /de rnams nub ④pa las ni zhi/ /stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis ni/ /kun ④kyang rtsa yi (ye'akhor lor 'gyur/ /de nyid kun chos ⑦nang du khyabal/ /stong nyid bsgom pa rnal 'byor las/ /yul rnams kyi ni ngo bo nyid/ /nges pa ⑤ru ni shes pa zhes/ /rig ⑨pa'i rdo rje ⑩rnam par 'joms/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba tsomangon par rtogs pa las rtsa rnams nub pa'i sbyong ba'i ⑩le'u ste sum cu phonyebadun pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad kyis ④nyon/ /spyod 8drug go 'phang mtshan nyid ni//ji lta ⑩ji lta ba bzhin sbyor/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i yan lag brten⑩/ /rnam pa drug po de las phyed/ /de bzhin brgyad brgyad de las lhag /brgyad gnyis brgyad phrag bzhi dang ni/ /de ltar grangs kyis (3sbyor ba gsal/ /zla ba phyed pa'i cha lta bu/ /stong nyid rlung gi 'khor lor gnas/ /phyed pa ma yin rdzogs pa min / /chu yi zla ba lta bur snang / /sgyu ma chen po 'gro ba'i ma/ /thams cad rten pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /rlung gi 'khor lo srog ces bshad/ /mkhas pa rnams kyi spyod yul min/ /me yi 'khor lo stong nyid khyab/ /dbus na thig le lta bu ni/ /mi 'gyur kun du 'gro ba dang / /rang byung kun la khyab pa dang / /bde ba yang dag 'phel bar byed/ /dbyangs dang gsal byed rnam par spangs/ /81wa 843

'jig rten gsum ni ma lus pa/ /gcig tu byas na skyed 1)par byed/ /mi shigs 2nā da'i go 'phang can/ /rnam pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ /sbrul gyi lce ltar g.yo ba dang / /tshangs pa la sogs pha mes dang / /'jigs pa ma yin g.yo ba min / /yi ge dang ni tshig ma yin/ /'byung ba'i 4tshogs ni rnam par spangs / /grangs bral zad med skye ba med/ /lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lor gnas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus gnas pa/ /sgra tsam dri ma dang bral ba/ /chags bral chags pa med pa dang / /bya ba byed dang gnas med pa/ /dpe med gnas pa med pa dang / /srog dang rtsol ba rnam par spangs/ /lha yi dbang phyug ye shes mchog /de lta bu yang rnyed 5par dka'/ /longs spyod 'khor lo mchog tu gnas / /'ching ba med pa'i rnam pa snyomachog /mchog tu khong du chud gyur pa/ /rnam pa kun gyis yang dag bzhugs/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung rang bzhin gyi / /chang gi ro yis myos pa bzhin/ /mchog ni dang po ma lus pa/ /dngos po kun gyi nang na gnas/ /thog ma tha ma lhag par gnas/ /mtshan nyid med cing snang ba med/ /mtshan nyid thams cad rnam par spangs/ /zhi ba mi 'jigs brjod du med/ /rang bzhin nyams myong rang ngo bo/ /bde ba chen po'i 'khor lor gnas / /bla ma brgyud 8pa las ni thob/ /de ltar ye shes bye brag che/ /rang gi ngo bo rnam shes drug /steng dang 'og tu yang dag sbyor9/ /rnal 'byor zhes ni rab tu grags/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba lamangon par rtogs pa las 'khor lo drug sgom pa'i le'u ste sum cu 1 brgyad pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan rdo rjes gsungs/ /dus kyi mtshan nyid sdom pa ni/ /81wa 844

rnorngo'abyoragang :sa—rtezungaparar+shatā grangs bye gre(rte /byeng ——— rjerno gre(wa/—————— — bye shā ni dus tshod zhes 1ni bshad/ /bsam dang bsam bral rang dngos ni/ /dus bzang dang ni dus ngan dang / /rnam pa gnyis la yang dag gnas/ /sna yi bu ga las byung nas/ /phyi yi sgo las rtag tu 'char/ /nang du sdud par dus bzang rnagasungs / /'byung ba yang ni dus ngan 'dod/ /dus ngan las ni gzhan pa mchog /dus bzang mchog ste darang nyid ni/ /rdzogs ldan dang ni gsum ldan dang ske/ /gnyis ldan dang ni dus bzang po/ /rtsod pa'i dus ni ngan pa ste/ /de ltar gsungs pa'i dus mtshan nyid/ /dga' dang mchog tu dga' ba dang / /lhan cig skyes pa dus bzang ste / /dga' dang 5bral ba ngan dus so/ /dus kyi mtshan nyid de ltar bshad/ /'jug pa dang ni gnas pa'i dus/ /dus bzang por ni yongs su grags/ /ldang ba yang ni dus ngan te/ /de ltar dus kyi mtshan nyid do/ /dus ni khams rnams thams cad de/ /mnyam pa ro gcig go 'phang mchog /ye shes rnam shes rnam spangs te/ /dus ni gcig ni brjod pa yin / /dngos dang dngos med spros bral ba/ /bzhi 6pa'i skad cig mtshan nyid ni / /brjod bya rjod 7byed las grol ba/ / dus gcig zhes 8ni brjod pa yin/ /chags dang chags bral nges grol ba/ /bde ba chen po go 'phang spangs/ /phyag rgya chen po'i don gyi gzhi/ /dus gcig zhes 9ni brjod pa yin/ /mtshan nyid med cing snang ba med/ /grangs ni rnal 'byor rnam par spangs/ /de nyid dus su nges 1 bshad de/ /bla ma brgyud 11pa las shes bya/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba 12mngon par rtogs pa las dus dang dus tshad 1 rnam par bshad pa'i le'u ste sum cu chodagu pa'o// //81wa 845

gang gis dngos grub mchog tu 'gro/ /phyag rgya chen po yang dag bsten/ /gsang ba sbas pa zhes ni bshad/ /rnal 'byor byis pas mi shes shing / /bzhi pa'i dbang zhes bya ba'i ming / /zhal nas brgyud pa'i rim pa rnams/ /mchog tu zhi ba'i ye shes che/ /rnam rtog thams cad rnam par spangs/ /phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub che/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i don bsdus pa/ /rnal 'byor ma rgyud las bslabs 0)pa/ /mchog tu rmad byung ngo bo nyid/ /ye shes chen po'i ro 'bebs pa/ /de nyid chen po'i yon tan ldan/ /nam mkha' mchog la gnas pa'i sa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rang ngo bo/ /bde ba rnams ni 'phel bar byed/ /bde ba chen po'i go 'phang 'das/ /shes dang shes bya rnam par bral/ /sgom dang bsgom bya rnam par spangs/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi bya bas stong / /kun du rtog pa thams cad spangs/ /dngos po kun gyi go 'phang gsal/ /'jig rten gsum gyi rnam pa'i mi(snye/ /chags dang chags bral rnam par spangs/ /dam tshig chen po la gnas pa/ /grangs med 'jig rten gsum gcig dngos/ /dngos grub de kho na yi rgyud/ /de ltar gsang ba'i 'bras bu gsal/ /gzhan ni gang du'ang ma gsungs pa/ /rnal 'byor mchog gi ye shes mchog /rnal 'byor ma rgyud las shes bya/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba ②mngon par rtogs pa las gsang ba'i 'bras bu zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bzhi bcu pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan rdo rjes gsungs/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi go 'phang mchog /81—846

chos kyi dbyings nas khyab pa'i khams/ /chos kyi dbyings kyis de la brjod/ /kun khyab mchog tu phra ba dang / /kun 'gro rtag tu 'char 1)ba dang / /phung po lnga nyid 'byung ba lnga/ /yul dang skye mched rnam shes dang / /de dag yang dag ldan chos kun/ /bshad de gsang ba'i dbang phyug ste(kye/ /de dag dbus na gnas pa'i khams/ /khyab cing spyod yul ma yin pa / /ji ltar til gyi til mar dang / /ji ltar shing la me bzhin du/ /de bzhin chos rnams thams cad la / /khyab kyang mthong ba ma yin no/ /nam mkha' bzhin du dri ma med/ /chos kun gyi ni gzhi yi mchog /gzung godang 'dzin pa'i kun rtog gis/ /khyab kyang mthong ba ma yin no/ /stong nyid ye shes rnal 'byor gyis/ /rnal 'byor pa yis gsal bar mthong / /chos dbyings bha ga zhes ni brjod/ /bha ga rin chen za ma togatso /gang phyir dbang phyug sogs yon tan/ /ldan pa de phyir bha ga brjod / /bha ga chos rnams su yang bshad/ /dbyings ni byang chub sems su gsungs / /khams gsum pa yi 'gro ba yi(6)/ /rgyu ni bha ga zhes byar bshad/ /dbyings ni yang dag sbyor dngos kyis/ /chu zla bzhin du yang dag gnas/ /don dam gcig pu'i de nyid shes/ /lag mthil skyu ru bzhag 9)pa bzhin/ /mchog gi de nyid ltar ni snang / /rang rig shin tu dri ma med/ /dngos dang dngos med zad nas ni/ /rtag tu de nyid mthong zhing snang / /chos kyi dbyings kyi go 'phang gsal/ /de ltar shin tu rgyas par bshad/ /gzung (2)dang 'dzin pa dang bral bas/ /sbyor bral shes pa rmad du byung / /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba ⑨mngon par rtogs pa las chos kyi dbyings kyi don bshad pa'i le'u ste bzhi bcu gcig pa'o// //81—847

de nas bcom ldan rdo rjes gsungs/ /rdo rje yi ni mtshan nyid mchog /de yi don du bshad kyis 1nyon/ /ji lta ba bzhin bshad par bya/ /rdo rje mi phyed zhes 2ni gsungs/ /ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid mchog /rtsa lnga yi ni nam mkhar rten ske/ /rtse mo lnga yi rang ngo bo/ /sa dang chu dang de bzhin me/ /rlung dang nam mkha' nyid dang ni/ /rtsa yi nam mkha'i cha yi gzugs/ /bla ma brgyud calas shes par bya/ /i raṃ lo baṃ yaṃ sa bon/ /brjod pa rtsa ni lnga rnams te/ /'bad pa yis 5ni shes par bya/ /rdo rjes skye ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ /pad+ma lte ba'i dbus gnas pa/ /thig ler bshad pa 'gro ba med/ /dam tshig gnas ni shes pa dang ske/ /bdud rtsi mchog gis 6rab tu gang / /rnam pa kun ldan rnam pa med/ /de ni rdo rjer yongs su grags/ /me long mnyam nyid ye shes dang / /so sor rtog 7dang bya nan tan/ /rnam par dag pa chos kyi dbyings/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin no/ /de yi ngo bo yongs su shes/ /rdo rje rang nyid nyams /myong mchog /nam mkhar cher gnas zhi ba dang / /rtog pa med cing nyon mongs med / /rdo rje sems dpa' yang dag gzhi/ /bla ma brgyud pa las shes bya/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba 9mngon par rtogs 7pa las rdo rje bshad pa'i le'u ste bzhi bcu gnyis pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan rdo rjes gsungs/ /rigs kyi dbye ba don bsdus pa/ /de tshe rigs ni rnam pa lnga/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud du gsal bar gsungs/ /rnal 'byor spros pa dbye ba yis/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i dam tshig go/ /rgyud du grags pa 1 81—848

dbye ba yi/ /mthar thug de ni yang dag gsungs/ /de nyid las ni bsdus nas kyang ske/ /rigs kyi dbye ba brgya ru gsungs/ /sna tshogs spros pa'i rnal 'byor gyis / /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes ni brjod/ /gang gis de yi rnam pa mthong / /sna tshogs nor bu ji bzhin no/ /sems can mos pa sna tshogs dang / /sna tshogs bsam pa'i bye brag gis/ /sna tshogs nyon mongs mnan nas ni/ /'gro ba'i bla mas grol ba'i phyir/ /gzhung nas gang gis de yis ni/ /sna tshogs spro ba'i ngo bo nyid / /grangs med pa yi hubyedabye ba yis/ /dbye ba grangs med sbyor ba yis/ /don dam rigs kyi dbye ba nyid/ /rgyud gzhan rnams su gsungs pa yin/ /sems can bsam pa'i bye brag gis/ /de ni bsdus na dbye bar 'gyur/ /rtsa yi 'khor lo'i rim pa yis/ /stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa'o/ /de la stong phrag sum cu drug /lus kyi rdzas dang gnas sogs kyis/ /rim pa'i dbye ba de las kyang / /stong phrag nyi shu rtsa bzhi'o/ /de rjes brgya yis mchog tu gang / /bdun cu rtsa gnyis drug cu bzhi/ /sum cu rtsa drug bsdus pa las/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi de las kyang / /sum cu dang ni dgu yang ngo / /de las lnga dang de phyir gsum / /gsum yang bsdus na gcig nyid de / /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i sbyor ba yis / /gzhan nas ④gzhan du 'dres nas 'gro/ /de yang 'od gsal go 'phang la'o / /rnam rtog med pa'i bde ba che/ /gnyis med ye shes dri ma med/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi bdag nyid mchog /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba 5mngon par rtogs pa las rigs kyi dbye ba'i don (6bsdus pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bzhi bcu 3dgasum pa'o// //81—849

de nas bcom ldan rdo rjes 0)gsungs/ /phyag rgya'i dbye ba bla na med/ /chos dang las dang dam tshig dang / /phyag rgya chen po mngon par brjod/ /las kyi rnam smin nges pa yis/ /kun nas rgyas btab lta bur gnas/ /gang yang 'di ni las gang gis(gyi/ /de 'bras ji lta ba bzhin 'gyur/ /chos rnams rang bzhin med pa nyid/ /rang bzhin gyis ni rgyas btab nas/ /dam tshig rang gi yon tan dngos/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi ①rgyas btab pa/ /stong dang snying rje mi phyed pa/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni rnam sbyong ④ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam tshig ni / /yongs su dag pa'i mdzad pa yisazhun/ /de yi rang bzhin rang bzhin med/ /phyag rgya chen po zhes ni brjod/ /las kyi phyag rgya yongs shes na/ /sngags pa las ni thob par skye/ /bla mas shes rab (6)dbang bskur na/ /ji ltar mthong ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rang dngos don/ /snying rje'i bsam pas gsal ba ni/ /de las nges par thob nas ni/ /chos nyid sgo nas nges par byed / /de ltar de nyid de ye shes/ /de ltar rnal 'byor ma mtshan nyid/ /dam tshig la zhen mkhas pa dang / /rlung gis ⑦de nyid pha rol son/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i don bslab 8)pa/ /ngag 'jam shes rab ldan ma dang / /mig yangs shedam yi bu mo rnyed57/ /gzugs dang lang /mtshos rnam par brgyan/ /ji bzhin rnal 'byor dam tshig la/ /phyag rgyas lhan cig sgrub par byed/ /de nas de nyid thob pa na/ /phyag rgya chen po'i mtshan nyid do/ /de nyid bde chen go 'phang ni/ /kun du rtog pa thams cad spangs/ /stong nyid ye shes dri ma med/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi go 'phang gsal/ /de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /phyag rgya'i dbye ba bla na med/ /rigs dang pha rol phyin dbye bas/ /phyag rgya drug tu 81—850

yang dag bshad/ /yo ro lo baṃ i haṃ dang / /lha mo rnams kyi rim pa las/ /mchod pa'i rim pa ro gcig pa/ /rtag tu yang ni mchod par bya/ /gdol pa mo dang khrus mkhan mo/ /sme sha can dang gar mkhan ma/ /ro bsregs 7mo dang bram ze mo/ /grub 'gyur don du rnal 'byor pas/ /bdag nyid rol cing gnas par bya/ /khrus mkhan rin chen rigs las skyes/ /gdol pa pad+ma'i rigs las skyes/ /de bzhin gar mkhan las kyi rigs/ /ro bsregs tsho ma ni 'khor lo'i rigs/ /sme sha can ni rdo rje'i rigs/ /ye shes phyag rgya bram ze mo/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs su brjod/ /'di ni rigs ni drug tu 'gyur/ /bram ze mo ni ma yin te/ /khrus mkhan mo ni sring mor brjod/ /gar mkhan mo ni bu mor shes/ /sme sha can ni chung mar grags/ /ro bsregs 97mo ni mna' ma ste/ /sgyug mo gdol pa ma zhes bya da/ /shes rab thabs kyi cho ga yis/ /rnam rtog med pas brjod par bya/ /gang phyir rnam rtog med gyur na/ /dngos grub kun la dus kun du/ /sems ni ma ru gyur nas ni/ /sring mo dag tu yang dag bshad/ /lus ni bu mor shes par bya/ /srog ni chung mar rab tu gsal/ /mna' ma thur du sel ba'i rlung / /dbu tshogema'i rlung ni sgyug mor brjod/ /ma ni rgyags pa'i rtsa yi ⑨cha/ /sangs rgyas rin chen za ma tog /sring mo khu ba 'bab pa'i ma spyi bo'i gnas na yang dag gnas/ /bu mo khrag rgyu ba yi rtsa/ /de ni phyed phyed lhag par gnas/ /chung ma gcin ni 'bab pa'i rtsa/ /de nyid kyi ni dbus na gnas//mna' ma mchi ma 'dzag ⑦pa'i rtsa/ /mgrin (shepa'i gnas su lhag par gnas/ /ma ni sa ru yang dag bshad/ / chu yi ༷9)khams ni sring mor brjod/ /me ni bu mor shes par bya/ /rlung ni chung mar rab tu grags/ /mna' ma nam mkha' ru 81—851

ni bshad/ /sgyug mo nam mkha' chen po'o(1)/ /mngar bar gyur pas ma dang ni / /skyur 2ba na sring mo ru ni brjod/ /kha ba rang gi bu mo dang / /lan tshwa chung mar yongs su grags/ /bska 4)ba sgyug mor shes par bya/ /tsha ba mna' mar yongs su grags/ /de dag 'bad pas 'dod bya zhing / /dngos grub 'dod pas bsten par bya/ /las kyi phyag rgya dbye ba 'di/ /de yi yon tan bsten pa'i mchog /dam tshig de dang rtog par 'jug /phyag rgya chen po'i bde ba che/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang zhi(5)/ /ye shes mchog ni bla na med/ /de ltar phyag rgya'i go 'phang gsal/ /rnal 'byor ma rgyud spyod yul lo/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba 76)mngon par rtogs pa las phyag rgya'i dbye ba rgyas par bshad pa'i le'u ste bzhi bcu bzhi pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang yang dag bshad/ /phung sogs skye mched mtshan nyid ni/ /rgyal ba rgyal ni gzugs zhes bshad/ /rdo rje 'dzin ni rnam shes dang / /rin chen 'dzin la 57 tshor bar gsungs/ /'khor ba (shelas brgal 3)'du shes gsungs//shes rab 'dzin ni 'du byed dang / /de ltar phung por rab tu grags(7/ /sa ni gti mug dga' mar bshad/ /de bzhin chu ni zhe sdang dga'/ /me ni 51mchags la dga' ba dang / /de bzhin rlung ni rdo rje dga'/ /nam mkha' rdo rje dbyings dbang phyug /gzugs ni gzugs kyi rdo rje dang / /sgra ni sgra yi rdo rje ste/ /dri ni dri yi rdo rje dang / /ro ni ro yi rdo rjer bshad/ /reg bya'i rdo rje reg byar 'gyur / /chos kyi dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ /mig gnyis sa yi snying po dang / /rna ba phyag na rdo rje dang / /sna ni nam mkha'i snying po dang / /lce ni 'jig rten 81wa 852

mgon po dang / /lus ni sgrib pa rnam sel brjod11/ /yid ni kun du bzang po dang ske/ /rtsa ni byams pa ru ni brjod/ /ye shes mchog ni 'jam dpal nyid/ /khyab pa ru ni yang dag bshad/ /de bzhin lus kyi chos rnams ni/ /khro bo bcur ni yang dag bshad/ /de ltar lus kyi dkyil 'khor gsungs/ /phung po la sogs skye mched sogs/ /rnal 'byor gnyis med mchog gis ni/ /bla ma brgyud ②pa las shes bya/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba mngon par rtogs pa las phung po la sogs pa dang skye mched kyi mtshan nyid kyi le'u ste bzhi bcu lnga pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /phyag rgya chen po'i don mtshan nyid/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i 'bras bu zhi/ /ye shes chen po'i don bsdus pa/ /bde ba chen po'i skal ba 54)che/ /ro mchog chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /sgyu ma chen mo 5mchog tu phra/ /chen po'i chen po nam mkha' che/ /phyag rgya de bzhin gshegs ye shes / /rnam rtog med pa'i go 'phang ste(6/ /mi phyed rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas/ /rnam rtog med pa'i bde ba che/ /nam mkha' bzhin du gos pa med/ /rang bzhin med cing gzhi dang bral/ /gnyis med bdag med brjod du med/ /rnal 'byor rnams ni rang rig pa/ /phung po khams dang skye mched cha'i/ /kun rtog chos ni yongs su spangs/ /sgom dang bsgom bya snyoms 77'jug dang / /rim pa gnyis ni rnam par spangs/ /rnam shes ye shes dang bral ba/ /sngags dang bzlas brjod bsnyen pa spangs/ /dngos po kun gyi dunaganas las brgal9/ /ye shes chen po rab gsol ba/ /dngos grub chen po 'dir shes bya/ /phyag rgya chen 81—853

po bla na med/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba hu)mngon par rtogs pa las phyag rgya chen po'i don rnam par nges pa'i le'u ste bzhi bcu ②drug pa'o // //de nas bcom ldan rdo rjes gsungs/ /nyams kyi mtshan nyid dbye ba ni/ /gang gis yongs shes (kyernal 'byor pa/ /rnal 'byor chen po dag shes par/ /gyur nas kyang ni ye shes che/ /de nyid rnal 'byor kun las bsgyings/ / 'dar dang 4rdul dang ba spu langs/ /dbyangs 'gyur ba dang ldibs 0pa dang / /mdog 'gyur mchi 56)'dzag thim pa dang / /snying stobs can gyis (pe'adi brgyad nyams / /dga' ba rgyas pa'i rtsa yi cha/ /rgyags pa'i cha yi rtsa dga' ni④/ /khong stong 'dar bar skyed (()par byed/ /rgyags pa'i chu yi rtsa sad na⑩/ /rab tu rngul byed skyed par nyunyebyed/ /de bzhin rgyags pas g.yengs 8pa'i rtsa/ /khong stong ba spu ldang nyusnyebar byed/ /de bzhin na sa ra yi rtsa/ /khong stong tshig ni ldib ri7par byed/ /rus sbal chen po'i rtsa rgyas tson/ /kha dog 'gyur ba skye bar byedal/ /mgo bo chen po'i rtsa rgyas na⑩/ /brgyal zhing sdug bsngal bcas par byed / /'ur 'ur chen po'i rtsa bye na/ /ba spu langs pa skyed ⑩par byed/ /dga' ba chen po'i rtsa rgyas na/ /khong stong mchi nyusnyem 'dzag par byed/ /myos pa chen po'i rtsa bye hurten/ /srog gi rlung ni thim par byed/ /brgyal 4)dang sems med bde ba che/ /de nas dran pa nyams par 'gyur/ /sgeg 0pa la sogs nyams su shes / /sngar bshad rim pas shurnyesad par byed/ /dzaḥpu te/ baṃ hoḥde bzhin du/ /a la la la la ho sngags/ / rab tu bskul gistebs rgyas nas su/ /nyams ni so 81—854

so'i dbye bas shes/ /de ltar de ni dbye brgyud 6)pa'o/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba lamangon par rtogs pa las nyams kyi dbye ba bshad pa'i le'u ste bzhi bcu (kyebadun pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan rdo rjes gsungs/ /bdag ces bya ba sgra yi rten/ /gang gis yang dag shes pa yis/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ /a haṃ 'khor lo'i 'ching ba dag /de ni yongs bzad grol ba'o/ /a ni dngos po kun gyi mchog /lus rnams kun la lhag par gnas/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan / /kun khyab kun mkhyen (5)zad pa med/ /thogs med snying stobs zhes bya ba / /thabs cig (btu ni skye bar byed/ /srid dang srid rtse brtse ba med/ /sprul pa'i sku yi mchog dang ni/ /don kun byed pa la mkhas pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbugs 'byung ba'o/ /haṃ ni dngos po dang bral ba/ /lus la gnas kyang lus bskyed min/ /dbang po las 'das mi gsal ba/ /rnam pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ /dngos dang dngos med las grol zhing / /gang la'ang lhag par gang gnas pa/ /dngos po thams cad nub rdzu pa dang / /chos kyi sku yi ngo bo nyid/ /sems ni rdo rje 'chang dbugs phyung / /don kun byed pa dang bral ba/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin mya ngan 'das/ /ye shes sku yi rang bzhin nyid / /rjod dang brjod bya rnam par grol/ /de yang yi ge haṃ du grags/ /thams cad a haṃ kun la khyab/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs9na / /a haṃ dngos po thams cad la/ /khyab pa'i sa ni lhag par gnas/ /a haṃ dang bral skyes bu ni/ /rtsa ba bcad pa'i shing bzhin no/ /haṃ ni dpral ba'i skra mtshams 81—855

na / /a ni lte bar yang dag gnas/ /'dir shi)ni a las zla bar bshad/ /'od zer stong 'gyed pa yi haṃ/ /'dir yang a yi ming la brten/ /rten tshanapa'i haṃ du rab tu grags/ /a ni srog gi rlung du bshad/ /de bzhin thur sel nahaṃ du brjod/ /de gnyis gcig gyur 'khor ba ste/ /des na a haṃ zhes par grags / /rnam rtog bral ba'i gnas pa ni/ /a haṃ gang du gnas pa med/ /gzhan ni 'ga' zhig 'di la yang / /don dam par ni dmigs su med/ /de ltar a haṃ nga yis bshad/ /rgyud ri4)rnams kun du rnyed par dka'/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba risamangon par rtogs pa las a haṃ gi sgra'i don bshad pa'i le'u ste bzhi bcu nerabargyad pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan rdo rjes gsungs/ /stod nyid dbye ba bsdus pa ni/ /rnal 'byor pa ni gang gis shes/ /stong nyid de ni shes par 'gyur/ /mi mthun pa dang gnyen po'i 75phyir/ /stong nyid bsgom par yongs su gsungs/ /nang gi bdag nyid chos rnams ni/ /kun du rtog pa'i gnyen po dang / /phyin ci log ni rnam dag pa/ /phyi nas stong pa nyid du 'dod/ /phyi rol dmigs pa dang bral ba / /nang gi bdag nyid chos rnams dang / /phyi rol du yang mi rtog pa/ /'dir ni phyi dang nang gi ni/ /stong pa nyid du yang dag bshad/ /snod kyi 'jig rten dang bral ba bye/ /chen po stong pa nyid du brjod/ /ye shes gang gis de stong par / /mthong ba de yang stong par brjod/ /me long ye shes rdzogs pa la/ /rjes su dmigs par byed phyir ro/ /de yi mi mthun phyogs stong pa/ /dngos med stong pa nyid stong nyid/ /don dam par ni brdzun ri9)pa'i dngos/ /shes pa 81wa 856

don dam stong pa nyid/ /'dus byas sbyin pa la sogs kyi/ /dge ba dmigs su med pa'i phyir/ /rang gi rnam rtog mtshan nyid spyod/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid du bshad/ /yang dag byang chub 'dus ma byas/ /rgyu mtshan yang ni dmigs su med / /dngos dang dngos med rnam par spangs/ /'dus ma byas pa'i stong nyid gsungs / /sems can don du smon lam sogs/ /rang dga' sogs pa dmigs pa med/ /shin tu stong pa nyid du bshad/ /kun rtog thams cad rnam par spangs/ /mtha' las 'das pa'i stong nyid gsungs/ /thog mtha' med pa'i 'jig rten gyi༅/ /'gro ba'i phyir ni smon lam nyid/ /rlom sems med par de brjod dordo kyi/ /thog mtha' med pa'i stong pa nyid/ /mya ngan 'das la dmigs pa med/ /dge ba'i bdag nyid mi stong ba/ /rlom sems med pa zhes bshad do//dor ba med pa stong pa nyid/ /'dod chags la sogs dri ma ni/ /bdag ni rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i/ /de ltar rlom sems med gsungs pa/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid du gsal/ /mtshan dang dpe da byad la sogs pa/ /sku gzugs de yi yon tan ni/ /gzhan rnams la yang mi dmigs pa/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid/ /byang chub phyogs kyi chos rnams nyid/ /spyod pa la yang rlom sems med / /chos rnams thams cad stong par bshad/ /bdag dang skyes pa'i chos rnams ni/ /sgro btags (4/dngos po med pa'i mchog /'ching ba thams cad rnam par gcod/ /dngos med stong pa nyid du gsungs/ /ji ltar sngon gsungs stong pa nyid/ /de ltar dngos po med shes pa/ /slar yang mi dmigs pa nyid ni / /dngos po med pa stong nyid 'dod/ /de ltar stong nyid dbye ba yang / /bag chags rnams kyi gnyen po'i nyaderiphyir/ /rgyu yi gnyen po mi mthun phyogs/ /bla 81—857

ma brgyud 0)pa las shes bya/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba ②mngon par rtogs pa las stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid kyi ②le'u ste bzhi bcu ④dgu pa'o de nas bcom ldan rdo rjes gsungs/ /stong pa nyid ni skye ba'i rgyu/ /rnam pa med pa'i nyams myong dngos/ /lus rnams la ni khyab pa dang / /phung po lnga ni rang bzhin lus/ /'khor lo drug la khyab pa dang / /chos rnams kun gyi dbus gnas phyir/ /ring ba ma yin nye ba min/ /de ni kun rdzob dang dbyer med/ /stong pa nyid ni don dam mo/ /rdo rje phreng ba de ltar bshad/ /srog gi rten ⑤gyi mtshan nyid ni/ /sku mdog sngon po zhal gsum pa/ /spyan gsum po la phyag drug mchog /rdo rje 'khor lo nor bu g.yas/ /g.yon pa dril bu pad+ma dang / /ral gri shin tu rnon po dang / /phyar ba go rims ⑥bzhin du bsnams/ /ā li kā li las byung ba/ /zla ba nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /sna tshogs pad rgyas gdan la ni/ /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung (3)gis bzhugs/ /r+ghaṃ gi sa bon rdzogs pa dang ske/ /rdo rje chen po'i rigs las byung / /kun rtog rnams ni bskyed (8)pa'i rlung ske/ /rnam par gcod cing thim par byed/ /gnod byed de dag sel bar byed / /gnyis pa thonathams cad rnam par gcod/ / sgyu ma chen mo kyestong pa che/ /sangs rgyas sa ni rmad du byung / /sangs rgyas nyid kyi 'bras ster ba'o/ /'di yi sngags ni brjod par bya/ /oṃ dang badz+ra mā le nyunyedang / /de bzhin āḥdang rtsu dang gnyis/ /phaṭa dang swā hā yang dag ldan/ /sngags mchog btus pa bla na med / /rlung 'phrog de kho na nyid kyis/ /yid kyi rnam rtog sel bar byed/ /zhi 81—858

ba'i gnas dang chu 'gram dang / /shing gcig lam gyi bzhi 5)mdo dang / /yang na sum mdor ②'bum phrag bcu/ /gsal bar yang ni bzlas par bya/ /de ni dngos grub mchog tu 'gro/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ / de yi ( noyon tan gsal bar 'byung / /zhi ba la sogs 'bad mi dgos/ /skad cig gcig la mngon par rtogs/ /de ni de nyid rigs mchog shes/ /dpa' bo gcig pu'i cho ga 'di/ /dpa' mo gcig pu ④nyid bsgrub (snyepa/ /de yi mtshan nyid sgom pa gang / /rnam rtog spangs pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /shin tu rnam dag mkha' yi yidangos/ /rang gi dngos grub mchog tu 'gro/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba ⑦mngon par rtogs du nyepa las stong pa nyid kyi rdo rje'i phreng ba bskyed ⑨pa'i mtshan nyid kyi le'u ste lnga bcu pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan rdo rjes gsungs/ / mtshan mo nyin mo'i mtshan nyid ni//bomatshan mo shes rab shes par bya/ /'byung po thams cad thim nas 'gro/ci /mtshan mo'i cha ni (nyazla bar 'gyur/ /zla ba mya ngan 'das mtshan nyid/ /kun rdzob dang ni don dam gyi/ /shes rab rnam pa gnyis zhes bya/ /kun rdzob shes byar shes par bya/ /don dam reg bya rnam par spangs/ /reg bya dang bral bde ba gang / /bde ba mchog de thob par dka'/ /nyin mo slar yang thabs su bshad / /thabs ni nyin mor gyur pa dang / /gang tshe dngos las skyes nyi ma/ /rtag tu bha ga'i bdag por 'gyur/ /'khor ba'i rnam pa nyi mar 'gyur/ /nyi ma yinalas ni zla ba skyem/ /de las gnyis med ngo bor bshad/ /'bar ba'i phyir ni nyi mar 'gyur/ /rnam par dpyad pa'i don dam dang / /chags bral mchog tu phra 81—859

ba dang / /mi snang ba dang stong pa'i lus/ /'od gsal ba yi go 'phang zhi/ /gang du yang dag mi gnas so/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba hu)mngon par rtogs pa las mtshan mo nyin mo rgyas par bshad pa'i le'u ste (kyelnga bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan rdo rjes gsungs/ /ā li kā li'i rimidam tshig ni/ /rgyud rnams gzhan du ma gsungs pa'i/ /rgyal sras rnams la dgongs pa yi/ /'od gsal go 'phang las skyes pa'i/ /snang ba mched pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /gsal byed sum cu rtsa gsum ldan/ /kā li'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'o/ /snang ba mched pa'i go 'phang ni/ /snang ba las byung zad pa med/ /dbyangs ni bcu drug dang ldan pa/ /ā 0li'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'o/ /de gnyis gsang ba'i sbyor ba las/ /dbus su skyes pa'i bde ba che/ /ā du li kā li'i dam tshig ces/ /dgongs pa'i tshig gis bye brag byas/ /shin tu phra ba'i ye shes mchog /bla ma brgyud 6rilas shes par bya/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba ri 7)mngon par rtogs pa las ā li kā li rgyas par bshad pa'i le'u ste lnga bcu (kyeganyis pa'o // //de nas gzhan yang bshad kyis ri9༄nyon/ /mtshams kyi mtshan nyid bla na med/ /snang dang mi snang bral ba'i mtshams/ /shes rab rdo rje las byung 7ba/ /gnyis med 'dres pa'i dbus na gnas/ /'bags rtsomashing gos pa rnam par spangs/ /rdo rje pad+ma 'chi med skyes/ /zla ba nyi ma yang dag 'dres/ /mthar ni yang dag 81wa 860

mi 'gro gang / /mtshams med 'khor ba dag par byed/ /rang gi ngo bo rnam pa mchog /phra ba'i mtshan nyid bsam mi khyab/ /sems can kun gyi mtshams kyi ni / /rdo rje 'chang gi btsun mo dang / /'char ba mchog tu dag par bshad/ /dga' bral la sogs rnam par spangs/ /mdud pa'i rtser gnas mchog tu zhi/ /tsa na ka yi 0)tshig gu tsam/ /mtshan mo bdag po de shar ba/ /gang phyir steng gi go 'phang gnas/ /la la thig le'i rang ngo bor/ /rnam pa bzhi yis tsho yang dag gnas / /la lar thog ma la sogs spangs/ /la lar de yang dmigs su med/ /gang phyir rang gi bdag nyid canardo ri/ /de phyir brjod du med pa'o/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba (4mngon par rtogs pa las mtshams kyi 'char ba'i mtshan nyid kyi le'u ste lnga bcu lde/gsum pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan rdo rjes gsungs/ /rnam pa nyi shu'i ming tsam ni/ /slob dpon las su yongs su bshad/ /sngags kyi rnal 'byor legs rgyas pa/ /sngon du bsnye na 6dpa sa sbyang dang / /'byung po bskrad pa nyid dang ni/ /sa gzung (7rinyid dang thig skud ni/ /sbyang tshananodang lhag par gnas pa dang / /bgegs bskrad de bzhin dkyil 'khor gyi/ /thig ni rab tu gsal ba dang / /phur bus yang dag gdab pa dang / /bum pa byin gyis brlabs ri pa dang / /bcom ldan 'das kyi lhag gnas dang / /khrus dang rab tu sbyang ba bodang / /mchod pa rab gnas gtor ma dang / /slob ma lhag par 11gnas pa dang / /me la sbyin sreg cho ga bzhin/ /dbang bskur ba dang gshegs su gsol/ci /de ltar cho ga nyi shu'i las / /gang gis de shes 'gro ba'i bla/ /dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pas bya/ /81—861

bdud las sdigs mdzub 0)de ni mchog /yi ge gsum zlos ②pa la zhen/ /rdo rje theg pa lhag par grol/ /zhi ba la sogs las gang gis/ /rtag tu lag pa'i mthil la gnas/ /de yi yang dag cho ga yis/ /cho ga mchog ni bya ba yin/ /rnal 'byor rjes su rnal 'byor sogs/ /cho ga la sogs brtsam par bya /bgegs mthar byed pa'i snying po'i sngags/ /yi ge nyi shu rtsa bzhi mchog /stong phrag bcu ni yongs su bzlas/ /thog mar mkhas pa ji bzhin du/ /bgegs rnams thams cad bsal ④ba'i phyir/ /sngon du bsnyen ⑤pa zhes ni bshad/ /de 'og yi ge gsum khrir ni/ /bsam pa kun gyis bzlas byas na/ /yid la 'dod pa'i dngos grub ster/ /slob ma rnams kyi dngos grub rgyur/ /skye bos dben pa'i phyag dar byasayi/ /sa bzung gachu ni nye bar bcas/ /grong dang ha cang mi nye zhing / /ring por yang ni brtsam mi bya/ /shin tu 'jam zhing srog chags med / /rgyal po'i pho brang shin tu ring / /khang 2khyim tshong dus las rgyang ring / /yang na bde gshegs rten la ni/ /thog mar sor mo rnams la ni/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i sngags dgod bya/ /khru gang sor ni bzhi pa yis/ /seng ldeng phur pa byas nas ni/ /yi ge dzi)gsum sngags chu yis bkru/ /yi ge brgya pa lan bdun dang ske/ /yi ge gsum gyi sngags kyis brko/ /sa ni chu yi ⑩mthar thug pa/ /yang na hu'ekhru ni byed dang gsum/ /yang na sems kyis sbyang bar 8bya/ /de la gnas pa'i 'byung po ni/ /yang dag 'gror ni 'jug par bya/ /oṃ ma hā kro dha dz+wa lārka/ /hūṃ phaṭa mtha' dang yang dag ldan/ /de ltar lag mthil sngags bkod la/ /'byung po rnams ni bskrad nyunyepar bya/ /sa la thal mo lan gsum du/ /brdab pa byas nas sngags bzlas te/ /ud bugats+tsha da lan gnyis brjod/ /sarba bhu ta snyig 81—862

ha ud gats+tsha/ /yi ge gsum ni mtha' ru brjod/ /badz+ra satwa be shad 91)de/ /las ni thams cad par gsungs pa'i/ /gtor ma byin nas 'gro ru gzhug /sa ni yongs su bzung rjes la/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyis brtsam bya/ / tsha sgo (5)med cing dri ma bsal / /mnyam zhing zug rngu med pa dang / /me long lta bur 'jam pa dang / /mnyam pa ④yang ni mkhas pas bya/ /ba yi lci ba la sogs pa/ /rnam pa lnga yis byug ⑤par bya/ /byugs nas de rjes khrus byas la/ /slob dpon khro bo'i sku dang ni/ /dkyil 'khor 'jam pa'i rdo rje yi(ye/ /mchog tu mi g.yo gzugs kyis ni/ /'jam pa dang ni sum sgril gyis/ /ras sam yang na gso ma yis / /yi ge gsum gyis rnam par sbyang / /thig skud kyis ni kun nas mnyam/ /gru bzhi par ni (pebyas nas kyang / /rdo rje can gyis khru gsum gsum/ /gru bzhi par ni gzung 2bar bya/ / de yi ponyedabus su lte ba'i cha/ /sgrib pa'i skyon ni spang 7bar bya/ /sku gdung dang ni rin chen gzhug37 /legs par bsangs nas byin gyis brlab/ /yi ge gsum yang swā hā'i mtha'/ /phaṭa kyi dbus su yang dag sbyar/ /sngags 'di yang ni bzlas par bya/ /brgya 8dang brgyad kyis nya lhag par gsal/ /tshangs pa'i thig ni btab nas ni/ /yi ge brgya pa bzla cibar bya/ /de rjes de la me tog char/ /sngags ni brjod nas gtor bar bya/ /oṃ dang a mo bhā 7pad+mo/ /de bzhin du ni phyi nas su/ /bha tsobu dha ri 〉dha ra gnyis/ /dha ra ṇi thamaṇ+ḍa li /yi/ /yi ge brgya pa'i sngags dang ni/ /lan gsum bar du thig skud la/ /zhabs bsil chu yis bsang 2 )bar bya/ /yi ge gsum gyis thig gdab bya / /zur bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rdo rje can gyis mtshams bzhi pa/ /thog mar 1shar dang byang dang ni/ /ji srid lho dang nub dag dang / /mtshams su yang dag 81—863

thig skud dang / /slar yang yang dag gdab par bya/ /shar dang lho yi nyamatshams dang ni/ /nub dang byang gi mtshams su ni/ /thig skud kyis ni tshad gzhal bya/ /zur bzhi dang ni thig skud bya/ /skor 2)thig gsum ni na sgo bzhi pa/ /rdo rje phreng 4 ba gsum gyis mdzes/ /tshangs pa'i thig gnyis btab nas ni/ /de las dbang po'i pho brang ni/ /rnam pa kun gyis yang dag thig /rgyal ba kun gyi bzhugs gnas gsal/ /de la rig pa 'dzin pa bri/ /slar yang rin chen phye ma 'am / /tshon sna lnga rnams me tog dang / /rdzas sam las kyi sbyor ba las rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du/ /mtshan ma'i phyag rgya la sogs bri/ /mi bskyod (shesku mdog phyag rgya sogs/ /rigs ni dbus su dgod par bya/ /rgyal ba rgyal dang rin chen 'chang / /'khor ba 'das dang shes rab 'chang / /rim bzhin sku mdog dbye ba yis/ /shar la sogs pa'i phyogs su dgod/ /gti mug zhe sdang chags pa dang / /rdo rje dga' sogs rim pa bzhin/ /me la sogs pa'i mtshams rnams su/ /ji lta ba bzhin dgod par bya/ /sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba yi/ /gdan bdun gzhan gyi nyi ma gnyis/ /'khor dga' zhe sdang dga' bar bcas ka yi 6)phreng gis rnam par brgyaname/ /zhal gsum phyag drug rnam pa can/ /g.yon na shes rab ral gri bsnams(she/ /gzugs dang dbyibs rnams ji bzhin du/ /dbus kyi dkyil 'khor ri9)mchod par bya/ /phyi rol gzugs kyi rdo rje sogs/ /mtshams kyi char ni rnam par dgod/ /shar la sogs pa'i snam bu la/ /byams pa sa yi snying po shar/ /'jam dpal phyag na rdo rje lhor/ /mkha' snying 'jig rten dbang phyug ni/ /kun nas nub tu bsgom par bya/ /sgrib pa 7rnam par sel ba dang / /kun du bzang po byang du dgod/ /zhal gsum phyag drug rnam pa 81—864

can / /g.yon na ral gri dgod pa dang / /phyag na rdo rje dri med pa'i/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi ni gdan/ /lha mo rnams la zla ba'i gdan/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng na gsal/ /rnam par snang mdzad rigs las byung / /mtshan ma'i phyag rgya la sogs dgod/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgo rnams su/ / gshin rje gshed 1la sogs pa dgod/ /zhal gsum phyag drug rnam pa can/ /de bzhin ral gri g.yon na 'dzin/ /mi g.yo la sogs mtshams rnams su/ /gshin rje gshed kyi rang ngo bo/ /zhal gsum phyag drug rnam pa can/ /g.yon na ral gri rnam par bsam / /gang phyir shes rab rang bzhin g.yon/ /de bzhin g.yon nas naral gri brjod/ /gnod mdzes de bzhin gtsug tor ni/ /'og dang steng du rnam par dgod/ /khro bo rnams ni nyi mar bzhugs/ /de bzhin sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan / /de bzhin phyag rgya dbyug la sogs/ /nye bar mtshon nas dgod par bya / /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam dag pa'i/ /ri mo lnga ni rnam par dgod/ /de la rdo rje 'bar ba'i phreng/ /ra ba yis / ni yongs su bskor/ /rin chen dra ba rnga ma dang / /lha mo rnams kyi 4nisnam bu yis/ /ka ba rta babs 'khor lor mtshan/ /ri dgas (5)rnams kyi mtshan pas brgyan phyi/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan sogs / /rnga yab me long la sogs kyis/ /brgyan sne pa ru ni rnam par bshad/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis yang dag brtenatshon/ /slob dpon mchog gi dkyil 'khor ni / /rang gi lus kyi gzugs brnyan no/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyis 9 bya ba/ /bgegs bskrad pa tshini sngon song bas/ /sum+bha'i sgra dang ni sum+bha/ /thog mar oṃ dang ngo mtshar che/ /rtsu gnyis phaṭa kyi mtha' dang ldan/ /shar gyi sgo ru dgod par bya/ /oṃ dang groṇ+ḍa groṇ+ḍa 11zhes/ /hūṃ gnyis phaṭa dang yang dag ldan/ /blo 81—865

dang ldan pas lho ru dgod/ /oṃ dang gro: 97pa ya gnyis/ /r+ghaṃ gnyis phaṭa kyi mtha' dang ldan/ /nub tu yang dag spro bar bya/ /oṃ ā (snyen ya ho bha ga / bān dang bit+yā rā dza ( dang / /hūṃ gnyis dang ni phaṭa mthar byadagod/ /de rjes yang ni byang du dgod95)/ /'di yis gdug ⑥pa bkug nas ni/ /de nas sngags pas phur pa gdab/ /seng ldeng las ni byas pa yi57/ /phur bu sor ni bcu gnyis tshad/ /zur gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan/ /yi ge brgya pa so sor bzlas / /sngags kyi chu yis bsangs nas ni/ /phyogs dang mtshams (8)su dgod par bya/ /oṃ dang yi ge gha lan gnyis/ /de bzhin ghā (9)ta ya ni ⑩gnyis/ / sarba du/ phaṭa zhes tsodang / /de bzhin tī la ya gnyis dang / /sarba pā paṃ phaṭa dang ni/ /hūm̐ gsum badz+ra tī la ya/ /badz+ra dha ra ā 81 pa ya ti/ /kā ya bā rtsit+ta nyusnyebadz+ra dang / /tī tshal ya rtsu phaṭa yi ge'i/ /mtha' can gyi ni phur bus gdab/ /oṃ dang badz+ra mun ra/ /badz+ra tī la ya ā 8ko ṭa/ /ya 8dang rtsu gnyis phaṭa mtha' dang / /sngags dang phur bus brdung ba brjod/ /de 4)rjes bgegs ni 'jug la sogs/ /bskrad don rdo rje ra ba dang / /steng du mda' yi dra ba dang //'og tu sna tshogs rdo rje dang / /gtsug tor gnod mdzes sngags kyis ni/ /byin gyis brlab pa'i cho ga yis/ /bum pa bcu 'am yang na drug /rin chen las byas rnam dag pa/ /sman lnga dang ni 'bras bu lnga/ /'bru lnga la sogs kyis gang ba / /rin chen lnga dang sna ma sogs/ /lo ma lnga yis rnam par brgyananyusnye/ /gur gum nyu9)gla rtsi ga pur dang / /tsan+dan chu yis gang bar bya/ /me tog la sogs kyis mchod bya/ /rang rang sngags kyis 7byin gyis brlab/ /badz+ra sgrika ( rnyedang dzi na dzig 2 /rat+na lhag 2snyedang ā ri )ro lika lha /de bzhin pradz+nyā :ka (nyesngags dang / /81wa 866

lcags kyu'i rnam pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /'og min 6)'jig rten khams nas ni/ /bum pa rang gis bskur byas pa/ /de nas spyan drangs nas ni gzhug(gu /de nas lha mo'i gzugs spros nas/ /de rjes gzhan la dgod par bya/ /oṃ dang ru ru spu rinaru dang / /de nas dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha (gegasal/ /de bzhin sid dha chi5)lo tsa de96kyi/ /sarba (7)ar+sha sā dha ne(8)/ /swā hā zhes ni de la bzlas/ /spyan gyi rnam pa rdzogs nas ni / /bum pa'i dbus su mchod par bya/ /oṃ dang shaṃ ka re dang yang 59༄ de las shārnyi 7ku ru dang / /de bzhin kurtsi ghar+bhe dang / /lhuṭi ne dang lhuṭi ne/ /sna 47ta ya ni lan gnyis brjod/ /swā hā'i mtha' can sngags brjod bya/ /mā ma tī yi rnam pa rdzogs/ /bum pa'i dbus su mchod par bya/ /oṃ dang ka ṭi 1ཿbi ka shephonye / /ni ka ṭi ka ṭaṃ ka sherdzi/ /ka ro ṭa bīḥ geswā hā/ /gos dkar rnam par rdzogs nas ni/ /bum pa'i dbus su mchod par bya/ oṃ dang tā re duṣ+ṭha re / /tu re swā hā dgod par bya/ /sgrol ma'i rnam pa rdzogs nas ni/ /bum pa'i dbus su mchod par bya/ /gshin rje (7gshed sogs gzhan rnams la/ /gcig la las ni thams cad pa/ /oṃ na maḥs man+ta kā nya 7ya bā rtsit+ta bsto 〉nyu / na mo 1rtabadz+ra gro dhā rdo )ya/ ma hā rdatho kāta ka ṭa hai ra wā na ya/ a si mu sa la/ /ba ra shu pā sha ha stu ya/ oṃ a mṛ (nyeta kuṇ+ḍa li/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ tiṣ+ṭha ti ṣ+ṭha/ brnya brnyasaste/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ gadz+dza gadz+dza ga/ bi sbo ṭa ya bi sbo ṭa ya / sarba bi du 9bi nā ya kān/ ma hā ga ṇa 2 tshopa ti/ dzī da 2bi ta an+ta ka rā rtaya rgyu phaṭa swā hā/ sngags 'di lan bdun bar du ni/ /las ni thams cad pa yin te / /snying po'i sngags ni bzlas byas la/ /rigs kyi dbang phyug mchod par bya/ /yi ge brgya pa'i sngags kyis ni/ /lan bdun bar du bsgom par bya/ /brgya dang 81wa 867

rtsa brgyad rim pa yis/ /yi ge gsum yang bzlas pa ni/ / de nas nyu)rang lha'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /mchod yon snod du mchod par bya/ /de nas du gu la ras ni / /ga pur a ga rus bdugs 3pa/ /bkab nas rang rang sngags dang ni/ /de la rim bzhin lhag gnas bya/ /zhal gsum phyag drug rnam pa can/ /sprin bral nam mkha' lta bu'o/ /de lta bu yi sku mdog phyag /rang snang ba yi sku la 'khyud / / ā li kā ri li las byung ba/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /gzhal yas khang dbus nyams dga' ba'i/ /'og min zhing khams na bzhugs pa'i / /dkyil 'khor 'khor dang bcas par rdo4)ni/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi cod pan can / /bsgoms nas de las 'od zer spro/ /kha dog lnga dang lcags kyu yi/ /de yi spyan drangs 5slob dpon gyis/ /sngags brjod nas ni spyan drang bya/ /e gye hi dang bha ga bān ri/ /sa ma ya ma nu sma ra/ /tiṣ+ṭha gnyis dang sa ma ya/ /de la a nu sma 7ra gnyis/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje dang / /swā hā'i namatha' can yilan gsum brjod/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje spyan drang bya/ /dkyil 'khor ba dang yang dag ldan/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su spyan drang babo/ /rang gi gdan gyi dbye ba la/ /bzhugs shing yang dag mchod par bya/ /rang rang sngags dang rim ji bzhin / /lha yi me tog sogs kyis mchod/ /'khor lo mchog ni mchod par bya / /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'dir/lha/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin grong ske/ /yo byad ci sna 'byor pa yis ni/ /dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyi bar 'tshal / /thugs kyis 1 brtse bar nyer dgongs te/ /mgon pos mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /oṃ sarba chota thā ga tā ṭ+wāṃ/ pū mdzo pa'i na yā ād+ma 7rna ni t+yā ta yā tsomi / bla mas yi ge gsum ni brjod/ /lha yi 718rnam par byas nas ni/ /de 81—868

rjes bdag la mchod par bya/ /oṃ sarba 1)ta thā ga ta(na/ /pū dzā sabadz+ra swa bhā ba/ /ād+ma ko3 (0rta zhes ni brjod/ /rang lha'i nga rgyal byas nas ni/ /ji ltar bskyed pa'i yul shernams dang / /gnod byed kha na ma tho med/ /zhe sdang chen po'i rigs las byung / /dkyil 'khor dbang phyug mchod bya zhing / /de nas pa lha rnams lhag gnas bya/ /yid 'phrog sna tshogs lha yi gos/ /ga pur a ka 7ru yis bdug(8) /sngags kyis 99)dag byas dgab 7par bya/ /oṃ dang tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hoḥ lha / /brjod nas dkyil 'khor lhag gnas bya'o/ /oṃ dang s+pha ra badz+ra hoḥ12/ /blo dang ldan pas sngags 'di brjod/ /me tog spar bas gtor nas ni/ /lhag gnas der ni gshegs par bya/ /rnam pa kun dang yang dag ldan/ /dkyil 'khor mchog ni mthong bar bya/ /rigs lnga'i rang bzhin bzang po yis/ /bcom ldan gzugs brnyan 12bsgoms nas ni/ /me long sogs la khrus bya zhing / /de bzhin rdzas dang 'o ma sogs/ /ji ltar bltams mipa tsam gyis kyang / /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ba/ /de bzhin bdag gi 7sku khrus gsol/ /cod pan dbang phyug rdo rje sems/ /dbus su yi ge gsum dang spel/ /ṭ+wā hā'i mtha' can tsobarjod par bya/ /las kyi de nyid cho ga shes/ /de rjes sbyar ba'i gtor ma bya/ /oṃ sarba 1 ā ba ra ṇa/ /shud+dha sarba lho rimā paṃ dang / /bi shud+dha badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ /swā hā'i mtha' can sngags brjod bya/ /pad+ma bskor ba'i phyag rgya dang //yungs kur 39dkar po bsregs byas nas/ /nyon mongs pa ni sel bar byed/ /'khyud tsho cing bskor bas mdor bar bya/ /de nas cho ga bzhin legs mchod na/ /sil snyan glu la sogs pa dang / /bcom ldan 'das la dbul bar bya /rang rang sngags dang go rims lhabazhin/ /oṃ sarba na ta thā ga ta/ /buṣ+ka pū dzā 5me gha 81—869

dang ske/ /sa mu dra shi)dang s+pha ra ṇa/ /sa ma ya dang shri ye āḥ.e/ /hūṃ gi sngags ni rjes su brjod/ /rdzas rnams kun la rang ming ni/ /gzugs la sogs pa snga ma bzhin/ /cho ga bzhin du yang dag brjod/ /rdo rje sems dpa' legs bsgyings pa/ /rdo rje slob dpon cho ga shes/ /sngags 'di yis ni rab gnas bya//oṃ dang su pra tiṣ+ṭha dang / /badz+ra swā hā'i mtha' can bzlas/ /yi ge gsum gyi snying po ni/ /sku gsung thugs la bkod nas ni/ /me tog char ni dbab par bya / /slob dpon slob ma'i tshogs dang bcas/ /glu ①yis yang dag bskul nas ni / /sad pa na ni phyag kyang byas/ /las kun bdag nyid rnal 'byor bdag /gtor ma don kun grub par byed/ /las la byang zhing ④mkhas pa dang / /cho ga bzhin du bsgyings (5)bcas dang / /chang dang sna tshogs sha dang ni/ /de bzhin la du 'o ma dang / /'bras chan (6)phye yi khur (chub dang / /sran khur (nyebye ba mang po dang / /mchod yon me tog sogs kyis mchod/ /snod bcu 7chu yis gang ba la'ol/ /gsungs pa'i khro bo bcu sngags kyis/ /snga ma bzhin du cho ga yis/ /de dbus 'byung po kun la ni/ /ngo mtshar chen po'i gtor ma sbyin/ /snga ma bzhin du cho ga yis/ /til bsregs bza' bas khyad par du/ /blo dang ldan pas sngags bzlas bya/ /'di ni don kun sgrub byed pa/ /oṃ brah+ma de ba tā sarba②/in+d+ra da sha lo ka rak+ṣa ka /nā ga gan dha r+bha rku bhā /sheṇ+ḍa/ yak+ṣa khyu ta ga ṇaḥ8/ta thā bre ta ut+pa 7ta/ pi shā tsi skis pa smra ra(nye/ ḍā ki nī gra ha/ bi mā trog ṇa/ sarba ta thā ga ta ag ni skyem ra gra hā/ oṃ dzo bhak+ṣa ma hā te dza/ ma nu ṣ+pe nā ’ ma/ bi ho / sa ka /mu dā hu(man+t+ra a dhi dho bh+yaḥso)tsa/ gra hā nak+ṣa tra ma nu ṣ+pe ma / i me ba lo/ pra gro sna n+tu/ sirnyi m+me pra yats+tshan+tu du me san dha/ sa t+ya ma ne 81—870

ṣā 67ka ra me 6(snye/ sata sa ha ya bha ban tu tse/ dhā na dhā na/dkyi/ su pa ra nañcangs / dha ḍān+tu ma ma to ṣi ta95)/ i ti u pā tākho 96tho ṣa ṇi satā ta nā ma nā 7sha yan+tu tse(de/ thog mar oṃ dang āḥs phaṭa/ /swā hā'i mtha' can las kun byed / /de ltar sngags 'di snod la bzlas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rnam par rol/ /slob ma lhag par gnas par bya 9)/ /mtshan nyid yon tan gyis brgyan 1 pa/ /tsan+dan ga pur gla rtsi yi/rnye/ /chu yis kyang ni khrus byas te/ /dad pa'i chu ni 'chang ba yisa'i/ /sems kyi dri ma rnam par 'khrud/ /bdog pa thams cad gtong bar byedam/ /gos gtsang hunyeb ni mchog tu bgo/ /khang pa brtsegs ma bibyas nas ni/ /ras kyi yol ba kun nas bre/ /yi ge gsum dang yang dag ldan/ /rdo rje can gyis chasngags chu ni/ /lan bdun gdong la gtor ba 7yis/ /las skyes dri ma sbyong bar byed/ /de nas sa yi ñca 7snying po sogs/ /mig la sogs la rnam par dgod / /sor mo dbu ma gnyis kyis ni/ /dbang po so so la reg pas/ /sngags brjod bya zhing byin gyis brlab/ /lus kyi dkyil 'khor rnal 'byor gyis/ /oṃ dang tsak+ṣa tsak+ṣuḥhu dang / /sa man+ta dang tsak+ṣuḥ36bzlas/ /mi tri satwa lo tsa ne/ /sarba rdzo )ar+sha sā dha ni/ /swā hā'i mtha' dang sngags 'di brjod/ /mthe bo gung mo yang dag sbyar/ /zhabs bsil 31)chu dang mnyes tsho rtanas ni/ /sngags de lan gsum bzlas par shustebya/ /slob ma'i mig la so sor ni/ /mthe bo'i phyag rgyas reg par bya/ /khru gang ba la sor bzhi pa'i/ /skud pa zhags pa 'dra ba la/ /yi ge brgya pa'i sngags lan gsum/ /bzlas nas zhabs bsil chus bsang 34bya/ /skud pa lan gsum dkris ④pa ni/ /rdo rje gsum ni mdud par ldan/ /dpung pa g.yon par bcings pa ni/ /sngags 'di lan gsum brjod par bya/ /oṃ 81—871

dang lo tsa ne 1yi sgra/ /ya ta tad haṃ 2)se pra te/ /mi ཿbha bi shudhi (༄yi sgra/ /ro dang rat+na mutra yā ya/ /sidhi na ni da da sha56 /ya swā hā yi sngags 'di ni/ /theg pa bla med lan bdun bzlas/ /slob ma la ni me tog ri rigator/ /de nas rdo rje 'chang gis ni/ /sor ni bcu gnyis gzhal ba yin)/ /zur ni gsum du yongs su bya/ /yi ge gsum gyis byin brlab (94)bsgom/ /slob ma'i lag tu gtad par bya / /oṃ dang pra ti badz+ra dang / /sa man+ta bodang i 3)shwa ri/ /āḥrgyu swā hā'i mtha' can sngags/ /bzlas nas slob mas dor bar bya/ /sar 'bab pa yi yinaphur bu ste/ /phyogs ni gang du lta ba nyid/ /slob dpon dang ni slob ma yis/ / de yi 51 phyogs bltas nyal bar bya/ /nam langs 8yang dag bla ma la/ /ji ltar mthong ba'i don kun zhu/ /de la dmigs nas sbyin sreg 7ni/ /zhi ba la sogs rab dbye bas/ /las ni thams cad pa nyid dam/ /bgegs zhi ba yi 8don du bya / /rdo rje sems dpa' bsgyings bcas pas/ /rnal 'byor ji bzhin cho ga bzhin / /sngar bzhin 'dir yang gtor ma ni/ /bgegs rnams zhi phyir sbyin par bya/ /de nas gsol 'debs slob ma ni/ /rdo rje slob dpon thugs rjes khyab / /thal mo sbyar bar 97byas nas ni/ /mdun du 'dug nas phyag byas te/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i :shetshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid stsal du gsol1ge/ /sdom pa rnams kyang bdag la 455so )/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /de nas bla mas de la yang / /bya dang mi bya gsungs pa ni/ /sems can las kyi srad bus gdab / /rdul tshon bkye rnamaba'i rim pa dgye rte/ /'gro ba 'di dag dkyil 'khor 81—872

te / /rang bzhin dag pa gnyis med pa'o/ /thog mar dkyil 'khor rnal 'byor bdag /rdo rje slob dpon rang nyid bsgom/ /slob ma bdag nyid 'drar dmigs nas/ /de 'og thams cad rab bsgrub bya/ /bla ma bzang la dbang bskur phyir/ /slob mas de 1—rjes gsol ba gdab/ /'di nas na 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho la( kyi/ /nyon mongs chu srin na kras 4)khyab/ /las kyi rlung gis 5 dba' klong 6'khrugs / /bdag byin 7)thugs rje'i rgya mtsho byerten/ /mi shes ling tog gis bsgribs 99)mig /nyon mongs dbang du bya ba ni/ /bde ba sdug bsngal 'jigs las skyob/ /thugs rje'i rgya mtshos bdag skyabs mdzod/ /de 'dra tshig gsan rdo rje can/ /thugs rje'i thugs ni yongs su gang / /slob ma la ni yongs su gsungs / /bu khyod dus 'di nas bzung ste/ /rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung lugs bstan / /rnal 'byor mchog ni khyod kyis zung bo/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i spyod pa'i gnas / /bu khyod 'di ni bdud nyu)rtsi ste/ /srungs 12shig ma srung 1snyen ni sregs /bsrungs na dngos grub kun 'grub ma'agyur/ /nyon mongs thams cad sel ba'i klung tshe/ /oṃ dang pañca a mṛ 7ta/ / u da ka 18dang āḥ/ ja3na/ /slob mas bdud rtsi lnga btung bya/ /rdo rje ye shes rmad ( tshobyung ba'o/ /gsang ba dran na skyon 'gyur phyir/ /rdo rje slob ma la ni dbab/ /dri chen dri chu la sogs pa/ / mtshal chen tsho rje'abab pa'i gebu mo'i gos/ /khrag dang khu bas yang dag bsgos/ /gu gul dang ni rnam par bsres de/ /yi dgas me 24ni blangs nas su/ /pad+ma'i snod du bzhag nas ni/ /der ni thams cad gzhug snyepar bya/ /khro bo rdo rje gsum bdag nyid/ /g.yas brkyang ri 9ba yi gnas pas gnas/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang slob ma la/ /rmad byung chen po'i bdug pas bdugs / /'bab par 'gyur 81—873
