bar the tshom 1nyemed/ /oṃ kyitiṣ+ṭha ma hā gro dha/ /de bzhin ā (gyebe sha ya rtsu/ /rnal 'byor pa yis sngags 'di brjod/ /slob ma la ni gsal bar dbab/ /badz+ra satwa ri4 nyi ma he/ / bibyā rā dza ya bit+yā (snyem he/ /de ltar sngags ni 'di yis kyang ske/ /slar yang slob ma dbang bskur nas/ /rang bzhin gyis dag rang gi lus / /dkyil 'khor mchog 'di mthong ba na/ /de bzhin gshegs dang lha mo dang ske/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyi ri yang dag gzhi/ /khro bo khyab pa'i gsang ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' rten (7)dang ni/ /phyi dang nang gi dkyil 'khor ni/ /gnyis po de la bstan par bya/ /slar yang slob mas gsol ba gdab/ /bdag la dbang bskur 58)mdzad du gsol/ /rnam rgyal bum pa blangs nas ni/ /pad+ma'i snod ni bzang po la/ /de yi dbus su blo bzang po/ /hūṃ rdor las byung mi bskyod rigebasgom/ /rang nyid ye shes sa bon gyi/ /'od zer yang dag bskul bas byung ske/ /slar yang ye shes sems dpa' bsgom/ /mi bskyod 7pa yi rnam pa mchog /mi bskyod tsha/mngo bo de nyid kyis/ /rnam par shes pa'i phung po bsgom/ /slob ma'i mgo bor lag pa bzhaga'i /rdo rje slob dpon thugs rjes khyab/ /oṃ dang ma hā satwa dang 51snye/ /de bzhin zhi shwa ra tai chadang / /a bhi ṣiñca 8mi swā hā la/ /oṃ sarba 7ta thā ga hu ta/ /a bhi ṣe ka sa ma ya/ /shri 7ye āḥrgyu de nas bzla / /chu yi gting nas slob ma la/ /dbu rgyan dbang bskur ṭu )don du ni/ /cod pan 'jig rten gsum rgyal po/ /sems can kun gyi don sgrub (7pa/ /snying rjes khyab pa ngas sogabyin gyis 2nye/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i yon tan gnas/ /sa bon traṃ shustelas byung ba yi/ /rin chen 'byung ldan bsgoms nas ni/ /ri mo dar sogs cod pan yang zhuge/ /slob ma'i mgo la sbyin par bya/ /oṃ sarba ( sneta thā ga ta//87wa 874

rat+na mu ku 4①sgra dang / /de bzhin sgra dang pū dza ya/ /a tiṣ+ṭha dang āḥ(gyirgyu dang / /sngags 'di dag ni brjod nas ni/ /me tog mgo la sbyin par bya/ /slob ma rdo rje dbang bskur phyir/ /slar yang bla ma la gsol gdab/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin dngos/ /rdo rje brtul ②zhugs ngas byin gyis④/ /gang gis ma rig sgo nga 'byed/ /ye shes thob 'gyur nga yis byas/ /hrīḥlas pad+ma rdzogs par ni / /'od dpag med du rnam par bsgom/ /rdo rje lag pa g.yas par sbyin/ /slob ma la ni 'di skad brjod/ /ngas khyod de phyiring dbang bskur bya/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /kun du bzang po'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /dngos grub bzang phyir rdo rje long (6)/ /khaṃ las byung ba'i ral gri 'am/ /don yod grub pa'i rang ngo bo/ /rdzogs par lag pa g.yon par ⑦ni/ /slob ma bsgyings pa'i phyag rgya 'dzin/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /dril bu sgra yi (8)rjes 'gror brjod/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /byang chub mchog ni rgyal ba'i gzhi/ /rdo rje dril bu bzung rjes la/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rang 0ngo bo / /rang bzhin yon tan rnams kyis gang / /bdag po yi ni rnal 'byor 'gyur / /rnam par snang mdzad rang ngo bo/ /slob ma'i mgo la lag bzhag ⑩ste/ /rdo rje can gyis ming dbang bskur/ /gzugs kyi phung po rnam par bsgom/ /oṃ sarba 'o ta thā ga ta/ /che ge mo zhes badz+ra sa nyunye// /a bhi ṣiñca hunyemi swā hā/ /phung po lnga yi rnam dag pas/ /thog mar chu nas ming gi mthar/ /dbang bskur ba ni mchog tu shes/ /rmad tsobyung chen po bshad par bya/ /sangs rgyas lnga ni dag pa 'di / /dbang bskur lnga ni thob par 'gyur/ /ma rig pa ni bsal snyinas ni/ /ye shes lnga ni thob par 'gyur/ /de nas rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /slob ma 'dod 81—875

don sngags dbang sbyin/ /sngags kyi dbang bskur ye shes mchog /ngas byin dngos grub ster bar byed/ /de nas yi ge drug sngags phaṭa/ /swā hā'i mtha' can yi ge gsum/ /kha ni dam tshig gis bkang nas/ /sngags kyi sku yis ①dag pa dang / /bla ma'i zhal las yang dag brjod/ /bla mas dngos grub sbyin bya'i phyir / /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /snying po yi geni ye shes mchog /sangs rgyas thams cad bsdus pa ni/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /de nas slob ma spyod brtul zhugs/ /sna tshogs bsam pa'i bye brag gis/ /gang gi spyod pa rnam dag pa/ /'dod la thugs rje'i gtso bo yis/ /sems can don ni byed pa'i thabs/ /nga yis laspyod pa'i brtul 9gezhugs sbyin/ /de nas glegs bam dung la sogs/ /mda' gzhu ral gri 'khor lo dang / /sngon bzhin sngags kyis /zhesadag par byed/ /slob ma'i lag tu rim bzhin sbyin/ /'di ni kun bzang spyod brtul 96༄zhugs/ /bsam pa sna tshogs rnam dag byed/ /khyod mekyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /sems can kun gyi don gyis byos/ /oṃ sarba lata thā ga ta/ /de bzhin d+dhā tshageṭa ra rta dang / / dhar+ya mi āḥrgyu dang bo/ /de ltar sngags 'di dgod par bya/ /de nas lung bstan 17thob don du/ /bsam pa dang bas bla ma la / /da nye ltar sangs rgyas rigs su 'jug / khyed kyis nyunyebadag la lung bstan gsol / /don yod rdo rje zhes bya khyod/ /rigs kyi dbang phyug lung bstan ④bya/ /de nas slob ma dbugs dbyung 'dod/ /bla ma'i zhal snga nas ni skye/ /mgon po yang dag bdag dbugs phyung / /byang chub spyod pa'i brtul zhugs brtanam/ /de nas rdo rje chos gos mtha'/ /g.yon pa'i lag pas bzung nas ni/ /g.yas pa mi 'jigs sbyin byas la/ /dbugs dbyung ba yi mchog bya ba/ /nga yis rdo rje 81—876

gsung bdag khyod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi go 'phang mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' mngon par brjod/ /khams gsum gyi ni rgyal po che/ /dpal ldan yon tan 'byung gnas bdag /bdud kyi stobs ni 1kun las rgyal/ /grong khyer mchog tu khyod zhugs so/ /de nas slob ma don 'dod la/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur (lde)bya/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur ( che/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la stsol/ /de nas ye shes rdor dbang phyug /ye shes sems dpa'i 'od zer gyis/ /spyan drangs sangs rgyas lnga la sogs/ /lha mo'i 'khor lo rim bzhin 'byung / /de yis ye shes chus bkang ba'i/ /bum pa phyag bsnams de bzhin gshegs/ /rdo rje 'dzin dang rgyal ba rgyal/ /rin chen 'dzin dang 'khor ba sgrol/ /shes rab 'chang ni rim pa bzhin/ /gti mug zhe snang 'dod chags la/ /de bzhin rdo rje dga' ma sogs/ /gshin rje mthar byed shes mthar (gebyed/ /pad+ma mthar byed bgegs mthar byed/ /'di yis kun nas dbang bskur bas/ /rdo rje slob ma rnam par bsam/ /dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje che / /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /gsang ba gsum gyi gnas las byung ske/ /sangs rgyas kun ni 5nga yis sbyin/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs lha mo/ /khro bo rang gi gnas su dgod/ /'jam dpal rnam par bsgoms nas ni/ /ye shes rdo rjes rnam par brgyan6/ /oṃ dang 7su pra tiṣ+ṭha dang tshon/ /badz+ra swā hā zhes ni dgod/ /blo bzang gis lhorani sngags brjod nas/ /slob ma la ni me tog gtor / /de nas me tog sogs kyis mchod/ /slob ma'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo 'dra / /thugs rjes khyab pa'i bla ma yis/ /de nas slob ma rjes gnang bya/ /de nyid shes pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /mi bya ba ni ci yang med/ /dpal chen khyod kyis 81—877

bka' ༅drin gyis/ /da ni 'dod yon lnga la spyod/ /sgyu ma rmi lam 'drar shes nas / /rten 'brel las byung chos rnams ni/ /gzugs brnyan lta bur shes nas ni / /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /bya ba byas pa'i slob ma ni/ /ci bde bar ni bsgrub (gepar gyis(mi/ /de nas bla ma la yon dbul/ /bstod cing kun nas phyag kyang bya/ /skye bo bzang dang lhan cig tu/ /de nas bla ma gsang ④don gnyer/ /thur ⑤du kha bltas kha sbyar te/ /ji ltar bdag nyid chen po khyed/ /bdag kyang de dang 'dra bar mdzod/ /de nas rigs lnga las byung ba'i/ /las dang chos sogs dbye ba yis6)/ /sngags kyi theg pas lhag par grol/ /skal ldan bud med phyag rgyar bshad/ /skye bos dben (7pa'i mtshan phyed na/ /ro yi gzhi (8)yi gnas song nas/ /thugs rje chen pos khyab pa yi/ /rdo rje slob dpon yon tan 'byung / / ji ltar de nyunyeltar rnyed phyag rgya/ /snyoms ⑩'jug la ni gang byung ba'i / /bla na med pa'i rang bzhin gyi/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa ni/ /rnal 'byor ma yi yang dag ltung / /kun rdzob byang chub sems gang yin/ /gsang ba de yis hunyedabang bskur bya/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /dam tshig chen po rnam byung ba/ /khams lnga las byung bcud kyis len/ /bde ba chen pos myong /3bar gyis/ /slob ma rtog pa dang bral bas/ /pad+ma la gnas de myang gyis / /'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang ba yis/ /rgyal sras dzo/nyeji ltar dbang bskur bci / /byang chub sems kyi chu yis ni/ /bu khyod de bzhin dbang bskur bya/ /de nas shes rab dbang bskur phyir/ /bla mas don 'dod slob ma la/ /dngos grub thams cad bsdus pa ni/ /bdag la khyed kyis dbang bskur hunyestsol/ /de nas slob dpon bdag nyid che/ /phyag rgya yang dag byin gyis rlob/ /mchog ni 81—878

thob par bya ba'i phyir/ /de 'og slob ma la ni sbyin/ /lha mo phyag rgya chen po 'di//dpag med bde ba rab ster ba/ /bu yis kun nas blangs nas ni/ /bla na med pa'i mchod pa gyis/ /de nas shes rab ye shes de'i/ /sgrub po 1)mchog tu 'dod pa'i don/ /lha mo'i ye shes de nyid mchog/ dngos grub don du nga yis sbyin / /lha mos de la bka' bsgo ba/ /dpa' bo'i bu ni bla na med/ /dpa' bo khyod ni spro 'am ci/ /byang chub sems ni za nus sam/ /yang dag de ni nges par ni/ /ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du smros/ /ji ltar gsungs pa'i dam tshig mchog /lha mo ci phyir bdag mi nus/ /de nas lha mo de dgyes nas/ /spa bkrol gos ni bor nas kyang / /pad+ma dag ni 'byed byed cing / / bhañja mok+ṣa ༷naho zhes gsungs/ / bha ga'i pad+ma'i rdokyedabus gnas pa/ /bde ba kun du rgyu ba'i rtsa / /sor mos bskul nas dga' bar bya/ /dzi hwas 9na kyang ni rol bar bya/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i (snyebade byed pa/ /'di nyid rig pa bzang bsten na/ /mchog tu dga' bas nyams myong nas/ /lhung ba'i bde bas de myang bya/ /de nas bcom ldan ma dgyes shinas/ / bhañja mok+ṣa'i (7)sngags gsung 90zhing / /rkang pa g.yon pa mgo la bzhag /bka' yis de nyid yang dag bstan/ /de ring phan chad bu khyod kyis/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /rmi ḍakyilam bzhin du sems can gyi/ /bla na med pa'i don byos shig /bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa yi / / man ngag las ni 'di tshemi shes/ /rig pa 'di ni dor byas na31 / /thabs gzhan gyis ⑩ni sangs mi rgya/ /brtul 32zhugs rnams kyi mchog gi mchog /rig pa'i brtul 8zhugs bu yis spyod/ /de ltar 'di ni byang chub mchog /rdo rje rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma/ /rim pa bzhin du yongs shes bya/ /rdo rje sems 81—879

dpa'i go 'phang rten3)/ /bdag la go 'phang mchog stsol rdogelags/ /ting 'dzin kun gyis 'bras bu gsal/ /sems can kun la ci 'dod par/ /dngos grub bla na med pa gsolanano/ /slar yang gshegs par mdzad pa'i phyir/ /rang gi gnas gshegs badz+ra muḥ(ge/ / de nas (gelhag ma'i gtor ma sbyin/ /'khor lo lhag par 'byung ba'i rim/ /u khyus k+ṣe (6)tra pa la/ /a ti tsakra u sbyijig/ /su bho dza rna 9shebi ba gnyis/ /bhak+ṣa dushesteganyis dang sarba lco byedang / /sid dhi pra yats+tsha me dang ske/ /oṃ sngon āḥrgyu phaṭa swā hā/ /de yi rjes la 7brjod par bya/ /rdo rje dril bu 'chang 'gyur ba/ /g.yon brkyang ba yi gnas pas gnas/ /khams gsum rnam rgyal rang bzhin dang / /rdo rje slob dpon rang bzhin ni/ /khams gsum rnam rgyal rang bzhin 'chang / /de ltar cho ga nyi shu las/ /bskyed 8pa'i rim pa'i mtshan nyid bstan/ /de nyid mang du shes pa yis/ /bla ma dge ba'i las bzang 8po/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba 7mngon par rtogs pa las cho ga nyi shu'i snyilas rgyas pa'i le'u ste lnga bcu ri bzhi pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ / de yi spyo rgyu mtshan 'bras bu ni/ /las ni cho ga nyi shur bshad/ /dbang phyug chen po'i rgyu mtshan ci/ /de yi 'bras bu ci zhig 'gyur/ /chen po'i chen po ji skad gsungs/ /de nas bcom ldan rdo rjes gsungs/ /las kyi rgyu mtshan 'bras bu dang / /sngon du bsnyen pa'i las kyis ni/ /rgyu mtshan 'jig rten dngos grub brgyad/ /ser sna la sogs bsal ba'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas mchod pa rnam bsgom zhing / /sbyin pa tshul khrims bzod pa dang / /brtson 'grus bsam gtan rab tu rdzogs/ /shes rab ye 81wa 880

shes dbang bskur 0)gyis/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa rdzogs/ /gsang ba la sogs (gel gnas pa/ /skye bo chags pa'i rgyu mtshan no/ /kun du spyod pa'i chos rnams kyis/ /mnyam nyid ye shes rgyu yis ni/ /bla ma dad pas mchod pa ni / /rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang don/ /chu sogs ming ni mthar thug pa/ /ye shes lnga yi rnam dag phyir/ /spyod pa phyir mi ldog pa'i mtha'/ /sems can bsam pa rnam dag phyir/ /shes rab brtul (4༄zhugs sogs kyi mtha'/ /dpe 5)yis bde ba bstan pa'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor sa tshon phra rab dang / /mtshungs pa de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /mchod pa nyid du 'gyur ba dang / /de ltar 'bras bu 'khor lo 'jug /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pa ni/ /las kyi sgrib pa dag par 'gyur/ /shin tu rnam dag chos kyi dbyings/ /dbang bskur ba ni thob pa dang ske/ /dngos po'i ngo bo ji bzhin du/ /shes rab ye shes kyis ni thob/ /bla ma yis ni sgrub 6༄pa yang / /mchod pa de yi go 'phang mchog /de ltar yun mi ring bar 'thob/ /dag pa'i spyod pa brtul zhugs mchog /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba (7)mngon par rtogs pa las cho ga nyi shu pa'i rgyu mtshan dang 'bras bu bstan pa'i le'u ste lnga bcu (8)lnga pa'o// //de nas rdo rje sems dpas shedagasungs/ /mchod pa'i cho ga bla na med/ /gnyis med mnyam pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /lus la mchod pa'i cho ga'i rim/ /rdo shing sa dang gser gyi ni/ /sku gzugs la ni phyag mi bya/ /rab gnas dkyil 'khor sbyin sreg mdang / / de nas 3lhanam yang mi bya'o/ /dri chen rdor chu dkon mchog sogs/ /bdag nyid lnga ni rtag tu mchod/ /de phyir de la mngon zhugs 81—881

pa'o / /thugs kyi rdo rje rang nyid gtso/ /sems de yang ni de dngos med/ /gang phyir stong nyid mtshan nyid ni/ /stong nyid kyang ①ni rnam pa med/ /de phyir thams cad nam mkha' 'dra/ /de ltar rnam dag rnam shes kyang kun)/ /rtsa ni gsum la'ang mchod par bya/ /gang phyir sems kyi rang bzhin kun/ /sems las gzhan pa yod ma yin/ /rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /sems kyi rang bzhin la ni gnas/ /lha yi gzugs ni bla med pa/ /sems ma gtogs pa gzhan ni med/ /de phyir de ltar rnam dpyod ①pa/ /rang lus gcig pu rtag tu mchod / /rigs lnga dag (0tu rtag spyod pas⑤/ /rigs gcig tu ni rnam par brtagazhi/ /'dod dang mi 'dod dbye ba dang / /btung dang mi btung rnam par spangs / /rnal 'byor skal yod skal med ces/ /nam yang smra bar mi bya'o/ /phyag rgya'i rnam pa sngon po 7)sogs/ /de bzhin gzugs la'ang dbye ba gsum/ /gzugs rdo rje ma bkug nas su/ /sa snying la ni dbul bar bya/ /yang dag glu (8)dang brjod bral dbyangs(9)/ /de bzhin sgra la'ang dbye ba gsum/ /sgra rdo rje ma yang dag dgug /phyag na rdo rje la ni dbul/ /ga pur a gar dzā nyu )ti sogs/ /de bzhin dri yang dbye ba gsum/ /dri rdo rje ma yang dag dgug /nam mkha'i 37snying po la yang dbul/ /'o byed pa dang 'jib hu pa dang / /ro drug de bzhin dbye ba gsum/ /rdo rje ro ma yang dag dgug /'jig rten dbang phyug la ni dbul / /rdo rje pad+ma yang dag sbyor/ /gos dang 'khyud pa'i dbye ba gsum/ /reg bya rdo rje yang dag dgug /sgrib sel la ni dbul bar bya/ /phyi yi chos rnams 'di dag kun/ /brtags 32pa dang ni ma brtags 7pa'ang chos dbyings rdo rje yang dag dgug /'jam pa'i rdo rje la ni dbul/ /de bzhin phyi 81—882

dang nang dang ni/ /gnyis ka yang ni mi dmigs pa1)/ /gzugs la gsum du byas nas ni/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /yul ni lnga ni nges gnas ten/ /rgyud lngar nges par 'byung ba ni/ /rmi lam rlung dang ldan pa ru/ /'dod pa lnga rnams spyod par byed/ /dbang po gang dang gang lam gyis/ /sgrub pa po ni yul 'thob bo/ /de dag thams cad thugs rje che/ /mnyes pa'i phyir ni dbul bar bya / /yang dag dga' ba'i me tog gis/ /rdo rje nyi (2)ma pad+ma 'byung / /me tog bdag nyid la mchod pa/ /rdo rje gsum gyi dam tshig mchog /rnam rtog tshul gyi ri yul min 'a)zhing / /de ltar gtum 6)mo'i me yis ni/ /nges par bsregs 7pa de ni spos/ /thugs kyi rdo rje la ni dbul/ /rdo rje pad+ma yang dag par/ /zhugs pa la sogs rim las byung / /rnal 'byor pa yi mi shigs sgra(87/ /thugs rdo rje la dbul bar bya/ /yi ge hūm̐ las yang dag byung / /sngags kyi 'od zer shin tu gsal / /mar me 'bar ba'i yang dag 'od/ /thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya/ /bde ba chen po nam mkhar gnas/ /byang chub sems ni sad pa dang / /de nyid kyis kyang byugs pa ni/ /thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya/ /'dir ni gang dang gang longs spyod/ /dbang po thams cad yang dag bsten(9)/ /de dag thams cad thugs rdo rje/ /bza' ba'i snod du mchod par bya/ /dgod bodang sgeg dang rtse 'jo ni/ /sna tshogs kyis ni sems dga' byed/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo dag dang ske/ /thugs kyi rdo rje la ni dbul/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba (lhamangon par rtogs pa las nang gi bdag nyid mchod pa'i cho ga'i rnam par dbye ba'i le'u ste lnga bcu 7drug pa'o// //81—883

de nas bcom ldan rdo rjes gsungs/ /lha mo yi ni mtshan nyid mchog /rnal 'byor bde la rtog (1)pa rnams/ /rtsa dbye ba yi rang bzhin gyis/ /rtag tu lus kyi rtse 'jo bya/ /de yi lha rnams su ni bshad/ /rtag tu bde ba kun gyis dga' / /kun nas rnam par sgeg pa'i lus/ /bde ba chen pos rdo kun du khyab/ /lha nyid du ni yang dag brjod/ /dga' dang mchog tu dga' ba dang / /bral ba lhan cig dun)skyes skad cig /char (4 pa dang ni rtse 'jo dang / /kun nas lhag par sgeg pa dang / /brgyal dang sad par gyur pa dang / /de rnams lha mo ru ni bshad / /phyi rol du ni byung ba na/ /gang phyir yang dag sbyor bar 'gyur/ /lus kyi rtsa rnams yang dag sad/ /de phyir rnal 'byor mar ni bshad/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba (5)mngon par rtogs pa las lha mo'i mtshan nyid kyi le'u ste lnga bcu 96ribadun pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan rdo rjes gsungs/ /e bam̐ zhes bya yi ge gnyis/ /e ni stong pa nyid du bshad/ /de bzhin baṃ ni thugs rje dang / /thig le de gnyis sbyor las byung / /de ni rnal 'byor rmad mchog byung / /e bam̐ gnyis ni sangs rgyas dang / /mdor bsdus 9) chos kyi phyag rgya'o/ /rgyal po chen po phyag rgya gnyis/ /rgyud rnams su ni thog mar gsungs/ /e ni bha ga'i mtshan nyid do/ /pad+ma'i rten tshon du shes par bya/ /rten pa rdo rje zhes ni gsungs/ /brtan 9༄pa rdo rje 'chang ba yi/ /de la gnas pa'i thig le'i gzugs/ /sna tshogs sprul pa ston par byed/ /bde ba kun gyi gzhi yi gnas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba che/ /e ni gsang ba'i mkha' dbyings sam/ /bha ga chos 'byung pad+ma la/ /rnal 81—884

'byor seng ge'i gdan la bzhugs/ /mchog tu rmad byung ston par mdzad/ /rdo rje sems dpa' baṃ rdo rje/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed dbang phyug dang / /he ru ka dang dus 'khor lo/ /dang po sangs rgyas la sogs mtshan/ /e baṃ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgya/ /gnyis su med pa'i bde mchog dang / /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med dang / /gang la de nyid mngon par brjod/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i hūṃ/ /gnyis med ye shes mtshan ma ni/ /rgyud kun gyi ni gleng gzhir gsungs/ /rgyud kun gyi ni don bsdus pa/ /stong nyid snying rje mi phyed pa//gang la de nyid mngorno par brjod/ /e baṃ zhes bya'i 17yi ge gnyis/ /gang la 'di nyid med pa ni/ /de la de kho na nyid med/ /gang la de nyid yongs shes pa//btso ②ma'i gser ltar gsal por ni/ /rgyud ni legs bshad de nyid shes/ /sngags kyi spyod pa la gnas par/ /de ltar 'di ni de nyid mchog /e bo don ni rnam par nges/ /chos kyi phyag rgya yi ge gnyis/ /dang po'i ngag tu yang dag bshad / /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba mngon par rtogs pa las e baṃ zhes bya ba dang po'i ngag bshad pa 9na dang rgyu mtshan bstan pa'i le'u ste lnga bcu 0brgyad pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad kyis sbyon)nyon/ /e baṃ la sogs don rgyas pa/ /gang gis yang dag yongs su shes/ /chos kyi de ni yang dag rtogs/ /e/ e ni shes rab dam pa ste/ /'dod chags bral sogs skad cig bdag /srid pa gsum na yongs shes pa/ /'di ni rtsa bar rnam par bstan/ /bo/ 'od ma bsgreng 6)ba ltar mdzes shing / /chags la sogs pa rab bskyed 7ldan/ /snang ba 81—885

gsal ba rnam par shes/ /ming ni thabs shes bya ba yin/ /mtshi/ rig chen rang nyid rtsa ba ste/ /ma rig pa ni zlog 90pa yin/ /ma rig pa las 'di 'byung bas9 gte/ngar /de bas snang ba 'byung ba'o/ /lnga(5)/ 'gro ba rnam shes gsum dang po'i / /de ming snang ba gsal ba ste/ /de ni stong pa cher 'gyur la/ /de yang 'od gsal bar 'gro'o/ /shu/ snang ba gsum gyi mtshan nyid can/ /gang 'di rnam shes gsum thob pa/ /sems can khams ni ma lus pa'i/ /rang bzhin rtsa ba 'di yin no/ /rta(6)/ de ni re re'i don snang ba/ /rlung gis blangs nas 'da'adzin byed pa/ /lo98༄/ rlung dang ldan pa'i rnam shes ni/ /kun du 'gro la gnas par 'gyur/ /e(9 ni/ 'di ni rlung khams chen po ste/ /rnam shes gsum gyi bzhon bopa yin/ /de yis rang bzhin /rnyedag tu ni/ /ji lta /tshogeji ltar 'gro bar 'gyuralho / /ka /sra ba'i sa khams chu nyid dang / /de bzhin me dang rlung dag ni/ /rnam par shes par blangs nas su/ /srid gsum gnas su skye bar 'gyur / /smi/ 'di ni 'phung po lnga rnams su/ /'byung ba 'dus byas mtshan nyid ni/ /gzugs tshor 'du shes 'du byed dang / /rnam shes nyid ni lnga pa'o/ /sa5ge / mnyam nyid so sor rtog ri7pa dang / /bya ba grub pho 7pa nyid dang ni/ /me long dang ni chos kyi dbyings/ /'di ni ye shes lnga po yin/ /ma/ yid kyi skye mched nyid dang ni/ /mig dang de bzhin rna ba dang / /sna dang lce dang lus rnams te/ /'di ni skye mched rnams 'byung ba'o/ /ye/ gang yang khams gsum sems can rnams/ /srog dang rtsol nyunyeb la brten pa/ /gsang sngags rgyal po zlos 517bzhin du/ /mi shes bsam gtan klog pa spangs/ /bhaX bye/ 'di las rang bzhin chags pa dang / /chags med la sogs par yang 'gyur/ /de 81wa 886

las dge dang mi dge'i las/ /de las skye ba 'byung ba yin/ /ga /'gro ba 'byung ba'i phung po rnams/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi bdag nyid de/ /mngon par byang chub rnam lnga zhes/ /ming gis rab tu bskul ba yin/ /bān0)/ rlung dang chu dang me dang sa/ /spyan la sogs pa bzhi po ste/ /ye shes bdag nyid can gsum du/ /shes bya sangs rgyas byang chub ster/ /sa/ thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i skur/ /phyag rgya bzhis ni rgyas btab cing / /mig la sogs pa'i bdag nyid der/ /sa snying la sogs rgyal sras so/ /rba(ri/ rol pas dga' ba gang yin pa'i/ /khro bo'i rgyal po stobs chen rnams/ /de yi phyogs mtshams dzodango bo ru/ /dpung pa yan lag rnams su brtag /ta ge/ de dang de yi rigs (5las byung / /lha dang lha mo tha dad pa/ /de ni yod min de dag kyang / /'gro ba'i don phyir ston pa yin/ /56)/ 'di las gnyis med mthong ba yi/ /rnal 'byor pa ni ye shes gsum/ /mthong phyir dman dang bar ma dang / /dam pa'i yul la gzhag (medapar bya/ /ga /dbang po rang nyid rang yul la/ /'gro bar 'gyur ba de dang de/ /dbang po'i spyod yul gang dang gang / /de dang de snang tsam nyid do/ /ta(she/ dbang po de yi (9lam nas ni/ /sgrub pa pos ni yul thob pa/ /de bzhin de las ma gsungs par/ /tshim par bya phyir dbul bar bya / /kābi/ sku gsum dag ni tha dad par/ /skyob pa yis ni yang dag bstan / /rdzogs pa'i rim gyis sbyor ba yis/ /gcig tu yang ni 'gyur ba yin/ /yam / gang zhig sangs rgyas sku mtshan nyid/ /kun rdzob bden par gsungs pa ni / /de nyid rdzogs rim sbyor ba yis7/ /'od gsal bar ni rnam dag 'gyur/ /bā 62ka /tshig gi lam gyi yul 'di nyid/ /gtso bo ye shes sku rang bzhin/ /81—887

sems can kun 7la phan pa'i phyir/ /'ja' tshon bzhin du snang ba yin/ /tsi tam/ /sems dang sems byung ma rig pa/ /shes rab thabs dang nyer rigethob dang ske/ /stong dang shin tu stong pa dang / /stong chen zhes kyang rab tu brjod/ /ta kyi / rang bzhin snang ba'i dbye shes na/ /de nas spyod pa rab tu bya/ /las kyi lus ni yongs spangs nas/ /rdo rje sku nyid thob par 'gyur/ /bla(de/ thugs la 'jig rten pa rnams kyi/ /don spyod bzhag nas de bzhin gshegs/ /kun rdzob tu ni sprul skur gnas/ /ji lta (nyeji ltar 'dod pa spyod/ /dayi/ yid bzhin nor bu mchog bzhin du/ /'dod pa thams cad ster bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi phun tshogs kyang / /stobs kyis blangs nas spyod par 'gyur / /ya/ rnal 'byor dbang po gang gang 97/'dod/ /de ni sgrib pa med par bya/ /mnyam par ma bzhag 98)rnal 'byor gyis/ /rtag tu mnyam par 'jog par 'gyur/ /ba/ rdo rje pad+mo mnyam sbyor bas/ /ye shes gsum gyi cha rig pa/ /blo la gos dang ma gos pa/ /der ni bde bas rtag tu gnas/ /dz+ra/ sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /dngos dag kun las rnam par rol/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed bzhin du/ /gtan la phab pa'i gzhi la gnas/ /yo/ /rnal 'byor lhag pa'i rnal 'byor dang / /rnal 'byor chen po rang nyid 'gyur/ /rdo rje can dang mkha' 'gro ma/ /gang yang rnal 'byor de rang nyid/ /〉(spyod/dgag pa dag kyang byed pas na/ /bya dang bya min rnam spangs te/bo /pad+ma la ni 'dam gyis bzhin 1/ /ngo bo nyid ces 32gos mi 'gyur/ /bha/ yon tan brgyad dang nyer ldan pas/ /sems can thams cad rigs 'gyur zhing / /'jig rten khams ni ma lus par/ /bdag nyid ye shes lus kyis spyod/ /ge/81—888

gtso bo gang du spyod pa yi/ /de yi khyim ni nam mkha' nyid/ /bde ba chen po'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /de nyid du ni rtag tu rol/ /ṣā/ 'di 17la snang ba dbye ba la / /thun mtshams nyin mo mtshan mo yi/ /'jig rten tha snyad byas pa yis/ /ye shes gsum ni mthong phyir ro/ /ben/ sna tshogs pa yi tha snyad dag /'jig rten pas ni yongs brtags pa/ / lam gsum na gyi ni dbye ba yis / /ye shes gsum las byung sbyon)ba'o/ /dza/ skye dang gnas dang 'jig pa dang / /srid pa 6bar mar gnas pa ste/ /ji snyed 'jig rten gyis brtags pa/ /sems kyi rlung ni rnam 'phrul lo/ /ha/ dgod dang rtsed (7)mo byed pa dang / /gar gyi nyams dgur ldan pa dang / /sngags dang phyag rgya rnam rtog pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i spyod pa'o/ /ra/ bdag byin rlabs chen ma (87gtogs pa/ /rin chen gzhan dag 'di na med/ /me yis sbyangs pa'i nor bu bzhin/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal rnam pa'o/ /'di skad la sogs dang po'i ngag /mchog tu gsungs pa'i don rgyas pa/ /gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa ba'i mdo/ /de nyid bshad pa bsdus pa ni / /rim pa ji lta ba bzhin shes/ /sgrub po'i de nyid shes pa ni/ /ye shes mchog gi mtshan nyid kyis/ /gang du gsal bar ma gsungs so/ /rim pa 'di yis rnal 'byor pas/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa rgyas btab 9pa/ /de ltar rim pa 'di yis shes/ /sems can kun la phan skyed 7pa'o/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba mngon par rtogs pa las e baṃ ma yā 11zhes bya ba dang po'i ngag bshad pa'i le'u ste lnga bcu 1snyedagu pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad kyis 32nyon/ /nang gi bdag nyid sbyin sreg mchog /81—889

nang du rgyu ba'i 'byung 3)ba rnams/ /gang gis thim par gyur pa dang / /rnam rtog bag chags sa bon ni/ /phung po lnga yi bud shing dang / /rnal (mi'abyor ye shes chen po'i mes/ /rtag tu sbyin sreg ( rmad byung bya/ /lte dbus gnas pa'i sgra tsam ni/ /sgra tsam phyi rol gsang pad+ma/ /de la rang rgyud rlung gis ni/ /yongs su bskul ba'i me yis ni/ /dbang po gnyis ni yang dag sbyor/ /gzi brjid gsal bar rab tu 'bar/ /gang tshe mar gang gsang pad+ma/ /de la 'di ni snod du brjod/ /haṃ ④ni blugs gzar zhes byar gsungs/ /rdo rje dgang gzar du ni brjod/ /bha ga thab khung zhes ni bshad/ /dbang po lnga yi bsreg ⑤rdzas dang / /phung po yam shing du ni gyur/ /mar ni byang chub sems su bshad/ /gnam stong nas brtsams nya yi (yibar/ /ji srid byed pa gshegs su gsol/ /me thab thig le tsam du gsungs/ /blugs gzar nam yang mi 'phogab sangs rgyas gti mug dga' la sogs/ /gzugs rdo rje sogs rgyal sras rnams/ /khro bo'i (8nyergyal po bcu la ni/ /rtag tu sbyin sreg 0gis tshim bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i tsomachod pa gang / /de yang dgang blugs su ni brjod/ /hūṃ phaṭa yang dag ldan sngags kyis/ /cho ga bzhin du sreg ablugs dbul/ /de yis lus gnas mnyes 'gyur na/ /lha yi dam tshig bla na med/ /yid la ji ltar 'dod pa rnams / /de ltar dngos grub stsal nas ni/ /sbyin sreg 8'di ni mchog tu gsungs / /dngos grub kun gyi 'bras bu stsol/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba (1gemangon par rtogs pa las nang gi bdag nyid kyi sbyin sreg 8gi le'u ste drug cu tshepa'o// //81—890

de nas bcom ldan rdo rjes gsungs/ /bdud rtsi lnga ni bza' ba ni/ /dngos grub kun byed de nyid mchog /ji ltar rigs pa'i rim pa bzhin/ /rnam snang mdzad dang mi bskyod dang / /don yod grub dang 'od dpag med/ /rin chen rgyal mtshan lnga po ni/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi mtshan nyid do/ /khrag ni rin chen dbang phyug dang / /byang chub sems ni 'od dpag med/ /de bzhin don yod grub pa sha /mi bskyod de bzhin rdo rje chu/ /dri chen rnam snang mdzad du bshad/ /de dag bdud rtsi lnga ni mchog /bas mtha' nyams dga' skye bos dben/ /sgra yi tsher ma rnam par spangs/ /de la khang pa bya ba ni/ /khang pa gnyis brtsegs (33sgo dang bcas/ /sa 'og khang pa gcig bya zhing / /gzhan dag de yi steng du bya/ /gzhan ni gsangs ②nas bya ba ste/ /'jig rten pa ni gcig tu shes/ /sgrub pos de nyid kun shes shing / /sngags shes bsam pa rgya che ba/ /brtan zhing snying rje mkhas pa dang / /yul la phrag dog rnam par spangs/ /sgrub po gtso bo'i (5)yon tan gang / /de lta bu nyid sgrub grogs mchog /chags dang chags bral rnam par spangs/ /brtson zhing brkam chags med pa dang / /khro med dang bcas dpa' ba dang / /mang du thos shing yod par lta5ge/ /thog ma gnyis ka (5tshoyi ni lus/ /'bras bu sogs kyis dag bya ba/ /gnod mdzes skul yibyed 'dzum phrag gcig /de rjes sngags pas bzla bar bya/ /oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/oṃ groṇ+ḍa groṇ+ḍa ⑦ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ grosna pa ya gro: (8)pa ya rtsu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā (9nyen ya ho / bha ga bān bit+yā 0rā dza 7rgyu hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas zla gcig yi ge gsum/ /sgrub pos mi smra bzlas par 'bya/ /kun du bzang po 'gro ba'i gtso/ /de ni skad cig rmi lam mthong / /des ni bka' yis bsgo ba ni/ / ka n+ya mchog ni bsten kyi 81—891

gyis la/ /sems can don ni mtshungs med byos/ /ji ltar de nyid rdo rje 'chang ske/ /bu mo skal ldan mig yangs ma/ /gzugs dang lang tshos rnam par brgyan tsho / /brkam chags med cing chags bcas sems/ /sgeg (7pas myos shing bsgyings dang bcas/ /nu rgyas sngo bsangs nyams dga' ba/ /rnam rtog med cing mang du thos/ /sgrub pos de srid 'dod par bya/ /ji srid khu ba dang bcas gyur / /de nas gdong ni pad+ma gnyis/ /gnyis ka 'byung ba blangs nas ni/ /pad+ma'i snod der gzhag sa par bya/ /mtshan nyid bzang por zhag bdun du/ /glang po rta khyi ba lang mi/ /dpyid zla tha chungs gnyis ka ①shar/ /skye gnas nas (5rini blangs nas ni/ /de bzhin de ru rim pa bzhin/ /pad snod de nyid la ni der / /zhag bdun bar du gzhag 96dpar bya/ /nyin zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig tu/ /yi ge gsum ni sngags bzlas bya/ /'du 'dzi med cing dben pa'i gnas/ /tsan+dan bzang po byugs nas ni/ /dzaḥ/ rba hoḥ'i (7)sngags bkod ②pa'i/ /pad+mo'i snod la gzhag nyu)par bya/ /ra yi 'o ma til gyi mar/ /mar dang li ⑩kha dkar po dang / /cha bsnyams bskol ba byas nas ni/ /de dang lhan cig snod bzhag bsre/ /rgya shug tshig gru humatshad tsam gyis/ /blo dang ldan pas ril bu tsobya/ /grib ma la ni bskam rtso)byas nas/ /rim gyis bskyed cing bza' bar bya/ /rdo rje ming sring spun dang ni/ /rnal 'byor ma dang lhan cig bza'/ /zla ba gcig nas de nas lhag /mdza' bo rnams dang yang dag bsgo/ /mar ngo'i tshes brgyad tshes bcu 'am/ /yang na bcu bzhi nas brtsams te/ /de la gtor ma bya ba ni/ /las kun la ni bla na med/ /de las 8kyang ni dngos grub skye/ /phyag rgya chen po mngon rdzogs dang / /dngos grub rgyas dang zhi ba sogs/ /de yis 'bad mi 81—892

dgos par 'thob3)/ /rlung gi de nyid yang dag slobatshon/ /mkha' spyod nyid ni thob par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba mngon par rtogs pa las bdud rtsi lnga bza' ba'i cho ga'i le'u ste drug cu tsho gcig pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad kyis 94༄nyon/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo cho ga mchog /gang gis mchod pa las byung ba/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi dngos grub mchog /rnal 'byor che ⑤dang lhan cig tu/ /sgrub (6)pa'i phyir ni yang dag gnas/ /phyag rgya brda ni yongs shes shing / /de dang dam tshig la ni 'jug /de rnams tshogs ni rab mchog dang / /tshogs kyi 'khor lo zhes ni brjod/ /kun kyang dam tshig la gnas pa/ /rtog pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ /bla ma la dad dam tshig gnas / /gtong sogs yon tan rnams kyis brgyan ge/ /thabs zhes 8bya ba bgegs med na/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo la ni 'jug /gzhan du skyon ni 'byung 'gyur te/ /'khor lo la yang 'grub mi 'gyur/ /shes rab kyang ni thabs dang mtshungs / /mdza' bo bzang dang rab tu mkhas/ /lo ni nyi shu rtsa lnga lon/ /lhag ma yongs su spangs nas ni/ /thabs dang so sor shes rab dang / /kun la gcig ni phan yon med/ /thog ma yid 'ong nyams dga' bar/ /me tog gi ni dkyil 'khor bya/ /de nyid sna tshogs mchod pa ni/ /legs par mnyam par bzhag (khenas mchod/ /gtso bo dngos po kun gyis ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bzhin du mchod/ /tshogs kyi bomachod pa byas rjes la/ /dkyil 'khor lugs 'byung lugs bzlog phostepas/ /dad pa dngos pos kun nas ni/ /mnyam pas blta bas bsgoms nas ni/ /bstan bcos skanyams myong 'jig rten dang / /81—893

'gal ba de ni gzhug 0)mi bya/ /gzhan yang bstan bcos las gsungs pa/ /mtshan phyed na ni dgug par bya/ /slob dpon mgon la yang dag mchod/ /ji ltar gdan stengs (babazhugs gsol nas/ /gdan ni rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /phyag rgya chen po yang dag ldan/ /rdo rje slob dpon de nyid kyang / /mkhyen pa 'khor lo'i snyenadabus na bzhugs/ /dkyil 'khor pa ni gzhan rnams dang / /de bzhin 'khor lo gnas pa gzhan④/ /dkyil 'khor pa bzhin shes par (nyabya/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lor gtam smra dang / /rtsod dang de bzhin sgrub pa dang / /mchil snabs dor zhing dgod pa dang / /rkang pa la sogs rkyong0ba dang / /yang dang yang du ldang ba ni/ /de la dus kun du mi bya/ /phyag rgya brda yi ⑦tshogs rnams kyis/ /bya zhing bya bar shes par bya/ /shes bzhin du ni gar dang glu / /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du ni (8)bya/ /gtso bo la ni snod kyi mchog⑨ /dum bu gcig pa mtshan nyid bzang / /de med dum bu gsum pa la/ /me tog sna tshogs rnams kyis mchod/ / lha yi 0chang la sogs pa gang / /legs par mnyam par gzhag nyu1ste dbul/ /tshogs rnams la yang so sor snod/ /me tog tshogs kyis yongs gang ba/ /thog mar gtor ma chen po sbyin/ /sngon bzhin bza' (12ba la sogs ldan/ /gang gis dga' ba rnams phogenyams pa/ /de 'dra btung bar mi bya'o/ /yang dang yang du phyag byas nas/ /phyag rgya bcings 8nas btung bar bya/ /de nas bza' ba thams cad ni/ /sbyang bya sogs kyis yang dag sbyangasarige/ /oṃ dang āḥdang rtsu gis ni/ /sbyang dang sad tshedang rtogs par bya / /gur gum 3 tshotsan+dan dpa' bo dang / /gangs dang ri dgas 0lte ba dang / /'di ni dag byed bdud rtsi lnga/ /bza' ba 'di rnams rab tu spyod/ /sbom po 81—894

ming med sbyor ba yis/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rim bzhin/ / rang gi lce yis myang 0)bar bya/ / dpa' bo (snyedabus su dus kun du/ /kha la dpa' bo darnam par dgod④/ /bla na med pa'i mchod pa 55)bya/ /pad+ma'i lte 6)ba'i dbus la ni / /dpa' bo rnams kyi gdan du brjod/ /(7)gal 8)te dpa' bos ma 59)shes na// dpa' bo don gyi mtshan nyid rnams/ /bodangos grub thams cad stsol ba yi/1/ /'khor lo de yi 'bras bu med/ /de lta'i 'bras bu kyi cung zad gang / /phyi nang bdag nyid yang dag spyod/ /de yis rnam 1snyedag dngos grub 'gyur/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i 'bras bu ster/ /rnal 'byor ma dang lhan cig 'dres/ /rab tu bshad kyis de nyid nyon/ /'dul ba'i bemakha' 'gro ma 'ga' zhig /sems rtog med pa'i skophyir 'ongs nas7/ /de la de tshe smra ba yang / /sgrub pa pos ni mi bya zhing / /tshig tsam gyis ni 1 tsholan mi gdab/ /bde bar 'ongs sam phyag rgyas nyunyebya/ /de la cung zad bya smra gang / /slob dpon rang nyid kyis 51(ni bya/ /yang na bya ba thams cad nitsho )/ /las kyi rdo rjes 27yang dag sbyar lha/ /gang phyir rang 2nyenyid rdo rje sems/ /las kyi rdo rje gzhan dga' min gyi/ /sna tshogs gzugs kyi sasnyernal 'byor ma/ /yang dang yang du dgug par bya/ /de la g.yo ba'i spyod pa med/ /slob dpon dpa' bo bzhin du spyod/ /gang yang skyon gyi spyod pas rmo 9ni/ /de yi lus ni ltung bar 'gyur/ /shin tu dga' ba yang dag skyes / /bka' bsgo gar gyi spyod tshopa bya/ /rdo rje bcing ba 8de yang bya/ /lha rnams ji ltar mnyes pa nyid/ /ma 'am sring mo bu mo 'am/ /gal te mchod par 'dod pa nas —rte/ /shes rab thabs kyi cho ga yis/ /rtog sdo 7pa med pas sdomabastan par bya/ /rab mchog de yi ru dngos grub ni/ /thob par 'di la the tshom lhamed/ /81wa 895

lhag ma'i 3)gtor ma blangs nas ni/ /dgon pa chen por song nas dor/ / smri u :sa k+ṣe tra pā/ /lā ya (9swā hā sngags brjod bya/ /gal te de ltar charab byed pa'i / /rnal 'byor pa yis bslar yang mthong / /de ltar de ni yongs shes nas//rnal 'byor pa yi 55)mtshan nyid mchog /gang gis yigadong ni 'bar ba'i 'od/ /zlum zhing 'jam la mdzes pa dang / /smin ma ring ba de shes bya/ /'od dpag med kyi rigs las byung / /de las ⑦pad+ma'i phyag rgya bstan/ /rus sbal phyag rgya lan yin no/ /mchu rle (8)mig dkyus ⑨ring ba dang / /kha dog ser mo 0yid 'phrog mnyu1/ /'di yi dpral bar ri mo lho:gsum/ /ji srid skra mtshams bar du gnas / /g.yul du 'chi ba rnams kyis (steni/ /gtam yidag la ni rab 8tu nyan//'di 'dra'i nyan pa ma mthong nasa'i/ /mdung gi phyag rgya bstan par bya/ /rkang pa g.yon pa bskum ⑩pa dang / /de ni gar byed tsorab tu stonayi/ /g.yon pa ( )yongs su bskor nas ni/ /phyag rgya'i lan ni cistobastan par bya/ /sna tshogs pa yi na gos la (snyedaga'/ /rin chen 'byung ldan rigs las byung / /kha dog gnag ④cing gos kyang gnagadu snye/ /skra ni 'khyil cing dar gyis bcings/ /dpral bar gzhu yi rnam pa yidu dzī/ /de 'dra'i mtshan ma mthong na dzo rinani/ /rtag tu de yi zhushesems g.yo ba/ /ma mo zhes ni rab tu grags/ /dril bu'i phyag rgya bstan par bya / /de yi g.yon pas phyag rgya ston/ /mi bskyod rigs las byung bar shes/ /mtshan mo 'ongs nas 'gro ba ༷ ltamachog /thung ngu lto sbom kha dog dkar/ /byin pa sbom zhing shin tu mdzes/ /sa spyod zhu )mar ni shes par bya/ /dung gi zhu༄phyag rgya lan yin no/ /rnam par snang mdzad rigs las byung / /mig yangs rdzi ma stug pa dang / /yan lag kun la ba spus khyab/ /sngo bsangs sa mig ni dmar ru ba 81wa 896

dang ske/ /yan lag phra zhing dpung pa ring / /de ni mkha' 'gro ma ru grags(1)/ /don yod grub pa'i rigs las byung / /de 'dra ba ni (gerab mthong na/ /ba dan gyi ni phyag rgya dang / /g.yon pa'i phyag rgya lan yin no/ /de ltar 'bad pas shis lanas ni/ /mkhas pas mtshan mo song nas ni/ /de la cung zad (4)'jigs mi bya/ /gang phyir de nyid sgimachod par 96)bya/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba (7)mngon par rtogs (zhedapa las tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mchod pa 9)dang /rnal 'byor ma dang 'dres pa'i ⑩le'u ste drug cu thuganyis pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad kyis 32nyon/ /gsang ba'i tshig ni 32bshad pa ni/ /bordo rje'i gnas sogs gnas rnams su/ /rigs kun las byung rnal 'byor ma(1lha/ /mtshan mo 'du 8ba'i dam tshig ni/ /'di 'dra ba yi tshig rnams dang / /de lta bu yi gsang ⑩ba ni/ / bshad kyis dad pa yis ni 1 nyon/ /saṃ po dang 39rka chang 'thung ba/ /bri ro sha ru rnam 2gepar brjod/ /ni la nā bla da tro thod pa/ /gu lang mi yi thod pas brgyanasku rte/ /kun du ro lha'adod yang dag spyod/ /tsha rdu 3 ro drug bza' ba po/ /sum̐ su ṭ+wāṃ risnyedabang gnyis sbyor ba/ /a lo kai tiyod pa yi ming —/ /sho ni rim ga skam skal yod shes/ /tsa kra ka 26ni skal med brjod/ /rtu shī ro ni khu tshur shes/ /me ka ma traṃ gcig tu ra tshobarjod/ /tsan+d+ra ma ni khrag tu bshad / /ga rmā bshang bar sumayongs su grags lha/ /gha rna tsho sha chen du ni bshad ri//ni rdza dha rigedu ra ru brjod/ /bha sa rmā 39ni chu ru bshad/ /ba k+ṣe yan lag rab tu bshad / /shu po bzang po zhes ni brjod/ /ho ni tshim ra tshopa zhes ni grags/ /marga ltogs pa ru ni brjod/ /sgri 82rta lam 8)du bshad pa dang / / byo ma gi dzā 8 tsho81wa 897

pha rol dpung / /ka ma ya ni gyis shig brjod/ /na ga ro ni bdag lus brjod/ /ba ta ka ni nyos zhes 4)brjod/ /a rdza ya ni me zhes brjod/ /sha kham za ba zhes ni brjod/ /ra gam 'dor ②ni cho ga brjod/ /sha ta kai mi bza' bar brjod/ /ci 'dra ba ni sngags zhes brjod/ /sha ro khyi 'tshed sha zhes brjod/ /ro pa ka ni bla mar bshad/ /ka ya 'dir ni rgyal rigs brjod/ /ra gi ③rje rigs zhes ni bshad / /be ro rgya ni dmangs ④rigs brjod/ /tsa rba rigs ngan zhes ni brjod / /sha ro sme sha can du brjod/ /bha ba tsa kre ko duwags mkhan/ /khad kom ro (phyirasreg ma ru bshad/ /sa mun tra ni rgyal por brjod/ /mi ro ma yi ②ring du brjod/ /bha ra ha gang zhes ni bshad/ / bi m+bha 0phag ces brjod par bya/ /pa lo sha ni nya zhes brjod/ /di nam ra skyes su ni bshad/ /nag rtu sbyin sreg ⑨tu ni bshad/ /marta asna ni ⑩'dab chags brjod/ /hi ra phyu ni me tog brjod/ /sha drul /tsho lo ni spos su bshad/ / mā la tro ni dri 0ru bshad/ /sha ku ni ka mar mer brjod32/ /ka shi kai ni gos su bshad/ /ke sa ra ni gdong du brjod④/ /bo traṃ dpral ba zhes su bshadaske/ /ma la smin mar yang dag grags/ /ko bal yo ni mig tu shes/ /a da ra ni so ru brjod/ /pal la po ni mchu ru shes/ /pa sha 8mgrin pa ru ni grags/ /hūm̐ so 'phrag ⑩pa ru ni bshad/ /a gu 8ro ni dpung par brjod/ /so so ru ni lag par bshad/ /shri pang le ni nu mar brjod/ /dza ti 17pha lo rkang par brjod/ / da la rna ni hu )lte bar brjod/ /pad+ma dza 27lam gsang ba'i gnas/ /ka rta ba kai brla zhugeganyis so/ /be si rje ngar du ni bshad/ /tsā nigeg na ni rkang par brjod/ /pa ra tsha ste.a ka ke sa ra/ /sen mo zhes ni yang dag bshad/ /pad+ma gar ni ga ni snang / /sha kra ku su lo mal stan/ /shag tu bu 81—898

zhes yo)bya bar brjod/ /na la ni nā lam (miston med/ /go bag rmi lam thams cad brjod/ /sā chag ro ni rgas par bshad/ /sa la ro ni zhim por brjod/ /a khyo ro rim mi zhim bshad/ /mṛ (5)gi mi smra bar ni bshad/ /pa go la mu rda 56)glu len / /mi tra gar zhes bya bar brjod/ /shabha ( tshul 'chos su ni bshad/ /spar sha zhags par rab tu grags/ /ra sa (8)sgeg mo'i (9)ro 'bebs ma/ /ru paṃ ri yi 'irtse mo'o/ /twa yine ha ni bsad par bshad/ /pā rā pa ta 'chi 8bar brjod/ /ta ma lā ko se tsom yul/ /pha lo grong khyer du ni brjod/ /pra na grong du bshad pa yin / /bya n+ya srog ces bya bar bshad/ /ku ru ta ra mkhas par bshad/ /na ya na ni rnam shes brjod/ /a bi tsan paṃ dgod 7par bshad/ /ru ti ter ni 'chang bar brjod/ /ku mu ra ni nyin mor bshad/ /kun nya mtshan mor rab tu grags / /da 7sa nyi ma phyed du bshad/ / da pi yi mtshan gyi cha ru grags/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba /ltemangon par rtogs pa las gsang ba'i tshig sdo )bshad pa'i le'u ste drug cu ri 1gsum pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad kyis ( rtenyon/ /sku gsung )thugs kyi dkyil 'khor ni / /sku ni mgo bor gnas pa ste/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis byang sems 'bab/ /de ni so sor rab phye bas/ /sku yi 'khor lo ru zhes bya/ /yi ge phyi mo'i dbye ba yis / /gsung la gnas par zhuzirab tu shes/ /chags sogs bag chags dbye ba yis / /thugs kyi 'khor lo ru ni shes/ /sku gsung thugs kyi bshad pa ni/ /sems dpa' chen po khyod nyon cig /rdo rje slob dpon sku la ni snye/ /rgyal ba'i sku ni rim bzhin gnas/ /dang po sku yi rdo rje ni/ /gzugs phung la ni yang 81wa 899

dag bzhugs/ /de ri17rjes nam mkha' rdo rje ni/ /tshor ba yi ni phung por bzhugs / /bcom ldan gsung gi rdo rje ni/ /'du shes kyi ni phung por bzhugs/ /las rnams kyi ni rdo rje ni/ /'du byed kyi ni phung por bzhugs/ /bcom ldan thugs kyi rdo rje ni/ /rnam shes phung por yang dag bzhugs/ /yang 'di'i sha sogs sa khams la/ /bcom ldan 'das yum spyan (5)bzhugs so/ /khrag sogs chu yi khams la ni/ /bcom ldan 'das yum mā ma (na bzhugs/ /dro ba la sogs me khams la/ /bcom ldan 'das yum gos dkar bzhugs/ /mi bskyod ④la sogs rlung khams la/ /bcom ldan 'das yum sgrol ma bzhugs/ /de mig dbang po gnyis la ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sa snying po/ /de yi rna ba'i dbang gnyis la/ /bde gshegs phyag na rdo rje'o/ /de yi sna bug gnyis la ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha'i mdzod/ / de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten dbang ske/ /(5nide yi lce yi dbang la gnas(6)/ /(7)de yi yid kyi dbang po la de bzhin gshegs pa 'jam dbyangs bzhugs/ /khams bzhi'i rang bzhin gong bu ni / /lus zhes 8)bya bar brtags pa la/ /sgrib pa thams cad rnam sel ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de bzhugs so/ /lus kyi tshigs kladani thams cad la/ / de bzhin gshegs pa kun du bzang / /lus kyi rtsa rgyus thams cad la/ /6de bzhin gshegs pa byams pa'o/ /lag pa g.yas pa'i rtsa bar ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gshin rje'i 31gshed/ /lag pa g.yon pa'i rtsa bar ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzhan mi thub/ /kha yi pad+mar bzhugs pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rta mgrin no/ /gsang ba'i gnas su bzhugs pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rtsi 'khyil/ /dpung pa g.yas par bzhugs pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 81wa 900

mi g.yo ba/ /dpung pa g.yon par bzhugs pa ni0)/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'dod pa'i rgyal/ /pus mo g.yas par bzhugs pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dbyig 0pa sngo/ /pus mo g.yon par bzhugs pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa stobs po che/ /rang gi mgo stengs na bzhugs pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor los sgyur(4)/ /rkang pa'i 'og tu bzhugs pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gnod mdzes te/ /lus ni 'di nyid kun la 'dir/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bzhugs/ /sku yi dkyil 'khor zhes brjod pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid kyi sku/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dbye ba yis/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ma lus 'di / /lus pa med pa sangs rgyas sku/ /skye ba 'di la rnal 'byor pa/ /mya ngan 'das pa myur du 'thob/ /khyod kyi dge ba yongs sbyin pa/ /de bas rdo rje slob dpon gyi/snye/ /lus la rgyal ba thams cad bzhugs/ /mthong na don ni yod pa kye / /phyi ma'i dus na sems dpa' che/ /de bas sems can thams cad kyi/ /lha yi mchod pa'i yo byad kyis(6)/ /rab tu 'bad de bla ma bsten/ /de nas mthong ba don yod bcas/ /byang chub sems dpa' grags pa che/ /dga' zhing mgu bas phyag byas nas(7)/ /bcom ldan 'das la mchi ma blags/ /gsung dang thugs kyi dkyil 'khor bzhugs/ /legs so bya ba byin nas ni/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis (8)'di skad gsungs/ /a ā i khri u u dang / / ṛ rī '-i lī 9ye i dang tshe/ /o au e aḥdabyangs zhes bya/ /ka tsa ṭa ta pa sde tshan/ /ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa/ /ha dang gsung gi dkyil 'khor shes/ /ngag kun rab tu spro dang ldan / /'dod chags la sogs bag chags kyang / /grangs ni nyi shu brgyad kyis sol/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor legs rgyas pa11/ /dpal mchog las ni shes 81—901

par bya/ /de ltar 'dus pa'i rnal 'byor rnams/ /rdo rje gsum ni dam tshig mchog /mchog tu rmad byung rgyas pa ni/ /sgrub pa'i dbang pos yang dag shes/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba mngon par rtogs pa las sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor bshad pa'i le'u ste drug cu 6)bzhi pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan rdo rjes gsungs/ /sangs rgyas dam chos dge 'dun dang —/ /bla ma ston pa slob dpon dang / /rdo rje 'chang dang slob ma yi/ /mtshan nyid thams cad bsdus ②pa ni/ /dri med sems ni sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /chos ni ngag tu yang dag gsungs/ /sku ni dge 'dun zhes bya ste/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi gnas/ /sangs rgyas yi ge hūṃ du bshad/ /gsung ni yi ge āḥru brjod/ /dge 'dun zhes bya yi ge oṃ/ /kun nas 'phro ba'i bdag nyid dol/ /sangs rgyas a ba dhū tīr 'gyur/ /chos kyang la la nā ru brjod/ /dge 'dun ra sa nā ru brjod/ /'di ni gsum po'i mtshan nyid do/ /gzugs med khams ni sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /gzugs kyi khams ni chos dang ni/ /'dod khams de bzhin dge 'dun te/ /de ltar khams gsum mtshan nyid mchog /snying por gyur pa rang srog las/ /khams gsum na ni gzhan med de/ /sgyu ma rlung gi khams gsum pa/ /mi lam mi ba (mibazhin du mthong / /khams gsum bdag nyid de bzhin nyid(pe/ /gcig pur myur bar⑤mthong bar 'gyur/ /byin gyis brlabs 4)nas de bzhin nyid/ /dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /dam pa'i chos ni chos kyi sku/ /dge 'dun sprul pa'i skur ni 'gyur/ /de ni sku gsum bdag nyid can/ /snang ba 81—902

sangs rgyas kyi ni gzugs/ /chos ni snang ba thob pa'o/ /dge 'dun snang ba mched par 'gyur/ /de ni snang ba gsum mtshan nyid/ /zhi ba la sogs las la byang / /sngags dang rnal 'byor che 0)rnams shes/ /cho ga nyi shu bya ba bslabs(mi/ /de ni bla mar (gumangon par brjod/ /tshul khrims dag cing sbyin pa gtong ske/ /bzod dang brtson 'grus mchog tu ldan/ /nyin dang mtshan du sgom la zhen/ /shes rab ldan zhing bzo la mkhas/ /bla ma'i spyir ni yon tan tshogs//dpal ldan slob dpon zhes ni brjod/ /nang gi gegasang 'dus la rab dga'/ /phyi rol nyan thos la spyod pa/ /de lta'i man (snyengag rim pa yis/ /slob ma rnams la rjes su bslab/ /de ni ston par yongs su gsungs/ /de skad smras pa de bzhin byed/ /rtog pa rnams dang dkyil 'khor tshogs/ /dam pa'i don gyi (6ri/bya ba dang / /slar yang snang ba gsum dang ni/ /rnal 'byor mchog gi spyod pa la / /slob cing gzhan yang slob tu 'jug /de ni slob dpon zhes bya'o/ /de nyid bcu ni yongs shes nas/ /dkyil 'khor la tsho sogs bya ba shes/ /slob ma rjes su ④nus pa dang / /gsang ba'i dbang ni bskur ba dang / /shes rab snying rje (she yang dag ldan/ /rgyud kyi man ngag la mi 'jigs/ /zab cing rgya cher yang dag ldan/ /rdo rje sems dpa' boganyis pa mchog /tshar gcod phan 'dogs pa la mkhas/ /de ni rdo rje 'chang du bshad/ /dad cing bla ma la yang gus/ /rtag tu dge ba'i /nyelas la gnas/ /gnyis med sgyu yang med pa dang / /rtog pa ngan pa rnam 8par spangs/ /lung ni mang du thos pa dang / /gsod pa dang ni 'tshe /tsho ba spangs/ /sems can rnams ni 'don pa'i blos/ /kun du brtson dang yang dag ldan/ /de la sogs pa'i yang dag ldan/ /dad pa chen po'i slob ma 81—903

bzang ske/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa/ /gang la de nyid nges shes bya/ /gong na med pa'i spyod rab mchog /sngags dang rnal 'byor rim pa sogs/ /ye shes lnga ni rnam dag dang / /sangs rgyas lnga ni rang bzhin nyid/ /mngon par byang chub rnam lnga yis/ /snang ba gsum gyi mtshan nyid dang / /chos dang longs 3spyod sprul pa dang / /sku gsum rnam par bsgom pa dang / /bde chen yon tan mtshan nyid ni/ /dga' ba la sogs dbye ba dang / /de bzhin sgeg sogs nyams dang ni/ /rnal 'byor rjes su rnal 'byor dang / /shin tu rnal 'byor rnal 'byor che/ /dang po sbyor ba mdor bsdus pas/ /de bzhin dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog /las kyi rgyal po rnal 'byor mchog /'jug dang gnas dang ldang ba ni/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor dang / /bde gnyis dbugs 9ge'abyung gnyis la sogs/ /gang la rgyas bshad de nyid rgyud/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud du brjod/ /yon tan ji lta bu yi (ldenargyud/ /thos sogs yon tan mchog gi ni/ /rten dang snod ces bya bar gsungs/ /mtshan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa dang / /ji ltar seng ge'i 'o ma ni/ /sa yi snod du bzhag 5kyimi bya/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud/ /snod min dag la sbyin mi bya/ /slob ma skad cig de la 'chi/ /'di dang pha rol du ni phung / /snod min man ngag rab bshad na/ /slob dpon dngos grub nyams par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba mngon par rtogs pa las/ sangs rgyas dang dam pa'i chos dang dge 'dun la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid kyi tshig rgyas pa'i le'u ste drug cu 95)lnga pa'o// //81—904

de nas bcom ldan rdo rjes gsungs/ /slob ma'i bya ba'i spyod pa ni/ /zhi ba la sogs bya ba yang / /sngags dang rnal 'byor rim pa yi/ /lham dang gdugs dang gtsug tor 93)dang / /so rtsi la sogs myang ba dang / /snabs kyi gong bu mchil ma sogs/ /'dor zhing rkang pa rkyong (2ba dang / /gzhan du lta na dang spyi brtol (gesmra/ /nor gyis snyems dang ngar 'dzin dang / /rgyan la sogs pa bltab pa (snyedang / /bag med par ni smra ba dang / /bla ma'i grib ma 'gom pa dang ske/ /de la sogs pa skyon gyi tshogs/ /bla ma'i mdun du rnam par spangs/ /'jigs pas thal mo sbyar nas ni/ /spyi bor 6)phyag rgya bka' lung nod/ /rab bdog kun gtong dam bcas pas/ /ngo tsha bcas shing 7rigadong smad pas/ /slob mas bla ma'i mdun gnas bya/ /gal te dngos grub mchog 'dod na/ /bla ma'i mdun du slob ma rnams/ /de lta bu sogs spyod ces 92)bya/ /dam tshig sdom pa sngar bshad pa/ /de rnams slob ma'i spyod pa'o/ /de yi zhi sogs bya ba ni/ /bla mas bstan par bya ba'i rigs/ /de la mdor bsdus bshad par bya/ /thun mong 97cho ga'i mtshan nyid ni/ /zhi ba dang ni rgyas pa gnyis/ /zla ba yar gyi ngo la bya/ /dbang dang mngon spyod kyi ni las/ /zla ba mar gyi ngo la brtsam3 sta/ /byang du kha bltas zhi ba la/ /de bzhin rgyas pa shar du blta/ /drag po'i las la lho phyogs su/ /dbang gi las la nub tu blta/ /gsod pa nyid la me yi phyogs/ /snang bar bya la bden bral du/ /gnas nas bskrad la rlung gi phyogs/ /rengs pa la ni dbang ldan phyogs/ /zhi ba'i kha dog dkar po ste/ /rgyas pa la ni ser po bya/ /dbang dang dgug pa la ni dmar/ /kha dog nag po gsod 3)pa la'o/ /byams pa'i sems kyis zhi ba la/ /dga' ba'i sems kyis rgyas pa la/ /chags 81wa 905

pa'i sems kyis dbang dag la/ /khro ba'i sems kyis gsod pa'o/ /zhi la phal cher tho rangs bya/ /de bzhin rgyas pa ①snga dro bya/ /dbang dang mngon spyod dag gi las/ /nyi ma gung dang mtshan phyed la'o/ /de ltar rigs (kyepar yang dag bshad / /sngags kyi rgyud gsungs mtshan nyid kyis/ /zhi ba la sogs dngos grub brgyad/ /blo ldan cho ga bzhin du bsgrubal/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba stimangon par rtogs pa las/ slob ma'i spyod pa rnam par dag pa dang / zhi ba la sogs pa'i las kyi 'bras bu bstan pa'i gele'u ⑥ste drug cu ( drug pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad kyis 2nyon/ /khro bo bzlas pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /gang gis rnal 'byor dngos grub brgyadasti/ /thob 'gyur 'di la the tshom 0med/ /khro bo'i sems kyi 'oḥbazlas pa ni/ /khro bo'i bzlas pa zhes ni brjod/ /yang na khro bo'i rgyal po rnams/ /sngags bzlas pa yi sbyor ba yis/ /khro bo'i bzlas pa de shes bya/ /dngos grub brgyad kyi 'bras bu stsol/ /'jigs su rung ba'i dur khrod du/ /'jigs pa 'jigs par byed pa'i gnas/ /skyes bu thod pa'i 'khrag gis gos/ /rma med pa yi mamatshan nyid blang / /skyes bu'i 8khu ba zla mtshan dang ske/ /bsres anas bri bar bya ba ni/ /de na ⑩bsgrub bya'i rnam pa dang / /gsal dang 'jigs pa skrag pa dang / /g.yon brkyang ba yis mnan nas ni/ /zhag bdun bar du dus gsum du/ /gshin rje'i chagashed kyi sngags 'dis nyunyeni/ /dngos grub rgyur ni bzlas par nyirkebya/ /na maḥs dz+nya )man+ta kā ya bārtsit+ta badzā (lhashā/oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba duṣ+ṭa satwa shurnyed ma ka /a si mu sa ༷ nyel ba ra shu pā sha 81—906

hasta / khan bā ma ta ra tsa ni haṣ+ṭha༅/ tsa tur mu kha/ tsa tur bhu dza/ ṣa (5༄ḍa (getsa ra ṇa/ ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha/ sarba duṣ+ṭa māṇa a pa ha cirari ṇi/ ma hā bigha (5)nā bhā ta ka /bi kṛ ta 6)ā nan/ sarba ( )zla ta bha yo ka ra/ as askyo ha (kyes nā di nel/ /byā gh+ra ⑩ tsarmā ni bā zhunyes na/ ku ru ku ru/ sarba kurmā ṇi/ sbyin smin / sarba man tān/ nyin dha nyin dhalcage/ pa ra mu dā 3nyen/ ā kur+sha ya ā kun ④ya/ sarba bhū tānam/ ma tha ma tha/ nir ma tha nir ma 7tha sarba duglen⑩ / pra be sha ya hunyeza be sha ya/ maṇ+ḍal ma sgye/ bai ba shwa ta/ dzī bi ta an+ta ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ mā bi las mamā bi las/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra/ hūm̐ hūṃ/ tardza 63 ya/ bhe gā 〈( —)/phaṭa phaṭa/ sbo ṭa ya sbo ṭa ya/ kā ra kā ra/ sar+pā sha pa ri pū rā sa ya he he 0bha ga bān/ krirdzi rā ya si nadu ste/ na maḥ sar+pā sā dha rdo snyeya hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ thog mar khro bo'i bzlas pa 'di/ /dbang du bya dang dgug pa'i 0mchog /bskrad pa rab tu bshad par bya/ /khro bo gnyis pa'i bzlas pa yang / /skye ( )tshe lan tshwa yungs mar dang / / dug dang dha du ra'i du nyekhu ba/ / sdigs mdzub ( )khrag dang bsres rgu nas su/ /dur khrod ras dang bya ba ni/ /zla ba phyed pa lta bu mchog ci/rlung gi dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /logs (teganyis rdo rjes thamatshan par bya/ /de dbus bsgrub sabya'i ming bris la/ /g.yon brkyang bar ni gnas nas ni/ /sngags 'di tsoyongs su bzla bar bya/ /sngar bzhin bsgrub bya'i ming bkug nas/ /mtshan phyed kyi ni dus su ni/ /kun nas zhag bdun bsgrub par ⑤bya/ /bskrad par ⑩yang ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /na maḥs man+ta kā ya bā 0rtsit+ta badzā rdunyeshā/ na mo badz+ra kro dhā ⑥ya/ ma hā rdas ta zhu ka ṭa lha ra wā 0ya/ a si mu sa la ba ra shu pā (nye81wa 907

sha hastu 37ya/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li/mi/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ brnya brnyaXkye / ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ gardza gardzab/ sbo ṭa sbo ṭa/ bi sbo ṭa ya bi sbo ṭa ya/ sarba bigha ṭ+wāṃ bi nā ya kān+ma hā ga ṇa pa ti/ ṭī bi tāhi ka rā (peya hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ sngags 'dis gdug pa'i sems can ni/ /bskrad pa'i don du byas pa yin56)/ /zhi ba'i las ni bshad bya ba/ /gzhan gyis mi thub ming dang ni/ /khro bo gsum pa bzlas nas ni/ /me dang sbrul sogs zhi bar byed/ /lag pa gnyis la nyi ma gnyis/ /de la hūm̐ gnyis bsgom par bya/ /bsgrub bya'i mgo la lag gnyis kyis/ /brabs la de la zhugs (7nas ni/ /bsgrub bya'i snying la de gnyis kyis/ /'byung po bsreg (8rwapar bsam par bya/ /me dang 'byung po 'jigs byed pa'i/ /'di yi sngags ni bshad par bya/ /na maḥs ⑨man+ta kā ya bā rtsit+ta mabadzā the tsā/ oṃ a pa rā dzī ti ri dzi nyunyertsu phaṭa/ che ge mo 'byung po'i gdon las grol bar mdzod cig /:ཿnya dug sel ba'i sngags kyis ni/ /bzhi pa bshad kyis 6de nyon cig /khro bo rta mgrin bzlas pas ni/ /yang dag mi mtshungs pa yi tsamachog /bsgrub bya sems dpa' sum brtsegs 8bsgom/ /snying gar 7zla gnas ye shes sems/ /de yi 'od zer gyis rab gang / /bsgrub bya'i lus la mchog tu bsam/ /rab tu 'bar ba de yis nyusnyedug /de nas lag g.yas bsam pa ni/ /zla ba haṃ gis rnam par brgyan8/ /kha dog dkar por sor mor dgod/ /de ltar sgrub pa po la bya/ /r+ghaṃ :ཿ )dzi k+ṣi zhu sā dha dgod/ /las rnams kun ni 'grub par byed/ /bsgrub bya'i mgo bo nas brtsams te/ /rkang pa'i mtha' yi bar du bsgom/ /chu rgyun rgyun mi 'chad pa ni/ /dug ni 'og btang rim pa du rteyis / /'dir ni sngags 'di bzlas ri ri bya ste/ /rta mgrin ci stedu ni mngon par 81—908

brjod / /na maḥs man+ta kā ya bārtsit+ta badzā (1shā/ oṃ r+ghaṃ rtsu r+ghaṃ/ ta rū la bi rū ri nasal / sarba (mi'i ṣa ghā (geta ka ta ka dzā li ta bi sbu liṅga/ astob hā sa nā da sa tī tari5) / ka sa ri sa ho ba tai ad de ba 96badz+ra khu ra (7)snya ta na/ tsa ta pa rinasu dha ta la ni shā sa ma (9)ruta uta k+ṣi p+ta dha ra ṇi midha ra/ bi ṣa na mas tsho1stohā sa a pa ri mi tā ba tshil pa rā nyu kra ma ār+ya ga ṇa dhī yin/ bud+dha bud+dha/ ha ya spyi 515ba kha kha/ sbyin sbyin/ ā 'ibe sha ya/ sarba gra he gnyu rme/ pra ti ha to bha ba1snye/ badz+ra rda: kiñci rā ya rtso)si i rda duṣ+ṭa gra haṃ rdas sa pā/ dhu na dhu na/ mā tha mā tha/ mardo man / budha dharma ra dha/ bud+dha dharma saṃ gha a nu dz+nyā na marlo na )ku ru swā hā/ che ge mo'i dug la sogs pa sel bar mdzod cig hūm̐ zhes bya ba dang sngags spel lo/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rjes 'brangs te/ /lhag ma rgyas par shes par bya/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba mngon par rtogs pa las khro bo'i bzlas pa dang zhi ba la sogs pa'i dngos grub brgyad kyi le'u ste drug cu smyo stobadun pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad par bya/ /dngos grub thams cad bsdus pa ni/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes mchog /dngos grub la sogs mazurngan nyid ni/ /sa snying phyag na rdo rje dang / /'jam dpal sgrib pa sel ba dang / /byams pa lnga po 'di dag dang / /yi ge gsum dang rnam par spel snye/ /mig dang rna ba yid dang lus / / rtsa yi 2nye'akhor lo byin gyis brlab/ /mtshan gsum nyin mo de dang 'dra//mngon shes lnga nyid thob par byed/ /bzhi pa yi 2rini dbang bskur bas/ /blo ldan de nyid mthong bar 'gyur/ /snang ba mtshan mo'i cha ru 'gyur/ /nyin mo snang ba mched pa'o/ /mtshams ni snang ba thob pa'o/ /de ltar snang la sogs 81wa 909

mtshan nyid/ /mtshan min mtshams dang nyin mo min/ /kun rtog rlung ni spong bar byed/ /de ni skad cig mngon byang chub/ /mtshan nyid skad cig mar ni brjod / /tha mar 'byung dang thog mar 'byung ba 'am/ /dbus mi ①'byung ba'ang dbus su 'byung ba 'am/ /mtha' min 'byung ba'ang mthar ni 'byung ba 'am / /de ni thams cad stong pa'i skad cig gcig tu gsungs/ /gang du 'gro ba dang ni 'ong med cing / /zad med 'phel med dngos dang dngos (gemed min//ngo mtshar gzugs can yin zhing ngo mtshar min/ /gnas par 'gyur min myur du 'gro ba min/ /gang zhig yod dang med pa'i tha snyad rnams dang bral/ /bsod nams gzugs min sdig pa'i gzugs ma yin/ /bsod nams sdig gi bdag min mchog gyur pa/ /de ni thams cad stong pa'i skad cig gcig tu gsungs/ /skad cig gcig la mngon byang chub/ /mtshan nyid 'di ni skad cig mchog /rdo rje rtse mo byang sems ni/ /'dzin pas lus kyi brtan pa nyid/ /de yis nga )de nyid byang sems ni/ /rlung gi de nyid rab sbyor bas/ /rigs pas steng du byed pa ni / /rgas pa med par the tshom ④med/ /r+ghaṃ hoḥ(snyerim bzhin shes pa ni/ /'dzin pa steng du rnam par spel/ /sngar bshad pa yi (5)bdud rtsi lnga/ /'di ni bcud kyis 6)len du brjod/ /'di nyid kyis (kyeni grub par byed/ /lcags kyi gser 'gyur byas nas ni/ /rdo rje phyag rgya dngos grub che/ /zung du 'jug pas thob par 'gyur/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i sbyor ba dang / /de bzhin rdzogs pa'i rim pa yang / /gang la de gnyis gcig 'gyur ba/ /de ni zung 7du 'jug par bshad / /'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das/ /rtog 'i/pa gnyis po spangs pas ni/ /gang du dngos po gcig 'gyur ba/ /zung du 'jug ces de la bshad/ /kun 81—910

rdzob dang ni don dam dag /rtog pa gnyis dang rnam par bral/ /gang du yang dag 'dres gyur pa①/ /de ni zung du 'jug par bshad/ /rdo rje bzlas pa'i rab sbyor bas/ /rlung gi mtshan nyid shes nas ni/ /rnam rtog rlung rnams rnam par gcod/ /sems la dmigs pa 'thob 95)par 'gyur/ /bdag la byin brlabs ②rim pas kyang / /dngos grub brgyad ni thob par 'gyur/ /snang ba la sogs dbye ba shes/ /mngon par byang chub rim pa thob/ /zung 'jug rim pa la gnas pa/ /dngos grub thams cad bsdus pa ni/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor pa yis the tshom (na med/ /phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub cher / /zung du 'jug pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /rnam rtog med par zhugs nas ni / /thob pa 'di la the tshom (nyemed/ /lus ni gzhal yas khang du 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis (phyirayang dag brten/ /zur bzhi pa yi 9)mdun rgyab dang / /g.yas dang g.yon gyi dbye bas so/ /steng 'og sgo yi dbye ba yis/ /sgo bzhi zhes ni bshad pa yin/ /sna rtse bzhi yi dbyibs kyis ni/ /rta babs (8)bzhi ni brjod par bya/ /dra ba chu bar tso)yang dag bshad/ /rgyus par gyur pa dra ba phyed/ /cha ni zla ba phyed pa dang / /bum pa lto bar yang dag shes/ /rje ngar brla tshadapung lag ngar ni/ /ka ba brgyad du yang dag bshad/ /mig gi rnam shes me long sogasal/ /sgra yi rnam shes rol mo dang / /sna yi rnam shes me tog phreng / /rin chen pha gu lce rnam 37shes/ /lus kyi rnam shes ras 'phan dang / /yid kyi rnam shes ri dgas 8so/ /mig ni 'khor lo'i mtshan ma dang / /rna ba kun nas rdo rje rnams / /sna ni ba dan du ni bshad/ /lce ni dril bu ru ni gsungs/ /rnga yab la sogs rnam dag pa/ /lus kyi tshogs zhes hustebya bar bshad/ /yid ni dbus 81—911

kyi pad+mar gsungs/ /rnam rtog rlung ni yang dag brten/ /ye shes lnga ni rnam dag pa/ / re khā ri1lngar ni yang dag brjod/ /phung po lnga ni rnam dag lnga / /rnam dag kha dog lnga ni dbye/ /de dag gzhal yas khang du bsgom/ /dang po sbyor bar shes par bya/ /mngon par byang chub rnam pa lnga / /rigs kyi dbye ba rang ngo bo/ /de nyid phyi rdo rol gnas par brjod/ /dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa'o / /khams bzhi'i rang bzhin bdag nyid ni/ /gzugs kyi phung po mdor bsdus na/ /gzugs kyi phung po rnams dang ni/ /mig gi rnam shes sa snying po/ /phyi rol gzugs kyi rdo rjer bshad/ /byams pa rtsa rgyus dbus na bzhugs/ /de bzhin khro bo'i rgyal po gnyis/ /shar dang lho yi mtshams su ni/ /me long ye shes su ni bshad/ /rnam par snang mdzad rnam dag nyid/ /bde dang sdug bsngal 'jigs dang skyo/ /tshor ba'i mtshan nyid du ni 'dod/ /tshor ba chu yi ④khams dang ni/ /phyi rol sgra ni rdo rje dang / /rna ba phyag na rdo rjer bshad/ /rigs ni gnyis po 'dres pa nyid/ /dri (geyi rdo rje phyi rol 'gyur/ /sna yi rnam 2shes mkha' snying po/ /khro bo gnyis po rnam par shes/ /mnyam nyid rin chen 'byung ba dang / /dngos dang dngos med sogs 'du shes/ /snga ma rjes dran mtshan nyid can/ /'du shes phung po me khams dang / /phyi rol dri yi rdo rje dang / / lce yi 65rnam shes 'jig rten mgon/ /de bzhin khro bo'i rgyal po gnyis/ /de ni so sor rtog ye shes/ /'od dpag med kyi rigs las byung / /dge dang mi dge'i las rnams kyis/ /bag chags 'du byed (7mtshan nyid ni/ /'du shes phung po rlung gi khams/ /phyi rol ro yi rdo rje dang / /lus kyi rnam shes sgrib rnam sel / /kun bzang tshigs kyi 48mtshams dbus bzhugs/ /de bzhin khro bo'i 81—912

rgyal po gnyis/ /bya ba nan tan grub ye shes/ /don yod grub pa'i rigs las byung ske/ /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin ni/ /ye shes mtshan nyid rnam shes brjod//rnam par shes pa nam mkha'i khams/ /yid kyi rnam shes 'jam rdo rje/ /de bzhin khro bo'i rgyal po gnyis/ /shin tu rnam dag chos kyi dbyings/ /mi bskyod pa yi ①rigs las byung / /mngon par byang chub rnam pa lnga / /gzhal yas khang na ༷ge'adi dag bzhugs/ /de nyid khams kyi dbye ba yis/ /rim pa ji bzhin bshad par bya/ /spa rus phyi sa mchil ma snying / /sa (0ni rnam snang bdag nyid do / /spu dang rnag (pedang nye ba'i snying / /sen mo chu yi khams su shes/ /rin chen 'byung ldan bdag nyid kyi/ /rigs kyi rten du shes par bya/ /so dang pags ⑤pa sha dang snying / /me 97yi khams zhes bya bar brjod/ /'od dpag med kyi rang bzhin dang / /rigs kyi dbye bar shes par bya/ /rgyus pa sha dang rtsib 97logs snying / /rlung ni don yod grub pa'o/ /dri ma rgyus tsho pa mkhris pa snying / /de ni nam mkha'i khams su grags/ /mi bskyod pa yi rang bzhin dang / /snying ni rnam shes lnga zhes bya/ /re re la yang 99)so sor ni/ /rnam pa lnga ni spro ba 7shes//de bzhin gshegs pa'i phung po lnga/ /nang gi bdag nyid rdzas phye ba/ /sha rtsa rgyus pa sha kham 7tshad/ /klad 8pa dang ni klad ri nyergyas dang / /rus pa rkang dang snye ma dang ske/ /mkhal ma snying dang lto ba dang / /glo ba mtsher cipa gcin dang ni/ /bshang ba pho ba long ka 7dang / /zhag dang chu ser rnag 9tshadang ni/ /khrag dang mkhris pa bad kun dang / /ngar snabs skra dang kha spu ho dang / /sen mo spu dang pags 3)pa dang / /lag pa rkang mig yan lag sogs/ /mtshog 19ma dpung pa zhes ni brjod — dī/ /de dag rim par shes par bya/ /gzhal yas khang ni rnam 81—913

dag pas/ /de la gnas kyi dbye ba ni/ /mdor bsdus nas ni bshad par bya/ / pū l+li 0)ra ni mgo bor shes/ /spyi gtsug dzā (kyelan dha ra dang / /rna ba g.yas par o can chadang / /spyi bo'i rgyab ni arbu da(ge/ /go dā (5)ba ri rna ba g.yon/ / rā me nerashā ri smin ma'i dbus/ /mig gnyis de bi ⑦ko ṭi dang / / mā la we (nyani dpung pa'i rtsa/ / kā ma rū (9)pa mchan khung gnyis/ / o ḍi 7nu ma gnyis su grags / /ko sa la ni lte bar shes/ /tri 0sa ku ne sna yi hunyertsa/ /kha yi pad+ma ka ling gnyusnye /mgrin pa lam pā kur ④ni brjod/ /snying ni kārtsir 7shes par bya/ /hi ma la ya mdoms su shes/ /mtshan ma gro ha de wa chadang / /pre ta pu ri bshang ba'i lam/ /brla gnyis su waṇ+ḍi dī pa/ /sau boraṣ+ṭa ni byin pa gnyis/ /rkang pa'i bol ni sin d+ma'i 'ayul/ /sor mo rnams la nā (/sheg ra/ / mthe bong pya gnyis ni ma rur shes nye/ /ku lu tā rdo —)ni rkang pa'i mthil/ /de ltar gnas kyi rnam dag dang / /sa bcu rnam par dag pa nyid/ /de nyid dang ldan shes par bya / /thim dang longs spyod bdag po nyid/ /'jug pa la sogs bye brag gis/ /rim du gegyis rdo rje sems dpa' nyid/ /de nas gzhan yang rab bshad pa/ /rlung rnams kyi ni mtshan nyid mchog /srog gi rlung ni snying gar dzo seganas/ /mi bskyod bye brag rigs las skyes/ /mdoms ( snyen gnas pa'i thur sel ni/ /rin chen 'byung ldan bye brag skyes/ /stod du rgyu ba ༅lkog mthar gnas/ /'od dpag med pa'i rang bzhin no/ /me dang mnyam gnas lte bar gnas/ /don yod grub pa'i rang bzhin no/ /khyab byed yan lag kun la gnas/ /rnam snang mdzad kyis byin gyis sa brlabs/ /dbang po'i sgo yi rgyun las ni/ /srog dang rtsol ba rgyun 'di dang / /dus kun du ni rgyu ba ni/ /srog ces bya ba yin par 81wa 914

bshad / /srog dang rlung dang phyi sa dang / /de bzhin du ni khu ba sogs/ /'og 1'dren 'di ni thur sel rlung / /rtag tu rnal 'byor pas shes bya/ /dgod (na dang za dang ldag ②pa dang / /kun du 'thung dang 'jib ④pa dang / /gang zhig rtag tu mnyam gnas pa/ /mnyam du gnas pa zhes byar brjod/ /gyen du 'gro zhing sdud (snyepa dang / /bza' dang myang ba tsho6)la sogs pa/ /shes nas 75lhan cig 'byor pa dag /gyen rgyu'i las su shes par bya/ /khyab dang 'dzin pa nyid dang ni / /de bzhin 'gro dang ldog pa sogs/ /tshigs kun du ni khyab pa'i phyir/ /khyab byed ces (nyeni bya bar bshad/ /rlung gi mtshan nyid bshad pa ni/ /de nas de yi 'jigs par brjod/ /snga ma bzhin du btang bzung 97)sogs/ /phan tshun du ni gnod par byed/ /gzhan ni gzhan la 'tshe ba yin/ /stobs ni thob pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /gcig ni gcig la thim par 'gro/ /ji ltar zla ba gzas (7bzung la/ /rlung rnams rim gyis nyams 'gyur ba/ /snga ma bzhin du gong nas gong ske/ /rang gi bdag nyid la thim par/ /btang bzung 41slar yang 'gro bar byedal/ /ji ltar mes bsregs dngos med dang / /rgyu med par ni thim par 'gro//slar yang srog gi rlung shar ba/ /las kyi rlung ni sna tshogs pa/ /de ni lhan cig rnam shes dang / /slar yang 'jig rten gsum du gnas/ /de las las dang de las skyes/ /de las chags sogs bag chags dang / /de las slar yang 'chi dang skye/ /de ltar 'khor lo bskor ba 'dra/ /sngon bzhin rdo rje bzlas la sogs//rim gyis de yi dbye bar 'gyur/ /de nas sems dpa' chen po kun/ /de nyid mig sman thur 32ma yis/ /thams cad 'khrul ba'i long 3lhab bsal/ /yang dag dngos po nyid ni mthong / /de nas yang yang 8phyag byas te/ /mchi skabacas mig 81wa 915
