rna ba sna dang ni/ /de bzhin lce dang lus dang yid/ /dbang po phung po'i dngos rnams dang / /khams rnams su ni 'jug pa yang / /ma rig bag chags sred pa yis / /bcings pa'i nyon mongs 'dod chags sogs/ /rnam par shes pa sna tshogs pa/ /ji ltar dngos su 'dus pa lags/ /dngos po med pa bsgoms 1pa'i gzugs/ /gzugs sogs spyod yul mtshan nyid rnams/ /rang bzhin med cing dmigs med la/ /dmigs pa dang bcas ji ltar lags/ /de dag ngo mtshar chen po ni/ /bdag gi the tshom lhas bka' stsol/ /de ltar zhus ma thag tu ni / /bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpas gsungs/ /shes rab zab pa nazad med ni / /nyon cig spyan ma bshad par bya/ /dpyad du med cing shes bya min/ /de bzhin dpyad mkhan gyis shes dka'/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rigugasang chen ni/ /nam mkha' nam mkha'i spyod yul lo/ /mi shes mun pas bsgribs pas na/ /nyan thos rnams kyis shes pa min/ /spyod yul bag chags shes mkhan ni/ /rang sangs rgyas su sprul pa ste/ /de dag kun gyis 4 kyang mi shes/ /shes med so so'i skye gnas dang (5)/ /ma 'ongs pa dang 'das pa dang / /da ltar byung ba'i dus gsum la/ /byol song bag chags las byung ba'i/ /dud 'gro yi dgas 6skye ba rnams/ /de kun gyis kyang mi shes te/ /sangs rgyas spyod yul gsang chen no//snying po shin tu snying po'i mchog /gang de kun bdag la gnas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi (7)gsang chen ni/ /lha mo khyod la bshad par bya/ /byang chub sems dag she'od gsal ba/ /zla ba shel 79dang mnyam pa'i 'od/ /de nyid ye shes lnga yi bodangos/ /yungs kur 7che ba'i tshad tsam mo/ /de yi dbus su bzhugs pa'i lha / /mi gsal gsal ba'i gzugs can te/ /phyed tsho12tshad tsam gyi phra mo'i 81wa 949

mchog /yid kyi dngos po'i thig le'i gzugs/ /rtag tu snying gi 6)dbus gnas pa/ /'od zer chen po 'bar ba can/ /ji snyed dgu pa'i bar du ni/ /dpral bar (ril gnas rkang mthil bar/ /thig le de kho nar bsdus te/ /lte ba'i dbus su rnam par gnas/ /cha shas lnga pa tsam ((yin te/ /bcu gnyis kyi ni tha ma la/ /cha shas drug gis mtshan pa nyid/ /nga ro thig les brgyan byed pa/ /rdo rje khong nas phyung nas su/ /sa bon skye gnas dbus bzhag ste/ /chos kyi dbyings ni zhu bar byed/ /de ni rim par skyed (gebyed na/ /sgo dgu la ni kun du 'gro/ /khyab cing khyab (zhenaganas 'gro kun la/ /mi g.yo la sogs g.yo dang bcas/ /tshangs sogs lha dang lha min gyi/ /gzhi ni de las gyur pa'o(be / /gang las ri zhigatso bor skyed byed pa(8ra/ /sa dang nam mkha' ⑨de zhes gsungs/ /ji srid 7lus la gnas pa'i bar/ /de yis las dang las min byed/ /dge dang mi dge bsam pa yang / /bya ba'i las kun byed pa yin/ /sbyor ba rtag tu de gsungs te/ /mchod pa bsgom par hunagasungs pa yin/ /gang tshe las kyi lus zhig na/ /de tshe de yi rang mthu yisatso/ /de 'dra'i lus su de 'gyur te/ /gang gis g.yo dang mi g.yo khyab/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa nyid 'dra ba/ /de ni gnas par ri nyeshes par bya/ /bcu yi gnyis mtha' tshig gi don/ /gang gis rtag tu bsgom tsobyas na/ /des 8ni dngos grub rgyas pa yisatso/ /rdo rje 'dzin par bdag nyid 'gyur/ /so dang mchu dang rkan 9ho dang lce/ /mgul gnas gang la yod pa ni/ /gang la de ni yig 'bru nyid/ /de ni zad dang gnas phyir ro/ /brjod pa med cing the tshom pa8/ /sgra yig nyu/rnam par spangs pa na stani/ /rang gi phyi nang de bzhin nyid/ /byang chub sems ni 'dir gsungs so/ /lha mo bzhis 7yongs su 81—950

zhus pa las lha mo spyan mas yongs su zhus pa'i le'u ste dang po'o51) //de nas lha mo mā ma khris/ /rdo rje can la 'di zhus te/ /byang chub sems kyi rim pa yil/ /kha snying lte ba gsang ba la/ /'gro dang phyir 'ong bstan pa ni/ /rdo rje chen pos ( skabaka' stsal 'tshal/ /cha shas rnam pa du zhig gsungs/ /gnas kyi rnam pa bsgyur ba du/ /kha dog rnam pa du zhig gsungs/ /de bzhin gdan yang ji ltar 'tshal/ /rdo rje can gyis bka' stsal pa/ /cha shas bzhi dang mnyam ldan zhing / /pad+ma bzhi la yang dag gnas/ /snying ga'i (0pad+ma la gnas gnag5kha yi pad+ma la gnas dkar/ /nga ro lte ba'i pad+mar gnas/ /gsang ba'i pad+ma nga ro mtha'/ /stabs kyi mtha' ru 'gro byed pas/ /thig le'i sbyor bar 6)rab tu gnas/ /snom (7)byed pa dang thos byed pa/ /de tshe mthong byed za byed pa/ /reg par byed kyang de kho nas/ /bde dang sdug bsngal tshor byed pa'o/ /gang las bzhad byed bza' 3)byed pa/ /de bzhin cho nge 99dang ngu ba/ /'byed 7pa gcod pa de kho nas/ /cho ga rnam pa mang po shes/ /rgyal po don yang byed par 'gyur / /dbang phyug don yang byed par 'gyur/ /bram ze rgyal po rje'u rigs dang ske/ /dmangs rigs smad pa'i rigs rnams dang / /bud med du ma sprul 11par byed/ /dud 'gro yi dgas 8skye ba dang / /gzugs can rnams dang gzugs med dang / /de bzhin 'dod pa'i srid rnams las/ /'byung ba thams cad skyed byed ma8/ /de nyid kho na rdzu 'phrul gnas/ /mo gzugs dang ni pho yi gzugs / /bde ba chen po go 'phang gnas/ /de ltar de bzhin nyid shes pa/ /dam pa'i yig 'bru shes pa gang / /des ni gsang chen shes pa ste/ /gang des 81—951

bdag nyid kun gnas pa/ /kha dog med cing kha dog dmar/ /kha dog dkar dang ser ba yi/ /thig le'i gzugs su bsgyur ba 'di911/ /'gro dang phyir 'ong rnam 95par bstan/ /gang de rig pa rdzu 'phrul che/ /mtha' yas bcas pa sna tshogs gzugs/ /skye sde dang bsdus dang 'jig 3)pa la/ /thig le'i gzugs su rab gnas so/ /gang gi 5)brgyad khri rtsa bzhi'i (6)chos/ /stong phrag brgya ru shes na yang ske/ /de yis tshon/de nyid mi shes te/ /de dag kun kyang 'bras med do/ /bcu gnyis lnga yi lnga pa yang / /brgyad kyi mtha' ru 'byung ba 'dus/ /sgra yig (9dang po yi ge a/ /lnga pa yis ni yang dag brgyanayi/ /snying rje chen po las byung ba / /kha mar bltas pa'i drug pas btags511/ /gdod ma mtha' ma med pa'i lha / /de ni spyi bor bstan pa yin/ /de dag gsang chen dam pa yin/ /lha mo bdag tshogis rab bstan to/ /lha mo bzhis yongs su zhus pa las lha mo mā ma khris zhus pa ste le'u gnyis pa'o// //de nas lha mo gos dkar mos/ /yan lag kun gyis btud nyananas su/ /thal mo snying gar misbyar byas te/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la gsol pa/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi bsdu ba ribodang / /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yi/ /rang bzhin nyid ni ji ltar salags/ /lha yi dbang phyug khyod la zhum/ /gang gis 'od kyi gong bur bsdum/ /rdo rje sems dpa' ji ltar lags/ /gsungs shig de nyid yig 'bru'i tshig /'dus pa gsungs pa ji ltar lags/ /chu khams dang ni me yi khams/ /ji ltar ro ni mnyam por 'gyur/ /ma las skye ba gsum tsam dang / /de bzhin pha las skye ba gsum/ /de dag drug sogs gong bu las/ /ji ltar mi rnams skye 81—952

ba lags/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni bdag mi 'tshal/ /thub pa chen pos bka' stsal mdzod/ /rdo rje can gyis bka' stsal pa/ /gsang ba shin tu gsang gyur pa// nyon cig lha mo bshad par bya/ /skye gnas dbus su rtsa gnyis ni/ /g.yon dang de bzhin g.yas pa ste/ /g.yon du byang chub sems zhes bya/ /g.yas ༅7su de bzhin rak+ta'o/ /de gnyis phrad nas gcig 'gyur ba/ /chos kyi dbyings ni 'dus pa yin/ /mun pa sku ste rdul gsung gzugs/ /thugs kyi rang bzhin snying stobs te/ /rdul ni rak+ta (7byang chub sems/ /mun pa de bzhin skyed ri pa yin / /rdo rje pad+ma mnyam sbyar nas/ /rang bzhin mnyam pa'i ror 'gyur ro/ /dri chen chu dang shel me tog /de bzhin lnga pa byang chub sems/ /bdud rtsi lnga dngos gong bur bsdus/ /de las rdo rje 4'dir gsungs so/ /cha shas gnyis pa dang ldan pa/ /de bzhin dgu pa yang tsho yin no/ /de skad gsungs pa de la ni/ /sum cu dang ni 6)bcu dang ni/ /de bzhin lnga pa'i sa bon te/ /cha shas gnyis pa lnga yis (me)ni/ /drug gis tshonarabatags pa des byung (9)ba/ /de ni thig ler gsungs pa'o / /chos kyi dbyings kyi yig 'bru byobo/ /skye gnas pad+ma la gnas pa/ /de nyid sa bon swā hā mtha'17/ /'dus pa la ni shes par bya/ /chu khams pha las skye zhes tsobya/ /me yi rmo khams ni ma las skyes/ /sha dang khrag dang pags ṅka pa yang / /ma las skyes pa zhes bshad dom/ /tshil dang rkang dang khu ba ni/ /pha las skyes zhes 8bshad pa yin/ /gong bur nya tshoyang dag 'dus pa ni/ /de dag tsam bla du bshad pa yin/ /gzugs dang tshor ba 'du shes dang / /de bzhin 'du byed rnam 7shes rnams/ /sangs rgyas dngos po lnga yi gzugs/ /phung po zhes byar bshad pa'o/ /lha mo bzhis yongs su zhus pa las lha mo na bza' 2 781—953

dkar mos zhus pa ste le'u gsum pa'o// //de nas bzhad 1pa'i zhal 'gyur te/ /lha mo sgrol ma bcom ldan mas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la zhus pa/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi sgrub 4pa ni/ /gsungs shig rdo rje can chen po/ /rdzas 5rnams sgrub par tshibaka' stsal 'tshal/ /de bzhin rig pa'i sngags rnams kyang / /dkyil 'khor rnams ni brtag pa dang / /sbyin sreg so sor bya ba dang / /de bzhin mchod pa'i cho ga yang / /khyad par du yang bka' stsal 'tshal/ /de ltar lha mos zhus ma thag /rdo rje sems dpas bka' stsal pa/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi sgrub thabs ni/ /nyon cig lha mo bshad par bya/ /gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ni/ /de bzhin ro dang reg la sogs/ /khams bcwa 8brgyad po de dag kyang / /chos kyi dbyings zhes 9bya ba'o/ /de dag nyid las byung ba ni/ /byang chub sems zhes 7shes par bya/ /byang chub sems las gong bu skye/ /gong bu ’ las kyang yid skyed mdo/ /yid las nam mkha'i khams kyang ni/ /khams rnams dang ni skye mched rnams/ /dbang po phung po 'byung ba rnams / /de ltar dbyings su bsdus pa nya ste/ /bsdu ba de ni bstan dbyas pa/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi sgrub pa yin/ /de bas nan tan thams cad kyis / /sgrub pa yang dag spyad par rgyal/ /ji ltar kul ba 7zhes dngos kyis/ /bsgrub par bya ba rab tu brtag /chos dbyings sgrub 9pa bshad nas su/ /rdzas brgyad yan lag sgrub pa bshad/ / ril bu /mig sman dngos grub dang / /sa 'og ral gri'i dngos grub dang / /nam mkhar 2'phur dang mig sman ridang / /'chi ba med dang nad 'joms dang / /mi dang glang po che dang rta/ /glang dang 81—954

khyi dang bong bu dang / /rnga mo ma he spyang gi 1rnams/ /cha ni mnyam por 2bya ba'o / /mthe bong tshigs tshad tsam du ni/ /shin tu mnyam par bzhag nas sbyar / /dri chen chu dang rak+ta dang / /byang chub sems nas 4tshad tsam ni/ /sngags bzlas nas ni sbyar byas te/ /byin gyis brlabs 5kyang bya ba'o/ /phyag 'tshal dang ni yi ge āḥphyi/ /dbus su de bzhin rtsu byas te/ /'bar ba'i hūṃ 4yig 'bar byed pa/ /dgu po de ni rab tu bsgrub / /lan ni nyi shu rtsa gcig tu / /sngags bzlas nas ni phye mar btagasal/ /yungs kur ’ lnga yi tshad tsam du//lnga dang lnga ni 'byor bar bya/ /tshes brgyad dang ni bcu bzhi la/ / ril bu 7rnams ni byas skanas su/ /pad+ma'i snod la bzhag byas te/ /stong phrag brgyar ni bzla bar —bya/ /mtshams bzhi la ni bsgom 'byas nas/ /nyin dang mtshan du bza' bar bya/ /de nas labaskal pa'i mtha' bar ’ yang / /dngos grub rgyas par 'gro ba ste/ /gzi brjid mdangs dang stobs brtson 'grus/ /lnga pa la ni smon lam yang / /mngon par shes pa lnga thob pa/ / ril bu 8chen po zos phyir ro / /rdzas kyi sgrub pa rnams rdzogs nas/ /rig 19pa'i sngags rnams bdag la stsol—/ /yi ge e dang bo yig dang / /lo yig dbus su yang dag gnas/ /dang po'i mdog ni dmar po ste/ /gnyis pa yi ni mdog dkar ba/ /gsum pa kha dog ser ba 7rnams/ /bha ga'i dbus su bsgom par bya/ /'khor lo ltar ni bskor ba ni/ /nyin phyed dang ni mtshan phyed la/ /rig pa de ni rab 'byor na/ /de ni skad cig kho nar 'grub/ /lha mo lha min bu mo dang / /mi yi bu mo rnam pa bzhi / /sa yi dkyil 'khor kun du ni/ /sngags kyis bkug nas spyad par 2 bya / /bsgom pa de bzhin rig pa'i sngags/ /bdag gis bshad pa zin byas 81wa 955

te / /dkyil 'khor rnams ni bshad par bya/ /dga' ma sems kyis 3rtse gcig nyon / /dkyil 'khor lus zhes gsungs pa ste/ /dkyil 'khor bha gar bstan pa yin/ /dkyil 'khor byang chub sems dang ni/ /dkyil 'khor gsum du btags pa yin/ /btags pa rnams kyang 'dus pa ste/ /gang du gtso bo skyed par byed/ /phung po rnams ni sangs rgyas gsungs/ /'byung ba rig mar btags pa'o5/ /chags phyopa lcags kyu kho na ste / /zhags pa pad+mar chud byed pa / /kha phrad pa ni sgrog yin par/ /sgra bsgrags pa ni dril bur bshad/ /spos ni dri chen zhes gsungs te/ /me tog rak+ta zhes 'dod do/ /mar me shu rnams kho na yin/ /dri ni byang chub sems zhes 'dod/ /sgeg mo liṅgar bstan pa ste/ /phreng ba bha ga kho na yin/ /dbyangs ma dbugs su bstan pa dang / /gar mkhan ma ni rnal 'byor te/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bzang por gsungs/ /de rtogs pa ni skal bzang 9yin/ /rtogs pa de rnams byams pa sogs/ /de ltar nang gi bdag nyid gsungs/ /dkyil 'khor gzhan ni sngon bshad zin/ /sbyin sreg 7las ni bshad par bya/ /nyon cig sbyin sreg rnam ha pa bzhi/ /sbyin sreg 7phyi dang nang gsungs te/ /phyi ni sngon : du bstan pa yin/ /nyon cig khyod kyis nang gi ni/ /pad+ma bzhi rnams 'byor pa ni/ /lus kyi dbus su nye 'bar gnas / /me dang de bzhin rlung dang ni/ /dbang chen dang ni chu de bzhin/ /rlung gis me ni sa'abar byas te/ /chu yis yongs su smin 7par byed/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor las byung ba/ /gang du me ni bskyod pa'o/ /ra yig mngon spyod yi ge ste/ /ya yig dbang gi 7las kho na/ /la yig rgyas par 'gyur ba ste/ /ba yig ’ zhi ba zhes gsungs so/ /gang zhig zas dang btung ba ni/ /de dag 81—956

thams cad chu la ste/ /pad+mar k+ṣaḥ1 yig kha mar lta / /snying gi pad+mar btsud par bya/ /lte ba'i pad+mar 'gro phyi rol/ /kha sbyor tshul gyi sbyor ba yis/ /gsang ba'i pad+mar 'gro ma thag /thal bar mtha' ru rnam par bstan / /de ltar sbyin sreg 4bdag bshad pa/ /nyin dang nyin 5du bya ba ste/ /rtag par rgyun du zas zos na/ /tshe 'di kho nar 'grub par 'gyur/ /rgas pa med cing nad kyang med//'chi ba med cing 'bras rnams med/ /de ni glo bur 'chi ba med/ /'tshe phyob thams cad zad 'gyur zhing / /rmi lam ngan yang zhi bar 'gyur/ /bzang po bskal snyopar gson pa ste/ /sems can thams cad dga' bar smra/ /mthong ba tsam gyis skul byed do/ /sbyin /sreg 7las rnams rnye bshad byas nas/ /lha mo mchod pa bstan par bya/ /dri dang phreng sogs gos rnams dang / /spos me zas dang lha bshos kyis/ /dbang po gnyis ni rab pa'abyor nas/ /bdag la mchod pa rnams ni bya/ /bdag ni thams cad sangs rgyas nyid/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gnas yin te/ /de bas nan tan thams cad kyis/ /rnal 'byor bas ni rtag tu mchod/ /gang zhig 'ga' sa yang bya ba'i las/ /rnal 'byor pa yis mchod par bsgomacho/ /zas dang btung ba de bzhin gosapa/ /de bzhin dri dang phreng kho ོnas / /rig ma bzhi 7yis rnam brgyan pa'i/ /bdag ni 19lha nyid bsam par bya / /de ltar bshad nas rdo rje de/ /cang mi gsung bar dngos por bzhugs/ /de nas lha mo bzhi rnams kyis/ /phyag gis thal mo sbyar gyur te/ / rab tu zhal ni rnam bzhad nas/ /rab tu dang ba'i sems kyis rini/ /rnam par mi rtog pa thob ste/ /cang mi gsung bar bzhugs gyur to/ /lha mo bzhis yongs su zhus pa las lha mo sgrol rims zhus pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //81—957

zhes bya ba'i rgyud/1tshog /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra dz+nyā na sa muts+tsha ya nā ma tan+t+ra/ bod skad du/ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji skad du/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rgyud las ji lta ba bzhin du gsungs pa'o//byams pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' drug stong gis bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ bcom ldan ca'adas ma rig 5pa dang / sems las byung ba dang /sems zhes bgyi ba ci lags/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rjes bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu nyon cig /ye shes gsum rdo rje las yang dag par byung ba de'i phyir ye shes gsum rdo rje'i rang bzhin no/ /byams pas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ye shes gsum rdo rje'i ngo bo ji ltar lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/81—962

yang dag pa'i mtha' zab pa/ 'gag pa med pa/ skye ba med pa/ de'i rkyen gyis ma rig pa ste/ ma rig pa zhes bya ba dang / snang 1ba nye bar thob pa dang /stong pa chen po'o/ /de yang rtogs 2par dka' ba'o/ /'on kyang snang ba dang bcas par brjod par bya'o/ /ma rig ripa'i rkyen gyis sems las byung ba ste/de ni snang ba mched pa dang shin tu stong pa zhes gsungs so/ /sems las byung ba'i rkyen gyis sems te/ de ni snang rib dang stong pa ste/ sems dang sems las byung ba dang / ma rig pa'i rang bzhin bdag med pa'o/ /gsum po de dang de 'od gsal ba las byung bas 5rdo rje'i rang bzhin no/ /de nas byams pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur pas cang mi smra phyi bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs nardo rjes byang chub sems dpa' k+ṣ-ichen po de rnams cang mi smra bar 'dug pa mthong nas bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu ci'i phyir cang mi smra bar gyur pas 'dug /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po chosade rnams kyis ’ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la phyag 'tshal te gtugs lonas gzhan yang zhus pa/ e ma'o ston pa rtogs par dka' ba rnam par shes pa :rigasum gyi khudabye ba mchog tu zab pa bcom ldan 'das bshad du gsol / bde bar gshegs pa bshad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang 'od gsal ba las byung ba rnam par shes pa de nyid sems dang /yid dang / rnam par shes pa zhes bya la/ de ni chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba ste/kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba'i bdag nyid de las rtog pa gnyis su gyur te bdag dang gzhan dag tu'o/ /rnam par shes pa de'i bzhon sku81—963

pa rlung ngo / /rlung las 1me'o/ /me las chu'o/ /chu las sa'o/ de rnams las phung po lnga dang / skye mched drug dang / yul lnga ste/ de dag thams cad ni rnam par shes pa rlung dang 'dres pa'o/ /de nas rnam par shes pa gsum gyi rang bzhin gyi snang ba rab tu gsal bar spyod pa rjes su myong bar byed de/snang ba'i rgyus rang bzhin rnams yang dag par 'byung ngo / /de la 'od gsal ba gnas med pa/ 'gag pa med pa/ skye ba med pa/ don dam pa'i bden pa / yang dag pa'i mtha' ste/ de las byung ba'i mun pa'i snang ba ni ma rig pa'o / /de'i rang bzhin lta ba dang / 'khrul pa dang / rnam par g.yeng ba dang —/ brjed ngas cipa dang / le lo dang / mi smra ba dang / mi gsal ba'o/ /ma rig pa sems las 5byung ba ste/ nyi ma'i snang ba lta bu phyodang / shin tu gsal ba'i smig rgyu lta 7bu'o/ /de'i rang bzhin 'dod chags dang / dga' ba dang ske/ mchog tu dga' ba dang / drag po la sogs pa dang / kun rdzob tu mngon sum 9du skyes pa'i gzugs dang / lha'i tshogs dang / mtshan ma dang /rdo rje'i brda'ol/ /sems las byung ba las sems te/ zla ba'i snang ba dang shin tu gsal ba'i chu'i zla ba lta bu'o/ /rang bzhin ni 'dod chags dang bral ba la sogs pa'o/ /kun rdzob tu ni mngon sum gyi/ bud med dang / bha ga dang /pad+ma dang / lha mo'i ’ tshogs kyi brda'o/ /rdo rje dang pad+ma yang dag par sbyor ba las shes rab kyi ye shes byung ba las/ rang gi rdo rje'i 'bad pa las me'o/ /me las chu stes/ nur nur po'i rnam pa dang / de las mer mer po dang / nar nar po dang / gor gor po dag go/ /de nas 'dod chags dang bral ba'i snang ba la khrag gi gong bu mkhrang gyur rnams so/ /de khu ba dang khrag dag gis bskyed 81—964

pa'o1ri / /de nas dbang po gnyis mnyam par sbyor rnab las 'dod chags so/ /'dod chags las 'dod chags dang bral ba dang / bar ma'i 'dod chags rab tu shes par bya ste/ de'i phyir lus te/ lus las byung ba'i skyil krung labacing ba la sogs pa dang / gsung gi phyag rgya'i thabs su gyur pa/ ā li kā 5li las yang dag par byung ba'i sngags dang / sems kyi phyag rgya'i thabs su gyur pa sa bon dang mtshan ma las lhar dmigs pa'o/ /gzugs la sogs pa'i yul ni dbang po gnyis snyoms par zhugs pa'i thabs su gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje dang pad+ma yang dag par sbyor ba ni sems dang sems las byung ba dag gi thabs su gyur pa'o / /sems dang sems las byung ba mnyam par sbyar ba ni bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyi thabs su gyur pa'o/ /de sgyu nema'i dpes nye bar mtshon pa ste/de'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni sgyu ma lta bu dang / chu zla dang / mig yor dang / smig rgyu dang / rmi lam dang / sgra brnyan dang / dri za'i grong khyer dang / mig 'phrul dang /dbang po'i gzhu dang / glog dang / chu bur dang / me long gi 7gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis kyis bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin nye bar mtshon par byed pa yin no/ /ji ltar 'o ma bsrubs 9pa las mar dang /ji ltar til las til mar te/ de bzhin du rdo rjes ni thabs kyi ye shes nye bar mtshon pa'i phyir dang / pad+mas ni shes rab kyi ye shes nye bar mtshon pa'i phyir ro//ji ltar 'o ma dang til dag ’ yang dag par mngon par 'dus byas pa med par til mar mi 'byung ba de bzhin du/ sngags dang phyag rgya dmangon par 'dus byas pa'i rdo rje dang / pad+ma mnyam par sbyar ba med par rnam par shes pa gsum 81—965

nye bar mtshon par mi nus so/ /gang gis bha ga dang ling ga yang dag par sbyor bar mi nus pa des ni bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin mi rnyed do/ /bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin 'ba' zhig la lhag par mos pa tsam gyis 1ni las dang po pa'i sa la gnas par 'gyur te/ phyir mi ldog pa la yang slob par 'gyur ro/ /gang rdo rje dang pad+ma mnyam par sbyor ba'i bde bas rang bzhin snang ba yang dag par nye bar mtshon par byed pa de ni/ bde ba chen po'i go 'phang la rab tu gnas par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni sbas pa'i bshad pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das spyi'i 4don ji ltar lags / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nyan thos la sogs pa 'dod chags dang bral ba'i chos spyod pa / rnam par rtog pa'i bag chags las ma grol ba rnams rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dag tu btsun mo'i bha ga la bzhugs zhes bya ba la sogs pa/ 'dod chags kyi chos gsal bar byed pa/ ngo mtshar can gyi rdo rje'i tshig thos nas smod par byed pa de rnams dang mi 'gal ba'i sgo nas bshad pa de ni spyi'i don du bshad pa gsungs pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'dod chags la spyod pa'i chos kyi tshul du mthar thug pa bshad pa tsho ji ltar lags/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams legs so/ /legs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po snying rje mchog dang ldan pa rnams nyon cig /mtha' ni mu ste/ 'od gsal ba yang dag pa'i tshul zhes bya ba mthar thug pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das thabs gang gis mthar thug pa thob pa lags na/81—966

bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched la sogs pa'i mtha' stong pa gsum mo/ /stong pa gsum gyi mtha' 'od gsal ba'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das stong pa gsum 'od gsal ba'i mthar ji ltar 'gyur ba lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ji ltar mes shing bsregs te/ thal bar byed pa de bzhin du 'od gsal bar shes rab kyi ye shes yun ring pos rnam par sbyong bar 1byed do/ /ji ltar ta la'i lo ma thal bar byed pa de bzhin du thabs kyi ye shes rnam par sbyong bar 5)byed do/ /ji ltar ras bal gyi 'dab 4ma bsregs pa de bzhin du snang ba thob pa'i ye shes mchog tu myur bas rnam par sbyong bar (5)byed do/ /de bas na rim pa 'dis shing ta la'i 6lo ma dang / ras bal gyi 'dab 9 ma thal bar 'gyur ba de bzhin du stong pa dang / shin tu stong pa dang / stong pa chen po rnams mthar 'od gsal bar 'gyur ro/ /'di ni mthar thug 9pa'i bshad pa gsungs pa'o/ /byams pas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rnal 'byor gyi 'irgyud du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mtha' drug gis bshad pa ji ltar lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dgongs pas bshad pa dang / dgongs pa ma yin pas bshad pa dang / drang ba'i don dang —/ nges pa'i don dang / sgra ji bzhin pa dang / sgra ji bzhin pa ma yin pa rnams so/ /byams pas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das thugs brtse ba nye bar bzhag geste/ tshig re re'i bshad pa bka' stsal du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang mthar thug par snyebashad pa de nyid dgongs pas bshad pa ste/ 'di lta ste/ 'dod chags ma yin pa dang / 'dod chags dang 81—967

bral ba ma yin pa dang / bar ma nye bar mi dmigs pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa rdo rje'i tshig rnams ni dgongs pas bshad pa'o/ /lus dang / ngag dang / yid med pa dang / bdag med pa dang / thams cad stong pa dang / dag pa dang /'od gsal ba zhes bya ba la sogs pa rdo rje'i tshig ni dgongs pa ma yin pas bshad pa'o/ /ga pur dang 1/ khrag chen po dang / tsan+dan dmar po nadang /rdo rje dang / pad+ma dang / phyag rgya zhes bya ba la sogs pa rdo rje'i tshig rnams ni drang ba'i don te / ga bur ni khu ba dang / khrag chen po ni zla mtshan gyi khrag dang —/ tsan+dan dmar po'i khu ba dang bsres pa ni tsan+dan dmar po'o/ /rdo rje ni mtshan ma ste thabs so/ /pad+ma ni bha ga ste shes rab dang / phyag rgya dang /btsun mo zhes bya ba la 5sogs pa rdo rje'i tshig rnams ni nges pa'i don to/ / gnyis ka spyodang / spyod pa dang / bya ba'i rgyud rnams su don gsal bar gsungs pa 'di lta ste/ dkyil 'khor dang / mchod sbyin dang / gtor ma dang —/ sman dang / zhi ba la sogs pa'i las kyi tshogs rnams dang / de bzhin du 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub chen po brgyad gsungs pa rnams ni sgra ji bzhin pa ste/ de ni yi ge'i don gyi bshad pa'o/ /ko tā khya/ ko tā ba/ ko tāḥ ko tā brtsi/ ko tri rā gā / ko la khya/ ko la ba / ko la/ ko la ba:/ko lasta tha/ 'dis dbang po dang yul gsungs te / de lta bu la sogs pa rdo rje'i tshig rnams ni sgra ji 7bzhin pa ma yin pas bshad pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' ’ chen pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dang / gnyis ku'i lorgyud dang / spyod pa'i rgyud dang / bya ba'i rgyud dang / rtog : pa'i rgyud rnams kyi tshad ji ltar lags/ bcom ldan 'das 81—968

kyis bka' stsal pa/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud kyi ming stong phrag bcu gnyis zhes bya ste/ rgyas par phye 1na grangs med do/ /gnyis ku'i rgyud stong phrag drug go/ /spyod pa'i rgyud stong phrag brgyad do/ /bya ba'i rgyud stong phrag bzhi'o/ /rtog pa'i rgyud stong phrag bzhi'o/ /de dag ni stong phrag sum cu rirtsa bzhi ste/ rgyud dang rtog pa'i ming gi mtha' ma'i yi ge ji snyed pa ni/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa bha paṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa / 'di dag ni ming gi yi ge'i mtha' ma rnams so/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de rnams kyi byed pa dang / cho ga dang / bsgrub bya dang / sgrub pa de gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ don dam pa'i bden pa las bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i rim gyis langs te/ 'dod chags las phyobyung ba'i byang chub kyi gnas pa rab tu bstan pa'i phyir/ btsun mo'i 'khor gyi dbus su 'khor los sgyur 9ba'i gzugs kyi dzibade ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyis btsun mo'i bha ga la yang dag par bzhugs te/ 'jig rten gyi spyod pa dang 'gal ba rmad du byung ba'i rdo rje'i tshig gi mtha' drug gang ’ gis rab tu dpyad de sgrub dpar byed pa ni rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud la bzhugs so/ /rig pa'i lha mo rnams dang lhan cig t+t+waṃdakyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la dgod pa skadang / de las byung ba'i byed pa dang /las dang / sgrub pa la sogs pa de kho na nyid rnam pa bcu rab tu dpyad de sgrub par byed pa ni gnyis ku'i brgyud la bzhugs laso/ /las kyi bya ba sna tshogs phyag 7rgya chen po bya ba'i rgyud kyi phyag rgya dmigs pa'i mtshan nyid rab tu dpyad : pas bsgrub par bya ba dang / sgrub dzopar byed pa ni spyod pa'i rgyud la bzhugs so/ /81—969

'jigs par dmigs shing shin tu gtsang sbra byed pa dang / ye shes sems dpa'i bde ba dam 1pa med pa dang / bdag nyid lha'i bsnyems 5pa med pa dang —/ rmad du byung ba'i spyod yul ma yin pa dang / skyon gyi rgyu'i rtog dpas rab tu dpyod capas sgrub par byed pa ni bya ba'i rgyud la bzhugs so/ /sngags dang —/ sman dang / sbyin sreg 5dang / phye ma dang / mig sman dang / rkang mgyogs la sogs pa dngos grub chen po brgyad porab tu dpyad pa sgrub par byed pa ni rtog pa'i rgyud nal bzhugs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rgyan rnam pa bdun ji ltar lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gleng 9bslang ba rnam pa lnga dang mtha' drug gis 7bshad pa dang / rigs pa rnam ’ pa bzhi dang / bshad pa rnam pa bzhi dang /dbye ba rnam pa gnyis dang / gang zag rnam pa lnga'i slob ma brtag pa dang /bden pa rnam pa gnyis kyi dgongs pa rnams so/ /gleng bslang ba rnam pa lnga ni 'di lta ste/ ming dang / gang gi 2don du byas pa dang / byed pa po dang /tshad dang / dgos sna pa rnams so/ /mtha' drug tu bshad pa ni 'di lta ste/dgongs pas bshad pa dang / dgongs pa lam yin pas bshad pa dang /drang ba'i don dang / nges pa'i don dang / sgra ji bzhin pa dang / sgra ji bzhin pa ma yin pa rnams so/ /rigs dpa rnam pa bzhi ni/ rgyud dang / gleng gzhi tshedang / nges tshig dang / rgyu rnams so/ /bshad pa rnam pa bzhi ni/ yi ge'i don dang / spyi'i don dang / sbas pa dang / mthar thug pa rnams so/ /dbye ba rnam pa tshoganyis ni 'di lta ste/ tshogs la bshad pa dang / slob ma la bshad ’ pa'o/ /gang zag rnam pa lnga'i slob ma brtag pa ni 'di lta ste/ rin po 81—970

che dang / tsan+dan dang / pad+ma dang / pad+ma dkar po dang / ut+pa la rnams sol/ /bden pa rnam pa gnyis kyi dgongs pa ni 'di lta ste/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa dang / don dam pa'i bden pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu kun rdzob ni mi brtan pa dang g.yo ba'o/ /de'i bden pa ni chu zla lta bu'o/ /don dam pa'i bden pa ni stong pa chen po bcwa 1brgyad do/ /de'i mtha' ni gnas so/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis gsol pa/ /don dam pa'i bden pa la rab tu gnas pa'i rnal 'byor chen po bas las kyi rgyal po mchog gi ting nge 'dzin la brten nas sems can gyi don ji ltar rab tu spyod par bgyid/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ji srid du zhi ba la sogs pa'i las kyis 5sems can gyi don mi byed pa de srid du yang dag pa'i mtha' la rab tu gnas par 'gyur ro/ /gang du sems can gyi don bya bar mthong ba de'i tshe bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pas yang dag pa'i mtha' las langs te/ sems can gyi don byas nas yang dag pa'i mtha' nyid du 'jug par byed do/ /de nas byams pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams dga' zhing mgu la yi 4rangs te/ dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes nas cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa zhes bya ba rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud las/ bde ba chen po'i le'u ste rim par phye ba gnyis pa'o/ /rdzogs sto45// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dz+nyā na 6ka ra'i zhal snga nas dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba khu ston dngos grub kyis bsgyur/ slad nas bla ma de nyid dang / dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas zhus shing gtan la phab pa // //ye shes rdo rje kun las btus/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i gsal byed yin/ /81—971

༄ga /phrin las thams cad 'byung ba'i sgrol ma 'dus pa don dam pa zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 3no༄7na /5rgya gar skad du/ sa mā ridza pa 4ra mārba sarba 1rmo da ya nā rnam tā rā yo gi nī tan+t+ra rā dza/ bod skad du/ phrin yi las thams cad 'byung ba'i sgrol ma 'dus pa don dam pa zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de nas dngos grub thams cad ni/ /rab tu sgrub byed bshad par bya / / bud med bye ba phrag brgya yang / /bdag la dad pas 'dud par byed/ /lha dang lha min rig 'dzin dang / /mi yi gtso bo dbang du byed/ /nyi ma zla ba dang mtshungs shing / /mkha' lding rgyal pos rnam par 'dud/ /klu rnams sdigs 9par byed pa dang / /lami dang mi min gang gi yang :mo/ /bu mo thams cad 'dzag byed pa/ /skyes pa gcig gis 'dod chen gyis/ /mi yi bu mo khri phrag dang / /nyin rer lha dang lha min mo/ /bud med 'bum phrag zil gnon pa/ /khu ba rengs tshapa'i byed pa las/ /gcig gis thams cad 'dod spyod pa/ /rdo rjer 81—975

byed pa rab tu bshad/ /'jigs pa kun las thar ba dang / /bskal pa chen por tshe yang gnas/ /1mkha' la 'gro dang mi snang dang / /ri lu la sogs rig 'dzin dang / /bcud kyi len dang gnod sbyin mo/ /rab tu sgrub byed sngags chen po/ /khrag khrig bcu gnyis mkha' 'gro ma/ /'byung po bye ba mthu chen dang ske/ /grong khyer gsum 'joms tshangs sogs lha/ /mngag gzhug nyid du byed par 'gyur/ / 'das pa'i dus na rdo rje can/ /sangs rgyas dbugs dbyung dkyil 'khor sprul/ /bde mchog bde mchog dges rdo rje/ /yid bde thig le la sogs bstan/ /'bum phrag brgya pa sgrol ma yi/ /sngags kyi rgyal po sngon bshad pa/ /rdzogs ldan dus su mi rnams spyod/ /de nas 'bum phrag drug pa bshad / /de yang nub nas khri nyis stong / /phyi ma'i dus su bshad pa yin/ /de yi snying po rtsod dus 'dir/ /g.yon pa'i spyod pas rnam spyod pas/ /nges brjod 'bum gyi rjes 'brang ba/ /slar yang rgyud 'di snang bar gyur / /4nges par 'dod chags chags chen 'dis/ /'dod ldan rnams la 5byang chub ster/ /sangs rgyas phrin phyolas thams cad 'byung / /dam tshig sgrol ma zhes bya'i sngags/ /mkha' 'gro ma kun 'dus pa las/ /dam pa'i don yang 'grub pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ma dam tshig sgrol mas rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ tā re tustu re tu re swā hā/ 'di ni dngos grub thams cad byed pa'o/ /oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥ swā hā/ ku ru kul+le'ol/ /oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re rgyu phaṭa/ snying po'o//oṃ tā re swā hā/ gsung skul ’ bar byed pa'o/ /oṃ āḥrta da / thugs skul bebar byed pa'o/ /na mo rat+na traṃ sayā ya/ na mo ād+ma las ba lo ki te 9shwa rā ya/bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ’ ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā 19ya/ tabya thā/ oṃ tā re 81—976

tut+ta )re tu re sarba duṣ+ṭa / pra du// ma ma kṛ te/ dzam+bha ya/ ste bha 4ya/ mo hā ya/ brnya ya/ rtsu rtsu rgyu/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba du/ ste bha 5ni tā re gā hā/'di ni las thams cad byed pa'o/ /lo mi paṃ rta rgyu/ lha mo lnga'i'o/ /oṃ ā raṇ+ḍa 'argyo rgyo ha ha ha ha si si si si/ zhes pa ni he ru ku'i sngags so/ /oṃ ā raṇ+ḍa ra —ga dze dze dze bh+yo swā hā/ zhes pa ni sngags gnyis pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra bā rā /tī ā mabe sha 1ya sarba dz+wa ra ṇa hrīḥswā hā/ rdo rje phag mo'i'od/ /oṃ ma ri partsu mi swā hā / 'od zer can ma'i'o/ /oṃ hro ches hūṃ phaṭa/ ral pa tshagacig ma'i'o/ /oṃ gu hā/ zhi bar byed pa'o/ /oṃ oṃ/ rgyas par byed pa'o/ /oṃ bā ṣaṭa ho/dbang du byed pa'o/ /oṃ phaṭa/ gsod par byed pa'o/ /ṭ+wā hā/ lo/ lo/lo / hriḥ7 dzaḥ phaṭa/ phaṭa/ ces pa ni las brgyad byed pa'o/ /dzaḥs bo hoḥ 'gugs 7par byed pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūm̐ r+ghaṃ phaṭa swā hā/ srung ba'i'o / /s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ spro ba'i'o/ /oṃ a kro dhe 19ka ya mān+ta ka rtsu/ gshin rje rtsogashed kyi'o/ /oṃ na mo a tsa la kā na tses tses mos mos tus tus gha gha ghā ta ya bhā ta ya rtsu phaṭa/ gtum po'i'o/ /oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta dbadz+ra kro dha ha ya spyi rib hūm̐ 2 hu lu tswa lu rgyu phaṭa/ rta mgrin gyi'o/ /na maḥs man+ta bu rgyo/ na mo ma hā badz+ra kro dhā ciya/ ma hā dostoska ṭa lha ra bā ya/ badz+ra sasdo ha daṅgā ya/ oṃ a mṛ ta /kuṇ+ḍa li r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i'o/ /oṃ rgyu shri 0ya de bī kā lī kā lī ma hā kā ri lī rgyu bh+yo snye/ oṃ ma hā kā ri lī dka ra lī bi kran+ta kā la rā tshospyi tsaṇ+ḍa ru pi tī rgyu phaṭa/ lha mo nag mo'i sngags so/ /oṃ badz+ra tī li tī lā ya sarba baspyosad+dha r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ phur bus gdab pa'i'o/ /sngags kyi le'u ste dang po'o// //81—977

1de nas bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka nas zhags pa dang lcags kyu'i tshogs spros te/ na maḥs man+ta kā ya bārtsit+ta badzā oṃ 3rim ṭak+ki rtsu dzaḥ zhes pa'i sngags 'di phyung ngo / /gdug pa thams cad bkug nas kyang / /nam mkha'i dbyings su skyel nas ni/ /rdo rje phur bu'i tshogs spros nas/ /gnas lnga dag tu phur bus btab / /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa khro bo che/ /rdo rje phur bu skul 4bar mdzod / /stong gsum dag gi khor yug la/ /bgegs rnams thams cad 'ching bar 5mdzad/ /oṃ lo stam+bha 5ya lo/ grog mkhar sa la gzugs byas nas/ /rkang pa g.yas pas mnan byas la/ /mi rus las skyes phur bu yis/ /btab na de yi med la 'chi/ /9sprul dang seṅge glang po dang / /rkun po'i yan lag dag la gdab/ /'di yis gdug cing sdang sems ldan/ /log 'dren dag la gdab par bya/ /7ye shes pad+ma kha phye nas/ /rdo rje phur bu'i 11rab sbyor bas/ /rang rang rigs kyi khro bor bcas/ /rdo rje sems sogs sngags la gdab/ /'di koyis rdo rje 'grub par 'gyur/ /rdo rje phur bus btab pa na/ /phung po rab tu 'jig pa dang / /rdo rje'i gnas kyang thob lha par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rnal 'byor lochen po'i dam tshig go/ /bzla ba nyi ma'i rlung gi dbus//rang sngags sa bon bsgom par bya/ /lha yi de nyid dmigs gyur na/ /bcu drug pa la de 'grub 'gyur/ /sems ni nam mkhar gyur pa la/ /zla ba nyi ma nub pa dang —/ /mun pa'i ye shes thim pa na/ /rdo rje'i lha ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /yang na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /lus kyi dri ma rab sbyangs nas/ /ye shes chen po rang sngags lha/ /zla ba nya la 'grub par 'gyur/ /rang sngags sa bon 'od zer gyis / /rdo rje gur sogs brtag par bya/ /'jigs pa brgyad las bsrung ba 81—978

dang —/ /lus med rnams kyis kyang mi mthong / /spu las nad rnams spre'u 'am/ /khyi dang 'dra bar rab tu dbyung / /ye shes sems dpa'i dam tshig 'dis/ /rdo rje mtshon chas bsnun par bya/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus su ni/ /ye shes me dpung dkar po bsam/ /sems can khams ni ma lus pa'i/ /gnas las me ni 'bar bar bsgrubs1/ /mtshams med lnga dag byed pa yang / /gtsang ma'i gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur/ /sdig pa rdo rje'i ye shes 'dis/ /skad cig gis ni dpal ldan 'gyur/ /nalte ba'i dbus su re ga ribasam/ /a ni mchog tu phra ba ste / /mi 'gyur nyams dga' bde ba'i gnas/ /mi shigs 4tshangs pa 'grub par 'gyur/ /rang sngags r+ghaṃ dang yi ge oṃ/ /rdo rje āḥyig bsam par bya/ /rlung gi de nyid rab grub nas/ /mi 'gro drag po'i ngag tu 'gyur/ /'od zer rnam lnga snying gar gnas/ /pad+mas rdo rje rab dbye ba/ /thig le rdo rjer byed pa ste / /ye shes khyab 'jug rgyal por 'gyur/ /5de nas rdo rje snying po la sogs pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rnams kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'di ci zhig lags/ lte ba las ni rlung khams 'byung / /ci phyir lus kyi chos su 'gyur//bdud las 'das pa'i lam bsgoms phyipas/ /ji ltar tshangs pa la sogs 'gyur / /pad+mas rdo rje 'byed byed ci/ /'di dag ci phyir 'gal mi 'gyur/ /dam tshig de nyid mkhyen pas gsungs/ /nyon cig rdo rje ji bzhin nyon/ /lus ni gzhan dag yod ma yin/ /sems kyi rang bzhin rnam g.yo ba/ /de las 'khrul ba'i lus po byung / /lte ba sku zhes bshad pa ste / /de dag de las byung ba yin/ /bram ze mo la 'dod spyod pa/ /rdo rje sku ru 'gyur ba'o/ /rlung gis smra bar byed pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje'i ngag ste de nyid brjod/ /dbyangs mkhan bu 81—979

mo'i dam tshig gis/ /rdo rje gsung du 'gyur ba yin/ /'khrul pas meganyis su rtog pa'i sems/ /thig le 'di las byung ba'i phyir/ /mig mdzes g.yung mo'i ( dam tshig gis/ /rdo rje thugs su 'gyur ba'o/ /nga ni 'gro bas mi shes te/ /tshangs pa khyab 'jug dbang phyug che/ /'phrul ldan lha zhes 'jig rten rtog /sku dang gsung thugs rdo rje ste/ /thams cad nga yi rnam par 'phrul/ /sku yi rdo rje tshangs par 'gyur/ /gsung gi rdo rje dbang phyug che/ /'jug sel thugs kyi rdo rje'o / /'di ni yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sems can khams la dbyer med de / /de dag rnams kyi lus ngag yid/ /mnyam gyur tshangs la sogs par snang //lus ni sprul pa'i 'khor lor gnas/ /mgrin par de bzhin rmi lam mo/ /gnyid kyi rnal 'byor snying gar snedagod/ /bde ba spyi bor mngon par brjod/ /gzhan yang rtsa lhug ston pa dang / /ri bong stag sogs chu bo dang / /nyin mtshan la sogs dngos kun tu/ /sangs rgyas gar mkhan zlos gar mdzad/ /gnyid la rdo rjes rnam sgom pa/ /tshangs pa'i dam tshig gti mug spong / /gzhan gyis gnyid dang 5spong bar dka'/ /bud med bral la sdom brtson med/ /'dod ldan tshangs spyod chen po ni/ /zhi ba'i dam tshig 'dod chags spong / /zhe sdang rdo rjer rnam sgom nen/ /rmongs sel khyab 'jug dam tshig go/ /gzhan du byams pas spong bar dka'/ /rnam pa 'di gsum gsang chen po/ /lha yi bde ba ser snar bcas/ /brtson 'grus phrag dog dam tshig ste/ /g.yo sgyus bdud rnams 'dul byed pa/ /dam tshig shin tu 'da' bar dka'/ /pad+ma'i snying po bde ba can/ /ji srid ma rnyed 'bras bu med/ /rdor dbyings dbang phyug rtsa 'di yis/ /rdo rje gnyis spang 7'byed par byed/ /shes rab rtogs napar byed 81—980

pa thabs/ /shes rab med la thabs mkhas med/ /rdo rjes 1pad+ma rgyas byed kyi/ /pad+mas 5rdo rje 'byed par byed/ /sprul pa bde chen 'khor los kyang / /chos dang longs spyod rnam par 'byed/ /de ltas 'di ni gsang chen te/ /rgyud gzhan du ni 'bad pas sbas/ /de la 'di ni sku gsum rdo rje'i gsang ba'o/ / /sems med gnas dang 'khrul skyed ridang / /sngon nas rnam par 'khrul ba yi/ /'jig rten 'di la sku gsum gnas/ /chos dang longs spyod rdzogs sprul pa'o/ /rang byung ngo bo brjod med pa/ /chos kun rang bzhin zhi ba brnyes/ /rkyen ni rnam par bkra ba mkhyen/ /rdo rje can gyi chos sku'o/ /me long gzugs brnyan ltar sems 'di/ /phra zhing lus ni rdul med pa/ /skad kyang sgra brnyan cilta bu ste//dag pa'i dkyil 'khor snang ba'o/ /sems can bsam pa ji bzhin du/ /sprul pa tha dad sna tshogs 'jug /longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul pa ste/ /gcig gyur 'dren pa bde ba che/ /rtsa yi dra ba lha mo ste/ /de bzhin khams dang nyer bcas pa'i5 / /bud med rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor/ /spangs nas ri phyimo su zhig len / /de la 'di ni rjes su rnal 'byor gyi dam tshig go/ /dri mas sems ni mngon bsgos pas/ /rnam shes ye shes dag mi 'gyur/ /theg pa mchog gi bgrod pa'i gnas/ /ye shes dbang mo nyan par 'tshal/ /nyon cig ji bzhin rdo rje nyon/ /dngos po bden rdzun 8rnam dpyad na/ /rdzun 9pa'i rdo rje yang dag mthong ske/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i de kho na/ /a zhes bya ba ni ma skyes pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /rtsu zhes bya ba ni ye shes dang ldan pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /phaṭa ces bya ba ni dgas tshapar byed pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /traṃ zhes bya ba ni nyi ma'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /āḥ /zhes bya ba ni smra ba thams cad kyi gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /81—981

ha 1zhes bya ba ni 'chi ba med pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /hrīḥzhes bya ba ni rjes su chags pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /i 5zhes bya ba ni 'jig par byed pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /khaṃ zhes bya ba ni nam mkha' dzo lta bu'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /oṃ 5zhes bya ba ni bde ba chen po'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /k+ṣa zhes bya ba ni rab tu mi gnas pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /aḥzhes bya ba ni gnyis su med pa'i gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /ya zhes bya ba ni rdo rje rlung ste gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /ra zhes bya ba ni rdo rje me ste gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /wa zhes bya ba ni rdo rje chu ste gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /la zhes bya ba ni rdo rje sa ste gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /haṃ zhes bya ba ni rdo rje sems te phyogazungs kyi sgo'o/ /i zhes bya ba ni rdo rje dbang po rnams te gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /bi zhes bya ba ni nam mkha'i khams su byed pa ste gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /a 7zhes bya ba ni chos thams cad kyi gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /rnam shes ye shes rnal 'byor te/ /de dag rdo rje rab sbyor bas / /rnal 'byor la ni rnal 'byor bsgom/ /rjes kyi rnal 'byor zhes bya'o/ /de la 'di ni shin tu rnal 'byor gyi dam tshig go/ /spre'u dang glog ltar mi gnas pa / /rab tu gzung bar dka' ba'i sems/ /'dod pa'i rdo rje rnam dpyad pa / /ye shes dbang mo mnyan 9par 'tshal/ /nyon cig ji bzhin rdo rje nyon/ /gser khams rdo la rnam gnas pa/ /mngon par zhi ba yod ma yin/ /sreg dang dbye ba'i thabs kyis ni/ /nyi ma bzhin du rnam par gsal/ /lcags bzhin me la rnam bzod na/ /gzhan dag ci phyir mi bzod byed/ /de phyir ye shes rnam shes dag /cha gnyis rnam par rtog mi bya/ /cha gnyis las ni sdig pa 'byung / /sdig pas bsod nams zad par 'gyur/ /sdug bsngal sdig pa zhes brjod de/ /bla med bde ba bsod nams so/ /bde dang sdug bsngal mnyam gyur pa/ /81—982

bsod nams sdig med rnam par thar/ /sdug bsngal gyis 1ni sems g.yengs te//dge dang sdig pa rnam par 'byed/ /bu mo'i longs spyod bde ba yis/ /rnam par mi rtog gnyis med 'grub/ /ri bo nyams ni dga' ba dang / /nags tshal dben pa'i sa phyogs su/ /mig bzang brtan pa'i blo ldan 5bzung / /dang por 'dus pa byas nas ni/ /rdo rje cho ga rab tu bsgrub/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i btsun mo'i mchog /dam tshig chen por byin gyis brlabaca/ /khyogs dang brla 5zhes bya ba dang / /de bzhin shin tu skyang dzo ba dang / /khab dang gru mo'i mtshan nyid bya/ /bung ba lta bur i yi sgra/ /nges par blo dang ldan pas bskul/ /sgeg 'chos nastabs kyis 'khyud nas ni/ /mgo yi skra bzung lkog ma gzir / /ma mchu'i sbrang rtsi gzhib par bya/ /rdo rje 'khyud pas 'khyud pa dang / /rdo rje 'o yis 'o gdab cing / /so dang sen mos bsnun par bya/ /rdo rje pad+mar rab 'jug cing / /sīta kyi sgra rnams byed pa dang / /nu ma 'tshir dang skyes pa'i tshul / /sbyor ba thams cad bya bar bya/ /nu ma sor mo rke rtsadang ma mchu dang / /rna ba mig dang spyi bo bha gar yang ’ / /'o bya rna ba mchan khung rke tshadang rtags/ /sen mos gdab chodabya nu ma mchan khung dang / /mkhur 6tshos 'gram dang rkang lag mthil dag tu/ /nyed dpar bya zhing 'khyud pa'i stabs brgyad bya/ /sor mo ling ga rtse dang lces bskyod nas/ /pad+ma bskul zhing rtsa mchog sad par bya/ /zab ches pa tshadang / shin tu chung ba dang / lhod pa dang / rtsub pa dang /rtag tu 'dzag pa dang / drod dang gsher 7dang bral ba'i bha ga ni spang ngo / /dpangs mtho ba dang / 'jam pa dang / steng mnyam pa dang / kha rgyas shing dam pa dang / khrag dang khu bar ldan pa dang / spu nyung ba dang / dus ma yin 81—983

par mi 'dzag pa dang / ring zhing snying po skum pa ni skal ba bzang mo'o de yongs su bskul bas ji srid du khong nas sīta 1kyi sgra 'byung ba de srid du'o/ /haḥ zhes bya bas mchog tu dga' ba'i tshe bcing bar bya'o/ /yang na/ r+ghaṃ zhes bya ba snying ga la gnas pa'i sgra yis so/ /yang na hri ha zhes bya ba mgrin pa la gnas pa'i sgra yis so/ /hūm̐ dang phaṭaḥ kyi bya ba dang / mda' bo che'i sbyor ba byas la khu ba bcing bar 5bya'o/ /gzhan yang cha bzhi pa'i phyed kyi mtshams su lhan cig skyes pa bsgom par bya ste/ gal te bha ga'i ze'u 'bru la gnas pa'i thig le yang rdo rje'i khas btung bar bya'o/ /skor phyob la sogs pa'i sbyor ba dang / rlung gi sbyor bas mnyam par bya'o/ /'di la dgang 7ba dang / gzhil ba dang /rengs pa dang / bum pa can gyi sbyor bas dag par byas nas/ mi mo rnams 8kyi sbyor ba la 'jug ste/ lus 'di nyid kyis dngos grub thob pa zhes bya'o/ /de las 9dga' ba bzhi'i dbye bas sgrub lapa po la rengs pa dang / rngul ba dang /ba spu ldang ba dang / dbugs 'gyur ba dang / 'dar ba dang / kha dog log pa dang / mchi ma 'byung ba dang / thim pa zhes bya ba ha snying stobs brgyad 'byung ngo / /bu mos ye shes thob pa ni/ /snying ni 'gul zhing bskyod pa dang / /'dar dang dran pa nyams pa dang / /skra grol dzigacer bu gsher bas khyab/ /mdog dmar rab tu phra ba'i mig /ye shes lnga yi rnam par 'phrul/ /bud med shes rab ye shes te/ /de las ye shes lnga thob 'gyur/ /rdo rje chu skyes sbyor ldan pa / /sku yi rdo rje snyan par brjod/ /rlung ni mnyam par gyur pa dang / /sīta lokyi sgra dang skad 'gyur ba/ /gsung ni nye bar sgrub rupa'o/ /skyod dpa las ni rab zhu ba/ /nor bur labacu drug cha babs te/ /yid kyi bde bas gnyis 81—984

'gags pa3)/ /thugs kyi de nyid sgrub tsho par brjod/ /gzhu yi gzugs can rab sbyor bas/ /dung dang kun+da ltar thig le/ /sdom brtson bde bas gzung tsho bar bya/ /rang gis tshogerig pa'i ye shes mchog /grub 55pa chen po'i de nyid de/ /rnam shes ye shes dag par byed/ /'di yis phyirdo rje bdag nyid che/ /sku gsum mi phyed las byung ba'i / /ye shes rgya mtsho 'grub par 'gyur/ /ye shes chen po rab sbyor bas/ /shin tu rnal 'byor mkhas pas bstod/ /bud med sgyu ma'i phyag rgya 'di/ /dam tshig rnams kyi mchog gi mchog /ngan zos ngan spyad tshanathams cad kyis/ /sgrib pa dag tu yongs mi 'gyur/ /de skad ces gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rnal 'byor dang po'i dam tshig go/ /ut+pal mi 'jigs phyag rgya can//phyag gnyis rnal 'byor bsgoms 9byas la/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ /dbus su kun nas zlum po ste//las kyi snam bu lnga dang ldan/ /ut+pal dmar po sil mar dgram / /zla ba nyi ma'i sbyor ba las/ /dam tshig sgrol ma bsam par bya/ /ljang sngon 'od zer dmar po 'khyil/ /mche ba gtsigs pa me stag 'bar/ /mchog sbyin gri gug ḍa 11ma ru/ /mda' dang ut+pal sdong bo tshadang / /thod pa khrag can rtse gsum dang / /bzhi pa me tog gzhu pa'adzin pa'o/ /dur khrod rgyan dang ut+pal rgyan / /g.yas brkyang rol pa'i skyil krung can/ /rang rang sngags las lha mo'i tshogs/ /snying ga'i dbus nas spro bar bya/ /oṃ tā re swā hā/ mig la'o/ /oṃ tustu re swā hā/rna ba la'o/ /oṃ tu swā hā/ lce la'o/ /oṃ re ṭ+wā hā/ snying ga pala'o/ /oṃ tā re ṇi swā hā/ spyi bo la'o/ /sngags kyi bdag pos 7byin rlabs 7dang / /ye shes dam tshig mnyam par bya/ /dbang gi don ni bsgoms 18byas la/ /rang lhar 81—985

sems ni brtan bya'o/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i 3)le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas sgrol mas bka' stsal pa/ oṃ lī māṃ r+pā rta(mi/ rgyu badz+ra a sgyi ṣiñca rtsu/oṃ phroṃ māṃ (gyidzo khaṃ t+t+waṃ/ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñca rtsu/ oṃ lhu khaṃ lhu sa)badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca rgyu / oṃ hūm̐ ṭ+wāṃ gno/ badz+ra a dhi pa ti (ye: a rnyi ṣiñca rtsu/ oṃ dzaḥrgyu baṃ hoḥ badz+ra satwa s+t+waṃ badz+ra nā 97)ma a bhi ṣiñca t+t+waṃ/ dbang bskur ba'i sngags so/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor tshon bri bar bya/ /ka ba brgyad kyis nye bar mdzes/ /thig bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan/ /phyi rol rwa ba me (zhenarir bcas/ /dur khrod dag kyang bri bar bya/ /dbus su ut+pal mthing ga bodagod/ /shar du zhi ba'i ut+pal dang / /byang du bum pa bri bar bya/ /nub tu lcags kyu 'bar ba ste/ /ral gri lho ru dgod par bya / /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang ni/ /gsod byed rnams kyi mtshan ma'o/ /grwa bzhir rigs kyi lha mo ste/ /ut+pal mdzes pa re re bri/ /lcags kyu la sogs sgo ru dgod3lha/ /stobs chen pha rol gnon pa yi/ /khro bo rnams kyang grwar dgod do/ /las rnams byed pa'i lha mo'i tshogs/ /phyi rol dag tu bri bar bya/ /dbus su bdag nyid gnas byas nas/ /rdo rje mtshan ma'i tshogs spros pas/ /sems can khams rnams sbyang bar bya/ /mchod pa'i sprin gyis nam mkha'i khams//mchog tu gang 12ba spro bar bya/ /me tog ga bur ma nyams pa/ /bha ga mchog las yang dag blangs3lha/ /rnal 'byor ma yi 'khor lo namachod/ /yang gsungs pa/sgo tshadagu nges par bkag byas nas/ /rgyas pa lnga yi mchod rten las/ /srog shing rtse mor rang gi sems/ /mda' gzhu'i sbyor bas 'pho bar bya/ /mtshams med lnga po byed pa yang / /'di yis grol 'gyur the tshom med/ /rig pa'i brtul 81—986

zhugs spyad bya ste/ /mi lpags ras rnying bgo ba 'am/ /gcer bu'i brtul zhugs byas nas ni/ /dogs pa'i sems ni kun spangs nas/ /ji lta bur na snang ba 'di/ /'dod spyod bde ba la bsdus nas/ /ngan zos ngan spyod thams cad kyis/ /bla med byang chub bsgrub par bya/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje 17dam tshig go / /gang las slob dpon dbang bskur ba/ /slob dpon gcig tu gyur pa yi/ /sring mo sgrol ma dang mnyam brtag /rdo rje slob dpon de bzhin du/ /rig ma'am bdag ②gi rig ma yang / /slob dpon mchog tu yongs su brjod/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun mnyam pas/ /de yi grib ma'ang 'gong /snenami bya/ /'on kyang dga' ma dges dbang mo/ /gnyis kyi sgo dgu las byung ba/ /mi rtog snod gcig bza' ④ba dang / /gtsang sbra'i sems kyis tsuspa dbul/ /lhan cig mal stan longs spyad (snyenas/ /lag gis rdo rje bzung gsor te/ /yo nir son bya dam 'khyud nas/ /tshig dang yi ges dges bskul bas/ /so dang sen ris 'drud pa dang / /'jib dang sgo yis zas 'bul ba/ /gus dang chags 56bcas bag rkyong bas/ /'gong ba 57)'di la nyes med de/ /slob dpon dges las dngos grub kun/ /bzang mo de yis rtag tu thob/ /yu dza gus pas gzhib pa dang ske/ /phyag bya gal te sems lhungs ༄8)gyur/ /'dab ldan las phyung bza' (9nibar bya/ /yo nis tsā 7ru dbul ba dang / /'khrig thabs 'khrul 'khor nyes med de/ /gang des de nyid mnyes byed pa'o/ /de nas las sna tshogs pa rnams gsungs pa/ phyogs bzhi dang grwa bzhir ut+pa la'i gzugs bya/ re re yang ṭ+wāṃ gsum gyis mtshan pa/ lte ba kun nas zlum po la/ oṃ pra san+da tā re a mṛ ta mu khri /tsho1a mṛ ta lo tsa ne tu sarba arba sā dha ni sarba satwa bā shaṃ ka ri/ sdi 51 bā pu ru kho bā 81—987

rā 51)dzā no bā ba sh+yi 9 ku ru ṭ+wāṃ naswā hā/ zhes pa lte bar bkod la/ 'khor lo rtsibs bcu par pad+ma la yi ge bcu pa'o/ /hriḥ4)gnyis kyi nang tshan du ming chud par byas na dbang du byed do/ /yang na rtsibs brgyad pa yi ge yang brgyad pa ste dbus su zla ba la rlu 6)yig go/ /'khor lo kha sbyor du byas na/ nyi ma bdun na nges par dbang du 'gyur ro/ /yang na rtsibs drug pa yi ge yang drug pa'o/ /dbus su hrīḥri bā shaṃ ku ru hrīḥswā hā/ go ro tsa na dang / tsan+dan dmar po dang / rgya skyegs dang / khrag gis na sgo dza pa tra la bri bar bya ste/ srid pa gsum yang dbang du byed do/ /gur gum la sogs 'khor lo ni/ /rtsibs brgyad mar dang sbrang rtsir bcas/ /kha sbyor sbyor 9bas dbang du byed/ /oṃ khusarba mo hā ni tā re tut+ta re sarba du/ 11mo hā ya bha ga ba tī 12sarba duṣ+ṭa ṭ+wāṃ 1lhabasta brnya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ gos kyi mtha' ni 'dud bobyas na/ /chom rkun 'ching bar byed pa'i mchog /ut+pa la la mngon bsngags pas/ /gang la sbyin tshepa de dbang 'gyur/ /ut+pa las mtshan 'khor lo'o17/ /chu dbus 1 sna tshogs rdo rje'i lter/ /thod les ming mthar hrīḥ12bris la/ /kham phor dbus su bzhag na rengs/ /'dab brgyad pad+mar ga yig nang / /chud cing lte bar ga brgyad bris/ / yungs pas nyu7rdo leb dag la ste/ /kha phub bzhag na shin tu rengs/ /'khor lo de ni dug dang khrag /ske 2 tshotshe mi rus btags pa'i chus/ /thod par hūṃ phaṭa mtshan pa bri 1/ /'di yis nges par gsod par byed/ /gro gar gur gum gyis bris la/ /oṃ bcas me tog ser pos mchod/ /yang na swā hār chud pa bris lha/ /rgyas dang srung lhab byed pa'i mchog /rtsibs bcu a yig nang chud pa/ /tsan+dan chus bri na kham phor bcas / /me tog dri bzang gis mchod na/ /shin tu zhi ba'i las la mchog /81wa 988

gshog par bsngags nas ni/ /dgra bo'i khyim du sbas ①na skyod/ /oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re tsa la pra tsa la shrī sgyu geg mi ni/ de ba dalta ut+ta ṭā la (mi phaṭa/ po sa cha ④dang yungs kur dang / /thang phrom a sho 55)ka'i me tog /'dab bcas sbyin sreg byed pa 'am/ /yang na mngar gsum bsregs (nabyas na/ /nyin bdun bu mo mchog thob 'gyur/ /oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re a mu kā dzodagi dha :me/ ku mā dri(9ra / ma he yurba ༅te na ta suḥ snyi 0ta pra yats+tsha tu 8swā hā/ zla mtshan ras la sgrol ma ni/ /ut+pal zhags pa bsnams pa bri/ /mchod cing sngags hu)stong bzlas nas ni/ /zhags pa lcags kyu'i sbyor bas spyad/ /oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re a mu tī ma me ba si te/ swasna kur+ṇa ka thā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ rag phrug tsher ma zla mtshan bcas/ /sreg blugs 8stong phrag gcig gis ni/ /mi bdag bu mo mchog kyang 'gugs/ /oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re a mu kā bhi dha ṭ+wāṃ 8su s+thā mnā dā /khyo 'iya ma māhi ke dzaḥzla ba gzas 32bzung 'jig rten dbang / /dung dang btags te 'dod mar sbyin / /yang na sbrul mgo gnyis pa'i sha /arka'i bal la dril byas la ba dmar mar khus mig sman bya/ /rdo rje chos dang nyi ma dang / /rta rgyal mchog gi spos bdug nas/ /bltas pas pad+ma gar dbang 'bab/ /ha la ha la'i mjug ma dang / /'jam 'bras rtsang 7pa'i mjug ma dang / /mgron bu ror bcas khu ba 'dzin/ /sdig pa'am sbal pa rmo )zhag gis sam/ /'o ma rnam gsum sbyar ba dang ske/ /a phu mtshal dang sbyar ba ni/ /gu gul bcas pa'i ri lus rdo nyekyang / /rtag tu khu ba rengs par 'gyur/ /oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re sahā 2ra ṇi hrīḥde ba dat+ta wā shaṃ ku ru hoḥ 2 pad+ma lcags gyur ribacas pa yi/ /spu ta liṅgas dgug sogepar bya / /zhags pa lcags kyu bsnams pa yi/ /lha mos 'gugs par byed pa yin/ /81wa 990
